विभुश्चानुग्रहं तत्र कौमारकम् अदीनधीः
पुरस्तादसृजद्देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा //
text_mt: and the pervasive one of undiscouraged mind [created] the grace [creation] there and the youthful [creation]. / At first the god created Sananda, and also Sanaka,

sanskrit_iast:
sanātanaṃ satāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naiṣkarmyeṇa gatāḥ param
marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum //
meaning:
सनातनं सतां श्रेष्ठं नैष्कर्म्येण गताः परम्
मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् //
text_mt: and Sanātana, the best of the virtuous, who reached the supreme through actionlessness; / [and] Marīci, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjad yogavidyayā
saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharmaṃ ca hy adharmaṃ bhagavānprabhuḥ //
meaning:
दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजद् योगविद्यया
संकल्पं चैव धर्मं च ह्य् अधर्मं भगवान्प्रभुः //
text_mt: Dakṣa, Atri, and Vasiṣṭha he created by the knowledge of yoga; / and the blessed lord [created] Saṃkalpa, Dharma, and Adharma.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśaiva prajāstvetā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca sasarjādau sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशैव प्रजास्त्वेता ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च ससर्जादौ सनातनः //
text_mt: These twelve beings were indeed of Brahmā, whose birth is from the unmanifest. / In the beginning the eternal one created Ṛbhu and Sanatkumāra.

sanskrit_iast:
tau cordhvaretasau divyau cāgrajau brahmavādinau
kumārau brahmaṇastulyau sarvajñau sarvabhāvinau //
meaning:
तौ चोर्ध्वरेतसौ दिव्यौ चाग्रजौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ
कुमारौ ब्रह्मणस्तुल्यौ सर्वज्ञौ सर्वभाविनौ //
text_mt: The two were celestial, with upward-drawn semen, the first-born, expounders of the Veda, / two youths equal to Brahmā, all-knowing, observing everything.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mukhyādikān sṛṣṭvā padmayoniḥ śilāśana
yugadharmānaśeṣāṃś ca kalpayāmāsa viśvasṛk //
meaning:
एवं मुख्यादिकान् सृष्ट्वा पद्मयोनिः शिलाशन
युगधर्मानशेषांश् च कल्पयामास विश्वसृक् //
text_mt: Having thus created the chief and other [creations], O eater of stones, / the creator of the universe, the lotus-born one, fashioned all the duties of the yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
śrutvā śakreṇa kathitaṃ pitā mama mahāmuniḥ
punaḥ papraccha deveśaṃ praṇamya racitāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
श्रुत्वा शक्रेण कथितं पिता मम महामुनिः
पुनः पप्रच्छ देवेशं प्रणम्य रचिताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Śailādi said: / Having heard what was told by Śakra, my father, the great sage, / having bowed with hands joined in reverence, asked the lord of the gods again:

sanskrit_iast:
śilāda uvāca
bhagavan śakra sarvajña devadevanamaskṛta
śacīpate jagannātha sahasrākṣa maheśvara //
meaning:
शिलाद उवाच
भगवन् शक्र सर्वज्ञ देवदेवनमस्कृत
शचीपते जगन्नाथ सहस्राक्ष महेश्वर //
text_mt: Śilāda said: / 'O blessed Śakra, all-knowing one, bowed to by the god of gods, / husband of Śacī, Lord of the Universe, thousand-eyed one, great lord!

sanskrit_iast:
yugadharmānkathaṃ cakre bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ
vaktumarhasi me sarvaṃ sāṃprataṃ praṇatāya me //
meaning:
युगधर्मान्कथं चक्रे भगवान्पद्मसंभवः
वक्तुमर्हसि मे सर्वं सांप्रतं प्रणताय मे //
text_mt: How did the blessed lotus-born one institute the duties of the yugas? / You ought to tell me everything now, as I am bowed down before you.'

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śilādasya mahātmanaḥ
vyājahāra yathādṛṣṭaṃ yugadharmaṃ suvistaram //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शिलादस्य महात्मनः
व्याजहार यथादृष्टं युगधर्मं सुविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Śailādi said: / Having heard those words of the great-souled Śilāda, / he proclaimed in detail the duty of the yuga, as it had been seen.

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ viddhi tatastretāyugaṃ mune
dvāparaṃ tiṣyamityete catvārastu samāsataḥ //
meaning:
शक्र उवाच
आद्यं कृतयुगं विद्धि ततस्त्रेतायुगं मुने
द्वापरं तिष्यमित्येते चत्वारस्तु समासतः //
text_mt: Śakra said: / 'Know the first to be the Kṛta Yuga; after that is the Tretā Yuga, O sage; / Dvāpara and Tiṣya: these four [are known] in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā dvāparaṃ ca rajastamaḥ
kalistamaś ca vijñeyaṃ yugavṛttiryugeṣu ca //
meaning:
सत्त्वं कृतं रजस्त्रेता द्वापरं च रजस्तमः
कलिस्तमश् च विज्ञेयं युगवृत्तिर्युगेषु च //
text_mt: Kṛta is sattva; Tretā is rajas; Dvāpara is rajas and tamas; / and Kali should be known as tamas; [such is] the course of the yugas in the yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ yajña ucyate
bhajanaṃ dvāpare śuddhaṃ dānameva kalau yuge //
meaning:
ध्यानं परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते
भजनं द्वापरे शुद्धं दानमेव कलौ युगे //
text_mt: Meditation is supreme in the Kṛta Yuga; in Tretā, sacrifice is said [to be supreme]; / pure worship in Dvāpara; and giving alone in the Kali Yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारि च सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम्
तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश् च तथाविधः //
text_mt: Four thousand years: that is the Kṛta Yuga; / its dawn twilight is as many hundred [years], and its dusk twilight is likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri ca sahasrāṇi mānuṣāṇi śilāśana
āyuḥ kṛtayuge viddhi prajānāmiha suvrata //
meaning:
चत्वारि च सहस्राणि मानुषाणि शिलाशन
आयुः कृतयुगे विद्धि प्रजानामिह सुव्रत //
text_mt: Know that the lifespan of human beings in the Kṛta yuga, / O Śilāśana of good vows, is four thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛtayuge tasmin saṃdhyāṃśe ca gate tu vai
pādāvaśiṣṭo bhavati yugadharmastu sarvataḥ //
meaning:
ततः कृतयुगे तस्मिन् संध्यांशे च गते तु वै
पादावशिष्टो भवति युगधर्मस्तु सर्वतः //
text_mt: Then, when that Kṛta yuga and its dusk twilight have passed, / only one quarter of the dharma of the yuga remains everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhāgaikahīnaṃ tu tretāyugamanuttamam
kṛtārdhaṃ dvāparaṃ viddhi tadardhaṃ tiṣyamucyate //
meaning:
चतुर्भागैकहीनं तु त्रेतायुगमनुत्तमम्
कृतार्धं द्वापरं विद्धि तदर्धं तिष्यमुच्यते //
text_mt: The peerless Tretā yuga is diminished by one fourth; / know Dvāpara to be half of Kṛta, and half of that is called Tiṣya [Kali].

sanskrit_iast:
triśatī dviśatī saṃdhyā tathā caikaśatī mune
saṃdhyāṃśakaṃ tathāpyevaṃ kalpeṣvevaṃ yuge yuge //
meaning:
त्रिशती द्विशती संध्या तथा चैकशती मुने
संध्यांशकं तथाप्येवं कल्पेष्वेवं युगे युगे //
text_mt: Its dawn twilight is three hundred, two hundred, and one hundred [years], O sage, / and likewise its dusk twilight; so it is in every kalpa, in every yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
ādye kṛtayuge dharmaś catuṣpādaḥ sanātanaḥ
tretāyuge tripādastu dvipādo dvāpare sthitaḥ //
meaning:
आद्ये कृतयुगे धर्मश् चतुष्पादः सनातनः
त्रेतायुगे त्रिपादस्तु द्विपादो द्वापरे स्थितः //
text_mt: In the first, the Kṛta yuga, eternal dharma has four quarters; / in the Tretā yuga it has three quarters, and in Dvāpara it stands on two quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
tripādahīnastiṣye tu sattāmātreṇa dhiṣṭhitaḥ
kṛte tu mithunotpattir vṛttiḥ sākṣādrasollasā //
meaning:
त्रिपादहीनस्तिष्ये तु सत्तामात्रेण धिष्ठितः
कृते तु मिथुनोत्पत्तिर् वृत्तिः साक्षाद्रसोल्लसा //
text_mt: In Tiṣya it is deprived of three quarters, standing merely by existence. / But in Kṛta there is birth in pairs; sustenance arises directly from the exuberance of the essence [of earth].

sanskrit_iast:
prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sarvānandāś ca bhoginaḥ
adhamottamatā tāsāṃ na viśeṣāḥ prajāḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
प्रजास्तृप्ताः सदा सर्वाः सर्वानन्दाश् च भोगिनः
अधमोत्तमता तासां न विशेषाः प्रजाः शुभाः //
text_mt: All the creatures were always satisfied, completely joyful, and experiencing pleasures. / There was no distinction among them of lower or higher; the creatures were fortunate.

sanskrit_iast:
tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasminkṛte yuge
tāsāṃ prītirna ca dvandvaṃ na dveṣo nāsti ca klamaḥ //
meaning:
तुल्यमायुः सुखं रूपं तासां तस्मिन्कृते युगे
तासां प्रीतिर्न च द्वन्द्वं न द्वेषो नास्ति च क्लमः //
text_mt: Their lifespan, happiness, and appearance were equal in that Kṛta yuga; / they had affection, no pairs of opposites, no hatred, and no exhaustion.

sanskrit_iast:
parvatodadhivāsinyo hy aniketāśrayāstu tāḥ
viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntabahulās tathā //
meaning:
पर्वतोदधिवासिन्यो ह्य् अनिकेताश्रयास्तु ताः
विशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला एकान्तबहुलास् तथा //
text_mt: Dwelling on mountains and shores of oceans, they had no houses for shelter; / free from grief, they were rich in sattva, and rich in solitude.

sanskrit_iast:
tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ
apravṛttiḥ kṛtayuge karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ //
meaning:
ता वै निष्कामचारिण्यो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः
अप्रवृत्तिः कृतयुगे कर्मणोः शुभपापयोः //
text_mt: They moved about free of desire, their minds always delighted; / in the Kṛta yuga there was no engagement in good or evil deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramavyavasthā ca tadāsīnna ca saṃkaraḥ
rasollāsaḥ kālayogāt tretākhye naśyate dvija //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्था च तदासीन्न च संकरः
रसोल्लासः कालयोगात् त्रेताख्ये नश्यते द्विज //
text_mt: The system of castes and stages of life did not exist then, nor was there confusion [of castes]. / Due to the effect of time, the exuberance of the essence is destroyed in the age called Tretā, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ siddhau pranaṣṭāyām anyā siddhiḥ prajāyate
apāṃ saukṣmye pratigate tadā meghātmanā tu vai //
meaning:
तस्यां सिद्धौ प्रनष्टायाम् अन्या सिद्धिः प्रजायते
अपां सौक्ष्म्ये प्रतिगते तदा मेघात्मना तु वै //
text_mt: When that perfection was destroyed, another perfection arose: / when the subtlety of the waters departed, [it appeared] then in the form of clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
meghebhyastanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam
sakṛd eva tathā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale //
meaning:
मेघेभ्यस्तनयित्नुभ्यः प्रवृत्तं वृष्टिसर्जनम्
सकृद् एव तथा वृष्ट्या संयुक्ते पृथिवीतले //
text_mt: From the thundering clouds the release of rain began; / as soon as the surface of the earth was joined with that rain,

sanskrit_iast:
prādurāsaṃstadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
sarvavṛttyupabhogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate //
meaning:
प्रादुरासंस्तदा तासां वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः
सर्ववृत्त्युपभोगस्तु तासां तेभ्यः प्रजायते //
text_mt: there appeared for them those trees known as 'houses'; / and from them arose every kind of livelihood and enjoyment for them.

sanskrit_iast:
vartayanti sma tebhyastās tretāyugamukhe prajāḥ
tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyayāt //
meaning:
वर्तयन्ति स्म तेभ्यस्तास् त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रजाः
ततः कालेन महता तासामेव विपर्ययात् //
text_mt: The creatures maintained their lives from them at the beginning of the Tretā yuga. / Then, through a great lapse of time, due to a transformation in those very [creatures],

sanskrit_iast:
rāgalobhātmako bhāvas tadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat
viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena tatkālabhāvinā //
meaning:
रागलोभात्मको भावस् तदा ह्याकस्मिको ऽभवत्
विपर्ययेण तासां तु तेन तत्कालभाविना //
text_mt: a disposition consisting of passion and greed suddenly arose. / Through that transformation of theirs occurring at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā maithunodbhavāḥ //
meaning:
प्रणश्यन्ति ततः सर्वे वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः
ततस्तेषु प्रनष्टेषु विभ्रान्ता मैथुनोद्भवाः //
text_mt: all those trees known as 'houses' then perished. / Then, when they had perished, those born of sexual union were bewildered.

sanskrit_iast:
api dhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā
prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
अपि ध्यायन्ति तां सिद्धिं सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा
प्रादुर्बभूवुस्तासां तु वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: Meditating upon truth, they then meditated upon that perfection, / and those trees known as 'houses' appeared again for them.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrāṇi te prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca
teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam //
meaning:
वस्त्राणि ते प्रसूयन्ते फलान्याभरणानि च
तेष्वेव जायते तासां गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम् //
text_mt: They produced garments, fruits, and ornaments; / and right on them arose for them, endowed with fragrance, colour, and taste,

sanskrit_iast:
amākṣikaṃ mahīvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu
tena tā vartayanti sma sukhamāyuḥ sadaiva hi //
meaning:
अमाक्षिकं महीवीर्यं पुटके पुटके मधु
तेन ता वर्तयन्ति स्म सुखमायुः सदैव हि //
text_mt: honey made without bees, the great potency of the earth, in every calyx. / By that they always maintained their lifespan in happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā prajā vai vigatajvarāḥ
tataḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstu tāḥ //
meaning:
हृष्टपुष्टास्तया सिद्ध्या प्रजा वै विगतज्वराः
ततः कालान्तरेणैव पुनर्लोभावृतास्तु ताः //
text_mt: Delighted and nourished by that perfection, the creatures were indeed free from suffering. / Then, in the course of time, overcome again by greed,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāṃstānparyagṛhṇanti madhu vā mākṣikaṃ balāt
tāsāṃ tenopacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai //
meaning:
वृक्षांस्तान्पर्यगृह्णन्ति मधु वा माक्षिकं बलात्
तासां तेनोपचारेण पुनर्लोभकृतेन वै //
text_mt: they seized those trees and took the honey by force. / Due to that conduct of theirs, caused again by greed,

sanskrit_iast:
pranaṣṭā madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacitkvacit
tasyāmevālpaśiṣṭāyāṃ siddhyāṃ kālavaśāttadā //
meaning:
प्रनष्टा मधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षाः क्वचित्क्वचित्
तस्यामेवाल्पशिष्टायां सिद्ध्यां कालवशात्तदा //
text_mt: the wish-fulfilling trees vanished here and there along with the honey. / When only a little of that perfection was left, then, under the influence of time,

sanskrit_iast:
āvartanāttu tretāyāṃ dvandvānyabhyutthitāni vai
śītavarṣātapaistīvrais tatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam //
meaning:
आवर्तनात्तु त्रेतायां द्वन्द्वान्यभ्युत्थितानि वै
शीतवर्षातपैस्तीव्रैस् ततस्ता दुःखिता भृशम् //
text_mt: pairs of opposites arose from the revolution of the Tretā [yuga]; / they then became intensely miserable through severe cold, rain, and heat.

sanskrit_iast:
dvandvaiḥ sampīḍyamānāś ca cakrur āvaraṇāni tu
kṛtadvandvapratīghātāḥ ketanāni girau tataḥ //
meaning:
द्वन्द्वैः सम्पीड्यमानाश् च चक्रुर् आवरणानि तु
कृतद्वन्द्वप्रतीघाताः केतनानि गिरौ ततः //
text_mt: Afflicted by the pairs of opposites, they made shelters; / having warded off the pairs of opposites, [they made] houses on the mountain then.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ nikāmacārāstā hy aniketā athāvasan
yathāyogaṃ yathāprīti niketeṣvavasanpunaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वं निकामचारास्ता ह्य् अनिकेता अथावसन्
यथायोगं यथाप्रीति निकेतेष्ववसन्पुनः //
text_mt: Previously moving at will, they had lived without houses; / then they lived again in houses, according to suitability and preference.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā dvandvopaghātāṃstān vṛttyupāyamacintayan
naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā //
meaning:
कृत्वा द्वन्द्वोपघातांस्तान् वृत्त्युपायमचिन्तयन्
नष्टेषु मधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षेषु वै तदा //
text_mt: Having countered those pairs of opposites, they thought of means of sustenance. / When the wish-fulfilling trees had perished along with the honey at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
vivādavyākulāstā vai prajāstṛṣṇākṣudhārditāḥ
tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ //
meaning:
विवादव्याकुलास्ता वै प्रजास्तृष्णाक्षुधार्दिताः
ततः प्रादुर्बभौ तासां सिद्धिस्त्रेतायुगे पुनः //
text_mt: the creatures, bewildered by dispute, were tormented by thirst and hunger. / Then perfection manifested again for them in the Tretā yuga:

sanskrit_iast:
vārtāyāḥ sādhikāpyanyā vṛṣṭistāsāṃ nikāmataḥ
tāsāṃ vṛṣṭyudakādīni hy abhavannimnagāni tu //
meaning:
वार्तायाः साधिकाप्यन्या वृष्टिस्तासां निकामतः
तासां वृष्ट्युदकादीनि ह्य् अभवन्निम्नगानि तु //
text_mt: another rain, achieving livelihood for them according to their desire. / From the rainwater of those [clouds] arose rivers;

sanskrit_iast:
abhavanvṛṣṭisaṃtatyā srotasthānāni nimnagāḥ
evaṃ nadyaḥ pravṛttāstu dvitīye vṛṣṭisarjane //
meaning:
अभवन्वृष्टिसंतत्या स्रोतस्थानानि निम्नगाः
एवं नद्यः प्रवृत्तास्तु द्वितीये वृष्टिसर्जने //
text_mt: from the continuous stream of rain, low-flowing streams and water-courses arose. / Thus rivers began in the second release of rain.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punastadapāṃ stokāḥ patitāḥ pṛthivītale
apāṃ bhūmeś ca saṃyogād oṣadhyastāstadābhavan //
meaning:
ये पुनस्तदपां स्तोकाः पतिताः पृथिवीतले
अपां भूमेश् च संयोगाद् ओषध्यस्तास्तदाभवन् //
text_mt: Moreover, the drops of that water which fell upon the surface of the earth, / from the union of the water and the earth, then became plants.

sanskrit_iast:
athālpakṛṣṭāścānuptā grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa
ṛtupuṣpaphalāścaiva vṛkṣagulmāś ca jajñire //
meaning:
अथाल्पकृष्टाश्चानुप्ता ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश
ऋतुपुष्पफलाश्चैव वृक्षगुल्माश् च जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Then arose fourteen [kinds of] cultivated and wild [plants], produced with little plowing and unsown, / flowering and fruiting according to the season, as well as trees and shrubs.

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhūtāni caitāni vṛkṣajātyauṣadhāni ca
tenauṣadhena vartante prajāstretāyuge tadā //
meaning:
प्रादुर्भूतानि चैतानि वृक्षजात्यौषधानि च
तेनौषधेन वर्तन्ते प्रजास्त्रेतायुगे तदा //
text_mt: When these plants and varieties of trees had appeared, / the creatures then maintained themselves by means of those plants in the Tretā yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ punarabhūttāsāṃ rāgo lobhaś ca sarvaśaḥ
avaśyaṃ bhāvinārthena tretāyugavaśena ca //
meaning:
ततः पुनरभूत्तासां रागो लोभश् च सर्वशः
अवश्यं भाविनार्थेन त्रेतायुगवशेन च //
text_mt: Then passion and greed arose once more everywhere among them, / through an inevitable outcome and under the influence of the Tretā yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān
vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam //
meaning:
ततस्ताः पर्यगृह्णन्त नदीक्षेत्राणि पर्वतान्
वृक्षगुल्मौषधीश्चैव प्रसह्य तु यथाबलम् //
text_mt: Then they forcefully seized rivers, fields, and mountains, / and trees, shrubs, and plants, according to their strength.

sanskrit_iast:
viparyayeṇa cauṣadhyaḥ pranaṣṭāstāścaturdaśa
matvā dharāṃ praviṣṭāstā ityauṣadhyaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
विपर्ययेण चौषध्यः प्रनष्टास्ताश्चतुर्दश
मत्वा धरां प्रविष्टास्ता इत्यौषध्यः पितामहः //
text_mt: And due to that perversion, those fourteen kinds of plants vanished. / Thinking that they, the plants, had entered the earth, Pitāmaha

sanskrit_iast:
dudoha gāṃ prayatnena sarvabhūtahitāya vai
tadāprabhṛti cauṣadhyaḥ phālakṛṣṭāstvitastataḥ //
meaning:
दुदोह गां प्रयत्नेन सर्वभूतहिताय वै
तदाप्रभृति चौषध्यः फालकृष्टास्त्वितस्ततः //
text_mt: milked the earth with effort for the welfare of all beings. / From that time onward, plants are cultivated by plows here and there.

sanskrit_iast:
vārtāṃ kṛṣiṃ samāyātā vartukāmāḥ prayatnataḥ
vārtā vṛttiḥ samākhyātā kṛṣikāmaprayatnataḥ //
meaning:
वार्तां कृषिं समायाता वर्तुकामाः प्रयत्नतः
वार्ता वृत्तिः समाख्याता कृषिकामप्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: Desiring to maintain themselves, they undertook agriculture as a livelihood with effort. / Livelihood is declared to be occupation, [undertaken] with effort from the desire for agriculture.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā jīvitaṃ tāsāṃ nāsti tretāyugātyaye
hastodbhavā hyapaścaiva bhavanti bahuśastadā //
meaning:
अन्यथा जीवितं तासां नास्ति त्रेतायुगात्यये
हस्तोद्भवा ह्यपश्चैव भवन्ति बहुशस्तदा //
text_mt: Otherwise there was no survival for them at the end of the Tretā yuga. / Then also the waters produced by hands become manifold.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi jagṛhuḥ sarve cānyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ
sutadāradhanādyāṃstu balādyugabalena tu //
meaning:
तत्रापि जगृहुः सर्वे चान्योन्यं क्रोधमूर्छिताः
सुतदारधनाद्यांस्तु बलाद्युगबलेन तु //
text_mt: There too, all of them, senseless with anger, seized each other's / sons, wives, wealth, and the like, by force, through the power of the yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ jñātvā tadakhilaṃ vibhuḥ
sasarja kṣatriyāṃstrātuṃ kṣatātkamalasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
मर्यादायाः प्रतिष्ठार्थं ज्ञात्वा तदखिलं विभुः
ससर्ज क्षत्रियांस्त्रातुं क्षतात्कमलसंभवः //
text_mt: Knowing all that, the lord who was born from the lotus created / Kṣatriyas to protect [the people] from injury, in order to establish order.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramapratiṣṭhāṃ ca cakāra svena tejasā
vṛttena vṛttinā vṛttaṃ viśvātmā nirmame svayam //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमप्रतिष्ठां च चकार स्वेन तेजसा
वृत्तेन वृत्तिना वृत्तं विश्वात्मा निर्ममे स्वयम् //
text_mt: And by his own splendour he established the castes and stages of life. / The Soul of the Universe himself ordained conduct through proper livelihood and behaviour.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñapravartanaṃ caiva tretāyāmabhavatkramāt
paśuyajñaṃ na sevante kecittatrāpi suvratāḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञप्रवर्तनं चैव त्रेतायामभवत्क्रमात्
पशुयज्ञं न सेवन्ते केचित्तत्रापि सुव्रताः //
text_mt: And the institution of sacrifice also came about in the Tretā in due course. / Even then, some who had good vows did not engage in animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
balādviṣṇustadā yajñam akarotsarvadṛk kramāt
dvijāstadā praśaṃsanti tatastvāhiṃsakaṃ mune //
meaning:
बलाद्विष्णुस्तदा यज्ञम् अकरोत्सर्वदृक् क्रमात्
द्विजास्तदा प्रशंसन्ति ततस्त्वाहिंसकं मुने //
text_mt: Then the all-seeing Viṣṇu performed the sacrifice by force in due order; / then the twice-born praised non-injury, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāpareṣvapi vartante matibhedāstadā nṛṇām
manasā karmaṇā vācā kṛcchrādvārtā prasidhyati //
meaning:
द्वापरेष्वपि वर्तन्ते मतिभेदास्तदा नृणाम्
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा कृच्छ्राद्वार्ता प्रसिध्यति //
text_mt: In the Dvāpara [yugas], differences of intellect arise among men; / livelihood is accomplished with difficulty through mind, deed, and speech.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu sarvabhūtānāṃ kāyakleśavaśātkramāt
lobho bhṛtirvaṇigyuddhaṃ tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ //
meaning:
तदा तु सर्वभूतानां कायक्लेशवशात्क्रमात्
लोभो भृतिर्वणिग्युद्धं तत्त्वानामविनिश्चयः //
text_mt: Then, for all beings, in due order, because of bodily affliction, / greed, wage-labour, trade, war, and uncertainty regarding truths arise;

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ dharmāṇāṃ saṃkaras tathā
varṇāśramaparidhvaṃsaḥ kāmadveṣau tathaiva ca //
meaning:
वेदशाखाप्रणयनं धर्माणां संकरस् तथा
वर्णाश्रमपरिध्वंसः कामद्वेषौ तथैव च //
text_mt: [as well as] the arrangement of Vedic branches, confusion of dharmas, / destruction of castes and stages of life, and desire and hatred likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāpare tu pravartante rāgo lobho madas tathā
vedo vyāsaiścaturdhā tu vyasyate dvāparādiṣu //
meaning:
द्वापरे तु प्रवर्तन्ते रागो लोभो मदस् तथा
वेदो व्यासैश्चतुर्धा तु व्यस्यते द्वापरादिषु //
text_mt: In the Dvāpara, passion, greed, and pride arise. / The Veda is divided into four by Vyāsas in the Dvāparas and other [ages].

sanskrit_iast:
eko vedaścatuṣpādas tretāsviha vidhīyate
saṃkṣayādāyuṣaścaiva vyasyate dvāpareṣu saḥ //
meaning:
एको वेदश्चतुष्पादस् त्रेतास्विह विधीयते
संक्षयादायुषश्चैव व्यस्यते द्वापरेषु सः //
text_mt: One four-footed Veda is ordained in the Tretā [yugas] here; / on account of the decline of lifespan, it is divided in the Dvāpara [yugas].

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiputraiḥ punarbhedā bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ
mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिपुत्रैः पुनर्भेदा भिद्यन्ते दृष्टिविभ्रमैः
मन्त्रब्राह्मणविन्यासैः स्वरवर्णविपर्ययैः //
text_mt: Then divisions are made by the sons of sages through delusions of vision, / through arrangements of mantras and brāhmaṇas, and inversions of accents and syllables.'

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ saṃhanyante manīṣibhiḥ
sāmānyā vaikṛtāścaiva draṣṭṛbhistaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak //
meaning:
संहिता ऋग्यजुःसाम्नां संहन्यन्ते मनीषिभिः
सामान्या वैकृताश्चैव द्रष्टृभिस्तैः पृथक्पृथक् //
text_mt: The Saṃhitās of the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma Vedas were compiled by the wise; / the general and modified forms were arranged separately by those seers.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca
anye tu prasthitāstānvai kecittānpratyavasthitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं कल्पसूत्राणि मन्त्रप्रवचनानि च
अन्ये तु प्रस्थितास्तान्वै केचित्तान्प्रत्यवस्थिताः //
text_mt: The Brāhmaṇa, the Kalpasūtras, and the expositions of the mantras— / some scholars supported them, while others opposed them.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇāni bhidyante kālagauravāt
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā //
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणानि भिद्यन्ते कालगौरवात्
ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा //
text_mt: The Itihāsas and Purāṇas became divided through the weight of time: / the Brāhma, the Pādma, the Vaiṣṇava, the Śaiva, and likewise the Bhāgavata;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyamataḥ param
āgneyaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgaṃ vārāhameva ca //
meaning:
भविष्यं नारदीयं च मार्कण्डेयमतः परम्
आग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गं वाराहमेव च //
text_mt: the Bhaviṣya, the Nāradīya, and next the Mārkaṇḍeya; / the Āgneya, the Brahmavaivarta, the Laiṅga, and also the Vārāha;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanākhyaṃ tataḥ kūrmaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍameva ca
skāndaṃ tathā ca brahmāṇḍaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaḥ prakathyate //
meaning:
वामनाख्यं ततः कूर्मं मात्स्यं गारुडमेव च
स्कान्दं तथा च ब्रह्माण्डं तेषां भेदः प्रकथ्यते //
text_mt: then the one named Vāmana, the Kūrma, the Mātsya, and the Gāruḍa; / likewise the Skānda and the Brahmāṇḍa. Their division is recounted [as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
laiṅgam ekādaśavidhaṃ prabhinnaṃ dvāpare śubham
manvatriviṣṇuhārītayājñavalkyośano 'ṅgirāḥ //
meaning:
लैङ्गम् एकादशविधं प्रभिन्नं द्वापरे शुभम्
मन्वत्रिविष्णुहारीतयाज्ञवल्क्योशनो ऽङ्गिराः //
text_mt: The auspicious Laiṅga was divided into eleven parts in Dvāpara. / Manu, Atri, Viṣṇu, Hārīta, Yājñavalkya, Uśanas, Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast:
yamāpastambasaṃvartāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī
parāśaravyāsaśaṅkhalikhitā dakṣagautamau //
meaning:
यमापस्तम्बसंवर्ताः कात्यायनबृहस्पती
पराशरव्यासशङ्खलिखिता दक्षगौतमौ //
text_mt: Yama, Āpastamba, Saṃvarta, Kātyāyana, Bṛhaspati, / Parāśara, Vyāsa, Śaṅkha, Likhita, Dakṣa, Gautama,

sanskrit_iast:
śātātapo vasiṣṭhaś ca evamādyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ
avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathā vyādhyādyupadravāḥ //
meaning:
शातातपो वसिष्ठश् च एवमाद्यैः सहस्रशः
अवृष्टिर्मरणं चैव तथा व्याध्याद्युपद्रवाः //
text_mt: Śātātapa, and Vasiṣṭha—through these and thousands of others, [smṛtis were taught]. / Drought, death, and afflictions such as diseases [arise];

sanskrit_iast:
vāṅmanaḥkarmajair duḥkhair nirvedo jāyate tataḥ
nirvedājjāyate teṣāṃ duḥkhamokṣavicāraṇā //
meaning:
वाङ्मनःकर्मजैर् दुःखैर् निर्वेदो जायते ततः
निर्वेदाज्जायते तेषां दुःखमोक्षविचारणा //
text_mt: then, from sorrows born of speech, mind, and action, world-weariness is born. / From world-weariness arises their inquiry into release from sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
vicāraṇācca vairāgyaṃ vairāgyāddoṣadarśanam
doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva dvāpare jñānasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
विचारणाच्च वैराग्यं वैराग्याद्दोषदर्शनम्
दोषाणां दर्शनाच्चैव द्वापरे ज्ञानसंभवः //
text_mt: From inquiry comes detachment, from detachment the perception of defects, / and from the perception of defects, knowledge arises in the Dvāpara [yuga].

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā rajastamoyuktā vṛttir vai dvāpare smṛtā
ādye kṛte tu dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravartate //
meaning:
एषा रजस्तमोयुक्ता वृत्तिर् वै द्वापरे स्मृता
आद्ये कृते तु धर्मो ऽस्ति स त्रेतायां प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: This way of life is remembered as endowed with rajas and tamas in Dvāpara. / In the first [yuga], Kṛta, dharma is present; it proceeds in Tretā;

sanskrit_iast: dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge //
meaning: द्वापरे व्याकुलीभूत्वा प्रणश्यति कलौ युगे //
text_mt: becoming perturbed in Dvāpara, it perishes in the Kali yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca
tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ caiva tapasvinām
sādhayanti narāstatra tamasā vyākulendriyāḥ //
meaning:
शक्र उवाच
तिष्ये मायामसूयां च वधं चैव तपस्विनाम्
साधयन्ति नरास्तत्र तमसा व्याकुलेन्द्रियाः //
text_mt: Śakra said: / In the Kali [age], men whose senses are perturbed by tamas practice / deceit, malice, and the murder of ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
kalau pramādako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayāni ca
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ //
meaning:
कलौ प्रमादको रोगः सततं क्षुद्भयानि च
अनावृष्टिभयं घोरं देशानां च विपर्ययः //
text_mt: In Kali, there is constant pestilence, disease, fear of starvation, / the terrible fear of drought, and ruin of lands.

sanskrit_iast:
na prāmāṇyaṃ śruterasti nṛṇāṃ cādharmasevanam
adhārmikāstvanācārā mahākopālpacetasaḥ //
meaning:
न प्रामाण्यं श्रुतेरस्ति नृणां चाधर्मसेवनम्
अधार्मिकास्त्वनाचारा महाकोपाल्पचेतसः //
text_mt: There is no authority in the Veda, and men engage in unrighteousness; / they become unrighteous, ill-behaved, highly wrathful, and small-minded.

sanskrit_iast:
anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhās tiṣye jātāś ca duṣprajāḥ
duriṣṭairduradhītaiś ca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ //
meaning:
अनृतं ब्रुवते लुब्धास् तिष्ये जाताश् च दुष्प्रजाः
दुरिष्टैर्दुरधीतैश् च दुराचारैर्दुरागमैः //
text_mt: Born in the Kali [age], greedy and wicked people speak falsehood; / with improper sacrifices, improper study, bad conduct, and false doctrines,

sanskrit_iast:
viprāṇāṃ karma doṣeṇa prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam
nādhīyante tadā vedān na yajanti dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
विप्राणां कर्म दोषेण प्रजानां जायते भयम्
नाधीयन्ते तदा वेदान् न यजन्ति द्विजातयः //
text_mt: through the flawed deeds of the brāhmaṇas, fear arises among the subjects. / Then the twice-born do not study the Vedas, nor do they sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
utsīdanti narāścaiva kṣatriyāś ca viśaḥ kramāt
śūdrāṇāṃ mantrayogena saṃbandho brāhmaṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
उत्सीदन्ति नराश्चैव क्षत्रियाश् च विशः क्रमात्
शूद्राणां मन्त्रयोगेन संबन्धो ब्राह्मणैः सह //
text_mt: Men fall into ruin, the kṣatriyas and vaiśyas in turn; / an association of śūdras with brāhmaṇas by means of mantras

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatīha kalau tasmiñ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ
rājānaḥ śūdrabhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇān bādhayanti te //
meaning:
भवतीह कलौ तस्मिञ् शयनासनभोजनैः
राजानः शूद्रभूयिष्ठा ब्राह्मणान् बाधयन्ति ते //
text_mt: takes place here in that Kali, in sharing beds, seats, and food. / The kings are mostly śūdras; they oppress the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā prajāyante prajāsu vai
śūdrāś ca brāhmaṇācārāḥ śūdrācārāś ca brāhmaṇāḥ //
meaning:
भ्रूणहत्या वीरहत्या प्रजायन्ते प्रजासु वै
शूद्राश् च ब्राह्मणाचाराः शूद्राचाराश् च ब्राह्मणाः //
text_mt: Destruction of embryos and killing of heroes arise among the people. / Śūdras take up the conduct of brāhmaṇas, and brāhmaṇas the conduct of śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
rājavṛttisthitāś caurāś caurācārāś ca pārthivāḥ
ekapatnyo na śiṣyanti vardhiṣyantyabhisārikāḥ //
meaning:
राजवृत्तिस्थिताश् चौराश् चौराचाराश् च पार्थिवाः
एकपत्न्यो न शिष्यन्ति वर्धिष्यन्त्यभिसारिकाः //
text_mt: Thieves abide in the conduct of kings, and rulers adopt the conduct of thieves. / Faithful wives will not remain; courtesans will increase.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramapratiṣṭhāno jāyate nṛṣu sarvataḥ
tadā svalpaphalā bhūmiḥ kvaciccāpi mahāphalā //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमप्रतिष्ठानो जायते नृषु सर्वतः
तदा स्वल्पफला भूमिः क्वचिच्चापि महाफला //
text_mt: The [destruction of the] stability of the classes and life-stages occurs everywhere among men. / Then the earth yields little fruit, though in some places it yields great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
arakṣitāro hartāraḥ pārthivāś ca śilāśana
śūdrā vai jñāninaḥ sarve brāhmaṇairabhivanditāḥ //
meaning:
अरक्षितारो हर्तारः पार्थिवाश् च शिलाशन
शूद्रा वै ज्ञानिनः सर्वे ब्राह्मणैरभिवन्दिताः //
text_mt: The rulers are no protectors, but plundering thieves, O Śilāśana! / Śūdras become all-knowing, saluted by brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣatriyāś ca rājāno viprāḥ śūdropajīvinaḥ
āsanasthā dvijāndṛṣṭvā na calantyalpabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
अक्षत्रियाश् च राजानो विप्राः शूद्रोपजीविनः
आसनस्था द्विजान्दृष्ट्वा न चलन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः //
text_mt: Non-kṣatriyas become kings, and brāhmaṇas live at the expense of śūdras. / Sitting upon their seats, the foolish ones do not rise when seeing the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍayanti dvijendrāṃś ca śūdrā vai svalpabuddhayaḥ
āsye nidhāya vai hastaṃ karṇaṃ śūdrasya vai dvijāḥ //
meaning:
ताडयन्ति द्विजेन्द्रांश् च शूद्रा वै स्वल्पबुद्धयः
आस्ये निधाय वै हस्तं कर्णं शूद्रस्य वै द्विजाः //
text_mt: Indeed, foolish śūdras beat the chief twice-born. / Placing a hand over their mouths, the twice-born into the ear of a śūdra,

sanskrit_iast:
nīcasyeva tadā vākyaṃ vadanti vinayena tam
uccāsanasthān śūdrāṃś ca dvijamadhye dvijarṣabha //
meaning:
नीचस्येव तदा वाक्यं वदन्ति विनयेन तम्
उच्चासनस्थान् शूद्रांश् च द्विजमध्ये द्विजर्षभ //
text_mt: as though speaking to a low-born man, address words to him with humility. / When śūdras sit upon high seats in the midst of twice-born, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā kalau kālavaśena tu
puṣpaiś ca vāsitaiścaiva tathānyair maṅgalaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा न हिंसते राजा कलौ कालवशेन तु
पुष्पैश् च वासितैश्चैव तथान्यैर् मङ्गलैः शुभैः //
text_mt: the king, knowing this, does not punish them in Kali, under the sway of time. / With fragrant flowers and other auspicious, beneficial things,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrānabhyarcayantyalpaśrutabhāgyabalānvitāḥ
na prekṣante garvitāś ca śūdrā dvijavarān dvija //
meaning:
शूद्रानभ्यर्चयन्त्यल्पश्रुतभाग्यबलान्विताः
न प्रेक्षन्ते गर्विताश् च शूद्रा द्विजवरान् द्विज //
text_mt: those possessed of little learning, fortune, and strength worship śūdras. / Arrogant śūdras do not look upon the best of twice-born, O twice-born one!

sanskrit_iast:
sevāvasaram ālokya dvāre tiṣṭhanti vai dvijāḥ
vāhanasthān samāvṛtya śūdrāñśūdropajīvinaḥ //
meaning:
सेवावसरम् आलोक्य द्वारे तिष्ठन्ति वै द्विजाः
वाहनस्थान् समावृत्य शूद्राञ्शूद्रोपजीविनः //
text_mt: Waiting for an opportunity to serve, the twice-born stand at the door. / Gathering around those seated in vehicles, the brāhmaṇas there serve the śūdras,

sanskrit_iast:
sevante brāhmaṇāstatra stuvanti stutibhiḥ kalau
tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
सेवन्ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र स्तुवन्ति स्तुतिभिः कलौ
तपोयज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: and those who live at the expense of śūdras praise them with hymns in Kali. / The foremost twice-born become sellers of the fruits of austerities and sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
yatayaś ca bhaviṣyanti bahavo 'sminkalau yuge
puruṣālpaṃ bahustrīkaṃ yugānte samupasthite //
meaning:
यतयश् च भविष्यन्ति बहवो ऽस्मिन्कलौ युगे
पुरुषाल्पं बहुस्त्रीकं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते //
text_mt: Many ascetics will arise in this Kali yuga. / When the end of the yuga approaches, men will be few and women many.

sanskrit_iast:
nindanti vedavidyāṃ ca dvijāḥ karmāṇi vai kalau
kalau devo mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ //
meaning:
निन्दन्ति वेदविद्यां च द्विजाः कर्माणि वै कलौ
कलौ देवो महादेवः शङ्करो नीललोहितः //
text_mt: In Kali, the twice-born revile Vedic knowledge and rituals. / In Kali, God Mahādeva, Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśate pratiṣṭhārthaṃ dharmasya vikṛtākṛtiḥ
ye taṃ viprā niṣevante yena kenāpi śaṅkaram //
meaning:
प्रकाशते प्रतिष्ठार्थं धर्मस्य विकृताकृतिः
ये तं विप्रा निषेवन्ते येन केनापि शङ्करम् //
text_mt: appears in a deformed guise for the sake of establishing dharma. / Whichever brāhmaṇas worship that Śaṅkara by any means whatever,

sanskrit_iast:
kalidoṣān vinirjitya prayānti paramaṃ padam
śvāpadaprabalatvaṃ ca gavāṃ caiva parikṣayaḥ //
meaning:
कलिदोषान् विनिर्जित्य प्रयान्ति परमं पदम्
श्वापदप्रबलत्वं च गवां चैव परिक्षयः //
text_mt: they overcome the evils of Kali and reach the supreme state. / The prevalence of wild beasts and the destruction of cows,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhūnāṃ vinivṛttiś ca vedyā tasminyugakṣaye
tadā sūkṣmo mahodarko durlabho dānamūlavān //
meaning:
साधूनां विनिवृत्तिश् च वेद्या तस्मिन्युगक्षये
तदा सूक्ष्मो महोदर्को दुर्लभो दानमूलवान् //
text_mt: and the departure of good men are to be known at the destruction of that yuga. / Then dharma, subtle, of great future result, difficult to attain, and rooted in giving,

sanskrit_iast:
cāturāśramaśaithilye dharmaḥ praticaliṣyati
arakṣitāro hartāro balibhāgasya pārthivāḥ //
meaning:
चातुराश्रमशैथिल्ये धर्मः प्रतिचलिष्यति
अरक्षितारो हर्तारो बलिभागस्य पार्थिवाः //
text_mt: will falter when the four life-stages become lax. / Failing to protect, taking the share of tax,

sanskrit_iast:
yugānteṣu bhaviṣyanti svarakṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ //
meaning:
युगान्तेषु भविष्यन्ति स्वरक्षणपरायणाः
अट्टशूला जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः //
text_mt: rulers at the end of the yuga will be devoted only to self-preservation. / The provinces will have storehouses for weapons; crossroads will have tridents of Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge
citravarṣī tadā devo yadā prāhuryugakṣayam //
meaning:
प्रमदाः केशशूलिन्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे
चित्रवर्षी तदा देवो यदा प्राहुर्युगक्षयम् //
text_mt: women will use their hair as weapons in the Kali yuga. / When they speak of the destruction of the yuga, the sky-god rains variably;

sanskrit_iast:
sarve vaṇigjanāścāpi bhaviṣyantyadhame yuge
kuśīlacaryāḥ pāṣaṇḍair vṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे वणिग्जनाश्चापि भविष्यन्त्यधमे युगे
कुशीलचर्याः पाषण्डैर् वृथारूपैः समावृताः //
text_mt: all people will become traders in that base yuga, / actors in conduct, surrounded by hypocrites devoid of virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuyājanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam
nāvyāhṛtakrūravākyo nārjavī nānasūyakaḥ //
meaning:
बहुयाजनको लोको भविष्यति परस्परम्
नाव्याहृतक्रूरवाक्यो नार्जवी नानसूयकः //
text_mt: People will mutually officiate at sacrifices for many; / no one will leave cruel words unsaid, no one will be straightforward, no one free from envy.

sanskrit_iast:
na kṛte pratikartā ca yugakṣīṇe bhaviṣyati
nindakāścaiva patitā yugāntasya ca lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
न कृते प्रतिकर्ता च युगक्षीणे भविष्यति
निन्दकाश्चैव पतिता युगान्तस्य च लक्षणम् //
text_mt: When the yuga declines, there will be no one who returns a favor. / Slanderers and fallen men are the hallmark of the end of the yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaśūnyā vasumatī na ca dhānyadhanāvṛtā
maṇḍalāni bhaviṣyanti deśeṣu nagareṣu ca //
meaning:
नृपशून्या वसुमती न च धान्यधनावृता
मण्डलानि भविष्यन्ति देशेषु नगरेषु च //
text_mt: The earth will be bereft of kings and devoid of grain and wealth; / factions will form in provinces and cities.

sanskrit_iast:
alpodakā cālpaphalā bhaviṣyati vasuṃdharā
goptāraścāpyagoptāraḥ sambhaviṣyantyaśāsanāḥ //
meaning:
अल्पोदका चाल्पफला भविष्यति वसुंधरा
गोप्तारश्चाप्यगोप्तारः सम्भविष्यन्त्यशासनाः //
text_mt: The earth will have little water and little fruit. / Protectors will become non-protectors, lawless.

sanskrit_iast:
hartāraḥ paravittānāṃ paradārapradharṣakāḥ
kāmātmāno durātmāno hy adhamāḥ sāhasapriyāḥ //
meaning:
हर्तारः परवित्तानां परदारप्रधर्षकाः
कामात्मानो दुरात्मानो ह्य् अधमाः साहसप्रियाः //
text_mt: Robbers of others' wealth, violators of others' wives, / lustful, wicked-souled, base, fond of reckless deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
pranaṣṭaceṣṭanāḥ puṃso muktakeśāś ca śūlinaḥ
janāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāś ca prajāyante yugakṣaye //
meaning:
प्रनष्टचेष्टनाः पुंसो मुक्तकेशाश् च शूलिनः
जनाः षोडशवर्षाश् च प्रजायन्ते युगक्षये //
text_mt: men will lose their natural endeavors, with disheveled hair, bearing tridents; / people will produce offspring at sixteen years of age at the end of the yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
śukladantājinākṣāś ca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ
śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte samupasthite //
meaning:
शुक्लदन्ताजिनाक्षाश् च मुण्डाः काषायवाससः
शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते //
text_mt: Showing white teeth, wearing deerskins and spectacles, shaven-headed, clad in red garments, / śūdras will practice dharma when the end of the yuga has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
sasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti dṛḍhacailābhilāṣiṇaḥ
caurāścorasvahartāro harturhartā tathāparaḥ //
meaning:
सस्यचौरा भविष्यन्ति दृढचैलाभिलाषिणः
चौराश्चोरस्वहर्तारो हर्तुर्हर्ता तथापरः //
text_mt: Men will be thieves of grain, desiring durable clothing. / Thieves will steal thieves' wealth, and another will rob the robber.

sanskrit_iast:
yogyakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate
kīṭamūṣakasarpāś ca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān //
meaning:
योग्यकर्मण्युपरते लोके निष्क्रियतां गते
कीटमूषकसर्पाश् च धर्षयिष्यन्ति मानवान् //
text_mt: When proper work ceases and the world has fallen into inactivity, / insects, mice, and snakes will attack humans.

sanskrit_iast:
subhikṣaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ durlabhaṃ tadā
kauśikīṃ pratipatsyante deśānkṣudbhayapīḍitāḥ //
meaning:
सुभिक्षं क्षेममारोग्यं सामर्थ्यं दुर्लभं तदा
कौशिकीं प्रतिपत्स्यन्ते देशान्क्षुद्भयपीडिताः //
text_mt: Abundance, safety, health, and strength will then be hard to find; / afflicted by hunger and fear, they will flee to the regions around the Kauśikī.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhenābhiplutānāṃ ca paramāyuḥ śataṃ tadā
dṛśyante na ca dṛśyante vedāḥ kaliyuge 'khilāḥ //
meaning:
दुःखेनाभिप्लुतानां च परमायुः शतं तदा
दृश्यन्ते न च दृश्यन्ते वेदाः कलियुगे ऽखिलाः //
text_mt: And for those overwhelmed by suffering, the maximum lifespan will then be a hundred years; / in the Kali yuga, the Vedas in their entirety are both seen and not seen.

sanskrit_iast:
utsīdanti tadā yajñāḥ kevalādharmapīḍitāḥ
kāṣāyiṇo 'pyanirgranthāḥ kāpālībahulāstviha //
meaning:
उत्सीदन्ति तदा यज्ञाः केवलाधर्मपीडिताः
काषायिणो ऽप्यनिर्ग्रन्थाः कापालीबहुलास्त्विह //
text_mt: Sacrifices then decay, overwhelmed entirely by unrighteousness; / there are those wearing ochre robes though not unattached, and skull-bearing ascetics abound here.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavikrayiṇaścānye tīrthavikrayiṇaḥ pare
varṇāśramāṇāṃ ye cānye pāṣaṇḍāḥ paripanthinaḥ //
meaning:
वेदविक्रयिणश्चान्ये तीर्थविक्रयिणः परे
वर्णाश्रमाणां ये चान्ये पाषण्डाः परिपन्थिनः //
text_mt: Others sell the Vedas, and yet others sell sacred bathing sites; / and there are other heretics who obstruct the social classes and life stages.

sanskrit_iast:
utpadyante tadā te vai samprāpte tu kalau yuge
adhīyante tadā vedāñ śūdrā dharmārthakovidāḥ //
meaning:
उत्पद्यन्ते तदा ते वै सम्प्राप्ते तु कलौ युगे
अधीयन्ते तदा वेदाञ् शूद्रा धर्मार्थकोविदाः //
text_mt: They indeed arise when the Kali yuga arrives; / then Śūdras, skilled in the meaning of righteousness, study the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
yajante cāśvamedhena rājānaḥ śūdrayonayaḥ
strībālagovadhaṃ kṛtvā hatvā caiva parasparam //
meaning:
यजन्ते चाश्वमेधेन राजानः शूद्रयोनयः
स्त्रीबालगोवधं कृत्वा हत्वा चैव परस्परम् //
text_mt: And kings of Śūdra origin perform the horse sacrifice; / having killed women, children, and cows, and having slain one another,

sanskrit_iast:
upadravāṃstathānyonyaṃ sādhayanti tadā prajāḥ
duḥkhaprabhūtamalpāyur dehotsādaḥ sarogatā //
meaning:
उपद्रवांस्तथान्योन्यं साधयन्ति तदा प्रजाः
दुःखप्रभूतमल्पायुर् देहोत्सादः सरोगता //
text_mt: the subjects then inflict afflictions on each other. / Full of suffering, with short lifespans, their bodies waste away, beset by diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam
prajāsu brahmahatyādi tadā vai sampravartate //
meaning:
अधर्माभिनिवेशित्वात् तमोवृत्तं कलौ स्मृतम्
प्रजासु ब्रह्महत्यादि तदा वै सम्प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: Because of dedication to unrighteousness, conduct in the Kali [yuga] is known to be governed by tamas; / then indeed the slaying of brāhmaṇas and other [crimes] proceed among the subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādāyurbalaṃ rūpaṃ kaliṃ prāpya prahīyate
tadā tvalpena kālena siddhiṃ gacchanti mānavāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादायुर्बलं रूपं कलिं प्राप्य प्रहीयते
तदा त्वल्पेन कालेन सिद्धिं गच्छन्ति मानवाः //
text_mt: Therefore, upon reaching Kali, lifespan, strength, and beauty decline; / yet in a short time men then attain perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte dvijasattamāḥ
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ ye carantyanasūyakāḥ //
meaning:
धन्या धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते द्विजसत्तमाः
श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं ये चरन्त्यनसूयकाः //
text_mt: At the end of the yuga, fortunate ones will practice righteousness, O best of the twice-born; / those who, free from malice, practice the righteousness taught by Śruti and Smṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyāṃ vārṣiko dharmo dvāpare māsikaḥ smṛtaḥ
yathākleśaṃ caranprājñas tadahnā prāpnute kalau //
meaning:
त्रेतायां वार्षिको धर्मो द्वापरे मासिकः स्मृतः
यथाक्लेशं चरन्प्राज्ञस् तदह्ना प्राप्नुते कलौ //
text_mt: righteousness requiring a year in the Tretā is said to require a month in the Dvāpara; / practicing it according to his capacity, a wise man attains it in a single day in the Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā kaliyugāvasthā saṃdhyāṃśaṃ tu nibodha me
yuge yuge ca hīyante trīṃstrīnpādāṃstu siddhayaḥ //
meaning:
एषा कलियुगावस्था संध्यांशं तु निबोध मे
युगे युगे च हीयन्ते त्रींस्त्रीन्पादांस्तु सिद्धयः //
text_mt: This is the state of the Kali yuga; now learn from me the dusk twilight. / In yuga after yuga, perfections decline by three quarters at a time.

sanskrit_iast:
yugasvabhāvāḥ saṃdhyāstu tiṣṭhantīha tu pādaśaḥ
saṃdhyāsvabhāvāḥ svāṃśeṣu pādaśaste pratiṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
युगस्वभावाः संध्यास्तु तिष्ठन्तीह तु पादशः
संध्यास्वभावाः स्वांशेषु पादशस्ते प्रतिष्ठिताः //
text_mt: The characteristics of the yugas abide quarter by quarter in the dawn twilights; / the characteristics of the dawn twilights are established quarter by quarter in their dusk twilights.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃdhyāṃśake kāle samprāpte tu yugāntike
teṣāṃ śāstā hyasādhūnāṃ bhūtānāṃ nidhanotthitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संध्यांशके काले सम्प्राप्ते तु युगान्तिके
तेषां शास्ता ह्यसाधूनां भूतानां निधनोत्थितः //
text_mt: Thus, when the time of the dusk twilight arrives at the end of the yuga, / a punisher of those wicked creatures arises at their destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
gotre 'sminvai candramaso nāmnā pramitirucyate
mānavasya tu so 'ṃśena pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare //
meaning:
गोत्रे ऽस्मिन्वै चन्द्रमसो नाम्ना प्रमितिरुच्यते
मानवस्य तु सो ऽंशेन पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे //
text_mt: In this lineage of Candramas, he is called Pramiti by name; / formerly, in the Svāyambhuva manvantara, [he was born] from a portion of Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
samāḥ sa viṃśatiḥ pūrṇāḥ paryaṭanvai vasuṃdharām
anukarṣan sa vai senāṃ savājirathakuñjarām //
meaning:
समाः स विंशतिः पूर्णाः पर्यटन्वै वसुंधराम्
अनुकर्षन् स वै सेनां सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् //
text_mt: Wandering indeed over the earth for twenty full years, / he led an army endowed with horses, chariots, and elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhītāyudhairvipraiḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
sa tadā taiḥ parivṛto mlecchān hanti sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
प्रगृहीतायुधैर्विप्रैः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
स तदा तैः परिवृतो म्लेच्छान् हन्ति सहस्रशः //
text_mt: With brāhmaṇas holding weapons by the hundreds and thousands, / surrounded by them then, he slays barbarians by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hatvā sarvaśaścaiva rājñastāñśūdrayonijān
pākhaṇḍāṃstu tataḥ sarvān niḥśeṣaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ //
meaning:
स हत्वा सर्वशश्चैव राज्ञस्ताञ्शूद्रयोनिजान्
पाखण्डांस्तु ततः सर्वान् निःशेषं कृतवान् प्रभुः //
text_mt: Having slain those kings born of Śūdra wombs on all sides, / the lord then completely eliminated all the heretics.

sanskrit_iast:
nātyarthaṃ dhārmikā ye ca tān sarvān hanti sarvataḥ
varṇavyatyāsajātāś ca ye ca tānanujīvinaḥ //
meaning:
नात्यर्थं धार्मिका ये च तान् सर्वान् हन्ति सर्वतः
वर्णव्यत्यासजाताश् च ये च ताननुजीविनः //
text_mt: And those who were not very righteous, he kills them all everywhere, / as well as those born of the confusion of castes and their dependents.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttacakro balavān mlecchānāmantakṛtsa tu
adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ cacārātha vasuṃdharām //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तचक्रो बलवान् म्लेच्छानामन्तकृत्स तु
अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानां चचाराथ वसुंधराम् //
text_mt: With his wheel set rolling, powerful, the terminator of barbarians, / unassailable by all creatures, he then roamed the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
mānavasya tu so 'ṃśena devasyeha vijajñivān
pūrvajanmani viṣṇostu pramitirnāma vīryavān //
meaning:
मानवस्य तु सो ऽंशेन देवस्येह विजज्ञिवान्
पूर्वजन्मनि विष्णोस्तु प्रमितिर्नाम वीर्यवान् //
text_mt: Born here from a portion of Manu, of the god [Viṣṇu]— / he was the heroic one named Pramiti in a former birth of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
gotrato vai candramasaḥ pūrṇe kaliyuge prabhuḥ
dvātriṃśe 'bhyudite varṣe prakrānto viṃśatiḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
गोत्रतो वै चन्द्रमसः पूर्णे कलियुगे प्रभुः
द्वात्रिंशे ऽभ्युदिते वर्षे प्रक्रान्तो विंशतिः समाः //
text_mt: From the lineage of Candramas, when the Kali yuga was full, the lord, / having arisen in his thirty-second year, advanced for twenty years,

sanskrit_iast:
vinighnansarvabhūtāni śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
kṛtvā bījāvaśeṣāṃ tu pṛthivīṃ krūrakarmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
विनिघ्नन्सर्वभूतानि शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
कृत्वा बीजावशेषां तु पृथिवीं क्रूरकर्मणः //
text_mt: slaying all creatures by the hundreds and thousands; / having reduced the earth to a remnant of seeds, of cruel deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
parasparanimittena kopenākasmikena tu
sa sādhayitvā vṛṣalān prāyaśas tān adhārmikān //
meaning:
परस्परनिमित्तेन कोपेनाकस्मिकेन तु
स साधयित्वा वृषलान् प्रायशस् तान् अधार्मिकान् //
text_mt: through mutual causes and sudden fury, / having subdued those base and mostly unrighteous men,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye sthitiṃ prāptaḥ sahānugaḥ
tato vyatīte kāle tu sāmātyaḥ sahasainikaḥ //
meaning:
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये स्थितिं प्राप्तः सहानुगः
ततो व्यतीते काले तु सामात्यः सहसैनिकः //
text_mt: he took up residence between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā along with his followers. / Then, when time had elapsed, together with his ministers and his army,

sanskrit_iast:
utsādya pārthivān sarvān mlecchāṃścaiva sahasraśaḥ
tatra saṃdhyāṃśake kāle samprāpte tu yugāntike //
meaning:
उत्साद्य पार्थिवान् सर्वान् म्लेच्छांश्चैव सहस्रशः
तत्र संध्यांशके काले सम्प्राप्ते तु युगान्तिके //
text_mt: having eradicated all kings and barbarians by the thousands, / there, when the time of the dusk twilight arrived at the end of the yuga,

sanskrit_iast:
sthitāsvalpāvaśiṣṭāsu prajāsviha kvacitkvacit
apragrahāstatastā vai lobhāviṣṭāstu kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
स्थितास्वल्पावशिष्टासु प्रजास्विह क्वचित्क्वचित्
अप्रग्रहास्ततस्ता वै लोभाविष्टास्तु कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: when few remaining subjects were situated here and there, / unrestrained, completely seized by greed,

sanskrit_iast:
upahiṃsanti cānyonyaṃ praṇipatya parasparam
arājake yugavaśāt saṃśaye samupasthite //
meaning:
उपहिंसन्ति चान्योन्यं प्रणिपत्य परस्परम्
अराजके युगवशात् संशये समुपस्थिते //
text_mt: they injure one another after bowing down before each other; / in a kingless state, by the power of the yuga, when danger has arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
prajāstā vai tataḥ sarvāḥ parasparabhayārditāḥ
vyākulāś ca paribhrāntās tyaktvā dārān gṛhāṇi ca //
meaning:
प्रजास्ता वै ततः सर्वाः परस्परभयार्दिताः
व्याकुलाश् च परिभ्रान्तास् त्यक्त्वा दारान् गृहाणि च //
text_mt: all those subjects, tormented by mutual fear, / agitated and wandering about, abandoning wives and homes,

sanskrit_iast:
svānprāṇān anapekṣanto niṣkāruṇyāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ
naṣṭe śraute smārtadharme parasparahatāstadā //
meaning:
स्वान्प्राणान् अनपेक्षन्तो निष्कारुण्याः सुदुःखिताः
नष्टे श्रौते स्मार्तधर्मे परस्परहतास्तदा //
text_mt: disregarding their own lives, pitiless, deeply sorrowful, / when the righteousness of Śruti and Smṛti is lost, they are slain by one another.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmaryādā nirākrāntā niḥsnehā nirapatrapāḥ
naṣṭe dharme pratihatāḥ hrasvakāḥ pañcaviṃśakāḥ //
meaning:
निर्मर्यादा निराक्रान्ता निःस्नेहा निरपत्रपाः
नष्टे धर्मे प्रतिहताः ह्रस्वकाः पञ्चविंशकाः //
text_mt: Boundless, unrestrained, devoid of affection, shameless, / confounded when righteousness is lost, dwarfish, living twenty-five years,

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā putrāṃś ca dārāṃś ca vivādavyākulendriyāḥ
anāvṛṣṭihatāścaiva vārtāmutsṛjya dūrataḥ //
meaning:
हित्वा पुत्रांश् च दारांश् च विवादव्याकुलेन्द्रियाः
अनावृष्टिहताश्चैव वार्तामुत्सृज्य दूरतः //
text_mt: leaving their sons and wives, their senses agitated by dispute, / struck by drought, abandoning agriculture far away,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyantānupasevante hitvā janapadān svakān
saritsāgarakūpāṃste sevante parvatāṃs tathā //
meaning:
प्रत्यन्तानुपसेवन्ते हित्वा जनपदान् स्वकान्
सरित्सागरकूपांस्ते सेवन्ते पर्वतांस् तथा //
text_mt: they resort to frontier regions, abandoning their own realms; / they resort to rivers, the ocean, wells, and mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
madhumāṃsairmūlaphalair vartayanti suduḥkhitāḥ
cīrapatrājinadharā niṣkriyā niṣparigrahāḥ //
meaning:
मधुमांसैर्मूलफलैर् वर्तयन्ति सुदुःखिताः
चीरपत्राजिनधरा निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहाः //
text_mt: They sustain themselves with honey, meat, roots, and fruits, deeply sorrowful, / wearing rags, leaves, and hides, inactive, without possessions,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramaparibhraṣṭāḥ saṃkaṭaṃ ghoramāsthitāḥ
evaṃ kaṣṭamanuprāptā alpaśeṣāḥ prajāstadā //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमपरिभ्रष्टाः संकटं घोरमास्थिताः
एवं कष्टमनुप्राप्ता अल्पशेषाः प्रजास्तदा //
text_mt: fallen from social classes and life stages, entering severe distress. / Thus having attained misery, the subjects remaining in small numbers then,

sanskrit_iast:
jarāvyādhikṣudhāviṣṭā duḥkhānnirvedamānasāḥ
vicāraṇā tu nirvedāt sāmyāvasthā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
जराव्याधिक्षुधाविष्टा दुःखान्निर्वेदमानसाः
विचारणा तु निर्वेदात् साम्यावस्था विचारणा //
text_mt: seized by old age, disease, and hunger, have their minds turned to detachment from suffering; / and from detachment comes reflection, and reflection is a state of equanimity.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmyāvasthātmako bodhaḥ saṃbodhāddharmaśīlatā
arūpaśamayuktāstu kaliśiṣṭā hi vai svayam //
meaning:
साम्यावस्थात्मको बोधः संबोधाद्धर्मशीलता
अरूपशमयुक्तास्तु कलिशिष्टा हि वै स्वयम् //
text_mt: Spiritual awakening consists of the state of equanimity; from awakening comes devotion to righteousness. / Endowed with tranquility without outward form, those remaining from the Kali [yuga] indeed [awaken] by themselves;

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātrāttadā tāsāṃ yugaṃ tu parivartate
cittasaṃmohanaṃ kṛtvā tāsāṃ vai suptamattavat //
meaning:
अहोरात्रात्तदा तासां युगं तु परिवर्तते
चित्तसंमोहनं कृत्वा तासां वै सुप्तमत्तवत् //
text_mt: then the yuga turns around in the span of a day and night, / making their minds bewildered, as if they were asleep or drunk.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvino 'rthasya ca balāt tataḥ kṛtamavartata
pravṛtte tu tatastasmin punaḥ kṛtayuge tu vai //
meaning:
भाविनो ऽर्थस्य च बलात् ततः कृतमवर्तत
प्रवृत्ते तु ततस्तस्मिन् पुनः कृतयुगे तु वै //
text_mt: By the power of what was destined to be, the Kṛta [yuga] then commenced; / and when that Kṛta yuga had begun again,

sanskrit_iast:
utpannāḥ kaliśiṣṭāstu prajāḥ kārtayugāstadā
tiṣṭhanti ceha ye siddhā adṛṣṭā vicaranti ca //
meaning:
उत्पन्नाः कलिशिष्टास्तु प्रजाः कार्तयुगास्तदा
तिष्ठन्ति चेह ये सिद्धा अदृष्टा विचरन्ति च //
text_mt: the subjects remaining from the Kali then became people belonging to the Kṛta [yuga]; / and the perfected ones who remain here roam about unseen.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta saptarṣibhiścaiva tatra te tu vyavasthitāḥ
brahmakṣatraviśaḥ śūdrā bījārthaṃ ye smṛtā iha //
meaning:
सप्त सप्तर्षिभिश्चैव तत्र ते तु व्यवस्थिताः
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशः शूद्रा बीजार्थं ये स्मृता इह //
text_mt: The seven remain stationed there along with the Seven Sages; / brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras who are remembered here as the seed,

sanskrit_iast:
kalijaiḥ saha te sarve nirviśeṣāstadābhavan
teṣāṃ saptarṣayo dharmaṃ kathayantītare 'pi ca //
meaning:
कलिजैः सह ते सर्वे निर्विशेषास्तदाभवन्
तेषां सप्तर्षयो धर्मं कथयन्तीतरे ऽपि च //
text_mt: they all then became indistinguishable from those born in the Kali [yuga]; / the Seven Sages and others declare righteousness to them,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramācārayutaṃ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ dvidhā tu yam
tatasteṣu kriyāvatsu vardhante vai prajāḥ kṛte //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाचारयुतं श्रौतं स्मार्तं द्विधा तु यम्
ततस्तेषु क्रियावत्सु वर्धन्ते वै प्रजाः कृते //
text_mt: which consists of the conduct of the social classes and life stages, twofold as Śrauta and Smārta; / then, as they perform their rituals, the subjects indeed multiply in the Kṛta [yuga].

sanskrit_iast:
śrautasmārtakṛtānāṃ ca dharme saptarṣidarśite
keciddharmavyavasthārthaṃ tiṣṭhantīha yugakṣaye //
meaning:
श्रौतस्मार्तकृतानां च धर्मे सप्तर्षिदर्शिते
केचिद्धर्मव्यवस्थार्थं तिष्ठन्तीह युगक्षये //
text_mt: In the righteousness performed according to Śruti and Smṛti, revealed by the Seven Sages, / some remain here at the end of the yuga for the sake of establishing righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantarādhikāreṣu tiṣṭhanti munayastu vai
yathā dāvapradagdheṣu tṛṇeṣviha tataḥ kṣitau //
meaning:
मन्वन्तराधिकारेषु तिष्ठन्ति मुनयस्तु वै
यथा दावप्रदग्धेषु तृणेष्विह ततः क्षितौ //
text_mt: Sages indeed remain in charge of the manvantaras; / just as when grasses are burnt by forest fire on the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
vanānāṃ prathamaṃ vṛṣṭyā teṣāṃ mūleṣu saṃbhavaḥ
tathā kārtayugānāṃ tu kalijeṣviha saṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
वनानां प्रथमं वृष्ट्या तेषां मूलेषु संभवः
तथा कार्तयुगानां तु कलिजेष्विह संभवः //
text_mt: the first growth of the woods comes from their roots through rain, / so the appearance of the people of the Kṛta occurs among those born in the Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yugādyugasyeha saṃtānaṃ tu parasparam
vartate ha vyavacchedād yāvanmanvantarakṣayaḥ //
meaning:
एवं युगाद्युगस्येह संतानं तु परस्परम्
वर्तते ह व्यवच्छेदाद् यावन्मन्वन्तरक्षयः //
text_mt: Thus the succession from yuga to yuga here proceeds without interruption, / until the end of the manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhamāyurbalaṃ rūpaṃ dharmo 'rthaḥ kāma eva ca
yugeṣvetāni hīyante trīṃstrīn pādān krameṇa tu //
meaning:
सुखमायुर्बलं रूपं धर्मो ऽर्थः काम एव च
युगेष्वेतानि हीयन्ते त्रींस्त्रीन् पादान् क्रमेण तु //
text_mt: Happiness, lifespan, strength, beauty, righteousness, wealth, and desire— / in the yugas, these decline in succession by three quarters at a time.

sanskrit_iast:
sasaṃdhyāṃśeṣu hīyante yugānāṃ dharmasiddhayaḥ
ityeṣā pratisiddhirvai kīrtitaiṣā krameṇa tu //
meaning:
ससंध्यांशेषु हीयन्ते युगानां धर्मसिद्धयः
इत्येषा प्रतिसिद्धिर्वै कीर्तितैषा क्रमेण तु //
text_mt: During the twilights, the accomplishments of dharma in the yugas decline; / in this manner, their counter-attainment has been proclaimed in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
caturyugānāṃ sarveṣām anenaiva tu sādhanam
eṣā caturyugāvṛttir ā sahasrād guṇīkṛtā //
meaning:
चतुर्युगानां सर्वेषाम् अनेनैव तु साधनम्
एषा चतुर्युगावृत्तिर् आ सहस्राद् गुणीकृता //
text_mt: And the completion of all four-yuga cycles occurs solely by this [measure]; / this cycle of four yugas, multiplied up to a thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇastadahaḥ proktaṃ rātriścaitāvatī smṛtā
anārjavaṃ jaḍībhāvo bhūtānām ā yugakṣayāt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणस्तदहः प्रोक्तं रात्रिश्चैतावती स्मृता
अनार्जवं जडीभावो भूतानाम् आ युगक्षयात् //
text_mt: is declared to be a day of Brahmā, and his night is known to be of the same length. / The crookedness and inertness of living beings lasts until the end of a yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva tu sarveṣāṃ yugānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ smṛtam
eṣāṃ caturyugāṇāṃ ca guṇitā hyekasaptatiḥ //
meaning:
एतदेव तु सर्वेषां युगानां लक्षणं स्मृतम्
एषां चतुर्युगाणां च गुणिता ह्येकसप्ततिः //
text_mt: Indeed, this is considered the characteristic of all the yugas; / and seventy-one of these four-yuga cycles, multiplied together,

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa parivṛttā tu manorantaram ucyate
caturyuge yathaikasmin bhavatīha yadā tu yat //
meaning:
क्रमेण परिवृत्ता तु मनोरन्तरम् उच्यते
चतुर्युगे यथैकस्मिन् भवतीह यदा तु यत् //
text_mt: and revolving in sequence, is called a manvantara. / Just as in one four-yuga cycle whatever occurs here and whenever,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā cānyeṣu bhavati punastadvai yathākramam
sarge sarge yathā bhedā utpadyante tathaiva tu //
meaning:
तथा चान्येषु भवति पुनस्तद्वै यथाक्रमम्
सर्गे सर्गे यथा भेदा उत्पद्यन्ते तथैव तु //
text_mt: so it occurs again in the others in due order. / Just as divisions arise in creation after creation,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatparimitā na nyūnā nādhikās tathā
tathā kalpā yugaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhavanti saha lakṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशत्परिमिता न न्यूना नाधिकास् तथा
तथा कल्पा युगैः सार्धं भवन्ति सह लक्षणैः //
text_mt: measured at twenty-five, neither fewer nor more, / so too the kalpas, together with the yugas and their characteristics, come to be.

sanskrit_iast: manvantarāṇāṃ sarveṣām etadeva tu lakṣaṇam //
meaning: मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेषाम् एतदेव तु लक्षणम् //
text_mt: This indeed is the characteristic of all the manvantaras.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yugānāṃ parivartanāni cirapravṛttāni yugasvabhāvāt
tathā tu saṃtiṣṭhati jīvalokaḥ kṣayodayābhyāṃ parivartamānaḥ //
meaning:
यथा युगानां परिवर्तनानि चिरप्रवृत्तानि युगस्वभावात्
तथा तु संतिष्ठति जीवलोकः क्षयोदयाभ्यां परिवर्तमानः //
text_mt: Just as the cycles of the yugas have long proceeded by the nature of the yugas, / so the world of living beings endures, revolving through destruction and arising.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yugānāṃ vai samāsataḥ
atītānāgatānāṃ hi sarvamanvantareṣu vai //
meaning:
इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं युगानां वै समासतः
अतीतानागतानां हि सर्वमन्वन्तरेषु वै //
text_mt: Thus has this characteristic of the yugas been declared in brief, / for the past and future ones in all manvantaras.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi ca
vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि च
व्याख्यातानि न संदेहः कल्पः कल्पेन चैव हि //
text_mt: By one manvantara, all the intervals are explained without doubt, / and kalpa by kalpa as well.

sanskrit_iast:
anāgateṣu tadvacca tarkaḥ kāryo vijānatā
manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣviha //
meaning:
अनागतेषु तद्वच्च तर्कः कार्यो विजानता
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह //
text_mt: In the same manner, inference should be made by one who knows regarding future ones, / in all manvantaras, both past and future here.

sanskrit_iast:
tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta
devā hyaṣṭavidhā ye ca ye ca manvantareśvarāḥ //
meaning:
तुल्याभिमानिनः सर्वे नामरूपैर्भवन्त्युत
देवा ह्यष्टविधा ये च ये च मन्वन्तरेश्वराः //
text_mt: All possessors of identity are equal in names and forms: / the gods of eight kinds and the lords of the manvantaras,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo manavaścaiva sarve tulyaprayojanāḥ
evaṃ varṇāśramāṇāṃ tu pravibhāgo yuge yuge //
meaning:
ऋषयो मनवश्चैव सर्वे तुल्यप्रयोजनाः
एवं वर्णाश्रमाणां तु प्रविभागो युगे युगे //
text_mt: the sages and the Manus, all have equal purposes. / Thus occurs the division of classes and life-stages in yuga after yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
yugasvabhāvaś ca tathā vidhatte vai tadā prabhuḥ
varṇāśramavibhāgāś ca yugāni yugasiddhayaḥ //
meaning:
युगस्वभावश् च तथा विधत्ते वै तदा प्रभुः
वर्णाश्रमविभागाश् च युगानि युगसिद्धयः //
text_mt: And the Lord then ordains the nature of the yuga, / the divisions of classes and life-stages, the yugas, and the accomplishments of the yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
yugānāṃ parimāṇaṃ te kathitaṃ hi prasaṅgataḥ
vadāmi devīputratvaṃ padmayoneḥ samāsataḥ //
meaning:
युगानां परिमाणं ते कथितं हि प्रसङ्गतः
वदामि देवीपुत्रत्वं पद्मयोनेः समासतः //
text_mt: The measure of the yugas has been recounted to you incidentally; / I shall now tell in brief of the lotus-born [Brahmā's] being the son of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
punaḥ sasarja bhagavān prabhraṣṭāḥ pūrvavatprajāḥ
sahasrayugaparyante prabhāte tu pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
पुनः ससर्ज भगवान् प्रभ्रष्टाः पूर्ववत्प्रजाः
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्ते प्रभाते तु पितामहः //
text_mt: Indra said: / At the end of a thousand yugas, at dawn, the lord Pitāmaha / once again created the creatures that had disappeared as before.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ parārdhe viprendra dviguṇe tu tathā gate
tadā dharāmbhasi vyāptā hy āpo vahnau samīraṇe //
meaning:
एवं परार्धे विप्रेन्द्र द्विगुणे तु तथा गते
तदा धराम्भसि व्याप्ता ह्य् आपो वह्नौ समीरणे //
text_mt: When twice a parārdha had thus passed, O best of Brahmins, / the earth was then pervaded by water, and the waters by fire; into the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
vahniḥ samīraṇaścaiva vyomni tanmātrasaṃyutaḥ
indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca tanmātrāṇi dvijottama //
meaning:
वह्निः समीरणश्चैव व्योम्नि तन्मात्रसंयुतः
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च तन्मात्राणि द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: the fire [dissolved], and the wind dissolved into space along with the subtle elements; / the eleven sense faculties and the subtle elements, O best of twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkāramanuprāpya pralīnāstatkṣaṇādaho
abhimānastadā tatra mahāntaṃ vyāpya vai kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
अहङ्कारमनुप्राप्य प्रलीनास्तत्क्षणादहो
अभिमानस्तदा तत्र महान्तं व्याप्य वै क्षणात् //
text_mt: reached ego and were dissolved at that instant—ah! / Ego, then pervading the Great Principle at that moment,

sanskrit_iast:
mahānapi tathā vyaktaṃ prāpya līno 'bhavaddvija
avyaktaṃ svaguṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ pralīnamabhavadbhave //
meaning:
महानपि तथा व्यक्तं प्राप्य लीनो ऽभवद्द्विज
अव्यक्तं स्वगुणैः सार्धं प्रलीनमभवद्भवे //
text_mt: the Great Principle also reached the unmanifest and dissolved, O twice-born. / The unmanifest, along with its own guṇas, was dissolved into Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sṛṣṭirabhūttasmāt pūrvavatpuruṣācchivāt
atha sṛṣṭāstadā tasya manasā tena mānasāḥ //
meaning:
ततः सृष्टिरभूत्तस्मात् पूर्ववत्पुरुषाच्छिवात्
अथ सृष्टास्तदा तस्य मनसा तेन मानसाः //
text_mt: Then, from that Puruṣa, Śiva, creation arose as before. / Thereupon, the mind-born [progeny] created then by him with his mind,

sanskrit_iast:
na vyavardhanta loke 'smin prajāḥ kamalayoninā
vṛddhyarthaṃ bhagavānbrahmā putrairvai mānasaiḥ saha //
meaning:
न व्यवर्धन्त लोके ऽस्मिन् प्रजाः कमलयोनिना
वृद्ध्यर्थं भगवान्ब्रह्मा पुत्रैर्वै मानसैः सह //
text_mt: the creatures created by the lotus-born [Brahmā], did not multiply in this world. / For the sake of increase, the lord Brahmā, along with his mind-born sons,

sanskrit_iast:
duścaraṃ vicacāreśaṃ samuddiśya tapaḥ svayam
tuṣṭastu tapasā tasya bhavo jñātvā sa vāñchitam //
meaning:
दुश्चरं विचचारेशं समुद्दिश्य तपः स्वयम्
तुष्टस्तु तपसा तस्य भवो ज्ञात्वा स वाञ्छितम् //
text_mt: personally performed severe asceticism directed towards the Lord. / Pleased with his asceticism and knowing what he desired, Bhava,

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭamadhyaṃ nirbhidya brahmaṇaḥ puruṣasya tu
putrasnehamiti procya strīpuṃrūpo 'bhavattadā //
meaning:
ललाटमध्यं निर्भिद्य ब्रह्मणः पुरुषस्य तु
पुत्रस्नेहमिति प्रोच्य स्त्रीपुंरूपो ऽभवत्तदा //
text_mt: bursting forth from the middle of the forehead of the Puruṣa Brahmā, / proclaiming, 'This is love for a son,' became of female and male form at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro mahādevo hy ardhanārīśvaro 'bhavat
dadāha bhagavānsarvaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca jagadgurum //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो महादेवो ह्य् अर्धनारीश्वरो ऽभवत्
ददाह भगवान्सर्वं ब्रह्माणं च जगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: His son became Mahādeva, the Lord Who is Half-Woman; / the Lord burned everything, including Brahmā, the teacher of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
athārdhamātrāṃ kalyāṇīm ātmanaḥ parameśvarīm
bubhuje yogamārgeṇa vṛddhyarthaṃ jagatāṃ śivaḥ //
meaning:
अथार्धमात्रां कल्याणीम् आत्मनः परमेश्वरीम्
बुभुजे योगमार्गेण वृद्ध्यर्थं जगतां शिवः //
text_mt: Then, through the path of yoga, Śiva enjoyed that auspicious half-mātrā, / his own Supreme Goddess, for the sake of the increase of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ hariṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ sasarja parameśvaraḥ
viśveśvarastu viśvātmā cāstraṃ pāśupataṃ tathā //
meaning:
तस्यां हरिं च ब्रह्माणं ससर्ज परमेश्वरः
विश्वेश्वरस्तु विश्वात्मा चास्त्रं पाशुपतं तथा //
text_mt: Upon her, the Supreme Lord created Hari and Brahmā; / and the Lord of the Universe, the Soul of All, created the Pāśupata weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbrahmā mahādevyāś cāṃśajaś ca haris tathā
aṇḍajaḥ padmajaścaiva bhavāṅgabhava eva ca //
meaning:
तस्माद्ब्रह्मा महादेव्याश् चांशजश् च हरिस् तथा
अण्डजः पद्मजश्चैव भवाङ्गभव एव च //
text_mt: Therefore, Brahmā and Hari are born from a portion of the Great Goddess; / he is egg-born, lotus-born, and also born from Bhava's body.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvam itihāsaṃ purātanam
parārdhaṃ brahmaṇo yāvat tāvadbhūtiḥ samāsataḥ //
meaning:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वम् इतिहासं पुरातनम्
परार्धं ब्रह्मणो यावत् तावद्भूतिः समासतः //
text_mt: All this ancient history has been recounted to you, / the extent of Brahmā's prosperity for a parārdha, in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
vairāgyaṃ brahmaṇo vakṣye tamodbhūtaṃ samāsataḥ
nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavān dvidhā kṛtvātmanastanum //
meaning:
वैराग्यं ब्रह्मणो वक्ष्ये तमोद्भूतं समासतः
नारायणो ऽपि भगवान् द्विधा कृत्वात्मनस्तनुम् //
text_mt: I shall tell of Brahmā's detachment arising from darkness, in brief: / the lord Nārāyaṇa, having divided his own body in two,

sanskrit_iast:
sasarja sakalaṃ tasmāt svāṅgādeva carācaram
tato brahmāṇamasṛjad brahmā rudraṃ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
ससर्ज सकलं तस्मात् स्वाङ्गादेव चराचरम्
ततो ब्रह्माणमसृजद् ब्रह्मा रुद्रं पितामहः //
text_mt: created from that very body of his all that moves and does not move. / Then he created Brahmā; Pitāmaha Brahmā created Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
mune kalpāntare rudro hariṃ brahmāṇam īśvaram
tato brahmāṇamasṛjan mune kalpāntare hariḥ //
meaning:
मुने कल्पान्तरे रुद्रो हरिं ब्रह्माणम् ईश्वरम्
ततो ब्रह्माणमसृजन् मुने कल्पान्तरे हरिः //
text_mt: In another kalpa, O sage, Rudra created Hari and Brahmā, the Lord; / then Hari created Brahmā in another kalpa, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ punarbrahmā brahmāṇaṃ ca punarbhavaḥ
tadā vicārya vai brahmā duḥkhaṃ saṃsāra ityajaḥ //
meaning:
नारायणं पुनर्ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं च पुनर्भवः
तदा विचार्य वै ब्रह्मा दुःखं संसार इत्यजः //
text_mt: again Brahmā created Nārāyaṇa, and again Bhava created Brahmā. / Then, reflecting that worldly existence is suffering, the unborn Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
sargaṃ visṛjya cātmānam ātmanyeva niyojya ca
saṃhṛtya prāṇasañcāraṃ pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ //
meaning:
सर्गं विसृज्य चात्मानम् आत्मन्येव नियोज्य च
संहृत्य प्राणसञ्चारं पाषाण इव निश्चलः //
text_mt: abandoning creation and fixing himself solely in the Self, / restraining the movement of the breath, motionless like a stone,

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samādhistho 'bhavatprabhuḥ
adhomukhaṃ tu yatpadmaṃ hṛdi saṃsthaṃ suśobhanam //
meaning:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि समाधिस्थो ऽभवत्प्रभुः
अधोमुखं तु यत्पद्मं हृदि संस्थं सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: the Lord remained absorbed in meditation for ten thousand years. / The lotus that was downward-facing, situated within the heart, most beautiful,

sanskrit_iast:
pūritaṃ pūrakeṇaiva prabuddhaṃ cābhavattadā
tadūrdhvavaktram abhavat kumbhakena nirodhitam //
meaning:
पूरितं पूरकेणैव प्रबुद्धं चाभवत्तदा
तदूर्ध्ववक्त्रम् अभवत् कुम्भकेन निरोधितम् //
text_mt: was filled by inhalation alone and then blossomed; / it became turned upward, held restrained by breath-retention.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpadmakarṇikāmadhye sthāpayāmāsa ceśvaram
tadomiti śivaṃ devam ardhamātrāparaṃ param //
meaning:
तत्पद्मकर्णिकामध्ये स्थापयामास चेश्वरम्
तदोमिति शिवं देवम् अर्धमात्रापरं परम् //
text_mt: In the middle of the pericarp of that lotus, he established the Lord, / that divine Śiva who is 'Om', higher than the highest, beyond the half-mātrā,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛṇālatantubhāgaikaśatabhāge vyavasthitam
yamī yamaviśuddhātmā niyamyaivaṃ hṛdīśvaram //
meaning:
मृणालतन्तुभागैकशतभागे व्यवस्थितम्
यमी यमविशुद्धात्मा नियम्यैवं हृदीश्वरम् //
text_mt: abiding within a hundredth part of a lotus-filament. / Self-restrained, purified by restraints, having thus restrained the Lord within his heart,

sanskrit_iast:
yamapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjyaṃ yājyo hyayajadavyayam
tasya hṛtkamalasthasya niyogāccāṃśajo vibhuḥ //
meaning:
यमपुष्पादिभिः पूज्यं याज्यो ह्ययजदव्ययम्
तस्य हृत्कमलस्थस्य नियोगाच्चांशजो विभुः //
text_mt: the sacrificer worshipped the imperishable one who is worthy of worship with the flowers of restraint and the like. / By the command of that one situated in the heart-lotus, the pervasive lord born of a portion,

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭamasya nirbhidya prādurāsītpitāmahāt
lohito 'bhūt svayaṃ nīlaḥ śivasya hṛdayodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
ललाटमस्य निर्भिद्य प्रादुरासीत्पितामहात्
लोहितो ऽभूत् स्वयं नीलः शिवस्य हृदयोद्भवः //
text_mt: bursting forth from his forehead, manifested from Pitāmaha. / He was red and dark blue himself, born from Śiva's heart.

sanskrit_iast:
vahneścaiva tu saṃyogāt prakṛtya puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ
nīlaś ca lohitaścaiva yataḥ kālākṛtiḥ pumān //
meaning:
वह्नेश्चैव तु संयोगात् प्रकृत्य पुरुषः प्रभुः
नीलश् च लोहितश्चैव यतः कालाकृतिः पुमान् //
text_mt: Because of the union with fire, the Lord is by nature Puruṣa; / because the Puruṣa is dark blue and red, having the form of Kāla,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlalohita ityuktas tena devena vai prabhuḥ
brahmaṇā bhagavānkālaḥ prītātmā cābhavadvibhuḥ //
meaning:
नीललोहित इत्युक्तस् तेन देवेन वै प्रभुः
ब्रह्मणा भगवान्कालः प्रीतात्मा चाभवद्विभुः //
text_mt: the Lord was called Nīlalohita by that god. / The lord Kāla was delighted in soul by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
suprītamanasaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca pitāmahaḥ
nāmāṣṭakena viśvātmā viśvātmānaṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
सुप्रीतमनसं देवं तुष्टाव च पितामहः
नामाष्टकेन विश्वात्मा विश्वात्मानं महामुने //
text_mt: And Pitāmaha praised the well-pleased god, / the Soul of All [praising] the Soul of All with eight names, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmaha uvāca
namaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejase
namo bhavāya devāya rasāyāmbumayāya te //
meaning:
पितामह उवाच
नमस्ते भगवन् रुद्र भास्करामिततेजसे
नमो भवाय देवाय रसायाम्बुमयाय ते //
text_mt: Pitāmaha said: / Homage to you, O Lord Rudra, whose splendor is immeasurable as the sun! / Homage to Bhava, the god whose nature is taste and water!

sanskrit_iast:
śarvāya kṣitirūpāya sadā surabhiṇe namaḥ
īśāya vāyave tubhyaṃ saṃsparśāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
शर्वाय क्षितिरूपाय सदा सुरभिणे नमः
ईशाय वायवे तुभ्यं संस्पर्शाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage to Śarva, whose form is the earth, ever fragrant! / Homage, homage to Īśa, who is the wind, whose nature is touch!

sanskrit_iast:
paśūnāṃ pataye caiva pāvakāyātitejase
bhīmāya vyomarūpāya śabdamātrāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
पशूनां पतये चैव पावकायातितेजसे
भीमाय व्योमरूपाय शब्दमात्राय ते नमः //
text_mt: And to the Lord of Beasts, to the Fire of supreme brilliance; / homage to Bhīma, whose form is space, whose nature is sound alone!

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāya somāya amṛtāya namo 'stu te
ugrāya yajamānāya namaste karmayogine //
meaning:
महादेवाय सोमाय अमृताय नमो ऽस्तु ते
उग्राय यजमानाय नमस्ते कर्मयोगिने //
text_mt: Homage be to Mahādeva, who is Soma, the nectar! / To Ugra, who is the sacrificer, homage to you, the practitioner of karma-yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi paitāmahamimaṃ stavam
rudrāya kathitaṃ viprāñ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि पैतामहमिमं स्तवम्
रुद्राय कथितं विप्राञ् श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः //
text_mt: Whoever recites or even listens to this hymn composed by Pitāmaha / addressed to Rudra, or recites it with concentrated mind to brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamūrtestu sāyujyaṃ varṣādekādavāpnuyāt
evaṃ stutvā mahādevam avaikṣata pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टमूर्तेस्तु सायुज्यं वर्षादेकादवाप्नुयात्
एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवम् अवैक्षत पितामहः //
text_mt: would attain union with the Eight-formed One after one year. / Having praised Mahādeva in this way, Pitāmaha looked around.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāṣṭadhā mahādevaḥ samātiṣṭhatsamantataḥ
tadā prakāśate bhānuḥ kṛṣṇavartmā niśākaraḥ //
meaning:
तदाष्टधा महादेवः समातिष्ठत्समन्ततः
तदा प्रकाशते भानुः कृष्णवर्त्मा निशाकरः //
text_mt: Then Mahādeva stood firmly on all sides in eight forms: / then the sun shines forth, [as do] fire and the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣitirvāyuḥ pumānaṃbhaḥ suṣiraṃ sarvagaṃ tathā
tadāprabhṛti taṃ prāhur aṣṭamūrtiritīśvaram //
meaning:
क्षितिर्वायुः पुमानंभः सुषिरं सर्वगं तथा
तदाप्रभृति तं प्राहुर् अष्टमूर्तिरितीश्वरम् //
text_mt: earth, wind, the male person, water, and all-pervading space. / From then on, they call that Lord the Eight-formed One.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamūrteḥ prasādena virañciścāsṛjatpunaḥ
sṛṣṭvaitad akhilaṃ brahmā punaḥ kalpāntare prabhuḥ //
meaning:
अष्टमूर्तेः प्रसादेन विरञ्चिश्चासृजत्पुनः
सृष्ट्वैतद् अखिलं ब्रह्मा पुनः कल्पान्तरे प्रभुः //
text_mt: By the grace of the Eight-formed One, Viriñca created again. / Having created all this, Lord Brahmā again in another kalpa,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ saṃsupte ca carācare
prajāḥ sraṣṭumanās tepe tata ugraṃ tapo mahat //
meaning:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तं संसुप्ते च चराचरे
प्रजाः स्रष्टुमनास् तेपे तत उग्रं तपो महत् //
text_mt: when the moving and unmoving had fully slept for the span of a thousand yugas, / wishing to create living beings, performed great and fierce austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiṃcitsamavartata
tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥkhātkrodho vyajāyata //
meaning:
तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य न किंचित्समवर्तत
ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुःखात्क्रोधो व्यजायत //
text_mt: While he was thus engaged in austerities, nothing came into being. / Then, after a long time, anger arose out of distress.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ
tatastebhyo 'śrubindubhyo bhūtāḥ pretāstadābhavan //
meaning:
क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः
ततस्तेभ्यो ऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो भूताः प्रेतास्तदाभवन् //
text_mt: From the eyes of him seized by anger, tears fell; / then from those tear-drops, ghosts and departed spirits arose.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṃstānagrajāndṛṣṭvā bhūtapretaniśācarān
anindata tadā devo brahmātmānam ajo vibhuḥ //
meaning:
सर्वांस्तानग्रजान्दृष्ट्वा भूतप्रेतनिशाचरान्
अनिन्दत तदा देवो ब्रह्मात्मानम् अजो विभुः //
text_mt: Seeing all those firstborn—the ghosts, departed spirits, and night-wanderers— / the unborn, all-pervading divine Brahmā then reproached himself.

sanskrit_iast:
jahau prāṇāṃś ca bhagavān krodhāviṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ
tataḥ prāṇamayo rudraḥ prādurāsītprabhormukhāt //
meaning:
जहौ प्राणांश् च भगवान् क्रोधाविष्टः प्रजापतिः
ततः प्राणमयो रुद्रः प्रादुरासीत्प्रभोर्मुखात् //
text_mt: Overwhelmed by anger, the Lord, the lord of creatures, gave up his life-breaths. / Then, consisting of life-breath, Rudra manifested from the lord’s mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
ardhanārīśvaro bhūtvā bālārkasadṛśadyutiḥ
tadaikādaśadhātmānaṃ pravibhajya vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
अर्धनारीश्वरो भूत्वा बालार्कसदृशद्युतिः
तदैकादशधात्मानं प्रविभज्य व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: having become Ardhanārīśvara, with the brilliance of the rising sun; / then dividing himself elevenfold, he remained.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhenāṃśena sarvātmā sasarjāsau śivāmumām
sā cāsṛjattadā lakṣmīṃ durgāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
अर्धेनांशेन सर्वात्मा ससर्जासौ शिवामुमाम्
सा चासृजत्तदा लक्ष्मीं दुर्गां श्रेष्ठां सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt: With half of his portion, that Self of all created the auspicious Umā, / and she then created Lakṣmī, Durgā, and the supreme Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāṃ raudrīṃ mahāmāyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ vārijekṣaṇām
kalāṃ vikiriṇīṃ caiva kālīṃ kamalavāsinīm //
meaning:
वामां रौद्रीं महामायां वैष्णवीं वारिजेक्षणाम्
कलां विकिरिणीं चैव कालीं कमलवासिनीम् //
text_mt: Vāmā, Raudrī, Mahāmāyā, lotus-eyed Vaiṣṇavī, / Kalā, Vikiriṇī, Kālī, and she who dwells in the lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
balavikariṇīṃ devīṃ balapramathinīṃ tathā
sarvabhūtasya damanīṃ sasṛje ca manonmanīm //
meaning:
बलविकरिणीं देवीं बलप्रमथिनीं तथा
सर्वभूतस्य दमनीं ससृजे च मनोन्मनीम् //
text_mt: the goddess Balavikariṇī, Balapramathinī, / the subduer of all beings, and she created Manonmanī.

sanskrit_iast:
tathānyā bahavaḥ sṛṣṭās tayā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ
rudraiścaiva mahādevas tābhistribhuvaneśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तथान्या बहवः सृष्टास् तया नार्यः सहस्रशः
रुद्रैश्चैव महादेवस् ताभिस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरः //
text_mt: Likewise many other women were created by her in thousands. / Together with the Rudras and those [women], Mahādeva, the lord of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmanaś ca tasyāgre hy atiṣṭhatparameśvaraḥ
mṛtasya tasya devasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वात्मनश् च तस्याग्रे ह्य् अतिष्ठत्परमेश्वरः
मृतस्य तस्य देवस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: the Supreme Lord, stood before the Self of all. / When that divine god Brahmā, the highest lord, was dead,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛṇī dadau punaḥ prāṇān brahmaputro maheśvaraḥ
brahmaṇaḥ pradadau prāṇān ātmasthāṃstu tadā prabhuḥ //
meaning:
घृणी ददौ पुनः प्राणान् ब्रह्मपुत्रो महेश्वरः
ब्रह्मणः प्रददौ प्राणान् आत्मस्थांस्तु तदा प्रभुः //
text_mt: the compassionate Maheśvara, the son of Brahmā, gave him back his life-breaths. / The Lord then restored to Brahmā the life-breaths that resided in himself.

sanskrit_iast:
prahṛṣṭo 'bhūttato rudraḥ kiṃcitpratyāgatāsavam
abhyabhāṣata deveśo brahmāṇaṃ paramaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
प्रहृष्टो ऽभूत्ततो रुद्रः किंचित्प्रत्यागतासवम्
अभ्यभाषत देवेशो ब्रह्माणं परमं वचः //
text_mt: Then Rudra rejoiced; to him whose breath had somewhat returned, / the Lord of Gods addressed a supreme word to Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast:
mā bhairdeva mahābhāga viriñca jagatāṃ guro
mayeha sthāpitāḥ prāṇās tasmāduttiṣṭha vai prabho //
meaning:
मा भैर्देव महाभाग विरिञ्च जगतां गुरो
मयेह स्थापिताः प्राणास् तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ वै प्रभो //
text_mt: “Do not fear, fortunate god, Viriñca, teacher of the worlds! / The life-breaths have been established by me here, therefore arise, O Lord!”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vacastatastasya svapnabhūtaṃ manogatam
pitāmahaḥ prasannātmā netraiḥ phullāmbujaprabhaiḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वचस्ततस्तस्य स्वप्नभूतं मनोगतम्
पितामहः प्रसन्नात्मा नेत्रैः फुल्लाम्बुजप्रभैः //
text_mt: Hearing that word of his, which had entered his mind like a dream, / Pitāmaha, his mind serene, with eyes possessing the luster of blossoming lotuses,
