प्रयान्ति चेश्वरं द्रष्टुं मेढीभूतं ध्रुवं दिवि //
text_mt:
Governed by Dhruva, circumambulating Dhruva alone,
they proceed in heaven to behold the Lord, who stands as the central pivot.

sanskrit_iast:
navayojanasāhasro viṣkambhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ
triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कम्भः सवितुः स्मृतः
त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः //
text_mt:
The diameter of the sun is traditionally held to be nine thousand yojanas;
by measure, the circumference of its orb is three times that.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇaḥ sūryavistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ
tulyastayostu svarbhānur bhūtvādhastātprasarpati //
meaning:
द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद् विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः
तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर् भूत्वाधस्तात्प्रसर्पति //
text_mt:
The width of the moon is recorded as twice the width of the sun;
Svarbhānu, having become equal to both of them, creeps below [them].

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtya pṛthivīchāyāṃ nirmitāṃ maṇḍalākṛtim
svarbhānostu bṛhatsthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yat tamomayam //
meaning:
उद्धृत्य पृथिवीछायां निर्मितां मण्डलाकृतिम्
स्वर्भानोस्तु बृहत्स्थानं तृतीयं यत् तमोमयम् //
text_mt:
Rising up and assuming the spherical shape made by the shadow of the earth,
the vast, third station of Svarbhānu consists of darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate
viṣkambhānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanācca pramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते
विष्कम्भान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनाच्च प्रमाणतः //
text_mt:
The sixteenth part of the moon is prescribed for the son of Bhṛgu,
in diameter, circumference, and measure of yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavātpādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ
pādahīnau vakrasaurī tathāyāmapramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
भार्गवात्पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः
पादहीनौ वक्रसौरी तथायामप्रमाणतः //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati should indeed be known as one quarter less than the son of Bhṛgu;
Mars and Saturn are each one quarter less [than Bṛhaspati] in the extent of their dimensions.

sanskrit_iast:
vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmantīha yāni vai //
meaning:
विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि वपुष्मन्तीह यानि वै //
text_mt:
Budha is one quarter less than both of them in width and circumference.
The bodily forms of the stars and constellations here,

sanskrit_iast:
budhena tāni tulyāni vistārānmaṇḍalādapi
prāyaśaścandrayogīni vidyādṛkṣāṇi tattvavit //
meaning:
बुधेन तानि तुल्यानि विस्तारान्मण्डलादपि
प्रायशश्चन्द्रयोगीनि विद्यादृक्षाणि तत्त्ववित् //
text_mt:
are equal to Budha in width and circumference.
The knower of reality should know that the constellations are usually in conjunction with the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparam
śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane //
meaning:
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परम्
शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने //
text_mt:
The forms of the stars and constellations decrease respectively:
five hundred, four, three, and two yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopari nikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni tu
yojanadvayamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate //
meaning:
सर्वोपरि निकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु
योजनद्वयमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते //
text_mt:
The lowest of the star-orbs, situated above all,
are of the measure of two yojanas; none smaller than them exists.

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭāttrayasteṣāṃ grahā ye dūrasarpiṇaḥ
sauro 'ṅgirāś ca vakraś ca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
उपरिष्टात्त्रयस्तेषां ग्रहा ये दूरसर्पिणः
सौरो ऽङ्गिराश् च वक्रश् च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिणः //
text_mt:
Above them are three planets that travel far:
Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars are to be known as slow-moving.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'dhastāttu catvāraḥ punaranye mahāgrahāḥ
sūryaḥ somo budhaścaiva bhārgavaścaiva śīghragāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽधस्तात्तु चत्वारः पुनरन्ये महाग्रहाः
सूर्यः सोमो बुधश्चैव भार्गवश्चैव शीघ्रगाः //
text_mt:
Below them, however, are four other great planets:
the sun, the moon, Budha, and the son of Bhṛgu are fast-moving.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvantyastārakāḥ koṭyo yāvantyṛkṣāṇi sarvaśaḥ
dhruvāt tu niyamāccaiṣām ṛkṣamārge vyavasthitiḥ //
meaning:
तावन्त्यस्तारकाः कोट्यो यावन्त्यृक्षाणि सर्वशः
ध्रुवात् तु नियमाच्चैषाम् ऋक्षमार्गे व्यवस्थितिः //
text_mt:
There are as many crores of stars as there are constellations all around;
by the command of Dhruva, their position is fixed in the stellar path.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāśvasyaiva sūryasya nīcoccatvamanukramāt
uttarāyaṇamārgastho yadā parvasu candramāḥ //
meaning:
सप्ताश्वस्यैव सूर्यस्य नीचोच्चत्वमनुक्रमात्
उत्तरायणमार्गस्थो यदा पर्वसु चन्द्रमाः //
text_mt:
The high and low positions of the seven-horsed sun follow in succession.
When the moon, standing in the northern course, is at the conjunctions,

sanskrit_iast:
uccatvāddṛśyate śīghraṃ nātivyaktairgabhastibhiḥ
tadā dakṣiṇamārgastho nīcāṃ vīthimupāśritaḥ //
meaning:
उच्चत्वाद्दृश्यते शीघ्रं नातिव्यक्तैर्गभस्तिभिः
तदा दक्षिणमार्गस्थो नीचां वीथिमुपाश्रितः //
text_mt:
it is seen swiftly on account of its height, with rays not very clear;
then, standing in the southern path, abiding in the lower course,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirekhāvṛtaḥ sūryaḥ paurṇimāvāsyayos tadā
dadṛśe ca yathākālaṃ śīghramastamupaiti ca //
meaning:
भूमिरेखावृतः सूर्यः पौर्णिमावास्ययोस् तदा
ददृशे च यथाकालं शीघ्रमस्तमुपैति च //
text_mt:
enveloped by the line of the earth, the sun, on the full-moon and new-moon days,
is seen at its proper time and swiftly goes to setting.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduttaramārgastho hy amāvāsyāṃ niśākaraḥ
dadṛśe dakṣiṇe mārge niyamāddṛśyate na ca //
meaning:
तस्मादुत्तरमार्गस्थो ह्य् अमावास्यां निशाकरः
ददृशे दक्षिणे मार्गे नियमाद्दृश्यते न च //
text_mt:
Therefore, the moon situated in the northern course is seen on the new moon;
in the southern course, it is, by rule, not seen,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣāṃ gatiyogena sūryasya tamasā vṛtaḥ
samānakālāstamayau viṣuvatsu samodayau //
meaning:
ज्योतिषां गतियोगेन सूर्यस्य तमसा वृतः
समानकालास्तमयौ विषुवत्सु समोदयौ //
text_mt:
covered by the darkness of the sun through the conjunction of the courses of the luminaries.
At the equinoxes, their risings and settings occur at the same time.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāsu ca vīthīṣu vyantarāstamanodayau
paurṇimāvāsyayor jñeyau jyotiścakrānuvartinau //
meaning:
उत्तरासु च वीथीषु व्यन्तरास्तमनोदयौ
पौर्णिमावास्ययोर् ज्ञेयौ ज्योतिश्चक्रानुवर्तिनौ //
text_mt:
And on the northern paths, the intermediate settings and risings
on the full-moon and new-moon days are to be known as following the wheel of the luminaries.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāyanamārgastho yadā carati raśmivān
grahāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sūryo 'dhastāt prasarpati //
meaning:
दक्षिणायनमार्गस्थो यदा चरति रश्मिवान्
ग्रहाणां चैव सर्वेषां सूर्यो ऽधस्तात् प्रसर्पति //
text_mt:
When the rayed one moves along the path of the southern course,
the sun creeps below all the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhvaṃ carate śaśī
nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ prasarpati //
meaning:
विस्तीर्णं मण्डलं कृत्वा तस्योर्ध्वं चरते शशी
नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं सोमादूर्ध्वं प्रसर्पति //
text_mt:
Making a broad circle, the moon moves above it;
the entire circle of constellations moves above the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrebhyo budhaścordhvaṃ budhādūrdhvaṃ tu bhārgavaḥ
vakrastu bhārgavādūrdhvaṃ vakrād ūrdhvaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्रेभ्यो बुधश्चोर्ध्वं बुधादूर्ध्वं तु भार्गवः
वक्रस्तु भार्गवादूर्ध्वं वक्राद् ऊर्ध्वं बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt:
Budha is above the constellations, and the son of Bhṛgu is above Budha;
Mars is above the son of Bhṛgu, and Bṛhaspati is above Mars.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchanaiścaraścordhvaṃ tasmātsaptarṣimaṇḍalam
ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saptānāṃ dhruvasyordhvaṃ vyavasthitiḥ //
meaning:
तस्माच्छनैश्चरश्चोर्ध्वं तस्मात्सप्तर्षिमण्डलम्
ऋषीणां चैव सप्तानां ध्रुवस्योर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितिः //
text_mt:
Saturn is above that, and above it is the circle of the Seven Sages;
and above the Seven Sages is the fixed position of Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ viṣṇulokaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt
dviguṇeṣu sahasreṣu yojanānāṃ śateṣu ca //
meaning:
तं विष्णुलोकं परमं ज्ञात्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषात्
द्विगुणेषु सहस्रेषु योजनानां शतेषु च //
text_mt:
Knowing that supreme realm of Viṣṇu, one is freed from evil.
Doubled by thousands and hundreds of yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
grahanakṣatratārāsu upariṣṭādyathākramam
grahāś ca candrasūryau ca yutau divyena tejasā //
meaning:
ग्रहनक्षत्रतारासु उपरिष्टाद्यथाक्रमम्
ग्रहाश् च चन्द्रसूर्यौ च युतौ दिव्येन तेजसा //
text_mt:
above the planets, constellations, and stars in regular order,
the planets and the sun and moon are endowed with divine splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
nityamṛkṣeṣu yujyante gacchanto 'harniśaṃ kramāt
grahanakṣatrasūryās te nīcoccaṛjusaṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
नित्यमृक्षेषु युज्यन्ते गच्छन्तो ऽहर्निशं क्रमात्
ग्रहनक्षत्रसूर्यास् ते नीचोच्चऋजुसंस्थिताः //
text_mt:
They are perpetually conjoined with the lunar mansions, moving day and night in succession;
those planets, constellations, and the sun, abide in low, high, and direct positions.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgame ca bhede ca paśyanti yugapatprajāḥ
ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ smṛtāḥ sarve samāgacchanti pañcadhā //
meaning:
समागमे च भेदे च पश्यन्ति युगपत्प्रजाः
ऋतवः षट् स्मृताः सर्वे समागच्छन्ति पञ्चधा //
text_mt:
In their conjunction and separation, creatures see them at once;
the six seasons are all traditionally declared to arrive in five ways.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparāsthitā hyete yujyante ca parasparam
asaṃkareṇa vijñeyas teṣāṃ yogastu vai budhaiḥ //
meaning:
परस्परास्थिता ह्येते युज्यन्ते च परस्परम्
असंकरेण विज्ञेयस् तेषां योगस्तु वै बुधैः //
text_mt:
Abiding mutually, these are conjoined with one another;
their conjunction, free from confusion, should indeed be understood by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃkṣipya kathitaṃ grahāṇāṃ gamanaṃ dvijāḥ
bhāskarapramukhānāṃ ca yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam //
meaning:
एवं संक्षिप्य कथितं ग्रहाणां गमनं द्विजाः
भास्करप्रमुखानां च यथादृष्टं यथाश्रुतम् //
text_mt:
Thus, O twice-born, the motion of the planets has been told in brief,
headed by the sun, as seen and as heard [in tradition].

sanskrit_iast:
grahādhipatye bhagavān brahmaṇā padmayoninā
abhiṣiktaḥ sahasrāṃśū rudreṇa tu yathā guhaḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहाधिपत्ये भगवान् ब्रह्मणा पद्मयोनिना
अभिषिक्तः सहस्रांशू रुद्रेण तु यथा गुहः //
text_mt:
The venerable, thousand-rayed one was consecrated to the lordship of the planets
by Brahmā, the lotus-born, just as Guha was by Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādgrahārcanā kāryā agnau codyaṃ yathāvidhi
ādityagrahapīḍāyāṃ sadbhiḥ kāryārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
तस्माद्ग्रहार्चना कार्या अग्नौ चोद्यं यथाविधि
आदित्यग्रहपीडायां सद्भिः कार्यार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt:
Therefore, worship of the planets should be performed and offerings made into fire according to rule,
by good people when troubled by the sun and planets, for the attainment of success in their aims.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
abhyaṣiñcatkathaṃ brahmā cādhipatye prajāpatiḥ
devadaityamukhān sarvān sarvātmā vada sāṃpratam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
अभ्यषिञ्चत्कथं ब्रह्मा चाधिपत्ये प्रजापतिः
देवदैत्यमुखान् सर्वान् सर्वात्मा वद सांप्रतम् //
text_mt:
The sages said:
How did Brahmā Prajāpati, the Self of all, consecrate [the rulers]
over the sovereignty of all the gods, Daityas, and the rest? Speak now!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
grahādhipatye bhagavān abhyaṣiñcaddivākaram
ṛkṣāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca somaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ग्रहाधिपत्ये भगवान् अभ्यषिञ्चद्दिवाकरम्
ऋक्षाणामोषधीनां च सोमं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः //

sanskrit_iast:
apāṃ ca varuṇaṃ devaṃ dhanānāṃ yakṣapuṅgavam
ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnāṃ pāvakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अपां च वरुणं देवं धनानां यक्षपुङ्गवम्
आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनां पावकं तथा //
text_mt:
the god Varuṇa [to the lordship] of waters, the foremost Yakṣa to that of treasures,
Viṣṇu among the Ādityas, and Pāvaka among the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ ca marutāṃ śakrameva ca
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca prahlādaṃ daityapuṅgavam //
meaning:
प्रजापतीनां दक्षं च मरुतां शक्रमेव च
दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादं दैत्यपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt:
Dakṣa among the Prajāpatis, and Śakra among the Maruts;
Prahlāda, the foremost Daitya, over the Daityas and Dānavas;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ pitṝṇām adhipaṃ nirṛtiṃ piśitāśinām
rudraṃ paśūnāṃ bhūtānāṃ nandinaṃ gaṇanāyakam //
meaning:
धर्मं पितॄणाम् अधिपं निरृतिं पिशिताशिनाम्
रुद्रं पशूनां भूतानां नन्दिनं गणनायकम् //
text_mt:
Dharma as the lord of the ancestors, Nirṛti of the raw-meat eaters,
Rudra of beasts, and Nandin, the leader of the host, of spirits;

sanskrit_iast:
vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca piśācānāṃ bhayaṃkaram
mātṝṇāṃ caiva cāmuṇḍāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām //
meaning:
वीराणां वीरभद्रं च पिशाचानां भयंकरम्
मातॄणां चैव चामुण्डां सर्वदेवनमस्कृताम् //
text_mt:
Vīrabhadra of heroes, and the terrible one of Piśācas;
Cāmuṇḍā, saluted by all the gods, [to the lordship] of the Mothers;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṇāṃ devadeveśaṃ nīlalohitamīśvaram
vighnānāṃ vyomajaṃ devaṃ gajāsyaṃ tu vināyakam //
meaning:
रुद्राणां देवदेवेशं नीललोहितमीश्वरम्
विघ्नानां व्योमजं देवं गजास्यं तु विनायकम् //
text_mt:
Nīlalohita, the Lord, the god of gods, over the Rudras;
and the sky-born god, Vināyaka, elephant-faced, over obstacles;

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ devīmumāṃ devīṃ vacasāṃ ca sarasvatīm
viṣṇuṃ māyāvināṃ caiva svātmānaṃ jagatāṃ tathā //
meaning:
स्त्रीणां देवीमुमां देवीं वचसां च सरस्वतीम्
विष्णुं मायाविनां चैव स्वात्मानं जगतां तथा //
text_mt:
the goddess Umā over women, and Sarasvatī over speech;
Viṣṇu over magicians, and his own self over the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
himavantaṃ girīṇāṃ tu nadīnāṃ caiva jāhnavīm
samudrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām adhipaṃ payasāṃ nidhim //
meaning:
हिमवन्तं गिरीणां तु नदीनां चैव जाह्नवीम्
समुद्राणां च सर्वेषाम् अधिपं पयसां निधिम् //
text_mt:
the Himavat over mountains, and the Jāhnavī over rivers;
and the Ocean, the repository of waters, as lord over all the seas;

sanskrit_iast: vṛkṣāṇāṃ caiva cāśvatthaṃ plakṣaṃ ca prapitāmahaḥ //
meaning: वृक्षाणां चैव चाश्वत्थं प्लक्षं च प्रपितामहः //
text_mt: and the great-grandfather [made] the aśvattha and the plakṣa [rulers] over trees.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvavidyādharakinnarāṇām īśaṃ punaś citrarathaṃ cakāra
nāgādhipaṃ vāsukimugravīryaṃ sarpādhipaṃ takṣakamugravīryam //
meaning:
गन्धर्वविद्याधरकिन्नराणाम् ईशं पुनश् चित्ररथं चकार
नागाधिपं वासुकिमुग्रवीर्यं सर्पाधिपं तक्षकमुग्रवीर्यम् //
text_mt:
Furthermore, he made Citraratha lord of the Gandharvas, Vidyādharas, and Kinnaras,
Vāsuki of fierce valor lord of Nāgas, and Takṣaka of fierce valor lord of snakes;

sanskrit_iast: suparṇamīśaṃ patatāmathāśvarājānamuccaiḥśravasaṃ cakāra //
meaning: सुपर्णमीशं पततामथाश्वराजानमुच्चैःश्रवसं चकार //
text_mt: he made the fair-winged [Garuḍa] lord of birds, and Uccaiḥśravas the king of horses;

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ gavāṃ ca mṛgādhipānāṃ śarabhaṃ cakāra
senādhipānāṃ guhamaprameyaṃ śrutismṛtīnāṃ lakulīśamīśam //
meaning:
सिंहं मृगाणां वृषभं गवां च मृगाधिपानां शरभं चकार
सेनाधिपानां गुहमप्रमेयं श्रुतिस्मृतीनां लकुलीशमीशम् //
text_mt:
the lion [lord] of wild beasts, the bull of cattle, and the śarabha lord of the beasts of prey;
the immeasurable Guha of army leaders, and Lakulīśa lord of the Śrutis and Smṛtis;

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṣiñcatsudharmāṇaṃ tathā śaṅkhapadaṃ diśām
ketumantaṃ krameṇaiva hemaromāṇameva ca //
meaning:
अभ्यषिञ्चत्सुधर्माणं तथा शङ्खपदं दिशाम्
केतुमन्तं क्रमेणैव हेमरोमाणमेव च //
text_mt:
he consecrated Sudharman and Śaṅkhapada as lords of the directions,
and likewise Ketumant and Hemaroman in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ pṛthumīśānaṃ sarveṣāṃ tu maheśvaram
caturmūrtiṣu sarvajñaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां पृथुमीशानं सर्वेषां तु महेश्वरम्
चतुर्मूर्तिषु सर्वज्ञं शङ्करं वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: [He consecrated] Pṛthu on the earth, Īśāna as the Maheśvara over all, / and Śaṅkara, whose banner bears a bull, as the omniscient one over the four forms.

sanskrit_iast:
prasādādbhagavāñchambhoś cābhyaṣiñcadyathākramam
purābhiṣicya puṇyātmā rarāja bhuvaneśvaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रसादाद्भगवाञ्छम्भोश् चाभ्यषिञ्चद्यथाक्रमम्
पुराभिषिच्य पुण्यात्मा रराज भुवनेश्वरः //
text_mt: By the grace of the blessed Śambhu, he consecrated them in proper order. / Having formerly consecrated them, the virtuous lord of the universe shone forth.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvo vistareṇaiva kathitaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
abhiṣiktāstatastvete viśiṣṭā viśvayoninā //
meaning:
एतद्वो विस्तरेणैव कथितं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
अभिषिक्तास्ततस्त्वेते विशिष्टा विश्वयोनिना //
text_mt: This has been told to you in detail, O foremost sages, / how these distinguished beings were then consecrated by the source of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etacchrutvā tu munayaḥ punastaṃ saṃśayānvitāḥ
papracchuruttaraṃ bhūyas tadā te romaharṣaṇam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु मुनयः पुनस्तं संशयान्विताः
पप्रच्छुरुत्तरं भूयस् तदा ते रोमहर्षणम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard this, the sages, filled with doubt again, / then questioned Romaharṣaṇa further for an answer.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
yadetaduktaṃ bhavatā sūteha vadatāṃ vara
etadvistarato brūhi jyotiṣāṃ ca vinirṇayam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
यदेतदुक्तं भवता सूतेह वदतां वर
एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि ज्योतिषां च विनिर्णयम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / That which has been spoken by you here, O Sūta, best among speakers, / tell this in detail: the decisive truth concerning the heavenly luminaries.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ tadā sūtaḥ samāhitaḥ
uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ teṣāṃ saṃśayanirṇaye //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां तदा सूतः समाहितः
उवाच परमं वाक्यं तेषां संशयनिर्णये //
text_mt: Having heard their words, the Sūta then, collected in mind, / spoke sublime words to resolve their doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
asminnarthe mahāprājñair yaduktaṃ śāntabuddhibhiḥ
etadvo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi sūryacandramasorgatim //
meaning:
अस्मिन्नर्थे महाप्राज्ञैर् यदुक्तं शान्तबुद्धिभिः
एतद्वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्यचन्द्रमसोर्गतिम् //
text_mt: Regarding this matter, as was stated by the highly wise of serene intellect, / this course of the sun and moon I will declare to you,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā devagṛhāṇīha sūryacandrādayo grahāḥ
ataḥ paraṃ tu trividham agnervakṣye samudbhavam //
meaning:
यथा देवगृहाणीह सूर्यचन्द्रादयो ग्रहाः
अतः परं तु त्रिविधम् अग्नेर्वक्ष्ये समुद्भवम् //
text_mt: how the sun, moon, and other planets are mansions of the gods in this world. / Further, I will explain the threefold origin of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
divyasya bhautikasyāgner atho 'gneḥ pārthivasya ca
vyuṣṭāyāṃ tu rajanyāṃ ca brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यस्य भौतिकस्याग्नेर् अथो ऽग्नेः पार्थिवस्य च
व्युष्टायां तु रजन्यां च ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः //
text_mt: of celestial fire, physical fire, and also earthly fire. / When the night of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, had dawned,

sanskrit_iast:
avyākṛtamidaṃ tvāsīn naiśena tamasā vṛtam
caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭe 'smin loke naṣṭe viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अव्याकृतमिदं त्वासीन् नैशेन तमसा वृतम्
चतुर्भागावशिष्टे ऽस्मिन् लोके नष्टे विशेषतः //
text_mt: this [world] was undifferentiated, enveloped in nocturnal darkness. / When this world had specially perished, with only one quarter remaining,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhūrbhagavāṃstatra lokasarvārthasādhakaḥ
khadyotavatsa vyacarad āvirbhāvacikīrṣayā //
meaning:
स्वयंभूर्भगवांस्तत्र लोकसर्वार्थसाधकः
खद्योतवत्स व्यचरद् आविर्भावचिकीर्षया //
text_mt: the self-born Lord there, accomplishing all purposes of the world, / roamed like a firefly, wishing to manifest himself.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'gniṃ sṛṣṭvātha lokādau pṛthivījalasaṃśritaḥ
saṃhṛtya tatprakāśārthaṃ tridhā vyabhajadīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽग्निं सृष्ट्वाथ लोकादौ पृथिवीजलसंश्रितः
संहृत्य तत्प्रकाशार्थं त्रिधा व्यभजदीश्वरः //
text_mt: Having created fire at the beginning of the world, resting on earth and water, / the Lord, drawing it together to produce light, divided it into three parts.

sanskrit_iast:
pavano yastu loke 'smin pārthivo vahnirucyate
yaścāsau lokādau sūrye śuciragnistu sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पवनो यस्तु लोके ऽस्मिन् पार्थिवो वह्निरुच्यते
यश्चासौ लोकादौ सूर्ये शुचिरग्निस्तु स स्मृतः //
text_mt: The wind which is in this world is called earthly fire; / and that which is in the sun at the world’s beginning is remembered as pure fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidyuto 'bjastu vijñeyas teṣāṃ vakṣye tu lakṣaṇam
vaidyuto jāṭharaḥ sauro vārigarbhāstrayo 'gnayaḥ //
meaning:
वैद्युतो ऽब्जस्तु विज्ञेयस् तेषां वक्ष्ये तु लक्षणम्
वैद्युतो जाठरः सौरो वारिगर्भास्त्रयो ऽग्नयः //
text_mt: The electrical fire is known to be born of water; I will declare their characteristics: / the electrical, the gastric, and the solar are three fires holding water within.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādapaḥ pibansūryo gobhir dīpyatyasau vibhuḥ
jale cābjaḥ samāviṣṭo nādbhir agniḥ praśāmyati //
meaning:
तस्मादपः पिबन्सूर्यो गोभिर् दीप्यत्यसौ विभुः
जले चाब्जः समाविष्टो नाद्भिर् अग्निः प्रशाम्यति //
text_mt: Therefore the all-pervading sun, drinking water with his rays, blazes. / And the fire born of water, entered into water, is not quenched by the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
mānavānāṃ ca kukṣistho nāgniḥ śāmyati pāvakaḥ
arciṣmānpavanaḥ so 'gnir niṣprabho jāṭharaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मानवानां च कुक्षिस्थो नाग्निः शाम्यति पावकः
अर्चिष्मान्पवनः सो ऽग्निर् निष्प्रभो जाठरः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Nor is the purifying fire residing in the belly of humans quenched. / The fire called wind is luminous, [while] the gastric [fire] is remembered as having no light.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścāyaṃ maṇḍalī śuklī nirūṣmā samprajāyate
prabhā saurī tu pādena hy astaṃ yāte divākare //
meaning:
यश्चायं मण्डली शुक्ली निरूष्मा सम्प्रजायते
प्रभा सौरी तु पादेन ह्य् अस्तं याते दिवाकरे //
text_mt: And that which is circular, white, and without heat is produced; / when the sun has set, the solar radiance, by a fourth part,

sanskrit_iast:
agnimāviśate rātrau tasmāddūrātprakāśate
udyantaṃ ca punaḥ sūryam auṣṇyam agneḥ samāviśet //
meaning:
अग्निमाविशते रात्रौ तस्माद्दूरात्प्रकाशते
उद्यन्तं च पुनः सूर्यम् औष्ण्यम् अग्नेः समाविशेत् //
text_mt: enters into fire at night; therefore [fire] shines from afar. / And the heat of the fire enters the rising sun again

sanskrit_iast:
pādena pārthivasyāgnes tasmādagnistapatyasau
prakāśoṣṇasvarūpe ca saurāgneye tu tejasī //
meaning:
पादेन पार्थिवस्याग्नेस् तस्मादग्निस्तपत्यसौ
प्रकाशोष्णस्वरूपे च सौराग्नेये तु तेजसी //
text_mt: by a fourth part of the earthly fire; therefore that [sun] burns. / In their natures of light and heat, the solar and fiery energies,

sanskrit_iast:
parasparānupraveśād āpyāyete parasparam
uttare caiva bhūmyardhe tathā hyagniś ca dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
परस्परानुप्रवेशाद् आप्यायेते परस्परम्
उत्तरे चैव भूम्यर्धे तथा ह्यग्निश् च दक्षिणे //
text_mt: through mutual penetration, nourish each other. / And in the northern hemisphere of the earth, as well as fire in the southern,

sanskrit_iast:
uttiṣṭhati punaḥ sūryaḥ punarvai praviśaty apaḥ
tasmāttāmrā bhavantyāpo divārātripraveśanāt //
meaning:
उत्तिष्ठति पुनः सूर्यः पुनर्वै प्रविशत्य् अपः
तस्मात्ताम्रा भवन्त्यापो दिवारात्रिप्रवेशनात् //
text_mt: the sun rises again, and it enters into the waters again. / Therefore the waters become copper-colored due to the entrance of day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
astaṃ yāti punaḥ sūryo 'harvai praviśaty apaḥ
tasmānnaktaṃ punaḥ śuklā āpo dṛśyanti bhāsvarāḥ //
meaning:
अस्तं याति पुनः सूर्यो ऽहर्वै प्रविशत्य् अपः
तस्मान्नक्तं पुनः शुक्ला आपो दृश्यन्ति भास्वराः //
text_mt: The sun sets again, and the day enters the waters. / Therefore at night the waters are seen again to be white and shining.

sanskrit_iast:
etena kramayogena bhūmyardhe dakṣiṇottare
udayāstamane nityam ahorātraṃ viśaty apaḥ //
meaning:
एतेन क्रमयोगेन भूम्यर्धे दक्षिणोत्तरे
उदयास्तमने नित्यम् अहोरात्रं विशत्य् अपः //
text_mt: By this successive course, in the southern and northern hemispheres of the earth, / day and night continually enter the waters at sunrise and sunset.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścāsau tapate sūryaḥ pibannaṃbho gabhastibhiḥ
pārthivāgnivimiśro 'sau divyaḥ śuciriti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
यश्चासौ तपते सूर्यः पिबन्नंभो गभस्तिभिः
पार्थिवाग्निविमिश्रो ऽसौ दिव्यः शुचिरिति स्मृतः //
text_mt: And that sun which shines, drinking the water with his rays, / blended with the earthly fire, is remembered as the divine pure [fire].

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrapādasau vahnir vṛttakumbhanibhaḥ smṛtaḥ
ādatte sa tu nāḍīnāṃ sahasreṇa samantataḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रपादसौ वह्निर् वृत्तकुम्भनिभः स्मृतः
आदत्ते स तु नाडीनां सहस्रेण समन्ततः //
text_mt: That fire is remembered as possessing a thousand feet, resembling a round pot. / It draws in [water] from all sides with a thousand channels:

sanskrit_iast:
nādeyīścaiva sāmudrīḥ kūpāścaiva tathā ghanāḥ
sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva vāpīkulyādikā apaḥ //
meaning:
नादेयीश्चैव सामुद्रीः कूपाश्चैव तथा घनाः
स्थावरा जङ्गमाश्चैव वापीकुल्यादिका अपः //
text_mt: river waters and ocean waters, wells and clouds, / stationary and moving waters, and those of ponds, channels, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya raśmisahasraṃ tac chītavarṣoṣṇaniḥsravam
tāsāṃ catuḥśatā nāḍyo varṣante citramūrtayaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य रश्मिसहस्रं तच् छीतवर्षोष्णनिःस्रवम्
तासां चतुःशता नाड्यो वर्षन्ते चित्रमूर्तयः //
text_mt: That thousand rays of his pour out cold, rain, and heat. / Of these, four hundred channels, of diverse forms, shower rain;

sanskrit_iast:
bhajanāścaiva mālyāś ca ketanāḥ patanās tathā
amṛtā nāmataḥ sarvā raśmayo vṛṣṭisarjanāḥ //
meaning:
भजनाश्चैव माल्याश् च केतनाः पतनास् तथा
अमृता नामतः सर्वा रश्मयो वृष्टिसर्जनाः //
text_mt: known by the names Bhajanā, Mālyā, Ketanā, and Patanā, / all are [called] Amṛtā rays, dischargers of rain.

sanskrit_iast:
himodvahāś ca tā nāḍyo raśmayas triśatāḥ punaḥ
reśā meghāś ca vātsyāś ca hlādinyo himasarjanāḥ //
meaning:
हिमोद्वहाश् च ता नाड्यो रश्मयस् त्रिशताः पुनः
रेशा मेघाश् च वात्स्याश् च ह्लादिन्यो हिमसर्जनाः //
text_mt: And those three hundred channels, rays bearing snow, / are Reśā, Meghā, Vātsyā, and Hlādinī, dischargers of snow.

sanskrit_iast:
candrabhā nāmataḥ sarvā pītābhāś ca gabhastayaḥ
śuklāś ca kakubhāścaiva gāvo viśvabhṛtas tathā //
meaning:
चन्द्रभा नामतः सर्वा पीताभाश् च गभस्तयः
शुक्लाश् च ककुभाश्चैव गावो विश्वभृतस् तथा //
text_mt: All are named Candrabhā, rays of yellow radiance; / and white, and Kakubhā, and cows, world-nourishers.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāstā nāmataḥ sarvās triśatīrgharmasarjanāḥ
somo bibharti tābhistu manuṣyapitṛdevatāḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लास्ता नामतः सर्वास् त्रिशतीर्घर्मसर्जनाः
सोमो बिभर्ति ताभिस्तु मनुष्यपितृदेवताः //
text_mt: All those three hundred are named Śuklā, dischargers of heat. / With them, Soma sustains humans, ancestors, and gods;

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyānauṣadheneha svadhayā ca pitṝnapi
amṛtena surān sarvāṃs tisṛbhis tarpayatyasau //
meaning:
मनुष्यानौषधेनेह स्वधया च पितॄनपि
अमृतेन सुरान् सर्वांस् तिसृभिस् तर्पयत्यसौ //
text_mt: humans with herbs here, ancestors with svadhā, / and all the gods with amṛta; he satisfies them with the three.

sanskrit_iast:
vasante caiva grīṣme ca śataiḥ sa tapate tribhiḥ
varṣāsvatho śaradi ca caturbhiḥ saṃpravarṣati //
meaning:
वसन्ते चैव ग्रीष्मे च शतैः स तपते त्रिभिः
वर्षास्वथो शरदि च चतुर्भिः संप्रवर्षति //
text_mt: In spring and summer he blazes with three hundred [rays]; / and in the rainy season and autumn he rains heavily with four hundred;

sanskrit_iast:
hemante śiśire caiva himamutsṛjate tribhiḥ
indro dhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā mitro 'tha varuṇo 'ryamā //
meaning:
हेमन्ते शिशिरे चैव हिममुत्सृजते त्रिभिः
इन्द्रो धाता भगः पूषा मित्रो ऽथ वरुणो ऽर्यमा //
text_mt: in winter and the dewy season he emits cold with three hundred. / Indra, Dhātṛ, Bhaga, Pūṣan, Mitra, then Varuṇa, Aryaman,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśur vivasvāṃstvaṣṭā ca parjanyo viṣṇureva ca
varuṇo māghamāse tu sūrya eva tu phālgune //
meaning:
अंशुर् विवस्वांस्त्वष्टा च पर्जन्यो विष्णुरेव च
वरुणो माघमासे तु सूर्य एव तु फाल्गुने //
text_mt: Aṃśu, Vivasvat, Tvaṣṭṛ, Parjanya, and Viṣṇu. / Varuṇa is the sun in the month of Māgha, and [Pūṣan] in Phālguna;

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi bhavedaṃśur dhātā vaiśākhatāpanaḥ
jyeṣṭhe māsi bhavedindra āṣāḍhe cāryamā raviḥ //
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि भवेदंशुर् धाता वैशाखतापनः
ज्येष्ठे मासि भवेदिन्द्र आषाढे चार्यमा रविः //
text_mt: Aṃśu is in the month of Caitra; Dhātṛ is the scorcher of Vaiśākha; / Indra is in the month of Jyeṣṭha; and the sun Aryaman is in Āṣāḍha;

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvān śrāvaṇe māsi prauṣṭhapade bhagaḥ smṛtaḥ
parjanyo 'śvayuje māsi tvaṣṭā vai kārtike raviḥ //
meaning:
विवस्वान् श्रावणे मासि प्रौष्ठपदे भगः स्मृतः
पर्जन्यो ऽश्वयुजे मासि त्वष्टा वै कार्तिके रविः //
text_mt: Vivasvat is remembered in the month of Śrāvaṇa; Bhaga in Prauṣṭhapada; / Parjanya is the sun in the month of Aśvayuj; Tvaṣṭṛ in Kārtika;

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe bhavenmitraḥ pauṣe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
pañcaraśmisahasrāṇi varuṇasyārkakarmaṇi //
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे भवेन्मित्रः पौषे विष्णुः सनातनः
पञ्चरश्मिसहस्राणि वरुणस्यार्ककर्मणि //
text_mt: Mitra is in Mārgaśīrṣa; Viṣṇu is the eternal one in Pauṣa. / Five thousand rays belong to Varuṇa in his solar work;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍbhiḥ sahasraiḥ pūṣā tu devo 'ṃśuḥ saptabhis tathā
dhātāṣṭabhiḥ sahasraistu navabhistu śatakratuḥ //
meaning:
षड्भिः सहस्रैः पूषा तु देवो ऽंशुः सप्तभिस् तथा
धाताष्टभिः सहस्रैस्तु नवभिस्तु शतक्रतुः //
text_mt: Pūṣan with six thousand; the god Aṃśu with seven; / Dhātṛ with eight thousand; and Śatakratu with nine;

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvān daśabhir yāti yātyekādaśabhir bhagaḥ
saptabhistapate mitras tvaṣṭā caivāṣṭabhiḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विवस्वान् दशभिर् याति यात्येकादशभिर् भगः
सप्तभिस्तपते मित्रस् त्वष्टा चैवाष्टभिः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Vivasvat moves with ten thousand; Bhaga moves with eleven; / Mitra shines with seven; and Tvaṣṭṛ is remembered with eight;

sanskrit_iast:
aryamā daśabhir yāti parjanyo navabhis tathā
ṣaḍbhī raśmisahasraistu viṣṇustapati medinīm //
meaning:
अर्यमा दशभिर् याति पर्जन्यो नवभिस् तथा
षड्भी रश्मिसहस्रैस्तु विष्णुस्तपति मेदिनीम् //
text_mt: Aryaman moves with ten thousand; Parjanya with nine; / with six thousand rays Viṣṇu scorches the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃte kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣme kāñcanasaprabhaḥ
śveto varṣāsu varṇena pāṇḍuḥ śaradi bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
वसंते कपिलः सूर्यो ग्रीष्मे काञ्चनसप्रभः
श्वेतो वर्षासु वर्णेन पाण्डुः शरदि भास्करः //
text_mt: In spring the sun is tawny; in summer he has the luster of gold; / in the rains he is white in color; in autumn the sun is pale;

sanskrit_iast:
hemante tāmravarṇastu śiśire lohito raviḥ
iti varṇāḥ samākhyātā mayā sūryasamudbhavāḥ //
meaning:
हेमन्ते ताम्रवर्णस्तु शिशिरे लोहितो रविः
इति वर्णाः समाख्याता मया सूर्यसमुद्भवाः //
text_mt: in winter he is copper-colored; in the dewy season the sun is red. / Thus the colors originating from the sun have been declared by me.

sanskrit_iast:
oṣadhīṣu balaṃ dhatte svadhayā ca pitṛṣvapi
sūryo 'mareṣvapyamṛtaṃ trayaṃ triṣu niyacchati //
meaning:
ओषधीषु बलं धत्ते स्वधया च पितृष्वपि
सूर्यो ऽमरेष्वप्यमृतं त्रयं त्रिषु नियच्छति //
text_mt: The sun imparts strength to the herbs, and to the ancestors with svadhā, / and to the immortals amṛta; he bestows the three upon the three.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ raśmisahasraṃ tat sauraṃ lokārthasādhakam
bhidyate lokamāsādya jalaśītoṣṇaniḥsravam //
meaning:
एवं रश्मिसहस्रं तत् सौरं लोकार्थसाधकम्
भिद्यते लोकमासाद्य जलशीतोष्णनिःस्रवम् //
text_mt: Thus that thousand rays of the sun, accomplishing the welfare of the world, / having reached the world, pours out water, cold, and heat.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetanmaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ bhāsvaraṃ sūryasaṃjñitam
nakṣatragrahasomānāṃ pratiṣṭhāyonireva ca //
meaning:
इत्येतन्मण्डलं शुक्लं भास्वरं सूर्यसंज्ञितम्
नक्षत्रग्रहसोमानां प्रतिष्ठायोनिरेव च //
text_mt: Thus this white, radiant disc known as the sun / is the foundation and the source of the lunar mansions, planets, and the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
candraṛkṣagrahāḥ sarve vijñeyāḥ sūryasaṃbhavāḥ
nakṣatrādhipatiḥ somo nayanaṃ vāmamīśituḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रऋक्षग्रहाः सर्वे विज्ञेयाः सूर्यसंभवाः
नक्षत्राधिपतिः सोमो नयनं वाममीशितुः //
text_mt: The moon, lunar mansions, and all planets are to be known as originating from the sun. / The moon, the lord of the lunar mansions, is the left eye of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
nayanaṃ caivam īśasya dakṣiṇaṃ bhāskaraḥ svayam
teṣāṃ janānāṃ loke 'smin nayanaṃ nayate yataḥ //
meaning:
नयनं चैवम् ईशस्य दक्षिणं भास्करः स्वयम्
तेषां जनानां लोके ऽस्मिन् नयनं नयते यतः //
text_mt: And likewise, the right eye of the Lord is the Sun himself, / because he leads the eyes of people in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śeṣāḥ pañca grahā jñeyā īśvarāḥ kāmacāriṇaḥ
paṭhyate cāgnirāditya udakaṃ candramāḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
शेषाः पञ्च ग्रहा ज्ञेया ईश्वराः कामचारिणः
पठ्यते चाग्निरादित्य उदकं चन्द्रमाः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / The remaining five planets are to be known as lords who move at will. / The Sun is declared to be fire, and the Moon is remembered as water.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāṇāṃ prakṛtiṃ samyag vakṣyamāṇāṃ nibodhata
surasenāpatiḥ skandaḥ paṭhyate 'ṅgārako grahaḥ //
meaning:
शेषाणां प्रकृतिं सम्यग् वक्ष्यमाणां निबोधत
सुरसेनापतिः स्कन्दः पठ्यते ऽङ्गारको ग्रहः //
text_mt: Understand properly the nature of the remaining ones as it will be told: / The planet Mars is declared to be Skanda, the commander of the gods’ army.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ budhaṃ prāhur devaṃ jñānavido janāḥ
sarvalokaprabhuḥ sākṣād yamo lokaprabhuḥ svayam //
meaning:
नारायणं बुधं प्राहुर् देवं ज्ञानविदो जनाः
सर्वलोकप्रभुः साक्षाद् यमो लोकप्रभुः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Men who know truth declare Mercury to be the god Nārāyaṇa. / The lord of all the worlds himself, Yama in person, is the lord of the worlds [here]:

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgraho dvijaśreṣṭhā mandagāmī śanaiścaraḥ
devāsuragurū dvau tu bhānumantau mahāgrahau //
meaning:
महाग्रहो द्विजश्रेष्ठा मन्दगामी शनैश्चरः
देवासुरगुरू द्वौ तु भानुमन्तौ महाग्रहौ //
text_mt: the great planet, the slow-moving Saturn, O best of the twice-born. / The two preceptors of the gods and asuras are the two radiant great planets,

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatisutāvuktau tataḥ śukrabṛhaspatī
ādityamūlamakhilaṃ trailokyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रजापतिसुतावुक्तौ ततः शुक्रबृहस्पती
आदित्यमूलमखिलं त्रैलोक्यं नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Venus and Jupiter; therefore they are said to be sons of Prajāpatis. / The entire three worlds have the Sun as their source; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatyasmājjagatkṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
rudrendropendracandrāṇāṃ viprendrāgnidivaukasām //
meaning:
भवत्यस्माज्जगत्कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
रुद्रेन्द्रोपेन्द्रचन्द्राणां विप्रेन्द्राग्निदिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: From him arises the entire world, along with gods, asuras, and humans; / [from him comes] the splendor of Rudras, Indras, Upendras, Moons,

sanskrit_iast:
dyutirdyutimatāṃ kṛtsnaṃ yattejaḥ sarvalaukikam
sarvātmā sarvalokeśo mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
द्युतिर्द्युतिमतां कृत्स्नं यत्तेजः सर्वलौकिकम्
सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशो महादेवः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: foremost Brahmins, Agnis, and denizens of heaven, of [all] luminous beings, / and all the cosmic brilliance. / The Self of all, the Lord of all the worlds, Mahādeva, Prajāpati,

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya eva trilokeśo mūlaṃ paramadaivatam
tataḥ saṃjāyate sarvaṃ tatraiva pravilīyate //
meaning:
सूर्य एव त्रिलोकेशो मूलं परमदैवतम्
ततः संजायते सर्वं तत्रैव प्रविलीयते //
text_mt: the Sun himself is the Lord of the three worlds, the source, the supreme deity. / From him everything arises, and in him alone everything dissolves.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvābhāvau hi lokānām ādityānniḥsṛtau purā
avijñeyo graho viprā dīptimānsuprabho raviḥ //
meaning:
भावाभावौ हि लोकानाम् आदित्यान्निःसृतौ पुरा
अविज्ञेयो ग्रहो विप्रा दीप्तिमान्सुप्रभो रविः //
text_mt: Indeed, the existence and non-existence of the worlds emanated in the past from the Sun. / The brilliant, brightly shining Sun is a planet beyond comprehension, O Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
atra gacchanti nidhanaṃ jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ
kṣaṇā muhūrtā divasā niśāḥ pakṣāś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
अत्र गच्छन्ति निधनं जायन्ते च पुनः पुनः
क्षणा मुहूर्ता दिवसा निशाः पक्षाश् च कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: In him do moments, muhūrtas, days, / nights, and fortnights go to their end and are born again and again in their entirety;

sanskrit_iast:
māsāḥ saṃvatsaraścaiva ṛtavo 'tha yugāni ca
tadādityādṛte hyeṣā kālasaṃkhyā na vidyate //
meaning:
मासाः संवत्सरश्चैव ऋतवो ऽथ युगानि च
तदादित्यादृते ह्येषा कालसंख्या न विद्यते //
text_mt: the months, the year, the seasons, and the yugas. / Indeed, without that Sun, this reckoning of time would not exist.

sanskrit_iast:
kālādṛte na niyamo na dīkṣā nāhnikakramaḥ
ṛtūnāṃ ca vibhāgaś ca puṣpaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ kutaḥ //
meaning:
कालादृते न नियमो न दीक्षा नाह्निकक्रमः
ऋतूनां च विभागश् च पुष्पं मूलं फलं कुतः //
text_mt: Without time, there is no sacred observance, no initiation, and no order of daily rites. / How could there be the division of the seasons, or flower, root, and fruit?

sanskrit_iast:
kutaḥ sasyaviniṣpattis tṛṇauṣadhigaṇo 'pi ca
abhāvo vyavahārāṇāṃ jantūnāṃ divi ceha ca //
meaning:
कुतः सस्यविनिष्पत्तिस् तृणौषधिगणो ऽपि च
अभावो व्यवहाराणां जन्तूनां दिवि चेह च //
text_mt: Whence could come the ripening of crops, or the multitude of grasses and medicinal herbs? / There would be non-existence of the activities of living beings, in heaven and here on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
jagatpratāpanamṛte bhāskaraṃ rudrarūpiṇam
sa eṣa kālaścāgniś ca dvādaśātmā prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
जगत्प्रतापनमृते भास्करं रुद्ररूपिणम्
स एष कालश्चाग्निश् च द्वादशात्मा प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: without the Sun who scorches the universe, whose form is Rudra. / He is Time, Fire, the twelve-souled Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
tapatyeṣa dvijaśreṣṭhās trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
sa eṣa tejasāṃ rāśiḥ samastaḥ sārvalaukikaḥ //
meaning:
तपत्येष द्विजश्रेष्ठास् त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
स एष तेजसां राशिः समस्तः सार्वलौकिकः //
text_mt: He warms the three worlds, both moving and unmoving, O best of the twice-born. / He is the mass of all splendors, universal across all worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ mārgamāsthāya rātryahobhir idaṃ jagat
pārśvata ūrdhvam adhaś caiva tāpayatyeṣa sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तमं मार्गमास्थाय रात्र्यहोभिर् इदं जगत्
पार्श्वत ऊर्ध्वम् अधश् चैव तापयत्येष सर्वशः //
text_mt: Taking the highest course through nights and days, he heats / this universe entirely, sideways, above, and below,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā prabhākaro dīpo gṛhamadhye 'valambitaḥ
pārśvata ūrdhvam adhaścaiva tamo nāśayate samam //
meaning:
यथा प्रभाकरो दीपो गृहमध्ये ऽवलम्बितः
पार्श्वत ऊर्ध्वम् अधश्चैव तमो नाशयते समम् //
text_mt: just as a luminous lamp suspended in the middle of a house / dispels darkness equally sideways, above, and below.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatsahasrakiraṇo graharājo jagatprabhuḥ
sūryo gobhir jagat sarvam ādīpayati sarvataḥ //
meaning:
तद्वत्सहस्रकिरणो ग्रहराजो जगत्प्रभुः
सूर्यो गोभिर् जगत् सर्वम् आदीपयति सर्वतः //
text_mt: In the same way, the thousand-rayed king of planets, the lord of the universe, / the Sun illuminates the entire world on all sides with his rays.

sanskrit_iast:
rave raśmisahasraṃ yat prāṅmayā samudāhṛtam
teṣāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ punaḥ sapta raśmayo grahayonayaḥ //
meaning:
रवे रश्मिसहस्रं यत् प्राङ्मया समुदाहृतम्
तेषां श्रेष्ठाः पुनः सप्त रश्मयो ग्रहयोनयः //
text_mt: The thousand rays of the Sun that were mentioned by me earlier— / among them seven rays are superior, being the wombs of the planets:

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumno harikeśaś ca viśvakarmā tathaiva ca
viśvavyacāḥ punaścādyaḥ saṃnaddhaś ca tataḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
सुषुम्नो हरिकेशश् च विश्वकर्मा तथैव च
विश्वव्यचाः पुनश्चाद्यः संनद्धश् च ततः परः //
text_mt: Suṣumna, Harikeśa, and Viśvakarmā, / and Viśvavyacas, the first [of the next group], and then Saṃnaddha after that,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāvasuḥ punaścānyaḥ svarāḍanyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
suṣumnaḥ sūryaraśmistu dakṣiṇāṃ rāśim aidhayat //
meaning:
सर्वावसुः पुनश्चान्यः स्वराडन्यः प्रकीर्तितः
सुषुम्नः सूर्यरश्मिस्तु दक्षिणां राशिम् ऐधयत् //
text_mt: and then another, Sarvāvasu, and another is proclaimed as Svarāj. / The solar ray Suṣumna nourished the southern mass [of constellations];

sanskrit_iast:
nyagūrdhvādhaḥ pracāro 'sya suṣumnaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
harikeśaḥ purastād yo ṛkṣayoniḥ prakīrtyate //
meaning:
न्यगूर्ध्वाधः प्रचारो ऽस्य सुषुम्नः परिकीर्तितः
हरिकेशः पुरस्ताद् यो ऋक्षयोनिः प्रकीर्त्यते //
text_mt: his course is downward, upward, and below—he is proclaimed as Suṣumna. / That Harikeśa, which is in the east, is proclaimed as the source of the asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe viśvakarmā ca raśmirvardhayate budham
viśvavyacāstu yaḥ paścāc chukrayoniḥ smṛto budhaiḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणे विश्वकर्मा च रश्मिर्वर्धयते बुधम्
विश्वव्यचास्तु यः पश्चाच् छुक्रयोनिः स्मृतो बुधैः //
text_mt: And in the south, the ray Viśvakarmā augments Mercury. / But that Viśvavyacas in the west is remembered by the wise as the womb of Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnaddhaś ca tu yo raśmiḥ sa yonir lohitasya tu
ṣaṣṭhaḥ sarvāvasū raśmiḥ sa yonistu bṛhaspateḥ //
meaning:
संनद्धश् च तु यो रश्मिः स योनिर् लोहितस्य तु
षष्ठः सर्वावसू रश्मिः स योनिस्तु बृहस्पतेः //
text_mt: The ray Saṃnaddha is the source of Mars; / the sixth ray, Sarvāvasu, is the source of Jupiter;

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaraṃ punaś cāpi raśmir āpyāyate svarāṭ
evaṃ sūryaprabhāvena nakṣatragrahatārakāḥ //
meaning:
शनैश्चरं पुनश् चापि रश्मिर् आप्यायते स्वराट्
एवं सूर्यप्रभावेन नक्षत्रग्रहतारकाः //
text_mt: and the ray Svarāj nourishes Saturn. / Thus, through the power of the Sun, the lunar asterisms, planets, and stars

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante divi tāḥ sarvāḥ viśvaṃ cedaṃ punarjagat
na kṣīyante yatastāni tasmānnakṣatratā smṛtā //
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते दिवि ताः सर्वाः विश्वं चेदं पुनर्जगत्
न क्षीयन्ते यतस्तानि तस्मान्नक्षत्रता स्मृता //
text_mt: are all seen in the sky, and this entire universe as well. / Since they do not perish (na kṣīyante), they are called nakṣatras.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
kṣetrāṇyetāni sarvāṇi ātapanti gabhastibhiḥ
teṣāṃ kṣetrāṇyathādatte sūryo nakṣatratārakāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
क्षेत्राण्येतानि सर्वाणि आतपन्ति गभस्तिभिः
तेषां क्षेत्राण्यथादत्ते सूर्यो नक्षत्रतारकाः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / All these fields shine with their rays; / then the Sun takes back the fields of those lunar asterisms and stars.

sanskrit_iast:
cīrṇena sukṛteneha sukṛtānte grahāśrayāḥ
tāraṇāttārakā hyetāḥ śuklatvāccaiva tārakāḥ //
meaning:
चीर्णेन सुकृतेनेह सुकृतान्ते ग्रहाश्रयाः
तारणात्तारका ह्येताः शुक्लत्वाच्चैव तारकाः //
text_mt: By virtue of good deeds performed here, at the end of the good deeds they have planets as their abodes. / Indeed, they are called tārakās (stars) because of carrying across (tāraṇa) and because of their whiteness (śuklatva).

sanskrit_iast:
divyānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca naiśānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ
ādānānnityamādityas tejasāṃ tamasāmapi //
meaning:
दिव्यानां पार्थिवानां च नैशानां चैव सर्वशः
आदानान्नित्यमादित्यस् तेजसां तमसामपि //
text_mt: Because he continually draws in (ādāna) heavenly, earthly, and nocturnal / splendors and darknesses from every direction, he is called Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
savane syandane 'rthe ca dhātur eṣa vibhāṣyate
savanāttejaso 'pāṃ ca tenāsau savitā mataḥ //
meaning:
सवने स्यन्दने ऽर्थे च धातुर् एष विभाष्यते
सवनात्तेजसो ऽपां च तेनासौ सविता मतः //
text_mt: This verbal root is spoken in the sense of pressing out (savana) and flowing; / because of pressing forth light and water, he is regarded as Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
bahulaścandra ityeṣa hlādane dhāturucyate
śuklatve cāmṛtatve ca śītatve ca vibhāvyate //
meaning:
बहुलश्चन्द्र इत्येष ह्लादने धातुरुच्यते
शुक्लत्वे चामृतत्वे च शीतत्वे च विभाव्यते //
text_mt: The root candr- is said to mean “to gladden” abundantly; / it is conceived in terms of whiteness, ambrosia, and coolness.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryācandramasordivye maṇḍale bhāsvare khage
jalatejomaye śukle vṛttakuṃbhanibhe śubhe //
meaning:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्दिव्ये मण्डले भास्वरे खगे
जलतेजोमये शुक्ले वृत्तकुंभनिभे शुभे //
text_mt: The divine, luminous discs of the Sun and Moon, moving in the sky, / consist of water and fire, are white, auspicious, and resemble round jars.

sanskrit_iast:
ghanatoyātmakaṃ tatra maṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam
ghanatejomayaṃ śuklaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhāskarasya tu //
meaning:
घनतोयात्मकं तत्र मण्डलं शशिनः स्मृतम्
घनतेजोमयं शुक्लं मण्डलं भास्करस्य तु //
text_mt: Among them, the disc of the Moon is remembered as consisting of dense water; / the disc of the Sun, however, is white and consists of dense fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vasanti sarvadevāś ca sthānānyetāni sarvaśaḥ
manvantareṣu sarveṣu ṛkṣasūryagrahāśrayāḥ //
meaning:
वसन्ति सर्वदेवाश् च स्थानान्येतानि सर्वशः
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु ऋक्षसूर्यग्रहाश्रयाः //
text_mt: All the gods dwell in these abodes in every way, / residing in the lunar asterisms, the Sun, and the planets through all the manvantaras.

sanskrit_iast:
tena grahā gṛhāṇyeva tadākhyāste bhavanti ca
sauraṃ sūryo 'viśatsthānaṃ saumyaṃ somastathaiva ca //
meaning:
तेन ग्रहा गृहाण्येव तदाख्यास्ते भवन्ति च
सौरं सूर्यो ऽविशत्स्थानं सौम्यं सोमस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Therefore the planets (graha) are indeed houses (gṛha), and they bear those names. / The Sun entered the solar abode, and the Moon entered the lunar abode;

sanskrit_iast:
śaukraṃ śukro 'viśatsthānaṃ ṣoḍaśārciḥ pratāpavān
bṛhad bṛhaspatiścaiva lohitaścaiva lohitam //
meaning:
शौक्रं शुक्रो ऽविशत्स्थानं षोडशार्चिः प्रतापवान्
बृहद् बृहस्पतिश्चैव लोहितश्चैव लोहितम् //
text_mt: Venus, sixteen-rayed and powerful, entered the abode of Venus; / Jupiter entered the great (bṛhat) abode, and Mars (Lohita) entered the red (lohita) abode;

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaraṃ tathā sthānaṃ devaścāpi śanaiścaraḥ
baudhaṃ budhastu svarbhānuḥ svarbhānusthānamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
शनैश्चरं तथा स्थानं देवश्चापि शनैश्चरः
बौधं बुधस्तु स्वर्भानुः स्वर्भानुस्थानमाश्रितः //
text_mt: the god Saturn entered the abode of Saturn; / Mercury entered the mercurial abode, and Svarbhānu (Rāhu) resorted to Svarbhānu’s abode.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi nakṣatrāṇi viśanti ca
gṛhāṇyetāni sarvāṇi jyotīṃṣi sukṛtātmanām //
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि नक्षत्राणि विशन्ति च
गृहाण्येतानि सर्वाणि ज्योतींषि सुकृतात्मनाम् //
text_mt: And all the lunar asterisms enter into the nakṣatras. / All these celestial bodies are houses for those of virtuous souls.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpādau sampravṛttāni nirmitāni svayaṃbhuvā
sthānānyetāni tiṣṭhanti yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
कल्पादौ सम्प्रवृत्तानि निर्मितानि स्वयंभुवा
स्थानान्येतानि तिष्ठन्ति यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: Initiated at the beginning of the kalpa, created by the Self-born, / these abodes remain until the cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu devasthānāni tāni vai
abhimānino 'vatiṣṭhante devāḥ sthānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु देवस्थानानि तानि वै
अभिमानिनो ऽवतिष्ठन्ते देवाः स्थानं पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: In all the manvantaras, those are indeed the abodes of the gods. / Presiding deities occupy that abode again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
atītaistu sahaitāni bhāvyābhāvyaiḥ suraiḥ saha
vartante vartamānaiś ca sthānibhistaiḥ suraiḥ saha //
meaning:
अतीतैस्तु सहैतानि भाव्याभाव्यैः सुरैः सह
वर्तन्ते वर्तमानैश् च स्थानिभिस्तैः सुरैः सह //
text_mt: Together with past gods, with those yet to come and those who will not, / and together with present ones, [these abodes] endure along with those occupying gods.

sanskrit_iast:
asminmanvantare caiva grahā vaimānikāḥ smṛtāḥ
vivasvānaditeḥ putraḥ sūryo vaivasvate 'ntare //
meaning:
अस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे चैव ग्रहा वैमानिकाः स्मृताः
विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सूर्यो वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे //
text_mt: And in this manvantara, the planets are remembered as celestial-car riders. / In the Vaivasvata interval, the Sun is Vivasvat, son of Aditi.

sanskrit_iast:
dyutimānṛṣiputrastu somo devo vasuḥ smṛtaḥ
śukro devastu vijñeyo bhārgavo 'surayājakaḥ //
meaning:
द्युतिमानृषिपुत्रस्तु सोमो देवो वसुः स्मृतः
शुक्रो देवस्तु विज्ञेयो भार्गवो ऽसुरयाजकः //
text_mt: The luminous Soma, son of a sage, is known as a god and a Vasu; / Śukra, son of Bhṛgu, is to be known as a god and the priest of the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhattejāḥ smṛto devo devācāryo 'ṅgiraḥsutaḥ
budho manoharaścaiva ṛṣiputrastu sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
बृहत्तेजाः स्मृतो देवो देवाचार्यो ऽङ्गिरःसुतः
बुधो मनोहरश्चैव ऋषिपुत्रस्तु स स्मृतः //
text_mt: The son of Aṅgiras of immense splendor is known as a god and the teacher of the gods; / Budha, attractive in appearance, is known as the son of a sage.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaro virūpastu saṃjñāputro vivasvataḥ
agnirvikeśyāṃ jajñe tu yuvāsau lohitārciṣaḥ //
meaning:
शनैश्चरो विरूपस्तु संज्ञापुत्रो विवस्वतः
अग्निर्विकेश्यां जज्ञे तु युवासौ लोहितार्चिषः //
text_mt: Śanaiścara, deformity-bodied, was the son of Vivasvat through Saṃjñā; / while he, born of Vikeśī, is the youthful fire of red rays.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatraṛkṣanāminyo dākṣāyaṇyastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ
svarbhānuḥ siṃhikāputro bhūtasaṃtāpano 'suraḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्रऋक्षनामिन्यो दाक्षायण्यस्तु ताः स्मृताः
स्वर्भानुः सिंहिकापुत्रो भूतसंतापनो ऽसुरः //
text_mt: The asterisms named nakṣatra and ṛkṣa are remembered as the daughters of Dakṣa; / Svarbhānu, son of Siṃhikā, is the asura who torments beings.

sanskrit_iast:
somarkṣagrahasūryeṣu kīrtitāstvabhimāninaḥ
sthānānyetānyathoktāni sthāninyaścaiva devatāḥ //
meaning:
सोमर्क्षग्रहसूर्येषु कीर्तितास्त्वभिमानिनः
स्थानान्येतान्यथोक्तानि स्थानिन्यश्चैव देवताः //
text_mt: These have been proclaimed as the presiding deities in the moon, the stars, the planets, and the sun; / and these abodes, as described, have these presiding deities.

sanskrit_iast:
sauram agnimayaṃ sthānaṃ sahasrāṃśorvivasvataḥ
himāṃśostu smṛtaṃ sthānam ammayaṃ śuklameva ca //
meaning:
सौरम् अग्निमयं स्थानं सहस्रांशोर्विवस्वतः
हिमांशोस्तु स्मृतं स्थानम् अम्मयं शुक्लमेव च //
text_mt: The abode of the thousand-rayed Vivasvat belongs to the sun and is full of fire; / that of the cool-rayed [moon] is remembered as made of water and white indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyaṃ śyāmaṃ manojñaṃ ca budharaśmigṛhaṃ smṛtam
śuklasyāpyammayaṃ śuklaṃ padaṃ ṣoḍaśaraśmivat //
meaning:
आप्यं श्यामं मनोज्ञं च बुधरश्मिगृहं स्मृतम्
शुक्लस्याप्यम्मयं शुक्लं पदं षोडशरश्मिवत् //
text_mt: The abode of Budha's rays is remembered as watery, dark-hued, and pleasing; / the abode of Śukra is also watery, white, and possessed of sixteen rays.

sanskrit_iast:
navaraśmi tu bhaumasya lohitaṃ sthānam uttamam
haridrābhaṃ bṛhaccāpi ṣoḍaśārcirbṛhaspateḥ //
meaning:
नवरश्मि तु भौमस्य लोहितं स्थानम् उत्तमम्
हरिद्राभं बृहच्चापि षोडशार्चिर्बृहस्पतेः //
text_mt: The excellent abode of Bhauma has nine rays and is red; / and that of Bṛhaspati is turmeric-hued, vast, and possessed of sixteen rays.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭaraśmigṛhaṃ cāpi proktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śanaiścare
svarbhānostāmasaṃ sthānaṃ bhūtasaṃtāpanālayam //
meaning:
अष्टरश्मिगृहं चापि प्रोक्तं कृष्णं शनैश्चरे
स्वर्भानोस्तामसं स्थानं भूतसंतापनालयम् //
text_mt: The dark abode of Śanaiścara is declared to possess eight rays; / the dark abode of Svarbhānu is the tormenting habitation of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñeyāstārakāḥ sarvās tv ṛṣayastvekaraśmayaḥ
āśrayāḥ puṇyakīrtīnāṃ śuklāścāpi svavarṇataḥ //
meaning:
विज्ञेयास्तारकाः सर्वास् त्व् ऋषयस्त्वेकरश्मयः
आश्रयाः पुण्यकीर्तीनां शुक्लाश्चापि स्ववर्णतः //
text_mt: All the stars are to be known as having one ray, as are the sages; / they are the resorts of those of virtuous fame and are white by their natural color.

sanskrit_iast:
ghanatoyātmikā jñeyāḥ kalpādāveva nirmitāḥ
ādityaraśmisaṃyogāt saṃprakāśātmikāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
घनतोयात्मिका ज्ञेयाः कल्पादावेव निर्मिताः
आदित्यरश्मिसंयोगात् संप्रकाशात्मिकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: They are to be known as dense water in nature, fashioned right at the beginning of the kalpa; / they are remembered as luminous through their conjunction with the sun's rays.

sanskrit_iast:
navayojanasāhasro viṣkaṃbhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ
triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कंभः सवितुः स्मृतः
त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः //
text_mt: The diameter of the sun is remembered as nine thousand yojanas; / the circumference of that disc is three times that in measure.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇaḥ sūryavistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ
tulyastayostu svarbhānur bhūtvādhastātprasarpati //
meaning:
द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद् विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः
तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर् भूत्वाधस्तात्प्रसर्पति //
text_mt: The diameter of the moon is remembered as twice the diameter of the sun; / equal to both of them, Svarbhānu creeps beneath them.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtya pṛthivīchāyāṃ nirmitāṃ maṇḍalākṛtim
svarbhānostu bṛhatsthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yattamomayam //
meaning:
उद्धृत्य पृथिवीछायां निर्मितां मण्डलाकृतिम्
स्वर्भानोस्तु बृहत्स्थानं तृतीयं यत्तमोमयम् //
text_mt: Taking up the shadow of the earth, fashioned into the shape of a disc, / the great third abode of Svarbhānu is full of darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityāttacca niṣkramya samaṃ gacchati parvasu
ādityameti somācca punaḥ saureṣu parvasu //
meaning:
आदित्यात्तच्च निष्क्रम्य समं गच्छति पर्वसु
आदित्यमेति सोमाच्च पुनः सौरेषु पर्वसु //
text_mt: Coming forth from the sun, it moves evenly at the joints [of the lunar phases]; / and from the moon it goes to the sun again during the solar joints.

sanskrit_iast:
svarbhānuṃ nudate yasmāt tasmātsvarbhānurucyate
candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate //
meaning:
स्वर्भानुं नुदते यस्मात् तस्मात्स्वर्भानुरुच्यते
चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते //
text_mt: Because it dispels the sun's light, it is called Svarbhānu. / One sixteenth part of the moon is allotted to Śukra,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkaṃbhānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanāgrātpramāṇataḥ
bhārgavātpādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
विष्कंभान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनाग्रात्प्रमाणतः
भार्गवात्पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: in diameter and circumference, and in the total measure in yojanas. / Bṛhaspati is to be known as one fourth less than Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurī ubhau smṛtau
vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतेः पादहीनौ वक्रसौरी उभौ स्मृतौ
विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः //
text_mt: Both Vakra and Śauri are remembered as one fourth less than Bṛhaspati; / and Budha is one fourth less than the two in diameter and circumference.

sanskrit_iast:
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmantīha yāni vai
budhena tāni tulyāni vistārānmaṇḍalācca vai //
meaning:
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि वपुष्मन्तीह यानि वै
बुधेन तानि तुल्यानि विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्च वै //
text_mt: The embodied forms of the lunar mansions and stars here / are equal to Budha in diameter and circumference.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaśaścandrayogīni vidyādṛkṣāṇi tattvavit
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparam //
meaning:
प्रायशश्चन्द्रयोगीनि विद्यादृक्षाणि तत्त्ववित्
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परम् //
text_mt: The knower of truth should know that the asterisms are mostly conjoined with the moon; / the forms of the stars and lunar mansions are smaller than one another.

sanskrit_iast:
śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane
sarvopari nikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni tu //
meaning:
शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने
सर्वोपरि निकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु //
text_mt: The lowest discs of stars situated above all / are five, four, three, and two yojanas [in size];

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānyardhamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate
upariṣṭāttrayasteṣāṃ grahāste dūrasarpiṇaḥ //
meaning:
योजनान्यर्धमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते
उपरिष्टात्त्रयस्तेषां ग्रहास्ते दूरसर्पिणः //
text_mt: down to half a yojana; smaller than these there is none. / Above them are three planets that travel far.

sanskrit_iast:
sauro 'ṅgirāś ca vakraś ca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ
pūrvameva samākhyātā gatisteṣāṃ yathākramam //
meaning:
सौरो ऽङ्गिराश् च वक्रश् च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिणः
पूर्वमेव समाख्याता गतिस्तेषां यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Śauri, Āṅgirasa, and Vakra are to be known as slow-moving; / the movement of these in proper order has already been declared before.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣveva grahāḥ sarve nakṣatreṣu samutthitāḥ
vivasvānaditeḥ putraḥ sūryo vai munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
एतेष्वेव ग्रहाः सर्वे नक्षत्रेषु समुत्थिताः
विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सूर्यो वै मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: All the planets arose in these very nakṣatras: / the sun, Vivasvat, son of Aditi, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhāsu samutpanno grahāṇāṃ prathamo grahaḥ
tviṣimān dharmaputrastu somo devo vasustu saḥ //
meaning:
विशाखासु समुत्पन्नो ग्रहाणां प्रथमो ग्रहः
त्विषिमान् धर्मपुत्रस्तु सोमो देवो वसुस्तु सः //
text_mt: the first planet among the planets, was born in Viśākhā; / the luminous god Soma, the Vasu, son of Dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
śītaraśmiḥ samutpannaḥ kṛttikāsu niśākaraḥ
ṣoḍaśārcirbhṛgoḥ putraḥ śukraḥ sūryādanantaram //
meaning:
शीतरश्मिः समुत्पन्नः कृत्तिकासु निशाकरः
षोडशार्चिर्भृगोः पुत्रः शुक्रः सूर्यादनन्तरम् //
text_mt: the cool-rayed night-maker, was born in Kṛttikā; / Śukra, the sixteen-rayed son of Bhṛgu, [born] right after the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
tārāgrahāṇāṃ pravaras tiṣye kṣetre samutthitaḥ
grahaścāṅgirasaḥ putro dvādaśārcirbṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
ताराग्रहाणां प्रवरस् तिष्ये क्षेत्रे समुत्थितः
ग्रहश्चाङ्गिरसः पुत्रो द्वादशार्चिर्बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: foremost among the planet-stars, arose in the asterism Tiṣya; / the planet Bṛhaspati, the twelve-rayed son of Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunīṣu samutpannaḥ pūrvākhyāsu jagadguruḥ
navārcirlohitāṅgaś ca prajāpatisuto grahaḥ //
meaning:
फाल्गुनीषु समुत्पन्नः पूर्वाख्यासु जगद्गुरुः
नवार्चिर्लोहिताङ्गश् च प्रजापतिसुतो ग्रहः //
text_mt: the teacher of the universe, was born in the constellation called Pūrvaphālgunī; / the red-bodied planet of nine rays, son of Prajāpati,

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhāsviha pūrvāsu samutpanna iti smṛtaḥ
revatīṣveva saptārciḥsthāne sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ //
meaning:
आषाढास्विह पूर्वासु समुत्पन्न इति स्मृतः
रेवतीष्वेव सप्तार्चिःस्थाने सौरिः शनैश्चरः //
text_mt: is remembered as born here in Pūrvāṣāḍhā; / Śanaiścara, the son of the sun, seven-rayed, [arose] in the place of Revatī;

sanskrit_iast:
saumyo budho dhaniṣṭhāsu pañcārcir udito grahaḥ
tamomayo mṛtyusutaḥ prajākṣayakaraḥ śikhī //
meaning:
सौम्यो बुधो धनिष्ठासु पञ्चार्चिर् उदितो ग्रहः
तमोमयो मृत्युसुतः प्रजाक्षयकरः शिखी //
text_mt: Budha, the son of Soma, the five-rayed planet, arose in Dhaniṣṭhā; / Śikhin, full of darkness, son of Mṛtyu, causing the destruction of creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣāsu samutpannaḥ sarvahārī mahāgrahaḥ
tathā svanāmadheyeṣu dākṣāyaṇyaḥ samutthitāḥ //
meaning:
आश्लेषासु समुत्पन्नः सर्वहारी महाग्रहः
तथा स्वनामधेयेषु दाक्षायण्यः समुत्थिताः //
text_mt: the great planet that snatches away all, was born in Āśleṣā; / likewise the daughters of Dakṣa arose in the asterisms named after themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
tamovīryamayo rāhuḥ prakṛtyā kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaḥ
bharaṇīṣu samutpanno grahaścandrārkamardanaḥ //
meaning:
तमोवीर्यमयो राहुः प्रकृत्या कृष्णमण्डलः
भरणीषु समुत्पन्नो ग्रहश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः //
text_mt: Rāhu, full of darkness and power, possessing a black disc by nature, / the planet that crushes the moon and the sun, was born in Bharaṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
ete tārā grahāścāpi boddhavyā bhārgavādayaḥ
janmanakṣatrapīḍāsu yānti vaiguṇyatāṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
एते तारा ग्रहाश्चापि बोद्धव्या भार्गवादयः
जन्मनक्षत्रपीडासु यान्ति वैगुण्यतां यतः //
text_mt: These stars and planets beginning with Śukra should also be understood: / since they become adverse during afflictions to one's birth star,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate tena doṣeṇa tatastadgrahabhaktitaḥ
sarvagrahāṇāmeteṣām ādirāditya ucyate //
meaning:
मुच्यते तेन दोषेण ततस्तद्ग्रहभक्तितः
सर्वग्रहाणामेतेषाम् आदिरादित्य उच्यते //
text_mt: one is freed from that affliction through devotion to that planet. / The sun is declared to be the foremost among all these planets,

sanskrit_iast:
tārāgrahāṇāṃ śukrastu ketūnāṃ cāpi dhūmavān
dhruvaḥ kila grahāṇāṃ tu vibhaktānāṃ caturdiśam //
meaning:
ताराग्रहाणां शुक्रस्तु केतूनां चापि धूमवान्
ध्रुवः किल ग्रहाणां तु विभक्तानां चतुर्दिशम् //
text_mt: Śukra among the planet-stars, and Dhūmavān among the comets; / Dhruva is indeed [the foremost] among the planets distributed in the four quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ śraviṣṭhā syād ayanānāṃ tathottaram
varṣāṇāṃ caiva pañcānām ādyaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्राणां श्रविष्ठा स्याद् अयनानां तथोत्तरम्
वर्षाणां चैव पञ्चानाम् आद्यः संवत्सरः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Śraviṣṭhā is the first of the nakṣatras, and the northern is the first of the solstices; / of the five-year cycle, Saṃvatsara is remembered as the first;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtūnāṃ śiśiraścāpi māsānāṃ māgha ucyate
pakṣāṇāṃ śuklapakṣastu tithīnāṃ pratipattathā //
meaning:
ऋतूनां शिशिरश्चापि मासानां माघ उच्यते
पक्षाणां शुक्लपक्षस्तु तिथीनां प्रतिपत्तथा //
text_mt: of the seasons, Śiśira; of the months, Māgha is declared [first]; / of the fortnights, the bright fortnight; and likewise Pratipad of the lunar days;

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātravibhāgānām ahaścādiḥ prakīrtitaḥ
muhūrtānāṃ tathaivādir muhūrto rudradaivataḥ //
meaning:
अहोरात्रविभागानाम् अहश्चादिः प्रकीर्तितः
मुहूर्तानां तथैवादिर् मुहूर्तो रुद्रदैवतः //
text_mt: of the divisions of day and night, the day is proclaimed as the first; / and likewise the first of the muhūrtas is the muhūrta that has Rudra as its deity;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaścāpi nimeṣādiḥ kālaḥ kālavidāṃ varāḥ
śravaṇāntaṃ dhaniṣṭhādi yugaṃ syātpañcavārṣikam //
meaning:
क्षणश्चापि निमेषादिः कालः कालविदां वराः
श्रवणान्तं धनिष्ठादि युगं स्यात्पञ्चवार्षिकम् //
text_mt: and the kṣaṇa is the beginning of the nimeṣa and others, O best of the knowers of time. / The five-year yuga begins with Dhaniṣṭhā and ends with Śravaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānorgativiśeṣeṇa cakravatparivartate
divākaraḥ smṛtastasmāt kālakṛdvibhurīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
भानोर्गतिविशेषेण चक्रवत्परिवर्तते
दिवाकरः स्मृतस्तस्मात् कालकृद्विभुरीश्वरः //
text_mt: Through the distinct motion of the sun, it turns like a wheel; / therefore the sun is remembered as the maker of time, the all-pervading lord,

sanskrit_iast:
caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ
tasyāpi bhagavān rudraḥ sākṣāddevaḥ pravartakaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्विधानां भूतानां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः
तस्यापि भगवान् रुद्रः साक्षाद्देवः प्रवर्तकः //
text_mt: the instigator and withdrawer of the four kinds of living beings; / and of him too, the lord Rudra himself, the visible god, is the instigator.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa jyotiṣāmevaṃ saṃniveśo 'rthaniścayaḥ
lokasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ mahādevena nirmitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येष ज्योतिषामेवं संनिवेशो ऽर्थनिश्चयः
लोकसंव्यवहारार्थं महादेवेन निर्मितः //
text_mt: Thus this arrangement of the heavenly bodies and determination of their meaning / was created by Mahādeva for the sake of worldly transactions.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhipūrvaṃ bhagavatā kalpādau sampravartitaḥ
sa āśrayo 'bhimānī ca sarvasya jyotirātmakaḥ //
meaning:
बुद्धिपूर्वं भगवता कल्पादौ सम्प्रवर्तितः
स आश्रयो ऽभिमानी च सर्वस्य ज्योतिरात्मकः //
text_mt: Deliberately set into motion by the Lord at the beginning of the kalpa, / he is the support and presiding deity of everything, consisting of light.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarūpapradhānasya pariṇāmo 'yamadbhutaḥ
naiṣa śakyaḥ prasaṃkhyātuṃ yāthātathyena kenacit //
meaning:
एकरूपप्रधानस्य परिणामो ऽयमद्भुतः
नैष शक्यः प्रसंख्यातुं याथातथ्येन केनचित् //
text_mt: This is a wonderful transformation of Pradhāna, which has a single nature; / it is not possible for anyone to calculate it in its true reality.

sanskrit_iast:
gatāgataṃ manuṣyeṇa jyotiṣāṃ māṃsacakṣuṣā
āgamādanumānācca pratyakṣādupapattitaḥ //
meaning:
गतागतं मनुष्येण ज्योतिषां मांसचक्षुषा
आगमादनुमानाच्च प्रत्यक्षादुपपत्तितः //
text_mt: The coming and going of the heavenly bodies [cannot be fully known] by a human being with the physical eye; / through tradition, inference, perception, and logical reason,

sanskrit_iast:
parīkṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā śraddhātavyaṃ vipaścitā
cakṣuḥ śāstraṃ jalaṃ lekhyaṃ gaṇitaṃ munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
परीक्ष्य निपुणं बुद्ध्या श्रद्धातव्यं विपश्चिता
चक्षुः शास्त्रं जलं लेख्यं गणितं मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: having examined it thoroughly with intellect, the wise person should place faith in it. / The eye, sacred scripture, water, writing, and calculation, O best of sages—

sanskrit_iast: pañcaite hetavo jñeyā jyotirmānavinirṇaye //
meaning: पञ्चैते हेतवो ज्ञेया ज्योतिर्मानविनिर्णये //
text_mt: these five are to be known as the means for determining the measure of the luminaries.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ viṣṇoḥ prasādādvai dhruvo buddhimatāṃ varaḥ
meḍhībhūto grāhāṇāṃ vai vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं विष्णोः प्रसादाद्वै ध्रुवो बुद्धिमतां वरः
मेढीभूतो ग्राहाणां वै वक्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / How, by the grace of Viṣṇu, did Dhruva, the best of the wise, / become the pivot of the planets? You should tell us now.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etamarthaṃ mayā pṛṣṭo nānāśāstraviśāradaḥ
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā prāha mahyaṃ śuśrūṣave dvijāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतमर्थं मया पृष्टो नानाशास्त्रविशारदः
मार्कण्डेयः पुरा प्राह मह्यं शुश्रूषवे द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
When questioned by me on this matter in the past, Mārkaṇḍeya, versed in various treatises, / spoke [thus] to me as I wished to hear, O twice-born.

Mārkaṇḍeya said:
King Uttānapāda, indeed an emperor of great majesty, / the best among all wielders of weapons, protected the earth.

He had two wives: Sunīti and Suruci. / A son of great fame was born to the elder wife, Sunīti:

named Dhruva, highly wise, the lamp of his lineage, of great intellect. / Once, although only seven years old, he climbed onto his father's lap.

Repulsing him, Suruci, with delight in her heart / and proud of her beauty, O best of sages, placed her own son on his lap.

Not gaining his father's lap, the wise [boy], his mind aggrieved, / approached his mother and wept again and again.

His mother, overcome with grief, said this to her weeping son: / 'Suruci is the beloved of her husband, and her son is like her.

You are born to me, an unfortunate woman, and so you too are unfortunate. / Why do you lament? For what purpose do you weep again and again?

Becoming afflicted at heart, you will cause me grief. / By your own power, O son, you should attain a firm, secure place.'

Having been spoken to thus by his mother, he went forth to the forest at that time. / Seeing Viśvāmitra there, he bowed down according to the rules,

and with folded hands said: 'O venerable one, you should speak; / by what means shall I attain a place above all others, O best of the virtuous?

O sage, as I was sitting on my father's lap, my mother Suruci / brushed me away; the king, my father, said nothing at all to him.

For that reason, O Brahman, terrified I went to my mother. / My mother Sunīti said to me: "Do not grieve so exceedingly;

by your own deeds you ought to attain the highest place, my dear son." / Hearing her words, O great sage, I sought your abode,

and have reached this forest, O Brahman; today I have seen you, O lord. / By your grace I shall attain a wondrous, highest place.'

Addressed thus, that glorious sage laughed and said this: / 'O prince, listen to this; you will attain the highest place

by worshipping the lord of the worlds, Keśava, the destroyer of affliction, / who sprang from the right side of Śambhu, the wise Mahādeva.

Constantly chant, O greatly wise one, that which destroys all sins, / grants desires, is supreme, pure, holy, spotless, and transcendent.

Utter this divine mantra endowed with the Praṇava: / "Salutation be to Vāsudeva!" With restrained senses,

meditating on the eternal Viṣṇu, devoted to chanting and oblations.' / Spoken to thus, the highly renowned [prince] bowed to Viśvāmitra,

and facing east, self-restrained, chanted with a joyful heart, / subsisting on greens, roots, and fruits, unwearied for a year.

Ceaselessly and perpetually he chanted the mantra again and again. / Dreadful vetālas, rākṣasas, lions, and other great wild beasts,

terrific ones, approached that great-souled one to bewilder his mind; / chanting 'Vāsudeva', he did not notice anything at all.

Assuming the form of Sunīti, his mother, / a piśācī arrived and wept, exceedingly sorrowful:

'You are my only son; why do you torment yourself? / Abandoning me who am helpless, you have undertaken austerity!'

While she was uttering these and other words, the great ascetic, / joyful in heart, chanted the name of Hari without even looking at her.

Then all forms of obstacles subsided everywhere there. / Thereupon, mounting Garuḍa, radiant like a dark raincloud,

surrounded by all the gods and praised by great sages, / the Lord Viṣṇu, the slayer of foes, arrived near Dhruva.

Seeing that he had arrived, Dhruva wondered, 'Who is he?' / and as though drinking in Hṛṣīkeśa, the lord of the world, with his eyes,

stood chanting 'Vāsudeva', endowed with great radiance. / Then Govinda touched his mouth with the edge of his conch.

Thereupon, having obtained supreme knowledge, / with folded hands he praised Hari, the Supreme Puruṣa, the lord of all worlds:

'Be gracious, O Lord of the gods of gods, bearer of the conch, discus, and mace! / O Self of the worlds, whose essence is the secret of the Vedas, I have taken refuge in you, O Keśava!

The great sages beginning with Sanaka do not know you, the Great-souled one; / so how could I know you? Salutations to you, O Lord of the universe!'

Smiling, Viṣṇu said to him: 'Come, my child, you shall be Dhruva (firm); / having attained a fixed abode, become the first consumer [of oblations] among the celestial luminaries.

Together with your mother, attain there the abode of the celestial luminaries. / This supreme abode of mine is Dhruva (fixed), eternal, and very auspicious.

It was obtained in the past from Śaṅkara by worshipping the Lord of gods through austerity. / The wise man who constantly chants "to Vāsudeva", / accompanied by the Praṇava, united with salutation, and joined with the word "Bhagavat" (i.e. "Oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya"), / indeed attains the fixed (dhruva) abode.'

Then the gods along with the gandharvas, the siddhas, and the supreme sages, / established Dhruva together with his mother in that abode.

Honouring the command of Viṣṇu, he attained the abode of the celestial luminaries. / Thus Dhruva, of great majesty, by means of the twelve-syllable mantra,

attained great perfection. This has been related to you by me.

Sūta said:
Therefore, the man who offers salutation to Vāsudeva / goes to the same realm as Dhruva, and likewise his firm stability [is assured].

Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Abode of Dhruva', in the Bhuvana-kośa section of the first part of the venerable Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

The sages said:
O Sūta, speak today in proper and unsurpassed order / of the origin of the gods, dānavas, gandharvas, serpents, and rakṣasas.

Sūta said:
The creation of the ancients is said to have occurred through intention, sight, and touch; / after Dakṣa, son of Pracetas, creation arose from sexual union.

When, as he was creating, the hosts of gods, sages, and serpents / did not increase the world, then through the practice of sexual union,

Dakṣa begat five thousand sons upon the mother (his wife Asiknī). / Seeing those fortunate ones, Nārada, wishing to have diverse creatures created,

said to the Haryaśvas, the sons of Dakṣa who had gathered: / 'Having known the entire extent of the earth, above as well as below,

then, O best of sages, carry out creation especially!' / Hearing his words, they departed in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
sārvabhaumo mahātejāḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
uttānapādo rājā vai pālayāmāsa medinīm //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
सार्वभौमो महातेजाः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः
उत्तानपादो राजा वै पालयामास मेदिनीम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / King Uttānapāda, indeed a universal monarch of great splendor / and the best of all wielders of weapons, protected the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāryādvayam abhūt sunītiḥ surucis tathā
agrajāyāmabhūtputraḥ sunītyāṃ tu mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य भार्याद्वयम् अभूत् सुनीतिः सुरुचिस् तथा
अग्रजायामभूत्पुत्रः सुनीत्यां तु महायशाः //
text_mt: He had two wives: Sunīti and Suruci. / To his elder wife, Sunīti, was born a highly renowned son,

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvo nāma mahāprājñaḥ kuladīpo mahāmatiḥ
kadācit saptavarṣe 'pi pituraṅkam upāviśat //
meaning:
ध्रुवो नाम महाप्राज्ञः कुलदीपो महामतिः
कदाचित् सप्तवर्षे ऽपि पितुरङ्कम् उपाविशत् //
text_mt: named Dhruva, of great wisdom, the lamp of his lineage, of noble intellect. / Once, although only seven years of age, he climbed into his father’s lap.

sanskrit_iast:
surucistaṃ vinirdhūya svaputraṃ prītimānasā
nyaveśayattaṃ viprendrā hy aṅkaṃ rūpeṇa mānitā //
meaning:
सुरुचिस्तं विनिर्धूय स्वपुत्रं प्रीतिमानसा
न्यवेशयत्तं विप्रेन्द्रा ह्य् अङ्कं रूपेण मानिता //
text_mt:
Suruci pushed him away, O foremost of Brahmins; having a delighted mind,
puffed up with pride in her beauty, she placed her own son upon the lap.

sanskrit_iast:
alabdhvā sa piturdhīmān aṅkaṃ duḥkhitamānasaḥ
mātuḥ samīpamāgamya ruroda sa punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अलब्ध्वा स पितुर्धीमान् अङ्कं दुःखितमानसः
मातुः समीपमागम्य रुरोद स पुनः पुनः //
text_mt:
Not receiving his father's lap, the wise boy, distressed in mind,
came to his mother and wept again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
rudantaṃ putramāhedaṃ mātā śokapariplutā
surucirdayitā bhartus tasyāḥ putro 'pi tādṛśaḥ //
meaning:
रुदन्तं पुत्रमाहेदं माता शोकपरिप्लुता
सुरुचिर्दयिता भर्तुस् तस्याः पुत्रो ऽपि तादृशः //
text_mt:
To her weeping son, the mother, overwhelmed with grief, said this:
“Suruci is the beloved of her husband, and her son is like her.

sanskrit_iast:
mama tvaṃ mandabhāgyāyā jātaḥ putro 'pyabhāgyavān
kiṃ śocasi kimarthaṃ tvaṃ rodamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
मम त्वं मन्दभाग्याया जातः पुत्रो ऽप्यभाग्यवान्
किं शोचसि किमर्थं त्वं रोदमानः पुनः पुनः //
text_mt:
You were born of me, an unfortunate woman, as a son who is also unfortunate.
Why do you grieve? Why are you weeping again and again?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtaptahṛdayo bhūtvā mama śokaṃ kariṣyasi
svasthasthānaṃ dhruvaṃ putra svaśaktyā tvaṃ samāpnuyāḥ //
meaning:
संतप्तहृदयो भूत्वा मम शोकं करिष्यसि
स्वस्थस्थानं ध्रुवं पुत्र स्वशक्त्या त्वं समाप्नुयाः //
text_mt:
Becoming heart-stricken, you will cause me grief.
By your own power, O son, you should attain a firm, secure place.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa tu mātrā vai nirjagāma tadā vanam
viśvāmitraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā praṇipatya yathāvidhi //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स तु मात्रा वै निर्जगाम तदा वनम्
विश्वामित्रं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रणिपत्य यथाविधि //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by his mother, he then went out to the forest.
Thereupon, having seen Viśvāmitra and bowed down to him in accordance with rule,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā bhagavan vaktumarhasi
sarveṣāmuparisthānaṃ kena prāpsyāmi sattama //
meaning:
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा भगवन् वक्तुमर्हसि
सर्वेषामुपरिस्थानं केन प्राप्स्यामि सत्तम //
text_mt:
with folded hands, he said: “O Lord, you ought to tell [me]:
by what means shall I attain a place above all [others], O best of beings?

sanskrit_iast:
pituraṅke samāsīnaṃ mātā māṃ surucirmune
vyadhūnayatsa taṃ rājā pitā novāca kiṃcana //
meaning:
पितुरङ्के समासीनं माता मां सुरुचिर्मुने
व्यधूनयत्स तं राजा पिता नोवाच किंचन //
text_mt:
As I was seated on my father's lap, O sage, my [step]mother Suruci
thrust me aside, and the king, my father, said nothing at all to her.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmāt kāraṇād brahmaṃs trasto 'haṃ mātaraṃ gataḥ
sunītirāha me mātā mā kṛthāḥ śokamuttamam //
meaning:
एतस्मात् कारणाद् ब्रह्मंस् त्रस्तो ऽहं मातरं गतः
सुनीतिराह मे माता मा कृथाः शोकमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
For this reason, O Brahmin, I went frightened to my mother.
My mother Sunīti said to me: ‘Do not give way to great grief.

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmaṇā paraṃ sthānaṃ prāptumarhasi putraka
tasyā hi vacanaṃ śrutvā sthānaṃ tava mahāmune //
meaning:
स्वकर्मणा परं स्थानं प्राप्तुमर्हसि पुत्रक
तस्या हि वचनं श्रुत्वा स्थानं तव महामुने //
text_mt:
You ought to attain the highest place by your own deed, my child.’
Having heard her words, indeed, [seeking] your abode, O great sage,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpto vanamidaṃ brahmann adya tvāṃ dṛṣṭavānprabho
tava prasādāt prāpsye 'haṃ sthānamadbhutamuttamam //
meaning:
प्राप्तो वनमिदं ब्रह्मन्न् अद्य त्वां दृष्टवान्प्रभो
तव प्रसादात् प्राप्स्ये ऽहं स्थानमद्भुतमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
I have reached this forest, O Brahmin. Today I have seen you, O lord.
By your grace I shall attain a wondrous, highest place.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ śrīmān prahasann idam abravīt
rājaputra śṛṇuṣvedaṃ sthānamuttamamāpsyasi //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स मुनिः श्रीमान् प्रहसन्न् इदम् अब्रवीत्
राजपुत्र शृणुष्वेदं स्थानमुत्तममाप्स्यसि //
text_mt:
Thus addressed, the illustrious sage smiled and said this:
“O prince, listen to this: you shall attain the highest place.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya jagatāmīśaṃ keśavaṃ kleśanāśanam
dakṣiṇāṅgabhavaṃ śaṃbhor mahādevasya dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
आराध्य जगतामीशं केशवं क्लेशनाशनम्
दक्षिणाङ्गभवं शंभोर् महादेवस्य धीमतः //
text_mt:
By worshipping Keśava, the lord of the worlds, the destroyer of affliction,
born from the right side of Śambhu, wise Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
japa nityaṃ mahāprājña sarvapāpavināśanam
iṣṭadaṃ paramaṃ śuddhaṃ pavitramamalaṃ param //
meaning:
जप नित्यं महाप्राज्ञ सर्वपापविनाशनम्
इष्टदं परमं शुद्धं पवित्रममलं परम् //
text_mt:
constantly chant, O greatly wise one, the destroyer of all sins,
the granter of desires, the supreme, pure, sacred, immaculate, highest [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
brūhi mantramimaṃ divyaṃ praṇavena samanvitam
namo 'stu vāsudevāya ityevaṃ niyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रूहि मन्त्रमिमं दिव्यं प्रणवेन समन्वितम्
नमो ऽस्तु वासुदेवाय इत्येवं नियतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt:
Utter this divine mantra equipped with the praṇava:
‘Reverence be to Vāsudeva,’ with senses restrained in this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyansanātanaṃ viṣṇuṃ japahomaparāyaṇaḥ
ityuktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ viśvāmitraṃ mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायन्सनातनं विष्णुं जपहोमपरायणः
इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्यैनं विश्वामित्रं महायशाः //
text_mt:
meditating upon the eternal Viṣṇu, devoted to chanting and oblations.”
Thus addressed, having bowed down to Viśvāmitra, the highly renowned [boy],

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukho niyato bhūtvā jajāpa prītamānasaḥ
śākamūlaphalāhāraḥ saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ //
meaning:
प्राङ्मुखो नियतो भूत्वा जजाप प्रीतमानसः
शाकमूलफलाहारः संवत्सरमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt:
facing east and self-restrained, chanted with a delighted mind,
subsisting on vegetables, roots, and fruits, unwearied for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
jajāpa mantramaniśam ajasraṃ sa punaḥ punaḥ
vetālā rākṣasā ghorāḥ siṃhādyāś ca mahāmṛgāḥ //
meaning:
जजाप मन्त्रमनिशम् अजस्रं स पुनः पुनः
वेताला राक्षसा घोराः सिंहाद्याश् च महामृगाः //
text_mt:
Day and night he chanted the mantra uninterruptedly, again and again.
Formidable vetālas, rākṣasas, lions, and other great wild beasts

sanskrit_iast:
tamabhyayurmahātmānaṃ buddhimohāya bhīṣaṇāḥ
japan sa vāsudeveti na kiṃcit pratyapadyata //
meaning:
तमभ्ययुर्महात्मानं बुद्धिमोहाय भीषणाः
जपन् स वासुदेवेति न किंचित् प्रत्यपद्यत //
text_mt:
approached that great-souled one, terrifying, in order to confuse his mind.
Chanting “Vāsudeva”, he noticed nothing [of them].

sanskrit_iast:
sunītir asya yā mātā tasyā rūpeṇa saṃvṛtā
piśāci samanuprāptā ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitā //
meaning:
सुनीतिर् अस्य या माता तस्या रूपेण संवृता
पिशाचि समनुप्राप्ता रुरोद भृशदुःखिता //
text_mt:
Veiled in the form of Sunīti, who was his mother,
a piśācī arrived and wept, exceedingly distressed:

sanskrit_iast:
mama tvamekaḥ putro 'si kimarthaṃ kliśyate bhavān
māmanāthāmapahāya tapa āsthitavānasi //
meaning:
मम त्वमेकः पुत्रो ऽसि किमर्थं क्लिश्यते भवान्
मामनाथामपहाय तप आस्थितवानसि //
text_mt:
“You are my only son; why are you tormenting yourself?
Having abandoned me, a helpless woman, you have undertaken asceticism!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamādīni vākyāni bhāṣamāṇāṃ mahātapāḥ
anirīkṣyaiva hṛṣṭātmā harernāma jajāpa saḥ //
meaning:
एवमादीनि वाक्यानि भाषमाणां महातपाः
अनिरीक्ष्यैव हृष्टात्मा हरेर्नाम जजाप सः //
text_mt:
To her speaking words such as these, the one of great austerities,
without even looking at her, with gladdened soul, chanted the name of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praśemuḥ sarvatra vighnarūpāṇi tatra vai
tato garuḍamāruhya kālameghasamadyutiḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रशेमुः सर्वत्र विघ्नरूपाणि तत्र वै
ततो गरुडमारुह्य कालमेघसमद्युतिः //
text_mt:
Then, all around, the forms of obstacles were entirely pacified.
Thereupon, having mounted Garuḍa, with the brilliance of a dark cloud,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevaiḥ parivṛtaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
āyayau bhagavānviṣṇuḥ dhruvāntikam arātihā //
meaning:
सर्वदेवैः परिवृतः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः
आययौ भगवान्विष्णुः ध्रुवान्तिकम् अरातिहा //
text_mt:
surrounded by all the gods, praised by the great sages,
Lord Viṣṇu, the slayer of foes, came near to Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgataṃ vilokyātha ko 'sāvityeva cintayan
pibanniva hṛṣīkeśaṃ nayanābhyāṃ jagatpatim //
meaning:
समागतं विलोक्याथ को ऽसावित्येव चिन्तयन्
पिबन्निव हृषीकेशं नयनाभ्यां जगत्पतिम् //
