पाषण्डिन इति ख्याता न संभाष्या द्विजातिभिः //
text_mt: Those whose observances and conduct are outside the Veda, expelled from Vedic and traditional rites, / known as heretics, are not to be spoken to by twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
na spṛṣṭavyā na draṣṭavyā dṛṣṭvā bhānuṃ samīkṣate
tathāpi tena vadhyāś ca nṛpairanyaiś ca jantubhiḥ //
meaning:
न स्पृष्टव्या न द्रष्टव्या दृष्ट्वा भानुं समीक्षते
तथापि तेन वध्याश् च नृपैरन्यैश् च जन्तुभिः //
text_mt: They are not to be touched nor looked upon; having looked [at them], one should gaze at the sun. / Even so, they may be slain by kings and other beings.

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṃgādvāpi yo martyaḥ satāṃ sakṛdaho dvijāḥ
rudralokamavāpnoti samabhyarcya maheśvaram //
meaning:
प्रसंगाद्वापि यो मर्त्यः सतां सकृदहो द्विजाः
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Whatever mortal, even by association with the virtuous, once, O twice-born, / having thoroughly worshipped Maheśvara, attains the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti duḥkhitāḥ sarve nirdayā munisattamāḥ
bhaktihīnā narāḥ sarve bhave paramakāraṇe //
meaning:
भवन्ति दुःखिताः सर्वे निर्दया मुनिसत्तमाः
भक्तिहीना नराः सर्वे भवे परमकारणे //
text_mt: All become sorrowful who are merciless, O best of sages; / all men are devoid of devotion towards Bhava, the ultimate cause.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhaktā devadevasya śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
bhāgyavanto vimucyante bhuktvā bhogānihaiva te //
meaning:
ये भक्ता देवदेवस्य शिवस्य परमेष्ठिनः
भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भुक्त्वा भोगानिहैव ते //
text_mt: Those who are devoted to the god of gods, Śiva the supreme lord, / are fortunate; having enjoyed pleasures here, they are liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
putreṣu dāreṣu gṛheṣu nṝṇāṃ bhaktaṃ yathā cittamathādideve
sakṛtprasaṃgādyatitāpasānāṃ teṣāṃ na dūraḥ parameśalokaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रेषु दारेषु गृहेषु नॄणां भक्तं यथा चित्तमथादिदेवे
सकृत्प्रसंगाद्यतितापसानां तेषां न दूरः परमेशलोकः //
text_mt: Just as men's minds are devoted to sons, wives, and homes, if it is thus towards the primal God / even once through the company of ascetics and mendicants, the realm of the Supreme Lord is not far for them.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ pūjyo mahādevo martyairmandairmahāmate
kalpāyuṣair alpavīryair alpasattvaiḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं पूज्यो महादेवो मर्त्यैर्मन्दैर्महामते
कल्पायुषैर् अल्पवीर्यैर् अल्पसत्त्वैः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: The sages said: / How is Mahādeva to be worshipped by foolish mortals, O wise one— / the Lord of Creatures [worshipped] by those of limited lifespan, slight strength, and little vigor?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarasahasraiś ca tapasā pūjya śaṅkaram
na paśyanti surāścāpi kathaṃ devaṃ yajanti te //
meaning:
संवत्सरसहस्रैश् च तपसा पूज्य शङ्करम्
न पश्यन्ति सुराश्चापि कथं देवं यजन्ति ते //
text_mt: Even the gods, having worshipped Śaṅkara with austerities for thousands of years, / do not behold him; how then do these [mortals] worship the God?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
kathitaṃ tathyam evātra yuṣmābhir munipuṅgavāḥ
tathāpi śraddhayā dṛśyaḥ pūjyaḥ saṃbhāṣya eva ca //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
कथितं तथ्यम् एवात्र युष्माभिर् मुनिपुङ्गवाः
तथापि श्रद्धया दृश्यः पूज्यः संभाष्य एव च //
text_mt: Sūta said: / The truth indeed has been spoken here by you, O best of sages; / nevertheless, through faith he can be seen, worshipped, and even spoken to.

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṃgāccaiva sampūjya bhaktihīnairapi dvijāḥ
bhāvānurūpaphalado bhagavāniti kīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसंगाच्चैव सम्पूज्य भक्तिहीनैरपि द्विजाः
भावानुरूपफलदो भगवानिति कीर्तितः //
text_mt: Even by worshipping casually, even by those devoid of devotion, O twice-born, / the Lord is proclaimed to grant fruits in accordance with one's disposition.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭaḥ pūjayanyāti paiśācaṃ tu dvijādhamaḥ
saṃkruddho rākṣasaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyān mūḍhadhīr dvijāḥ //
meaning:
उच्छिष्टः पूजयन्याति पैशाचं तु द्विजाधमः
संक्रुद्धो राक्षसं स्थानं प्राप्नुयान् मूढधीर् द्विजाः //
text_mt: Worshipping while impure from food, the vile twice-born goes to the realm of the piśācas; / angry, the dull-witted man would attain the rākṣasa state, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣyabhakṣī sampūjya yākṣaṃ prāpnoti durjanaḥ
gānaśīlaś ca gāndharvaṃ nṛtyaśīlastathaiva ca //
meaning:
अभक्ष्यभक्षी सम्पूज्य याक्षं प्राप्नोति दुर्जनः
गानशीलश् च गान्धर्वं नृत्यशीलस्तथैव च //
text_mt: A wicked man worshipping while eating forbidden food attains the yakṣa state; / one fond of singing, the gandharva state; and likewise one fond of dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
khyātiśīlas tathā cāndraṃ strīṣu sakto narādhamaḥ
madārtaḥ pūjayan rudraṃ somasthānamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ख्यातिशीलस् तथा चान्द्रं स्त्रीषु सक्तो नराधमः
मदार्तः पूजयन् रुद्रं सोमस्थानमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: One fond of fame attains the lunar realm; the vile man attached to women, / afflicted with lust while worshipping Rudra, would obtain the realm of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā devamabhyarcya prājāpatyamavāpnuyāt
brāhmaṃ hi praṇavenaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ cābhinandya ca //
meaning:
गायत्र्या देवमभ्यर्च्य प्राजापत्यमवाप्नुयात्
ब्राह्मं हि प्रणवेनैव वैष्णवं चाभिनन्द्य च //
text_mt: Worshipping the God with the Gāyatrī, he obtains the realm of Prajāpati; / with the syllable Oṃ, the realm of Brahman; and having praised him, the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhayā sakṛdevāpi samabhyarcya maheśvaram
rudralokamanuprāpya rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate //
meaning:
श्रद्धया सकृदेवापि समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्
रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य रुद्रैः सार्धं प्रमोदते //
text_mt: Having thoroughly worshipped Maheśvara with faith even once, / he reaches the realm of Rudra and rejoices together with the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśodhya ca śubhaṃ liṅgam amarāsurapūjitam
jalaiḥ pūtaistathā pīṭhe devamāvāhya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
संशोध्य च शुभं लिङ्गम् अमरासुरपूजितम्
जलैः पूतैस्तथा पीठे देवमावाह्य भक्तितः //
text_mt: Having purified the auspicious liṅga, worshipped by immortals and asuras, / with purified waters, and having invoked the God on the pedestal with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ yathānyāyaṃ praṇipatya ca śaṅkaram
kalpite cāsane sthāpya dharmajñānamaye śubhe //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा देवं यथान्यायं प्रणिपत्य च शङ्करम्
कल्पिते चासने स्थाप्य धर्मज्ञानमये शुभे //
text_mt: having beheld the God according to rule and bowed down to Śaṅkara, / placing him on a prepared, auspicious seat composed of dharma and knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
vairāgyaiśvaryasampanne sarvalokanamaskṛte
oṅkārapadmamadhye tu somasūryāgnisaṃbhave //
meaning:
वैराग्यैश्वर्यसम्पन्ने सर्वलोकनमस्कृते
ओङ्कारपद्ममध्ये तु सोमसूर्याग्निसंभवे //
text_mt: endowed with detachment and sovereignty, saluted by all worlds, / in the centre of the lotus of the syllable Oṃ, born of the moon, sun, and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ dattvā rudrāya śaṃbhave
snāpayeddivyatoyaiś ca ghṛtena payasā tathā //
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं दत्त्वा रुद्राय शंभवे
स्नापयेद्दिव्यतोयैश् च घृतेन पयसा तथा //
text_mt: having offered water for the feet, water for sipping, and arghya to Rudra, Śambhu, / one should bathe him with divine waters, and with ghee and milk.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhnā ca snāpayedrudraṃ śodhayecca yathāvidhi
tataḥ śuddhāṃbunā snāpya candanādyaiś ca pūjayet //
meaning:
दध्ना च स्नापयेद्रुद्रं शोधयेच्च यथाविधि
ततः शुद्धांबुना स्नाप्य चन्दनाद्यैश् च पूजयेत् //
text_mt: One should also bathe Rudra with curd and purify him according to rule; / then, having bathed him with pure water, one should worship him with sandalwood and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
rocanādyaiś ca sampūjya divyapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet
bilvapatrairakhaṇḍaiś ca padmairnānāvidhais tathā //
meaning:
रोचनाद्यैश् च सम्पूज्य दिव्यपुष्पैश् च पूजयेत्
बिल्वपत्रैरखण्डैश् च पद्मैर्नानाविधैस् तथा //
text_mt: Having worshipped him with yellow orpiment and the like, one should worship him with divine flowers, / with unbroken bilva leaves, and with various kinds of lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalaiś ca rājīvair nadyāvartaiś ca mallikaiḥ
campakair jātipuṣpaiśca bakulaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ //
meaning:
नीलोत्पलैश् च राजीवैर् नद्यावर्तैश् च मल्लिकैः
चम्पकैर् जातिपुष्पैश्च बकुलैः करवीरकैः //
text_mt: with blue lotuses, night-blooming lotuses, nadyāvarta flowers, jasmine, / campaka, royal jasmine, bakula, and oleander flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
śamīpuṣpair bṛhatpuṣpair unmattāgastyajairapi
apāmārgakadambaiś ca bhūṣaṇairapi śobhanaiḥ //
meaning:
शमीपुष्पैर् बृहत्पुष्पैर् उन्मत्तागस्त्यजैरपि
अपामार्गकदम्बैश् च भूषणैरपि शोभनैः //
text_mt: with flowers of śamī, large flowers, flowers of datura and agastya, / and with apāmārga and kadamba, and also with radiant ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā pañcavidhaṃ dhūpaṃ pāyasaṃ ca nivedayet
dadhibhaktaṃ ca madhvājyapariplutamataḥ param //
meaning:
दत्त्वा पञ्चविधं धूपं पायसं च निवेदयेत्
दधिभक्तं च मध्वाज्यपरिप्लुतमतः परम् //
text_mt: Having offered fivefold incense, one should present milk-rice, / and curd-rice overflowing with honey and clarified butter thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhānnaṃ caiva mudgānnaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ ca nivedayet
atha pañcavidhaṃ vāpi saghṛtaṃ vinivedayet //
meaning:
शुद्धान्नं चैव मुद्गान्नं षड्विधं च निवेदयेत्
अथ पञ्चविधं वापि सघृतं विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: One should offer pure boiled rice and mudga-bean rice of six kinds, / or else offer [rice] of five kinds accompanied by clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ cāpi śuddhānnam āḍhakaṃ taṇḍulaṃ pacet
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ cānte namaskṛtya muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
केवलं चापि शुद्धान्नम् आढकं तण्डुलं पचेत्
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं चान्ते नमस्कृत्य मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: Or one should cook an āḍhaka measure of grain as pure boiled rice alone; / having circumambulated at the end and bowed down repeatedly,

sanskrit_iast:
stutvā ca devamīśānaṃ punaḥ sampūjya śaṅkaram
īśānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva aghoraṃ vāmameva ca //
meaning:
स्तुत्वा च देवमीशानं पुनः सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
ईशानं पुरुषं चैव अघोरं वाममेव च //
text_mt: having praised God Īśāna and worshipped Śaṅkara again— / as Īśāna, Puruṣa, Aghora, and Vāmadeva—

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātaṃ japaṃścāpi pañcabhiḥ pūjayecchivam
anena vidhinā devaḥ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
सद्योजातं जपंश्चापि पञ्चभिः पूजयेच्छिवम्
अनेन विधिना देवः प्रसीदति महेश्वरः //
text_mt: And reciting the Sadyojāta [mantra], he should worship Śiva with the five [mantras]. / By this procedure, the god Maheśvara becomes pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāḥ puṣpādipatrādyair upayuktāḥ śivārcane
gāvaścaiva dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
वृक्षाः पुष्पादिपत्राद्यैर् उपयुक्ताः शिवार्चने
गावश्चैव द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रयान्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Trees whose flowers, leaves, and other parts are used in the worship of Śiva, / and cows as well, O best of the twice-born, attain the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedyaḥ śivaṃ rudraṃ śarvaṃ bhavamajaṃ sakṛt
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam //
meaning:
पूजयेद्यः शिवं रुद्रं शर्वं भवमजं सकृत्
स याति शिवसायुज्यं पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् //
text_mt: Whoever worships Śiva, Rudra, Śarva, Bhava, the unborn, even once, / attains union with Śiva, free from return [to rebirth].

sanskrit_iast:
arcitaṃ parameśānaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim
sakṛtprasaṃgādvā dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
अर्चितं परमेशानं भवं शर्वमुमापतिम्
सकृत्प्रसंगाद्वा दृष्ट्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having seen Parameśāna, Bhava, Śarva, the lord of Umā, who has been worshipped, / even once or by chance, one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitaṃ vā mahādevaṃ pūjyamānamathāpi vā
dṛṣṭvā prayāti vai martyo brahmalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पूजितं वा महादेवं पूज्यमानमथापि वा
दृष्ट्वा प्रयाति वै मर्त्यो ब्रह्मलोकं न संशयः //
text_mt: Having seen Mahādeva worshipped or even while being worshipped, / a mortal indeed goes to the world of Brahmā; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvānumodayeccāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
yo dadyād ghṛtadīpaṃ ca sakṛlliṅgasya cāgrataḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वानुमोदयेच्चापि स याति परमां गतिम्
यो दद्याद् घृतदीपं च सकृल्लिङ्गस्य चाग्रतः //
text_mt: Having heard and rejoiced in it, he also goes to the supreme state. / Whoever offers a ghee-lamp, even once, before a liṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāṃ gatim avāpnoti svāśramair durlabhāṃ sthirām
dīpavṛkṣaṃ pārthivaṃ vā dāravaṃ vā śivālaye //
meaning:
स तां गतिम् अवाप्नोति स्वाश्रमैर् दुर्लभां स्थिराम्
दीपवृक्षं पार्थिवं वा दारवं वा शिवालये //
text_mt: he attains that permanent state difficult to attain even through one's own āśramas. / Having given a lamp-stand made of clay or wood in an abode of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā kulaśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate
āyasaṃ tāmrajaṃ vāpi raupyaṃ sauvarṇikaṃ tathā //
meaning:
दत्त्वा कुलशतं साग्रं शिवलोके महीयते
आयसं ताम्रजं वापि रौप्यं सौवर्णिकं तथा //
text_mt: along with a full hundred [ancestors of his] lineage, he is honoured in the world of Śiva. / Made of iron, copper, silver, or gold,

sanskrit_iast:
śivāya dīpaṃ yo dadyād vidhinā vāpi bhaktitaḥ
sūryāyutasamaiḥ ślakṣṇair yānaiḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet //
meaning:
शिवाय दीपं यो दद्याद् विधिना वापि भक्तितः
सूर्यायुतसमैः श्लक्ष्णैर् यानैः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: whoever offers a lamp to Śiva according to the rules or with devotion, / travels to the city of Śiva in smooth chariots equal to ten thousand suns.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike māsi yo dadyād ghṛtadīpaṃ śivāgrataḥ
sampūjyamānaṃ vā paśyed vidhinā parameśvaram //
meaning:
कार्तिके मासि यो दद्याद् घृतदीपं शिवाग्रतः
सम्पूज्यमानं वा पश्येद् विधिना परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Whoever offers a ghee-lamp before Śiva in the month of Kārtika, / or beholds Parameśvara being worshipped according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti brahmaṇo lokaṃ śraddhayā munisattamāḥ
āvāhanaṃ susānnidhyaṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
स याति ब्रह्मणो लोकं श्रद्धया मुनिसत्तमाः
आवाहनं सुसान्निध्यं स्थापनं पूजनं तथा //
text_mt: he goes with faith to the world of Brahmā, O best of sages. / The invocation, bringing near, installation, and worship

sanskrit_iast:
samproktaṃ rudragāyatryā āsanaṃ praṇavena vai
pañcabhiḥ snapanaṃ proktaṃ rudrādyaiś ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सम्प्रोक्तं रुद्रगायत्र्या आसनं प्रणवेन वै
पञ्चभिः स्नपनं प्रोक्तं रुद्राद्यैश् च विशेषतः //
text_mt: are taught with the Rudragāyatrī, and the seat with the Praṇava; / bathing is taught with the five [mantras], especially beginning with Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sampūjayennityaṃ devadevamumāpatim
brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya praṇavena samarcayet //
meaning:
एवं सम्पूजयेन्नित्यं देवदेवमुमापतिम्
ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे तस्य प्रणवेन समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Thus one should daily worship the god of gods, the lord of Umā. / To his right one should worship Brahmā with the Praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ gāyatriyā yajet
vahnau hutvā yathānyāyaṃ pañcabhiḥ praṇavena ca //
meaning:
उत्तरे देवदेवेशं विष्णुं गायत्रिया यजेत्
वह्नौ हुत्वा यथान्यायं पञ्चभिः प्रणवेन च //
text_mt: To the north one should worship Viṣṇu, the lord of the gods of gods, with the Gāyatrī. / Having offered into the fire according to the proper manner with the five [mantras] and with the Praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti śivasāyujyam evaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaram
iti saṃkṣepataḥ prokto liṅgārcanavidhikramaḥ //
meaning:
स याति शिवसायुज्यम् एवं सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो लिङ्गार्चनविधिक्रमः //
text_mt: he goes to union with Śiva, having worshipped Śaṅkara in this way. / Thus in brief has been declared the order of the procedure for liṅga worship,

sanskrit_iast: vyāsena kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ śrutvā rudramukhātsvayam //
meaning: व्यासेन कथितः पूर्वं श्रुत्वा रुद्रमुखात्स्वयम् //
text_mt: spoken formerly by Vyāsa, having heard it directly from the mouth of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ paśupatiṃ dṛṣṭvā paśupāśavimokṣaṇam
paśutvaṃ tatyajurdevās tanno vaktumihārhasi //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं पशुपतिं दृष्ट्वा पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्
पशुत्वं तत्यजुर्देवास् तन्नो वक्तुमिहार्हसि //
text_mt: The sages said: / How, having seen Paśupati who liberates from the fetters of the beast, / did the gods abandon their beast-hood? You should tell that to us here.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
purā kailāsaśikhare bhogyākhye svapure sthitam
sametya devāḥ sarvajñam ājagmustatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
पुरा कैलासशिखरे भोग्याख्ये स्वपुरे स्थितम्
समेत्य देवाः सर्वज्ञम् आजग्मुस्तत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Formerly, having assembled together, the gods, by his grace, approached the omniscient one / residing on the peak of Kailāsa in his own city named Bhogyā.

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya sarvadevānāṃ brahmaṇā ca janārdanaḥ
garuḍasya tathā skandham āruhya puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
हिताय सर्वदेवानां ब्रह्मणा च जनार्दनः
गरुडस्य तथा स्कन्धम् आरुह्य पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: For the welfare of all the gods, Janārdana, with Brahmā, / having mounted upon the shoulders of Garuḍa, the Puruṣottama,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma devatābhir vai devadevāntikaṃ hariḥ
sarve samprāpya devasya sārdhaṃ girivaraṃ śubham //
meaning:
जगाम देवताभिर् वै देवदेवान्तिकं हरिः
सर्वे सम्प्राप्य देवस्य सार्धं गिरिवरं शुभम् //
text_mt: Hari indeed went with the deities into the presence of the god of gods. / All reaching the auspicious, excellent mountain together with that god,

sanskrit_iast:
sendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sayamāḥ praṇemur girimuttamam
bhagavān vāsudevo 'sau garuḍād garuḍadhvajaḥ
avatīrya giriṃ merum āruroha surottamaiḥ //
meaning:
सेन्द्राः ससाध्याः सयमाः प्रणेमुर् गिरिमुत्तमम्
भगवान् वासुदेवो ऽसौ गरुडाद् गरुडध्वजः
अवतीर्य गिरिं मेरुम् आरुरोह सुरोत्तमैः //
text_mt: accompanied by Indra, the Sādhyas, and Yama, they bowed to the supreme mountain. / That blessed Vāsudeva, who has Garuḍa on his banner, / having descended from Garuḍa, ascended Mount Meru with the best of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sakaladuritahīnaṃ sarvadaṃ bhogamukhyaṃ muditakuraravṛndaṃ nāditaṃ nāgavṛndaiḥ
madhuraraṇitagītaṃ sānukūlāndhakāraṃ padaracitavanāntaṃ kāntavātāntatoyam //
meaning:
सकलदुरितहीनं सर्वदं भोगमुख्यं मुदितकुररवृन्दं नादितं नागवृन्दैः
मधुररणितगीतं सानुकूलान्धकारं पदरचितवनान्तं कान्तवातान्ततोयम् //
text_mt: free from all sins, bestowing everything, chief in enjoyment, filled with joyful osprey flocks, resounded by herds of elephants, / with sweet resounding songs, possessing pleasant shade, with interior forests laid out with paths, and water cooled by delightful breezes,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanaśatasahasrair juṣṭam ādityakalpair lalitagatividagdhair haṃsavṛndaiś ca bhinnam
dhavakhadirapalāśaiś candanādyaiś ca vṛkṣair dvijavaragaṇavṛndaiḥ kokilādyairdvirephaiḥ //
meaning:
भवनशतसहस्रैर् जुष्टम् आदित्यकल्पैर् ललितगतिविदग्धैर् हंसवृन्दैश् च भिन्नम्
धवखदिरपलाशैश् चन्दनाद्यैश् च वृक्षैर् द्विजवरगणवृन्दैः कोकिलाद्यैर्द्विरेफैः //
text_mt: frequented by hundreds of thousands of mansions resembling the sun, and broken by flocks of swans skilled in graceful movements, / with dhava, khadira, palāśa, sandalwood, and other trees, with flocks of the best birds, cuckoos, and bees,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacidaśeṣasuradrumasaṃkulaṃ kurabakaiḥ priyakaistilakais tathā
bahukadambatamālalatāvṛtaṃ girivaraṃ śikharairvividhais tathā //
meaning:
क्वचिदशेषसुरद्रुमसंकुलं कुरबकैः प्रियकैस्तिलकैस् तथा
बहुकदम्बतमाललतावृतं गिरिवरं शिखरैर्विविधैस् तथा //
text_mt: crowded here and there with countless divine trees, with kurabakas, priyakas, and tilakas, / covered with many kadambas and tamāla creepers, the excellent mountain with its diverse peaks.

sanskrit_iast:
gireḥ pṛṣṭhe paraṃ śārvaṃ kalpitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā
krīḍārthaṃ devadevasya bhavasya parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
गिरेः पृष्ठे परं शार्वं कल्पितं विश्वकर्मणा
क्रीडार्थं देवदेवस्य भवस्य परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: On the back of the mountain, a supreme city of Śarva had been fashioned by Viśvakarman / for the play of the god of gods, Bhava, the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyaṃstatpuraṃ devāḥ sendropendrāḥ samāhitāḥ
praṇemurdūrataścaiva prabhāvādeva śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
अपश्यंस्तत्पुरं देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्राः समाहिताः
प्रणेमुर्दूरतश्चैव प्रभावादेव शूलिनः //
text_mt: The gods, with Indra and Upendra, composed in mind, saw that city, / and bowed from afar solely by the power of the trident-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrasūryapratimaṃ mahāntaṃ sahasraśaḥ sarvaguṇaiś ca bhinnam
jagāma kailāsagiriṃ mahātmā meruprabhāge puramādidevaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रसूर्यप्रतिमं महान्तं सहस्रशः सर्वगुणैश् च भिन्नम्
जगाम कैलासगिरिं महात्मा मेरुप्रभागे पुरमादिदेवः //
text_mt: Resembling a thousand suns, immense, manifold with all excellent qualities by the thousands, / the great-souled primordial god went to the city on Kailāsa mountain, on a section of Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'tha nārigajavājisaṃkulaṃ rathair anekair amarārisūdanaḥ
gaṇairgaṇeśaiś ca girīndrasaṃnibhaṃ mahāpuradvāramajo hariś ca //
meaning:
ततो ऽथ नारिगजवाजिसंकुलं रथैर् अनेकैर् अमरारिसूदनः
गणैर्गणेशैश् च गिरीन्द्रसंनिभं महापुरद्वारमजो हरिश् च //
text_mt: Then the unborn slayer of the enemies of the immortals, Hari, [approached] the gate of the great city, which resembled the lord of mountains, / crowded with women, elephants, and horses, with many chariots, and with the gaṇas and chiefs of the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
atha jāṃbūnadamayair bhavanairmaṇibhūṣitaiḥ
vimānairvividhākāraiḥ prākāraiś ca samāvṛtam //
meaning:
अथ जांबूनदमयैर् भवनैर्मणिभूषितैः
विमानैर्विविधाकारैः प्राकारैश् च समावृतम् //
text_mt: Then, surrounded by mansions made of Jāmbūnada gold adorned with jewels, / by aerial chariots of diverse forms, and by ramparts,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhoḥ puraṃ bāhyaṃ devaiḥ sabrahmakairhariḥ
prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā praviveśa tataḥ puram //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा शंभोः पुरं बाह्यं देवैः सब्रह्मकैर्हरिः
प्रहृष्टवदनो भूत्वा प्रविवेश ततः पुरम् //
text_mt: having seen the outer city of Śambhu, Hari along with the gods and Brahmā, / with a joyful face, thereupon entered the city.

sanskrit_iast:
harmyaprāsādasambādhaṃ mahāṭṭālasamanvitam
dvitīyaṃ devadevasya caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam //
meaning:
हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधं महाट्टालसमन्वितम्
द्वितीयं देवदेवस्य चतुर्द्वारं सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: Crowded with mansions and palaces, furnished with great watchtowers, / the very beautiful second [enclosure] of the god of gods has four gates,

sanskrit_iast:
vajravaiḍūryamāṇikyamaṇijālaiḥ samāvṛtam
dolāvikṣepasaṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam //
meaning:
वज्रवैडूर्यमाणिक्यमणिजालैः समावृतम्
दोलाविक्षेपसंयुक्तं घण्टाचामरभूषितम् //
text_mt: covered with lattices of diamonds, cat's-eye gems, and rubies, / fitted with swinging swings, adorned with bells and fly-whisks,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṅgamurajairjuṣṭaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam
nṛtyadbhir apsaraḥsaṃghair bhūtasaṃghaiś ca saṃvṛtam
devendrabhavanākārair bhavanair dṛṣṭimohanaiḥ //
meaning:
मृदङ्गमुरजैर्जुष्टं वीणावेणुनिनादितम्
नृत्यद्भिर् अप्सरःसंघैर् भूतसंघैश् च संवृतम्
देवेन्द्रभवनाकारैर् भवनैर् दृष्टिमोहनैः //
text_mt: frequented by mṛdaṅga and muraja drums, resounding with lutes and flutes, / filled with dancing hosts of apsarases and hosts of bhūtas, / with mansions captivating to the eye resembling the mansions of the lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādaśṛṅgeṣvatha pauranāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ puṣpaphalākṣatādyaiḥ
sthitāḥ karaistasya hareḥ samantāt pracikṣipurmūrdhni yathā bhavasya //
meaning:
प्रासादशृङ्गेष्वथ पौरनार्यः सहस्रशः पुष्पफलाक्षताद्यैः
स्थिताः करैस्तस्य हरेः समन्तात् प्रचिक्षिपुर्मूर्ध्नि यथा भवस्य //
text_mt: Then, standing on the pinnacles of the palaces, the women of the city in their thousands / cast from all sides with their hands flowers, fruits, unbroken grains, and the like upon the head of Hari, just as upon Bhava.

sanskrit_iast: dṛṣṭvā nāryastadā viṣṇuṃ madāghūrṇitalocanāḥ //
meaning: दृष्ट्वा नार्यस्तदा विष्णुं मदाघूर्णितलोचनाः //
text_mt: Beholding Viṣṇu then, the women with eyes rolling from intoxication,

sanskrit_iast:
viśālajaghanāḥ sadyo nanṛturmumudurjaguḥ
kāściddṛṣṭvā hariṃ nāryaḥ kiṃcit prahasitānanāḥ //
meaning:
विशालजघनाः सद्यो ननृतुर्मुमुदुर्जगुः
काश्चिद्दृष्ट्वा हरिं नार्यः किंचित् प्रहसिताननाः //
text_mt: with broad hips, immediately danced, rejoiced, and sang. / Seeing Hari, some women, their faces smiling slightly,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃcid visrastavastrāś ca srastakāñcīguṇā jaguḥ
caturthaṃ pañcamaṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca saptamaṃ tathā //
meaning:
किंचिद् विस्रस्तवस्त्राश् च स्रस्तकाञ्चीगुणा जगुः
चतुर्थं पञ्चमं चैव षष्ठं च सप्तमं तथा //
text_mt: their garments slightly slipping down and the cords of their girdles loosened, sang. / Passing beyond the fourth, the fifth, the sixth, the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ caiva daśamaṃ ca purottamam
atītyāsādya devasya puraṃ śaṃbhoḥ suśobhanam //
meaning:
अष्टमं नवमं चैव दशमं च पुरोत्तमम्
अतीत्यासाद्य देवस्य पुरं शंभोः सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: the eighth, the ninth, and the tenth excellent city, / and having reached the most splendid city of the god Śambhu,

sanskrit_iast:
suvṛttaṃ sutarāṃ śubhraṃ kailāsaśikhare śubhe
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃkāśair vimānaiś ca vibhūṣitam //
meaning:
सुवृत्तं सुतरां शुभ्रं कैलासशिखरे शुभे
सूर्यमण्डलसंकाशैर् विमानैश् च विभूषितम् //
text_mt: well-rounded, exceedingly white, on the auspicious peak of Kailāsa, / adorned with aerial chariots resembling the solar orb,

sanskrit_iast:
sphāṭikair maṇḍapaiḥ śubhrair jāṃbūnadamayais tathā
nānāratnamayaiścaiva digvidikṣu vibhūṣitam //
meaning:
स्फाटिकैर् मण्डपैः शुभ्रैर् जांबूनदमयैस् तथा
नानारत्नमयैश्चैव दिग्विदिक्षु विभूषितम् //
text_mt: adorned in the cardinal and intermediate directions with white crystal pavilions, / as well as golden ones and those made of various jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
gopurairgopateḥ śaṃbhor nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ
anekaiḥ sarvatobhadraiḥ sarvaratnamayais tathā //
meaning:
गोपुरैर्गोपतेः शंभोर् नानाभूषणभूषितैः
अनेकैः सर्वतोभद्रैः सर्वरत्नमयैस् तथा //
text_mt: with the gateways of Śambhu, the lord of the bulls, adorned with diverse ornaments, / with many sarvatobhadra structures made of every jewel,

sanskrit_iast:
prākārairvividhākārair aṣṭāviṃśatibhir vṛtam
upadvārairmahādvārair vidikṣu vividhairdṛḍhaiḥ //
meaning:
प्राकारैर्विविधाकारैर् अष्टाविंशतिभिर् वृतम्
उपद्वारैर्महाद्वारैर् विदिक्षु विविधैर्दृढैः //
text_mt: surrounded by twenty-eight ramparts of diverse forms, / with secondary gates and great gates, firm and manifold, in the intermediate directions,

sanskrit_iast:
guhyālayairguhyagṛhair guhasya bhavanaiḥ śubhaiḥ
grāmyair anyair mahābhāgā mauktikair dṛṣṭimohanaiḥ //
meaning:
गुह्यालयैर्गुह्यगृहैर् गुहस्य भवनैः शुभैः
ग्राम्यैर् अन्यैर् महाभागा मौक्तिकैर् दृष्टिमोहनैः //
text_mt: with secret shrines, secret houses, and auspicious mansions of Guha, / and other delightful ones, O noble ones, captivating to the eye with pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśāyatanair divyaiḥ padmarāgamayais tathā
candanairvividhākāraiḥ puṣpodyānaiś ca śobhanaiḥ //
meaning:
गणेशायतनैर् दिव्यैः पद्मरागमयैस् तथा
चन्दनैर्विविधाकारैः पुष्पोद्यानैश् च शोभनैः //
text_mt: with divine temples of Gaṇeśa made of rubies, / with diverse sandal trees and beautiful flower gardens,

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāgair dirghikābhiś ca hemasopānapaṅktibhiḥ
strīṇāṃ gatijitair haṃsaiḥ sevitābhiḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
तडागैर् दिर्घिकाभिश् च हेमसोपानपङ्क्तिभिः
स्त्रीणां गतिजितैर् हंसैः सेविताभिः समन्ततः //
text_mt: with ponds and oblong tanks having rows of golden steps, / frequented on all sides by swans that surpassed women's graceful gait;

sanskrit_iast:
mayūraiścaiva kāraṇḍaiḥ kokilaiścakravākakaiḥ
śobhitābhiś ca vāpībhir divyāmṛtajalais tathā //
meaning:
मयूरैश्चैव कारण्डैः कोकिलैश्चक्रवाककैः
शोभिताभिश् च वापीभिर् दिव्यामृतजलैस् तथा //
text_mt: and with step-wells adorned with peacocks, kāraṇḍa ducks, cuckoos, and cakravāka birds, / and filled with celestial nectar-like water;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃlāpālāpakuśalaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ
stanabhārāvanamraiś ca madāghūrṇitalocanaiḥ //
meaning:
संलापालापकुशलैः सर्वाभरणभूषितैः
स्तनभारावनम्रैश् च मदाघूर्णितलोचनैः //
text_mt: skilled in conversation and speech, adorned with all ornaments, / bowing down from the weight of their breasts, their eyes rolling with intoxication;

sanskrit_iast:
geyanādaratairdivyai rudrakanyāsahasrakaiḥ
nṛtyadbhir apsaraḥsaṃghair amarairapi durlabhaiḥ //
meaning:
गेयनादरतैर्दिव्यै रुद्रकन्यासहस्रकैः
नृत्यद्भिर् अप्सरःसंघैर् अमरैरपि दुर्लभैः //
text_mt: devoted to songs and music, with thousands of divine maidens of Rudra / and dancing hosts of apsarases, difficult to be attained even by the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
praphullāṃbujavṛndādyais tathā dvijavarairapi
rudrastrīgaṇasaṃkīrṇair jalakrīḍāratais tathā //
meaning:
प्रफुल्लांबुजवृन्दाद्यैस् तथा द्विजवरैरपि
रुद्रस्त्रीगणसंकीर्णैर् जलक्रीडारतैस् तथा //
text_mt: with clusters of blooming lotuses and also excellent birds, / crowded with groups of Rudra's women devoted to playing in the water,

sanskrit_iast:
ratotsavarataiścaiva lalitaiś ca pade pade
grāmarāgānuraktaiś ca padmarāgasamaprabhaiḥ //
meaning:
रतोत्सवरतैश्चैव ललितैश् च पदे पदे
ग्रामरागानुरक्तैश् च पद्मरागसमप्रभैः //
text_mt: and devoted to festivals of amorous play, charming at every step, / fond of melodies from the musical scale, and radiant as rubies—

sanskrit_iast:
strīsaṃghair devadevasya bhavasya paramātmanaḥ
dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpannās tasthurdevāḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीसंघैर् देवदेवस्य भवस्य परमात्मनः
दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमापन्नास् तस्थुर्देवाः समन्ततः //
text_mt: having seen these hosts of women belonging to the God of gods, Bhava, the Supreme Self, / the gods stood on all sides, filled with amazement.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva dadṛśurdevā vṛndaṃ rudragaṇasya ca
gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ vīrāṇām api vṛndaṃ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैव ददृशुर्देवा वृन्दं रुद्रगणस्य च
गणेश्वराणां वीराणाम् अपि वृन्दं सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Right there the gods saw the troop of Rudra's host, / and also the host of heroic leaders of the gaṇas, by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇakṛtasopānān vajravaiḍūryabhūṣitān
sphāṭikān devadevasya dadṛśuste vimānakān //
meaning:
सुवर्णकृतसोपानान् वज्रवैडूर्यभूषितान्
स्फाटिकान् देवदेवस्य ददृशुस्ते विमानकान् //
text_mt: They saw the crystal celestial chariots of the God of gods, / having steps made of gold and adorned with diamonds and cat's-eye gems.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ śṛṅgeṣu hṛṣṭāś ca nāryaḥ kamalalocanāḥ
viśālajaghanā yakṣā gandharvāpsarasas tathā //
meaning:
तेषां शृङ्गेषु हृष्टाश् च नार्यः कमललोचनाः
विशालजघना यक्षा गन्धर्वाप्सरसस् तथा //
text_mt: On their pinnacles were joyful lotus-eyed women / of broad hips, yakṣas, gandharvas, and apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
kinnaryaḥ kiṃnarāścaiva bhujaṅgāḥ siddhakanyakāḥ
nānāveṣadharāścānyā nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
किन्नर्यः किंनराश्चैव भुजङ्गाः सिद्धकन्यकाः
नानावेषधराश्चान्या नानाभूषणभूषिताः //
text_mt: kinnarīs and kinnaras, serpents and daughters of the siddhas, / and others wearing various costumes and adorned with various ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāprabhāvasaṃyuktā nānābhogaratipriyāḥ
nīlotpaladalaprakhyāḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
नानाप्रभावसंयुक्ता नानाभोगरतिप्रियाः
नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्याः पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणाः //
text_mt: endowed with various powers, fond of various enjoyments and amorous pleasure, / resembling blue lotus petals, with eyes as long as lotus petals,

sanskrit_iast:
padmakiñjalkasaṃkāśair aṃśukairatiśobhanāḥ
valayairnūpurairhāraiś chatraiścitraistathāṃśukaiḥ //
meaning:
पद्मकिञ्जल्कसंकाशैर् अंशुकैरतिशोभनाः
वलयैर्नूपुरैर्हारैश् छत्रैश्चित्रैस्तथांशुकैः //
text_mt: exceedingly radiant in garments resembling the filaments of a lotus, / with bracelets, anklets, necklaces, parasols, and varied robes,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣitā bhūṣitaiś cānyair maṇḍitā maṇḍanapriyāḥ
dṛṣṭvātha vṛndaṃ surasundarīṇāṃ gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ surasundarīṇām
jagmurgaṇeśasya puraṃ sureśāḥ puradviṣaḥ śakrapurogamāś ca //
meaning:
भूषिता भूषितैश् चान्यैर् मण्डिता मण्डनप्रियाः
दृष्ट्वाथ वृन्दं सुरसुन्दरीणां गणेश्वराणां सुरसुन्दरीणाम्
जग्मुर्गणेशस्य पुरं सुरेशाः पुरद्विषः शक्रपुरोगमाश् च //
text_mt: ornamented, adorned with other ornaments, and fond of adornment. / Then, having seen the throng of celestial beauties belonging to the lords of the gaṇas, / the chiefs of the gods, preceded by Śakra, went to the city of the enemy of the cities, the Lord of the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca tasthuḥ surasiddhasaṃghāḥ purasya madhye puruhūtapūrvāḥ
bhavasya bālārkasahasravarṇaṃ vimānamādyaṃ parameśvarasya //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा च तस्थुः सुरसिद्धसंघाः पुरस्य मध्ये पुरुहूतपूर्वाः
भवस्य बालार्कसहस्रवर्णं विमानमाद्यं परमेश्वरस्य //
text_mt: Having seen it, the hosts of gods and siddhas, preceded by Puruhūta, stood in the middle of the city, / [before] the primeval celestial chariot of Bhava, the Supreme Lord, possessing the hue of a thousand morning suns.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tasya vimānasya dvāri saṃsthaṃ gaṇeśvaram
nandinaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
अथ तस्य विमानस्य द्वारि संस्थं गणेश्वरम्
नन्दिनं ददृशुः सर्वे देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: Then all the gods, preceded by Śakra, saw the lord of the gaṇas, / Nandin, standing at the doorway of that celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandinaṃ sarve praṇamyāhur gaṇeśvaram
jayeti devāstaṃ dṛṣṭvā so 'pyāha ca gaṇeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा नन्दिनं सर्वे प्रणम्याहुर् गणेश्वरम्
जयेति देवास्तं दृष्ट्वा सो ऽप्याह च गणेश्वरः //
text_mt: Seeing that Nandin, all the gods bowed down, saw the lord of the gaṇas, / and said, "Victory!" And that lord of the gaṇas spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
bho bho devā mahābhāgāḥ sarve nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
samprāptāḥ sarvalokeśā vaktumarhatha suvratāḥ //
meaning:
भो भो देवा महाभागाः सर्वे निर्धूतकल्मषाः
सम्प्राप्ताः सर्वलोकेशा वक्तुमर्हथ सुव्रताः //
text_mt: "O most fortunate gods, whose sins have all been shaken off, / all you rulers of the worlds have arrived; you ought to speak, O you of noble vows!"

sanskrit_iast:
tamāhurvaradaṃ devaṃ vāraṇendrasamaprabham
paśupāśavimokṣārthaṃ darśayāsmān maheśvaram //
meaning:
तमाहुर्वरदं देवं वारणेन्द्रसमप्रभम्
पशुपाशविमोक्षार्थं दर्शयास्मान् महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: They said to that boon-bestowing divine one, radiant as an elephant chief: / "For the sake of liberation from the bondage of paśus, show us Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
purā puratrayaṃ dagdhuṃ paśutvaṃ paribhāṣitam
śaṅkitāś ca vayaṃ tatra paśutvaṃ prati suvrata //
meaning:
पुरा पुरत्रयं दग्धुं पशुत्वं परिभाषितम्
शङ्किताश् च वयं तत्र पशुत्वं प्रति सुव्रत //
text_mt: Formerly, to burn the three cities, the state of paśu was declared [for us]; / and we are apprehensive regarding that state of paśu, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ proktaṃ bhavena parameṣṭhinā
vratenānena bhūteśa paśutvaṃ naiva vidyate //
meaning:
व्रतं पाशुपतं प्रोक्तं भवेन परमेष्ठिना
व्रतेनानेन भूतेश पशुत्वं नैव विद्यते //
text_mt: The Pāśupata vow was spoken of by Bhava, the Parameṣṭhin; / by this vow, O lord of beings, the state of paśu does not exist at all.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dvādaśavarṣaṃ vā māsadvādaśakaṃ tu vā
dinadvādaśakaṃ vāpi kṛtvā tad vratam uttamam //
meaning:
अथ द्वादशवर्षं वा मासद्वादशकं तु वा
दिनद्वादशकं वापि कृत्वा तद् व्रतम् उत्तमम् //
text_mt: Whether for twelve years, or for twelve months, / or even for twelve days, having performed that supreme vow,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyante paśavaḥ sarve paśupāśairbhavasya tu
darśayāmāsa tāndevān nārāyaṇapurogamān //
meaning:
मुच्यन्ते पशवः सर्वे पशुपाशैर्भवस्य तु
दर्शयामास तान्देवान् नारायणपुरोगमान् //
text_mt: all paśus are freed from the fetters of Bhava's beasts." / He then showed them, the gods preceded by Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
nandī śilādatanayaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇāgraṇīḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamīśānaṃ sāṃbaṃ sagaṇam avyayam //
meaning:
नन्दी शिलादतनयः सर्वभूतगणाग्रणीः
तं दृष्ट्वा देवमीशानं सांबं सगणम् अव्ययम् //
text_mt: —Nandī, the son of Śilāda, the leader of all the host of beings. / Having seen that god Īśāna, accompanied by Ambā and his attendants, imperishable,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇemus tuṣṭuvuś caiva prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ
vijñāpya śitikaṇṭhāya paśupāśavimokṣaṇam //
meaning:
प्रणेमुस् तुष्टुवुश् चैव प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः
विज्ञाप्य शितिकण्ठाय पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् //
text_mt: their skins bristling with joy, they bowed down and praised [him]; / having petitioned Śitikaṇṭha for liberation from the bondage of paśus,

sanskrit_iast:
tasthustadāgrataḥ śaṃbhoḥ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ
tataḥ samprekṣya tān sarvān devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
तस्थुस्तदाग्रतः शंभोः प्रणिपत्य पुनः पुनः
ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य तान् सर्वान् देवदेवो वृषध्वजः //
text_mt: they stood then before Śambhu, bowing down again and again. / Then, having looked upon them all, the God of gods, Vṛṣadhvaja,

sanskrit_iast:
viśodhya teṣāṃ devānāṃ paśutvaṃ parameśvaraḥ
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caiva svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
विशोध्य तेषां देवानां पशुत्वं परमेश्वरः
व्रतं पाशुपतं चैव स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: the Supreme Lord, purified the state of paśu of those gods; / and the god Maheśvara himself,

sanskrit_iast:
upadiśya munīnāṃ ca sahāste cāṃbayā bhavaḥ
tadāprabhṛti te devāḥ sarve pāśupatāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
उपदिश्य मुनीनां च सहास्ते चांबया भवः
तदाप्रभृति ते देवाः सर्वे पाशुपताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: having taught the Pāśupata vow to the sages, Bhava sat with Ambayā. / From that time on, all those gods have been remembered as Pāśupatas.

sanskrit_iast:
paśūnāṃ ca patiryasmāt teṣāṃ sākṣāddhi devatāḥ
tasmātpāśupatāḥ proktās tapastepuś ca te punaḥ //
meaning:
पशूनां च पतिर्यस्मात् तेषां साक्षाद्धि देवताः
तस्मात्पाशुपताः प्रोक्तास् तपस्तेपुश् च ते पुनः //
text_mt: And because he is the master of paśus, their manifest deity, / therefore they are called Pāśupatas; and they performed austerities again.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvādaśavarṣānte muktapāśāḥ surottamāḥ
yayuryathāgataṃ sarve brahmaṇā saha viṣṇunā //
meaning:
ततो द्वादशवर्षान्ते मुक्तपाशाः सुरोत्तमाः
ययुर्यथागतं सर्वे ब्रह्मणा सह विष्णुना //
text_mt: Then, at the end of twelve years, their bonds freed, the best of the gods / all went just as they had come, along with Brahmā and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pitāmahamukhācchrutam
purā sanatkumāreṇa tasmādvyāsena dhīmatā //
meaning:
एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं पितामहमुखाच्छ्रुतम्
पुरा सनत्कुमारेण तस्माद्व्यासेन धीमता //
text_mt: All this has been told to you, as heard from the mouth of Pitāmaha / formerly by Sanatkumāra, and from him by the wise Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śrāvayecchucir viprāñ chṛṇuyādvā śucirnaraḥ
sa dehabhedamāsādya paśupāśaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
यः श्रावयेच्छुचिर् विप्राञ् छृणुयाद्वा शुचिर्नरः
स देहभेदमासाद्य पशुपाशैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: A pure person who recites this to Brahmins, or a pure man who hears it, / having reached the dissolution of his body, is released from the bondage of paśus.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vratametattvayā proktaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ laiṅgaṃ purā devair anuṣṭhitam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
व्रतमेतत्त्वया प्रोक्तं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्
व्रतं पाशुपतं लैङ्गं पुरा देवैर् अनुष्ठितम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / This vow of liberation from the bondage of paśus has been told by you, / the Pāśupata vow relating to the liṅga, performed of old by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tvayā śrutam
purā sanatkumāreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ śailādirādarāt //
meaning:
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं यथापूर्वं त्वया श्रुतम्
पुरा सनत्कुमारेण पृष्टः शैलादिरादरात् //
text_mt: You ought to tell us as it was heard by you formerly, / when Śailādi was questioned with reverence by Sanatkumāra of old.

sanskrit_iast:
nandī prāha vacastasmai pravadāmi samāsataḥ
devairdaityais tathā siddhair gandharvaiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ //
meaning:
नन्दी प्राह वचस्तस्मै प्रवदामि समासतः
देवैर्दैत्यैस् तथा सिद्धैर् गन्धर्वैः सिद्धचारणैः //
text_mt: Nandī spoke words to him; I shall tell it in summary. / By the gods, daityas, siddhas, gandharvas, and siddha-cāraṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
munibhiś ca mahābhāgair anuṣṭhitamanuttamam
vrataṃ dvādaśaliṅgākhyaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam //
meaning:
मुनिभिश् च महाभागैर् अनुष्ठितमनुत्तमम्
व्रतं द्वादशलिङ्गाख्यं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् //
text_mt: and by the most fortunate sages was performed the peerless / vow called the twelve liṅgas, which releases from the bondage of paśus,

sanskrit_iast:
bhogadaṃ yogadaṃ caiva kāmadaṃ muktidaṃ śubham
aviyogakaraṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhayanāśanam //
meaning:
भोगदं योगदं चैव कामदं मुक्तिदं शुभम्
अवियोगकरं पुण्यं भक्तानां भयनाशनम् //
text_mt: bestowing enjoyment and yoga, granting desires, bestowing liberation, auspicious, / preventing separation, holy, and destroying fear for devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgasahitān vedān mathitvā tena nirmitam
sarvadānottamaṃ puṇyam aśvamedhāyutādhikam //
meaning:
षडङ्गसहितान् वेदान् मथित्वा तेन निर्मितम्
सर्वदानोत्तमं पुण्यम् अश्वमेधायुताधिकम् //
text_mt: Formulated by churning the Vedas together with the six auxiliary limbs, / it is the highest of all gifts, meritorious, greater than ten thousand horse sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamaṅgaladaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmapi mokṣadam //
meaning:
सर्वमङ्गलदं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम्
संसारार्णवमग्नानां जन्तूनामपि मोक्षदम् //
text_mt: bestowing all auspiciousness, meritorious, destroying all enemies, / and granting liberation even to creatures drowned in the ocean of saṃsāra,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavyādhiharaṃ caiva sarvajvaravināśanam
devairanuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā //
meaning:
सर्वव्याधिहरं चैव सर्वज्वरविनाशनम्
देवैरनुष्ठितं पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा विष्णुना तथा //
text_mt: removing all diseases, and destroying all fevers. / It was performed formerly by the gods, by Brahmā, and also by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kanīyasaṃ liṅgaṃ snāpya candanavāriṇā
caitramāsādi viprendrāḥ śivaliṅgavrataṃ caret //
meaning:
कृत्वा कनीयसं लिङ्गं स्नाप्य चन्दनवारिणा
चैत्रमासादि विप्रेन्द्राः शिवलिङ्गव्रतं चरेत् //
text_mt: Having made a small liṅga, and having bathed it with sandalwood water, / beginning from the month of Caitra, O best of Brahmins, one should observe the vow of the Śivaliṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā haimaṃ śubhaṃ padmaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam
navaratnaiś ca khacitam aṣṭapatraṃ yathāvidhi //
meaning:
कृत्वा हैमं शुभं पद्मं कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम्
नवरत्नैश् च खचितम् अष्टपत्रं यथाविधि //
text_mt: Having made an auspicious golden lotus endowed with pericarp and filaments, / inlaid with nine gems, with eight petals according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāyāṃ nyaselliṅgaṃ sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhasaṃyutam
tatra bhaktyā yathānyāyam arcayed bilvapatrakaiḥ //
meaning:
कर्णिकायां न्यसेल्लिङ्गं स्फाटिकं पीठसंयुतम्
तत्र भक्त्या यथान्यायम् अर्चयेद् बिल्वपत्रकैः //
text_mt: one should place a crystal liṅga endowed with a pedestal on the pericarp; / there, with devotion and according to the proper manner, one should worship with bilva leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
sitaiḥ sahasrakamalai raktairnīlotpalairapi
śvetārkakarṇikāraiś ca karavīrairbakairapi //
meaning:
सितैः सहस्रकमलै रक्तैर्नीलोत्पलैरपि
श्वेतार्ककर्णिकारैश् च करवीरैर्बकैरपि //
text_mt: with white thousand-petalled lotuses, red and blue lotuses, / with white arka and karṇikāra blossoms, with karavīras and baka flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
etairanyair yathālābhaṃ gāyatryā tasya suvratāḥ
sampūjya caiva gandhādyair dhūpairdīpaiś ca maṅgalaiḥ //
meaning:
एतैरन्यैर् यथालाभं गायत्र्या तस्य सुव्रताः
सम्पूज्य चैव गन्धाद्यैर् धूपैर्दीपैश् च मङ्गलैः //
text_mt: With these and others as available, with his Gāyatrī, O you of noble vows, / having worshipped with perfumes and the like, and with auspicious incenses and lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
nīrājanādyaiścānyaiś ca liṅgamūrtimaheśvaram
agaruṃ dakṣiṇe dadyād aghoreṇa dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
नीराजनाद्यैश्चान्यैश् च लिङ्गमूर्तिमहेश्वरम्
अगरुं दक्षिणे दद्याद् अघोरेण द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: with waving of lights and other rites, to Maheśvara in the form of the liṅga, / one should offer aloe wood in the south with the Aghora mantra, O best of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
paścime sadyamantreṇa divyāṃ caiva manaḥśilām
uttare vāmadevena candanaṃ vāpi dāpayet //
meaning:
पश्चिमे सद्यमन्त्रेण दिव्यां चैव मनःशिलाम्
उत्तरे वामदेवेन चन्दनं वापि दापयेत् //
text_mt:
In the west, with the Sadyo[jāta] mantra, [one should offer] divine realgar,
and in the north, with the Vāmadeva [mantra], one should offer sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣeṇa muniśreṣṭhā haritālaṃ ca pūrvataḥ
sitāgarūdbhavaṃ viprās tathā kṛṣṇāgarūdbhavam //
meaning:
पुरुषेण मुनिश्रेष्ठा हरितालं च पूर्वतः
सितागरूद्भवं विप्रास् तथा कृष्णागरूद्भवम् //
text_mt:
With the Puruṣa [mantra], O best of sages, [one should offer] orpiment in the east,
and, O brāhmaṇas, [incense] produced from white aloe and produced from black aloe,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā gugguludhūpaṃ ca saugandhikamanuttamam
sitāraṃ nāma dhūpaṃ ca dadyād īśāya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
तथा गुग्गुलुधूपं च सौगन्धिकमनुत्तमम्
सितारं नाम धूपं च दद्याद् ईशाय भक्तितः //
text_mt:
as well as bdellium incense, and unexcelled fragrant incense,
and the incense named sitāra; one should offer [these] with devotion to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
mahācarurnivedyaḥ syād āḍhakānnamathāpi vā
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ śivaliṅgamahāvratam //
meaning:
महाचरुर्निवेद्यः स्याद् आढकान्नमथापि वा
एतद् वः कथितं पुण्यं शिवलिङ्गमहाव्रतम् //
text_mt:
A great oblation of boiled rice or food measuring an āḍhaka should be offered.
This meritorious, great observance of the Śivaliṅga has been related to you.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāseṣu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo 'pi ca kīrtyate
vaiśākhe vajraliṅgaṃ ca jyeṣṭhe mārakataṃ tathā //
meaning:
सर्वमासेषु सामान्यं विशेषो ऽपि च कीर्त्यते
वैशाखे वज्रलिङ्गं च ज्येष्ठे मारकतं तथा //
text_mt:
It is common to all months, and the particularity also is proclaimed:
in Vaiśākha, a liṅga of diamond; and in Jyeṣṭha, one of emerald;

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe mauktikaṃ liṅgaṃ śrāvaṇe nīlanirmitam
māsi bhādrapade liṅgaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ śubham //
meaning:
आषाढे मौक्तिकं लिङ्गं श्रावणे नीलनिर्मितम्
मासि भाद्रपदे लिङ्गं पद्मरागमयं शुभम् //
text_mt:
in Āṣāḍha, a liṅga of pearl; in Śrāvaṇa, one made of sapphire;
in the month of Bhādrapada, an auspicious liṅga made of ruby;

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine caiva viprendrāḥ gomedakamayaṃ śubham
pravālenaiva kārtikyāṃ tathā vai mārgaśīrṣake //
meaning:
आश्विने चैव विप्रेन्द्राः गोमेदकमयं शुभम्
प्रवालेनैव कार्तिक्यां तथा वै मार्गशीर्षके //
text_mt:
and in Āśvina, O best of brāhmaṇas, an auspicious one made of hessonite;
in Kārttika, indeed of coral; and likewise in Mārgaśīrṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiḍūryanirmitaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣparāgeṇa puṣyake
māghe ca sūryakāntena phālgune sphāṭikena ca //
meaning:
वैडूर्यनिर्मितं लिङ्गं पुष्परागेण पुष्यके
माघे च सूर्यकान्तेन फाल्गुने स्फाटिकेन च //
text_mt:
a liṅga made of cat's-eye; in Puṣya, with topaz;
in Māgha, with sunstone; and in Phālguna, with crystal.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimamekaṃ vidhīyate
alābhe rājataṃ vāpi kevalaṃ kamalaṃ tu vā //
meaning:
सर्वमासेषु कमलं हैममेकं विधीयते
अलाभे राजतं वापि केवलं कमलं तु वा //
text_mt:
In all months, a single golden lotus is prescribed;
if unavailable, a silver one, or even a simple lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnānām apyalābhe tu hemnā vā rājatena vā
rajatasyāpyalābhe tu tāmralohena kārayet //
meaning:
रत्नानाम् अप्यलाभे तु हेम्ना वा राजतेन वा
रजतस्याप्यलाभे तु ताम्रलोहेन कारयेत् //
text_mt:
If the gems are not available, then with gold or with silver;
and if silver is also not available, one should have it made of copper or iron,

sanskrit_iast:
śailaṃ vā dārujaṃ vāpi mṛnmayaṃ vā savedikam
sarvagandhamayaṃ vāpi kṣaṇikaṃ parikalpayet //
meaning:
शैलं वा दारुजं वापि मृन्मयं वा सवेदिकम्
सर्वगन्धमयं वापि क्षणिकं परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt:
or of stone, or made of wood, or of clay, along with a pedestal,
or one made of all perfumes, one may prepare a temporary [liṅga].

sanskrit_iast:
haimantike mahādevaṃ śrīpattreṇaiva pūjayet
sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimamekamathāpi vā //
meaning:
हैमन्तिके महादेवं श्रीपत्त्रेणैव पूजयेत्
सर्वमासेषु कमलं हैममेकमथापि वा //
text_mt:
In the cold season, one should worship Mahādeva with bilva leaves alone,
or in all months, a single golden lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
rājataṃ vāpi kamalaṃ haimakarṇikamuttamam
rājatasyāpyabhāve tu bilvapatraiḥ samarcayet //
meaning:
राजतं वापि कमलं हैमकर्णिकमुत्तमम्
राजतस्याप्यभावे तु बिल्वपत्रैः समर्चयेत् //
text_mt:
or a silver lotus with an excellent golden pericarp;
and in the absence of silver, one should worship with bilva leaves.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakamalālābhe tadardhenāpi pūjayet
tadardhārdhena vā rudram aṣṭottaraśatena vā //
meaning:
सहस्रकमलालाभे तदर्धेनापि पूजयेत्
तदर्धार्धेन वा रुद्रम् अष्टोत्तरशतेन वा //
text_mt:
If a thousand lotuses are not obtained, one should worship with half of that,
or with half of that half, or with one hundred and eight, Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvapatre sthitā lakṣmīr devī lakṣaṇasaṃyutā
nīlotpale 'ṃbikā sākṣād utpale ṣaṇmukhaḥ svayam //
meaning:
बिल्वपत्रे स्थिता लक्ष्मीर् देवी लक्षणसंयुता
नीलोत्पले ऽंबिका साक्षाद् उत्पले षण्मुखः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
In a bilva leaf resides Lakṣmī, the goddess endowed with auspicious marks;
in a blue lotus is Ambikā directly, and in a lotus is the six-faced [Kārttikeya] himself.

sanskrit_iast:
padmāśrito mahādevaḥ sarvadevapatiḥ śivaḥ
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrīpattraṃ na tyajedbudhaḥ //
meaning:
पद्माश्रितो महादेवः सर्वदेवपतिः शिवः
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन श्रीपत्त्रं न त्यजेद्बुधः //
text_mt:
Mahādeva, Śiva the lord of all gods, resides in the lotus;
therefore, by every effort, the wise person should not omit the bilva leaf.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalaṃ cotpalaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
sarvavaśyakaraṃ padmaṃ śilā sarvārthasiddhidā //
meaning:
नीलोत्पलं चोत्पलं च कमलं च विशेषतः
सर्ववश्यकरं पद्मं शिला सर्वार्थसिद्धिदा //
text_mt:
The blue lotus, the water lily, and especially the lotus—
the lotus brings all under control, and the stone [liṅga] grants the attainment of all aims.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāgarusamudbhūtaṃ sarvapāpanikṛntanam
gugguluprabhṛtīnāṃ caiva dīpānāṃ ca nivedanam //
meaning:
कृष्णागरुसमुद्भूतं सर्वपापनिकृन्तनम्
गुग्गुलुप्रभृतीनां चैव दीपानां च निवेदनम् //
text_mt:
That which comes from black aloe cuts through all sins;
and the offering of bdellium and other incenses, and lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarogakṣayaṃ caiva candanaṃ sarvasiddhidam
saugandhikaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam //
meaning:
सर्वरोगक्षयं चैव चन्दनं सर्वसिद्धिदम्
सौगन्धिकं तथा धूपं सर्वकामार्थसाधकम् //
text_mt:
brings the destruction of all diseases; and sandalwood grants all accomplishments;
likewise, fragrant incense fulfills all desires and aims.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetāgarūdbhavaṃ caiva tathā kṛṣṇāgarūdbhavam
saumyaṃ sītāridhūpaṃ ca sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidam //
meaning:
श्वेतागरूद्भवं चैव तथा कृष्णागरूद्भवम्
सौम्यं सीतारिधूपं च साक्षान्निर्वाणसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt:
That which comes from white aloe and that which comes from black aloe,
and the gentle sītāri incense directly grant the accomplishment of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetārkakusume sākṣāc caturvaktraḥ prajāpatiḥ
karṇikārasya kusume medhā sākṣādvyavasthitā //
meaning:
श्वेतार्ककुसुमे साक्षाच् चतुर्वक्त्रः प्रजापतिः
कर्णिकारस्य कुसुमे मेधा साक्षाद्व्यवस्थिता //
text_mt:
In the flower of the white arka is directly Prajāpati of four faces;
in the flower of the karṇikāra resides Medhā visibly;

sanskrit_iast:
karavīre gaṇādhyakṣo bake nārāyaṇaḥ svayam
sugandhiṣu ca sarveṣu kusumeṣu nagātmajā //
meaning:
करवीरे गणाध्यक्षो बके नारायणः स्वयम्
सुगन्धिषु च सर्वेषु कुसुमेषु नगात्मजा //
text_mt:
in the oleander is the lord of Gaṇas; in the baka flower is Nārāyaṇa himself;
and in all fragrant flowers is the Daughter of the Mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādetairyathālābhaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादेतैर्यथालाभं पुष्पधूपादिभिः शुभैः
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः //
text_mt:
Therefore, with these auspicious flowers, incenses, and the like, as available,
one should worship the Lord of the god of gods with devotion according to one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayettato bhaktyā pāyasaṃ ca mahācarum
saghṛtaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ ca sarvadravyasamanvitam //
meaning:
निवेदयेत्ततो भक्त्या पायसं च महाचरुम्
सघृतं सोपदंशं च सर्वद्रव्यसमन्वितम् //
text_mt:
Then one should offer with devotion milk-rice and a great oblation of boiled rice,
with clarified butter, with side-dishes, and endowed with all ingredients,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhānnaṃ vāpi mudgānnam āḍhakaṃ cārdhakaṃ tu vā
cāmaraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca tasmai bhaktyā nivedayet //
meaning:
शुद्धान्नं वापि मुद्गान्नम् आढकं चार्धकं तु वा
चामरं तालवृन्तं च तस्मै भक्त्या निवेदयेत् //
text_mt:
or pure food, or mung-bean rice, measuring an āḍhaka or half of it;
and one should offer a flywhisk and a palm-leaf fan to him with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
upahārāṇi puṇyāni nyāyenaivārjitānyapi
nānāvidhāni cārhāṇi prokṣitānyaṃbhasā punaḥ //
meaning:
उपहाराणि पुण्यानि न्यायेनैवार्जितान्यपि
नानाविधानि चार्हाणि प्रोक्षितान्यंभसा पुनः //
text_mt:
Meritorious offerings, earned by righteous means,
of various kinds and worthy, sprinkled again with water,

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayecca rudrāya bhaktiyuktena cetasā
kṣīrādvai sarvadevānāṃ sthityarthamamṛtaṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
निवेदयेच्च रुद्राय भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा
क्षीराद्वै सर्वदेवानां स्थित्यर्थममृतं ध्रुवम् //
text_mt:
one should offer to Rudra with a mind joined with devotion.
From milk indeed comes the immortal nectar for the sustenance of all gods.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā sākṣād anne sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
bhūtānām annadānena prītir bhavati śaṅkare //
meaning:
विष्णुना जिष्णुना साक्षाद् अन्ने सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
भूतानाम् अन्नदानेन प्रीतिर् भवति शङ्करे //
text_mt:
By Viṣṇu, the victorious, everything is directly established in food;
by the giving of food to living beings, pleasure arises in Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sampūjayed devam anne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
upahāre tathā tuṣṭir vyañjane pavanaḥ svayam //
meaning:
तस्मात् सम्पूजयेद् देवम् अन्ने प्राणाः प्रतिष्ठिताः
उपहारे तथा तुष्टिर् व्यञ्जने पवनः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Therefore, one should worship the God; the vital breaths are established in food.
Likewise, contentment is in the food-offering, and the wind itself is in the condiment.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmako mahādevo gandhatoye hyapāmpatiḥ
pīṭhe vai prakṛtiḥ sākṣān mahadādyairvyavasthitā //
meaning:
सर्वात्मको महादेवो गन्धतोये ह्यपाम्पतिः
पीठे वै प्रकृतिः साक्षान् महदाद्यैर्व्यवस्थिता //
text_mt:
Mahādeva constitutes all things, while the Lord of Waters is in the perfumed water;
on the pedestal indeed resides Prakṛti visibly, along with the intellect and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddevaṃ yajedbhaktyā pratimāsaṃ yathāvidhi
paurṇamāsyāṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
तस्माद्देवं यजेद्भक्त्या प्रतिमासं यथाविधि
पौर्णमास्यां व्रतं कार्यं सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt:
Therefore, one should worship the God with devotion every month according to the rule;
on the full moon day, the observance should be performed for the accomplishment of all desired ends.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā śāntiḥ saṃtoṣo dānameva ca
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyām upavāsaṃ ca kārayet //
meaning:
सत्यं शौचं दया शान्तिः संतोषो दानमेव च
पौर्णमास्याममावास्याम् उपवासं च कारयेत् //
text_mt:
Truth, purity, compassion, tranquility, contentment, and giving—
on the full moon day and on the new moon day, one should also observe a fast.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarānte godānaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ viśeṣataḥ
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā śrotriyān vedapāragān //
meaning:
संवत्सरान्ते गोदानं वृषोत्सर्गं विशेषतः
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या श्रोत्रियान् वेदपारगान् //
text_mt:
At the end of the year, the gift of a cow and especially the setting free of a bull [should be done];
with devotion one should feed brāhmaṇas who are learned and have mastered the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tal liṅgaṃ pūjitaṃ tena sarvadravyasamanvitam
sthāpayed vā śivakṣetre dāpayed brāhmaṇāya vā //
meaning:
तल् लिङ्गं पूजितं तेन सर्वद्रव्यसमन्वितम्
स्थापयेद् वा शिवक्षेत्रे दापयेद् ब्राह्मणाय वा //
text_mt:
That liṅga worshipped by him, along with all the materials,
he should install in a sacred field of Śiva or give to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ sarvamāseṣu śivaliṅgamahāvratam
kuryādbhaktyā muniśreṣṭhāḥ sa eva tapatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
य एवं सर्वमासेषु शिवलिङ्गमहाव्रतम्
कुर्याद्भक्त्या मुनिश्रेष्ठाः स एव तपतां वरः //
text_mt:
Whoever performs the great observance of the Śivaliṅga thus in all months
with devotion, O best of sages, he is the best among ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ nehāyāti kadācana //
meaning:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर् विमानै रत्नभूषितैः
गत्वा शिवपुरं दिव्यं नेहायाति कदाचन //
text_mt:
Having gone in aerial chariots resembling ten million suns and adorned with gems
to the divine city of Śiva, he never returns here.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā hyekamāsaṃ vā caredevaṃ vratottamam
śivalokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
अथवा ह्येकमासं वा चरेदेवं व्रतोत्तमम्
शिवलोकमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt:
Or, if one should perform this best of observances for even one month,
he attains the world of Śiva; no doubt should be entertained in this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā saktacittaśced yānyān saṃcintayedvarān
varṣamekaṃ caredevaṃ tāṃstānprāpya śivaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
अथवा सक्तचित्तश्चेद् यान्यान् संचिन्तयेद्वरान्
वर्षमेकं चरेदेवं तांस्तान्प्राप्य शिवं व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
Or, if his mind is attached, whatever boons he may contemplate,
if he performs it thus for one year, having obtained those very [boons], he goes to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
devatvaṃ vā pitṛtvaṃ vā devarājatvameva ca
gāṇapatyapadaṃ vāpi sakto 'pi labhate naraḥ //
meaning:
देवत्वं वा पितृत्वं वा देवराजत्वमेव च
गाणपत्यपदं वापि सक्तो ऽपि लभते नरः //
text_mt:
Divinity, or ancestral status, or the kingship of the gods,
or the rank of the leadership of the Gaṇas, even an attached man attains.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt
dravyārthī ca nidhiṃ paśyed āyuḥkāmaś cirāyuṣam //
meaning:
विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां भोगार्थी भोगमाप्नुयात्
द्रव्यार्थी च निधिं पश्येद् आयुःकामश् चिरायुषम् //
text_mt:
A seeker of knowledge attains knowledge; a seeker of pleasure would obtain pleasure;
a seeker of wealth would find a treasure; and a seeker of long life, a long life.

sanskrit_iast:
yānyāṃścintayate kāmāṃs tāṃstānprāpyeha modate
ekamāsavratādeva so 'nte rudratvamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
यान्यांश्चिन्तयते कामांस् तांस्तान्प्राप्येह मोदते
एकमासव्रतादेव सो ऽन्ते रुद्रत्वमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Whatever desires he thinks upon, having obtained those very [desires], he rejoices here;
from the observance of just one month, in the end he attains Rudra-hood.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ vratottamaṃ viśvasṛjāpi sṛṣṭam
hitāya devāsurasiddhamartyavidyādharāṇāṃ paramaṃ śivena //
meaning:
इदं पवित्रं परमं रहस्यं व्रतोत्तमं विश्वसृजापि सृष्टम्
हिताय देवासुरसिद्धमर्त्यविद्याधराणां परमं शिवेन //
text_mt:
This supreme, holy secret, the best of observances, was created by Śiva, the creator of the universe,
for the highest welfare of gods, asuras, siddhas, mortals, and vidyādharas.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya pūjyaṃ vidhinaivamīśaṃ praṇamya mūrdhnā saha bhṛtyaputraiḥ
vyapohanaṃ nāma japetstavaṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtya śivaṃ prayatnāt //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य पूज्यं विधिनैवमीशं प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना सह भृत्यपुत्रैः
व्यपोहनं नाम जपेत्स्तवं च प्रदक्षिणं कृत्य शिवं प्रयत्नात् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the adorable Lord according to the rule thus, having bowed with his head together with servants and sons,
and having circumambulated Śiva with effort, one should recite the hymn named Vyapohana,

sanskrit_iast:
purākṛtaṃ viśvasṛjā stavaṃ ca hitāya devena jagattrayasya
pitāmahenaiva suraiśca sārdhaṃ mahānubhāvena mahārghyam etat //
meaning:
पुराकृतं विश्वसृजा स्तवं च हिताय देवेन जगत्त्रयस्य
पितामहेनैव सुरैश्च सार्धं महानुभावेन महार्घ्यम् एतत् //
text_mt:
which was composed of old by the creator of the universe, the God, for the benefit of the three worlds,
by Pitāmaha together with the gods—this noble, priceless [hymn].

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vyapohanastavaṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham
nandinaś ca mukhācchrutvā kumāreṇa mahātmanā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
व्यपोहनस्तवं वक्ष्ये सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं शुभम्
नन्दिनश् च मुखाच्छ्रुत्वा कुमारेण महात्मना //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
I shall proclaim the auspicious Vyapohana hymn that grants all accomplishments,
having heard it from the mouth of Nandin by the great-souled Kumāra,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsāya kathitaṃ tasmād bahumānena vai mayā
namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya nirmalāya yaśasvine //
meaning:
व्यासाय कथितं तस्माद् बहुमानेन वै मया
नमः शिवाय शुद्धाय निर्मलाय यशस्विने //
text_mt:
and by him told to Vyāsa, [and] from him indeed by me with great respect.
Salutation to Śiva, the pure, the stainless, the renowned,

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭāntakāya sarvāya bhavāya paramātmane
pañcavaktro daśabhujo hy akṣapañcadaśairyutaḥ //
meaning:
दुष्टान्तकाय सर्वाय भवाय परमात्मने
पञ्चवक्त्रो दशभुजो ह्य् अक्षपञ्चदशैर्युतः //
text_mt:
the destroyer of the wicked, to Śarva, to Bhava, to the Supreme Self,
who has five faces, ten arms, and is endowed with fifteen eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śāntaḥ sarvopari susaṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः
सर्वज्ञः सर्वगः शान्तः सर्वोपरि सुसंस्थितः //
text_mt: Resembling pure crystal, adorned with all ornaments, / omniscient, omnipresent, tranquil, seated above all,

sanskrit_iast:
padmāsanasthaḥ someśaḥ pāpamāśu vyapohatu
īśānaḥ puruṣaścaiva aghoraḥ sadya eva ca //
meaning:
पद्मासनस्थः सोमेशः पापमाशु व्यपोहतु
ईशानः पुरुषश्चैव अघोरः सद्य एव च //
text_mt: seated on a lotus throne, may Someśa quickly remove my sin; / and Īśāna, Puruṣa, Aghora, and Sadyojāta,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevaś ca bhagavān pāpamāśu vyapohatu
anantaḥ sarvavidyeśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
वामदेवश् च भगवान् पापमाशु व्यपोहतु
अनन्तः सर्वविद्येशः सर्वज्ञः सर्वदः प्रभुः //
text_mt: and the lord Vāmadeva—may he quickly remove my sin. / Ananta, lord of all lore, omniscient, all-giving sovereign,

sanskrit_iast:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
sūkṣmaḥ surāsureśāno viśveśo gaṇapūjitaḥ //
meaning:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
सूक्ष्मः सुरासुरेशानो विश्वेशो गणपूजितः //
text_mt: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / Sūkṣma, ruler of gods and asuras, lord of the universe, worshipped by the gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śivottamo mahāpūjyaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
शिवोत्तमो महापूज्यः शिवध्यानपरायणः //
text_mt: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / Śivottama, greatly worthy of worship, intent on meditation on Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagaḥ sarvadaḥ śāntaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
ekākṣo bhagavānīśaḥ śivārcanaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वगः सर्वदः शान्तः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
एकाक्षो भगवानीशः शिवार्चनपरायणः //
text_mt: omnipresent, all-giving, tranquil: may he remove my sin. / The one-eyed lord Īśa, devoted to the worship of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
trimūrtir bhagavān īśaḥ śivabhaktiprabodhakaḥ //
meaning:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
त्रिमूर्तिर् भगवान् ईशः शिवभक्तिप्रबोधकः //
text_mt: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / The three-formed lord Īśa, who awakens devotion to Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñ śivadhyānarataḥ sadā //
meaning:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
श्रीकण्ठः श्रीपतिः श्रीमाञ् शिवध्यानरतः सदा //
text_mt: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / Śrīkaṇṭha, lord of Śrī, glorious, ever delighting in meditation on Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī //
meaning:
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
त्रैलोक्यनमिता देवी सोल्काकारा पुरातनी //
text_mt: delighting in the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin. / The ancient goddess bowed to by the three worlds, meteor-like in form,

sanskrit_iast:
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī //
meaning:
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
त्रैलोक्यनमिता देवी सोल्काकारा पुरातनी //
text_mt: delighting in the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin. / The ancient goddess bowed to by the three worlds, meteor-like in form,

sanskrit_iast:
dākṣāyaṇī mahādevī gaurī haimavatī śubhā
ekaparṇāgrajā saumyā tathā vai caikapāṭalā //
meaning:
दाक्षायणी महादेवी गौरी हैमवती शुभा
एकपर्णाग्रजा सौम्या तथा वै चैकपाटला //
text_mt: Dākṣāyaṇī, Mahādevī, Gaurī, the auspicious daughter of Himavat, / gentle elder sister of Ekaparṇā, and likewise Ekapāṭalā,

sanskrit_iast:
aparṇā varadā devī varadānaikatatparā
umā suraharā sākṣāt kauśikī vā kapardinī //
meaning:
अपर्णा वरदा देवी वरदानैकतत्परा
उमा सुरहरा साक्षात् कौशिकी वा कपर्दिनी //
text_mt: Aparṇā, boon-bestowing goddess, intent solely on giving boons, / Umā, who destroys the enemies of the gods, Kauśikī, or the matted-haired goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇī divyā karāgratarupallavā
naigameyādibhir divyaiś caturbhiḥ putrakairvṛtā //
meaning:
खट्वाङ्गधारिणी दिव्या कराग्रतरुपल्लवा
नैगमेयादिभिर् दिव्यैश् चतुर्भिः पुत्रकैर्वृता //
text_mt: bearing a skull-topped staff, divine, the tips of her hands like young tree sprouts, / surrounded by her four divine sons beginning with Naigameya,

sanskrit_iast:
menāyā nandinī devī vārijā vārijekṣaṇā
aṃbāyā vītaśokasya nandinaś ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
मेनाया नन्दिनी देवी वारिजा वारिजेक्षणा
अंबाया वीतशोकस्य नन्दिनश् च महात्मनः //
text_mt: the goddess who delights Menā, born of the waters, lotus-eyed, / [consort] of the high-souled Nandin, free from sorrow, of Ambā,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāvatyāḥ sakhī śāntā pañcacūḍā varapradā
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtitvaṃ gatāvyayā //
meaning:
शुभावत्याः सखी शान्ता पञ्चचूडा वरप्रदा
सृष्ट्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां प्रकृतित्वं गताव्यया //
text_mt: friend of Śubhāvatī, tranquil, Pañcacūḍā, bestower of boons, / who, for the creation of all beings, has become imperishable Prakṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
trayoviṃśatibhis tattvair mahadādyair vijṛmbhitā
lakṣmyādiśaktibhir nityaṃ namitā nandanandinī //
meaning:
त्रयोविंशतिभिस् तत्त्वैर् महदाद्यैर् विजृम्भिता
लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिभिर् नित्यं नमिता नन्दनन्दिनी //
text_mt: manifest through the twenty-three principles beginning with Mahat, / ever bowed down to by the powers beginning with Lakṣmī, who brings joy to Nanda,

sanskrit_iast:
manonmanī mahādevī māyāvī maṇḍanapriyā
māyayā yā jagatsarvaṃ brahmādyaṃ sacarācaram //
meaning:
मनोन्मनी महादेवी मायावी मण्डनप्रिया
मायया या जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्माद्यं सचराचरम् //
text_mt: Manonmanī, Mahādevī, skilled in illusion, fond of ornaments, / who through her illusion [pervades] the entire universe, beginning with Brahmā, with all that moves and is still,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣobhiṇī mohinī nityaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitā
ekānekasthitā loke indīvaranibhekṣaṇā //
meaning:
क्षोभिणी मोहिनी नित्यं योगिनां हृदि संस्थिता
एकानेकस्थिता लोके इन्दीवरनिभेक्षणा //
text_mt: agitating, deluding, ever abiding in the hearts of yogins, / one yet manifold in the world, with eyes resembling the blue lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ sarvadevairabhiṣṭutā
gaṇendrāmbhojagarbhendrayamavitteśapūrvakaiḥ //
meaning:
भक्त्या परमया नित्यं सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुता
गणेन्द्राम्भोजगर्भेन्द्रयमवित्तेशपूर्वकैः //
text_mt: ever praised with supreme devotion by all the gods, / by the lords of the gaṇas, Brahmā, Indra, Yama, and the lord of wealth [Kubera],

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstutā jananī teṣāṃ sarvopadravanāśinī
bhaktānāmārtihā bhavyā bhavabhāvavināśanī //
meaning:
संस्तुता जननी तेषां सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनी
भक्तानामार्तिहा भव्या भवभावविनाशनी //
text_mt: praised by them as mother, destroyer of all afflictions, / remover of distress for her devotees, auspicious, destroyer of worldly existence,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktipradā divyā bhaktānāmaprayatnataḥ
sā me sākṣānmahādevī pāpam āśu vyapohatu //
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा दिव्या भक्तानामप्रयत्नतः
सा मे साक्षान्महादेवी पापम् आशु व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: divine bestower of enjoyment and liberation effortlessly to devotees: / may that Mahādevī herself quickly remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍaḥ sarvagaṇeśāno mukhācchaṃbhorvinirgataḥ
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
चण्डः सर्वगणेशानो मुखाच्छंभोर्विनिर्गतः
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: Caṇḍa, ruler of all gaṇas, emerged from the mouth of Śambhu, / devoted to the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
śālaṅkāyanaputrastu halamārgotthitaḥ prabhuḥ
jāmātā marutāṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtamaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
शालङ्कायनपुत्रस्तु हलमार्गोत्थितः प्रभुः
जामाता मरुतां देवः सर्वभूतमहेश्वरः //
text_mt: The son of Śālaṅkāyana, who arose from the furrow of the plow, the lord, / son-in-law of the Maruts, the deity, great lord of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagaḥ sarvadṛk śarvaḥ sarveśasadṛśaḥ prabhuḥ
sanārāyaṇakair devaiḥ sendracandradivākaraiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वगः सर्वदृक् शर्वः सर्वेशसदृशः प्रभुः
सनारायणकैर् देवैः सेन्द्रचन्द्रदिवाकरैः //
text_mt: omnipresent, all-seeing Śarva, the lord equal to the Lord of All, / [praised] by the gods together with Nārāyaṇa, Indra, the moon, and the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhaiś ca yakṣagandharvair bhūtairbhūtavidhāyakaiḥ
uragairṛṣibhiścaiva brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā //
meaning:
सिद्धैश् च यक्षगन्धर्वैर् भूतैर्भूतविधायकैः
उरगैरृषिभिश्चैव ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना //
text_mt: by siddhas, yakṣas, gandharvas, spirits, the creators of beings, / serpents, sages, and the great-souled Brahmā—

sanskrit_iast:
stutastrailokyanāthastu munirantaḥ puraṃ sthitaḥ
sarvadā pūjitaḥ sarvair nandī pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
स्तुतस्त्रैलोक्यनाथस्तु मुनिरन्तः पुरं स्थितः
सर्वदा पूजितः सर्वैर् नन्दी पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: the praised lord of the three worlds, the sage dwelling in the inner sanctuary, / ever worshipped by all: may Nandin remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākāyo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
महाकायो महातेजा महादेव इवापरः
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: Of vast body, of great splendour, like another Mahādeva, / devoted to the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
merumandārakailāsataṭakūṭaprabhedanaḥ
airāvatādibhir divyair diggajaiś ca supūjitaḥ //
meaning:
मेरुमन्दारकैलासतटकूटप्रभेदनः
ऐरावतादिभिर् दिव्यैर् दिग्गजैश् च सुपूजितः //
text_mt: He who cleaves the slopes and peaks of Meru, Mandara, and Kailāsa, / well-worshipped by Airāvata and the other divine elephants of the quarters,

sanskrit_iast:
saptapātālapādaś ca saptadvīporujaṅghakaḥ
saptārṇavāṅkuśaścaiva sarvatīrthodaraḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
सप्तपातालपादश् च सप्तद्वीपोरुजङ्घकः
सप्तार्णवाङ्कुशश्चैव सर्वतीर्थोदरः शिवः //
text_mt: whose feet are the seven subterranean worlds, whose thighs and shanks are the seven continents, / whose goad is the seven oceans, whose belly contains all sacred tirthas, the auspicious one,

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśadeho digbāhuḥ somasūryāgnilocanaḥ
hatāsuramahāvṛkṣo brahmavidyāmahotkaṭaḥ //
meaning:
आकाशदेहो दिग्बाहुः सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनः
हतासुरमहावृक्षो ब्रह्मविद्यामहोत्कटः //
text_mt: whose body is space, whose arms are the quarters, whose eyes are the moon, sun, and fire, / who uproots the great trees of the asuras, formidable with the knowledge of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyādhoraṇair divyair yogapāśasamanvitaiḥ
baddho hṛtpuṇḍarīkākhye staṃbhe vṛttiṃ nirudhya ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्याधोरणैर् दिव्यैर् योगपाशसमन्वितैः
बद्धो हृत्पुण्डरीकाख्ये स्तंभे वृत्तिं निरुध्य च //
text_mt: bound by divine elephant-drivers beginning with Brahmā equipped with nooses of yoga / to the post called the heart-lotus, having restrained his mental fluctuations,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgendravaktro yaḥ sākṣād gaṇakoṭiśatairvṛtaḥ
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
नागेन्द्रवक्त्रो यः साक्षाद् गणकोटिशतैर्वृतः
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: he who truly has the face of an elephant-king, surrounded by hundreds of millions of gaṇas, / wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgīśaḥ piṅgalākṣo 'sau bhasitāśastu dehayuk
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
भृङ्गीशः पिङ्गलाक्षो ऽसौ भसिताशस्तु देहयुक्
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: Bhṛṅgīśa, reddish-brown-eyed, whose body is covered in ash, / devoted to the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhistanubhir nityaṃ sarvāsuranibarhaṇaḥ
skandaḥ śaktidharaḥ śāntaḥ senānīḥ śikhivāhanaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्भिस्तनुभिर् नित्यं सर्वासुरनिबर्हणः
स्कन्दः शक्तिधरः शान्तः सेनानीः शिखिवाहनः //
text_mt: Who constantly destroys all asuras through his four forms, / Skanda, spear-bearer, tranquil, general, having the peacock for his mount,

sanskrit_iast:
devasenāpatiḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
bhavaḥ śarvastatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatis tathā //
meaning:
देवसेनापतिः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
भवः शर्वस्तथेशानो रुद्रः पशुपतिस् तथा //
text_mt: commander of the army of the gods, glorious: may he remove my sin. / Bhava, Śarva, as well as Īśāna, Rudra, and Paśupati,

sanskrit_iast:
ugro bhīmo mahādevaḥ śivārcanarataḥ sadā
etāḥ pāpaṃ vyapohantu mūrtayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
उग्रो भीमो महादेवः शिवार्चनरतः सदा
एताः पापं व्यपोहन्तु मूर्तयः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: Ugra, Bhīma, Mahādeva, ever devoted to the worship of Śiva: / may these forms of the Supreme Lord remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ
īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
महादेवः शिवो रुद्रः शङ्करो नीललोहितः
ईशानो विजयो भीमो देवदेवो भवोद्भवः //
text_mt: Mahādeva, Śiva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita, / Īśāna, Vijaya, Bhīma, God of Gods, Bhavodbhava,

sanskrit_iast:
kapālīśaś ca vijñeyo rudrā rudrāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ
śivapraṇāmasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
कपालीशश् च विज्ञेयो रुद्रा रुद्रांशसंभवाः
शिवप्रणामसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: and Kapālīśa to be known—these Rudras born from parts of Rudra, / devoted to bowing before Śiva: may they remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
vikartano vivasvāṃś ca mārtaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ
lokaprakāśakaścaiva lokasākṣītrivikramaḥ //
meaning:
विकर्तनो विवस्वांश् च मार्तण्डो भास्करो रविः
लोकप्रकाशकश्चैव लोकसाक्षीत्रिविक्रमः //
text_mt: Vikartana, Vivasvat, Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Ravi, / illuminator of the worlds, witness of the worlds, Trivikrama,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaś ca tathā sūryaś cāṃśumāṃś ca divākaraḥ
ete vai dvādaśādityā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
आदित्यश् च तथा सूर्यश् चांशुमांश् च दिवाकरः
एते वै द्वादशादित्या व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: Āditya, and likewise Sūrya, Aṃśumat, and Divākara: / may these twelve Ādityas remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
gaganaṃ sparśanaṃ tejo rasaś ca pṛthivī tathā
candraḥ sūryastathātmā ca tanavaḥ śivabhāṣitāḥ //
meaning:
गगनं स्पर्शनं तेजो रसश् च पृथिवी तथा
चन्द्रः सूर्यस्तथात्मा च तनवः शिवभाषिताः //
text_mt: Space, wind, fire, water, and earth, / the moon, the sun, and the self—proclaimed as the forms of Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ vyapohantu mama bhayaṃ nirṇāśayantu me
vāsavaḥ pāvakaścaiva yamo nirṛtireva ca //
meaning:
पापं व्यपोहन्तु मम भयं निर्णाशयन्तु मे
वासवः पावकश्चैव यमो निरृतिरेव च //
text_mt: may they remove my sin, may they destroy my fear! / Vāsava, Pāvaka, Yama, and Nirṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇo vāyusomau ca īśāno bhagavān hariḥ
pitāmahaś ca bhagavān śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
वरुणो वायुसोमौ च ईशानो भगवान् हरिः
पितामहश् च भगवान् शिवध्यानपरायणः //
text_mt: Varuṇa, Vāyu and Soma, Īśāna, the lord Hari, / and the lord Pitāmaha, intent on meditation on Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
ete pāpaṃ vyapohantu manasā karmaṇā kṛtam
nabhasvānsparśano vāyur anilo mārutas tathā //
meaning:
एते पापं व्यपोहन्तु मनसा कर्मणा कृतम्
नभस्वान्स्पर्शनो वायुर् अनिलो मारुतस् तथा //
text_mt: may these remove the sin committed by my mind or action. / Nabhasvat, Sparśana, Vāyu, Anila, and Māruta,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇaḥ prāṇeśajīveśau mārutaḥ śivabhāṣitāḥ
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
प्राणः प्राणेशजीवेशौ मारुतः शिवभाषिताः
शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: Prāṇa, the lords of breath and life, Māruta, declared by Śiva, / all devoted to the worship of Śiva: may they remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
khecarī vasucārī ca brahmeśo brahmabrahmadhīḥ
suṣeṇaḥ śāśvataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ supuṣṭaś ca mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
खेचरी वसुचारी च ब्रह्मेशो ब्रह्मब्रह्मधीः
सुषेणः शाश्वतः पृष्टः सुपुष्टश् च महाबलः //
text_mt: Khecarī, Vasucārī, Brahmeśa, Brahmabrahmadhī, / Suṣeṇa, Śāśvata, Pṛṣṭa, Supuṣṭa, and Mahābala:

sanskrit_iast:
ete vai cāraṇāḥ śaṃbhoḥ pūjayātīva bhāvitāḥ
vyapohantu malaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam //
meaning:
एते वै चारणाः शंभोः पूजयातीव भाविताः
व्यपोहन्तु मलं सर्वं पापं चैव मया कृतम् //
text_mt: these Cāraṇas of Śambhu, greatly elevated through worship, / may they remove all impurity and sin committed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrajño mantravit prājño mantrarāṭ siddhapūjitaḥ
siddhavatparamaḥ siddhaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyinaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रज्ञो मन्त्रवित् प्राज्ञो मन्त्रराट् सिद्धपूजितः
सिद्धवत्परमः सिद्धः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनः //
text_mt: Knower of mantras, master of mantras, wise, king of mantras, worshipped by the siddhas, / supreme like a siddha, perfected ones who grant all accomplishments:

sanskrit_iast:
vyapohantu malaṃ sarve siddhāḥ śivapadārcakāḥ
yakṣo yakṣeśadhanado jṛmbhako maṇibhadrakaḥ //
meaning:
व्यपोहन्तु मलं सर्वे सिद्धाः शिवपदार्चकाः
यक्षो यक्षेशधनदो जृम्भको मणिभद्रकः //
text_mt: may all the siddhas, worshippers of Śiva's feet, remove my impurity. / The Yakṣa, the lord of yakṣas who bestows wealth, Jṛmbhaka, Maṇibhadra,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇabhadreśvaro mālī śitikuṇḍalireva ca
narendraścaiva yakṣeśā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
पूर्णभद्रेश्वरो माली शितिकुण्डलिरेव च
नरेन्द्रश्चैव यक्षेशा व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: Pūrṇabhadreśvara, Mālī, and Śitikuṇḍalin, / and Narendra, lords of yakṣas: may they remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaḥ kulikaścaiva vāsukistakṣakastathā
karkoṭako mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkhapālo mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्तः कुलिकश्चैव वासुकिस्तक्षकस्तथा
कर्कोटको महापद्मः शङ्खपालो महाबलः //
text_mt: Ananta, Kulika, Vāsuki, and Takṣaka, / Karkoṭaka, Mahāpadma, and the mighty Śaṅkhapāla,

sanskrit_iast:
śivapraṇāmasampannāḥ śivadehaprabhūṣaṇāḥ
mama pāpaṃ vyapohantu viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
शिवप्रणामसम्पन्नाः शिवदेहप्रभूषणाः
मम पापं व्यपोहन्तु विषं स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: devoted to bowing before Śiva, adornments on Śiva's body— / may they remove my sin and poison, whether stationary or mobile.

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇājñaḥ kinnaraścaiva surasenaḥ pramardanaḥ
atīśayaḥ sa prayogī gītajñaścaiva kinnarāḥ //
meaning:
वीणाज्ञः किन्नरश्चैव सुरसेनः प्रमर्दनः
अतीशयः स प्रयोगी गीतज्ञश्चैव किन्नराः //
text_mt: The vīṇā-knowing Kinnara, Surasena, Pramardana, / the pre-eminent Prayogin, and Kinnaras skilled in song,

sanskrit_iast:
śivapraṇāmasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama
vidyādharaś ca vibudho vidyārāśirvidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
शिवप्रणामसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
विद्याधरश् च विबुधो विद्याराशिर्विदां वरः //
text_mt: devoted to bowing before Śiva, may they remove my impurity. / The Vidyādhara, Vibudha, the treasury of learning, the best of the wise,

sanskrit_iast:
vibuddho vibudhaḥ śrīmān kṛtajñaś ca mahāyaśāḥ
ete vidyādharāḥ sarve śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
विबुद्धो विबुधः श्रीमान् कृतज्ञश् च महायशाः
एते विद्याधराः सर्वे शिवध्यानपरायणाः //
text_mt: Vibuddha, the wise Vibudha, the glorious, grateful, and widely renowned— / all these Vidyādharas, intent on meditating upon Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vyapohantu malaṃ ghoraṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ
vāmadevī mahājambhaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ //
meaning:
व्यपोहन्तु मलं घोरं महादेवप्रसादतः
वामदेवी महाजम्भः कालनेमिर्महाबलः //
text_mt: may they remove terrible impurity through the grace of Mahādeva. / Vāmadevī, Mahājambha, the mighty Kālanemi,

sanskrit_iast:
sugrīvo mardakaścaiva piṅgalo devamardanaḥ
prahrādaścāpyanuhrādaḥ saṃhrādaḥ kila bāṣkalau //
meaning:
सुग्रीवो मर्दकश्चैव पिङ्गलो देवमर्दनः
प्रह्रादश्चाप्यनुह्रादः संह्रादः किल बाष्कलौ //
text_mt: Sugrīva, Mardaka, Piṅgala, Devamardana, / Prahrāda, Anuhrāda, Saṃhrāda, indeed the two Bāṣkalas,

sanskrit_iast:
jambhaḥ kuṃbhaś ca māyāvī kārtavīryaḥ kṛtaṃjayaḥ
ete 'surā mahātmāno mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
जम्भः कुंभश् च मायावी कार्तवीर्यः कृतंजयः
एते ऽसुरा महात्मानो महादेवपरायणाः //
text_mt: Jambha, Kumbha the wily, Kārtavīrya, Kṛtañjaya— / these high-souled Asuras, devoted to Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoram āsuraṃ bhāvameva ca
garutmān khagatiścaiva pakṣirāṭ nāgamardanaḥ //
meaning:
व्यपोहन्तु भयं घोरम् आसुरं भावमेव च
गरुत्मान् खगतिश्चैव पक्षिराट् नागमर्दनः //
text_mt: may they remove terrible fear and the Asura nature itself. / Garutmat, Khagati, king of birds, crusher of serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgaśatrur hiraṇyāṅgo vainateyaḥ prabhañjanaḥ
nāgāśīrviṣanāśaś ca viṣṇuvāhana eva ca //
meaning:
नागशत्रुर् हिरण्याङ्गो वैनतेयः प्रभञ्जनः
नागाशीर्विषनाशश् च विष्णुवाहन एव च //
text_mt: the enemy of serpents, golden-limbed, son of Vinatā, Prabhañjana, / the devourer of snakes, destroyer of venom, and mount of Viṣṇu—

sanskrit_iast:
ete hiraṇyavarṇābhā garuḍā viṣṇuvāhanāḥ
nānābharaṇasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
एते हिरण्यवर्णाभा गरुडा विष्णुवाहनाः
