नानाभरणसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: these golden-hued Garuḍas, the mounts of Viṣṇu, / adorned with diverse ornaments, may they remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyaś ca vasiṣṭhaś ca aṅgirā bhṛgureva ca
kāśyapo nāradaścaiva dadhīcaścyavanas tathā //
meaning:
अगस्त्यश् च वसिष्ठश् च अङ्गिरा भृगुरेव च
काश्यपो नारदश्चैव दधीचश्च्यवनस् तथा //
text_mt: Agastya, Vasiṣṭha, Aṅgiras, and Bhṛgu, / Kāśyapa, Nārada, Dadhīca, and Cyavana,

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyustathānye ca ṛṣayaḥ śivabhāvitāḥ
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
उपमन्युस्तथान्ये च ऋषयः शिवभाविताः
शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: Upamanyu and other sages who contemplate Śiva, / all devoted to worshipping Śiva, may they remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraḥ pitāmahāś ca tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ
agniṣvāttā barhiṣadas tathā mātāmahādayaḥ //
meaning:
पितरः पितामहाश् च तथैव प्रपितामहाः
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदस् तथा मातामहादयः //
text_mt: The fathers, the grandfathers, and the great-grandfathers, / the Agniṣvāttas, the Barhiṣads, and the maternal grandfathers and others,

sanskrit_iast:
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
lakṣmīś ca dharaṇī caiva gāyatrī ca sarasvatī //
meaning:
व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं शिवध्यानपरायणाः
लक्ष्मीश् च धरणी चैव गायत्री च सरस्वती //
text_mt: intent on meditating upon Śiva, may they remove fear and sin. / Lakṣmī, Dharaṇī, Gāyatrī, and Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
durgā uṣā śacī jyeṣṭhā mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ
devānāṃ mātaraś caiva gaṇānāṃ mātaras tathā //
meaning:
दुर्गा उषा शची ज्येष्ठा मातरः सुरपूजिताः
देवानां मातरश् चैव गणानां मातरस् तथा //
text_mt: Durgā, Uṣas, Śacī, Jyeṣṭhā, the mothers worshipped by the gods, / the mothers of the gods, and the mothers of the gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvā yatra yā gaṇamātaraḥ
prasādāddevadevasya vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
meaning:
भूतानां मातरः सर्वा यत्र या गणमातरः
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम //
text_mt: all the mothers of the bhūtas, and whatever mothers of the gaṇas are there— / by the grace of the God of gods, may they remove my impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśī menakā caiva raṃbhā ratitilottamāḥ
sumukhī durmukhī caiva kāmukī kāmavardhanī //
meaning:
उर्वशी मेनका चैव रंभा रतितिलोत्तमाः
सुमुखी दुर्मुखी चैव कामुकी कामवर्धनी //
text_mt: Urvaśī, Menakā, Rambhā, Rati, and Tilottamā, / Sumukhī, Durmukhī, Kāmukī, and Kāmavardhanī,

sanskrit_iast:
tathānyāḥ sarvalokeṣu divyāścāpsarasas tathā
śivāya tāṇḍavaṃ nityaṃ kurvantyo 'tīva bhāvitāḥ //
meaning:
तथान्याः सर्वलोकेषु दिव्याश्चाप्सरसस् तथा
शिवाय ताण्डवं नित्यं कुर्वन्त्यो ऽतीव भाविताः //
text_mt: and the other celestial Apsarases across all the worlds, / who constantly perform the tāṇḍava dance for Śiva with deep devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
devyaḥ śivārcanaratā vyapohantu malaṃ mama
arkaḥ somo 'ṅgārakaś ca budhaścaiva bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
देव्यः शिवार्चनरता व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
अर्कः सोमो ऽङ्गारकश् च बुधश्चैव बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: divine women devoted to worshipping Śiva, may they remove my impurity. / The Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, and Jupiter,

sanskrit_iast:
śukraḥ śanaiścaraścaiva rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoraṃ grahapīḍāṃ śivārcakāḥ //
meaning:
शुक्रः शनैश्चरश्चैव राहुः केतुस्तथैव च
व्यपोहन्तु भयं घोरं ग्रहपीडां शिवार्चकाः //
text_mt: Venus, Saturn, Rāhu, and Ketu— / worshippers of Śiva, may they remove terrible fear and affliction from the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣo vṛṣo 'tha mithunas tathā karkaṭakaḥ śubhaḥ
siṃhaś ca kanyā vipulā tulā vai vṛścikas tathā //
meaning:
मेषो वृषो ऽथ मिथुनस् तथा कर्कटकः शुभः
सिंहश् च कन्या विपुला तुला वै वृश्चिकस् तथा //
text_mt: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and auspicious Cancer, / Leo, large Virgo, Libra, and Scorpio,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuś ca makaraścaiva kuṃbho mīnastathaiva ca
rāśayo dvādaśa hyete śivapūjāparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
धनुश् च मकरश्चैव कुंभो मीनस्तथैव च
राशयो द्वादश ह्येते शिवपूजापरायणाः //
text_mt: Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces— / these twelve zodiac signs, devoted to the worship of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ
aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā //
meaning:
व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
अश्विनी भरणी चैव कृत्तिका रोहिणी तथा //
text_mt: may they remove fear and sin by the grace of the Supreme Lord. / Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, Kṛttikā, and Rohiṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanmṛgaśiraścārdrā punarvasupuṣyasārpakāḥ
maghā vai pūrvaphālgunya uttarāphālgunī tathā //
meaning:
श्रीमन्मृगशिरश्चार्द्रा पुनर्वसुपुष्यसार्पकाः
मघा वै पूर्वफाल्गुन्य उत्तराफाल्गुनी तथा //
text_mt: splendid Mṛgaśiras, Ārdrā, Punarvasu, Puṣya, and Āśleṣā, / Maghā, Pūrvaphālgunī, and Uttaraphālgunī,

sanskrit_iast:
hastacitrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā
jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ mahābhāgā pūrvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca //
meaning:
हस्तचित्रा तथा स्वाती विशाखा चानुराधिका
ज्येष्ठा मूलं महाभागा पूर्वाषाढा तथैव च //
text_mt: Hasta, Citrā, Svātī, Viśākhā, and Anurādhā, / Jyeṣṭhā, Mūla, fortunate Pūrvāṣāḍhā,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāṣāḍhikā caiva śravaṇaṃ ca śraviṣṭhikā
śatabhiṣak pūrvabhadrā tathā proṣṭhapadā tathā //
meaning:
उत्तराषाढिका चैव श्रवणं च श्रविष्ठिका
शतभिषक् पूर्वभद्रा तथा प्रोष्ठपदा तथा //
text_mt: Uttarāṣāḍhā, Śravaṇa, Dhaniṣṭhā, / Śatabhiṣak, Pūrvabhādrapadā, and Uttarabhādrapadā,

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇaṃ ca devyaḥ satataṃ vyapohantu malaṃ mama
jvaraḥ kumbhodaraścaiva śaṅkukarṇo mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
पौष्णं च देव्यः सततं व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
ज्वरः कुम्भोदरश्चैव शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः //
text_mt: and Revatī—may these divine maidens constantly remove my impurity. / Jvara, Kumbhodara, the mighty Śaṅkukarṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
mahākarṇaḥ prabhātaś ca mahābhūtapramardanaḥ
śyenajicchivadūtaś ca pramathāḥ prītivardhanāḥ //
meaning:
महाकर्णः प्रभातश् च महाभूतप्रमर्दनः
श्येनजिच्छिवदूतश् च प्रमथाः प्रीतिवर्धनाः //
text_mt: Mahākarṇa, Prabhāta, crusher of mighty bhūtas, / Śyenajit, Śivadūta, the Pramathas who foster affection,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikoṭiśataiścaiva bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sadā
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ //
meaning:
कोटिकोटिशतैश्चैव भूतानां मातरः सदा
व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं महादेवप्रसादतः //
text_mt: and the mothers of the bhūtas by hundreds of millions— / may they constantly remove fear and sin by the grace of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
śivadhyānaikasampanno himarāḍ aṃbusannibhaḥ
kundendusadṛśākāraḥ kuṃbhakundendubhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नो हिमराड् अंबुसन्निभः
कुन्देन्दुसदृशाकारः कुंभकुन्देन्दुभूषणः //
text_mt: Solely engrossed in meditating upon Śiva, resembling the king of snow and water, / with a form like the kunda flower and the moon, adorned with a pot, kunda flowers, and the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
vaḍavānalaśatruryo vaḍavāmukhabhedanaḥ
catuṣpādasamāyuktaḥ kṣīroda iva pāṇḍuraḥ //
meaning:
वडवानलशत्रुर्यो वडवामुखभेदनः
चतुष्पादसमायुक्तः क्षीरोद इव पाण्डुरः //
text_mt: the foe of the submarine fire who cleft the submarine mouth, / endowed with four feet, white as the milk ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
rudraloke sthito nityaṃ rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ
vṛṣendro viśvadhṛg devo viśvasya jagataḥ pitā //
meaning:
रुद्रलोके स्थितो नित्यं रुद्रैः सार्धं गणेश्वरैः
वृषेन्द्रो विश्वधृग् देवो विश्वस्य जगतः पिता //
text_mt: dwelling eternally in the world of Rudra alongside the Rudras and the lords of the gaṇas, / the Lord of Bulls, the god who upholds all, the father of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛto nandādibhir nityaṃ mātṛbhir makhamardanaḥ
śivārcanarato nityaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
वृतो नन्दादिभिर् नित्यं मातृभिर् मखमर्दनः
शिवार्चनरतो नित्यं स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: ever surrounded by the mothers headed by Nandā, the destroyer of the sacrifice, / ever devoted to worshipping Śiva—may he remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgā mātā jaganmātā rudraloke vyavasthitā
śivabhaktā tu yā nandā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
गङ्गा माता जगन्माता रुद्रलोके व्यवस्थिता
शिवभक्ता तु या नन्दा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: Mother Gaṅgā, the mother of the world, who dwells in the world of Rudra, / and Nandā who is devoted to Śiva—may she remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrā bhadrapadā devī śivaloke vyavasthitā
mātā gavāṃ mahābhāgā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
भद्रा भद्रपदा देवी शिवलोके व्यवस्थिता
माता गवां महाभागा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: The goddess Bhadrā, of auspicious steps, who dwells in the world of Śiva, / the fortunate mother of cows—may she remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
surabhiḥ sarvatobhadrā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī
rudrapūjāratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
सुरभिः सर्वतोभद्रा सर्वपापप्रणाशनी
रुद्रपूजारता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: Surabhi, auspicious on every side, destroyer of all sin, / ever devoted to the worship of Rudra—may she remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
suśīlā śīlasampannā śrīpradā śivabhāvitā
śivaloke sthitā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
सुशीला शीलसम्पन्ना श्रीप्रदा शिवभाविता
शिवलोके स्थिता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: Suśīlā, richly endowed with good character, granter of prosperity, devoted to Śiva, / ever abiding in the world of Śiva—may she remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrārthatattvajñaḥ sarvakāryābhicintakaḥ
samastaguṇasampannaḥ sarvadeveśvarātmajaḥ //
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वकार्याभिचिन्तकः
समस्तगुणसम्पन्नः सर्वदेवेश्वरात्मजः //
text_mt: Knower of the truth of the Veda and the scriptures, mindful of all tasks, / endowed with all virtues, son of the Lord of all gods,

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhaḥ sarveśvaraḥ saumyo mahāviṣṇutanuḥ svayam
āryaḥ senāpatiḥ sākṣād gahano makhamardanaḥ //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठः सर्वेश्वरः सौम्यो महाविष्णुतनुः स्वयम्
आर्यः सेनापतिः साक्षाद् गहनो मखमर्दनः //
text_mt: the Eldest, the Lord of all, gentle, the very embodiment of Mahāviṣṇu, / the noble one, commander of the army in person, unfathomable, destroyer of the sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
airāvatagajārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ
kṛṣṇāṅgo raktanayanaḥ śaśipannagabhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ऐरावतगजारूढः कृष्णकुञ्चितमूर्धजः
कृष्णाङ्गो रक्तनयनः शशिपन्नगभूषणः //
text_mt: mounted upon the elephant Airāvata, with black curled hair, / dark-bodied, red-eyed, adorned with the moon and serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācaiś ca kūṣmāṇḍaiś ca samāvṛtaḥ
śivārcanarataḥ sākṣāt sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
भूतैः प्रेतैः पिशाचैश् च कूष्माण्डैश् च समावृतः
शिवार्चनरतः साक्षात् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: surrounded by bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and kūṣmāṇḍas, / directly engaged in worshipping Śiva—may he remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇī caiva māheśī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā
vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍāgneyikā tathā //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणी चैव माहेशी कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा
वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डाग्नेयिका तथा //
text_mt: Brahmāṇī, Māheśī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, / Vārāhī, Māhendrī, Cāmuṇḍā, and Āgneyī—

sanskrit_iast:
etā vai mātaraḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokaprapūjitāḥ
yoginībhir mahāpāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ //
meaning:
एता वै मातरः सर्वाः सर्वलोकप्रपूजिताः
योगिनीभिर् महापापं व्यपोहन्तु समाहिताः //
text_mt: all these mothers, worshipped by all the worlds, / with their Yoginīs, intent on meditation, may they remove my great sin.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadro mahātejā himakundendusannibhaḥ
rudrasya tanayo raudraḥ śūlāsaktamahākaraḥ //
meaning:
वीरभद्रो महातेजा हिमकुन्देन्दुसन्निभः
रुद्रस्य तनयो रौद्रः शूलासक्तमहाकरः //
text_mt: Vīrabhadra of great splendour, resembling snow, the kunda flower, and the moon, / the fierce son of Rudra, whose mighty hand grasps the trident,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvāyudhadharaḥ svayam
tretāgninayano devas trailokyābhayadaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रबाहुः सर्वज्ञः सर्वायुधधरः स्वयम्
त्रेताग्निनयनो देवस् त्रैलोक्याभयदः प्रभुः //
text_mt: thousand-armed, omniscient, bearing all weapons himself, / the god whose eyes are the three sacred fires, the lord who grants fearlessness to the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
mātṝṇāṃ rakṣako nityaṃ mahāvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ
trailokyanamitaḥ śrīmān śivapādārcane rataḥ //
meaning:
मातॄणां रक्षको नित्यं महावृषभवाहनः
त्रैलोक्यनमितः श्रीमान् शिवपादार्चने रतः //
text_mt: the constant protector of the mothers, whose mount is a great bull, / bowed to by the three worlds, glorious, devoted to worshipping the feet of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñasya ca śiraśchettā pūṣṇo dantavināśanaḥ
vahnerhastaharaḥ sākṣād bhaganetranipātanaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञस्य च शिरश्छेत्ता पूष्णो दन्तविनाशनः
वह्नेर्हस्तहरः साक्षाद् भगनेत्रनिपातनः //
text_mt: the severer of the head of the sacrifice, the destroyer of Pūṣan's teeth, / who severed the hands of Fire, who cast down the eyes of Bhaga,

sanskrit_iast:
pādāṅguṣṭhena somāṅgapeṣakaḥ prabhusaṃjñakaḥ
upendrendrayamādīnāṃ devānāmaṅgarakṣakaḥ //
meaning:
पादाङ्गुष्ठेन सोमाङ्गपेषकः प्रभुसंज्ञकः
उपेन्द्रेन्द्रयमादीनां देवानामङ्गरक्षकः //
text_mt: who crushed the limbs of the Moon with his big toe, called the Lord, / the body-protector of the gods beginning with Upendra, Indra, and Yama—

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyā mahādevyā nāsikoṣṭhāvakartanaḥ
gaṇeśvaro yaḥ senānīḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
सरस्वत्या महादेव्या नासिकोष्ठावकर्तनः
गणेश्वरो यः सेनानीः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: May the lord of the gaṇas, the commander of armies, who cut off the nose and lip of the great goddess Sarasvatī, / remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā varadā varābharaṇabhūṣitā
mahālakṣmīrjaganmātā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा वरदा वराभरणभूषिता
महालक्ष्मीर्जगन्माता सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: May the foremost, the most excellent, the grantor of boons, adorned with splendid ornaments, / Mahālakṣmī, the mother of the universe, remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmohā mahābhāgā mahābhūtagaṇairvṛtā
śivārcanaratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
महामोहा महाभागा महाभूतगणैर्वृता
शिवार्चनरता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: May she who is Great Delusion, highly fortunate, surrounded by hosts of great spirits, / ever devoted to the worship of Śiva, remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīḥ sarvaguṇopetā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā
sarvadā sarvagā devī sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीः सर्वगुणोपेता सर्वलक्षणसंयुता
सर्वदा सर्वगा देवी सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: May Lakṣmī, endowed with all auspicious qualities, possessing all auspicious marks, / the ever-giving, all-pervading goddess, remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhārūḍhā mahādevī pārvatyāstanayāvyayā
viṣṇornidrā mahāmāyā vaiṣṇavī surapūjitā //
meaning:
सिंहारूढा महादेवी पार्वत्यास्तनयाव्यया
विष्णोर्निद्रा महामाया वैष्णवी सुरपूजिता //
text_mt: Mounted upon a lion, the great goddess, the imperishable daughter of Pārvatī, / the slumber of Viṣṇu, Mahāmāyā, Vaiṣṇavī, worshipped by the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrā varadā devī mahiṣāsuramardinī
śivārcanaratā durgā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रा वरदा देवी महिषासुरमर्दिनी
शिवार्चनरता दुर्गा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु //
text_mt: three-eyed, grantor of boons, the goddess crusher of the demon Mahiṣa, / Durgā, devoted to the worship of Śiva—may she remove my sin.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍadhārakā rudrāḥ sarvalokaprapūjitāḥ
satyāś ca mānasāḥ sarve vyapohantu bhayaṃ mama //
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डधारका रुद्राः सर्वलोकप्रपूजिताः
सत्याश् च मानसाः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु भयं मम //
text_mt: May the Rudras, upholders of the cosmic egg, revered by all worlds, / the Satyas, and all the mind-born [deities], remove my fear.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāś ca kūṣmāṇḍagaṇanāyakāḥ
kūṣmāṇḍakāś ca te pāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ //
meaning:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश् च कूष्माण्डगणनायकाः
कूष्माण्डकाश् च ते पापं व्यपोहन्तु समाहिताः //
text_mt: May the bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, leaders of the kūṣmāṇḍa hosts, / and the kūṣmāṇḍas, composed in mind, remove your sin.

sanskrit_iast:
anena devaṃ stutvā tu cānte sarvaṃ samāpayet
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pratimāse dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
अनेन देवं स्तुत्वा तु चान्ते सर्वं समापयेत्
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रतिमासे द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Having praised the God with this [hymn], one should conclude everything at the end, / bowing one's head to the ground every month, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vyapohanastavaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi
vidhūya sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
व्यपोहनस्तवं दिव्यं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि
विधूय सर्वपापानि रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Whoever recites or even listens to this divine Vyapohana hymn / shakes off all sins and is exalted in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ jayakāmo jayaṃ labhet
arthakāmo labhedarthaṃ putrakāmo bahūn sutān //
meaning:
कन्यार्थी लभते कन्यां जयकामो जयं लभेत्
अर्थकामो लभेदर्थं पुत्रकामो बहून् सुतान् //
text_mt: One who desires a maiden obtains a maiden; one who seeks victory obtains victory; / one who desires wealth obtains wealth; one who desires a son obtains many sons.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt
yānyānprārthayate kāmān mānavaḥ śravaṇādiha //
meaning:
विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां भोगार्थी भोगमाप्नुयात्
यान्यान्प्रार्थयते कामान् मानवः श्रवणादिह //
text_mt: One who desires learning obtains learning; one who seeks enjoyment attains enjoyment; / whatever desires a mortal asks for here from hearing it,

sanskrit_iast:
tānsarvān śīghramāpnoti devānāṃ ca priyo bhavet
paṭhyamānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yamuddiśya tu paṭhyate //
meaning:
तान्सर्वान् शीघ्रमाप्नोति देवानां च प्रियो भवेत्
पठ्यमानमिदं पुण्यं यमुद्दिश्य तु पठ्यते //
text_mt: all those he attains swiftly, and he becomes dear to the gods. / When this meritorious [hymn] is recited, for whoever's sake it is recited,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya rogā na bādhante vātapittādisaṃbhavāḥ
nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya na sarpairapi daśyate //
meaning:
तस्य रोगा न बाधन्ते वातपित्तादिसंभवाः
नाकाले मरणं तस्य न सर्पैरपि दश्यते //
text_mt: diseases arising from wind, bile, and the like do not torment him; / untimely death is not his, nor is he bitten by serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpuṇyaṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ yajñānāṃ caiva yatphalam
dānānāṃ caiva yatpuṇyaṃ vratānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
यत्पुण्यं चैव तीर्थानां यज्ञानां चैव यत्फलम्
दानानां चैव यत्पुण्यं व्रतानां च विशेषतः //
text_mt: Whatever merit comes from sacred fords, whatever fruit from sacrifices, / whatever merit comes from gifts, and especially from religious observances,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ japtvā cāpnoti mānavaḥ
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaś ca vīrahā brahmahā bhavet //
meaning:
तत्पुण्यं कोटिगुणितं जप्त्वा चाप्नोति मानवः
गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश् च वीरहा ब्रह्महा भवेत् //
text_mt: a person attains that merit multiplied ten million times by reciting [this]. / Even if one is a killer of cows, ungrateful, a slayer of heroes, or a slayer of a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśvāsaghātakaḥ
duṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā //
meaning:
शरणागतघाती च मित्रविश्वासघातकः
दुष्टः पापसमाचारो मातृहा पितृहा तथा //
text_mt: a slayer of those who sought refuge, a betrayer of friends' trust, / wicked, sinful in conduct, a killer of a mother or a father,

sanskrit_iast: vyapohya sarvapāpāni śivaloke mahīyate //
meaning: व्यपोह्य सर्वपापानि शिवलोके महीयते //
text_mt: having dispelled all sins, he is exalted in the realm of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vyapohanastavaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutamasmābhir ādarāt
prasaṃgālliṅgadānasya vratānyapi vadasva naḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
व्यपोहनस्तवं पुण्यं श्रुतमस्माभिर् आदरात्
प्रसंगाल्लिङ्गदानस्य व्रतान्यपि वदस्व नः //
text_mt: The sages said: / We have attentively heard the sacred Vyapohana hymn. / In connection with the gift of a liṅga, tell us also about the religious observances.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vratāni vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śubhāni munisattamāḥ
nandinā kathitānīha brahmaputrāya dhīmate //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
व्रतानि वः प्रवक्ष्यामि शुभानि मुनिसत्तमाः
नन्दिना कथितानीह ब्रह्मपुत्राय धीमते //
text_mt: Sūta said: / I will declare to you, O best of sages, the auspicious observances / related here by Nandin to the wise son of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni vyāsādupaśrutya yuṣmākaṃ pravadāmyaham
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
तानि व्यासादुपश्रुत्य युष्माकं प्रवदाम्यहम्
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पक्षयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt: Having heard them from Vyāsa, I declare them to you. / On the eighth and fourteenth days of both fortnights,

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivam
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
वर्षमेकं तु भुञ्जानो नक्तं यः पूजयेच्छिवम्
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: eating only at night for one year, whoever worships Śiva / attains the fruit of all sacrifices and goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ bhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā parvasu mānavaḥ
ahorātreṇa caikena trirātraphalamaśnute //
meaning:
पृथिवीं भाजनं कृत्वा भुक्त्वा पर्वसु मानवः
अहोरात्रेण चैकेन त्रिरात्रफलमश्नुते //
text_mt: A person who, using the ground as a plate, eats on the sacred junction-days, / enjoys the fruit of a three-night fast by means of a single day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
dvayor māsasya pañcamyor dvayoḥ pratipadornaraḥ
kṣīradhārāvrataṃ kuryāt so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
द्वयोर् मासस्य पञ्चम्योर् द्वयोः प्रतिपदोर्नरः
क्षीरधाराव्रतं कुर्यात् सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: If a man performs the stream-of-milk observance on both fifth days and both first days of the month, / he attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu naktena yāvatkṛṣṇacaturdaśī
bhuñjanbhogānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु नक्तेन यावत्कृष्णचतुर्दशी
भुञ्जन्भोगानवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति //
text_mt: Eating only at night from the dark eighth until the dark fourteenth, / he attains enjoyments and goes to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'bdamekaṃ prakurvīta naktaṃ parvasu parvasu
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽब्दमेकं प्रकुर्वीत नक्तं पर्वसु पर्वसु
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधः शिवध्यानपरायणः //
text_mt: One who observes a night meal on every sacred junction-day for one year, / chaste, with anger subdued, devoted to meditation on Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarānte viprendrān bhojayedvidhipūrvakam
sa yāti śāṅkaraṃ lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
संवत्सरान्ते विप्रेन्द्रान् भोजयेद्विधिपूर्वकम्
स याति शाङ्करं लोकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: should feed eminent brāhmaṇas according to rule at the end of the year; / he goes to the realm of Śaṅkara—there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsāt paraṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyāt param ayācitam
ayācitāt paraṃ naktaṃ tasmān naktena vartayet //
meaning:
उपवासात् परं भैक्ष्यं भैक्ष्यात् परम् अयाचितम्
अयाचितात् परं नक्तं तस्मान् नक्तेन वर्तयेत् //
text_mt: Better than fasting is begged food; better than begged food is unsolicited food; / better than unsolicited food is eating at night: therefore one should subsist by night eating.

sanskrit_iast:
devairbhuktaṃ tu pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne ṛṣibhis tathā
aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ //
meaning:
देवैर्भुक्तं तु पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने ऋषिभिस् तथा
अपराह्णे च पितृभिः संध्यायां गुह्यकादिभिः //
text_mt: Food is eaten by the gods in the forenoon, by the sages at midday, / by the ancestors in the afternoon, and by the guhyakas and others at twilight.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavelāmatikramya naktabhojanamuttamam
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyamāhāralāghavam //
meaning:
सर्ववेलामतिक्रम्य नक्तभोजनमुत्तमम्
हविष्यभोजनं स्नानं सत्यमाहारलाघवम् //
text_mt: Surpassing all times, the night meal is supreme. / Eating sacrificial food, bathing, truthfulness, lightness of food,

sanskrit_iast:
agnikāryamadhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret
pratimāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śivavratamanuttamam //
meaning:
अग्निकार्यमधःशय्यां नक्तभोजी समाचरेत्
प्रतिमासं प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवव्रतमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: fire ritual, and sleeping on the ground—one who eats at night should practise [these]. / I shall declare the peerless observance of Śiva month by month,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmakāmārthamokṣārthaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye
puṣyamāse ca sampūjya yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam //
meaning:
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षार्थं सर्वपापविशुद्धये
पुष्यमासे च सम्पूज्य यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: for the sake of dharma, kāma, artha, and liberation, and for purification from all sins. / In the month of Puṣya, having worshipped and eating only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
satyavādī jitakrodhaḥ śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ
pakṣayoraṣṭamīṃ yatnād upavāsena vartayet //
meaning:
सत्यवादी जितक्रोधः शालिगोधूमगोरसैः
पक्षयोरष्टमीं यत्नाद् उपवासेन वर्तयेत् //
text_mt: truth-speaking, anger subdued, [subsisting on] winter rice, wheat, and cow's milk products, / one should diligently observe a fast on the eighth day of both fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiśayyāṃ ca māsānte paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ
snāpya rudraṃ mahādevaṃ sampūjya vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
भूमिशय्यां च मासान्ते पौर्णमास्यां घृतादिभिः
स्नाप्य रुद्रं महादेवं सम्पूज्य विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Sleeping on the ground, and at the end of the month, on the full moon day, / having bathed Rudra, Mahādeva, with ghee and other substances and worshipped him according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvakaṃ caudanaṃ dattvā sakṣīraṃ saghṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
bhojayed brāhmaṇāñśiṣṭāñ japecchāntiṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
यावकं चौदनं दत्त्वा सक्षीरं सघृतं द्विजाः
भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणाञ्शिष्टाञ् जपेच्छान्तिं विशेषतः //
text_mt: offering barley porridge and boiled rice with milk and ghee, O twice-born, / one should feed cultivated brāhmaṇas and especially recite the peace chant.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā gomithunaṃ caiva kapilaṃ vinivedayet
bhavāya devadevāya śivāya parameṣṭhine //
meaning:
तथा गोमिथुनं चैव कपिलं विनिवेदयेत्
भवाय देवदेवाय शिवाय परमेष्ठिने //
text_mt: Likewise, one should present a pair of tawny cattle / to Bhava, the God of gods, Śiva, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti muniśārdūla vāhneyaṃ lokamuttamam
bhuktvā sa vipulān lokān tatraiva sa vimucyate //
meaning:
स याति मुनिशार्दूल वाह्नेयं लोकमुत्तमम्
भुक्त्वा स विपुलान् लोकान् तत्रैव स विमुच्यते //
text_mt: He goes, O tiger among sages, to the excellent world of Agni; / having enjoyed vast worlds, he is liberated right there.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse tu sampūjya yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam
kṛśaraṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
माघमासे तु सम्पूज्य यः कुर्यान् नक्तभोजनम्
कृशरं घृतसंयुक्तं भुञ्जानः संयतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, having worshipped, one who eats only at night, / consuming khichdi mixed with ghee, with senses subdued,

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāsaṃ caturdaśyāṃ bhavedubhayapakṣayoḥ
rudrāya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu dadyādvai ghṛtakambalam //
meaning:
सोपवासं चतुर्दश्यां भवेदुभयपक्षयोः
रुद्राय पौर्णमास्यां तु दद्याद्वै घृतकम्बलम् //
text_mt: should observe a fast on the fourteenth day of both fortnights; / and on the full moon day, one should offer a blanket of ghee to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ gomithunaṃ dadyāt pūjayeccaiva śaṃkaram
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva yathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
कृष्णं गोमिथुनं दद्यात् पूजयेच्चैव शंकरम्
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणांश्चैव यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: One should give a pair of black cattle and worship Śaṅkara, / and feed brāhmaṇas according to the extent of one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyamāsādya vai lokaṃ yamena saha modate
phālgune caiva samprāpte kuryādvai naktabhojanam //
meaning:
याम्यमासाद्य वै लोकं यमेन सह मोदते
फाल्गुने चैव सम्प्राप्ते कुर्याद्वै नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: Reaching the realm of Yama, he rejoices with Yama. / When Phālguna arrives, one should eat only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmākānnaghṛtakṣīrair jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ
caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyām upavāsaṃ ca kārayet //
meaning:
श्यामाकान्नघृतक्षीरैर् जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः
चतुर्दश्यामथाष्टम्याम् उपवासं च कारयेत् //
text_mt: with wild millet grains, ghee, and milk, with anger and senses subdued, / and should undertake a fast on the fourteenth or the eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ mahādevaṃ snāpya sampūjya śaṅkaram
dadyādgomithunaṃ vāpi tāmrābhaṃ śūlapāṇaye //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां महादेवं स्नाप्य सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
दद्याद्गोमिथुनं वापि ताम्राभं शूलपाणये //
text_mt: On the full moon day, having bathed and worshipped Mahādeva, Śaṅkara, / one should give a pair of copper-coloured cattle to the Trident-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu prārthayetparameśvaram
sa yāti candrasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा तु प्रार्थयेत्परमेश्वरम्
स याति चन्द्रसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Having fed brāhmaṇas, he should pray to the Supreme Lord; / he attains union with the Moon—there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre 'pi rudramabhyarcya kuryādvai naktabhojanam
śālyannaṃ payasā yuktaṃ ghṛtena ca yathāsukham //
meaning:
चैत्रे ऽपि रुद्रमभ्यर्च्य कुर्याद्वै नक्तभोजनम्
शाल्यन्नं पयसा युक्तं घृतेन च यथासुखम् //
text_mt: In Caitra as well, having worshipped Rudra, one should eat only at night / rice from winter grain mixed with milk and ghee at pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhaśāyī muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṣitau niśi bhavaṃ smaret
paurṇamāsyāṃ śivaṃ snāpya dadyādgomithunaṃ sitam //
meaning:
गोष्ठशायी मुनिश्रेष्ठाः क्षितौ निशि भवं स्मरेत्
पौर्णमास्यां शिवं स्नाप्य दद्याद्गोमिथुनं सितम् //
text_mt: Sleeping in a cow-pen on the ground, O best of sages, one should remember Bhava at night; / on the full moon day, having bathed Śiva, one should give a pair of white cattle,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayeccaiva nirṛteḥ sthānamāpnuyāt
vaiśākhe ca tathā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्चैव निरृतेः स्थानमाप्नुयात्
वैशाखे च तथा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: and feed brāhmaṇas; he attains the abode of Nirṛti. / Likewise, in the month of Vaiśākha, having eaten only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ bhavaṃ snāpya pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ
śvetaṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां भवं स्नाप्य पञ्चगव्यघृतादिभिः
श्वेतं गोमिथुनं दत्त्वा सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: bathing Bhava on the full moon day with the five products of the cow, ghee, and other liquids, / and giving a pair of white cattle, he obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe māse ca deveśaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim
sampūjya śraddhayā bhaktyā kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे मासे च देवेशं भवं शर्वमुमापतिम्
सम्पूज्य श्रद्धया भक्त्या कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: And in the month of Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped the lord of the gods, Bhava, Śarva, the lord of Umā, / with faith and devotion, and having eaten only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
raktaśālyannamadhvā ca adbhiḥ pūtaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ
vīrāsano niśārdhaṃ ca gavāṃ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ //
meaning:
रक्तशाल्यन्नमध्वा च अद्भिः पूतं घृतादिभिः
वीरासनो निशार्धं च गवां शुश्रूषणे रतः //
text_mt: [eating] red rice and honey, purified with water and ghee, / sitting in the hero's posture for half the night and devoted to tending cows,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sampūjya devadevamumāpatim
snāpya śaktyā yathānyāyaṃ caruṃ dadyāc ca śūline //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां तु सम्पूज्य देवदेवमुमापतिम्
स्नाप्य शक्त्या यथान्यायं चरुं दद्याच् च शूलिने //
text_mt: and having worshipped the god of gods, the lord of Umā, on the full moon day, / having bathed [him] according to rule to the best of one's ability, one should offer the sacred boiled offering to the Trident-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca yathāvibhavavistaram
dhūmraṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā vāyuloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च यथाविभवविस्तरम्
धूम्रं गोमिथुनं दत्त्वा वायुलोके महीयते //
text_mt: And having fed Brahmins according to the extent of one's wealth, / and having given a smoke-coloured pair of cattle, one is honoured in the world of Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe māsi cāpyevaṃ naktabhojanatatparaḥ
bhūrikhaṇḍājyasaṃmiśraṃ saktubhiścaiva gorasam //
meaning:
आषाढे मासि चाप्येवं नक्तभोजनतत्परः
भूरिखण्डाज्यसंमिश्रं सक्तुभिश्चैव गोरसम् //
text_mt: And in the month of Āṣāḍha likewise, intent on eating only at night, / [eating] milk and milk-products mixed with roasted barley flour, abundant raw sugar, and ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādyaistu snāpya pūjya yathāvidhi
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śrotriyān vedapāragān //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां घृताद्यैस्तु स्नाप्य पूज्य यथाविधि
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च श्रोत्रियान् वेदपारगान् //
text_mt: having bathed and worshipped [him] on the full moon day according to rule with ghee and the like, / and having fed Brahmins learned in the Vedas and masters of the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādgomithunaṃ gauraṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt
śrāvaṇe ca dvijā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam //
meaning:
दद्याद्गोमिथुनं गौरं वारुणं लोकमाप्नुयात्
श्रावणे च द्विजा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: one should give a fair-coloured pair of cattle; one attains the world of Varuṇa. / And in the month of Śrāvaṇa, O twice-born ones, having eaten only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam
paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādyaistu snāpya pūjya yathāvidhi //
meaning:
क्षीरषष्टिकभक्तेन सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम्
पौर्णमास्यां घृताद्यैस्तु स्नाप्य पूज्य यथाविधि //
text_mt: having worshipped him who has a bull on his banner with cooked sixty-day rice in milk, / and on the full moon day having bathed and worshipped [him] according to rule with ghee and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śrotriyān vedapāragān
śvetāgrapādaṃ pauṇḍraṃ ca dadyādgomithunaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च श्रोत्रियान् वेदपारगान्
श्वेताग्रपादं पौण्ड्रं च दद्याद्गोमिथुनं पुनः //
text_mt: and having fed Brahmins learned in the Vedas and masters of the Vedas, / one should then give a pair of cattle, pauṇḍra [in breed] with white forefeet.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti vāyusāyujyaṃ vāyuvatsarvago bhavet
prāpte bhādrapade māse kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam //
meaning:
स याति वायुसायुज्यं वायुवत्सर्वगो भवेत्
प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे मासे कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: He goes to union with Vāyu and becomes all-pervading like Vāyu. / When the month of Bhādrapada has arrived, having thus eaten only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
hutaśeṣaṃ ca viprendrān vṛkṣamūlāśrito divā
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu deveśaṃ snāpya sampūjya śaṅkaram //
meaning:
हुतशेषं च विप्रेन्द्रान् वृक्षमूलाश्रितो दिवा
पौर्णमास्यां तु देवेशं स्नाप्य सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् //
text_mt: [eating] the remnants of the oblation, O best of Brahmins, dwelling at the root of a tree by day, / and on the full moon day having bathed and worshipped Śaṅkara, the lord of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlaskandhaṃ vṛṣaṃ gāṃ ca dattvā bhaktyā yathāvidhi
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca vedavedāṅgapāragān //
meaning:
नीलस्कन्धं वृषं गां च दत्त्वा भक्त्या यथाविधि
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान् //
text_mt: having given with devotion according to rule a blue-shouldered bull and a cow, / and having fed Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣalokamanuprāpya yakṣarājo bhavennaraḥ
tataścāśvayuje māsi kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam //
meaning:
यक्षलोकमनुप्राप्य यक्षराजो भवेन्नरः
ततश्चाश्वयुजे मासि कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: having reached the world of the Yakṣas, a man becomes a Yakṣa king. / Then in the month of Āśvayuja, having thus eaten only at night,

sanskrit_iast:
saghṛtaṃ śaṅkaraṃ pūjya paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvavat
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śivabhaktān sadā śucīn //
meaning:
सघृतं शङ्करं पूज्य पौर्णमास्यां च पूर्ववत्
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च शिवभक्तान् सदा शुचीन् //
text_mt: having worshipped Śaṅkara with ghee and on the full moon day as before, / and having fed Brahmins who are devotees of Śiva, always pure,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhaṃ nīlavarṇābham urodeśasamunnatam
gāṃ ca dattvā yathānyāyam aiśānaṃ lokamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
वृषभं नीलवर्णाभम् उरोदेशसमुन्नतम्
गां च दत्त्वा यथान्यायम् ऐशानं लोकमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: and having given according to rule a bull having the appearance of a dark colour, / with an elevated chest, and a cow, one attains the world of Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike ca tathā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam
kṣīraudanena sājyena sampūjya ca bhavaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
कार्तिके च तथा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम्
क्षीरौदनेन साज्येन सम्पूज्य च भवं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: And in the month of Kārtika likewise, having eaten only at night, / and having worshipped Lord Bhava with rice cooked in milk with ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca vidhivat snāpya dattvā caruṃ punaḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca yathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां च विधिवत् स्नाप्य दत्त्वा चरुं पुनः
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: and on the full moon day having bathed [him] according to rule and offered the sacred boiled offering again, / and having fed Brahmins according to the extent of one's wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā gomithunaṃ caiva kāpilaṃ pūrvavad dvijāḥ
sūryasāyujyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
दत्त्वा गोमिथुनं चैव कापिलं पूर्ववद् द्विजाः
सूर्यसायुज्यमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: and having given a pair of tawny cattle as before, O twice-born ones, / one attains union with Sūrya; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe ca māse 'pi kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam
yavānnena yathānyāyam ājyakṣīrādibhiḥ samam //
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे च मासे ऽपि कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम्
यवान्नेन यथान्यायम् आज्यक्षीरादिभिः समम् //
text_mt: And in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa also, having thus eaten only at night, / [subsisting] according to rule on barley-food along with ghee, milk, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ kṛtvā śarvāya śaṃbhave
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca daridrānvedapāragān //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां च पूर्वोक्तं कृत्वा शर्वाय शंभवे
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च दरिद्रान्वेदपारगान् //
text_mt: and having performed on the full moon day what was previously spoken of for Śarva, Śambhu, / and having fed poor Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā gomithunaṃ caiva pāṇḍuraṃ vidhipūrvakam
somalokamanuprāpya somena saha modate //
meaning:
दत्त्वा गोमिथुनं चैव पाण्डुरं विधिपूर्वकम्
सोमलोकमनुप्राप्य सोमेन सह मोदते //
text_mt: and having given a pale pair of cattle according to rule, / having reached the world of Soma, one rejoices with Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṣamā dayā
triḥsnānaṃ cāgnihotraṃ ca bhūśayyā naktabhojanam //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं क्षमा दया
त्रिःस्नानं चाग्निहोत्रं च भूशय्या नक्तभोजनम् //
text_mt: Non-violence, truth, non-stealing, celibacy, forgiveness, compassion, / bathing three times a day, performing the Agnihotra fire-offering, sleeping on the ground, eating only at night,

sanskrit_iast: pakṣayorupavāsaṃ ca caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca //
meaning: पक्षयोरुपवासं च चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च //
text_mt: and fasting during the fortnights on the fourteenth and eighth [lunar days]—

sanskrit_iast: ityetadakhilaṃ proktaṃ pratimāsaṃ śivavratam //
meaning: इत्येतदखिलं प्रोक्तं प्रतिमासं शिवव्रतम् //
text_mt: all this has been spoken of as the monthly Śiva-vow.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādvarṣaṃ krameṇaiva vyutkrameṇāpi vā dvijāḥ
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ jñānayogamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
कुर्याद्वर्षं क्रमेणैव व्युत्क्रमेणापि वा द्विजाः
स याति शिवसायुज्यं ज्ञानयोगमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: One should observe it for a year in regular order, or even in reverse order, O twice-born ones; / he goes to union with Śiva and attains the yoga of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
umāmaheśvaraṃ vakṣye vratamīśvarabhāṣitam
naranāryādijantūnāṃ hitāya munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
उमामहेश्वरं वक्ष्ये व्रतमीश्वरभाषितम्
नरनार्यादिजन्तूनां हिताय मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall declare the Umā-Maheśvara vow spoken by the Lord / for the welfare of men, women, and other living beings, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca
naktamabdaṃ prakurvīta haviṣyaṃ pūjayedbhavam //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च
नक्तमब्दं प्रकुर्वीत हविष्यं पूजयेद्भवम् //
text_mt: On the full moon, new moon, fourteenth, and eighth [lunar days], / one should eat sacrificial food at night for a year and worship Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśapratimāṃ hemnā kṛtvā suśobhanām
rājatīṃ vātha varṣānte pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi //
meaning:
उमामहेशप्रतिमां हेम्ना कृत्वा सुशोभनाम्
राजतीं वाथ वर्षान्ते प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि //
text_mt: Having fashioned a very beautiful image of Umā and Maheśa out of gold / or silver, and having consecrated it according to rule at the end of the year,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca dattvā śaktyā ca dakṣiṇām
rathādyairvāpi deveśaṃ nītvā rudrālayaṃ prati //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च दत्त्वा शक्त्या च दक्षिणाम्
रथाद्यैर्वापि देवेशं नीत्वा रुद्रालयं प्रति //
text_mt: and having fed Brahmins and given a priestly fee according to one's ability, / or having conveyed the lord of the gods to an abode of Rudra by chariots and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātiśayasaṃyuktaiś chatracāmarabhūṣaṇaiḥ
nivedayedvrataṃ caiva śivāya parameṣṭhine //
meaning:
सर्वातिशयसंयुक्तैश् छत्रचामरभूषणैः
निवेदयेद्व्रतं चैव शिवाय परमेष्ठिने //
text_mt: with parasols, chowries, and ornaments endowed with all excellences, / one should dedicate the vow to Śiva, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nārī devyā yadi prabho
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī //
meaning:
स याति शिवसायुज्यं नारी देव्या यदि प्रभो
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी //
text_mt: He goes to union with Śiva; and a woman [attains union] with the Goddess, O lord, / if, restrained and celibate on the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days],

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ na bhuñjati kanyā vā vidhavāpi vā
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ //
meaning:
वर्षमेकं न भुञ्जति कन्या वा विधवापि वा
वर्षान्ते प्रतिमां कृत्वा पूर्वोक्तविधिना ततः //
text_mt: she does not eat for one year, whether she is a maiden or a widow. / Having fashioned an image at the end of the year according to the rule previously stated, then

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ dattvā rudrālaye punaḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca bhavānyā saha modate //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं दत्त्वा रुद्रालये पुनः
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च भवान्या सह मोदते //
text_mt: having consecrated it according to rule and presented it in an abode of Rudra, / and having fed Brahmins, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
yā nāryevaṃ caredabdaṃ kṛṣṇāmekāṃ caturdaśīm
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā yena kenāpi vā dvijāḥ //
meaning:
या नार्येवं चरेदब्दं कृष्णामेकां चतुर्दशीम्
वर्षान्ते प्रतिमां कृत्वा येन केनापि वा द्विजाः //
text_mt: The woman who would observe thus for a year on each single dark fourteenth [lunar day], / and having fashioned an image at the end of the year out of whatever [she can], O twice-born ones,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyā saha modate
amāvāsyāṃ nirāhārā bhavedabdaṃ suyantritā //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तमखिलं कृत्वा भवान्या सह मोदते
अमावास्यां निराहारा भवेदब्दं सुयन्त्रिता //
text_mt: and having done all that was previously stated, rejoices with Bhavānī. / Well-disciplined, she should be without food on the new moon for a year,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ ca vidhinā kṛtvā varṣānte vinivedayet
snāpyeśānaṃ yajedbhaktyā sahasraiḥ kamalaiḥ sitaiḥ //
meaning:
शूलं च विधिना कृत्वा वर्षान्ते विनिवेदयेत्
स्नाप्येशानं यजेद्भक्त्या सहस्रैः कमलैः सितैः //
text_mt: and having fashioned a trident according to rule, she should present it at the end of the year; / having bathed Īśāna, she should worship him with devotion with thousands of white lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
rājataṃ kamalaṃ caiva jāṃbūnadasukarṇikam
dattvā bhavāya viprebhyaḥ pradadyād dakṣiṇām api //
meaning:
राजतं कमलं चैव जांबूनदसुकर्णिकम्
दत्त्वा भवाय विप्रेभ्यः प्रदद्याद् दक्षिणाम् अपि //
text_mt: And having given a silver lotus with a pericarp of gold / to Bhava, she should also bestow a priestly fee upon the Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmato 'pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyādikaṃ ca yat
tatsarvaṃ śūladānena bhindyānnārī na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
कामतो ऽपि कृतं पापं भ्रूणहत्यादिकं च यत्
तत्सर्वं शूलदानेन भिन्द्यान्नारी न संशयः //
text_mt: Whatever sin has been committed even intentionally, such as the killing of an embryo, / a woman would destroy all of it by the gift of a trident; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyujyaṃ caivamāpnoti bhavānyā dvijasattamāḥ
kuryādyadvā naraḥ so 'pi rudrasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सायुज्यं चैवमाप्नोति भवान्या द्विजसत्तमाः
कुर्याद्यद्वा नरः सो ऽपि रुद्रसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: And thus she attains union with Bhavānī, O best of twice-born ones; / or if a man should do it, he too attains union with Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ varṣamekamatandritā
upavāsaratā nārī naro 'pi dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां वर्षमेकमतन्द्रिता
उपवासरता नारी नरो ऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Unwearied on the full moon and new moon for one year, / a woman or a man devoted to fasting, O best of twice-born ones—

sanskrit_iast:
niyogādeva tatkāryaṃ bhartṝṇāṃ dvijasattamāḥ
japaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ sarvam asvatantrā yataḥ striyaḥ //
meaning:
नियोगादेव तत्कार्यं भर्तॄणां द्विजसत्तमाः
जपं दानं तपः सर्वम् अस्वतन्त्रा यतः स्त्रियः //
text_mt: it must be performed by women only with the permission of their husbands, O best of twice-born ones, / including all recitation, giving, and austerity, since women are not independent.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣānte sarvagandhāḍhyāṃ pratimāṃ saṃnivedayet
sā bhavānyāś ca sāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ cāpi suvratā //
meaning:
वर्षान्ते सर्वगन्धाढ्यां प्रतिमां संनिवेदयेत्
सा भवान्याश् च सायुज्यं सारूप्यं चापि सुव्रता //
text_mt: At the end of the year, she should present an image endowed with all perfumes; / she, of good vows, [attains] union and sameness of form with Bhavānī;

sanskrit_iast:
labhate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham
kārtikyāṃ vā tu yā nārī ekabhaktena vartate //
meaning:
लभते नात्र संदेहः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम्
कार्तिक्यां वा तु या नारी एकभक्तेन वर्तते //
text_mt: she obtains [it], there is no doubt here; I speak the truth, the truth. / Or on the full moon of Kārtika, the woman who subsists on a single meal,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyuktā brahmacāriṇī
dadyātkṛṣṇatilānāṃ ca bhāramekam atandritā //
meaning:
क्षमाहिंसादिनियमैः संयुक्ता ब्रह्मचारिणी
दद्यात्कृष्णतिलानां च भारमेकम् अतन्द्रिता //
text_mt: endowed with the observances of forgiveness, non-violence, and the like, observing celibacy, / unwearied, should give one bhāra of black sesame seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
saghṛtaṃ saguḍaṃ caiva odanaṃ parameṣṭhine
dattvā ca brāhmaṇebhyaś ca yathā vibhavavistaram //
meaning:
सघृतं सगुडं चैव ओदनं परमेष्ठिने
दत्त्वा च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश् च यथा विभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: and cooked rice with ghee and with raw sugar to the Supreme Lord; / and having given to Brahmins according to the extent of her wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyām upavāsaratā ca sā
bhavānyā modate sārdhaṃ sārūpyaṃ prāpya suvratā //
meaning:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्याम् उपवासरता च सा
भवान्या मोदते सार्धं सारूप्यं प्राप्य सुव्रता //
text_mt: and devoted to fasting on the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days], / she, of good vows, having attained sameness of form, rejoices with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo rudrapūjanam //
meaning:
क्षमा सत्यं दया दानं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः
सर्वव्रतेष्वयं धर्मः सामान्यो रुद्रपूजनम् //
text_mt: Forgiveness, truth, compassion, charity, purity, restraint of the senses, / and the worship of Rudra—this is the common duty in all vows.

sanskrit_iast:
samāsādvaḥ pravakṣyāmi pratimāsamanukramāt
mārgaśīrṣakamāsādikārttikāntaṃ yathākramam //
meaning:
समासाद्वः प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमासमनुक्रमात्
मार्गशीर्षकमासादिकार्त्तिकान्तं यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: I shall declare to you concisely, in order month by month, / in proper succession, beginning with the month of Mārgaśīrṣa and ending with Kārtika.

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ suvipulaṃ puṇyaṃ nandinā paribhāṣitam
mārgaśīrṣakamāse 'tha vṛṣaṃ pūrṇāṅgamuttamam //
meaning:
व्रतं सुविपुलं पुण्यं नन्दिना परिभाषितम्
मार्गशीर्षकमासे ऽथ वृषं पूर्णाङ्गमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
The very extensive and meritorious observance spoken of by Nandin:
Then, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, having an excellent bull with all limbs complete,

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkṛtya yathānyāyaṃ śivāya vinivedayet
sā ca sārdhaṃ bhavānyā vai modate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अलंकृत्य यथान्यायं शिवाय विनिवेदयेत्
सा च सार्धं भवान्या वै मोदते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
adorned properly, she should present it to Śiva.
And she truly rejoices together with Bhavānī; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyamāse tu vai śūlaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nivedayet
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyā saha modate //
meaning:
पुष्यमासे तु वै शूलं प्रतिष्ठाप्य निवेदयेत्
पूर्वोक्तमखिलं कृत्वा भवान्या सह मोदते //
text_mt:
In the month of Puṣya, having consecrated and offered a trident,
and having done all that was previously mentioned, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse rathaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
dadyāt sampūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścaiva bhojayet //
meaning:
माघमासे रथं कृत्वा सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
दद्यात् सम्पूज्य देवेशं ब्राह्मणांश्चैव भोजयेत् //
text_mt:
In the month of Māgha, having fashioned a chariot endowed with every auspicious mark,
having worshipped the Lord of gods, she should give it away and feed the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca devyā mahābhāgā modate nātra saṃśayaḥ
phālgune pratimāṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyena yathāvidhi //
meaning:
सा च देव्या महाभागा मोदते नात्र संशयः
फाल्गुने प्रतिमां कृत्वा हिरण्येन यथाविधि //
text_mt:
And that fortunate woman rejoices with the Goddess; of this there is no doubt.
In Phālguna, having made an image out of gold according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
rājatenāpi tāmreṇa yathāvibhavavistaram
pratiṣṭhāpya samabhyarcya sthāpayecchaṅkarālaye //
meaning:
राजतेनापि ताम्रेण यथाविभवविस्तरम्
प्रतिष्ठाप्य समभ्यर्च्य स्थापयेच्छङ्करालये //
text_mt:
or of silver or copper, according to the extent of one's wealth,
consecrating and properly worshipping it, she should establish it in a temple of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca sārdhaṃ mahādevyā modate nātra saṃśayaḥ
caitre bhavaṃ kumāraṃ ca bhavānīṃ ca yathāvidhi //
meaning:
सा च सार्धं महादेव्या मोदते नात्र संशयः
चैत्रे भवं कुमारं च भवानीं च यथाविधि //
text_mt:
And she rejoices together with the Great Goddess; of this there is no doubt.
In Caitra, [having fashioned images of] Bhava, Kumāra, and Bhavānī according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrādyairvidhivatkṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi
bhavānyā modate sārdhaṃ dattvā rudrāya śaṃbhave //
meaning:
ताम्राद्यैर्विधिवत्कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि
भवान्या मोदते सार्धं दत्त्वा रुद्राय शंभवे //
text_mt:
duly made from copper and other [metals] and consecrated properly,
having given them to Rudra Śambhu, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvālayaṃ hi kauberaṃ rājataṃ rajatena vai
īśvaromāsamāyuktaṃ gaṇeśaiś ca samantataḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वालयं हि कौबेरं राजतं रजतेन वै
ईश्वरोमासमायुक्तं गणेशैश् च समन्ततः //
text_mt:
Having made a Kuveran abode of silver, indeed of silver,
accompanied by Īśvara and Umā, and surrounded on all sides by the lords of the Gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi
sthāpayetparameśasya bhavasyāyatane śubhe //
meaning:
सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तं प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि
स्थापयेत्परमेशस्य भवस्यायतने शुभे //
text_mt:
furnished with all kinds of jewels, consecrated according to rule,
she should install it in the auspicious temple of Bhava, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhe vai cared evaṃ kailāsākhyaṃ vratottamam
kailāsaparvataṃ prāpya bhavānyā saha modate //
meaning:
वैशाखे वै चरेद् एवं कैलासाख्यं व्रतोत्तमम्
कैलासपर्वतं प्राप्य भवान्या सह मोदते //
text_mt:
In Vaiśākha, one should thus perform this best of observances called Kailāsa;
reaching Mount Kailāsa, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe māsi mahādevaṃ liṅgamūrtimumāpatim
kṛtāñjalipuṭenaiva brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे मासि महादेवं लिङ्गमूर्तिमुमापतिम्
कृताञ्जलिपुटेनैव ब्रह्मणा विष्णुना तथा //
text_mt:
In the month of Jyeṣṭha, [making an auspicious image of] Mahādeva, the lord of Umā whose form is the liṅga,
along with Brahmā and Viṣṇu having their hands joined in reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
madhye bhavena saṃyuktaṃ liṅgamūrti dvijottamāḥ
haṃsena ca varāheṇa kṛtvā tāmrādibhiḥ śubhām //
meaning:
मध्ये भवेन संयुक्तं लिङ्गमूर्ति द्विजोत्तमाः
हंसेन च वराहेण कृत्वा ताम्रादिभिः शुभाम् //
text_mt:
joined with Bhava in the middle, O best of the twice-born,
and having fashioned the auspicious liṅga-form with the swan and the boar out of copper and other metals,

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ
śivāya śivamāsādya śivasthāne yathāvidhi //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत्ततः
शिवाय शिवमासाद्य शिवस्थाने यथाविधि //
text_mt:
consecrating it properly, she should then feed the brahmins.
Approaching Śiva for the sake of Śiva, in a place sacred to Śiva, according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitāṃ sthāpya devyāḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt
āṣāḍhe ca śubhe māse gṛhaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणैः सहितां स्थाप्य देव्याः सायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
आषाढे च शुभे मासे गृहं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् //
text_mt:
installing it together with the brahmins, she attains union with the Goddess.
And in the auspicious month of Āṣāḍha, having built a beautiful house

sanskrit_iast:
pakveṣṭakābhir vidhivad yathāvibhavavistaram
sarvabījarasaiścāpi sampūrṇaṃ sarvaśobhanaiḥ //
meaning:
पक्वेष्टकाभिर् विधिवद् यथाविभवविस्तरम्
सर्वबीजरसैश्चापि सम्पूर्णं सर्वशोभनैः //
text_mt:
with baked bricks according to rule, matching the extent of one's wealth,
filled also with all seeds and juices, possessing all lovely things,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhopakaraṇaiścaiva musalolūkhalādibhiḥ
dāsīdāsādibhiścaiva śayanairaśanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
गृहोपकरणैश्चैव मुसलोलूखलादिभिः
दासीदासादिभिश्चैव शयनैरशनादिभिः //
text_mt:
furnished with household utensils such as pestles and mortars,
with female and male servants, with beds, food, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
sampūrṇaiś ca gṛhaṃ vastrair ācchādya ca samantataḥ
devaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ snāpya mahādevamumāpatim //
meaning:
सम्पूर्णैश् च गृहं वस्त्रैर् आच्छाद्य च समन्ततः
देवं घृतादिभिः स्नाप्य महादेवमुमापतिम् //
text_mt:
and covering the fully-equipped house completely on all sides with cloths,
having bathed the god, Mahādeva, the lord of Umā, with ghee and other substances,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayitvā yathāvidhi
vidyāvinayasampannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां सहस्रं च भोजयित्वा यथाविधि
विद्याविनयसम्पन्नं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् //
text_mt:
and having fed a thousand brahmins according to rule,
[and having found] a brahmin endowed with learning and modesty, who has mastered the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
prathamāśramiṇaṃ bhaktyā sampūjya ca yathāvidhi
kanyāṃ sumadhyamāṃ yāvat kālajīvanasaṃyutām //
meaning:
प्रथमाश्रमिणं भक्त्या सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि
कन्यां सुमध्यमां यावत् कालजीवनसंयुताम् //
text_mt:
and is in the first stage of life, having worshipped him with devotion according to rule,
[and given him] a slender-waisted maiden who has means of living for a lifetime,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ gomithunaṃ caiva tadgṛhe ca nivedayet
sāyanair vividhair divyair meruparvatasannibhaiḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रं गोमिथुनं चैव तद्गृहे च निवेदयेत्
सायनैर् विविधैर् दिव्यैर् मेरुपर्वतसन्निभैः //
text_mt:
she should offer in that house a field, a pair of cattle,
and various divine couch-beds resembling Mount Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
golokaṃ samanuprāpya bhavānyā saha modate
bhavānyā sadṛśībhūtvā sarvakalpeṣu sāvyayā //
meaning:
गोलोकं समनुप्राप्य भवान्या सह मोदते
भवान्या सदृशीभूत्वा सर्वकल्पेषु साव्यया //
text_mt:
Having attained Goloka, she rejoices with Bhavānī.
Becoming equal to Bhavānī in all kalpas, imperishable,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānyāścaiva sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
sarvadhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam //
meaning:
भवान्याश्चैव सायुज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः
सर्वधातुसमाकीर्णं विचित्रध्वजशोभितम् //
text_mt:
she attains union with Bhavānī; of this there is no doubt.
Filled with all minerals and adorned with varied banners,

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayīta śarvāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam
vitānadhvajavastrādyair dhātubhiś ca nivedayet //
meaning:
निवेदयीत शर्वाय श्रावणे तिलपर्वतम्
वितानध्वजवस्त्राद्यैर् धातुभिश् च निवेदयेत् //
text_mt:
she should offer a mountain of sesame seeds to Śarva in Śrāvaṇa;
she should offer it with canopies, banners, cloths, and minerals.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca pūrvoktamakhilaṃ bhavet
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi śobhanaṃ śāliparvatam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च पूर्वोक्तमखिलं भवेत्
कृत्वा भाद्रपदे मासि शोभनं शालिपर्वतम् //
text_mt:
And having fed the brahmins, everything previously mentioned shall come to pass.
Having made a splendid mountain of rice in the month of Bhādrapada,

sanskrit_iast:
vitānadhvajavastrādyair dhātubhiś ca nivedayet
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca dāpayecca yathāvidhi //
meaning:
वितानध्वजवस्त्राद्यैर् धातुभिश् च निवेदयेत्
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च दापयेच्च यथाविधि //
text_mt:
she should present it with canopies, banners, cloths, and minerals.
Having fed the brahmins, she should also cause it to be given away according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca sūryāṃśusaṃkāśā bhavānyā saha modate
kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam //
meaning:
सा च सूर्यांशुसंकाशा भवान्या सह मोदते
कृत्वा चाश्वयुजे मासि विपुलं धान्यपर्वतम् //
text_mt:
And she, radiant as a sunbeam, rejoices with Bhavānī.
Having fashioned an abundant mountain of grain in the month of Āśvayuja,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ dattvā sampūjya śaṅkaram
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca pūrvoktamakhilaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
सुवर्णवस्त्रसंयुक्तं दत्त्वा सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च पूर्वोक्तमखिलं भवेत् //
text_mt:
furnished with gold and garments, having given it after worshipping Śaṅkara,
and having fed the brahmins, everything previously mentioned shall come to pass.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadhānyasamāyuktaṃ sarvabījarasādibhiḥ
sarvadhātusamāyuktaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam //
meaning:
सर्वधान्यसमायुक्तं सर्वबीजरसादिभिः
सर्वधातुसमायुक्तं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम् //
text_mt:
[A mountain] endowed with all grains, with all seeds, juices, and the like,
endowed with all minerals, adorned with all jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vitānacchatraśobhitam
gandhamālyais tathā dhūpaiś citraiścāpi suśobhitam //
meaning:
शृङ्गैश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तं वितानच्छत्रशोभितम्
गन्धमाल्यैस् तथा धूपैश् चित्रैश्चापि सुशोभितम् //
text_mt:
furnished with four peaks, adorned with canopies and parasols,
and beautifully decorated with perfumes, garlands, and varied incense,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrairnṛtyageyaiś ca śaṅkhavīṇādibhis tathā
brahmaghoṣairmahāpuṇyaṃ maṅgalaiś ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
विचित्रैर्नृत्यगेयैश् च शङ्खवीणादिभिस् तथा
ब्रह्मघोषैर्महापुण्यं मङ्गलैश् च विशेषतः //
text_mt:
accompanied by varied dances and songs, by conches, vīṇās, and the like,
and especially made most meritorious by the chanting of the Vedas and auspicious sounds,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādhvajāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalam
nagendraṃ merunāmānaṃ trailokyādhāramuttamam //
meaning:
महाध्वजाष्टसंयुक्तं विचित्रकुसुमोज्ज्वलम्
नगेन्द्रं मेरुनामानं त्रैलोक्याधारमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
furnished with eight great banners, radiant with variegated flowers,
[representing] the king of mountains named Meru, the excellent foundation of the three worlds—

sanskrit_iast:
tasya mūrdhni śivaṃ kuryān madhyato dhātunaiva tu
dakṣiṇe ca yathānyāyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca caturmukham //
meaning:
तस्य मूर्ध्नि शिवं कुर्यान् मध्यतो धातुनैव तु
दक्षिणे च यथान्यायं ब्रह्माणं च चतुर्मुखम् //
text_mt:
on its summit she should place Śiva made of mineral in the middle,
and on the south, properly, the four-faced Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
uttare devadeveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
indrādilokapālāṃś ca kṛtvā bhaktyā yathāvidhi //
meaning:
उत्तरे देवदेवेशं नारायणमनामयम्
इन्द्रादिलोकपालांश् च कृत्वा भक्त्या यथाविधि //
text_mt:
on the north Nārāyaṇa, the flawless Lord of the lords of the gods;
and having fashioned the world-protectors headed by Indra with devotion according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāpya tataḥ snāpya samabhyarcya maheśvaram
devasya dakṣiṇe haste śūlaṃ tridaśapūjitam //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततः स्नाप्य समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्
देवस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते शूलं त्रिदशपूजितम् //
text_mt:
and consecrated them, then having bathed and worshipped Maheśvara,
[she should place] in the right hand of the god the trident worshipped by the thirty [gods],

sanskrit_iast:
vāme pāśaṃ bhavānyāś ca kamalaṃ hemabhūṣitam
viṣṇoś ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca gadāmabjaṃ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
वामे पाशं भवान्याश् च कमलं हेमभूषितम्
विष्णोश् च शङ्खं चक्रं च गदामब्जं प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt:
and in the left a noose; and Bhavānī's lotus adorned with gold;
and diligently [fashion] Viṣṇu's conch, discus, mace, and lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaścākṣasūtraṃ ca kamaṇḍalumanuttamam
indrasya vajram agneś ca śaktyākhyaṃ paramāyudham //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणश्चाक्षसूत्रं च कमण्डलुमनुत्तमम्
इन्द्रस्य वज्रम् अग्नेश् च शक्त्याख्यं परमायुधम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā's rosary and peerless water-pot,
Indra's thunderbolt, and Agni's supreme weapon named the spear,

sanskrit_iast:
yamasya daṇḍaṃ nirṛteḥ khaḍgaṃ niśicarasya tu
varuṇasya mahāpāśaṃ nāgākhyaṃ rudramadbhutam //
meaning:
यमस्य दण्डं निरृतेः खड्गं निशिचरस्य तु
वरुणस्य महापाशं नागाख्यं रुद्रमद्भुतम् //
text_mt:
Yama's staff, Nirṛti the demon's sword,
Varuṇa's great wonder-working Rudra-noose known as the serpent,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyor yaṣṭiṃ kuberasya gadāṃ lokaprapūjitām
ṭaṅkaṃ ceśānadevasya nivedyaivaṃ krameṇa ca //
meaning:
वायोर् यष्टिं कुबेरस्य गदां लोकप्रपूजिताम्
टङ्कं चेशानदेवस्य निवेद्यैवं क्रमेण च //
text_mt:
Vāyu's staff, Kubera's mace revered by the world,
and the chisel of the god Īśāna; having thus offered these in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā carusamanvitām
pūjayetsarvadevāṃś ca yathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
शिवस्य महतीं पूजां कृत्वा चरुसमन्विताम्
पूजयेत्सर्वदेवांश् च यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt:
and having performed a grand worship of Śiva accompanied by an oblation of boiled rice,
she should worship all the deities according to the extent of her wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ
mahāmeruvrataṃ kṛtvā mahādevāya dāpayet //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा च पूजां कृत्वा प्रयत्नतः
महामेरुव्रतं कृत्वा महादेवाय दापयेत् //
text_mt:
And having fed the brahmins, and having performed the worship with diligence,
having completed the Mahāmeru observance, she should give it to Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmerumanuprāpya mahādevyā pramodate
ciraṃ sāyujyam āpnoti mahādevyā na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
महामेरुमनुप्राप्य महादेव्या प्रमोदते
चिरं सायुज्यम् आप्नोति महादेव्या न संशयः //
text_mt:
Attaining Mahāmeru, she rejoices with the Great Goddess;
she attains lasting union with the Great Goddess; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikyāmapi yā nārī kṛtvā devīmumāṃ śubhām
sarvābharaṇasampūrṇāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām //
meaning:
कार्तिक्यामपि या नारी कृत्वा देवीमुमां शुभाम्
सर्वाभरणसम्पूर्णां सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम् //
text_mt:
And that woman who, on the full moon day of Kārttika, having fashioned the auspicious goddess Umā,
complete with all ornaments and marked with every auspicious sign,

sanskrit_iast:
hematāmrādibhiścaiva pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānataḥ
devaṃ ca kṛtvā deveśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam //
meaning:
हेमताम्रादिभिश्चैव प्रतिष्ठाप्य विधानतः
देवं च कृत्वा देवेशं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
out of gold, copper, and other materials, and consecrating it according to rule,
and having made the god, the Lord of gods, endowed with all auspicious characteristics,

sanskrit_iast:
tayoragre hutāśaṃ ca sruvahastaṃ pitāmaham
nārāyaṇaṃ ca dātāraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam //
meaning:
तयोरग्रे हुताशं च स्रुवहस्तं पितामहम्
नारायणं च दातारं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् //
text_mt:
and before the two of them Hutāśa (Agni), and Pitāmaha with a sacrificial ladle in his hand,
and Nārāyaṇa the giver, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālais tathā siddhaiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ sthāpya yatnataḥ
rudrālaye vrataṃ tasmai dāpayedbhaktipūrvakam //
meaning:
लोकपालैस् तथा सिद्धैः संवृतं स्थाप्य यत्नतः
रुद्रालये व्रतं तस्मै दापयेद्भक्तिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt:
surrounded by the world-protectors and Siddhas, carefully installing them,
should offer the observance to him in the temple of Rudra with devotion—

sanskrit_iast:
sā bhavānyāstanuṃ gatvā bhavena saha modate
ekabhaktavrataṃ puṇyaṃ pratimāsamanukramāt //
meaning:
सा भवान्यास्तनुं गत्वा भवेन सह मोदते
एकभक्तव्रतं पुण्यं प्रतिमासमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt:
she, having attained Bhavānī's form, rejoices with Bhava.
This meritorious single-meal observance, month by month in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣakamāsādikārtikāntaṃ pravartitam
naranāryādijantūnāṃ hitāya munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षकमासादिकार्तिकान्तं प्रवर्तितम्
नरनार्यादिजन्तूनां हिताय मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt:
commencing with the month of Mārgaśīrṣa and ending with Kārttika, has been set forth
for the welfare of living beings such as men and women, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
naraḥ kṛtvā vrataṃ caiva śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
nārī devyā na saṃdehaḥ śivena paribhāṣitam //
meaning:
नरः कृत्वा व्रतं चैव शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
नारी देव्या न संदेहः शिवेन परिभाषितम् //
text_mt: A man who performs this observance attains union with Śiva, / and a woman with the Goddess, without doubt; this was declared by Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
sarvavrateṣu sampūjya devadevamumāpatim
japetpañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vidhinaiva dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
सर्वव्रतेषु सम्पूज्य देवदेवमुमापतिम्
जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यां विधिनैव द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / In all observances, having worshipped the god of gods, the lord of Umā, / one should repeat the five-syllable formula according to the rules, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
japādeva na saṃdeho vratānāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ
samāptirnānyathā tasmāj japetpañcākṣarīṃ śubhām //
meaning:
जपादेव न संदेहो व्रतानां वै विशेषतः
समाप्तिर्नान्यथा तस्माज् जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरीं शुभाम् //
text_mt: Only from repetition, without doubt, does the completion of observances especially come about, / not otherwise; therefore one should repeat the auspicious five-syllable formula.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ pañcākṣarī vidyā prabhāvo vā kathaṃ vada
kramopāyaṃ mahābhāga śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं पञ्चाक्षरी विद्या प्रभावो वा कथं वद
क्रमोपायं महाभाग श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः //
text_mt: The sages said: / How is the five-syllable formula [constituted], or how is its power? Speak! / We are eager to hear the method of procedure, O fortunate one.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
purā devena rudreṇa devadevena śaṃbhunā
pārvatyāḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
पुरा देवेन रुद्रेण देवदेवेन शंभुना
पार्वत्याः कथितं पुण्यं प्रवदामि समासतः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / What was told of old to Pārvatī by the god Rudra, / the god of gods, Śaṃbhu, that holy [matter] I shall tell in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyuvāca
bhagavandevadeveśa sarvalokamaheśvara
pañcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ //
meaning:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
भगवन्देवदेवेश सर्वलोकमहेश्वर
पञ्चाक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः //
text_mt: The glorious Goddess said: / O Blessed One, lord of the god of gods, Maheśvara of all the worlds! / I wish to hear in truth the majesty of the five-syllable formula.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
pañcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi
na śakyaṃ kathituṃ devi tasmāt saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
पञ्चाक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि
न शक्यं कथितुं देवि तस्मात् संक्षेपतः शृणु //
text_mt: The Blessed One said: / The majesty of the five-syllable formula, even in hundreds of crores of years, / cannot be told, O goddess; therefore hear it in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
pralaye samanuprāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
naṣṭe devāsure caiva naṣṭe coragarākṣase //
meaning:
प्रलये समनुप्राप्ते नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे
नष्टे देवासुरे चैव नष्टे चोरगराक्षसे //
text_mt: When cosmic dissolution arrived and the stationary and moving perished, / and the gods and asuras perished, and the serpents and rākṣasas perished,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ prakṛtimāpannaṃ tvayā pralayameṣyati
eko 'haṃ saṃsthito devi na dvitīyo 'sti kutracit //
meaning:
सर्वं प्रकृतिमापन्नं त्वया प्रलयमेष्यति
एको ऽहं संस्थितो देवि न द्वितीयो ऽस्ति कुत्रचित् //
text_mt: when everything dissolved into Prakṛti together with you, / I alone remained, O goddess; there was no second anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminvedāś ca śāstrāṇi mantre pañcākṣare sthitāḥ
te nāśaṃ naiva samprāptā macchaktyā hyanupālitāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्वेदाश् च शास्त्राणि मन्त्रे पञ्चाक्षरे स्थिताः
ते नाशं नैव सम्प्राप्ता मच्छक्त्या ह्यनुपालिताः //
text_mt: In it—in that five-syllable mantra—the Vedas and śāstras were situated; / they suffered no destruction at all, preserved by my power.

sanskrit_iast:
ahameko dvidhāpyāsaṃ prakṛtyātmaprabhedataḥ
sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ śete devo māyāmayīṃ tanum //
meaning:
अहमेको द्विधाप्यासं प्रकृत्यात्मप्रभेदतः
स तु नारायणः शेते देवो मायामयीं तनुम् //
text_mt: Though one, I became two through the division of Prakṛti and the Self; / and that Nārāyaṇa, the god, lies down in a body composed of māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāya yogaparyaṅkaśayane toyamadhyagaḥ
tannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
आस्थाय योगपर्यङ्कशयने तोयमध्यगः
तन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः //
text_mt: Having reclined on the couch of yoga, amidst the waters, / Pitāmaha was born from the lotus of his navel, five-faced.

sanskrit_iast:
sisṛkṣamāṇo lokānvai trīnaśakto 'sahāyavān
daśa brahmā sasarjādau mānasānamitaujasaḥ //
meaning:
सिसृक्षमाणो लोकान्वै त्रीनशक्तो ऽसहायवान्
दश ब्रह्मा ससर्जादौ मानसानमितौजसः //
text_mt: Desiring to create the three worlds, [yet] unable, being without helper, / Brahmā first created ten mind-born [sons] of boundless splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiprasiddhyarthaṃ māṃ provāca pitāmahaḥ
matputrāṇāṃ mahādeva śaktiṃ dehi maheśvara //
meaning:
तेषां सृष्टिप्रसिद्ध्यर्थं मां प्रोवाच पितामहः
मत्पुत्राणां महादेव शक्तिं देहि महेश्वर //
text_mt: For the accomplishment of their creation, Pitāmaha said to me: / “O Mahādeva, O Maheśvara, give power to my sons!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tena samādiṣṭaḥ pañcavaktradharo hyaham
pañcākṣarānpañcamukhaiḥ proktavān padmayonaye //
meaning:
इति तेन समादिष्टः पञ्चवक्त्रधरो ह्यहम्
पञ्चाक्षरान्पञ्चमुखैः प्रोक्तवान् पद्मयोनये //
text_mt: Thus addressed by him, I, bearing five faces, / uttered the five syllables with my five mouths to the lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
tānpañcavadanairgṛhṇan brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
vācyavācakabhāvena jñātavānparameśvaram //
meaning:
तान्पञ्चवदनैर्गृह्णन् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः
वाच्यवाचकभावेन ज्ञातवान्परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Receiving them with his five faces, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / understood the Supreme Lord through the relationship of the expressed and the expressing.

sanskrit_iast:
vācyaḥ pañcākṣarairdevi śivastrailokyapūjitaḥ
vācakaḥ paramo mantras tasya pañcākṣaraḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
वाच्यः पञ्चाक्षरैर्देवि शिवस्त्रैलोक्यपूजितः
वाचकः परमो मन्त्रस् तस्य पञ्चाक्षरः स्थितः //
text_mt: The expressed, O goddess, through the five syllables, is Śiva, worshipped by the three worlds; / the supreme expressing mantra of his is established as the five syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā prayogaṃ vidhinā ca siddhiṃ labdhvā tathā pañcamukho mahātmā
provāca putreṣu jagaddhitāya mantraṃ mahārthaṃ kila pañcavarṇam //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा प्रयोगं विधिना च सिद्धिं लब्ध्वा तथा पञ्चमुखो महात्मा
प्रोवाच पुत्रेषु जगद्धिताय मन्त्रं महार्थं किल पञ्चवर्णम् //
text_mt: Knowing its application according to rule and having attained perfection, the five-faced, great-souled one / taught the mantra of great meaning, consisting indeed of five letters, to his sons for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
te labdhvā mantraratnaṃ tu sākṣāllokapitāmahāt
tamārādhayituṃ devaṃ parātparataraṃ śivam //
meaning:
ते लब्ध्वा मन्त्ररत्नं तु साक्षाल्लोकपितामहात्
तमाराधयितुं देवं परात्परतरं शिवम् //
text_mt: Having received that jewel of a mantra directly from the grandfather of the worlds, / in order to worship that god, Śiva, who is higher than the highest,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastutoṣa bhagavān trimūrtīnāṃ paraḥ śivaḥ
dattavānakhilaṃ jñānam aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam //
meaning:
ततस्तुतोष भगवान् त्रिमूर्तीनां परः शिवः
दत्तवानखिलं ज्ञानम् अणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् //
text_mt: then the Blessed One, Śiva, who is beyond the three forms, was pleased; / he bestowed all knowledge and the eight attributes beginning with anima.

sanskrit_iast:
te 'pi labdhvā varānviprās tadārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
merostu śikhare ramye muñjavānnāma parvataḥ //
meaning:
ते ऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्विप्रास् तदाराधनकाङ्क्षिणः
मेरोस्तु शिखरे रम्ये मुञ्जवान्नाम पर्वतः //
text_mt: Having received those boons, those Brahmins, desiring to worship him, / [went] to the delightful summit of Meru, where there is a mountain named Muñjavant,

sanskrit_iast:
matpriyaḥ satataṃ śrīmān madbhūtaiḥ parirakṣitaḥ
tasyābhyāśe tapastīvraṃ lokasṛṣṭisamutsukāḥ //
meaning:
मत्प्रियः सततं श्रीमान् मद्भूतैः परिरक्षितः
तस्याभ्याशे तपस्तीव्रं लोकसृष्टिसमुत्सुकाः //
text_mt: ever dear to me, glorious, and protected by my bhūtas. / Near it, eager to create the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu vāyubhakṣāḥ samācaran
tiṣṭhanto 'nugrahārthāya devi te ṛṣayaḥ purā //
meaning:
दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं तु वायुभक्षाः समाचरन्
तिष्ठन्तो ऽनुग्रहार्थाय देवि ते ऋषयः पुरा //
text_mt: those sages of old performed severe asceticism for a thousand divine years, / feeding on air, remaining steadfast for the sake of grace, O goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ bhaktimahaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ pratyakṣatāmiyām
pañcākṣaram ṛṣicchando daivataṃ śaktibījavat //
meaning:
तेषां भक्तिमहं दृष्ट्वा सद्यः प्रत्यक्षतामियाम्
पञ्चाक्षरम् ऋषिच्छन्दो दैवतं शक्तिबीजवत् //
text_mt: Seeing their devotion, I instantly became visible [to them]; / the five-syllable mantra, along with its seer, metre, deity, power, and seed-syllable,

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ digbandhaṃ viniyogamaśeṣataḥ
proktavānahamāryāṇāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
न्यासं षडङ्गं दिग्बन्धं विनियोगमशेषतः
प्रोक्तवानहमार्याणां लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: the ritual placement, the six auxiliary limbs, the sealing of the directions, and the application in full / I taught, wishing for the welfare of the noble worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā mantramāhātmyam ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ
mantrasya viniyogaṃ ca kṛtvā sarvamanuṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रमाहात्म्यम् ऋषयस्ते तपोधनाः
मन्त्रस्य विनियोगं च कृत्वा सर्वमनुष्ठिताः //
text_mt: Having heard the majesty of the mantra, those sages rich in asceticism, / having performed the application of the mantra, accomplished everything.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmāhātmyāt tadā lokān sadevāsuramānuṣān
varṇānvarṇavibhāgāṃś ca sarvadharmāṃś ca śobhanān //
meaning:
तन्माहात्म्यात् तदा लोकान् सदेवासुरमानुषान्
वर्णान्वर्णविभागांश् च सर्वधर्मांश् च शोभनान् //
text_mt: From its majesty, [they brought forth] then the worlds together with the gods, asuras, and humans, / the classes, the divisions of classes, and all the auspicious duties,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvakalpasamudbhūtāñ chrutavanto yathā purā
pañcākṣaraprabhāvācca lokā vedā maharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वकल्पसमुद्भूताञ् छ्रुतवन्तो यथा पुरा
पञ्चाक्षरप्रभावाच्च लोका वेदा महर्षयः //
text_mt: having heard [them] just as they were produced in the previous kalpa of old. / And through the power of the five syllables, the worlds, the Vedas, the great sages,

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanti śāśvatā dharmā devāḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat
tad idānīṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu cāvahitākhilam //
meaning:
तिष्ठन्ति शाश्वता धर्मा देवाः सर्वमिदं जगत्
तद् इदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु चावहिताखिलम् //
text_mt: the eternal dharmas, the gods, and all this universe endure. / That I shall now proclaim in full; listen attentively:

sanskrit_iast:
alpākṣaraṃ mahārthaṃ ca vedasāraṃ vimuktidam
ājñāsiddhamasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametacchivātmakam //
meaning:
अल्पाक्षरं महार्थं च वेदसारं विमुक्तिदम्
आज्ञासिद्धमसंदिग्धं वाक्यमेतच्छिवात्मकम् //
text_mt: With few syllables and of great meaning, the essence of the Veda, bestowing liberation, / accomplished by command, free from doubt, this speech is of the nature of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāsiddhiyutaṃ divyaṃ lokacittānurañjakam
suniścitārthaṃ gaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ me pārameśvaram //
meaning:
नानासिद्धियुतं दिव्यं लोकचित्तानुरञ्जकम्
सुनिश्चितार्थं गंभीरं वाक्यं मे पारमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: endowed with various perfections, divine, delighting the minds of people, / of well-determined meaning, profound—my supreme sovereign word,

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ mukhasukhoccāryam aśeṣārthaprasādhakam
tadbījaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ mantramādyaṃ suśobhanam //
meaning:
मन्त्रं मुखसुखोच्चार्यम् अशेषार्थप्रसाधकम्
तद्बीजं सर्वविद्यानां मन्त्रमाद्यं सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: a mantra easy to utter with the mouth, accomplishing all ends, / that seed of all Vidyās, the primeval, most auspicious mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
atisūkṣmaṃ mahārthaṃ ca jñeyaṃ tadvaṭabījavat
vedaḥ sa triguṇātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛtprabhuḥ //
meaning:
अतिसूक्ष्मं महार्थं च ज्ञेयं तद्वटबीजवत्
वेदः स त्रिगुणातीतः सर्वज्ञः सर्वकृत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: Very subtle and of great meaning, it should be known like a banyan seed; / it is the Veda, beyond the three guṇas, omniscient, the lord who creates all.

sanskrit_iast:
omityekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ sthitaḥ sarvagataḥ śivaḥ
mantre ṣaḍakṣare sūkṣme pañcākṣaratanuḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं मन्त्रं स्थितः सर्वगतः शिवः
मन्त्रे षडक्षरे सूक्ष्मे पञ्चाक्षरतनुः शिवः //
text_mt: Śiva is situated as all-pervading in the single-syllable mantra 'Om'; / in the subtle six-syllable mantra, Śiva has the five syllables as his body.

sanskrit_iast:
vācyavācakabhāvena sthitaḥ sākṣātsvabhāvataḥ
vācyaḥ śivaḥ prameyatvān mantrastadvācakaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
वाच्यवाचकभावेन स्थितः साक्षात्स्वभावतः
वाच्यः शिवः प्रमेयत्वान् मन्त्रस्तद्वाचकः स्मृतः //
text_mt: He is directly present by nature through the relationship of the expressed and the expressing; / Śiva is the expressed because he is the object of knowledge; the mantra is handed down as his expressing [word].

sanskrit_iast:
vācyavācakabhāvo 'yam anādiḥ saṃsthitastayoḥ
vede śivāgame vāpi yatra yatra ṣaḍakṣaraḥ //
meaning:
वाच्यवाचकभावो ऽयम् अनादिः संस्थितस्तयोः
वेदे शिवागमे वापि यत्र यत्र षडक्षरः //
text_mt: This relation of the expressed and the expressing between the two is beginningless; / in the Veda or in the Śiva-āgama, wherever the six syllables [are],

sanskrit_iast:
mantraḥ sthitaḥ sadā mukhyo loke pañcākṣaro mataḥ
kiṃ tasya bahubhir mantraiḥ śāstrairvā bahuvistṛtaiḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रः स्थितः सदा मुख्यो लोके पञ्चाक्षरो मतः
किं तस्य बहुभिर् मन्त्रैः शास्त्रैर्वा बहुविस्तृतैः //
text_mt: the mantra is always prominent; in the world it is regarded as having five syllables. / What use to him are many mantras or extensive treatises,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyaivaṃ hṛdi saṃstho 'yaṃ mantraḥ syātpārameśvaraḥ
tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam //
meaning:
यस्यैवं हृदि संस्थो ऽयं मन्त्रः स्यात्पारमेश्वरः
तेनाधीतं श्रुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम् //
text_mt: in whose heart this sovereign mantra of the Supreme Lord resides? / By him [all] has been studied, by him heard, by him all has been performed.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vidvānvai japetsamyag adhītyaiva vidhānataḥ
etāvaddhi śivajñānam etāvatparamaṃ padam //
meaning:
यो विद्वान्वै जपेत्सम्यग् अधीत्यैव विधानतः
एतावद्धि शिवज्ञानम् एतावत्परमं पदम् //
text_mt: The wise man who properly repeats it, having studied it according to rule— / just this is the knowledge of Śiva; just this is the supreme abode;

sanskrit_iast:
etāvad brahmavidyā ca tasmānnityaṃ japedbudhaḥ
pañcākṣaraiḥ sapraṇavo mantro 'yaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama //
meaning:
एतावद् ब्रह्मविद्या च तस्मान्नित्यं जपेद्बुधः
पञ्चाक्षरैः सप्रणवो मन्त्रो ऽयं हृदयं मम //
text_mt: just this is the knowledge of Brahman; therefore the wise man should repeat it daily. / This mantra of five syllables together with the Praṇava is my heart,

sanskrit_iast:
guhyādguhyataraṃ sākṣān mokṣajñānam anuttamam
asya mantrasya vakṣyāmi ṛṣicchando 'dhidaivatam //
meaning:
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं साक्षान् मोक्षज्ञानम् अनुत्तमम्
अस्य मन्त्रस्य वक्ष्यामि ऋषिच्छन्दो ऽधिदैवतम् //
text_mt: more secret than the secret, the unexcelled knowledge of liberation itself. / I shall declare this mantra’s seer, metre, presiding deity,

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ śaktiṃ svaraṃ varṇaṃ sthānaṃ caivākṣaraṃ prati
vāmadevo nāma ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
बीजं शक्तिं स्वरं वर्णं स्थानं चैवाक्षरं प्रति
वामदेवो नाम ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतः //
text_mt: seed-syllable, power, tone, colour, and place, syllable by syllable: / Vāmadeva is named as its seer; the metre is declared to be Paṅkti;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā śiva evāhaṃ mantrasyāsya varānane
nakārādīni bījāni pañcabhūtātmakāni ca //
meaning:
देवता शिव एवाहं मन्त्रस्यास्य वरानने
नकारादीनि बीजानि पञ्चभूतात्मकानि च //
text_mt: the deity of this mantra is none other than I, Śiva, O fair-faced one; / the seed-syllables are those beginning with 'na', and they consist of the five elements.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ praṇavaṃ viddhi sarvavyāpinamavyayam
śaktistvameva deveśi sarvadevanamaskṛte //
meaning:
आत्मानं प्रणवं विद्धि सर्वव्यापिनमव्ययम्
शक्तिस्त्वमेव देवेशि सर्वदेवनमस्कृते //
