savyañjano makārastu svarloka iti gīyate //
meaning:
अकारस् त्वेष भूर्लोक उकारो भुव उच्यते
सव्यञ्जनो मकारस्तु स्वर्लोक इति गीयते //
text_mt:
The letter ‘A’ is the earth-world; the letter ‘U’ is called the intermediate realm;
and the letter ‘M’ along with its consonant is sung of as the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārastu trayo lokāḥ śirastasya triviṣṭapam
bhuvanāṅgaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṃ tatpadamucyate //
meaning:
ओङ्कारस्तु त्रयो लोकाः शिरस्तस्य त्रिविष्टपम्
भुवनाङ्गं च तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मं तत्पदमुच्यते //
text_mt:
The syllable Oṃ is the three worlds; its head is heaven;
and all that is the body of the universe is called that state of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrāpādo rudraloko hy amātraṃ tu śivaṃ padam
evaṃ jñānaviśeṣeṇa tatpadaṃ samupāsyate //
meaning:
मात्रापादो रुद्रलोको ह्य् अमात्रं तु शिवं पदम्
एवं ज्ञानविशेषेण तत्पदं समुपास्यते //
text_mt:
The quarter of a mora is the world of Rudra, but the mora-less is the state of Śiva;
thus, through the excellence of knowledge, that state is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddhyānaratirnityam amātraṃ hi tadakṣaram
upāsyaṃ hi prayatnena śāśvataṃ sukhamicchatā //
meaning:
तस्माद्ध्यानरतिर्नित्यम् अमात्रं हि तदक्षरम्
उपास्यं हि प्रयत्नेन शाश्वतं सुखमिच्छता //
text_mt:
Therefore, with constant delight in meditation, that mora-less imperishable
should indeed be worshipped with effort by one desiring eternal happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvā tu prathamā mātrā tato dīrghā tvanantaram
tataḥ plutavatī caiva tṛtīyā copadiśyate //
meaning:
ह्रस्वा तु प्रथमा मात्रा ततो दीर्घा त्वनन्तरम्
ततः प्लुतवती चैव तृतीया चोपदिश्यते //
text_mt:
The first mora is short, then immediately after it is long,
and the third is taught as being protracted.

sanskrit_iast:
etāstu mātrā vijñeyā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ
yāvadeva tu śakyante dhāryante tāvadeva hi //
meaning:
एतास्तु मात्रा विज्ञेया यथावदनुपूर्वशः
यावदेव तु शक्यन्ते धार्यन्ते तावदेव हि //
text_mt:
These morae are to be known in due order as they are;
indeed, they are held for as long as they can be.

sanskrit_iast:
indriyāṇi mano buddhiṃ dhyāyannātmani yaḥ sadā
ardhaṃ tanmātram api cec chṛṇu yat phalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिं ध्यायन्नात्मनि यः सदा
अर्धं तन्मात्रम् अपि चेच् छृणु यत् फलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
He who, constantly meditating on the senses, mind, and intellect in the Self,
[meditates on] even half that mora—listen to what fruit he obtains:

sanskrit_iast:
māse māse 'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ
tena yatprāpyate puṇyaṃ mātrayā tadavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
मासे मासे ऽश्वमेधेन यो यजेत शतं समाः
तेन यत्प्राप्यते पुण्यं मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
the merit that is attained by one who would sacrifice month after month
with a horse sacrifice for a hundred years, that he obtains by a single mora.

sanskrit_iast:
na tathā tapasogreṇa na yajñairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ
yatphalaṃ prāpyate samyaṅ mātrayā tadavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
न तथा तपसोग्रेण न यज्ञैर्भूरिदक्षिणैः
यत्फलं प्राप्यते सम्यङ् मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Not by fierce asceticism, nor by sacrifices with lavish gifts / is that fruit attained which one may fully obtain by a single measure.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra caiṣā tu yā mātrā plutā nāmopadiśyate
eṣā eva bhavetkāryā gṛhasthānāṃ tu yoginām //
meaning:
तत्र चैषा तु या मात्रा प्लुता नामोपदिश्यते
एषा एव भवेत्कार्या गृहस्थानां तु योगिनाम् //
text_mt: And that measure which is taught there under the name of 'prolonged' (pluta) / should indeed be practised by householder yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa aiśvarye hyaṣṭalakṣaṇe
aṇimādye tu vijñeyā tasmādyuñjīta tāṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
एषां चैव विशेषेण ऐश्वर्ये ह्यष्टलक्षणे
अणिमाद्ये तु विज्ञेया तस्माद्युञ्जीत तां द्विजाः //
text_mt: And this [measure] is especially known to bring the eightfold supernatural mastery / beginning with minuteness (aṇiman); therefore let the twice-born join themselves to it.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi yogasaṃyuktaḥ śucir dānto jitendriyaḥ
ātmānaṃ vidyate yastu sa sarvaṃ vindate dvijāḥ //
meaning:
एवं हि योगसंयुक्तः शुचिर् दान्तो जितेन्द्रियः
आत्मानं विद्यते यस्तु स सर्वं विन्दते द्विजाः //
text_mt: Endowed thus with yoga, pure, self-controlled, and with senses conquered, / he who knows the Self finds all, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpāśupatairyogair ātmānaṃ cintayedbudhaḥ
ātmānaṃ jānate ye tu śucayaste na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्पाशुपतैर्योगैर् आत्मानं चिन्तयेद्बुधः
आत्मानं जानते ये तु शुचयस्ते न संशयः //
text_mt: Therefore the wise man should contemplate the Self through Pāśupata yogas; / those who know the Self are pure, no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni vedopaniṣadas tathā
yogajñānādavāpnoti brāhmaṇo 'dhyātmacintakaḥ //
meaning:
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि वेदोपनिषदस् तथा
योगज्ञानादवाप्नोति ब्राह्मणो ऽध्यात्मचिन्तकः //
text_mt: The Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma verses, and the Vedopaniṣads— / from the knowledge of yoga the brāhmaṇa contemplating the inner Self attains them all.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayo bhūtvā abhūtaḥ sa tu jāyate
yonisaṃkramaṇaṃ tyaktvā yāti vai śāśvataṃ padam //
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयो भूत्वा अभूतः स तु जायते
योनिसंक्रमणं त्यक्त्वा याति वै शाश्वतं पदम् //
text_mt: Consisting of all gods, he becomes unborn; / abandoning the cycle of wombs, he goes indeed to the eternal state.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vṛkṣāt phalaṃ pakvaṃ pavanena samīritam
namaskāreṇa rudrasya tathā pāpaṃ praṇaśyati //
meaning:
यथा वृक्षात् फलं पक्वं पवनेन समीरितम्
नमस्कारेण रुद्रस्य तथा पापं प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: Just as ripe fruit falls from a tree, shaken by the wind, / so through reverence to Rudra sin is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvaḥ
anyadevanamaskārān na tatphalamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
यत्र रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वकर्मफलो ध्रुवः
अन्यदेवनमस्कारान् न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Where reverence to Rudra unfailingly yields the fruit of all deeds, / one cannot obtain such fruit from reverence to other gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttriḥpravaṇaṃ yogī upāsīta maheśvaram
daśavistārakaṃ brahma tathā ca brahmavistaraiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्रिःप्रवणं योगी उपासीत महेश्वरम्
दशविस्तारकं ब्रह्म तथा च ब्रह्मविस्तरैः //
text_mt: Therefore the yogin should worship Maheśvara with three inclinations, / [and meditate upon] the tenfold-extended Brahman through the extensions of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyānasamāyuktaḥ svadehaṃ yaḥ parityajet
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ samuddhṛtya kulatrayam //
meaning:
एवं ध्यानसमायुक्तः स्वदेहं यः परित्यजेत्
स याति शिवसायुज्यं समुद्धृत्य कुलत्रयम् //
text_mt: Endowed thus with meditation, he who casts off his own body / goes to Śiva's union, having delivered three ancestral lines.

sanskrit_iast:
athavāriṣṭamālokya maraṇe samupasthite
avimukteśvaraṃ gatvā vārāṇasyāṃ tu śodhanam //
meaning:
अथवारिष्टमालोक्य मरणे समुपस्थिते
अविमुक्तेश्वरं गत्वा वाराणस्यां तु शोधनम् //
text_mt: Or, beholding omens of death when death is near at hand, / having gone to Avimukteśvara, the purifier in Vārāṇasī,

sanskrit_iast:
yena kenāpi vā dehaṃ saṃtyajen mucyate naraḥ
śrīparvate vā viprendrāḥ saṃtyajetsvatanuṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
येन केनापि वा देहं संत्यजेन् मुच्यते नरः
श्रीपर्वते वा विप्रेन्द्राः संत्यजेत्स्वतनुं नरः //
text_mt: abandoning the body by any means whatsoever, a man is liberated; / or on Śrīparvata, O best of the twice-born, a man should abandon his body.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
avimuktaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ jantūnāṃ muktidaṃ sadā //
meaning:
स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
अविमुक्तं परं क्षेत्रं जन्तूनां मुक्तिदं सदा //
text_mt: He goes to Śiva's union; no doubt should be entertained here. / Avimukta is the supreme site, ever granting liberation to living beings.

sanskrit_iast: seveta satataṃ dhīmān viśeṣānmaraṇāntike //
meaning: सेवेत सततं धीमान् विशेषान्मरणान्तिके //
text_mt: The wise man should resort to it constantly, especially when death is near.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
evaṃ vārāṇasī puṇyā yadi sūta mahāmate
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ tatprabhāvaṃ hi sāṃpratam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
एवं वाराणसी पुण्या यदि सूत महामते
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं तत्प्रभावं हि सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / If Vārāṇasī is thus holy, O noble-minded Sūta, / you ought now to tell us its power.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrasyāsya ca māhātmyam avimuktasya śobhanam
vistareṇa yathānyāyaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रस्यास्य च माहात्म्यम् अविमुक्तस्य शोभनम्
विस्तरेण यथान्यायं श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः //
text_mt: The beautiful majesty of this sacred site, Avimukta, / we are eager to hear at length according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vakṣye saṃkṣepataḥ samyak vārāṇasyāḥ suśobhanam
avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ yathāha bhagavān bhavaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
वक्ष्ये संक्षेपतः सम्यक् वाराणस्याः सुशोभनम्
अविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यं यथाह भगवान् भवः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall declare succinctly and properly the very auspicious / majesty of Vārāṇasī, of Avimukta, as the blessed Bhava spoke it.

sanskrit_iast:
vistareṇa mayā vaktuṃ brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā
śakyate naiva viprendrā varṣakoṭiśatairapi //
meaning:
विस्तरेण मया वक्तुं ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना
शक्यते नैव विप्रेन्द्रा वर्षकोटिशतैरपि //
text_mt: It cannot be told at length by me, or by the great-souled Brahmā, / even in hundreds of millions of years, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
devaḥ purā kṛtodvāhaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ
himavacchikharāddevyā haimavatyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
देवः पुरा कृतोद्वाहः शङ्करो नीललोहितः
हिमवच्छिखराद्देव्या हैमवत्या गणेश्वरैः //
text_mt: Formerly, having married, the god Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita, / [descending] from the peak of the Himālaya with goddess Pārvatī, daughter of Himavat, and the lords of the Gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasīmanuprāpya darśayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ vāsaṃ tatra cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
वाराणसीमनुप्राप्य दर्शयामास शङ्करः
अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं वासं तत्र चकार सः //
text_mt: having reached Vārāṇasī, Śaṅkara showed [her] / the liṅga Avimukteśvara, and made his dwelling there.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasīkurukṣetraśrīparvatamahālaye
tuṅgeśvare ca kedāre tatsthāne yo yatirbhavet //
meaning:
वाराणसीकुरुक्षेत्रश्रीपर्वतमहालये
तुङ्गेश्वरे च केदारे तत्स्थाने यो यतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: In Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Śrīparvata, Mahālaya, / Tuṅgeśvara, and Kedāra—he who becomes an ascetic in those places,

sanskrit_iast:
yoge pāśupate samyak dinamekaṃ yatirbhavet
tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya caret pāśupataṃ vratam //
meaning:
योगे पाशुपते सम्यक् दिनमेकं यतिर्भवेत्
तस्मात्सर्वं परित्यज्य चरेत् पाशुपतं व्रतम् //
text_mt: who becomes an ascetic properly in the Pāśupata yoga even for a single day— / therefore, abandoning all, one should observe the Pāśupata vow.

sanskrit_iast:
devodyāne vasettatra śarvodyānamanuttamam
manasā nirmame rudro vimānaṃ ca suśobhanam //
meaning:
देवोद्याने वसेत्तत्र शर्वोद्यानमनुत्तमम्
मनसा निर्ममे रुद्रो विमानं च सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: He should dwell there in the divine garden, Śarva's incomparable garden; / Rudra fashioned with his mind a most beautiful aerial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
darśayāmāsa ca tadā devodyānamanuttamam
haimavatyāḥ svayaṃ devaḥ sanandī parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
दर्शयामास च तदा देवोद्यानमनुत्तमम्
हैमवत्याः स्वयं देवः सनन्दी परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: And then the divine supreme lord himself, accompanied by Nandī, / showed the incomparable divine garden to the daughter of Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrasyāsya ca māhātmyam avimuktasya śaṅkaraḥ
uktavānparameśānaḥ pārvatyāḥ prītaye bhavaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रस्यास्य च माहात्म्यम् अविमुक्तस्य शङ्करः
उक्तवान्परमेशानः पार्वत्याः प्रीतये भवः //
text_mt: The majesty of this sacred site, Avimukta, Śaṅkara, / the supreme lord Bhava, recounted for the delight of Pārvatī:

sanskrit_iast:
praphullanānāvidhagulmaśobhitaṃ latāpratānādimanoharaṃ bahiḥ
virūḍhapuṣpaiḥ paritaḥ priyaṅgubhiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ kaṇṭakitaiś ca ketakaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रफुल्लनानाविधगुल्मशोभितं लताप्रतानादिमनोहरं बहिः
विरूढपुष्पैः परितः प्रियङ्गुभिः सुपुष्पितैः कण्टकितैश् च केतकैः //
text_mt: Adorned with various flowering thickets, enchanting outside with spreading creepers and the like, / surrounded by blossoming priyaṅgu shrubs and flowering, thorny ketaka bushes;

sanskrit_iast:
tamālagulmairnicitaṃ sugandhibhir nikāmapuṣpairvakulaiś ca sarvataḥ
aśokapunnāgaśataiḥ supuṣpitair dvirephamālākulapuṣpasaṃcayaiḥ //
meaning:
तमालगुल्मैर्निचितं सुगन्धिभिर् निकामपुष्पैर्वकुलैश् च सर्वतः
अशोकपुन्नागशतैः सुपुष्पितैर् द्विरेफमालाकुलपुष्पसंचयैः //
text_mt: crowded on every side with clumps of tamāla trees and fragrant, profusely blooming vakula trees, / with hundreds of blossoming aśoka and punnāga trees whose mass of flowers is crowded with swarms of bees;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacit praphullāmbujareṇubhūṣitair vihaṅgamaiś cānukalapraṇādibhiḥ
vināditaṃ sārasacakravākaiḥ pramattadātyūhavaraiś ca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
क्वचित् प्रफुल्लाम्बुजरेणुभूषितैर् विहङ्गमैश् चानुकलप्रणादिभिः
विनादितं सारसचक्रवाकैः प्रमत्तदात्यूहवरैश् च सर्वतः //
text_mt: graced here and there with blossoming lotus pollen, resounding on all sides / with birds warbling sweet, soft notes, with sārasa cranes, cakravāka ducks, and joyous, excellent water-cocks;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacicca kekārutanāditaṃ śubhaṃ kvacicca kāraṇḍavanādanāditam
kvacicca mattālikulākulīkṛtaṃ madākulābhir bhramarāṅganādibhiḥ //
meaning:
क्वचिच्च केकारुतनादितं शुभं क्वचिच्च कारण्डवनादनादितम्
क्वचिच्च मत्तालिकुलाकुलीकृतं मदाकुलाभिर् भ्रमराङ्गनादिभिः //
text_mt: resounding pleasantly here and there with the cries of peacocks, and echoed elsewhere with the calls of kāraṇḍava ducks, / filled in places with swarms of intoxicated bees, buzzing with honey-maddened female bees;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣevitaṃ cārusugandhipuṣpakaiḥ kvacit supuṣpaiḥ sahakāravṛkṣaiḥ
latopagūḍhaistilakaiś ca gūḍhaṃ pragītavidyādharasiddhacāraṇam //
meaning:
निषेवितं चारुसुगन्धिपुष्पकैः क्वचित् सुपुष्पैः सहकारवृक्षैः
लतोपगूढैस्तिलकैश् च गूढं प्रगीतविद्याधरसिद्धचारणम् //
text_mt: adorned in places with blossoming mango trees bearing lovely, fragrant flowers, / hidden by tilaka trees embraced by creepers, where Vidyādharas, Siddhas, and Cāraṇas sing;

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttanṛttānugatāpsarogaṇaṃ prahṛṣṭanānāvidhapakṣisevitam
pranṛttahārītakulopanāditaṃ mṛgendranādākulamattamānasaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तनृत्तानुगताप्सरोगणं प्रहृष्टनानाविधपक्षिसेवितम्
प्रनृत्तहारीतकुलोपनादितं मृगेन्द्रनादाकुलमत्तमानसैः //
text_mt: thronged with troops of Apsarases engaged in dance, attended by joyous birds of various kinds, / resounding with flocks of dancing green pigeons, their ecstatic minds bewildered by the roars of lions;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacit kvacid gandhakadambakair mṛgair vilūnadarbhāṅkurapuṣpasaṃcayam
praphullanānāvidhacārupaṅkajaiḥ sarastaḍāgairupaśobhitaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
क्वचित् क्वचिद् गन्धकदम्बकैर् मृगैर् विलूनदर्भाङ्कुरपुष्पसंचयम्
प्रफुल्लनानाविधचारुपङ्कजैः सरस्तडागैरुपशोभितं क्वचित् //
text_mt: where here and there masses of fragrant kadamba flowers and deer graze on clipped sprouts of darbha grass, / adorned here and there with lakes and ponds filled with blossoming, variegated, lovely lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
viṭapanicayalīnaṃ nīlakaṇṭhābhirāmaṃ madamuditavihaṅgaṃ prāptanādābhirāmam
kusumitataruśākhālīnamattadvirephaṃ navakisalayaśobhāśobhitaṃ prāṃśuśākham //
meaning:
विटपनिचयलीनं नीलकण्ठाभिरामं मदमुदितविहङ्गं प्राप्तनादाभिरामम्
कुसुमिततरुशाखालीनमत्तद्विरेफं नवकिसलयशोभाशोभितं प्रांशुशाखम् //
text_mt: nestled among dense boughs, charming with blue-throated peacocks, delightful with the sounds of joyfully ecstatic birds, / drunken bees clinging to branches of flowering trees, its lofty boughs adorned with the beauty of fresh shoots;

sanskrit_iast: kvacidvilāsālasagāminībhir niṣevitaṃ kiṃpuruṣāṅganābhiḥ //
meaning: क्वचिद्विलासालसगामिनीभिर् निषेवितं किंपुरुषाङ्गनाभिः //
text_mt: frequented in places by Kiṃpuruṣa women / walking with slow and graceful gait;

sanskrit_iast:
pārāvatadhvanivikūjitacāruśṛṅgair abhraṅkaṣaiḥ sitamanoharacārurūpaiḥ
ākīrṇapuṣpanikarapravibhaktahaṃsair vibhrājitaṃ tridaśadivyakulairanekaiḥ //
meaning:
पारावतध्वनिविकूजितचारुशृङ्गैर् अभ्रङ्कषैः सितमनोहरचारुरूपैः
आकीर्णपुष्पनिकरप्रविभक्तहंसैर् विभ्राजितं त्रिदशदिव्यकुलैरनेकैः //
text_mt: cooing with pigeon cries on its lovely peaks, cloud-scraping, white, beautiful and charming in form, / scattered with multitudes of flowers and distinct with swans, radiant with many divine hosts of gods;

sanskrit_iast:
phullotpalāṃbujavitānasahasrayuktaṃ toyāśayaiḥ samanuśobhitadevamārgam
mārgāntarākalitapuṣpavicitrapaṅktisambaddhagulmaviṭapair vividhairupetam //
meaning:
फुल्लोत्पलांबुजवितानसहस्रयुक्तं तोयाशयैः समनुशोभितदेवमार्गम्
मार्गान्तराकलितपुष्पविचित्रपङ्क्तिसम्बद्धगुल्मविटपैर् विविधैरुपेतम् //
text_mt: endowed with a thousand canopies of blooming blue and white lotuses, its divine pathways adorned with pools of water, / filled with various thickets and trees joined by colorful rows of flowers arranged along pathways;

sanskrit_iast:
tuṅgāgrair nīlapuṣpastabakabharanataprāṃśuśākhair aśokair dolāprāntāntanīlaśrutisukhajanakair bhāsitāntaṃ manojñaiḥ
rātrau candrasya bhāsā kusumitatilakairekatāṃ samprayātaṃ chāyāsuptaprabuddhasthitahariṇakulāluptadūrvāṅkurāgram //
meaning:
तुङ्गाग्रैर् नीलपुष्पस्तबकभरनतप्रांशुशाखैर् अशोकैर् दोलाप्रान्तान्तनीलश्रुतिसुखजनकैर् भासितान्तं मनोज्ञैः
रात्रौ चन्द्रस्य भासा कुसुमिततिलकैरेकतां सम्प्रयातं छायासुप्तप्रबुद्धस्थितहरिणकुलालुप्तदूर्वाङ्कुराग्रम् //
text_mt: its edges glowing and charming with lofty aśokas whose tall branches are weighed down by clusters of dark flowers, giving ear-delighting sounds at the edge of swings, / merging at night into oneness with flowering tilakas under the radiance of the moon, its dūrvā grass tips grazed by herds of deer standing, awaking from sleep in the shade;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsānāṃ pakṣavātapracalitakamalasvacchavistīrṇatoyaṃ toyānāṃ tīrajātapracakitakadalīcāṭunṛtyanmayūram
māyūraiḥ pakṣacandraiḥ kvacidavanigatai rañjitakṣmāpradeśaṃ deśe deśe vilīnapramuditavilasanmattahārītavṛndam //
meaning:
हंसानां पक्षवातप्रचलितकमलस्वच्छविस्तीर्णतोयं तोयानां तीरजातप्रचकितकदलीचाटुनृत्यन्मयूरम्
मायूरैः पक्षचन्द्रैः क्वचिदवनिगतै रञ्जितक्ष्माप्रदेशं देशे देशे विलीनप्रमुदितविलसन्मत्तहारीतवृन्दम् //
text_mt: its vast, clear waters stirred by the wind from the wings of swans, where peacocks dance charmingly among trembling plantains growing on the water's banks, / its soil tinted in places with the eyes of peacock feathers fallen to the ground, with flocks of joyful, playful, drunken green pigeons roosting in place after place;

sanskrit_iast:
sāraṅgaiḥ kvacidupaśobhitapradeśaṃ pracchannaṃ kusumacayaiḥ kvacidvicitraiḥ
hṛṣṭābhiḥ kvacidapi kinnarāṅganābhir vīṇābhiḥ sumadhuragītanṛttakaṇṭham //
meaning:
सारङ्गैः क्वचिदुपशोभितप्रदेशं प्रच्छन्नं कुसुमचयैः क्वचिद्विचित्रैः
हृष्टाभिः क्वचिदपि किन्नराङ्गनाभिर् वीणाभिः सुमधुरगीतनृत्तकण्ठम् //
text_mt: its regions adorned here and there with spotted deer, veiled in places with variegated masses of flowers, / and in places its atmosphere filled with the sweetest songs, lutes, and dancing of joyful Kinnara maidens.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsṛṣṭaiḥ kvacidupaliptakīrṇapuṣpair āvāsaiḥ parivṛtapādapaṃ munīnām
ā mūlāt phalanicitaiḥ kvacidviśālair uttuṅgaiḥ panasamahīruhairupetam //
meaning:
संसृष्टैः क्वचिदुपलिप्तकीर्णपुष्पैर् आवासैः परिवृतपादपं मुनीनाम्
आ मूलात् फलनिचितैः क्वचिद्विशालैर् उत्तुङ्गैः पनसमहीरुहैरुपेतम् //
text_mt: With the hermitages of sages surrounded by trees, swept, smeared [with cowdung], and strewn with flowers in some places, / and accompanied in other places by lofty jackfruit trees, broad and laden with fruit down to the roots;

sanskrit_iast: ramyaṃ priyaṅgutarumañjarisaktabhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgāvalīkavalitāmrakadambapuṣpam //
meaning: रम्यं प्रियङ्गुतरुमञ्जरिसक्तभृङ्गं भृङ्गावलीकवलिताम्रकदम्बपुष्पम् //
text_mt: Charming, with bees clinging to the clusters of priyaṅgu trees, and the flowers of mango and kadamba swallowed by swarms of bees;

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpotkarānilavighūrṇitavāriramyaṃ ramyadvirephavinipātitamañjugulmam
gulmāntaraprasabhabhītamṛgīsamūhaṃ vāteritaṃ tanubhṛtāmapavargadātṛ //
meaning:
पुष्पोत्करानिलविघूर्णितवारिरम्यं रम्यद्विरेफविनिपातितमञ्जुगुल्मम्
गुल्मान्तरप्रसभभीतमृगीसमूहं वातेरितं तनुभृतामपवर्गदातृ //
text_mt: Charming with water stirred by winds bearing heaps of blossoms, its lovely thickets brought down by pleasing bees, / with herds of does violently frightened within the bushes, stirred by the breeze, bestowing liberation upon embodied beings;

sanskrit_iast:
candrāṃśujālaśabalais tilakair manojñaiḥ sindūrakuṅkumakusumbhanibhair aśokaiḥ
cāmīkaradyutisamairatha karṇikāraiḥ puṣpotkarairupacitaṃ suviśālaśākhaiḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रांशुजालशबलैस् तिलकैर् मनोज्ञैः सिन्दूरकुङ्कुमकुसुम्भनिभैर् अशोकैः
चामीकरद्युतिसमैरथ कर्णिकारैः पुष्पोत्करैरुपचितं सुविशालशाखैः //
text_mt: Filled with heaps of blossoms on very broad branches—with pleasing tilaka trees dappled like a web of moonbeams, with aśoka trees resembling vermilion, saffron, and safflower, / and with karṇikāra trees equal in splendor to gold;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacidañjanacūrṇābhaiḥ kvacid vidrumasannibhaiḥ
kvacitkāñcanasaṃkāśaiḥ puṣpair ācitabhūtalam //
meaning:
क्वचिदञ्जनचूर्णाभैः क्वचिद् विद्रुमसन्निभैः
क्वचित्काञ्चनसंकाशैः पुष्पैर् आचितभूतलम् //
text_mt: Its ground covered with flowers resembling collyrium powder in some places, like coral in others, / and like gold in still others;

sanskrit_iast:
punnāgeṣu dvijaśatavirutaṃ raktāśokastabakabharanatam
ramyopāntaklamahārabhavanaṃ phullābjeṣu bhramaravilasitam //
meaning:
पुन्नागेषु द्विजशतविरुतं रक्ताशोकस्तबकभरनतम्
रम्योपान्तक्लमहारभवनं फुल्लाब्जेषु भ्रमरविलसितम् //
text_mt: Resounding with hundreds of birds in the punnāga trees, bowed with the burden of clusters of red aśokas, / an abode removing weariness on its lovely borders, sportively frequented by bees among the blooming lotuses—

sanskrit_iast:
sakalabhuvanabhartā lokanāthastadānīṃ tuhinaśikharaputryā sārdhamiṣṭairgaṇeśaiḥ
vividhataruviśālaṃ mattahṛṣṭānnapuṣṭair upavanam atiramyaṃ darśayāmāsa devyāḥ //
meaning:
सकलभुवनभर्ता लोकनाथस्तदानीं तुहिनशिखरपुत्र्या सार्धमिष्टैर्गणेशैः
विविधतरुविशालं मत्तहृष्टान्नपुष्टैर् उपवनम् अतिरम्यं दर्शयामास देव्याः //
text_mt: At that time the master of all the worlds, the lord of the universe, together with the daughter of the snowy peak and his dear lords of the gaṇas, / showed to the goddess the exceedingly delightful grove, filled with various broad trees, fattened by food, wild and overjoyed.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpairvanyaiḥ śubhaśubhatamaiḥ kalpitairdivyabhūṣair devīṃ divyāmupavanagatāṃ bhūṣayāmāsa śarvaḥ
sā cāpyenaṃ tuhinagirisutā śaṅkaraṃ devadevaṃ puṣpairdivyaiḥ śubhataratamair bhūṣayāmāsa bhaktyā //
meaning:
पुष्पैर्वन्यैः शुभशुभतमैः कल्पितैर्दिव्यभूषैर् देवीं दिव्यामुपवनगतां भूषयामास शर्वः
सा चाप्येनं तुहिनगिरिसुता शङ्करं देवदेवं पुष्पैर्दिव्यैः शुभतरतमैर् भूषयामास भक्त्या //
text_mt: Śarva adorned the divine goddess present in the grove with forest flowers, the most auspicious of all, fashioned into divine ornaments; / and she too, the daughter of the snowy mountain, with devotion adorned him, Śaṅkara, the god of gods, with divine, most auspicious flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya pūjyaṃ tridaśeśvarāṇāṃ samprekṣya codyānam atīva ramyam
gaṇeśvarair nandimukhaiś ca sārdham uvāca devaṃ praṇipatya devī //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य पूज्यं त्रिदशेश्वराणां सम्प्रेक्ष्य चोद्यानम् अतीव रम्यम्
गणेश्वरैर् नन्दिमुखैश् च सार्धम् उवाच देवं प्रणिपत्य देवी //
text_mt: Having worshiped the one worthy of worship by the lords of the gods, and having gazed upon the exceedingly delightful garden, / the goddess, together with the lords of the gaṇas headed by Nandin, bowed down and spoke to the god:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyuvāca
udyānaṃ darśitaṃ deva prabhayā parayā yutam
kṣetrasya ca guṇānsarvān punarme vaktumarhasi //
meaning:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
उद्यानं दर्शितं देव प्रभया परया युतम्
क्षेत्रस्य च गुणान्सर्वान् पुनर्मे वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: The goddess said: / The garden endowed with supreme splendor has been shown, O god. / You ought to tell me once more all the excellences of the sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
asya kṣetrasya māhātmyam avimuktasya sarvathā
vaktumarhasi deveśa devadeva vṛṣadhvaja //
meaning:
अस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यम् अविमुक्तस्य सर्वथा
वक्तुमर्हसि देवेश देवदेव वृषध्वज //
text_mt: You ought to tell me, by all means, the majesty of this sacred field, of Avimukta, / O lord of the gods, O god of gods, O Vṛṣadhvaja!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
devyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo varaprabhuḥ
āghrāya vadanāmbhojaṃ tadāha girijāṃ hasan //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
देव्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो वरप्रभुः
आघ्राय वदनाम्भोजं तदाह गिरिजां हसन् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of the goddess, the god of gods, the best of lords, / having kissed her lotus face, then said smilingly to the mountain-born goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ sadā vārāṇasī mama
sarveṣāmeva jantūnāṃ heturmokṣasya sarvadā //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
इदं गुह्यतमं क्षेत्रं सदा वाराणसी मम
सर्वेषामेव जन्तूनां हेतुर्मोक्षस्य सर्वदा //
text_mt: The Lord said: / This most secret sacred field, Vārāṇasī, is always mine; / it is ever the cause of liberation for all living creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
asminsiddhāḥ sadā devi madīyaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ
nānāliṅgadharā nityaṃ mama lokābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
अस्मिन्सिद्धाः सदा देवि मदीयं व्रतमास्थिताः
नानालिङ्गधरा नित्यं मम लोकाभिकाङ्क्षिणः //
text_mt: In this [place], O goddess, the perfected ones, ever established in my observance, / constantly bearing various sectarian marks, long for my world.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyasyanti paraṃ yogaṃ yuktātmāno jitendriyāḥ
nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇe nānāvihagaśobhite //
meaning:
अभ्यस्यन्ति परं योगं युक्तात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः
नानावृक्षसमाकीर्णे नानाविहगशोभिते //
text_mt: Composed in mind and with senses conquered, they practice supreme yoga / in [this place] crowded with various trees and adorned with various birds,

sanskrit_iast:
kamalotpalapuṣpāḍhyaiḥ sarobhiḥ samalaṃkṛte
apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ sadā saṃsevite śubhe //
meaning:
कमलोत्पलपुष्पाढ्यैः सरोभिः समलंकृते
अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः सदा संसेविते शुभे //
text_mt: Adorned with lakes rich in lotuses and water-lilies, / ever frequented by troops of apsarases and gandharvas, auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
rocate me sadā vāso yena kāryeṇa tacchṛṇu
manmanā mama bhaktaś ca mayi nityārpitakriyaḥ //
meaning:
रोचते मे सदा वासो येन कार्येण तच्छृणु
मन्मना मम भक्तश् च मयि नित्यार्पितक्रियः //
text_mt: Residence here is always pleasing to me; hear the reason for this: / with mind fixed on me, devoted to me, with his actions ever offered to me,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā mokṣamavāpnoti anyatra na tathā kvacit
kāmaṃ hyatra mṛto devi janturmokṣāya kalpate //
meaning:
यथा मोक्षमवाप्नोति अन्यत्र न तथा क्वचित्
कामं ह्यत्र मृतो देवि जन्तुर्मोक्षाय कल्पते //
text_mt: As he attains liberation, he does not do so elsewhere in any way. / Indeed, a creature dying here, O goddess, is readily fit for liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
etanmama puraṃ divyaṃ guhyādguhyatamaṃ mahat
brahmādayo vijānanti ye ca siddhā mumukṣavaḥ //
meaning:
एतन्मम पुरं दिव्यं गुह्याद्गुह्यतमं महत्
ब्रह्मादयो विजानन्ति ये च सिद्धा मुमुक्षवः //
text_mt: This divine city of mine is the greatest secret of secrets; / Brahmā and others know it, as do the perfected ones who seek liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paramidaṃ kṣetraṃ parā ceyaṃ gatirmama
vimuktaṃ na mayā yasmān mokṣyate vā kadācana //
meaning:
अतः परमिदं क्षेत्रं परा चेयं गतिर्मम
विमुक्तं न मया यस्मान् मोक्ष्यते वा कदाचन //
text_mt: Therefore this sacred field is supreme, and this is my highest refuge; / since it has never been abandoned by me, nor will it ever be abandoned,

sanskrit_iast:
mama kṣetramidaṃ tasmād avimuktamiti smṛtam
naimiṣe ca kurukṣetre gaṅgādvāre ca puṣkare //
meaning:
मम क्षेत्रमिदं तस्माद् अविमुक्तमिति स्मृतम्
नैमिषे च कुरुक्षेत्रे गङ्गाद्वारे च पुष्करे //
text_mt: This sacred field of mine is therefore called Avimukta. / In Naimiṣa, in Kurukṣetra, at Gaṅgādvāra, and at Puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
snānātsaṃsevanādvāpi na mokṣaḥ prāpyate yataḥ
iha samprāpyate yena tata etadviśiṣyate //
meaning:
स्नानात्संसेवनाद्वापि न मोक्षः प्राप्यते यतः
इह सम्प्राप्यते येन तत एतद्विशिष्यते //
text_mt: Liberation is not attained through bathing or worship, / because it is attained here; on that account this [field] is superior.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāge vā bhavenmokṣa iha vā matparigrahāt
prayāgādapi tīrthāgryād avimuktamidaṃ śubham //
meaning:
प्रयागे वा भवेन्मोक्ष इह वा मत्परिग्रहात्
प्रयागादपि तीर्थाग्र्याद् अविमुक्तमिदं शुभम् //
text_mt: Liberation may occur in Prayāga or here, by virtue of my acceptance; / even compared to Prayāga, the foremost of tīrthas, this auspicious Avimukta is superior.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasyopaniṣat satyaṃ mokṣasyopaniṣac chamaḥ
kṣetratīrthopaniṣadaṃ na vidurbudhasattamāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मस्योपनिषत् सत्यं मोक्षस्योपनिषच् छमः
क्षेत्रतीर्थोपनिषदं न विदुर्बुधसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Truth is the secret doctrine of righteousness; tranquility is the secret doctrine of liberation; / but the best of the wise do not know the secret doctrine of sacred fields and tīrthas.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ bhuñjan svapan krīḍan kurvan hi vividhāḥ kriyāḥ
avimukte tyajetprāṇān janturmokṣāya kalpate //
meaning:
कामं भुञ्जन् स्वपन् क्रीडन् कुर्वन् हि विविधाः क्रियाः
अविमुक्ते त्यजेत्प्राणान् जन्तुर्मोक्षाय कल्पते //
text_mt: Even while eating, sleeping, sporting at will, and performing various activities, / if a creature abandons his life-breaths in Avimukta, he is fit for liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi piśācatvaṃ varaṃ nṛṇām
na tu śakrasahasratvaṃ svarge kāśīpurīṃ vinā //
meaning:
कृत्वा पापसहस्राणि पिशाचत्वं वरं नृणाम्
न तु शक्रसहस्रत्वं स्वर्गे काशीपुरीं विना //
text_mt: Having committed thousands of sins, the state of a piśāca is preferable for men / [here] rather than the state of a thousand Indras in heaven without the city of Kāśī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaṃsevanīyaṃ hi avimuktaṃ hi muktaye
jaigīṣavyaḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ gato yatra mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्संसेवनीयं हि अविमुक्तं हि मुक्तये
जैगीषव्यः परां सिद्धिं गतो यत्र महातपाः //
text_mt: Therefore Avimukta is indeed to be resorted to for liberation, / where Jaigīṣavya of great austerities attained supreme perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
asya kṣetrasya māhātmyād bhaktyā ca mama bhāvitaḥ
jaigīṣavyaguhā śreṣṭhā yogināṃ sthānamiṣyate //
meaning:
अस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्याद् भक्त्या च मम भावितः
जैगीषव्यगुहा श्रेष्ठा योगिनां स्थानमिष्यते //
text_mt: Purified by devotion to me and through the majesty of this sacred field, / the excellent cave of Jaigīṣavya is regarded as the abode of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyantastatra māṃ nityaṃ yogāgnirdīpyate bhṛśam
kaivalyaṃ paramaṃ yāti devānāmapi durlabham //
meaning:
ध्यायन्तस्तत्र मां नित्यं योगाग्निर्दीप्यते भृशम्
कैवल्यं परमं याति देवानामपि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Meditating upon me there constantly, the fire of yoga blazes brightly; / one goes to supreme isolation, difficult to attain even for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaliṅgairmunibhiḥ sarvasiddhāntavedibhiḥ
iha samprāpyate mokṣo durlabho 'nyatra karhicit //
meaning:
अव्यक्तलिङ्गैर्मुनिभिः सर्वसिद्धान्तवेदिभिः
इह सम्प्राप्यते मोक्षो दुर्लभो ऽन्यत्र कर्हिचित् //
text_mt: By sages with unmanifest marks, knowing all established doctrines, / liberation is attained here, which is scarcely ever found elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaścāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaiśvaryamanuttamam
ātmanaścaiva sāyujyam īpsitaṃ sthānameva ca //
meaning:
तेभ्यश्चाहं प्रवक्ष्यामि योगैश्वर्यमनुत्तमम्
आत्मनश्चैव सायुज्यम् ईप्सितं स्थानमेव च //
text_mt: And to them I shall explain the unsurpassed sovereignty of yoga, / absorption into myself, and the desired abode.

sanskrit_iast:
kubero 'tra mama kṣetre mayi sarvārpitakriyaḥ
kṣetrasaṃsevanādeva gaṇeśatvamavāpa ha //
meaning:
कुबेरो ऽत्र मम क्षेत्रे मयि सर्वार्पितक्रियः
क्षेत्रसंसेवनादेव गणेशत्वमवाप ह //
text_mt: Kubera, in this sacred field of mine, with all actions offered to me, / obtained the status of a gaṇa lord merely by resorting to this sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvarto bhavitā yaś ca so 'pi bhakto mamaiva tu
ihaivārādhya māṃ devi siddhiṃ yāsyatyanuttamām //
meaning:
संवर्तो भविता यश् च सो ऽपि भक्तो ममैव तु
इहैवाराध्य मां देवि सिद्धिं यास्यत्यनुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: And Saṃvarta, who is to come, shall also be my devotee; / having worshiped me right here, O goddess, he will attain unsurpassed perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
parāśarasutau yogī ṛṣirvyāso mahātapāḥ
mama bhakto bhaviṣyaś ca vedasaṃsthāpravartakaḥ //
meaning:
पराशरसुतौ योगी ऋषिर्व्यासो महातपाः
मम भक्तो भविष्यश् च वेदसंस्थाप्रवर्तकः //
text_mt: The yogin sage Vyāsa, son of Parāśara, of great austerities, / will also be my devotee, the establisher of the Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
raṃsyate so 'pi padmākṣi kṣetre 'sminmunipuṅgavaḥ
brahmā devarṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ viṣṇurvāpi divākaraḥ //
meaning:
रंस्यते सो ऽपि पद्माक्षि क्षेत्रे ऽस्मिन्मुनिपुङ्गवः
ब्रह्मा देवर्षिभिः सार्द्धं विष्णुर्वापि दिवाकरः //
text_mt: He too, O lotus-eyed one, will delight in this sacred field, as the foremost of sages. / Brahmā together with the divine sages, or Viṣṇu, or the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
devarājastathā śakro ye 'pi cānye divaukasaḥ
upāsate mahātmānaḥ sarve māmiha suvrate //
meaning:
देवराजस्तथा शक्रो ये ऽपि चान्ये दिवौकसः
उपासते महात्मानः सर्वे मामिह सुव्रते //
text_mt: And the king of gods, Śakra, and whatever other denizens of heaven [there are]— / all those great-souled ones worship me here, O woman of good vows.

sanskrit_iast:
anye 'pi yogino divyāś channarūpā mahātmanaḥ
ananyamanaso bhūtvā māmihopāsate sadā //
meaning:
अन्ये ऽपि योगिनो दिव्याश् छन्नरूपा महात्मनः
अनन्यमनसो भूत्वा मामिहोपासते सदा //
text_mt: Other divine yogins too, great-souled ones in disguised forms, / becoming single-minded, ever worship me here.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayāsaktacitto 'pi tyaktadharmaratirnaraḥ
iha kṣetre mṛtaḥ so 'pi saṃsāre na punarbhavet //
meaning:
विषयासक्तचित्तो ऽपि त्यक्तधर्मरतिर्नरः
इह क्षेत्रे मृतः सो ऽपि संसारे न पुनर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Even a man whose mind is attached to sense-objects and who has abandoned delight in righteousness, / if he dies in this sacred field, he will not be reborn in saṃsāra.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punarnirmamā dhīrāḥ sattvasthā vijitendriyāḥ
vratinaś ca nirārambhāḥ sarve te mayi bhāvitāḥ //
meaning:
ये पुनर्निर्ममा धीराः सत्त्वस्था विजितेन्द्रियाः
व्रतिनश् च निरारम्भाः सर्वे ते मयि भाविताः //
text_mt: On the other hand, those who are without possessiveness, resolute, established in sattva, with senses conquered, / observing vows, and free from undertakings—they are all absorbed in me.

sanskrit_iast:
devadevaṃ samāsādya dhīmantaḥ saṃgavarjitāḥ
gatā iha paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādānmama suvrate //
meaning:
देवदेवं समासाद्य धीमन्तः संगवर्जिताः
गता इह परं मोक्षं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रते //
text_mt: Having approached the god of gods, wise and free from attachment, / they have attained supreme liberation here through my grace, O woman of good vows.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntarasahasreṣu yaṃ na yogī samāpnuyāt
tamihaiva paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādānmama suvrate //
meaning:
जन्मान्तरसहस्रेषु यं न योगी समाप्नुयात्
तमिहैव परं मोक्षं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रते //
text_mt: That supreme liberation which a yogin does not attain in thousands of other births, / [he attains] right here through my grace, O woman of good vows.

sanskrit_iast:
goprekṣakam idaṃ kṣetraṃ brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ purā
kailāsabhavanaṃ cātra paśya divyaṃ varānane //
meaning:
गोप्रेक्षकम् इदं क्षेत्रं ब्रह्मणा स्थापितं पुरा
कैलासभवनं चात्र पश्य दिव्यं वरानने //
text_mt: This sacred field of Goprekṣaka was formerly established by Brahmā; / and behold here, O fair-faced one, the divine abode of Kailāsa!

sanskrit_iast:
goprekṣakam athāgamya dṛṣṭvā māmatra mānavaḥ
na durgatimavāpnoti kalmaṣaiś ca vimucyate //
meaning:
गोप्रेक्षकम् अथागम्य दृष्ट्वा मामत्र मानवः
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति कल्मषैश् च विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having arrived at Goprekṣaka and having seen me here, / a human being does not go to a bad state and is freed from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāhradam ityevaṃ tathā vai brahmaṇā kṛtam
gavāṃ stanyajatoyena tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ mahat //
meaning:
कपिलाह्रदम् इत्येवं तथा वै ब्रह्मणा कृतम्
गवां स्तन्यजतोयेन तीर्थं पुण्यतमं महत् //
text_mt: Likewise, Kapilāhrada was created by Brahmā, / a great and most sacred tīrtha, with water born from the milk of cows.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpi svayamevāhaṃ vṛṣadhvaja iti smṛtaḥ
sānnidhyaṃ kṛtavān devi sadāhaṃ dṛśyate tvayā //
meaning:
अत्रापि स्वयमेवाहं वृषध्वज इति स्मृतः
सान्निध्यं कृतवान् देवि सदाहं दृश्यते त्वया //
text_mt: Here too, I myself, remembered as Vṛṣadhvaja, / have established my presence, O goddess; you may always see me here.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadratoyaṃ ca paśyeha brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ hradam
sarvairdevairahaṃ devi asmindeśe prasāditaḥ //
meaning:
भद्रतोयं च पश्येह ब्रह्मणा च कृतं ह्रदम्
सर्वैर्देवैरहं देवि अस्मिन्देशे प्रसादितः //
text_mt: And behold here Bhadratoya, the pool made by Brahmā. / In this place, O goddess, I was propitiated by all the gods [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
gacchopaśamam īśeti upaśāntaḥ śivas tathā
atrāhaṃ brahmaṇānīya sthāpitaḥ parameṣṭhinā //
meaning:
गच्छोपशमम् ईशेति उपशान्तः शिवस् तथा
अत्राहं ब्रह्मणानीय स्थापितः परमेष्ठिना //
text_mt: “Become pacified, O Īśa!” Thus was Śiva pacified. / Brought here by Brahmā the Parameṣṭhin, I was installed.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā cāpi saṃgṛhya viṣṇunā sthāpitaḥ punaḥ
brahmaṇāpi tato viṣṇuḥ proktaḥ saṃvignacetasā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा चापि संगृह्य विष्णुना स्थापितः पुनः
ब्रह्मणापि ततो विष्णुः प्रोक्तः संविग्नचेतसा //
text_mt: And having been taken from Brahmā, it was installed again by Viṣṇu. / Then Viṣṇu was addressed by Brahmā with an agitated mind:

sanskrit_iast:
mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmāt sthāpitavān asi
tamuvāca punar viṣṇur brahmāṇaṃ kupitānanam //
meaning:
मयानीतमिदं लिङ्गं कस्मात् स्थापितवान् असि
तमुवाच पुनर् विष्णुर् ब्रह्माणं कुपिताननम् //
text_mt: “This liṅga was brought by me; why have you installed it?” / Viṣṇu then spoke again to Brahmā whose face was enraged:

sanskrit_iast:
rudre deve mamātyantaṃ parā bhaktirmahattarā
mayaiva sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
रुद्रे देवे ममात्यन्तं परा भक्तिर्महत्तरा
मयैव स्थापितं लिङ्गं तव नाम्ना भविष्यति //
text_mt: “I have supreme and very great devotion to god Rudra. / The liṅga installed by me shall indeed be known by your name.”

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbha ityevaṃ tato 'trāhaṃ samāsthitaḥ
dṛṣṭvainamapi deveśaṃ mama lokaṃ vrajennaraḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भ इत्येवं ततो ऽत्राहं समास्थितः
दृष्ट्वैनमपि देवेशं मम लोकं व्रजेन्नरः //
text_mt: Thus, as Hiraṇyagarbha, I have taken my abode here. / Seeing this Lord of the Gods, a mortal goes to my world.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ punarapi brahmā mama liṅgamidaṃ śubham
sthāpayāmāsa vidhivad bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
ततः पुनरपि ब्रह्मा मम लिङ्गमिदं शुभम्
स्थापयामास विधिवद् भक्त्या परमया युतः //
text_mt: Then, once again, Brahmā, endowed with supreme devotion, / installed this auspicious liṅga of mine according to the sacred precepts.

sanskrit_iast:
svarlīneśvara ityevam atrāhaṃ svayamāgataḥ
prāṇān iha narastyaktvā na punarjāyate kvacit //
meaning:
स्वर्लीनेश्वर इत्येवम् अत्राहं स्वयमागतः
प्राणान् इह नरस्त्यक्त्वा न पुनर्जायते क्वचित् //
text_mt: I myself came here as Svarlīneśvara. / Giving up his vital breaths here, a mortal is never born again anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
ananyā sā gatistasya yogināṃ caiva yā smṛtā
asminnapi mayā deśe daityo daivatakaṇṭakaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्या सा गतिस्तस्य योगिनां चैव या स्मृता
अस्मिन्नपि मया देशे दैत्यो दैवतकण्टकः //
text_mt: His is that unique state of attainment which is commemorated for yogins. / In this place as well, a daitya, a thorn to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrarūpaṃ samāsthāya nihato darpito balī
vyāghreśvara iti khyāto nityamatrāhamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
व्याघ्ररूपं समास्थाय निहतो दर्पितो बली
व्याघ्रेश्वर इति ख्यातो नित्यमत्राहमास्थितः //
text_mt: haughty and mighty, who had assumed the form of a tiger, was slain by me. / Renowned as Vyāghreśvara, I abide here constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
na punardurgatiṃ yāti dṛṣṭvainaṃ vyāghramīśvaram
utpalo vidalaścaiva yau daityau brahmaṇā purā //
meaning:
न पुनर्दुर्गतिं याति दृष्ट्वैनं व्याघ्रमीश्वरम्
उत्पलो विदलश्चैव यौ दैत्यौ ब्रह्मणा पुरा //
text_mt: Having seen this Tiger-Lord, one never again meets a bad rebirth. / Utpala and Vidala, the two daityas whom formerly Brahmā [had made]

sanskrit_iast:
strīvadhyau darpitau dṛṣṭvā tvayaiva nihatau raṇe
sāvajñaṃ kandukenātra tasyedaṃ dehamāsthitam //
meaning:
स्त्रीवध्यौ दर्पितौ दृष्ट्वा त्वयैव निहतौ रणे
सावज्ञं कन्दुकेनात्र तस्येदं देहमास्थितम् //
text_mt: destined to be slain only by a woman, were seen to be haughty and slain in battle by you alone, / with disdain, by means of a ball; here their bodies remained.

sanskrit_iast:
ādāvatrāhamāgamya prasthito gaṇapaiḥ saha
jyeṣṭhasthānamidaṃ tasmād etanme puṇyadarśanam //
meaning:
आदावत्राहमागम्य प्रस्थितो गणपैः सह
ज्येष्ठस्थानमिदं तस्माद् एतन्मे पुण्यदर्शनम् //
text_mt: Having come here at the very beginning, I departed together with the chiefs of the gaṇas; / therefore this is Jyeṣṭhasthāna, bringing holy sight of me.

sanskrit_iast:
devaiḥ samantād etāni liṅgāni sthāpitānyataḥ
dṛṣṭvāpi niyato martyo dehabhede gaṇo bhavet //
meaning:
देवैः समन्ताद् एतानि लिङ्गानि स्थापितान्यतः
दृष्ट्वापि नियतो मर्त्यो देहभेदे गणो भवेत् //
text_mt: These liṅgas have consequently been installed all around by the gods. / A self-controlled mortal who sees them becomes a gaṇa upon the dissolution of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā te śailarājena purā himavatā svayam
mama priyahitaṃ sthānaṃ jñātvā liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
पित्रा ते शैलराजेन पुरा हिमवता स्वयम्
मम प्रियहितं स्थानं ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: Formerly, by your father, the king of mountains, Himavat himself, / knowing it to be my dear and beneficial abode, a liṅga was installed.

sanskrit_iast:
śaileśvaramiti khyātaṃ dṛśyatāmiha cādarāt
dṛṣṭvaitanmanujo devi na durgatimato vrajet //
meaning:
शैलेश्वरमिति ख्यातं दृश्यतामिह चादरात्
दृष्ट्वैतन्मनुजो देवि न दुर्गतिमतो व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Behold here with reverence that celebrated as Śaileśvara; / having seen this, O goddess, a human being never goes to a bad rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
nadyeṣā varuṇā devi puṇyā pāpapramocanī
kṣetrametad alaṃkṛtya jāhnavyā saha saṃgatā //
meaning:
नद्येषा वरुणा देवि पुण्या पापप्रमोचनी
क्षेत्रमेतद् अलंकृत्य जाह्नव्या सह संगता //
text_mt: This holy river Varuṇā, O goddess, which delivers from sins, / adorns this sacred field and unites with the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā cāpi saṃgame liṅgamuttamam
saṃgameśvaram ityevaṃ khyātaṃ jagati dṛśyatām //
meaning:
स्थापितं ब्रह्मणा चापि संगमे लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
संगमेश्वरम् इत्येवं ख्यातं जगति दृश्यताम् //
text_mt: At the confluence, an excellent liṅga was installed by Brahmā; / behold that which is renowned throughout the world as Saṃgameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgame devanadyā hi yaḥ snātvā manujaḥ śuciḥ
arcayet saṃgameśvaraṃ tasya janmabhayaṃ kutaḥ //
meaning:
संगमे देवनद्या हि यः स्नात्वा मनुजः शुचिः
अर्चयेत् संगमेश्वरं तस्य जन्मभयं कुतः //
text_mt: For having bathed pure at the confluence of the divine river, / if a human being worships Saṃgameśvara, whence would he have any fear of birth?

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ manye mahākṣetraṃ nivāso yogināṃ param
kṣetramadhye ca yatrāhaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvāgramāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
इदं मन्ये महाक्षेत्रं निवासो योगिनां परम्
क्षेत्रमध्ये च यत्राहं स्वयं भूत्वाग्रमास्थितः //
text_mt: I regard this great sacred field as the supreme dwelling of yogins, / where, having manifested myself in the middle of the sacred field, I abide in the forefront.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyameśvaramityevaṃ khyātaḥ sarvasurāsuraiḥ
siddhānāṃ sthānametaddhi madīyavratadhāriṇām //
meaning:
मध्यमेश्वरमित्येवं ख्यातः सर्वसुरासुरैः
सिद्धानां स्थानमेतद्धि मदीयव्रतधारिणाम् //
text_mt: Celebrated as Madhyameśvara by all the gods and asuras, / this is indeed the abode of the siddhas who observe my vows,

sanskrit_iast:
yogināṃ mokṣalipsūnāṃ jñānayogaratātmanām
dṛṣṭvainaṃ madhyameśānaṃ janma prati na śocati //
meaning:
योगिनां मोक्षलिप्सूनां ज्ञानयोगरतात्मनाम्
दृष्ट्वैनं मध्यमेशानं जन्म प्रति न शोचति //
text_mt: and of yogins desiring liberation whose minds are devoted to the yoga of knowledge. / Seeing this Madhyameśāna, one does not grieve over rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpitaṃ liṅgametattu śukreṇa bhṛgusūnunā
nāmnā śukreśvaraṃ nāma sarvasiddhāmarārcitam //
meaning:
स्थापितं लिङ्गमेतत्तु शुक्रेण भृगुसूनुना
नाम्ना शुक्रेश्वरं नाम सर्वसिद्धामरार्चितम् //
text_mt: This liṅga was installed by Śukra, the son of Bhṛgu, / known by the name Śukreśvara, worshipped by all siddhas and immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvainaṃ niyataḥ sadyo mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
mṛtaś ca na punarjantuḥ saṃsārī tu bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैनं नियतः सद्यो मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
मृतश् च न पुनर्जन्तुः संसारी तु भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: Seeing this, a self-controlled human being is instantly freed from all sins, / and when dead, that creature never becomes a transmigrating mortal again.

sanskrit_iast:
purā jambūkarūpeṇa asuro devakaṇṭakaḥ
brahmaṇo hi varaṃ labdhvā gomāyurbandhaśaṅkitaḥ //
meaning:
पुरा जम्बूकरूपेण असुरो देवकण्टकः
ब्रह्मणो हि वरं लब्ध्वा गोमायुर्बन्धशङ्कितः //
text_mt: Formerly, an asura who was a thorn to the gods, in the form of a jackal, / having obtained a boon from Brahmā, was anxious about capture by a jackal [trap].

sanskrit_iast:
nihato himavatputri jambūkeśastato hyaham
adyāpi jagati khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam //
meaning:
निहतो हिमवत्पुत्रि जम्बूकेशस्ततो ह्यहम्
अद्यापि जगति ख्यातं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: He was slain, O daughter of Himavat; therefore I am Jambūkeśa, / renowned in the world even today, bowed down to by gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvainamapi deveśaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt
grahaiḥ śukrapurogaiś ca etāni sthāpitāni ha //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैनमपि देवेशं सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
ग्रहैः शुक्रपुरोगैश् च एतानि स्थापितानि ह //
text_mt: Seeing this Lord of the Gods, one attains all desires. / These were installed by the planets headed by Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
paśya puṇyāni liṅgāni sarvakāmapradāni tu
evametāni puṇyāni mannivāsāni pārvati //
meaning:
पश्य पुण्यानि लिङ्गानि सर्वकामप्रदानि तु
एवमेतानि पुण्यानि मन्निवासानि पार्वति //
text_mt: Behold these holy liṅgas, bestowers of all wishes; / thus these holy abodes of mine have been declared, O Pārvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
kathitāni mama kṣetre guhyaṃ cānyadidaṃ śṛṇu
catuḥkrośaṃ caturdikṣu kṣetrametatprakīrtitam //
meaning:
कथितानि मम क्षेत्रे गुह्यं चान्यदिदं शृणु
चतुःक्रोशं चतुर्दिक्षु क्षेत्रमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: in my sacred field; and listen to this other secret: / This sacred field is proclaimed to measure four krośas in the four cardinal directions.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanaṃ viddhi cārvaṅgi mṛtyukāle 'mṛtapradam
mahālayagiristhaṃ māṃ kedāre ca vyavasthitam //
meaning:
योजनं विद्धि चार्वङ्गि मृत्युकाले ऽमृतप्रदम्
महालयगिरिस्थं मां केदारे च व्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt: Know it to be a yojana, O lovely-limbed one, which bestows immortality at the time of death. / By seeing me residing on Mount Mahālaya and abiding in Kedāra,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇatvaṃ labhate dṛṣṭvā hy asminmokṣo hyavāpyate
gāṇapatyaṃ labhedyasmād yataḥ sā muktiruttamā //
meaning:
गणत्वं लभते दृष्ट्वा ह्य् अस्मिन्मोक्षो ह्यवाप्यते
गाणपत्यं लभेद्यस्माद् यतः सा मुक्तिरुत्तमा //
text_mt: one attains gaṇa-hood, but in this [field] liberation is attained; / for that is the supreme liberation, from which one attains the status of leader of gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mahālayāt tasmāt kedārānmadhyamādapi
smṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ kṣetram avimuktaṃ varānane //
meaning:
ततो महालयात् तस्मात् केदारान्मध्यमादपि
स्मृतं पुण्यतमं क्षेत्रम् अविमुक्तं वरानने //
text_mt: Therefore, more than Mahālaya, Kedāra, or Madhyama, / the sacred field Avimukta is remembered as the holiest, O fair-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
kedāraṃ madhyamaṃ kṣetraṃ sthānaṃ caiva mahālayam
mama puṇyāni bhūrloke tebhyaḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ tvidam //
meaning:
केदारं मध्यमं क्षेत्रं स्थानं चैव महालयम्
मम पुण्यानि भूर्लोके तेभ्यः श्रेष्ठतमं त्विदम् //
text_mt: Kedāra, the Madhyama field, and the holy site of Mahālaya / are my holy places on the mortal earth, but this is the most excellent of them.

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ sṛṣṭāstvime lokās tataḥ kṣetramidaṃ śubham
kadācinna mayā muktam avimuktaṃ tato 'bhavat //
meaning:
यतः सृष्टास्त्विमे लोकास् ततः क्षेत्रमिदं शुभम्
कदाचिन्न मया मुक्तम् अविमुक्तं ततो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Since these worlds were created, this auspicious sacred field / has never been abandoned by me; therefore it became Avimukta.

sanskrit_iast:
avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ mama dṛṣṭveha mānavaḥ
sadyaḥ pāpavinirmuktaḥ paśupāśairvimucyate //
meaning:
अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं मम दृष्ट्वेह मानवः
सद्यः पापविनिर्मुक्तः पशुपाशैर्विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Seeing my Avimukteśvara liṅga here, a human being / is immediately freed from sins and released from the bonds of individual souls.

sanskrit_iast:
śaileśaṃ saṃgameśaṃ ca svarlīnaṃ madhyameśvaram
hiraṇyagarbham īśānaṃ goprekṣaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
शैलेशं संगमेशं च स्वर्लीनं मध्यमेश्वरम्
हिरण्यगर्भम् ईशानं गोप्रेक्षं वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: Śaileśa, Saṃgameśa, Svarlīna, Madhyameśvara, / Hiraṇyagarbha, Īśāna, Goprekṣa, Vṛṣabhadhvaja,

sanskrit_iast:
upaśāntaṃ śivaṃ caiva jyeṣṭhasthānanivāsinam
śukreśvaraṃ ca vikhyātaṃ vyāghreśaṃ jambukeśvaram //
meaning:
उपशान्तं शिवं चैव ज्येष्ठस्थाननिवासिनम्
शुक्रेश्वरं च विख्यातं व्याघ्रेशं जम्बुकेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Upaśānta, Śiva, and the resident of Jyeṣṭhasthāna, / the celebrated Śukreśvara, Vyāghreśa, and Jambukeśvara—

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā na jāyate martyaḥ saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare
evam uktvā mahādevo diśaḥ sarvā vyalokayat //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा न जायते मर्त्यः संसारे दुःखसागरे
एवम् उक्त्वा महादेवो दिशः सर्वा व्यलोकयत् //
text_mt: having seen [these], a mortal is not born again in the ocean of sorrow that is saṃsāra.” / Having spoken thus, Mahādeva looked upon all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya saṃsthite paścād devadeve maheśvare
akasmādabhavatsarvaḥ sa deśojjvalito yathā //
meaning:
विलोक्य संस्थिते पश्चाद् देवदेवे महेश्वरे
अकस्मादभवत्सर्वः स देशोज्ज्वलितो यथा //
text_mt: As Maheśvara, the God of gods, stood there having looked, / suddenly that entire region became, as it were, ablaze with light.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pāśupatāḥ siddhā bhasmābhyaṅgasitaprabhāḥ
māheśvarā mahātmānas tathā vai niyatavratāḥ //
meaning:
ततः पाशुपताः सिद्धा भस्माभ्यङ्गसितप्रभाः
माहेश्वरा महात्मानस् तथा वै नियतव्रताः //
text_mt: Then Pāśupata siddhas, radiant white with the besmearing of sacred ashes, / great-souled worshippers of Maheśvara, firm in their vows,

sanskrit_iast:
bahavaḥ śataśo 'bhyetya namaścakrurmaheśvaram
punarnirīkṣya yogeśaṃ dhyānayogaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
बहवः शतशो ऽभ्येत्य नमश्चक्रुर्महेश्वरम्
पुनर्निरीक्ष्य योगेशं ध्यानयोगं च कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: approaching in great numbers by the hundreds, bowed down to Maheśvara. / Beholding again the Lord of Yoga and the entirety of dhyāna-yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
tasthurātmānamāsthāya līyamānā iveśvare
sthitānāṃ sa tadā teṣāṃ devadeva umāpatiḥ //
meaning:
तस्थुरात्मानमास्थाय लीयमाना इवेश्वरे
स्थितानां स तदा तेषां देवदेव उमापतिः //
text_mt: they remained abiding in the Self, seeming to dissolve into the Lord. / As they stood thus, the God of gods, the lord of Umā,

sanskrit_iast:
sa bibhratparamāṃ mūrtiṃ babhūva puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ
kṛtsnaṃ jagadihaikasthaṃ kartum anta iva sthitaḥ //
meaning:
स बिभ्रत्परमां मूर्तिं बभूव पुरुषः प्रभुः
कृत्स्नं जगदिहैकस्थं कर्तुम् अन्त इव स्थितः //
text_mt: assuming his supreme form, became the Lord, the Puruṣa, / standing as if at the end of time to bring the entire world into unity here.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tāṃ paramāṃ mūrtim āsthitasya jagatprabhoḥ
na śaśāka punardraṣṭuṃ hṛṣṭaromā girīndrajā //
meaning:
तस्य तां परमां मूर्तिम् आस्थितस्य जगत्प्रभोः
न शशाक पुनर्द्रष्टुं हृष्टरोमा गिरीन्द्रजा //
text_mt: As the Lord of the world assumed that supreme form of his, / the daughter of the king of mountains, her body hair bristling, was unable to look upon it again.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvadṛṣṭamākāraṃ buddhvā sā prakṛtisthitam
prakṛtermūrtimāsthāya yogena parameśvarī //
meaning:
ततस्त्वदृष्टमाकारं बुद्ध्वा सा प्रकृतिस्थितम्
प्रकृतेर्मूर्तिमास्थाय योगेन परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: Then, realising that his unseen form abides in prakṛti, / the supreme goddess, assuming the form of prakṛti through yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ śaśāka punardraṣṭuṃ harasya ca mahātmanaḥ
tataste layamādhāya yoginaḥ puruṣasya tu //
meaning:
तं शशाक पुनर्द्रष्टुं हरस्य च महात्मनः
ततस्ते लयमाधाय योगिनः पुरुषस्य तु //
text_mt: was able to behold him again, that great-souled Hara. / Then those yogins, dissolving themselves into the Puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
viviśurhṛdayaṃ sarve dagdhasaṃsārabījinaḥ
pañcākṣarasya vai bījaṃ saṃsmarantaḥ suśobhanam //
meaning:
विविशुर्हृदयं सर्वे दग्धसंसारबीजिनः
पञ्चाक्षरस्य वै बीजं संस्मरन्तः सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: all entered his heart, having burnt the seeds of rebirth, / remembering the most splendid seed syllable of the five-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ purā caiva prakāśitam
nīlalohitamūrtisthaṃ punaścakre vapuḥ śubham //
meaning:
सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं पुरा चैव प्रकाशितम्
नीललोहितमूर्तिस्थं पुनश्चक्रे वपुः शुभम् //
text_mt: It removes all sins, is divine, and was revealed formerly. / Residing in the form of Nīlalohita, he again assumed an auspicious body.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śailajā prāha hṛṣṭasarvatanūruhā
stuvatī caraṇau natvā ka ime bhagavanniti //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा शैलजा प्राह हृष्टसर्वतनूरुहा
स्तुवती चरणौ नत्वा क इमे भगवन्निति //
text_mt: Seeing him, the Mountain-born daughter, with all the hairs of her body bristling with joy, / praising him and bowing to his feet, said, “Who are these, O Lord?”

sanskrit_iast:
tāmuvāca suraśreṣṭhas tadā devīṃ girīndrajām
madīyaṃ vratamāśritya bhaktimadbhir dvijottamaiḥ //
meaning:
तामुवाच सुरश्रेष्ठस् तदा देवीं गिरीन्द्रजाम्
मदीयं व्रतमाश्रित्य भक्तिमद्भिर् द्विजोत्तमैः //
text_mt: The foremost of the gods then spoke to her, the goddess, daughter of the king of mountains: / “By the best of Brahmins who, taking refuge in my vow, are endowed with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
yairyairyogā ihābhyastās teṣām ekena janmanā
kṣetrasyāsya prabhāvena bhaktyā ca mama bhāmini //
meaning:
यैर्यैर्योगा इहाभ्यस्तास् तेषाम् एकेन जन्मना
क्षेत्रस्यास्य प्रभावेन भक्त्या च मम भामिनि //
text_mt: by whichever of them yogas were practiced here, within a single birth, / through the power of this sacred field and through devotion to me, O beautiful woman,

sanskrit_iast:
anugraho mayā hyevaṃ kriyate mūrtitaḥ svayam
tasmād etan mahat kṣetraṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevitaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अनुग्रहो मया ह्येवं क्रियते मूर्तितः स्वयम्
तस्माद् एतन् महत् क्षेत्रं ब्रह्माद्यैः सेवितं तथा //
text_mt: grace is thus granted by me directly through my visible form. / Therefore this great sacred field has been frequented by Brahmā and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
śrutimadbhiś ca viprendraiḥ saṃsiddhaiś ca tapasvibhiḥ
pratimāsaṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pratimāsaṃ caturdaśīm //
meaning:
श्रुतिमद्भिश् च विप्रेन्द्रैः संसिद्धैश् च तपस्विभिः
प्रतिमासं तथाष्टम्यां प्रतिमासं चतुर्दशीम् //
text_mt: and by wise foremost Brahmins, and by perfected ascetics, / every month on the eighth day, and every month on the fourteenth day,

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayoḥ pakṣayordevi vārāṇasyāmupāsyate
śaśibhānūparāge ca kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
उभयोः पक्षयोर्देवि वाराणस्यामुपास्यते
शशिभानूपरागे च कार्तिक्यां च विशेषतः //
text_mt: during both fortnights, O goddess, it is worshipped in Vārāṇasī, / and especially at eclipses of the moon and sun, and on the full moon of Kārttika,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaparvasu puṇyeṣu viṣuveṣvayaneṣu ca
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni vārāṇasyāṃ tu jāhnavīm //
meaning:
सर्वपर्वसु पुण्येषु विषुवेष्वयनेषु च
पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थानि वाराणस्यां तु जाह्नवीम् //
text_mt: on all auspicious festive days, and at the equinoxes and solstices. / All the sacred fords on earth, but in Vārāṇasī the Jāhnavī,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarapravahāṃ puṇyāṃ mama mauliviniḥsṛtām
pituste girirājasya śubhāṃ himavataḥ sutām //
meaning:
उत्तरप्रवहां पुण्यां मम मौलिविनिःसृताम्
पितुस्ते गिरिराजस्य शुभां हिमवतः सुताम् //
text_mt: flowing northwards, sacred, issuing from my crown, / the auspicious daughter of your father, the king of mountains, Himavat,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyasthānasthitāṃ puṇyāṃ puṇyadikpravahāṃ sadā
bhajante sarvato 'bhyetya ye tāñchṛṇu varānane //
meaning:
पुण्यस्थानस्थितां पुण्यां पुण्यदिक्प्रवहां सदा
भजन्ते सर्वतो ऽभ्येत्य ये ताञ्छृणु वरानने //
text_mt: situated in a sacred place, sacred, ever flowing toward the sacred quarter— / hear, O fair-faced one, who they are that resort to it, having approached from every side:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnihatya kurukṣetraṃ sārdhaṃ tīrthaśatais tathā
puṣkaraṃ nimiṣaṃ caiva prayāgaṃ ca pṛthūdakam //
meaning:
संनिहत्य कुरुक्षेत्रं सार्धं तीर्थशतैस् तथा
पुष्करं निमिषं चैव प्रयागं च पृथूदकम् //
text_mt: Kurukṣetra along with Saṃnihitā, as well as hundreds of sacred fords, / Puṣkara, Nimiṣa, Prayāga, and Pṛthūdaka,

sanskrit_iast:
drumakṣetraṃ kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthasaṃyutam
kṣetrāṇi sarvato devi devatā ṛṣayas tathā //
meaning:
द्रुमक्षेत्रं कुरुक्षेत्रं नैमिषं तीर्थसंयुतम्
क्षेत्राणि सर्वतो देवि देवता ऋषयस् तथा //
text_mt: Drumakṣetra, Kurukṣetra, and Naimiṣa together with its sacred fords; / the sacred fields from all around, O goddess, and the deities and ṛṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyā ca ṛtavaścaiva sarvā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca
samudrāḥ sapta caivātra devatīrthāni kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
संध्या च ऋतवश्चैव सर्वा नद्यः सरांसि च
समुद्राः सप्त चैवात्र देवतीर्थानि कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: the twilights and the seasons, all rivers and lakes, / and the seven oceans here, and the divine sacred fords in their entirety,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgīrathīṃ sameṣyanti sarvaparvasu suvrate
avimukteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā caiva triviṣṭapam //
meaning:
भागीरथीं समेष्यन्ति सर्वपर्वसु सुव्रते
अविमुक्तेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वा चैव त्रिविष्टपम् //
text_mt: will assemble at the Bhāgīrathī on all auspicious festive days, O woman of good vows, / having seen Avimukteśvara, and having seen Triviṣṭapa.

sanskrit_iast:
kālabhairavamāsādya dhūtapāpāni sarvaśaḥ
bhavanti hi sureśāni sarvaparvasu parvasu //
meaning:
कालभैरवमासाद्य धूतपापानि सर्वशः
भवन्ति हि सुरेशानि सर्वपर्वसु पर्वसु //
text_mt: Having approached Kālabhairava, their sins are washed away on all sides; / indeed, on every festive day they become so, O ruler of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni puṇyāni mahāntyāyatanāni ca
praviśanti sadābhyetya puṇyaṃ parvasu parvasu
avimuktaṃ kṣetravaraṃ mahāpāpanibarhaṇam //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि पुण्यानि महान्त्यायतनानि च
प्रविशन्ति सदाभ्येत्य पुण्यं पर्वसु पर्वसु
अविमुक्तं क्षेत्रवरं महापापनिबर्हणम् //
text_mt: Whatever sacred and great shrines there are on earth / ever enter, having approached on festive day after festive day, / into Avimukta, the excellent sacred field that eradicates great sins.

sanskrit_iast: kedāre caiva yalliṅgaṃ yacca liṅgaṃ mahālaye //
meaning: केदारे चैव यल्लिङ्गं यच्च लिङ्गं महालये //
text_mt: Whatever liṅga there is in Kedāra, and whatever liṅga in Mahālaya,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyameśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca tathā pāśupateśvaram
śaṅkukarṇeśvaraṃ caiva gokarṇau ca tathā hyubhau //
meaning:
मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञं च तथा पाशुपतेश्वरम्
शङ्कुकर्णेश्वरं चैव गोकर्णौ च तथा ह्युभौ //
text_mt: and the one named Madhyameśvara, as well as Pāśupateśvara, / Śaṅkukarṇeśvara, and both the Gokarṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
drumacaṇḍeśvaraṃ nāma bhadreśvaram anuttamam
sthāneśvaraṃ tathaikāgraṃ kāleśvaram ajeśvaram //
meaning:
द्रुमचण्डेश्वरं नाम भद्रेश्वरम् अनुत्तमम्
स्थानेश्वरं तथैकाग्रं कालेश्वरम् अजेश्वरम् //
text_mt: the one named Drumacaṇḍeśvara, the unsurpassed Bhadreśvara, / Sthāneśvara, likewise the one-pointed Kāleśvara, Ajeśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
bhairaveśvaram īśānaṃ tathauṃkārakasaṃjñitam
amareśaṃ mahākālaṃ jyotiṣaṃ bhasmagātrakam //
meaning:
भैरवेश्वरम् ईशानं तथौंकारकसंज्ञितम्
अमरेशं महाकालं ज्योतिषं भस्मगात्रकम् //
text_mt: Bhairaveśvara, Īśāna, and the one named Oṃkāraka, / Amareśa, Mahākāla, Jyotiṣa, and Bhasmagātraka,

sanskrit_iast:
yāni cānyāni puṇyāni sthānāni mama bhūtale
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisamākhyāni rūḍhānyanyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
यानि चान्यानि पुण्यानि स्थानानि मम भूतले
अष्टषष्टिसमाख्यानि रूढान्यन्यानि कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: and whatever other sacred places of mine there are on the earth's surface, / sixty-eight in number, well-established and all others in their entirety,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni sarvāṇyaśeṣāṇi vārāṇasyāṃ viśanti mām
sarvaparvasu puṇyeṣu guhyaṃ caitadudāhṛtam //
meaning:
तानि सर्वाण्यशेषाणि वाराणस्यां विशन्ति माम्
सर्वपर्वसु पुण्येषु गुह्यं चैतदुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: all of them without exception enter into me in Vārāṇasī / on all auspicious festive days; and this has been declared as a secret.

sanskrit_iast:
teneha labhate jantur mṛto divyāmṛtaṃ padam
snātasya caiva gaṅgāyāṃ dṛṣṭena ca mayā śubhe //
meaning:
तेनेह लभते जन्तुर् मृतो दिव्यामृतं पदम्
स्नातस्य चैव गङ्गायां दृष्टेन च मया शुभे //
text_mt: Therefore a creature who dies here attains the divine immortal abode; / and for one who has bathed in the Gaṅgā and seen me, O auspicious one,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñaphalaistulyam iṣṭaiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
sadya eva samāpnoti kiṃ tataḥ paramādbhutam //
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञफलैस्तुल्यम् इष्टैः शतसहस्रशः
सद्य एव समाप्नोति किं ततः परमाद्भुतम् //
text_mt: he instantly attains the fruit equal to all sacrifices / offered by hundreds of thousands. What could be more wondrous than that?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāyatanamukhyāni divi bhūmau giriṣv api
parātparataraṃ devī budhyasveti mayoditam //
meaning:
सर्वायतनमुख्यानि दिवि भूमौ गिरिष्व् अपि
परात्परतरं देवी बुध्यस्वेति मयोदितम् //
text_mt: The foremost of all shrines in heaven, on earth, and also in the mountains, / know it, O goddess, to be higher than the highest, as told by me.

sanskrit_iast:
aviśabdena pāpastu vedoktaḥ kathyate dvijaiḥ
tena muktaṃ mayā juṣṭam avimuktam ata ucyate //
meaning:
अविशब्देन पापस्तु वेदोक्तः कथ्यते द्विजैः
तेन मुक्तं मया जुष्टम् अविमुक्तम् अत उच्यते //
text_mt: By the word 'avi', sin spoken of in the Vedas is meant by the twice-born; / freed from that, it is inhabited by me, hence it is called Avimukta.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavān rudraḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ
sudṛṣṭaṃ kuru deveśi avimuktaṃ gṛhaṃ mama //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः
सुदृष्टं कुरु देवेशि अविमुक्तं गृहं मम //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord Rudra, the Maheśvara of all the worlds, [said:] / “Behold well, O ruler of gods, Avimukta, my home.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavān devas tayā sārdham umāpatiḥ
darśayāmāsa bhagavān śrīparvatamanuttamam //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् देवस् तया सार्धम् उमापतिः
दर्शयामास भगवान् श्रीपर्वतमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord, the god, the lord of Umā, / together with her showed her the unsurpassed Śrīparvata.

sanskrit_iast:
avimukteśvare nityam avasacca sadā tayā
sarvagatvācca sarvatvāt sarvātmā sadasanmayaḥ //
meaning:
अविमुक्तेश्वरे नित्यम् अवसच्च सदा तया
सर्वगत्वाच्च सर्वत्वात् सर्वात्मा सदसन्मयः //
text_mt: He constantly resided at Avimukteśvara, ever with her; / and because he is all-pervading and omnipresent, the Self of all consists of both being and non-being.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīparvatamanuprāpya devyā deveśvaro haraḥ
kṣetrāṇi darśayāmāsa sarvabhūtapatirbhavaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीपर्वतमनुप्राप्य देव्या देवेश्वरो हरः
क्षेत्राणि दर्शयामास सर्वभूतपतिर्भवः //
text_mt: Reaching Śrīparvata with the goddess, Hara, the lord of gods, / Bhava, the lord of all beings, showed her the sacred fields:

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍīprabhaṃ ca paramaṃ divyaṃ vaiśravaṇeśvaram
āśāliṅgaṃ ca deveśaṃ divyaṃ yacca bileśvaram //
meaning:
कुण्डीप्रभं च परमं दिव्यं वैश्रवणेश्वरम्
आशालिङ्गं च देवेशं दिव्यं यच्च बिलेश्वरम् //
text_mt: The supreme Kuṇḍīprabha, divine Vaiśravaṇeśvara, / the lord of gods Āśāliṅga, and divine Bileśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeśvaraṃ ca paramaṃ viṣṇunā yatpratiṣṭhitam
dakṣiṇadvārapārśve tu kuṇḍaleśvaramīśvaram //
meaning:
रामेश्वरं च परमं विष्णुना यत्प्रतिष्ठितम्
दक्षिणद्वारपार्श्वे तु कुण्डलेश्वरमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: the supreme Rāmeśvara, which was installed by Viṣṇu, / and beside the southern gate, Lord Kuṇḍaleśvaram,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadvārasamīpasthaṃ tripurāntakamuttamam
vivṛddhaṃ giriṇā sārdhaṃ devadevanamaskṛtam //
meaning:
पूर्वद्वारसमीपस्थं त्रिपुरान्तकमुत्तमम्
विवृद्धं गिरिणा सार्धं देवदेवनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: the excellent Tripurāntaka situated near the eastern gate, / which grew together with the mountain and is bowed to by the god of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyameśvaramityuktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
amareśvaraṃ ca varadaṃ devaiḥ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
मध्यमेश्वरमित्युक्तं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
अमरेश्वरं च वरदं देवैः पूर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: the one called Madhyameśvara, renowned in the three worlds, / and the boon-giving Amareśvara, installed formerly by the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
gocarmeśvaram īśānaṃ tathendreśvaram adbhutam
karmeśvaraṃ ca vipulaṃ kāryārthaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam //
meaning:
गोचर्मेश्वरम् ईशानं तथेन्द्रेश्वरम् अद्भुतम्
कर्मेश्वरं च विपुलं कार्यार्थं ब्रह्मणा कृतम् //
text_mt: Gocarmeśvara, Īśāna, and wondrous Indreśvara, / and the extensive Karmeśvara, made by Brahmā for the sake of his purpose,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatsiddhavaṭaṃ caiva sadāvāso mamāvyaye
ajena nirmitaṃ divyaṃ sākṣādajabilaṃ śubham //
meaning:
श्रीमत्सिद्धवटं चैव सदावासो ममाव्यये
अजेन निर्मितं दिव्यं साक्षादजबिलं शुभम् //
text_mt: the glorious Siddhavata, my perpetual dwelling, O imperishable one, / the auspicious, manifest Ajabila, fashioned divine by Aja,

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva pāduke divye madīye ca bileśvare
tatra śṛṅgāṭakākāraṃ śṛṅgāṭācalamadhyame //
meaning:
तत्रैव पादुके दिव्ये मदीये च बिलेश्वरे
तत्र शृङ्गाटकाकारं शृङ्गाटाचलमध्यमे //
text_mt: right there my divine sandals in Bileśvara; / there, shaped like a four-way crossway, in the middle of Mount Śṛṅgāṭa,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgāṭakeśvaraṃ nāma śrīdevyā tu pratiṣṭhitam
mallikārjunakaṃ caiva mama vāsamidaṃ śubham //
meaning:
शृङ्गाटकेश्वरं नाम श्रीदेव्या तु प्रतिष्ठितम्
मल्लिकार्जुनकं चैव मम वासमिदं शुभम् //
text_mt: the one named Śṛṅgāṭakeśvara, installed by the glorious goddess, / and Mallikārjunaka, this auspicious abode of mine,

sanskrit_iast:
rajeśvaraṃ ca paryāye rajasā supratiṣṭhitam
gajeśvaraṃ ca vaiśākhaṃ kapoteśvaramavyayam //
meaning:
रजेश्वरं च पर्याये रजसा सुप्रतिष्ठितम्
गजेश्वरं च वैशाखं कपोतेश्वरमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Rajeśvara, well installed in due succession with dust, / Gajeśvara, Vaiśākha, and imperishable Kapoteśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭīśvaraṃ mahātīrthaṃ rudrakoṭigaṇaiḥ purā
sevitaṃ devi paśyādya sarvasmādadhikaṃ śubham //
meaning:
कोटीश्वरं महातीर्थं रुद्रकोटिगणैः पुरा
सेवितं देवि पश्याद्य सर्वस्मादधिकं शुभम् //
text_mt: Koṭīśvara, the great sacred ford, formerly frequented / by the hosts of crores of Rudras; see it today, O goddess, more auspicious than all.

sanskrit_iast:
dvidevakulasaṃjñaṃ ca brahmaṇā dakṣiṇe śubham
uttare sthāpitaṃ caiva viṣṇunā caiva śailajam //
meaning:
द्विदेवकुलसंज्ञं च ब्रह्मणा दक्षिणे शुभम्
उत्तरे स्थापितं चैव विष्णुना चैव शैलजम् //
text_mt: And the auspicious one called Dvidevakula on the south by Brahmā, / and established on the north by Viṣṇu, born of the mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpramāṇaliṅgaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
paścime parvate paśya brahmeśvaramaleśvaram //
meaning:
महाप्रमाणलिङ्गं च मया पूर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
पश्चिमे पर्वते पश्य ब्रह्मेश्वरमलेश्वरम् //
text_mt: and the liṅga of great measure, formerly installed by me; / look upon Brahmeśvara and Aleśvara on the western mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkṛtaṃ tvayā brahman purastān munibhiḥ saha
ityuktvā tadgṛhe tiṣṭhad alaṃgṛhamiti smṛtam //
meaning:
अलंकृतं त्वया ब्रह्मन् पुरस्तान् मुनिभिः सह
इत्युक्त्वा तद्गृहे तिष्ठद् अलंगृहमिति स्मृतम् //
text_mt: “It has been adorned by you, O Brahmā, in front together with the sages.” / Saying this, he stayed in that dwelling, which is commemorated as Alaṃgṛha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi tīrthaṃ tīrthajñe vyomaliṅgaṃ ca paśya me
kadambeśvaram etaddhi skandenaiva pratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
तत्रापि तीर्थं तीर्थज्ञे व्योमलिङ्गं च पश्य मे
कदम्बेश्वरम् एतद्धि स्कन्देनैव प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: There also is a sacred ford, O knower of sacred fords; behold my Vyomaliṅga. / This is Kadambeśvara, installed by Skanda himself,

sanskrit_iast:
gomaṇḍaleśvaraṃ caiva nandādyaiḥ supratiṣṭhitam
devaiḥ sarvaistu śakrādyaiḥ sthāpitāni varānane //
meaning:
गोमण्डलेश्वरं चैव नन्दाद्यैः सुप्रतिष्ठितम्
देवैः सर्वैस्तु शक्राद्यैः स्थापितानि वरानने //
text_mt: and Gomaṇḍaleśvara, well installed by Nandā and others; / all these were established by the gods headed by Śakra, O fair-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmaddevahradaprānte sthānānīmāni paśya me
tathā hārapure devi tava hāre nipātite //
meaning:
श्रीमद्देवह्रदप्रान्ते स्थानानीमानि पश्य मे
तथा हारपुरे देवि तव हारे निपातिते //
text_mt: Behold these places of mine on the edge of the glorious Devahrada. / Likewise, O goddess, in Hārapura, when your necklace fell down,

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā hitāya jagatāṃ hārakuṇḍamidaṃ kṛtam
śivarudrapure caiva tatkāyopari suvrate //
meaning:
त्वया हिताय जगतां हारकुण्डमिदं कृतम्
शिवरुद्रपुरे चैव तत्कायोपरि सुव्रते //
text_mt: this Hārakuṇḍa was made by you for the welfare of the worlds; / and in Śivarudrapura, over that body, O lady of good vows,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pitrā suśailena sthāpitaṃ tvacaleśvaram
alaṃkṛtaṃ mayā brahma purastān munibhiḥ saha //
meaning:
तत्र पित्रा सुशैलेन स्थापितं त्वचलेश्वरम्
अलंकृतं मया ब्रह्म पुरस्तान् मुनिभिः सह //
text_mt: there Acaleśvara was established by your father, the good mountain. / “O Brahmā, it was adorned by me in front along with the sages.”

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍikeśvarakaṃ devi caṇḍikeśā tavātmajā
caṇḍikānirmitaṃ sthānam aṃbikātīrtham uttamam //
meaning:
चण्डिकेश्वरकं देवि चण्डिकेशा तवात्मजा
चण्डिकानिर्मितं स्थानम् अंबिकातीर्थम् उत्तमम् //
text_mt: Caṇḍikeśvaraka, O goddess, whose Caṇḍikā is your daughter, / the place fashioned by Caṇḍikā, the excellent sacred ford of Aṃbikā.

sanskrit_iast:
rucikeśvarakaṃ caiva dhāraiṣā kapilā śubhā
eteṣu devi sthāneṣu tīrtheṣu vividheṣu ca //
meaning:
रुचिकेश्वरकं चैव धारैषा कपिला शुभा
एतेषु देवि स्थानेषु तीर्थेषु विविधेषु च //
text_mt: And Rucikeśvaraka, and this auspicious stream Kapilā; / in these places and various sacred sites, O goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayenmāṃ sadā bhaktyā mayā sārdhaṃ hi modate
śrīśaile saṃtyajed dehaṃ brāhmaṇo dagdhakilbiṣaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेन्मां सदा भक्त्या मया सार्धं हि मोदते
श्रीशैले संत्यजेद् देहं ब्राह्मणो दग्धकिल्बिषः //
text_mt: one should always worship me with devotion; he rejoices with me. / A brāhmaṇa whose sins are burned away who abandons his body at Śrīśaila,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate nātra saṃdeho hy avimukte yathā śubham
mahāsnānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād ghṛtena vidhinaiva tu //
meaning:
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहो ह्य् अविमुक्ते यथा शुभम्
महास्नानं च यः कुर्याद् घृतेन विधिनैव तु //
text_mt: is liberated—there is no doubt about this—just as auspiciously in Avimukta. / And whoever performs the great bath with ghee according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti mama sāyujyaṃ sthāneṣveteṣu suvrate
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyam abhyaṅgaṃ pañcaviṃśati //
meaning:
स याति मम सायुज्यं स्थानेष्वेतेषु सुव्रते
स्नानं पलशतं ज्ञेयम् अभ्यङ्गं पञ्चविंशति //
text_mt: he attains intimate union with me in these places, O lady of good vows. / A bath is known to be one hundred palas, an unction twenty-five [palas];

sanskrit_iast:
palānāṃ dve sahasre tu mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtitam
snāpya liṅgaṃ madīyaṃ tu gavyenaiva ghṛtena ca //
meaning:
पलानां द्वे सहस्रे तु महास्नानं प्रकीर्तितम्
स्नाप्य लिङ्गं मदीयं तु गव्येनैव घृतेन च //
text_mt: the great bath is proclaimed to be of two thousand palas. / Having bathed my liṅga with ghee produced from cow's milk,

sanskrit_iast:
viśodhya sarvadravyaistu vāribhir abhiṣiñcati
saṃmārjya śatayajñānāṃ snānena prayutaṃ tathā //
meaning:
विशोध्य सर्वद्रव्यैस्तु वारिभिर् अभिषिञ्चति
संमार्ज्य शतयज्ञानां स्नानेन प्रयुतं तथा //
text_mt: and purified it with all substances, he sprinkles it with waters. / Having wiped it, [the merit] of a hundred sacrifices is gained by a bath, and a million

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayā śatasāhasram anantaṃ gītavādinām
mahāsnāne prasaktaṃ tu snānamaṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
पूजया शतसाहस्रम् अनन्तं गीतवादिनाम्
महास्नाने प्रसक्तं तु स्नानमष्टगुणं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: by worship, a hundred thousand [by music], and endless [merit] by singers and musicians. / When one is devoted to the great bath, the bath is considered eight times greater,

sanskrit_iast:
jalena kevalenaiva gandhatoyena bhaktitaḥ
anulepanaṃ tu tat sarvaṃ pañcaviṃśatpalena vai //
meaning:
जलेन केवलेनैव गन्धतोयेन भक्तितः
अनुलेपनं तु तत् सर्वं पञ्चविंशत्पलेन वै //
text_mt: with water alone or with fragrant water offered with devotion. / The unguent altogether should be twenty-five palas.

sanskrit_iast:
śamīpuṣpaṃ ca vidhinā bilvapatraṃ ca paṅkajam
anyānyapi ca puṣpāṇi bilvapatraṃ na saṃtyajet //
meaning:
शमीपुष्पं च विधिना बिल्वपत्रं च पङ्कजम्
अन्यान्यपि च पुष्पाणि बिल्वपत्रं न संत्यजेत् //
text_mt: Śamī flowers according to the rule, bilva leaves, and lotus, / and other flowers as well; one must not omit the bilva leaf.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdroṇair mahādevam aṣṭadroṇairathāpi vā
daśadroṇais tu naivedyam aṣṭadroṇairathāpi vā //
meaning:
चतुर्द्रोणैर् महादेवम् अष्टद्रोणैरथापि वा
दशद्रोणैस् तु नैवेद्यम् अष्टद्रोणैरथापि वा //
text_mt: To Mahādeva [one should offer a food offering] of four droṇas, or eight droṇas, / or a food offering of ten droṇas, or else of eight droṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
śatadroṇasamaṃ puṇyam āḍhake 'pi vidhīyate
vittahīnasya viprasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
शतद्रोणसमं पुण्यम् आढके ऽपि विधीयते
वित्तहीनस्य विप्रस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Merit equal to a hundred droṇas is prescribed even for an āḍhaka / for a brāhmaṇa who lacks wealth; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
bherīmṛdaṅgamurajatimirāpaṭahādibhiḥ
vāditrairvividhaiścānyair ninādairvividhairapi //
meaning:
भेरीमृदङ्गमुरजतिमिरापटहादिभिः
वादित्रैर्विविधैश्चान्यैर् निनादैर्विविधैरपि //
text_mt: With kettle-drums, mṛdaṅgas, murajas, timirās, paṭahas, and the like, / with various musical instruments and other diverse sounds,

sanskrit_iast:
jāgaraṃ kārayedyastu prārthayecca yathākramam
sa bhṛtyaputradāraiś ca tathā saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ //
meaning:
जागरं कारयेद्यस्तु प्रार्थयेच्च यथाक्रमम्
स भृत्यपुत्रदारैश् च तथा संबन्धिबान्धवैः //
text_mt: he who keeps vigil and prays in proper order, / he, together with servants, sons, wives, and relations and kinsmen,

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prārthayelliṅgam uttamam
dravyahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ sureśvara //
meaning:
सार्धं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रार्थयेल्लिङ्गम् उत्तमम्
द्रव्यहीनं क्रियाहीनं श्रद्धाहीनं सुरेश्वर //
text_mt: having made circumambulation, should pray to the supreme liṅga: / 'Lacking wealth, lacking rites, lacking faith, O Lord of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ vā na kṛtaṃ vāpi kṣantumarhasi śaṅkara
ityuktvā vai japedrudraṃ tvaritaṃ śāntimeva ca //
meaning:
कृतं वा न कृतं वापि क्षन्तुमर्हसि शङ्कर
इत्युक्त्वा वै जपेद्रुद्रं त्वरितं शान्तिमेव च //
text_mt: done or not done, you ought to forgive it, O Śaṅkara.' / Having spoken thus, he should quickly recite the Rudra hymn for peace.

sanskrit_iast:
japitvaivaṃ mahābījaṃ tathā pañcākṣarasya vai
sa evaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam //
meaning:
जपित्वैवं महाबीजं तथा पञ्चाक्षरस्य वै
स एवं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम् //
text_mt: Having thus recited the great seed-syllable and the five-syllable mantra, / whatever fruit is obtained in all sacred sites and in all sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vārāṇasyāṃ yathā mṛtaḥ
tathaiva mama sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति वाराणस्यां यथा मृतः
तथैव मम सायुज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: that fruit he fully obtains, just as one who dies in Vārāṇasī; / likewise he attains intimate union with me, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
matpriyārthamidaṃ kāryaṃ madbhaktairvidhipūrvakam
ye na kurvanti te bhaktā na bhavanti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
मत्प्रियार्थमिदं कार्यं मद्भक्तैर्विधिपूर्वकम्
ये न कुर्वन्ति ते भक्ता न भवन्ति न संशयः //
text_mt: This is to be done according to the rule by my devotees for my pleasure; / those who do not do it are not devotees, there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
niśamya vacanaṃ devī gatvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm
avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ payasā ca ghṛtena ca //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
निशम्य वचनं देवी गत्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम्
अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं पयसा च घृतेन च //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing his words, the goddess went to the city of Vārāṇasī, / and the Avimukteśvara liṅga, with milk and ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayāmāsa deveśaṃ rudraṃ bhuvananāyakam
avimukte ca tapasā mandarasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अर्चयामास देवेशं रुद्रं भुवननायकम्
अविमुक्ते च तपसा मन्दरस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: she worshipped, [honouring] the lord of gods, Rudra, ruler of the universe. / And through the austerity of the great-souled Mandara at Avimukta,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpayāmāsa vai kṣetraṃ mandare cārukandare
tatrāndhakaṃ mahādaityaṃ hiraṇyākṣasutaṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
कल्पयामास वै क्षेत्रं मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे
तत्रान्धकं महादैत्यं हिरण्याक्षसुतं प्रभुः //
text_mt: he prepared the sacred field in the beautiful cave of Mandara. / There, having shown grace to the great daitya Andhaka, son of Hiraṇyākṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
anugṛhya gaṇatvaṃ ca prāpayāmāsa līlayā
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kathāsarvasvamādarāt //
meaning:
अनुगृह्य गणत्वं च प्रापयामास लीलया
एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं कथासर्वस्वमादरात् //
text_mt: the Lord raised him playfully to the status of a gaṇa. / All this has been narrated to you with respect, the whole essence of the story.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam
sarvakṣetreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ sahasā labhet //
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
सर्वक्षेत्रेषु यत्पुण्यं तत्सर्वं सहसा लभेत् //
text_mt: Whoever reads or listens to this supreme majesty of the sacred field / quickly obtains all the merit that exists in all sacred fields.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvayedvā dvijānsarvān kṛtaśaucān jitendriyān
sa eva sarvayajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान्सर्वान् कृतशौचान् जितेन्द्रियान्
स एव सर्वयज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः //
text_mt: Or if he recites it to all twice-born who are purified and have subdued their senses, / that man obtains the fruit of all sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
andhako nāma daityendro mandare cārukandare
damitastu kathaṃ lebhe gāṇapatyaṃ maheśvarāt //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
अन्धको नाम दैत्येन्द्रो मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे
दमितस्तु कथं लेभे गाणपत्यं महेश्वरात् //
text_mt: The sages said: / "How did the lord of daityas named Andhaka, in the beautiful cave of Mandara, / being subdued, obtain the status of gaṇa-lord from Maheśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam
andhakānugrahaṃ caiva mandare śoṣaṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं यथावृत्तं यथाश्रुतम्
अन्धकानुग्रहं चैव मन्दरे शोषणं तथा //
text_mt: You ought to tell us what took place, as it was heard [by you], / both the grace shown to Andhaka and the drying up at Mandara."

sanskrit_iast:
varalābhamaśeṣaṃ ca pravadāmi samāsataḥ
hiraṇyākṣasya tanayo hiraṇyanayanopamaḥ //
meaning:
वरलाभमशेषं च प्रवदामि समासतः
हिरण्याक्षस्य तनयो हिरण्यनयनोपमः //
text_mt: "I shall declare concisely the complete attainment of the boon: / The son of Hiraṇyākṣa, resembling the golden-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
purāndhaka iti khyātas tapasā labdhavikramaḥ
prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ sākṣād avadhyatvamavāpya ca //
meaning:
पुरान्धक इति ख्यातस् तपसा लब्धविक्रमः
प्रसादाद्ब्रह्मणः साक्षाद् अवध्यत्वमवाप्य च //
text_mt: celebrated of old as Andhaka, who gained prowess through austerity, / having obtained invulnerability directly by the grace of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyamakhilaṃ bhuktvā jitvā cendrapuraṃ purā
līlayā cāprayatnena trāsayāmāsa vāsavam //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं भुक्त्वा जित्वा चेन्द्रपुरं पुरा
लीलया चाप्रयत्नेन त्रासयामास वासवम् //
text_mt: enjoyed the entire three worlds and conquered the city of Indra of old, / and playfully, without effort, terrified Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
bādhitāstāḍitā baddhāḥ pātitāstena te surāḥ
viviśurmandaraṃ bhītā nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
बाधितास्ताडिता बद्धाः पातितास्तेन ते सुराः
विविशुर्मन्दरं भीता नारायणपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: Oppressed, beaten, bound, and struck down by him, / the gods, terrified, entered Mandara with Nārāyaṇa at their head.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpīḍya vai devān andhako 'pi mahāsuraḥ
yadṛcchayā giriṃ prāpto mandaraṃ cārukandaram //
meaning:
एवं संपीड्य वै देवान् अन्धको ऽपि महासुरः
यदृच्छया गिरिं प्राप्तो मन्दरं चारुकन्दरम् //
