text_mt: Having thus tormented the gods, the great asura Andhaka / also happened to reach the mountain Mandara, of beautiful caves.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste samastāḥ surendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sureśaṃ maheśaṃ puretyāhurevam
drutaṃ cālpavīryaprabhinnāṅgabhinnā vayaṃ daityarājasya śastrairnikṛttāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते समस्ताः सुरेन्द्राः ससाध्याः सुरेशं महेशं पुरेत्याहुरेवम्
द्रुतं चाल्पवीर्यप्रभिन्नाङ्गभिन्ना वयं दैत्यराजस्य शस्त्रैर्निकृत्ताः //
text_mt: Then all those lords of gods together with the sādhyas said to Maheśa, lord of gods, approaching him: / 'Quickly, our bodies shattered by diminished strength, we are cut to pieces by the daitya king's weapons.'

sanskrit_iast:
itīdamakhilaṃ śrutvā daityāgamam anaupamam
gaṇeśvaraiś ca bhagavān andhakābhimukhaṃ yayau //
meaning:
इतीदमखिलं श्रुत्वा दैत्यागमम् अनौपमम्
गणेश्वरैश् च भगवान् अन्धकाभिमुखं ययौ //
text_mt: Hearing this entire report of the peerless arrival of the daitya, / the Lord went towards Andhaka accompanied by the lords of the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: jayeti vācā bhagavantam ūcuḥ kirīṭabaddhāñjalayaḥ samantāt //
meaning: जयेति वाचा भगवन्तम् ऊचुः किरीटबद्धाञ्जलयः समन्तात् //
text_mt: With crowns bowed and palms joined on all sides, they said to the Lord with the word, 'Victory!'

sanskrit_iast:
athāśeṣāsurāṃstasya koṭikoṭiśatais tataḥ
bhasmīkṛtya mahādevo nirbibhedāndhakaṃ tadā //
meaning:
अथाशेषासुरांस्तस्य कोटिकोटिशतैस् ततः
भस्मीकृत्य महादेवो निर्बिभेदान्धकं तदा //
text_mt: Then, having reduced all his asuras to ashes by hundreds of crores, / Mahādeva pierced Andhaka.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlena śūlinā protaṃ dagdhakalmaṣakañcukam
dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ nanādeśaṃ praṇamya sa pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
शूलेन शूलिना प्रोतं दग्धकल्मषकञ्चुकम्
दृष्ट्वान्धकं ननादेशं प्रणम्य स पितामहः //
text_mt: Seeing Andhaka impaled on the trident by the trident-bearer, his armour of defilement burned away, / Pitāmaha bowed down and shouted praises to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tannādaśravaṇānnedur devā devaṃ praṇamya tam
nanṛturmunayaḥ sarve mumudurgaṇapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
तन्नादश्रवणान्नेदुर् देवा देवं प्रणम्य तम्
ननृतुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुमुदुर्गणपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: Hearing that shout, the gods bowed down to that god and roared; / all the sages danced, and the foremost gaṇas rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi devāḥ śaṃbhostadopari
trailokyamakhilaṃ harṣān nananda ca nanāda ca //
meaning:
ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षाणि देवाः शंभोस्तदोपरि
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं हर्षान् ननन्द च ननाद च //
text_mt: The gods showered rainfalls of flowers upon Śambhu; / out of joy, the entire threefold world exulted and roared.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdho 'gninā ca śūlena protaḥ preta ivāndhakaḥ
sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāsthāya cintayāmāsa cetasā //
meaning:
दग्धो ऽग्निना च शूलेन प्रोतः प्रेत इवान्धकः
सात्त्विकं भावमास्थाय चिन्तयामास चेतसा //
text_mt: Burned by fire and impaled on the trident like a ghost, Andhaka, / adopting a sattva-filled disposition, thought in his mind:

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntare 'pi devena dagdho yasmācchivena vai
ārādhito mayā śaṃbhuḥ purā sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
जन्मान्तरे ऽपि देवेन दग्धो यस्माच्छिवेन वै
आराधितो मया शंभुः पुरा साक्षान्महेश्वरः //
text_mt: 'Because I am burned by the god Śiva, even in another life / Śambhu, the manifest Maheśvara, was worshipped by me of old.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādetanmayā labdham anyathā nopapadyate
yaḥ smarenmanasā rudraṃ prāṇānte sakṛdeva vā //
meaning:
तस्मादेतन्मया लब्धम् अन्यथा नोपपद्यते
यः स्मरेन्मनसा रुद्रं प्राणान्ते सकृदेव वा //
text_mt: Therefore this has been obtained by me; otherwise it would not be possible. / Whoever remembers Rudra with his mind even once at the end of life,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ kiṃ punarbahuśaḥ smaran
brahmā ca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ //
meaning:
स याति शिवसायुज्यं किं पुनर्बहुशः स्मरन्
ब्रह्मा च भगवान्विष्णुः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः //
text_mt: attains intimate union with Śiva; how much more so one who remembers him repeatedly? / Brahmā and the blessed Viṣṇu, and all the gods together with Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ prāpya tiṣṭhanti tameva śaraṇaṃ vrajet
evaṃ saṃcintya tuṣṭātmā so 'ndhakaś cāndhakārdanam //
meaning:
शरणं प्राप्य तिष्ठन्ति तमेव शरणं व्रजेत्
एवं संचिन्त्य तुष्टात्मा सो ऽन्धकश् चान्धकार्दनम् //
text_mt: abide having taken refuge; one should seek refuge in him alone.' / Thinking thus, his mind pleased, that Andhaka praised the destroyer of Andhaka,

sanskrit_iast:
sagaṇaṃ śivamīśānam astuvatpuṇyagauravāt
prārthitastena bhagavān paramārtiharo haraḥ //
meaning:
सगणं शिवमीशानम् अस्तुवत्पुण्यगौरवात्
प्रार्थितस्तेन भगवान् परमार्तिहरो हरः //
text_mt: Śiva, Īśāna, along with his gaṇa, through the gravity of merit. / Prayed to by him, the Lord Hara, remover of supreme distress,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyanetratanayaṃ śūlāgrasthaṃ sureśvaraḥ
provāca dānavaṃ prekṣya ghṛṇayā nīlalohitaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यनेत्रतनयं शूलाग्रस्थं सुरेश्वरः
प्रोवाच दानवं प्रेक्ष्य घृणया नीललोहितः //
text_mt: the Lord of gods, Nīlalohita, looking out of pity at the dānava, / the son of Hiraṇyanetra situated on the tip of the trident, said:

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭo 'smi vatsa bhadraṃ te kāmaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te
varānvaraya daityendra varado 'haṃ tavāndhaka //
meaning:
तुष्टो ऽस्मि वत्स भद्रं ते कामं किं करवाणि ते
वरान्वरय दैत्येन्द्र वरदो ऽहं तवान्धक //
text_mt: 'I am pleased, my child; blessing upon you! What desire of yours may I fulfil? / Choose boons, O lord of daityas; I am the giver of boons to you, O Andhaka.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākyaṃ tadā śaṃbhor hiraṇyanayanātmajaḥ
harṣagadgadayā vācā provācedaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं तदा शंभोर् हिरण्यनयनात्मजः
हर्षगद्गदया वाचा प्रोवाचेदं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Hearing the words of Śambhu, the son of the golden-eyed one / said this to Maheśvara in a voice faltering with joy:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevadeveśa bhaktārtihara śaṅkara
tvayi bhaktiḥ prasīdeśa yadi deyo varaś ca me //
meaning:
भगवन्देवदेवेश भक्तार्तिहर शङ्कर
त्वयि भक्तिः प्रसीदेश यदि देयो वरश् च मे //
text_mt:
"O Lord, Lord of the gods of gods, dispeller of the distress of devotees, Śaṅkara,
if a boon is to be given to me, be pleased, O Lord: [let there be] devotion to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā bhavo 'pi vacanam andhakasya mahātmanaḥ
pradadau durlabhāṃ śraddhāṃ daityendrāya mahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा भवो ऽपि वचनम् अन्धकस्य महात्मनः
प्रददौ दुर्लभां श्रद्धां दैत्येन्द्राय महाद्युतिः //
text_mt:
Having heard the words of the high-souled Andhaka,
Bhava, of great splendour, granted rare faith to the lord of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
gāṇapatyaṃ ca daityāya pradadau cāvaropya tam
praṇemustaṃ surendrādyā gāṇapatye pratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
गाणपत्यं च दैत्याय प्रददौ चावरोप्य तम्
प्रणेमुस्तं सुरेन्द्राद्या गाणपत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt:
And bringing him down, he granted leadership of the gaṇas to the Daitya;
established in the leadership of the gaṇas, the lords of the gods and others bowed to him.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathamasya pitā daityo hiraṇyākṣaḥ sudāruṇaḥ
viṣṇunā sūdito viṣṇur vārāhatvaṃ kathaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथमस्य पिता दैत्यो हिरण्याक्षः सुदारुणः
विष्णुना सूदितो विष्णुर् वाराहत्वं कथं गतः //
text_mt:
The sages said:
How was his father, the most fierce Daitya Hiraṇyākṣa,
slain by Viṣṇu? How did Viṣṇu assume the state of a boar?

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śṛṅgaṃ maheśasya bhūṣaṇatvaṃ kathaṃ gatam
etatsarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa sūta vaktumihārhasi //
meaning:
तस्य शृङ्गं महेशस्य भूषणत्वं कथं गतम्
एतत्सर्वं विशेषेण सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि //
text_mt:
How did his tusk become an ornament for Maheśa?
O Sūta, you ought to tell all this in detail here.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
hiraṇyakaśiporbhrātā hiraṇyākṣa iti smṛtaḥ
purāndhakāsureśasya pitā kālāntakopamaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
हिरण्यकशिपोर्भ्राता हिरण्याक्ष इति स्मृतः
पुरान्धकासुरेशस्य पिता कालान्तकोपमः //

sanskrit_iast:
devāñjitvātha daityendro baddhvā ca dharaṇīmimām
nītvā rasātalaṃ cakre vandīm indīvaraprabhām //
meaning:
देवाञ्जित्वाथ दैत्येन्द्रो बद्ध्वा च धरणीमिमाम्
नीत्वा रसातलं चक्रे वन्दीम् इन्दीवरप्रभाम् //
text_mt:
Then, having conquered the gods and bound this earth,
the lord of the Daityas took her to Rasātala and made a captive of her who has the lustre of a blue lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ
bādhitāstāḍitā baddhvā hiraṇyākṣeṇa tena vai //
meaning:
ततः सब्रह्मका देवाः परिम्लानमुखश्रियः
बाधितास्ताडिता बद्ध्वा हिरण्याक्षेण तेन वै //
text_mt:
Then the gods, together with Brahmā, the splendour of their faces faded,
oppressed, beaten, and bound indeed by that Hiraṇyākṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
balinā daityamukhyena krūreṇa sudurātmanā
praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ daityakoṭivimardanam //
meaning:
बलिना दैत्यमुख्येन क्रूरेण सुदुरात्मना
प्रणम्य शिरसा विष्णुं दैत्यकोटिविमर्दनम् //
text_mt:
by that mighty leader of the Daityas, cruel and exceedingly wicked-minded,
bowed with their heads to Viṣṇu, the crusher of tens of millions of Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve vijñāpayāmāsur dharaṇībandhanaṃ hareḥ
śrutvaitadbhagavān viṣṇur dharaṇībandhanaṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे विज्ञापयामासुर् धरणीबन्धनं हरेः
श्रुत्वैतद्भगवान् विष्णुर् धरणीबन्धनं हरिः //
text_mt:
They all reported the binding of the earth to Hari.
Hearing this binding of the earth, the Blessed Viṣṇu, Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtvā yajñavarāho 'sau yathā liṅgodbhave tathā
daityaiś ca sārdhaṃ daityendraṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam //
meaning:
भूत्वा यज्ञवराहो ऽसौ यथा लिङ्गोद्भवे तथा
दैत्यैश् च सार्धं दैत्येन्द्रं हिरण्याक्षं महाबलम् //
text_mt:
having become the Boar of Sacrifice—just as at the manifestation of the liṅga—
[encountered] the exceedingly powerful lord of the Daityas, Hiraṇyākṣa, along with the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrāgrakoṭyā hatvainaṃ reje daityāntakṛtprabhuḥ
kalpādiṣu yathāpūrvaṃ praviśya ca rasātalam //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राग्रकोट्या हत्वैनं रेजे दैत्यान्तकृत्प्रभुः
कल्पादिषु यथापूर्वं प्रविश्य च रसातलम् //
text_mt:
Having slain him with the tip of his sharp tusk, the Lord, the destroyer of Daityas, shone resplendent.
And entering Rasātala as before at the beginning of the kalpas,

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya vasudhāṃ devīm aṅkasthāmakarodbahiḥ
tatas tuṣṭāva deveśaṃ devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
आनीय वसुधां देवीम् अङ्कस्थामकरोद्बहिः
ततस् तुष्टाव देवेशं देवदेवः पितामहः //
text_mt:
bringing the goddess Earth, he placed her on his lap outside.
Then Pitāmaha, the god of gods, praised the Lord of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
śakrādyaiḥ sahito bhūtvā harṣagadgadayā girā
śāśvatāya varāhāya daṃṣṭriṇe daṇḍine namaḥ //
meaning:
शक्राद्यैः सहितो भूत्वा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा
शाश्वताय वराहाय दंष्ट्रिणे दण्डिने नमः //
text_mt:
joined by Śakra and the others, with a voice faltering with joy:
"Obeisance to the eternal Boar, the tusker, the staff-bearer!

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇāya sarvāya brahmaṇe paramātmane
kartre dhartre dharāyāstu hartre devāriṇāṃ svayam
kartre netre surendrāṇāṃ śāstre ca sakalasya ca //
meaning:
नारायणाय सर्वाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने
कर्त्रे धर्त्रे धरायास्तु हर्त्रे देवारिणां स्वयम्
कर्त्रे नेत्रे सुरेन्द्राणां शास्त्रे च सकलस्य च //
text_mt:
To Nārāyaṇa, to Sarva, to Brahman, to the Supreme Self,
the maker and sustainer of the earth, the slayer of the foes of the gods himself,
the maker and guide of the lords of the gods, and the ruler of all!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamaṣṭamūrtistvamanantamūrtis tvamādidevastvamanantaveditaḥ
tvayā kṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ prasīda sureśa lokeśa varāha viṣṇo //
meaning:
त्वमष्टमूर्तिस्त्वमनन्तमूर्तिस् त्वमादिदेवस्त्वमनन्तवेदितः
त्वया कृतं सर्वमिदं प्रसीद सुरेश लोकेश वराह विष्णो //
text_mt:
You are the eight-formed one, you are the endless-formed one, you are the primal god, you are known through endless [texts];
all this was made by you; be gracious, O Lord of the gods, Lord of the world, O Boar, O Viṣṇu!

sanskrit_iast:
tathaikadaṃṣṭrāgramukhāgrakoṭibhāgaikabhāgārdhatamena viṣṇo
hatāḥ kṣaṇāt kāmada daityamukhyāḥ svadaṃṣṭrakoṭyā saha putrabhṛtyaiḥ //
meaning:
तथैकदंष्ट्राग्रमुखाग्रकोटिभागैकभागार्धतमेन विष्णो
हताः क्षणात् कामद दैत्यमुख्याः स्वदंष्ट्रकोट्या सह पुत्रभृत्यैः //
text_mt:
Likewise, O Viṣṇu, by a mere half-fraction of the front edge of the tip of a single tusk,
the foremost Daityas, together with their sons and servants, were slain in an instant, O granter of desires, by the tip of your tusk!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayoddhṛtā deva dharā dhareśa dharādharākāra dhṛtāgradaṃṣṭre
dharādharaiḥ sarvajanaiḥ samudraiḥ surāsuraiḥ sevitacandravaktra //
meaning:
त्वयोद्धृता देव धरा धरेश धराधराकार धृताग्रदंष्ट्रे
धराधरैः सर्वजनैः समुद्रैः सुरासुरैः सेवितचन्द्रवक्त्र //
text_mt:
By you, O God, Lord of the earth, bearing the form of a mountain, holding [her] on the tip of your tusk, the earth was lifted up,
O you whose moon-like face is attended by mountains, by all people, by oceans, by gods and Asuras!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva deveśa vibho kṛtaś ca jayaḥ surāṇāmasureśvarāṇām
aho pradattastu varaḥ prasīda vāgdevatā vārijasaṃbhavāya //
meaning:
त्वयैव देवेश विभो कृतश् च जयः सुराणामसुरेश्वराणाम्
अहो प्रदत्तस्तु वरः प्रसीद वाग्देवता वारिजसंभवाय //
text_mt:
By you alone, O Lord of the gods, O omnipresent one, was victory wrought for the gods over the lords of the Asuras;
oh, a boon was granted to the lotus-born one [Brahmā] and the goddess of speech; be pleased!

sanskrit_iast: nihitā rasātalagatā vasuṃdharā tava pṛṣṭhataḥ sakalatārakādayaḥ //
meaning: निहिता रसातलगता वसुंधरा तव पृष्ठतः सकलतारकादयः //
text_mt: The earth that had gone to Rasātala was deposited [by you]; upon your back are all the stars and heavenly bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatāṃ hitāya bhavatā vasuṃdharā bhagavan rasātalapuṭaṃ gatā tadā
abaloddhṛtā ca bhagavaṃstavaiva sakalaṃ tvayaiva hi dhṛtaṃ jagadguro //
meaning:
जगतां हिताय भवता वसुंधरा भगवन् रसातलपुटं गता तदा
अबलोद्धृता च भगवंस्तवैव सकलं त्वयैव हि धृतं जगद्गुरो //
text_mt:
For the welfare of the worlds, O Blessed One, the earth, which had then reached the hollow of Rasātala,
was lifted up by you, the powerless [rescued]; all is indeed yours, for by you alone is it sustained, O Guru of the world!

sanskrit_iast:
iti vākpatirbahuvidhaistavārcanaiḥ praṇipatya viṣṇumamaraiḥ prajāpatiḥ
vividhānvarān harimukhāttu labdhavān harinābhivārijadehabhṛt svayam //
meaning:
इति वाक्पतिर्बहुविधैस्तवार्चनैः प्रणिपत्य विष्णुममरैः प्रजापतिः
विविधान्वरान् हरिमुखात्तु लब्धवान् हरिनाभिवारिजदेहभृत् स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Thus Prajāpati, the lord of speech, having bowed to Viṣṇu together with the immortals through many kinds of praise and worship,
obtained various boons from the mouth of Hari, he who himself bears a body born from the lotus of Hari's navel."

sanskrit_iast:
atha tāmuddhṛtāṃ tena dharāṃ devā munīśvarāḥ
mūrdhnyāropya namaścakruś cakriṇaḥ saṃnidhau tadā //
meaning:
अथ तामुद्धृतां तेन धरां देवा मुनीश्वराः
मूर्ध्न्यारोप्य नमश्चक्रुश् चक्रिणः संनिधौ तदा //
text_mt:
Then the gods and the foremost of sages placed on their heads that earth
lifted up by him, and bowed in the presence of the discus-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva varāheṇa coddhṛtāsi varaprade
kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakāryeṇa śatahastena viṣṇunā //
meaning:
अनेनैव वराहेण चोद्धृतासि वरप्रदे
कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकार्येण शतहस्तेन विष्णुना //
text_mt:
"You have been lifted up by this very Boar, O granter of boons,
by Kṛṣṇa of effortless deeds, by Viṣṇu of a hundred arms.

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇi tvaṃ mahābhoge bhūmistvaṃ dhenuravyaye
lokānāṃ dhāriṇī tvaṃ hi mṛttike hara pātakam //
meaning:
धरणि त्वं महाभोगे भूमिस्त्वं धेनुरव्यये
लोकानां धारिणी त्वं हि मृत्तिके हर पातकम् //
text_mt:
O Earth, you of great enjoyment, you are the soil, you are the cow, O imperishable one,
you are indeed the supporter of the worlds; O earth-clay, remove our sin!

sanskrit_iast:
manasā karmaṇā vācā varade vārijekṣaṇe
tvayā hatena pāpena jīvāmastvatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा वरदे वारिजेक्षणे
त्वया हतेन पापेन जीवामस्त्वत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt:
In thought, word, and deed, O granter of boons, lotus-eyed one,
with our sin destroyed by you, we live through your grace!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā sā tadā devī dharā devair athābravīt
varāhadaṃṣṭrābhinnāyāṃ dharāyāṃ mṛttikāṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्ता सा तदा देवी धरा देवैर् अथाब्रवीत्
वराहदंष्ट्राभिन्नायां धरायां मृत्तिकां द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Thus addressed then by the gods, the goddess Earth said:
"O twice-born ones, whoever applies to his head, with this mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena yo bibhrat mūrdhni pāpātpramucyate
āyuṣmān balavān dhanyaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन यो बिभ्रत् मूर्ध्नि पापात्प्रमुच्यते
आयुष्मान् बलवान् धन्यः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः //
text_mt:
the clay from the earth split open by the Boar's tusk, is released from sin;
he becomes long-lived, strong, blessed, and endowed with sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
kramādbhuvi divaṃ prāpya karmānte modate suraiḥ
atha deve gate tyaktvā varāhe kṣīrasāgaram //
meaning:
क्रमाद्भुवि दिवं प्राप्य कर्मान्ते मोदते सुरैः
अथ देवे गते त्यक्त्वा वराहे क्षीरसागरम् //
text_mt:
In due course, leaving the earth and attaining heaven, he rejoices with the gods at the end of his deeds."
Then, when the god, the Boar, had departed, leaving the ocean of milk,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāharūpamanaghaṃ cacāla ca dharā punaḥ
tasya daṃṣṭrābharākrāntā devadevasya dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
वाराहरूपमनघं चचाल च धरा पुनः
तस्य दंष्ट्राभराक्रान्ता देवदेवस्य धीमतः //
text_mt:
and [leaving behind] his faultless boar form, the earth shook again,
oppressed by the weight of the tusk of that wise god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yadṛcchayā bhavaḥ paśyan jagāma jagadīśvaraḥ
daṃṣṭrāṃ jagrāha dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhūṣaṇārthamathātmanaḥ //
meaning:
यदृच्छया भवः पश्यन् जगाम जगदीश्वरः
दंष्ट्रां जग्राह दृष्ट्वा तां भूषणार्थमथात्मनः //
text_mt:
Passing by by chance and seeing it, Bhava, the Lord of the world,
seeing that tusk, seized it as an ornament for himself.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhāra ca mahādevaḥ kūrcānte vai mahorasi
devāś ca tuṣṭuvuḥ sendrā devadevasya vaibhavam //
meaning:
दधार च महादेवः कूर्चान्ते वै महोरसि
देवाश् च तुष्टुवुः सेन्द्रा देवदेवस्य वैभवम् //
text_mt:
And Mahādeva wore it at the end of his beard upon his broad chest;
and the gods, led by Indra, praised the majesty of the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dharā pratiṣṭhitā hyevaṃ devadevena līlayā
bhūtānāṃ saṃplave cāpi viṣṇoścaiva kalevaram //
meaning:
धरा प्रतिष्ठिता ह्येवं देवदेवेन लीलया
भूतानां संप्लवे चापि विष्णोश्चैव कलेवरम् //
text_mt:
Thus was the earth stabilized by the god of gods in divine play;
and at the deluge of all beings, [he wears] the body of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaś ca tathānyeṣāṃ devānāmapi līlayā
vibhuraṅgavibhāgena bhūṣito na yadi prabhuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणश् च तथान्येषां देवानामपि लीलया
विभुरङ्गविभागेन भूषितो न यदि प्रभुः //
text_mt:
and likewise of Brahmā and of other gods, in divine play.
If the all-pervading Lord were not adorned with parts of their bodies,

sanskrit_iast: kathaṃ vimuktirviprāṇāṃ tasmāddaṃṣṭrī maheśvaraḥ //
meaning: कथं विमुक्तिर्विप्राणां तस्माद्दंष्ट्री महेश्वरः //
text_mt: how could there be liberation for the brahmins? Therefore Maheśvara bears the tusk.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
nṛsiṃhena hataḥ pūrvaṃ hiraṇyākṣāgrajaḥ śrutam
kathaṃ niṣūditastena hiraṇyakaśipurvada //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
नृसिंहेन हतः पूर्वं हिरण्याक्षाग्रजः श्रुतम्
कथं निषूदितस्तेन हिरण्यकशिपुर्वद //
text_mt:
The sages said:
It has been heard that the elder brother of Hiraṇyākṣa was slain formerly by the Man-Lion.
Tell us how Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain by him.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahrāda iti viśrutaḥ
dharmajñaḥ satyasampannas tapasvī cābhavatsudhīḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्रः प्रह्राद इति विश्रुतः
धर्मज्ञः सत्यसम्पन्नस् तपस्वी चाभवत्सुधीः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Hiraṇyakaśipu had a son renowned as Prahrāda,
who knew dharma, was endowed with truth, was an ascetic, and was wise.

sanskrit_iast:
janmaprabhṛti deveśaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāvyayam
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadevabhavodbhavam //
meaning:
जन्मप्रभृति देवेशं पूजयामास चाव्ययम्
सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं विष्णुं सर्वदेवभवोद्भवम् //
text_mt:
From his very birth, he worshipped the imperishable Lord of the gods,
the omniscient, all-pervading Viṣṇu, the origin of the birth of all gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tamādipuruṣaṃ bhaktyā parabrahmasvarūpiṇam
brahmaṇo 'dhipatiṃ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakāraṇam //
meaning:
तमादिपुरुषं भक्त्या परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणम्
ब्रह्मणो ऽधिपतिं सृष्टिस्थितिसंहारकारणम् //
text_mt:
him, the primal Puruṣa, the embodiment of the supreme Brahman, with devotion—
the ruler of Brahmā, the cause of creation, maintenance, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi viṣṇostathābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ samāhitam
namo nārāyaṇāyeti govindeti muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि विष्णोस्तथाभूतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं समाहितम्
नमो नारायणायेति गोविन्देति मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt:
Seeing his son composed thus toward Viṣṇu,
praising him constantly with, "Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa! O Govinda!",

sanskrit_iast:
stuvantaṃ prāha devāriḥ pradahanniva pāpadhīḥ
na māṃ jānāsi durbuddhe sarvadaityāmareśvaram //
meaning:
स्तुवन्तं प्राह देवारिः प्रदहन्निव पापधीः
न मां जानासि दुर्बुद्धे सर्वदैत्यामरेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
the enemy of the gods, evil-minded, spoke as though burning him:
"Do you not know me, O fool, as the lord of all Daityas and immortals?

sanskrit_iast:
prahrāda vīra duṣputra dvijadevārtikāraṇam
ko viṣṇuḥ padmajo vāpi śakraś ca varuṇo 'thavā //
meaning:
प्रह्राद वीर दुष्पुत्र द्विजदेवार्तिकारणम्
को विष्णुः पद्मजो वापि शक्रश् च वरुणो ऽथवा //
text_mt:
O Prahrāda, warrior, wicked son, cause of distress to twice-born and gods!
Who is Viṣṇu, or the lotus-born [Brahmā], or Śakra, or Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuḥ somastatheśānaḥ pāvako mama yaḥ samaḥ
māmevārcaya bhaktyā ca svalpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sadā //
meaning:
वायुः सोमस्तथेशानः पावको मम यः समः
मामेवार्चय भक्त्या च स्वल्पं नारायणं सदा //
text_mt:
or Vāyu, or Soma, or Īśāna, or Fire, that is equal to me?
Worship me alone with devotion, and [regard] Nārāyaṇa ever as insignificant!

sanskrit_iast:
prahrāda jīvite vāñchā tavaiṣā śṛṇu cāsti cet
śrutvāpi tasya vacanaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
प्रह्राद जीविते वाञ्छा तवैषा शृणु चास्ति चेत्
श्रुत्वापि तस्य वचनं हिरण्यकशिपोः सुधीः //
text_mt:
Hear this, O Prahrāda, if you have a desire for life!"
Even upon hearing those words of Hiraṇyakaśipu, the wise one—

sanskrit_iast:
prahrādaḥ pūjayāmāsa namo nārāyaṇeti ca
namo nārāyaṇāyeti sarvadaityakumārakān //
meaning:
प्रह्रादः पूजयामास नमो नारायणेति च
नमो नारायणायेति सर्वदैत्यकुमारकान् //
text_mt: Prahrāda worshipped, reciting, 'Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa!' / and to all the Daitya youths, 'Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa!'

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpayāmāsa ca tāṃ brahmavidyāṃ suśobhanām
durlaṅghyāṃ cātmano dṛṣṭvā śakrādibhir api svayam //
meaning:
अध्यापयामास च तां ब्रह्मविद्यां सुशोभनाम्
दुर्लङ्घ्यां चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा शक्रादिभिर् अपि स्वयम् //
text_mt: He taught that most splendid knowledge of Brahman. / Seeing his own command flouted, which could not be crossed even by Śakra and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
putreṇa laṅghitāmājñāṃ hiraṇyaḥ prāha dānavān
etaṃ nānāvidhairvadhyaṃ duṣputraṃ hantumarhatha //
meaning:
पुत्रेण लङ्घितामाज्ञां हिरण्यः प्राह दानवान्
एतं नानाविधैर्वध्यं दुष्पुत्रं हन्तुमर्हथ //
text_mt: flouted by his son, Hiraṇya[kaśipu] said to the Dānavas: / 'You must slay this wicked son, fit to be killed in manifold ways!'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktāstadā tena daityena sudurātmanā
nijaghnurdevadevasya bhṛtyaṃ prahrādamavyayam //
meaning:
एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन दैत्येन सुदुरात्मना
निजघ्नुर्देवदेवस्य भृत्यं प्रह्रादमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed then by that utterly evil-minded Daitya, / they attacked the imperishable servant of the God of gods, Prahrāda.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatpratikṛtaṃ tadā surair daityarājatanayaṃ dvijottamāḥ
kṣīravārinidhiśāyinaḥ prabhor niṣphalaṃ tvatha babhūva tejasā //
meaning:
तत्र तत्प्रतिकृतं तदा सुरैर् दैत्यराजतनयं द्विजोत्तमाः
क्षीरवारिनिधिशायिनः प्रभोर् निष्फलं त्वथ बभूव तेजसा //
text_mt: Whatever countermeasures the gods [of the Daityas] took against the son of the Daitya king, O best of the twice-born, / became entirely fruitless through the splendour of the Lord who reclines on the ocean of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
tadātha garvabhinnasya hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prabhuḥ
tatraivāvirabhūddhantuṃ nṛsiṃhākṛtimāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
तदाथ गर्वभिन्नस्य हिरण्यकशिपोः प्रभुः
तत्रैवाविरभूद्धन्तुं नृसिंहाकृतिमास्थितः //
text_mt: Then, to Hiranyakaśipu whose pride was shattered, the Lord / manifested right there, assuming the form of Nṛsiṃha, to slay him.

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna ca sutaṃ prekṣya pitaraṃ dānavādhamam
bibheda tatkṣaṇādeva karajair niśitaiḥ śataiḥ //
meaning:
जघान च सुतं प्रेक्ष्य पितरं दानवाधमम्
बिभेद तत्क्षणादेव करजैर् निशितैः शतैः //
text_mt: Seeing the son, he struck down the father, the vilest of the Dānavas; / he tore him apart in that very moment with hundreds of sharpened claws.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nihatya taṃ daityaṃ sabāndhavamaghāpahaḥ
pīḍayāmāsa daityendraṃ yugāntāgnirivāparaḥ //
meaning:
ततो निहत्य तं दैत्यं सबान्धवमघापहः
पीडयामास दैत्येन्द्रं युगान्ताग्निरिवापरः //
text_mt: Then, having slain that Daitya along with his kinsmen, the dispeller of sin / tormented the king of Daityas like another fire at the end of the yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
nādaistasya nṛsiṃhasya ghorairvitrāsitaṃ jagat
ā brahmabhuvanād viprāḥ pracacāla ca suvratāḥ //
meaning:
नादैस्तस्य नृसिंहस्य घोरैर्वित्रासितं जगत्
आ ब्रह्मभुवनाद् विप्राः प्रचचाल च सुव्रताः //
text_mt: By the terrible roars of that Nṛsiṃha the world was terrified; / it trembled from the realm of Brahmā downward, O upright Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā surāsuramahoragasiddhasādhyās tasmin kṣaṇe hariviriñcimukhā nṛsiṃham
dhairyaṃ balaṃ ca samavāpya yayurvisṛjya ā diṅmukhāntam asurakṣaṇatatparāś ca //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सुरासुरमहोरगसिद्धसाध्यास् तस्मिन् क्षणे हरिविरिञ्चिमुखा नृसिंहम्
धैर्यं बलं च समवाप्य ययुर्विसृज्य आ दिङ्मुखान्तम् असुरक्षणतत्पराश् च //
text_mt: Seeing Nṛsiṃha at that moment, the gods, Asuras, great serpents, Siddhas, and Sādhyas, led by Hari and Viriñci, / abandoned their courage and strength and fled to the ends of the quarters, intent on their own preservation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastairgataiḥ saiṣa devo nṛsiṃhaḥ sahasrākṛtiḥ sarvapāt sarvabāhuḥ
sahasrekṣaṇaḥ somasūryāgninetras tadā saṃsthitaḥ sarvamāvṛtya māyī //
meaning:
ततस्तैर्गतैः सैष देवो नृसिंहः सहस्राकृतिः सर्वपात् सर्वबाहुः
सहस्रेक्षणः सोमसूर्याग्निनेत्रस् तदा संस्थितः सर्वमावृत्य मायी //
text_mt: Then, when they had departed, that divine Nṛsiṃha—possessing a thousand forms, all feet, all arms, / possessing a thousand eyes, with moon, sun, and fire as eyes, the master of māyā—stood enclosing everything.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ suraśreṣṭhā lokā lokācale sthitāḥ
sabrahmakāḥ sasādhyāś ca sayamāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
तं तुष्टुवुः सुरश्रेष्ठा लोका लोकाचले स्थिताः
सब्रह्मकाः ससाध्याश् च सयमाः समरुद्गणाः //
text_mt: The foremost gods dwelling on Mount Lokāloka praised him, / together with Brahmā, the Sādhyas, Yama, and the hosts of the Maruts:

sanskrit_iast:
parātparataraṃ brahma tattvāt tattvatamaṃ bhavān
jyotiṣāṃ tu paraṃ jyotiḥ paramātmā jaganmayaḥ //
meaning:
परात्परतरं ब्रह्म तत्त्वात् तत्त्वतमं भवान्
ज्योतिषां तु परं ज्योतिः परमात्मा जगन्मयः //
text_mt: 'You are the Brahman higher than the highest, the ultimate reality among principles, / the supreme light among lights, the Supreme Self consisting of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ susūkṣmaṃ ca śabdabrahmamayaḥ śubhaḥ
vāgatīto nirālaṃbo nirdvandvo nirupaplavaḥ //
meaning:
स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं सुसूक्ष्मं च शब्दब्रह्ममयः शुभः
वागतीतो निरालंबो निर्द्वन्द्वो निरुपप्लवः //
text_mt: You are the gross, the subtle, and the extremely subtle, the auspicious one composed of the sound-Brahman, / transcending speech, unsupported, beyond dualities, free from affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhugyajñamūrtistvaṃ yajñināṃ phaladaḥ prabhuḥ
bhavānmatsyākṛtiḥ kaurmam āsthāya jagati sthitaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञभुग्यज्ञमूर्तिस्त्वं यज्ञिनां फलदः प्रभुः
भवान्मत्स्याकृतिः कौर्मम् आस्थाय जगति स्थितः //
text_mt: You are the enjoyer of sacrifice, the sacrifice embodied, the lord who gives fruits to sacrificers. / Assuming the form of the Fish, and the form of the Tortoise, you abided in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhīṃ caiva tāṃ saiṃhīm āsthāyehavyavasthitaḥ
devānāṃ devarakṣārthaṃ nihatya ditijeśvaram //
meaning:
वाराहीं चैव तां सैंहीम् आस्थायेहव्यवस्थितः
देवानां देवरक्षार्थं निहत्य दितिजेश्वरम् //
text_mt: And assuming that Boar form, and now this Lion form, you stand established, / having slain the lord of Diti's sons to protect the gods of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijaśāpacchalenaivam avatīrṇo 'si līlayā
na dṛṣṭaṃ yattvadanyaṃ hi bhavān sarvaṃ carācaram //
meaning:
द्विजशापच्छलेनैवम् अवतीर्णो ऽसि लीलया
न दृष्टं यत्त्वदन्यं हि भवान् सर्वं चराचरम् //
text_mt: Under the pretext of a Brahmin's curse, you have descended thus in divine play; / for nothing other than you is seen—you are all that moves and is still.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānviṣṇurbhavān rudro bhavāneva pitāmahaḥ
bhavānādirbhavānanto bhavāneva vayaṃ vibho //
meaning:
भवान्विष्णुर्भवान् रुद्रो भवानेव पितामहः
भवानादिर्भवानन्तो भवानेव वयं विभो //
text_mt: You are Viṣṇu, you are Rudra, you alone are Pitāmaha; / you are the beginning, you are the end, you alone are ourselves, O all-pervading Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāneva jagatsarvaṃ pralāpena kimīśvara
māyayā bahudhā saṃstham advitīyamayaṃ prabho //
meaning:
भवानेव जगत्सर्वं प्रलापेन किमीश्वर
मायया बहुधा संस्थम् अद्वितीयमयं प्रभो //
text_mt: You alone are the entire universe; what is the use of prattle, O Sovereign? / Established in manifold ways through māyā, you consist of the one without a second, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
stoṣyāmastvāṃ kathaṃ bhāsi devadeva mṛgādhipa
stuto 'pi vividhaiḥ stutyair bhāvairnānāvidhaiḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
स्तोष्यामस्त्वां कथं भासि देवदेव मृगाधिप
स्तुतो ऽपि विविधैः स्तुत्यैर् भावैर्नानाविधैः प्रभुः //
text_mt: How shall we praise you? You shine forth, O God of gods, king of beasts!' / Although praised with various laudable sentiments of many kinds, the Lord

sanskrit_iast:
na jagāma dvijāḥ śāntiṃ mānayanyonimātmanaḥ
yo nṛsiṃhastavaṃ bhaktyā paṭhedvārthaṃ vicārayet //
meaning:
न जगाम द्विजाः शान्तिं मानयन्योनिमात्मनः
यो नृसिंहस्तवं भक्त्या पठेद्वार्थं विचारयेत् //
text_mt: did not attain peace, O twice-born, honouring his lion origin. / Whoever recites the hymn to Nṛsiṃha with devotion, or contemplates its meaning,

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvayedvā dvijānsarvān viṣṇuloke mahīyate
tadantare śivaṃ devāḥ sendrāḥ sabrahmakāḥ prabhum //
meaning:
श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान्सर्वान् विष्णुलोके महीयते
तदन्तरे शिवं देवाः सेन्द्राः सब्रह्मकाः प्रभुम् //
text_mt: or recites it to all the Brahmins, is honoured in the world of Viṣṇu. / In the meantime, the gods, accompanied by Indra and Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
samprāpya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvaṃ vijñāpya mṛgarūpiṇaḥ
tato brahmādayastūrṇaṃ saṃstūya parameśvaram //
meaning:
सम्प्राप्य तुष्टुवुः सर्वं विज्ञाप्य मृगरूपिणः
ततो ब्रह्मादयस्तूर्णं संस्तूय परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: approached the Lord Śiva and praised him, reporting everything about the one who had taken the beast form. / Then Brahmā and the others, quickly praising the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmatrāṇāya śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ paramakāraṇam
mandarasthaṃ mahādevaṃ krīḍamānaṃ sahomayā //
meaning:
आत्मत्राणाय शरणं जग्मुः परमकारणम्
मन्दरस्थं महादेवं क्रीडमानं सहोमया //
text_mt: went for their own protection to the supreme cause as their refuge— / Mahādeva, who was staying on Mount Mandara, sporting with Umā,

sanskrit_iast:
sevitaṃ gaṇagandharvaiḥ siddhairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
devatābhiḥ saha brahmā bhītabhītaḥ sagadgadam
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau tuṣṭāva parameśvaram //
meaning:
सेवितं गणगन्धर्वैः सिद्धैरप्सरसां गणैः
देवताभिः सह ब्रह्मा भीतभीतः सगद्गदम्
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूमौ तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: served by the Gaṇas, Gandharvas, Siddhas, and hosts of Apsarases. / Brahmā, along with the deities, greatly terrified, faltering with emotion, / prostrating like a staff upon the ground, praised the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
namaste kālakālāya namaste rudra manyave
namaḥ śivāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
नमस्ते कालकालाय नमस्ते रुद्र मन्यवे
नमः शिवाय रुद्राय शङ्कराय शिवाय ते //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'Obeisance to you, the Death of Death! Obeisance to you, O Rudra, wrath [personified]! / Obeisance to Śiva, to Rudra, to Śaṅkara, to the auspicious one!

sanskrit_iast:
ugro 'si sarvabhūtānāṃ niyantāsi śivo 'si naḥ
namaḥ śivāya śarvāya śaṅkarāyārttihāriṇe //
meaning:
उग्रो ऽसि सर्वभूतानां नियन्तासि शिवो ऽसि नः
नमः शिवाय शर्वाय शङ्करायार्त्तिहारिणे //
text_mt: You are fierce toward all creatures, you are their controller, you are benevolent to us. / Obeisance to Śiva, to Śarva, to Śaṅkara, to the remover of affliction!

sanskrit_iast:
mayaskarāya viśvāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe namaḥ
antakāya namastubhyam umāyāḥ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
मयस्कराय विश्वाय विष्णवे ब्रह्मणे नमः
अन्तकाय नमस्तुभ्यम् उमायाः पतये नमः //
text_mt: Obeisance to the bringer of joy, to the all, to Viṣṇu, to Brahmā! / Obeisance to you, the end-maker; obeisance to the lord of Umā!

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyabāhave sākṣād dhiraṇyapataye namaḥ
śarvāya sarvarūpāya puruṣāya namonamaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यबाहवे साक्षाद् धिरण्यपतये नमः
शर्वाय सर्वरूपाय पुरुषाय नमोनमः //
text_mt: Obeisance to the golden-armed, visibly to the golden lord! / Obeisance, obeisance to Śarva, to the one whose form is everything, to Puruṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
sadasadvyaktihīnāya mahataḥ kāraṇāya te
nityāya viśvarūpāya jāyamānāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
सदसद्व्यक्तिहीनाय महतः कारणाय ते
नित्याय विश्वरूपाय जायमानाय ते नमः //
text_mt: To the one free from manifestation as existence or non-existence, to you the cause of the Great [Principle], / to the eternal, to the one whose form is the universe, to you who are being born, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
jātāya bahudhā loke prabhūtāya namonamaḥ
rudrāya nīlarudrāya kadrudrāya pracetase //
meaning:
जाताय बहुधा लोके प्रभूताय नमोनमः
रुद्राय नीलरुद्राय कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे //
text_mt: To the one born in manifold ways in the world, to the abundant one, obeisance, obeisance! / To Rudra, to Nīlarudra, to the auspicious Rudra, to the wise!

sanskrit_iast:
kālāya kālarūpāya namaḥ kālāṅgahāriṇe
mīḍhuṣṭamāya devāya śitikaṇṭhāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
कालाय कालरूपाय नमः कालाङ्गहारिणे
मीढुष्टमाय देवाय शितिकण्ठाय ते नमः //
text_mt: To Time, to the form of Time, obeisance to the destroyer of the limbs of Time! / To the most generous deity, to you of the dark neck, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
mahīyase namastubhyaṃ hantre devāriṇāṃ sadā
tārāya ca sutārāya tāraṇāya namonamaḥ //
meaning:
महीयसे नमस्तुभ्यं हन्त्रे देवारिणां सदा
ताराय च सुताराय तारणाय नमोनमः //
text_mt: Obeisance to you, the greatest, the eternal slayer of the enemies of the gods! / To the saviour, to the good deliverer, to the ferryman across [samsara], obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
harikeśāya devāya śaṃbhave paramātmane
devānāṃ śaṃbhave tubhyaṃ bhūtānāṃ śaṃbhave namaḥ //
meaning:
हरिकेशाय देवाय शंभवे परमात्मने
देवानां शंभवे तुभ्यं भूतानां शंभवे नमः //
text_mt: To the golden-haired god, to Śambhu, the Supreme Self; / to you, the Śambhu of the gods, to the Śambhu of all beings, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
śambhave haimavatyāś ca manyave rudrarūpiṇe
kapardine namastubhyaṃ kālakaṇṭhāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
शम्भवे हैमवत्याश् च मन्यवे रुद्ररूपिणे
कपर्दिने नमस्तुभ्यं कालकण्ठाय ते नमः //
text_mt: To the Śambhu of the daughter of Himavat, to the one whose form is wrath, Rudra! / To the one with matted hair, obeisance to you, to you with the black throat, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyāya maheśāya śrīkaṇṭhāya namonamaḥ
bhasmadigdhaśarīrāya daṇḍamuṇḍīśvarāya ca //
meaning:
हिरण्याय महेशाय श्रीकण्ठाय नमोनमः
भस्मदिग्धशरीराय दण्डमुण्डीश्वराय च //
text_mt: To the golden one, to the great lord, to Śrīkaṇṭha, obeisance, obeisance! / To the one whose body is smeared with sacred ash, to the lord with the staff and skull!

sanskrit_iast:
namo hrasvāya dīrghāya vāmanāya namonamaḥ
nama ugratriśūlāya ugrāya ca namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ह्रस्वाय दीर्घाय वामनाय नमोनमः
नम उग्रत्रिशूलाय उग्राय च नमो नमः //
text_mt: Obeisance to the short, to the tall, to the dwarf, obeisance, obeisance! / Obeisance to the one with the fierce trident, and to the fierce one, obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmāya bhīmarūpāya bhīmakarmaratāya te
agrevadhāya vai bhūtvā namo dūrevadhāya ca //
meaning:
भीमाय भीमरूपाय भीमकर्मरताय ते
अग्रेवधाय वै भूत्वा नमो दूरेवधाय च //
text_mt: To the terrible, to the terrible in form, to you who delight in terrible deeds, / having become the slayer from up close, obeisance, and the slayer from afar!

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvine śūline tubhyaṃ gadine haline namaḥ
cakriṇe varmiṇe nityaṃ daityānāṃ karmabhedine //
meaning:
धन्विने शूलिने तुभ्यं गदिने हलिने नमः
चक्रिणे वर्मिणे नित्यं दैत्यानां कर्मभेदिने //
text_mt: To you, the archer, the bearer of the spear, the bearer of the mace, the bearer of the plough, obeisance! / To the bearer of the discus, to the armoured one, ever the shatterer of the Daityas' works!

sanskrit_iast:
sadyāya sadyarūpāya sadyojātāya te namaḥ
vāmāya vāmarūpāya vāmanetrāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
सद्याय सद्यरूपाय सद्योजाताय ते नमः
वामाय वामरूपाय वामनेत्राय ते नमः //
text_mt: To the immediate one, to the form of the immediate, to Sadyojāta, obeisance to you! / To the lovely one, to the lovely-formed, to you with lovely eyes, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast: puruṣarūpāya puruṣaikatatpuruṣāya vai namaḥ //
meaning: पुरुषरूपाय पुरुषैकतत्पुरुषाय वै नमः //
text_mt: Obeisance indeed to the form of Puruṣa, to the sole Puruṣa, to Tatpuruṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣārthapradānāya pataye parameṣṭhine
īśānāya namastubhyam īśvarāya namonamaḥ //
meaning:
पुरुषार्थप्रदानाय पतये परमेष्ठिने
ईशानाय नमस्तुभ्यम् ईश्वराय नमोनमः //
text_mt: To the bestower of the aims of human life, to the lord, to Parameṣṭhin! / To Īśāna, obeisance to you, to Īśvara, obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇe brahmarūpāya namaḥ sākṣācchivāya te
sarvaviṣṇurnṛsiṃhasya rūpamāsthāya viśvakṛt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मरूपाय नमः साक्षाच्छिवाय ते
सर्वविष्णुर्नृसिंहस्य रूपमास्थाय विश्वकृत् //
text_mt: To Brahman, to the form of Brahman, obeisance to you, who are visibly Śiva! / The all-Viṣṇu, the creator of the universe, having assumed the form of Nṛsiṃha,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā karajairniśitaiḥ svayam
daityendrairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ hitārthaṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपुं हत्वा करजैर्निशितैः स्वयम्
दैत्येन्द्रैर्बहुभिः सार्धं हितार्थं जगतां प्रभुः //
text_mt: having himself slain Hiraṇyakaśipu with his sharpened claws, / along with many Daitya chiefs, for the welfare of the worlds, the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
saiṃhīṃ samānayanyoniṃ bādhate nikhilaṃ jagat
yatkṛtyamatra deveśa tatkuruṣva bhavāniha //
meaning:
सैंहीं समानयन्योनिं बाधते निखिलं जगत्
यत्कृत्यमत्र देवेश तत्कुरुष्व भवानिह //
text_mt: honouring his lion origin, torments the entire universe. / Whatever is to be done in this matter, O Lord of gods, please do that here!

sanskrit_iast:
ugro 'si sarvaduṣṭānāṃ niyantāsi śivo 'si naḥ
kālakūṭādivapuṣā trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān //
meaning:
उग्रो ऽसि सर्वदुष्टानां नियन्तासि शिवो ऽसि नः
कालकूटादिवपुषा त्राहि नः शरणागतान् //
text_mt: You are fierce toward all wicked ones, you are the controller, you are benevolent to us. / By your form that swallowed the kālakūṭa poison, protect us who have sought refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
śukraṃ tu vṛttaṃ viśveśa krīḍā vai kevalaṃ vayam
tavonmeṣanimeṣābhyām asmākaṃ pralayodayau //
meaning:
शुक्रं तु वृत्तं विश्वेश क्रीडा वै केवलं वयम्
तवोन्मेषनिमेषाभ्याम् अस्माकं प्रलयोदयौ //
text_mt: All conduct is pure, O Lord of the universe; we are indeed merely your play. / By the opening and closing of your eyes occur our cosmic dissolution and origin.'

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlayet tvayi brahman vināśo 'sti na te śiva
saṃtaptāsmo vayaṃ deva hariṇāmitatejasā //
meaning:
उन्मीलयेत् त्वयि ब्रह्मन् विनाशो ऽस्ति न ते शिव
संतप्तास्मो वयं देव हरिणामिततेजसा //
text_mt: When you open your eyes, O Brahman, there is no destruction for you, O Śiva. / We are tormented, O God, by Hari of immeasurable splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokahitāyainaṃ tattvaṃ saṃhartumicchasi
vijñāpitas tathā devaḥ prahasanprāha tān surān //
meaning:
सर्वलोकहितायैनं तत्त्वं संहर्तुमिच्छसि
विज्ञापितस् तथा देवः प्रहसन्प्राह तान् सुरान् //
text_mt: For the welfare of all the worlds, you wish to destroy him in reality.” / Thus addressed, the God laughed and said to those gods:

sanskrit_iast:
abhayaṃ ca dadau teṣāṃ haniṣyāmīti taṃ prabhuḥ
so 'pi śakraḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇipatya yathāgatam //
meaning:
अभयं च ददौ तेषां हनिष्यामीति तं प्रभुः
सो ऽपि शक्रः सुरैः सार्धं प्रणिपत्य यथागतम् //
text_mt: And the Lord granted them freedom from fear, saying: “I will slay him.” / Śakra also, along with the gods, having bowed down, as they had come,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma bhagavān brahmā tathānye ca surottamāḥ
athotthāya mahādevaḥ śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
जगाम भगवान् ब्रह्मा तथान्ये च सुरोत्तमाः
अथोत्थाय महादेवः शारभं रूपमास्थितः //
text_mt: The Lord Brahmā departed, and likewise the other best of gods. / Then Mahādeva, having arisen, assumed the form of a Śarabha.

sanskrit_iast:
yayau prānte nṛsiṃhasya garvitasya mṛgāśinaḥ
apahṛtya tadā prāṇān śarabhaḥ surapūjitaḥ //
meaning:
ययौ प्रान्ते नृसिंहस्य गर्वितस्य मृगाशिनः
अपहृत्य तदा प्राणान् शरभः सुरपूजितः //
text_mt: He went to the side of Nṛsiṃha, who was arrogant and devoured beasts. / Then, taking away his life-breaths, the Śarabha, praised by the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāttato naro bhūtvā jagāma ca yathākramam
evaṃ stutastadā devair jagāma sa yathākramam //
meaning:
सिंहात्ततो नरो भूत्वा जगाम च यथाक्रमम्
एवं स्तुतस्तदा देवैर् जगाम स यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: From a lion then became a man, and went according to due order. / Thus praised then by the gods, he departed according to due order.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi saṃstavaṃ śārvamuttamam
rudralokamanuprāpya rudreṇa saha modate //
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि संस्तवं शार्वमुत्तमम्
रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य रुद्रेण सह मोदते //
text_mt: Whoever recites or hears this excellent hymn to Śarva, / having reached the world of Rudra, rejoices together with Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ devo mahādevo viśvasaṃhārakārakaḥ
śarabhākhyaṃ mahāghoraṃ vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं देवो महादेवो विश्वसंहारकारकः
शरभाख्यं महाघोरं विकृतं रूपमास्थितः //
text_mt: The sages said: / How did God Mahādeva, the agent of cosmic dissolution, / assume the exceedingly terrible, monstrous form named Śarabha?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kiṃ dhairyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena brūhi sarvam aśeṣataḥ
evamabhyarthito devair matiṃ cakre kṛpālayaḥ //
meaning:
किं किं धैर्यं कृतं तेन ब्रूहि सर्वम् अशेषतः
एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर् मतिं चक्रे कृपालयः //
text_mt: What great deed of courage did he perform? Tell it all without remainder. / Thus requested by the gods, the abode of compassion resolved [to act].

sanskrit_iast:
yattejastu nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ saṃhartuṃ parameśvaraḥ
tadarthaṃ smṛtavān rudro vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam //
meaning:
यत्तेजस्तु नृसिंहाख्यं संहर्तुं परमेश्वरः
तदर्थं स्मृतवान् रुद्रो वीरभद्रं महाबलम् //
text_mt: In order to withdraw that splendor called Nṛsiṃha, the Supreme Lord, / for that purpose, Rudra remembered the mighty Vīrabhadra,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ mahāpralayakārakam
ājagāma purā sadyo gaṇānāmagrato hasan //
meaning:
आत्मनो भैरवं रूपं महाप्रलयकारकम्
आजगाम पुरा सद्यो गणानामग्रतो हसन् //
text_mt: His own terrifying form, the cause of the great cosmic dissolution. / Formerly he arrived at once, laughing before the gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
sāṭṭahāsair gaṇavarair utpatadbhir itastataḥ
nṛsiṃharūpairatyugraiḥ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ //
meaning:
साट्टहासैर् गणवरैर् उत्पतद्भिर् इतस्ततः
नृसिंहरूपैरत्युग्रैः कोटिभिः परिवारितः //
text_mt: Surrounded by crores [of gaṇas] having the form of Nṛsiṃha, exceedingly fierce, / with the best of gaṇas bursting with loud laughter, leaping here and there,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadbhir abhito vīrair nṛtyadbhiś ca mudānvitaiḥ
krīḍadbhiś ca mahādhīrair brahmādyaiḥ kandukairiva //
meaning:
तावद्भिर् अभितो वीरैर् नृत्यद्भिश् च मुदान्वितैः
क्रीडद्भिश् च महाधीरैर् ब्रह्माद्यैः कन्दुकैरिव //
text_mt: And surrounded all around by as many heroes, dancing and full of joy, / playing, exceedingly brave, with Brahmā and the others as if with balls,

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭapūrvairanyaiś ca veṣṭito vīravanditaḥ
kalpāntajvalanajvālo vilasallocanatrayaḥ //
meaning:
अदृष्टपूर्वैरन्यैश् च वेष्टितो वीरवन्दितः
कल्पान्तज्वलनज्वालो विलसल्लोचनत्रयः //
text_mt: And surrounded by others never seen before, praised by heroes, / blazing with the flames of the fire at the end of the kalpa, his three eyes shining,

sanskrit_iast:
āttaśastro jaṭājūṭe jvaladbālendumaṇḍitaḥ
bālendudvitayākāratīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāṅkuradvayaḥ //
meaning:
आत्तशस्त्रो जटाजूटे ज्वलद्बालेन्दुमण्डितः
बालेन्दुद्वितयाकारतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राङ्कुरद्वयः //
text_mt: Weapons in hand, adorned with the blazing crescent moon in his matted locks, / having two sharp sprout-like fangs resembling a pair of young moons,

sanskrit_iast:
ākhaṇḍaladhanuḥkhaṇḍasaṃnibhabhrūlatāyutaḥ
mahāpracaṇḍahuṅkārabadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
आखण्डलधनुःखण्डसंनिभभ्रूलतायुतः
महाप्रचण्डहुङ्कारबधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः //
text_mt: Possessed of creeper-like brows resembling pieces of Indra’s bow, / deafening the directions with his mighty, fierce roars,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlameghāñjanākārabhīṣaṇaśmaśruradbhutaḥ
vādakhaṇḍam akhaṇḍābhyāṃ bhrāmayaṃstriśikhaṃ muhuḥ //
meaning:
नीलमेघाञ्जनाकारभीषणश्मश्रुरद्भुतः
वादखण्डम् अखण्डाभ्यां भ्रामयंस्त्रिशिखं मुहुः //
text_mt: Wondrous, with a fearsome beard having the appearance of dark clouds and collyrium, / repeatedly twirling the sharp three-pointed trident with unyielding [hands].

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadro 'pi bhagavān vīraśaktivijṛmbhitaḥ
svayaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa kimatra smṛtikāraṇam //
meaning:
वीरभद्रो ऽपि भगवान् वीरशक्तिविजृम्भितः
स्वयं विज्ञापयामास किमत्र स्मृतिकारणम् //
text_mt: The Lord Vīrabhadra also, swollen with heroic power, / himself addressed [him]: “What is the cause of your remembering [me] here?

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāpaya jagatsvāmin prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi
akāle bhayamutpannaṃ devānāmapi bhairava //
meaning:
आज्ञापय जगत्स्वामिन् प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि
अकाले भयमुत्पन्नं देवानामपि भैरव //
text_mt: Command, O Lord of the universe! Let favor be shown to me.” / “Untimely fear has arisen even for the gods, O Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalitaḥ sa nṛsiṃhāgniḥ śamayainaṃ durāsadam
sāntvayan bodhayādau taṃ tena kiṃ nopaśāmyati //
meaning:
ज्वलितः स नृसिंहाग्निः शमयैनं दुरासदम्
सान्त्वयन् बोधयादौ तं तेन किं नोपशाम्यति //
text_mt: That fire of Nṛsiṃha is blazing; pacify this unapproachable one. / First instruct him with soothing words; will he not become calm by that?

sanskrit_iast:
tato matparamaṃ bhāvaṃ bhairavaṃ saṃpradarśaya
sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmeṇa saṃhṛtya sthūlaṃ sthūlena tejasā //
meaning:
ततो मत्परमं भावं भैरवं संप्रदर्शय
सूक्ष्मं सूक्ष्मेण संहृत्य स्थूलं स्थूलेन तेजसा //
text_mt: Then reveal to him my supreme, terrifying state. / Withdrawing the subtle by the subtle, and the gross by the gross splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
vaktramānaya kṛttiṃ ca vīrabhadra mamājñayā
ityādiṣṭo gaṇādhyakṣaḥ praśāntavapurāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
वक्त्रमानय कृत्तिं च वीरभद्र ममाज्ञया
इत्यादिष्टो गणाध्यक्षः प्रशान्तवपुरास्थितः //
text_mt: Bring his face and hide, O Vīrabhadra, by my command.” / Thus commanded, the chief of gaṇas, assuming a peaceful form,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma raṃhasā tatra yatrāste narakesarī
tatastaṃ bodhayāmāsa vīrabhadro haro harim //
meaning:
जगाम रंहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते नरकेसरी
ततस्तं बोधयामास वीरभद्रो हरो हरिम् //
text_mt: Went swiftly to where the Man-Lion was sitting. / Then Vīrabhadra, [manifestation of] Hara, instructed Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vākyamīśānaḥ pitā putramivaurasam
jagatsukhāya bhagavann avatīrṇo 'si mādhava //
meaning:
उवाच वाक्यमीशानः पिता पुत्रमिवौरसम्
जगत्सुखाय भगवन्न् अवतीर्णो ऽसि माधव //
text_mt: Īśāna spoke these words like a father to his own biological son: / “For the happiness of the world, O Lord Mādhava, you have descended.

sanskrit_iast:
sthityarthena ca yukto 'si pareṇa parameṣṭhinā
jantucakraṃ bhagavatā rakṣitaṃ matsyarūpiṇā //
meaning:
स्थित्यर्थेन च युक्तो ऽसि परेण परमेष्ठिना
जन्तुचक्रं भगवता रक्षितं मत्स्यरूपिणा //
text_mt: And you are engaged in maintenance by the Supreme Parameṣṭhin. / The collection of living beings was protected by the Lord in the form of a Fish,

sanskrit_iast:
pucchenaiva samābadhya bhramannekārṇave purā
bibharṣi kūrmarūpeṇa vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī //
meaning:
पुच्छेनैव समाबध्य भ्रमन्नेकार्णवे पुरा
बिभर्षि कूर्मरूपेण वाराहेणोद्धृता मही //
text_mt: Tying [the ship] to your tail while wandering formerly in the sole ocean; / in the form of a Tortoise you support [the world], and as a Boar the earth was lifted up.

sanskrit_iast:
anena harirūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ
vāmanena balirbaddhas tvayā vikramatā punaḥ //
meaning:
अनेन हरिरूपेण हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः
वामनेन बलिर्बद्धस् त्वया विक्रमता पुनः //
text_mt: By this form of a lion, Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain. / Again, as Vāmana striding forth, Bali was bound by you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvam eva sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhāvaḥ prabhur avyayaḥ
yadā yadā hi lokasya duḥkhaṃ kiṃcit prajāyate //
meaning:
त्वम् एव सर्वभूतानां प्रभावः प्रभुर् अव्ययः
यदा यदा हि लोकस्य दुःखं किंचित् प्रजायते //
text_mt: You alone are the power and the imperishable Lord of all beings. / Whenever any distress arises for the world,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tadāvatīrṇastvaṃ kariṣyasi nirāmayam
nādhikastvatsamo 'pyasti hare śivaparāyaṇa //
meaning:
तदा तदावतीर्णस्त्वं करिष्यसि निरामयम्
नाधिकस्त्वत्समो ऽप्यस्ति हरे शिवपरायण //
text_mt: Then, having descended, you will make it free from disease. / There is none greater than you, nor even equal to you, O Hari, devoted to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā dharmāś ca vedāś ca śubhe mārge pratiṣṭhitāḥ
yadartham avatāro 'yaṃ nihataḥ so 'pi keśava //
meaning:
त्वया धर्माश् च वेदाश् च शुभे मार्गे प्रतिष्ठिताः
यदर्थम् अवतारो ऽयं निहतः सो ऽपि केशव //
text_mt: By you dharmas and Vedas are established on the auspicious path. / He for whose sake this descent occurred has also been slain, O Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantaghoraṃ bhagavan narasiṃha vapustava
upasaṃhara viśvātmaṃs tvameva mama saṃnidhau //
meaning:
अत्यन्तघोरं भगवन् नरसिंह वपुस्तव
उपसंहर विश्वात्मंस् त्वमेव मम संनिधौ //
text_mt: Exceedingly terrible, O Lord, is your body as the Man-Lion. / Withdraw it yourself in my presence, O Soul of the universe!”

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ śāntayā girā
tato 'dhikaṃ mahāghoraṃ kopaṃ prajvālayaddhariḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः शान्तया गिरा
ततो ऽधिकं महाघोरं कोपं प्रज्वालयद्धरिः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Thus spoken to by Vīrabhadra with gentle speech, / Hari then flared up with an even greater, exceedingly terrible wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnṛsiṃha uvāca
āgato 'si yatastatra gaccha tvaṃ mā hitaṃ vada
idānīṃ saṃhariṣyāmi jagadetaccarācaram //
meaning:
श्रीनृसिंह उवाच
आगतो ऽसि यतस्तत्र गच्छ त्वं मा हितं वद
इदानीं संहरिष्यामि जगदेतच्चराचरम् //
text_mt: The glorious Nṛsiṃha said: / “Go back to where you have come from! Do not speak of what is beneficial! / Now I will destroy this entire world of moving and unmoving beings.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhartur na hi saṃhāraḥ svato vā parato 'pi vā
śāsitaṃ mama sarvatra śāstā ko 'pi na vidyate //
meaning:
संहर्तुर् न हि संहारः स्वतो वा परतो ऽपि वा
शासितं मम सर्वत्र शास्ता को ऽपि न विद्यते //
text_mt: Indeed, there is no destruction of the Destroyer, either through himself or through another. / My rule is everywhere; there is no ruler of mine anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
matprasādena sakalaṃ samaryādaṃ pravartate
ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ //
meaning:
मत्प्रसादेन सकलं समर्यादं प्रवर्तते
अहं हि सर्वशक्तीनां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः //
text_mt: By my grace everything proceeds within bounds. / For I am the impeller and the withdrawer of all powers.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā
tattadviddhi gaṇādhyakṣa mama tejovijṛmbhitam //
meaning:
यद् यद् विभूतिमत् सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा
तत्तद्विद्धि गणाध्यक्ष मम तेजोविजृम्भितम् //
text_mt: Whatever being is possessed of glory, majesty, or power, / know that, O chief of gaṇas, to be a manifestation of my splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāparamārthajñā mamaiva paramaṃ viduḥ
madaṃśāḥ śaktisampannā brahmaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
देवतापरमार्थज्ञा ममैव परमं विदुः
मदंशाः शक्तिसम्पन्ना ब्रह्मशक्रादयः सुराः //
text_mt: The gods who know the supreme truth know me alone as the Supreme. / The gods headed by Brahmā and Śakra are endowed with power as my portions.

sanskrit_iast:
mannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ purā brahmā caturmukhaḥ
tallalāṭasamutpanno bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
मन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पुरा ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखः
तल्ललाटसमुत्पन्नो भगवान्वृषभध्वजः //
text_mt: Formerly the four-faced Brahmā was born from the lotus of my navel; / from his forehead the Lord Vṛṣabhadhvaja was born.

sanskrit_iast:
rajasādhiṣṭhitaḥ sraṣṭā rudrastāmasa ucyate
ahaṃ niyantā sarvasya matparaṃ nāsti daivatam //
meaning:
रजसाधिष्ठितः स्रष्टा रुद्रस्तामस उच्यते
अहं नियन्ता सर्वस्य मत्परं नास्ति दैवतम् //
text_mt: Governed by rajas, the Creator is called [Brahmā], and Rudra is called tāmasa. / I am the controller of all; there is no deity higher than me.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvādhikaḥ svatantraś ca kartā hartākhileśvaraḥ
idaṃ tu matparaṃ tejaḥ kaḥ punaḥ śrotumicchati //
meaning:
विश्वाधिकः स्वतन्त्रश् च कर्ता हर्ताखिलेश्वरः
इदं तु मत्परं तेजः कः पुनः श्रोतुमिच्छति //
text_mt: I am superior to the universe, independent, the agent, the destroyer, the Lord of all. / Who wishes to hear further of this supreme splendor of mine?

sanskrit_iast:
ato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ
avehi paramaṃ bhāvam idaṃ bhūtamaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अतो मां शरणं प्राप्य गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः
अवेहि परमं भावम् इदं भूतमहेश्वरः //
text_mt: Therefore, taking refuge in me, go your way, free from distress! / Recognize this supreme nature: I am the Great Lord of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kālo 'smyahaṃ kālavināśahetur lokān samāhartum ahaṃ pravṛttaḥ
mṛtyormṛtyuṃ viddhi māṃ vīrabhadra jīvantyete matprasādena devāḥ //
meaning:
कालो ऽस्म्यहं कालविनाशहेतुर् लोकान् समाहर्तुम् अहं प्रवृत्तः
मृत्योर्मृत्युं विद्धि मां वीरभद्र जीवन्त्येते मत्प्रसादेन देवाः //
text_mt: I am Time; I am the cause of the destruction of Time; I have set out to consume the worlds. / Know me, O Vīrabhadra, as the Death of death; these gods live by my grace.”

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
sāhaṅkāramidaṃ śrutvā harer amitavikramaḥ
vihasyovāca sāvajñaṃ tato visphuritādharaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
साहङ्कारमिदं श्रुत्वा हरेर् अमितविक्रमः
विहस्योवाच सावज्ञं ततो विस्फुरिताधरः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing this arrogant [speech] of Hari, [Vīrabhadra] of boundless valor / laughed, and then, his lower lip trembling, scornfully spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvīrabhadra uvāca
kiṃ na jānāsi viśveśaṃ saṃhartāraṃ pinākinam
asadvādo vivādaś ca vināśastvayi kevalaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीवीरभद्र उवाच
किं न जानासि विश्वेशं संहर्तारं पिनाकिनम्
असद्वादो विवादश् च विनाशस्त्वयि केवलः //
text_mt: The glorious Vīrabhadra said: / “Do you not know the Lord of the universe, the destroyer, Pinākin? / False speech and dispute [lead] only to destruction for you.

sanskrit_iast:
tavānyonyāvatārāṇi kāni śeṣāṇi sāṃpratam
kṛtāni yena kenāpi kathāśeṣo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तवान्योन्यावताराणि कानि शेषाणि सांप्रतम्
कृतानि येन केनापि कथाशेषो भविष्यति //
text_mt: What other various incarnations of yours remain now? / Whatever was done by someone, he will remain only as a story.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣaṃ tvaṃ paśya etattvam avasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ
tena saṃhāradakṣeṇa kṣaṇātsaṃkṣayameṣyasi //
meaning:
दोषं त्वं पश्य एतत्त्वम् अवस्थामीदृशीं गतः
तेन संहारदक्षेण क्षणात्संक्षयमेष्यसि //
text_mt: Behold the fault in this, that you have reached such a condition. / By him who is skilled in dissolution you will go to complete destruction in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtistvaṃ pumān rudras tvayi vīryaṃ samāhitam
tvannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमान् रुद्रस् त्वयि वीर्यं समाहितम्
त्वन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः //
text_mt: You are Prakṛti; the Man is Rudra; the seed is deposited in you. / The five-faced Pitāmaha was born from the lotus of your navel.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyarthena jagatpūrvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam
lalāṭe cintayāmāsa tapasyugre vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
सृष्ट्यर्थेन जगत्पूर्वं शङ्करं नीललोहितम्
ललाटे चिन्तयामास तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: For the sake of creation, the Lord of the world, established in fierce austerity, / formerly meditated on Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita, in his forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
tallalāṭādabhūcchaṃbhoḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ tanna dūṣaṇam
aṃśo 'haṃ devadevasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ //
meaning:
तल्ललाटादभूच्छंभोः सृष्ट्यर्थं तन्न दूषणम्
अंशो ऽहं देवदेवस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः //
text_mt: He arose from the forehead of Śambhu for the purpose of creation; there is no fault in that. / I am a portion of the God of gods who possesses the form of Mahābhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatsaṃhāre niyukto 'smi vinayena balena ca
evaṃ rakṣo vidāryaiva tvaṃ śaktikalayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
त्वत्संहारे नियुक्तो ऽस्मि विनयेन बलेन च
एवं रक्षो विदार्यैव त्वं शक्तिकलया युतः //
text_mt: I have been appointed to destroy you with modesty and with power. / Having torn apart the demon thus, you, endowed with a portion of [divine] power,

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkārāvalepena garjasi tvamatandritaḥ
upakāro hyasādhūnām apakārāya kevalam //
meaning:
अहङ्कारावलेपेन गर्जसि त्वमतन्द्रितः
उपकारो ह्यसाधूनाम् अपकाराय केवलम् //
text_mt: roar unceasingly with the arrogance of egoism. / A favor done to the wicked indeed leads only to injury.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi siṃha maheśānaṃ svapunarbhūta manyase
na tvaṃ sraṣṭā na saṃhartā na svatantro hi kutracit //
meaning:
यदि सिंह महेशानं स्वपुनर्भूत मन्यसे
न त्वं स्रष्टा न संहर्ता न स्वतन्त्रो हि कुत्रचित् //
text_mt: If, O Lion, you consider Maheśāna as your own rebirth, / you are not the creator, nor the destroyer, nor independent anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
kulālacakravacchaktyā prerito 'si pinākinā
adyāpi tava nikṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ kūrmarūpiṇaḥ //
meaning:
कुलालचक्रवच्छक्त्या प्रेरितो ऽसि पिनाकिना
अद्यापि तव निक्षिप्तं कपालं कूर्मरूपिणः //
text_mt: You are impelled like a potter’s wheel by the power of Pinākin. / Even today your skull as the Tortoise is placed

sanskrit_iast:
harahāralatāmadhye mugdha kasmānna budhyase
vismṛtaṃ kiṃ tadaṃśena daṃṣṭrotpātanapīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
हरहारलतामध्ये मुग्ध कस्मान्न बुध्यसे
विस्मृतं किं तदंशेन दंष्ट्रोत्पातनपीडितः //
text_mt: amidst the string of neck-garlands of Hara. O deluded one, why do you not understand? / Have you forgotten how, tormented by the extraction of the tusk by a portion of him,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhavigrahaste 'dya sākrośaṃ tārakāriṇā
dagdho 'si yasya śūlāgre viṣvaksenacchalādbhavān //
meaning:
वाराहविग्रहस्ते ऽद्य साक्रोशं तारकारिणा
दग्धो ऽसि यस्य शूलाग्रे विष्वक्सेनच्छलाद्भवान् //
text_mt: your Boar form today [was struck] with reproach by the enemy of Tāraka? / You were burnt at the tip of the trident of him on the pretext of Viṣvaksena.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣayajñe śiraśchinnaṃ mayā te yajñarūpiṇaḥ
adyāpi tava putrasya brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ //
meaning:
दक्षयज्ञे शिरश्छिन्नं मया ते यज्ञरूपिणः
अद्यापि तव पुत्रस्य ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः //
text_mt: At the sacrifice of Dakṣa, your head was severed by me when you had the form of the sacrifice. / Even today, the fifth head of your son Brahmā

sanskrit_iast:
chinnaṃ tamenābhisaṃdhaṃ tadaṃśaṃ tasya tadbalam
nirjitastvaṃ dadhīcena saṃgrāme samarudgaṇaḥ //
meaning:
छिन्नं तमेनाभिसंधं तदंशं तस्य तद्बलम्
निर्जितस्त्वं दधीचेन संग्रामे समरुद्गणः //
text_mt: is severed; it was united with sin by him; such is his portion, such is his might. / You were completely vanquished in battle along with the host of Maruts by Dadhīca.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇḍūyamāne śirasi kathaṃ tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā
cakraṃ vikramato yasya cakrapāṇe tava priyam //
meaning:
कण्डूयमाने शिरसि कथं तद्विस्मृतं त्वया
चक्रं विक्रमतो यस्य चक्रपाणे तव प्रियम् //
text_mt: When your head was itching, how did you forget that? / Whence was the discus, which is dear to you, O discus-bearer, obtained by his prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
kutaḥ prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ kena tvayā tadapi vismṛtam
te mayā sakalā lokā gṛhītāstvaṃ payonidhau //
meaning:
कुतः प्राप्तं कृतं केन त्वया तदपि विस्मृतम्
ते मया सकला लोका गृहीतास्त्वं पयोनिधौ //
text_mt: and by whom was it made? Even that has been forgotten by you! / All the worlds have been seized by me, and you in the ocean of milk,

sanskrit_iast:
nidrāparavaśaḥ śeṣe sa kathaṃ sāttviko bhavān
tvadādistambaparyantaṃ rudraśaktivijṛmbhitam //
meaning:
निद्रापरवशः शेषे स कथं सात्त्विको भवान्
त्वदादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं रुद्रशक्तिविजृम्भितम् //
text_mt: helpless under the power of sleep, are lying down. How can you be composed of sattva? / From you down to a pillar of grass, all is the unfolding of the power of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktimānabhitastvaṃ ca hy analastvaṃ ca mohitaḥ
tattejaso 'pi māhātmyaṃ yuvāṃ draṣṭuṃ na hi kṣamau //
meaning:
शक्तिमानभितस्त्वं च ह्य् अनलस्त्वं च मोहितः
तत्तेजसो ऽपि माहात्म्यं युवां द्रष्टुं न हि क्षमौ //
text_mt: You, who are powerful on all sides, and Fire were both deluded. / The two of you were not able to perceive the majesty of his fiery brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlā ye hi prapaśyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
dyāvāpṛthivyā indrāgniyamasya varuṇasya ca //
meaning:
स्थूला ये हि प्रपश्यन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम्
द्यावापृथिव्या इन्द्राग्नियमस्य वरुणस्य च //
text_mt: Those who perceive that supreme abode of Viṣṇu are coarse. / Being born in the belly of the darkness of heaven and earth, of Indra, Agni, Yama, Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
dhvāntodare śaśāṅkasya janitvā parameśvaraḥ
kālo 'si tvaṃ mahākālaḥ kālakālo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ध्वान्तोदरे शशाङ्कस्य जनित्वा परमेश्वरः
कालो ऽसि त्वं महाकालः कालकालो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: and of the moon, the Supreme Lord / is Time; you are Mahākāla; Maheśvara is the Death of Death.

sanskrit_iast:
atastvamugrakalayā mṛtyormṛtyurbhaviṣyasi
sthiradhanvā kṣayo vīro vīro viśvādhikaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
अतस्त्वमुग्रकलया मृत्योर्मृत्युर्भविष्यसि
स्थिरधन्वा क्षयो वीरो वीरो विश्वाधिकः प्रभुः //
text_mt: Therefore, by his fierce portion, you will become the death of death. / He of the firm bow, the destroyer, the hero, the hero superior to the universe, the sovereign lord,

sanskrit_iast:
upahastā jvaraṃ bhīmo mṛgapakṣihiraṇmayaḥ
śāstāśeṣasya jagato na tvaṃ naivacaturmukhaḥ //
meaning:
उपहस्ता ज्वरं भीमो मृगपक्षिहिरण्मयः
शास्ताशेषस्य जगतो न त्वं नैवचतुर्मुखः //
text_mt: the assailant, fever, the terrible, golden, consisting of beasts and birds, / the ruler of the entire universe; neither you nor the four-faced one [is].

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya saṃharātmānam ātmanā
no cedidānīṃ krodhasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं सर्वं समालोक्य संहरात्मानम् आत्मना
नो चेदिदानीं क्रोधस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः //
text_mt: Having observed everything thus, withdraw yourself by yourself. / If not, now the death [coming] from Sthāṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
vajrāśaniriva sthāṇos tv evaṃ mṛtyuḥ patiṣyati
ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ //
meaning:
वज्राशनिरिव स्थाणोस् त्व् एवं मृत्युः पतिष्यति
इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः क्रोधविह्वलः //
text_mt: like a thunderbolt of wrath in the form of Mahābhairava, will surely fall upon you." / Addressed thus by Vīrabhadra, Narasiṃha, overwhelmed with wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
nanāda tanuvegena taṃ gṛhītuṃ pracakrame
atrāntare mahāghoraṃ vipakṣabhayakāraṇam //
meaning:
ननाद तनुवेगेन तं गृहीतुं प्रचक्रमे
अत्रान्तरे महाघोरं विपक्षभयकारणम् //
text_mt: roared with bodily force and proceeded to seize him. / In the meantime, most terrible and causing fear to adversaries,

sanskrit_iast:
gaganavyāpi durdharṣaśaivatejaḥsamudbhavam
vīrabhadrasya tadrūpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva dṛśyate //
meaning:
गगनव्यापि दुर्धर्षशैवतेजःसमुद्भवम्
वीरभद्रस्य तद्रूपं तत्क्षणादेव दृश्यते //
text_mt: pervading the sky, arising from the unassailable Śaiva splendor, / that form of Vīrabhadra was seen at that very moment.

sanskrit_iast:
na taddhiraṇmayaṃ saumyaṃ na sauraṃ nāgnisaṃbhavam
na taḍiccandrasadṛśam anaupamyaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
न तद्धिरण्मयं सौम्यं न सौरं नाग्निसंभवम्
न तडिच्चन्द्रसदृशम् अनौपम्यं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: It was not golden, not gentle, not solar, nor born of fire, / not resembling lightning or the moon—it was Maheśvara’s matchless [splendor].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tejāṃsi sarvāṇi tasmin līnāni śāṅkare
tato vyakto mahātejā vyakte saṃbhavatastataḥ //
meaning:
तदा तेजांसि सर्वाणि तस्मिन् लीनानि शाङ्करे
ततो व्यक्तो महातेजा व्यक्ते संभवतस्ततः //
text_mt: Then all splendors merged into that belonging to Śaṅkara. / Therefrom the one of great splendor became manifest; from the manifest they come into being.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrasādhāraṇaṃ caiva cihnitaṃ vikṛtākṛti
tataḥ saṃhārarūpeṇa suvyaktaḥ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
रुद्रसाधारणं चैव चिह्नितं विकृताकृति
ततः संहाररूपेण सुव्यक्तः परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: Characterized by that which is common to Rudra and having a deformed shape, / the Supreme Lord then became clearly manifest in the form of dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
sahasrabāhur jaṭilaś candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ //
meaning:
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः
सहस्रबाहुर् जटिलश् चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरः //
text_mt: while all the gods watched, amidst auspicious cries of victory and the like, / with a thousand arms, matted locks, and the crescent moon upon his crest.

sanskrit_iast:
sa mṛgārdhaśarīreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ cañcunā dvijāḥ
atitīkṣṇamahādaṃṣṭro vajratulyanakhāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
स मृगार्धशरीरेण पक्षाभ्यां चञ्चुना द्विजाः
अतितीक्ष्णमहादंष्ट्रो वज्रतुल्यनखायुधः //
text_mt: With half the body of a beast, with two wings and a beak, O twice-born ones, / having exceedingly sharp, huge fangs and claw-weapons equal to the thunderbolt,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe kālo mahābāhuś catuṣpād vahnisaṃbhavaḥ
yugāntodyatajīmūtabhīmagaṃbhīraniḥsvanaḥ //
meaning:
कण्ठे कालो महाबाहुश् चतुष्पाद् वह्निसंभवः
युगान्तोद्यतजीमूतभीमगंभीरनिःस्वनः //
text_mt: dark-necked, mighty-armed, four-footed, born of fire, / roaring with a deep and dreadful sound like thunderclouds risen at the end of a yuga,

sanskrit_iast:
samaṃ kupitavṛttāgnivyāvṛttanayanatrayaḥ
spaṣṭadaṃṣṭro 'dharoṣṭhaś ca huṅkāreṇa yuto haraḥ //
meaning:
समं कुपितवृत्ताग्निव्यावृत्तनयनत्रयः
स्पष्टदंष्ट्रो ऽधरोष्ठश् च हुङ्कारेण युतो हरः //
text_mt: with three rounded, fiery, rolled eyes alike in anger, / having visible fangs and lower lip, accompanied by the sound "huṃ", Hara [manifested].

sanskrit_iast:
haristaddarśanādeva vinaṣṭabalavikramaḥ
bibhrad aurmyaṃ sahasrāṃśor adhaḥ khadyotavibhramam //
meaning:
हरिस्तद्दर्शनादेव विनष्टबलविक्रमः
बिभ्रद् और्म्यं सहस्रांशोर् अधः खद्योतविभ्रमम् //
text_mt: Hari, from the very sight of him, had his strength and prowess destroyed, / bearing beneath him the illusion of a firefly in comparison to the splendor of the thousand-rayed sun.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vibhramya pakṣābhyāṃ nābhipāde 'bhyudārayan
pādāvābadhya pucchena bāhubhyāṃ bāhumaṇḍalam //
meaning:
अथ विभ्रम्य पक्षाभ्यां नाभिपादे ऽभ्युदारयन्
पादावाबध्य पुच्छेन बाहुभ्यां बाहुमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Then, having whirled him with his wings and split open the region of the navel and feet, / binding his two feet with his tail and the circle of his arms with his arms,

sanskrit_iast:
bhindannurasi bāhubhyāṃ nijagrāha haro harim
tato jagāma gaganaṃ devaiḥ saha maharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
भिन्दन्नुरसि बाहुभ्यां निजग्राह हरो हरिम्
ततो जगाम गगनं देवैः सह महर्षिभिः //
text_mt: cleaving his chest with his arms, Hara seized Hari. / Then he went into the sky along with the gods and great sages,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasaiva bhayādviṣṇuṃ vihagaś ca yathoragam
utkṣipyotkṣipya saṃgṛhya nipātya ca nipātya ca //
meaning:
सहसैव भयाद्विष्णुं विहगश् च यथोरगम्
उत्क्षिप्योत्क्षिप्य संगृह्य निपात्य च निपात्य च //
text_mt: suddenly [bearing] Viṣṇu out of fear, as a bird [bears] a serpent, / tossing him up repeatedly, seizing him, hurling him down repeatedly,

sanskrit_iast:
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya bhagavān pakṣāghātavimohitam
hariṃ harantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ viśveśānaṃ tamīśvaram //
meaning:
उड्डीयोड्डीय भगवान् पक्षाघातविमोहितम्
हरिं हरन्तं वृषभं विश्वेशानं तमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: flying up again and again, the Lord, carrying Hari who was stunned by the blows of his wings— / he, the bull, the Lord of the universe, that sovereign Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
anuyānti surāḥ sarve namovākyena tuṣṭuvuḥ
nīyamānaḥ paravaśo dīnavaktraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
अनुयान्ति सुराः सर्वे नमोवाक्येन तुष्टुवुः
नीयमानः परवशो दीनवक्त्रः कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: all the gods followed and praised with words of reverence. / Being carried away, helpless, with a miserable face and folded hands,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ haristaṃ lalitākṣaraiḥ
namo rudrāya śarvāya mahāgrāsāya viṣṇave //
meaning:
तुष्टाव परमेशानं हरिस्तं ललिताक्षरैः
नमो रुद्राय शर्वाय महाग्रासाय विष्णवे //
text_mt: Hari praised that Supreme Lord with graceful words: / "Homage to Rudra, to Śarva, to Viṣṇu the great devourer!

sanskrit_iast:
nama ugrāya bhīmāya namaḥ krodhāya manyave
namo bhavāya śarvāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te //
meaning:
नम उग्राय भीमाय नमः क्रोधाय मन्यवे
नमो भवाय शर्वाय शङ्कराय शिवाय ते //
text_mt: Homage to the fierce one, to the terrible one; homage to wrath, to fury! / Homage to Bhava, to Śarva, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
kālakālāya kālāya mahākālāya mṛtyave
vīrāya vīrabhadrāya kṣayadvīrāya śūline //
meaning:
कालकालाय कालाय महाकालाय मृत्यवे
वीराय वीरभद्राय क्षयद्वीराय शूलिने //
text_mt: To the Death of Death, to Time, to Mahākāla, to Death, / to the hero, to Vīrabhadra, to the destroyer of heroes, to the wielder of the trident!

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāya mahate paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
ekāya nīlakaṇṭhāya śrīkaṇṭhāya pinākine //
meaning:
महादेवाय महते पशूनां पतये नमः
एकाय नीलकण्ठाय श्रीकण्ठाय पिनाकिने //
text_mt: Homage to Mahādeva, the great one, the Lord of beasts! / To the single one, to the blue-throated one, to Śrīkaṇṭha, to Pinākin!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'nantāya sūkṣmāya namaste mṛtyumanyave
parāya parameśāya parātparatarāya te //
meaning:
नमो ऽनन्ताय सूक्ष्माय नमस्ते मृत्युमन्यवे
पराय परमेशाय परात्परतराय ते //
text_mt: Homage to the endless, to the subtle; homage to you, the fury of Death! / To the transcendent, to the supreme ruler, to you who are higher than the highest!

sanskrit_iast:
parātparāya viśvāya namaste viśvamūrttaye
namo viṣṇukalatrāya viṣṇukṣetrāya bhānave //
meaning:
परात्पराय विश्वाय नमस्ते विश्वमूर्त्तये
नमो विष्णुकलत्राय विष्णुक्षेत्राय भानवे //
text_mt: To the one higher than the highest, to the universal, homage to you whose form is the universe! / Homage to the spouse of Viṣṇu, to the field of Viṣṇu, to the sun!

sanskrit_iast:
kaivartāya kirātāya mahāvyādhāya śāśvate
bhairavāya śaraṇyāya mahābhairavarūpiṇe //
meaning:
कैवर्ताय किराताय महाव्याधाय शाश्वते
भैरवाय शरण्याय महाभैरवरूपिणे //
text_mt: To the fisherman, to the Kirāta, to the great hunter, to the eternal one, / to Bhairava, the refuge, the one possessing the form of Mahābhairava!

sanskrit_iast:
namo nṛsiṃhasaṃhartre kāmakālapurāraye
mahāpāśaughasaṃhartre viṣṇumāyāntakāriṇe //
meaning:
नमो नृसिंहसंहर्त्रे कामकालपुरारये
महापाशौघसंहर्त्रे विष्णुमायान्तकारिणे //
text_mt: Homage to the destroyer of Narasiṃha, the enemy of Kāma, of Kāla, and of the cities, / to the destroyer of the great flood of nooses, who brings an end to the illusion of Viṣṇu!

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃbakāya tryakṣarāya śipiviṣṭāya mīḍhuṣe
mṛtyuñjayāya śarvāya sarvajñāya makhāraye //
meaning:
त्र्यंबकाय त्र्यक्षराय शिपिविष्टाय मीढुषे
मृत्युञ्जयाय शर्वाय सर्वज्ञाय मखारये //
text_mt: To Tryambaka, to the three-syllabled one, to Śipiviṣṭa, to the bountiful, / to the conqueror of death, to Śarva, to the omniscient, to the enemy of sacrifice!

sanskrit_iast:
makheśāya vareṇyāya namaste vahnirūpiṇe
mahāghrāṇāya jihvāya prāṇāpānapravartine //
meaning:
मखेशाय वरेण्याय नमस्ते वह्निरूपिणे
महाघ्राणाय जिह्वाय प्राणापानप्रवर्तिने //
text_mt: To the lord of sacrifice, to the most excellent, homage to you who have the form of fire! / To the great scent, to the tongue, to the activator of the prāṇa and apāna breaths!

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇāya triśūlāya guṇātītāya yogine
saṃsārāya pravāhāya mahāyantrapravartine //
meaning:
त्रिगुणाय त्रिशूलाय गुणातीताय योगिने
संसाराय प्रवाहाय महायन्त्रप्रवर्तिने //
text_mt: To the one of three guṇas, to the trident-bearer, to the one beyond guṇas, to the yogin, / to the cycle of rebirth, to the current, to the operator of the great machine!

sanskrit_iast:
namaścandrāgnisūryāya muktivaicitryahetave
varadāyāvatārāya sarvakāraṇahetave //
meaning:
नमश्चन्द्राग्निसूर्याय मुक्तिवैचित्र्यहेतवे
वरदायावताराय सर्वकारणहेतवे //
text_mt: Homage to the moon, fire, and sun, to the cause of the variety of liberation, / to the giver of boons, to the descent, to the cause of all causes!

sanskrit_iast:
kapāline karālāya pataye puṇyakīrttaye
amoghāyāgninetrāya lakulīśāya śaṃbhave //
meaning:
कपालिने करालाय पतये पुण्यकीर्त्तये
अमोघायाग्निनेत्राय लकुलीशाय शंभवे //
text_mt: To the skull-bearer, to the dreadful, to the lord of meritorious fame, / to the unfailing, to the fire-eyed, to Lakulīśa, to Śambhu!

sanskrit_iast:
bhiṣaktamāya muṇḍāya daṇḍine yogarūpiṇe
meghavāhāya devāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ //
meaning:
भिषक्तमाय मुण्डाय दण्डिने योगरूपिणे
मेघवाहाय देवाय पार्वतीपतये नमः //
text_mt: To the supreme physician, to the shaven-headed, to the staff-bearer, to the one whose form is yoga, / to the one whose mount is a cloud, to the God, homage to the lord of Pārvatī!

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktāya viśokāya sthirāya sthiradhanvine
sthāṇave kṛttivāsāya namaḥ pañcārthahetave //
meaning:
अव्यक्ताय विशोकाय स्थिराय स्थिरधन्विने
स्थाणवे कृत्तिवासाय नमः पञ्चार्थहेतवे //
text_mt: To the unmanifest, to the sorrowless, to the firm one, to the one of firm bow, / to Sthāṇu, to the one clad in hide, homage to the cause of the five principles!"

sanskrit_iast:
varadāyaikapādāya namaścandrārdhamauline
namaste 'dhvararājāya vayasāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
वरदायैकपादाय नमश्चन्द्रार्धमौलिने
नमस्ते ऽध्वरराजाय वयसां पतये नमः //
text_mt:
Homage to the boon-giver, the one-footed, homage to the moon-crested,
homage to you, the king of sacrifice; homage to the lord of birds!

sanskrit_iast:
yogīśvarāya nityāya satyāya parameṣṭhine
sarvātmane namastubhyaṃ namaḥ sarveśvarāya te //
meaning:
योगीश्वराय नित्याय सत्याय परमेष्ठिने
सर्वात्मने नमस्तुभ्यं नमः सर्वेश्वराय ते //
text_mt:
Homage to the lord of yogins, the eternal, the true, Parameṣṭhin;
homage to you, the self of all; homage to you, the lord of all!

sanskrit_iast:
ekadvitricatuḥpañcakṛtvas te 'stu namonamaḥ
daśakṛtvastu sāhasrakṛtvaste ca namonamaḥ //
meaning:
एकद्वित्रिचतुःपञ्चकृत्वस् ते ऽस्तु नमोनमः
दशकृत्वस्तु साहस्रकृत्वस्ते च नमोनमः //
text_mt:
Homage, homage to you, one, two, three, four, five times;
homage, homage to you ten times, and a thousand times!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'parimitaṃ kṛtvā-nantakṛtvo namonamaḥ
namonamo namo bhūyaḥ punarbhūyo namonamaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽपरिमितं कृत्वा-नन्तकृत्वो नमोनमः
नमोनमो नमो भूयः पुनर्भूयो नमोनमः //
text_mt:
Having offered homage boundlessly, homage, homage an infinite number of times!
Homage, homage, homage again, again and again homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
nāmnāmaṣṭaśatenaivaṃ stutvāmṛtamayena tu
punastu prārthayāmāsa nṛsiṃhaḥ śarabheśvaram //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
नाम्नामष्टशतेनैवं स्तुत्वामृतमयेन तु
पुनस्तु प्रार्थयामास नृसिंहः शरभेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having praised [him] thus with the immortal hundred and eight names,
Nṛsiṃha again made a prayer to the lord who is the Śarabha:

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yadā mamājñānam atyahaṅkāradūṣitam
tadā tadāpanetavyaṃ tvayaiva parameśvara //
meaning:
यदा यदा ममाज्ञानम् अत्यहङ्कारदूषितम्
तदा तदापनेतव्यं त्वयैव परमेश्वर //
text_mt:
“Whenever my ignorance is defiled by excessive egoism,
then and there it must be dispelled by you alone, O Supreme Lord!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vijñāpayanprītaḥ śaṅkaraṃ narakesarī
nanvaśakto bhavān viṣṇo jīvitāntaṃ parājitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं विज्ञापयन्प्रीतः शङ्करं नरकेसरी
नन्वशक्तो भवान् विष्णो जीवितान्तं पराजितः //
text_mt:
Thus supplicating Śaṅkara, the man-lion was pleased.
“Indeed, O Viṣṇu, you were powerless, overcome to the end of life.”

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaktraśeṣamātrāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvasya vigraham
śuktiśityaṃ tadā maṅgaṃ vīrabhadraḥ kṣaṇāttataḥ //
meaning:
तद्वक्त्रशेषमात्रान्तं कृत्वा सर्वस्य विग्रहम्
शुक्तिशित्यं तदा मङ्गं वीरभद्रः क्षणात्ततः //
text_mt:
Then Vīrabhadra in an instant made his whole body
end only with the face remaining, destroying its limbs […]

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
atha brahmādayaḥ sarve vīrabhadra tvayā dṛśā
jīvitāḥ smo vayaṃ devāḥ parjanyeneva pādapāḥ //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
अथ ब्रह्मादयः सर्वे वीरभद्र त्वया दृशा
जीविताः स्मो वयं देवाः पर्जन्येनेव पादपाः //
text_mt:
The gods said:
“Now, O Vīrabhadra, all the gods headed by Brahmā have been brought to life
by your glance, as trees are by a rain-cloud.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya bhīṣā dahatyagnir udeti ca raviḥ svayam
vāto vāti ca so 'si tvaṃ mṛtyurdhāvati pañcamaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य भीषा दहत्यग्निर् उदेति च रविः स्वयम्
वातो वाति च सो ऽसि त्वं मृत्युर्धावति पञ्चमः //
text_mt:
You are he through whose fear fire burns and the sun rises on its own,
and the wind blows; Death runs as the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
yadavyaktaṃ paraṃ vyoma kalātītaṃ sadāśivam
bhagavaṃstvāmeva bhavaṃ vadanti brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
यदव्यक्तं परं व्योम कलातीतं सदाशिवम्
भगवंस्त्वामेव भवं वदन्ति ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt:
That unmanifest supreme ether, beyond the kalās, Sadāśiva—
O Lord, the knowers of Brahman proclaim that you alone are Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
ke vayameva dhātukye vedane parameśvaraḥ
na viddhi paramaṃ dhāma rūpalāvaṇyavarṇane //
meaning:
के वयमेव धातुक्ये वेदने परमेश्वरः
न विद्धि परमं धाम रूपलावण्यवर्णने //
text_mt:
Who are we, [created] in the realm of Dhātṛ, to know you, O Supreme Lord?
No one knows your supreme abode, nor can describe your beauty and form.

sanskrit_iast:
upasargeṣu sarveṣu trāyasvāsmān gaṇādhipa
ekādaśātman bhagavān vartate rūpavān haraḥ //
meaning:
उपसर्गेषु सर्वेषु त्रायस्वास्मान् गणाधिप
एकादशात्मन् भगवान् वर्तते रूपवान् हरः //
text_mt:
In all calamities, protect us, O lord of gaṇas!
O eleven-fold self, the blessed Hara stands possessing form.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśān te 'vatārāṇi dṛṣṭvā śiva bahūṃstamaḥ
kadācit saṃdihen nāsmāṃs tvaccintāstamayā tathā //
meaning:
ईदृशान् ते ऽवताराणि दृष्ट्वा शिव बहूंस्तमः
कदाचित् संदिहेन् नास्मांस् त्वच्चिन्तास्तमया तथा //
text_mt:
Having seen such numerous forms of yours, O Śiva, may darkness
never cause us doubt, through the setting of meditation upon you.

sanskrit_iast:
guñjāgirivarataṭā-mitarūpāṇi sarvaśaḥ
abhyasaṃhara gamyaṃ te na nītavyaṃ parāparā //
meaning:
गुञ्जागिरिवरतटा-मितरूपाणि सर्वशः
अभ्यसंहर गम्यं ते न नीतव्यं परापरा //
text_mt:
[…] forms immeasurable on all sides, like slopes of Guñjā mountains;
withdraw [them]; what is approachable for you cannot be attained as the higher and lower.

sanskrit_iast:
dve tanū tava rudrasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ
ghorāpyanyā śivāpyanyā te pratyekamanekadhā //
meaning:
द्वे तनू तव रुद्रस्य वेदज्ञा ब्राह्मणा विदुः
घोराप्यन्या शिवाप्यन्या ते प्रत्येकमनेकधा //
text_mt:
Brahmins who know the Veda know two bodies of yours, Rudra:
one terrible and the other benign; and each of them is manifold.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāsmānpāhi bhagavan nityāhatamahābalaḥ
bhavatā hi jagatsarvaṃ vyāptaṃ svenaiva tejasā //
meaning:
इहास्मान्पाहि भगवन् नित्याहतमहाबलः
भवता हि जगत्सर्वं व्याप्तं स्वेनैव तेजसा //
text_mt:
Protect us here, O Lord, whose great power is ever unbroken!
For the entire universe is pervaded by you with your own splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇvindracandrādi vayaṃ ca pramukhāḥ surāḥ
surāsurāḥ samprasūtās tvattaḥ sarve maheśvara //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रचन्द्रादि वयं च प्रमुखाः सुराः
सुरासुराः सम्प्रसूतास् त्वत्तः सर्वे महेश्वर //
text_mt:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, the Moon, and the other prominent gods—we,
the gods and asuras, are all born from you, O Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā ca indro viṣṇuś ca yamādyā na surāsurān
tato nigṛhya ca hariṃ siṃha ity upacetasam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा च इन्द्रो विष्णुश् च यमाद्या न सुरासुरान्
ततो निगृह्य च हरिं सिंह इत्य् उपचेतसम् //
text_mt:
Neither Brahmā nor Indra nor Viṣṇu nor Yama and the rest [could check] the gods and asuras;
and then, having subdued Hari, the lion, who had that mind […]

sanskrit_iast:
yato bibharṣi sakalaṃ vibhajya tanumaṣṭadhā
ato 'smān pāhi bhagavan surān dānair abhīpsitaiḥ //
meaning:
यतो बिभर्षि सकलं विभज्य तनुमष्टधा
अतो ऽस्मान् पाहि भगवन् सुरान् दानैर् अभीप्सितैः //
text_mt:
Since you sustain everything, dividing your body into eight,
