therefore protect us gods, O Lord, with desired gifts!”

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca tān surāndevo maharṣīṃś ca purātanān
yathā jale jalaṃ kṣiptaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīre ghṛtaṃ ghṛte //
meaning:
उवाच तान् सुरान्देवो महर्षींश् च पुरातनान्
यथा जले जलं क्षिप्तं क्षीरं क्षीरे घृतं घृते //
text_mt:
The god spoke to those gods and to the ancient great sages:
“Just as water cast into water, milk into milk, ghee into ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
eka eva tadā viṣṇuḥ śivalīno na cānyathā
eṣa eva nṛsiṃhātmā sadarpaś ca mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
एक एव तदा विष्णुः शिवलीनो न चान्यथा
एष एव नृसिंहात्मा सदर्पश् च महाबलः //
text_mt:
so Viṣṇu is one, merged in Śiva, and not otherwise.
This very self of Nṛsiṃha, arrogant and possessed of great strength,

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsaṃhārakāreṇa pravṛtto narakesarī
yājanīyo namastasmai madbhaktisiddhikāṅkṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
जगत्संहारकारेण प्रवृत्तो नरकेसरी
याजनीयो नमस्तस्मै मद्भक्तिसिद्धिकाङ्क्षिभिः //
text_mt:
the man-lion set out to cause the destruction of the world.
He should be worshipped—homage to him—by those desiring success in devotion to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā bhagavān vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ
apaśyan sarvabhūtānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् वीरभद्रो महाबलः
अपश्यन् सर्वभूतानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt:
Having said this much, the blessed Vīrabhadra of great strength,
with all beings not seeing, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhakṛttivasanas tadāprabhṛti śaṅkaraḥ
vaktraṃ tanmuṇḍamālāyāṃ nāyakatvena kalpitam //
meaning:
नृसिंहकृत्तिवसनस् तदाप्रभृति शङ्करः
वक्त्रं तन्मुण्डमालायां नायकत्वेन कल्पितम् //
text_mt:
From then on, Śaṅkara has been clothed in the hide of the man-lion,
and its head was set as the central jewel in his garland of skulls.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devā nirātaṅkāḥ kīrtayantaḥ kathāmimām
vismayotphullanayanā jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam //
meaning:
ततो देवा निरातङ्काः कीर्तयन्तः कथामिमाम्
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम् //
text_mt:
Then the gods, free from anxiety, reciting this story,
with eyes opened wide in wonder, all departed as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiḥ samanvitam
paṭhitvā śṛṇute caiva sarvaduḥkhavināśanam //
meaning:
य इदं परमाख्यानं पुण्यं वेदैः समन्वितम्
पठित्वा शृणुते चैव सर्वदुःखविनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Whoever, having read or heard this supreme and meritorious account,
which is accordant with the Vedas, destroys all sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam ārogyaṃ puṣṭivardhanam
sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam //
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् आरोग्यं पुष्टिवर्धनम्
सर्वविघ्नप्रशमनं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् //
text_mt:
[It brings] fortune, fame, long life, health, and increase of vigor;
it quells all obstacles and destroys all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
apamṛtyupraśamanaṃ mahāśāntikaraṃ śubham
aricakrapraśamanaṃ sarvādhipravināśanam //
meaning:
अपमृत्युप्रशमनं महाशान्तिकरं शुभम्
अरिचक्रप्रशमनं सर्वाधिप्रविनाशनम् //
text_mt:
It averts untimely death, produces great peace, is auspicious;
it quells hostile armies and destroys all mental anguish.

sanskrit_iast:
tato duḥsvapnaśamanaṃ sarvabhūtanivāraṇam
viṣagrahakṣayakaraṃ putrapautrādivardhanam //
meaning:
ततो दुःस्वप्नशमनं सर्वभूतनिवारणम्
विषग्रहक्षयकरं पुत्रपौत्रादिवर्धनम् //
text_mt:
Then it quells bad dreams, wards off all evil spirits,
brings about the destruction of poisons and planets, and increases sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
yogasiddhipradaṃ samyak śivajñānaprakāśakam
śeṣalokasya sopānaṃ vāñchitārthaikasādhanam //
meaning:
योगसिद्धिप्रदं सम्यक् शिवज्ञानप्रकाशकम्
शेषलोकस्य सोपानं वाञ्छितार्थैकसाधनम् //
text_mt:
It grants success in yoga, clearly illumines knowledge of Śiva,
is a ladder for the rest of humanity, and is the sole means to obtain desired objects.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumāyānirasanaṃ devatāparamārthadam
vāñchāsiddhipradaṃ caiva ṛddhiprajñādisādhanam //
meaning:
विष्णुमायानिरसनं देवतापरमार्थदम्
वाञ्छासिद्धिप्रदं चैव ऋद्धिप्रज्ञादिसाधनम् //
text_mt:
It dispels the māyā of Viṣṇu, grants the highest truth of divinity,
brings the attainment of desires, and procures prosperity, wisdom, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu śarabhākāraṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ pinākinaḥ
prakāśitavyaṃ bhakteṣu cireṣūdyamiteṣu ca //
meaning:
इदं तु शरभाकारं परं रूपं पिनाकिनः
प्रकाशितव्यं भक्तेषु चिरेषूद्यमितेषु च //
text_mt:
This supreme form of Pinākin in the shape of a Śarabha
is to be revealed among devotees who have long made effort;

sanskrit_iast:
taireva paṭhitavyaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ ca śivātmabhiḥ
śivotsaveṣu sarveṣu caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca //
meaning:
तैरेव पठितव्यं च श्रोतव्यं च शिवात्मभिः
शिवोत्सवेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च //
text_mt:
it should be read and heard only by those whose souls are devoted to Śiva,
on all festivals of Śiva, and on the fourteenth and eighth days.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhetpratiṣṭhākāleṣu śivasannidhikāraṇam
coravyāghrāhisiṃhāntakṛto rājabhayeṣu ca //
meaning:
पठेत्प्रतिष्ठाकालेषु शिवसन्निधिकारणम्
चोरव्याघ्राहिसिंहान्तकृतो राजभयेषु च //
text_mt:
One should recite it at times of temple installations, as a cause of Śiva’s presence;
and in times of fears from kings, thieves, tigers, serpents, lions, or death;

sanskrit_iast:
atrānyotpātabhūkampadavāgnipāṃsuvṛṣṭiṣu
ulkāpāte mahāvāte vinā vṛṣṭyātivṛṣṭiṣu //
meaning:
अत्रान्योत्पातभूकम्पदवाग्निपांसुवृष्टिषु
उल्कापाते महावाते विना वृष्ट्यातिवृष्टिषु //
text_mt:
in other portents here, earthquakes, forest fires, dust storms,
falls of meteors, violent gales, droughts, and excessive rain.

sanskrit_iast:
atastatra paṭhedvidvāñ chivabhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi stavaṃ sarvamanuttamam //
meaning:
अतस्तत्र पठेद्विद्वाञ् छिवभक्तो दृढव्रतः
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स्तवं सर्वमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Therefore, a wise devotee of Śiva, steadfast in his vows, should recite it there.
Whoever recites or hears this entire unsurpassed hymn,

sanskrit_iast: sa rudratvaṃ samāsādya rudrasyānucaro bhavet //
meaning: स रुद्रत्वं समासाद्य रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत् //
text_mt: having attained the state of Rudra, becomes an attendant of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
jalandharaṃ jaṭāmauliḥ purā jambhārivikramam
kathaṃ jaghāna bhagavān bhaganetraharo haraḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
जलन्धरं जटामौलिः पुरा जम्भारिविक्रमम्
कथं जघान भगवान् भगनेत्रहरो हरः //
text_mt:
The sages said:
How did the blessed Hara, whose crown is matted hair, who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga,
slay Jalandhara of old, who possessed the prowess of Indra?

sanskrit_iast:
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa suvrata
jalandhara iti khyāto jalamaṇḍalasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं रोमहर्षण सुव्रत
जलन्धर इति ख्यातो जलमण्डलसंभवः //
text_mt:
You ought to tell us, O Romaharṣaṇa of good vows!
He was known as Jalandhara, born from the orb of the waters;

sanskrit_iast:
āsīdantakasaṃkāśas tapasā labdhavikramaḥ
tena devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ //
meaning:
आसीदन्तकसंकाशस् तपसा लब्धविक्रमः
तेन देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः //
text_mt:
he was like the god of death, having obtained prowess through asceticism.
By him all the gods, along with gandharvas, yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
nirjitāḥ samare sarve brahmā ca bhagavānajaḥ
jitvaiva devasaṃghātaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vai jalandharaḥ //
meaning:
निर्जिताः समरे सर्वे ब्रह्मा च भगवानजः
जित्वैव देवसंघातं ब्रह्माणं वै जलन्धरः //
text_mt:
were conquered in battle, as well as the blessed unborn Brahmā.
Having indeed conquered the host of gods and Brahmā, Jalandhara

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaharaṃ gurum
tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ divārātram aviśramam //
meaning:
जगाम देवदेवेशं विष्णुं विश्वहरं गुरुम्
तयोः समभवद्युद्धं दिवारात्रम् अविश्रमम् //
text_mt:
went to the lord of the gods, Viṣṇu, the destroyer of the universe, the teacher.
Between the two of them a battle occurred, day and night without rest.

sanskrit_iast:
jalandhareśayostena nirjito madhusūdanaḥ
jalandharo 'pi taṃ jitvā devadevaṃ janārdanam //
meaning:
जलन्धरेशयोस्तेन निर्जितो मधुसूदनः
जलन्धरो ऽपि तं जित्वा देवदेवं जनार्दनम् //
text_mt:
Between Jalandhara and the Lord, Madhusūdana was conquered by him.
And having conquered that god of gods, Janārdana, Jalandhara,

sanskrit_iast:
provācedaṃ diteḥ putrān nyāyadhīrjetumīśvaram
sarve jitā mayā yuddhe śaṅkaro hyajito raṇe //
meaning:
प्रोवाचेदं दितेः पुत्रान् न्यायधीर्जेतुमीश्वरम्
सर्वे जिता मया युद्धे शङ्करो ह्यजितो रणे //
text_mt:
resolute in his mind to conquer the Lord, spoke this to the sons of Diti:
“All have been conquered by me in battle; Śaṅkara alone remains unconquered in war.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ jitvā sarvamīśānaṃ gaṇapair nandinā kṣaṇāt
ahameva bhavatvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तं जित्वा सर्वमीशानं गणपैर् नन्दिना क्षणात्
अहमेव भवत्वं च ब्रह्मत्वं वैष्णवं तथा //
text_mt:
Having conquered that whole Īśāna in an instant, along with the troop-leaders and Nandin,
I myself shall give to you, O best among the dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsavatvaṃ ca yuṣmākaṃ dāsye dānavapuṅgavāḥ
jalandharavacaḥ śrutvā sarve te dānavādhamāḥ //
meaning:
वासवत्वं च युष्माकं दास्ये दानवपुङ्गवाः
जलन्धरवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते दानवाधमाः //
text_mt:
the state of Bhava, the state of Brahmā, the state of Viṣṇu,
and the state of Indra!” Hearing Jalandhara’s words, all those vile dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
jagarjuruccaiḥ pāpiṣṭhā mṛtyudarśanatatparāḥ
daityairetaistathānyaiś ca rathanāgaturaṅgamaiḥ //
meaning:
जगर्जुरुच्चैः पापिष्ठा मृत्युदर्शनतत्पराः
दैत्यैरेतैस्तथान्यैश् च रथनागतुरङ्गमैः //
text_mt:
most wicked, intent upon facing their death, roared loudly.
Equipped together with these and other daityas, with chariots, elephants, and horses,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnaddhaiḥ saha saṃnahya śarvaṃ prati yayau balī
bhavo 'pi dṛṣṭvā daityendraṃ merukūṭamiva sthitam //
meaning:
संनद्धैः सह संनह्य शर्वं प्रति ययौ बली
भवो ऽपि दृष्ट्वा दैत्येन्द्रं मेरुकूटमिव स्थितम् //
text_mt:
the mighty one went towards Śarva.
Bhava, too, having seen the king of the daityas standing like a peak of Mount Meru,

sanskrit_iast:
avadhyatvam api śrutvā tathānyair bhaganetrahā
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ rakṣan rakṣako jagatāṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
अवध्यत्वम् अपि श्रुत्वा तथान्यैर् भगनेत्रहा
ब्रह्मणो वचनं रक्षन् रक्षको जगतां प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Even hearing of his invulnerability [to death] by others, the smiter of Bhaga's eyes,
the protector and Lord of the worlds, honouring Brahmā's word,

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃbaḥ sanandī sagaṇaḥ provāca prahasanniva
kiṃ kṛtyamasureśāna yuddhenānena sāṃpratam //
meaning:
सांबः सनन्दी सगणः प्रोवाच प्रहसन्निव
किं कृत्यमसुरेशान युद्धेनानेन सांप्रतम् //
text_mt:
together with Ambā, with Nandin and with the gaṇas, spoke as though smiling:
'What need is there of this battle now, O lord of the asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
madbāṇairbhinnasarvāṅgo martumabhyudyate mudā
jalandharo 'pi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śrotravidāraṇam //
meaning:
मद्बाणैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो मर्तुमभ्युद्यते मुदा
जलन्धरो ऽपि तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा श्रोत्रविदारणम् //
text_mt:
when you are gladly intent on dying, all your limbs pierced by my arrows?'
And Jalandhara, hearing that ear-splitting speech of his,

sanskrit_iast:
sureśvaramuvācedaṃ suretarabaleśvaraḥ
vākyenālaṃ mahābāho devadeva vṛṣadhvaja //
meaning:
सुरेश्वरमुवाचेदं सुरेतरबलेश्वरः
वाक्येनालं महाबाहो देवदेव वृषध्वज //
text_mt:
the lord of the army of the non-gods, spoke thus to the Lord of gods:
'Enough of words, O mighty-armed god of gods, O Vṛṣadhvaja!

sanskrit_iast:
candrāṃśusannibhaiḥ śastrair hara yoddhumihāgataḥ
niśamyāsya vacaḥ śūlī pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā
mahāṃbhasi cakārāśu rathāṅgaṃ raudramāyudham //
meaning:
चन्द्रांशुसन्निभैः शस्त्रैर् हर योद्धुमिहागतः
निशम्यास्य वचः शूली पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया
महांभसि चकाराशु रथाङ्गं रौद्रमायुधम् //
text_mt:
O Hara, I have come here to fight with weapons resembling moonbeams.'
Hearing his words, the wielder of the trident, in divine play with the big toe of his foot,
quickly made a discus, a fearsome weapon, in the great water.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvārṇavāṃbhasi sitaṃ bhagavān rathāṅgaṃ smṛtvā jagattrayamanena hatāḥ surāś ca
dakṣāndhakāntakapuratrayayajñahartā lokatrayāntakakaraḥ prahasaṃtadāha //
meaning:
कृत्वार्णवांभसि सितं भगवान् रथाङ्गं स्मृत्वा जगत्त्रयमनेन हताः सुराश् च
दक्षान्धकान्तकपुरत्रययज्ञहर्ता लोकत्रयान्तककरः प्रहसंतदाह //
text_mt:
Having fashioned a white discus in the water of the ocean, the Blessed One, remembering the three worlds and the gods slain by him—
he who destroyed Dakṣa's sacrifice, the destroyer of Andhaka and of the three cities, the maker of the end of the three worlds—said with a smile:

sanskrit_iast:
pādena nirmitaṃ daitya jalandhara mahārṇave
balavān yadi coddhartuṃ tiṣṭha yoddhuṃ na cānyathā //
meaning:
पादेन निर्मितं दैत्य जलन्धर महार्णवे
बलवान् यदि चोद्धर्तुं तिष्ठ योद्धुं न चान्यथा //
text_mt:
'This was fashioned with my foot, O daitya Jalandhara, in the great ocean.
If you are strong enough to lift it, stand and fight; otherwise do not.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā krodhenādīptalocanaḥ
pradahanniva netrābhyāṃ prāhālokya jagattrayam //
meaning:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्रोधेनादीप्तलोचनः
प्रदहन्निव नेत्राभ्यां प्राहालोक्य जगत्त्रयम् //
text_mt:
Hearing those words of his, his eyes blazing with rage,
as though burning the three worlds with both eyes, looking [upon them], he said:

sanskrit_iast:
jalandhara uvāca
gadāmuddhṛtya hatvā ca nandinaṃ tvāṃ ca śaṅkara
hatvā lokānsuraiḥ sārdhaṃ ḍuṇḍubhān garuḍo yathā //
meaning:
जलन्धर उवाच
गदामुद्धृत्य हत्वा च नन्दिनं त्वां च शङ्कर
हत्वा लोकान्सुरैः सार्धं डुण्डुभान् गरुडो यथा //
text_mt:
Jalandhara said:
'Lifting my mace and slaying Nandin and you, O Śaṅkara,
slaying the worlds together with the gods, as Garuḍa [slays] water snakes,

sanskrit_iast:
hantuṃ carācaraṃ sarvaṃ samartho 'haṃ savāsavam
ko maheśvara madbāṇair acchedyo bhuvanatraye //
meaning:
हन्तुं चराचरं सर्वं समर्थो ऽहं सवासवम्
को महेश्वर मद्बाणैर् अच्छेद्यो भुवनत्रये //
text_mt:
I am capable of slaying all that moves and does not move, along with Indra.
Who in the three worlds, O Maheśvara, cannot be pierced by my arrows?

sanskrit_iast:
bālabhāve ca bhagavān tapasaiva vinirjitaḥ
brahmā balī yauvane vai munayaḥ surapuṅgavaiḥ //
meaning:
बालभावे च भगवान् तपसैव विनिर्जितः
ब्रह्मा बली यौवने वै मुनयः सुरपुङ्गवैः //
text_mt:
Even in childhood, the Lord was completely overcome by penance alone,
and the strong Brahmā in his youth, indeed, along with the sages and the foremost among the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhaṃ kṣaṇena sakalaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
tapasā kiṃ tvayā rudra nirjito bhagavānapi //
meaning:
दग्धं क्षणेन सकलं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
तपसा किं त्वया रुद्र निर्जितो भगवानपि //
text_mt:
All the three worlds, moving and unmoving, were burnt in an instant.
Were you too, O Rudra, even though a Lord, not vanquished by penance?

sanskrit_iast:
indrāgniyamavitteśavāyuvārīśvarādayaḥ
na sehire yathā nāgā gandhaṃ pakṣipateriva //
meaning:
इन्द्राग्नियमवित्तेशवायुवारीश्वरादयः
न सेहिरे यथा नागा गन्धं पक्षिपतेरिव //
text_mt:
Indra, Agni, Yama, the lord of wealth, Vāyu, the lord of waters, and others
could not endure [my smell], just as serpents cannot endure the smell of the king of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
na labdhvā divi bhūmau ca bāhavo mama śaṅkara
samastānparvatānprāpya gharṣitāś ca gaṇeśvara //
meaning:
न लब्ध्वा दिवि भूमौ च बाहवो मम शङ्कर
समस्तान्पर्वतान्प्राप्य घर्षिताश् च गणेश्वर //
text_mt:
Finding no [match] in heaven or on earth, O Śaṅkara, O lord of the gaṇas,
my arms reached all the mountains and rubbed against them.

sanskrit_iast:
girīndro mandaraḥ śrīmān nīlo meruḥ suśobhanaḥ
gharṣito bāhudaṇḍena kaṇḍūnodārtham āpatat //
meaning:
गिरीन्द्रो मन्दरः श्रीमान् नीलो मेरुः सुशोभनः
घर्षितो बाहुदण्डेन कण्डूनोदार्थम् आपतत् //
text_mt:
The glorious lord of mountains Mandara, Nīla, and the most splendid Meru
were rubbed by my staff-like arms to relieve an itch, and fell down.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgā niruddhā bāhubhyāṃ līlārthaṃ himavadgirau
nārīṇāṃ mama bhṛtyaiś ca vajro baddho divaukasām //
meaning:
गङ्गा निरुद्धा बाहुभ्यां लीलार्थं हिमवद्गिरौ
नारीणां मम भृत्यैश् च वज्रो बद्धो दिवौकसाम् //
text_mt:
The Gaṅgā was blocked with both arms for sport on Mount Himavat;
and the thunderbolt of the celestials was bound by the servants of my women.

sanskrit_iast:
vaḍavāyā mukhaṃ bhagnaṃ gṛhītvā vai kareṇa tu
tatkṣaṇādeva sakalaṃ caikārṇavamabhūdidam //
meaning:
वडवाया मुखं भग्नं गृहीत्वा वै करेण तु
तत्क्षणादेव सकलं चैकार्णवमभूदिदम् //
text_mt:
The mouth of the submarine fire was seized and broken by my hand;
and at that very moment all this became a single ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
airāvatādayo nāgāḥ kṣiptāḥ sindhujalopari
saratho bhagavānindraḥ kṣiptaś ca śatayojanam //
meaning:
ऐरावतादयो नागाः क्षिप्ताः सिन्धुजलोपरि
सरथो भगवानिन्द्रः क्षिप्तश् च शतयोजनम् //
text_mt:
The elephants headed by Airāvata were cast onto the waters of the ocean,
and the blessed Indra along with his chariot was cast a hundred yojanas away.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍo 'pi mayā baddho nāgapāśena viṣṇunā
urvaśyādyā mayā nītā nāryaḥ kārāgṛhāntaram //
meaning:
गरुडो ऽपि मया बद्धो नागपाशेन विष्णुना
उर्वश्याद्या मया नीता नार्यः कारागृहान्तरम् //
text_mt:
Even Garuḍa was bound by me with a serpent-noose, along with Viṣṇu;
women headed by Urvaśī were brought by me into the inner prison.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃcillabdhavān śakraḥ śacīmekāṃ praṇamya mām
māṃ na jānāsi daityendraṃ jalandharamumāpate //
meaning:
कथंचिल्लब्धवान् शक्रः शचीमेकां प्रणम्य माम्
मां न जानासि दैत्येन्द्रं जलन्धरमुमापते //
text_mt:
Somehow Śakra regained Śacī alone after bowing down to me.
Do you not know me, the lord of daityas, Jalandhara, O lord of Umā?'

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
evamukto mahādevaḥ prādahadvai rathaṃ tadā
tasya netrāgnibhāgaikakalārdhārdhena cākulam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एवमुक्तो महादेवः प्रादहद्वै रथं तदा
तस्य नेत्राग्निभागैककलार्धार्धेन चाकुलम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Being spoken to thus, Mahādeva then burnt his chariot, which was bewildered
by even a fraction of a sixteenth part of a sixteenth of the fire of his eye.

sanskrit_iast:
daityānāmatulabalairhayaiś ca nāgair daityendrās tripuraripor nirīkṣaṇena
nāgād vaiśasam anusaṃvṛtaś ca nāgair deveśaṃ vacanamuvāca cālpabuddhiḥ //
meaning:
दैत्यानामतुलबलैर्हयैश् च नागैर् दैत्येन्द्रास् त्रिपुररिपोर् निरीक्षणेन
नागाद् वैशसम् अनुसंवृतश् च नागैर् देवेशं वचनमुवाच चाल्पबुद्धिः //
text_mt:
The lords of daityas, along with horses of matchless strength and elephants,
did not incur destruction from the look of the enemy of the three cities; and surrounded by elephants, the small-minded one spoke these words to the Lord of gods:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kāryaṃ mama yudhi devadaityasaṃghair hantuṃ yatsakalamidaṃ kṣaṇātsamarthaḥ
yattasmādbhayamihanāsti yoddhum īśa vāñchaiṣā vipulatarā na saṃśayo 'tra //
meaning:
किं कार्यं मम युधि देवदैत्यसंघैर् हन्तुं यत्सकलमिदं क्षणात्समर्थः
यत्तस्माद्भयमिहनास्ति योद्धुम् ईश वाञ्छैषा विपुलतरा न संशयो ऽत्र //
text_mt:
'What need have I of battle with hosts of gods and daityas, when I am able to destroy all this in an instant?
Since there is no fear here, O Lord, my desire to fight is very great—there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ mama madanāridakṣaśatro yajñāre tripuraripo mamaiva vīraiḥ
bhūtendrairharivadanena devasaṃghair yoddhuṃ te balamiha cāsti ceddhi tiṣṭha //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं मम मदनारिदक्षशत्रो यज्ञारे त्रिपुररिपो ममैव वीरैः
भूतेन्द्रैर्हरिवदनेन देवसंघैर् योद्धुं ते बलमिह चास्ति चेद्धि तिष्ठ //
text_mt:
Therefore, O enemy of the god of love, O enemy of Dakṣa, O enemy of the sacrifice, O enemy of the three cities, if you have the strength to fight here
with my heroes, the lords of spirits, the monkey-faced ones, and hosts of gods, then stand firm!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvātha mahādevaṃ mahādevārinandanaḥ
na cacāla na sasmāra nihatānbāndhavānyudhi //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वाथ महादेवं महादेवारिनन्दनः
न चचाल न सस्मार निहतान्बान्धवान्युधि //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to Mahādeva, the son of the enemy of Mahādeva
did not waver, nor did he remember his kinsmen slain in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
durmadenāvinītātmā dorbhyāmāsphoṭya dorbalāt
sudarśanākhyaṃ yaccakraṃ tena hantuṃ samudyataḥ //
meaning:
दुर्मदेनाविनीतात्मा दोर्भ्यामास्फोट्य दोर्बलात्
सुदर्शनाख्यं यच्चक्रं तेन हन्तुं समुद्यतः //
text_mt:
His mind undisciplined through insolent pride, striking his arms with his arm-strength,
he set about to kill him with the discus named Sudarśana.

sanskrit_iast:
durdhareṇa rathāṅgena kṛcchreṇāpi dvijottamāḥ
sthāpayāmāsa vai skandhe dvidhābhūtaś ca tena vai //
meaning:
दुर्धरेण रथाङ्गेन कृच्छ्रेणापि द्विजोत्तमाः
स्थापयामास वै स्कन्धे द्विधाभूतश् च तेन वै //
text_mt:
With great difficulty, O best of the twice-born, he placed the unbearable discus
upon his shoulder, and by it he was split in two.

sanskrit_iast:
kuliśena yathā chinno dvidhā girivaro dvijāḥ
papāta daityo balavān añjanādririvāparaḥ //
meaning:
कुलिशेन यथा छिन्नो द्विधा गिरिवरो द्विजाः
पपात दैत्यो बलवान् अञ्जनाद्रिरिवापरः //
text_mt:
Just as a great mountain is split in two by a thunderbolt, O twice-born,
the mighty daitya fell like another mountain of collyrium.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya raktena raudreṇa sampūrṇam abhavatkṣaṇāt
tadraktamakhilaṃ rudraniyogānmāṃsameva ca //
meaning:
तस्य रक्तेन रौद्रेण सम्पूर्णम् अभवत्क्षणात्
तद्रक्तमखिलं रुद्रनियोगान्मांसमेव च //
text_mt:
In an instant, [the place] became completely filled with his dreadful blood.
All that blood, and also his flesh, by Rudra's command,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārauravamāsādya raktakuṇḍamabhūdaho
jalandharaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā devagandharvapārṣadāḥ //
meaning:
महारौरवमासाद्य रक्तकुण्डमभूदहो
जलन्धरं हतं दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वपार्षदाः //
text_mt:
entered the Mahāraurava hell and became a pool of blood, ah!
Seeing Jalandhara slain, the gods, gandharvas, and attendants

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā sādhu deveti cābruvan
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi jalandharavimardanam //
meaning:
सिंहनादं महत्कृत्वा साधु देवेति चाब्रुवन्
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि जलन्धरविमर्दनम् //
text_mt:
uttered a great lion's roar and cried out: 'Well done, O god!'
Whoever recites or hears this destruction of Jalandhara,

sanskrit_iast: śrāvayedvā yathānyāyaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning: श्रावयेद्वा यथान्यायं गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: or causes it to be heard according to rule, shall attain the status of a lord of the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ devena vai sūta devadevānmaheśvarāt
sudarśanākhyaṃ vai labdhaṃ vaktumarhasi viṣṇunā //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं देवेन वै सूत देवदेवान्महेश्वरात्
सुदर्शनाख्यं वै लब्धं वक्तुमर्हसि विष्णुना //
text_mt:
The sages said:
'O Sūta, you should tell how the [weapon] named Sudarśana was obtained
by the god Viṣṇu from Maheśvara, the god of gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
devānām asurendrāṇām abhavacca sudāruṇaḥ
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ vināśakaraṇo mahān //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
देवानाम् असुरेन्द्राणाम् अभवच्च सुदारुणः
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां विनाशकरणो महान् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
There was a most dreadful, great [battle] between the gods and the lords of asuras,
which caused the destruction of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
te devāḥ śaktimuśalaiḥ sāyakairnataparvabhiḥ
prabhidyamānāḥ kuntaiś ca dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ //
meaning:
ते देवाः शक्तिमुशलैः सायकैर्नतपर्वभिः
प्रभिद्यमानाः कुन्तैश् च दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः //
text_mt:
The gods, pierced by javelins, pestles, arrows with bent joints,
and lances, fled in all directions, distraught with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
parājitāstadā devā devadeveśvaraṃ harim
praṇemustaṃ sureśānaṃ śokasaṃvignamānasāḥ //
meaning:
पराजितास्तदा देवा देवदेवेश्वरं हरिम्
प्रणेमुस्तं सुरेशानं शोकसंविग्नमानसाः //
text_mt:
Defeated then, the gods bowed to Hari, the lord of the god of gods;
with minds agitated by grief, [they bowed] to that lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tān samīkṣyātha bhagavān devadeveśvaro hariḥ
praṇipatya sthitāndevān idaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
तान् समीक्ष्याथ भगवान् देवदेवेश्वरो हरिः
प्रणिपत्य स्थितान्देवान् इदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Seeing the gods who stood there having bowed down, the Blessed One,
Hari, the lord of the god of gods, spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
vatsāḥ kimiti vai devāś cyutālaṅkāravikramāḥ
samāgatāḥ sasaṃtāpā vaktumarhatha suvratāḥ //
meaning:
वत्साः किमिति वै देवाश् च्युतालङ्कारविक्रमाः
समागताः ससंतापा वक्तुमर्हथ सुव्रताः //
text_mt:
'O children, why have the gods come thus, their ornaments and valour fallen away,
filled with distress? You should tell, O you of noble vows!'

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tathābhūtāḥ surottamāḥ
praṇamyāhuryathāvṛttaṃ devadevāya viṣṇave //
meaning:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तथाभूताः सुरोत्तमाः
प्रणम्याहुर्यथावृत्तं देवदेवाय विष्णवे //
text_mt:
Hearing those words of his, the foremost of the gods, being in that state,
bowed down and told what had happened to the god of gods, Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevadeveśa viṣṇo jiṣṇo janārdana
dānavaiḥ pīḍitāḥ sarve vayaṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ //
meaning:
भगवन्देवदेवेश विष्णो जिष्णो जनार्दन
दानवैः पीडिताः सर्वे वयं शरणमागताः //
text_mt:
'O Blessed One, O lord of the god of gods, O Viṣṇu, O victorious one, O Janārdana,
all of us, tormented by the dānavas, have come to you for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva devadeveśa gatirnaḥ puruṣottama
tvameva paramātmā hi tvaṃ pitā jagatāmapi //
meaning:
त्वमेव देवदेवेश गतिर्नः पुरुषोत्तम
त्वमेव परमात्मा हि त्वं पिता जगतामपि //
text_mt:
You alone, O lord of the god of gods, are our resort, O Supreme Spirit!
For you alone are the Supreme Self, and you are the father of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva bhartā hartā ca bhoktā dātā janārdana
hantumarhasi tasmāttvaṃ dānavāndānavārdana //
meaning:
त्वमेव भर्ता हर्ता च भोक्ता दाता जनार्दन
हन्तुमर्हसि तस्मात्त्वं दानवान्दानवार्दन //
text_mt:
You alone are the maintainer, the destroyer, the enjoyer, and the giver, O Janārdana.
Therefore, you should slay the dānavas, O crusher of dānavas!

sanskrit_iast:
daityāś ca vaiṣṇavairbrāhmai raudrairyāmyaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ
kauberaiścaiva saumyaiś ca nairṛtyairvāruṇairdṛḍhaiḥ //
meaning:
दैत्याश् च वैष्णवैर्ब्राह्मै रौद्रैर्याम्यैः सुदारुणैः
कौबेरैश्चैव सौम्यैश् च नैरृत्यैर्वारुणैर्दृढैः //
text_mt:
The daityas [are striking us] with dreadful Vaiṣṇava, Brāhma, Raudra, Yāmya,
Kaubera, Saumya, Nairṛta, and firm Vāruṇa [missiles],

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyaiś ca tathāgneyair aiśānair vārṣikaiḥ śubhaiḥ
saurai raudrais tathā bhīmaiḥ kampanair jṛmbhaṇair dṛḍhaiḥ //
meaning:
वायव्यैश् च तथाग्नेयैर् ऐशानैर् वार्षिकैः शुभैः
सौरै रौद्रैस् तथा भीमैः कम्पनैर् जृम्भणैर् दृढैः //
text_mt:
and likewise with Vāyavya, Āgneya, Aiśāna, auspicious Vārṣika,
Saura, Raudra, and fearsome, shaking, yawning, and firm [missiles].'

sanskrit_iast:
avadhyā varalābhātte sarve vārijalocana
sūryamaṇḍalasambhūtaṃ tvadīyaṃ cakram udyatam //
meaning:
अवध्या वरलाभात्ते सर्वे वारिजलोचन
सूर्यमण्डलसम्भूतं त्वदीयं चक्रम् उद्यतम् //
text_mt: They are invincible because they have obtained boons, O lotus-eyed one! / Your raised discus, born from the solar orb,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇṭhitaṃ hi dadhīcena cyāvanena jagadguro
daṇḍaṃ śārṅgaṃ tavāstraṃ ca labdhaṃ daityaiḥ prasādataḥ //
meaning:
कुण्ठितं हि दधीचेन च्यावनेन जगद्गुरो
दण्डं शार्ङ्गं तवास्त्रं च लब्धं दैत्यैः प्रसादतः //
text_mt: Was indeed blunted by Dadhīca, son of Cyavana, O teacher of the world! / And your staff, your Śārṅga bow, and your weapons were obtained by the Daityas through grace.

sanskrit_iast:
purā jalandharaṃ hantuṃ nirmitaṃ tripurāriṇā
rathāṅgaṃ suśitaṃ ghoraṃ tena tān hantum arhasi //
meaning:
पुरा जलन्धरं हन्तुं निर्मितं त्रिपुरारिणा
रथाङ्गं सुशितं घोरं तेन तान् हन्तुम् अर्हसि //
text_mt: Formerly, to slay Jalandhara, a discus was fashioned by the enemy of Tripura, / extremely sharp and terrible; with that you ought to slay them.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttena nihantavyā nānyaiḥ śastraśatairapi
tato niśamya teṣāṃ vai vacanaṃ vārijekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्तेन निहन्तव्या नान्यैः शस्त्रशतैरपि
ततो निशम्य तेषां वै वचनं वारिजेक्षणः //
text_mt: Therefore, they must be slain with that, and not with hundreds of other weapons.” / Then, hearing their words, the lotus-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
vācaspatimukhānāha sa hariścakrabhṛt svayam
bhobho devā mahādevaṃ sarvair devaiḥ sanātanaiḥ //
meaning:
वाचस्पतिमुखानाह स हरिश्चक्रभृत् स्वयम्
भोभो देवा महादेवं सर्वैर् देवैः सनातनैः //
text_mt: Hari himself, the wielder of the discus, spoke to those led by Vācaspati: / “O gods! Having approached Mahādeva along with all the eternal gods,

sanskrit_iast:
samprāpya sāṃprataṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi divaukasām
devā jalandharaṃ hantuṃ nirmitaṃ hi purāriṇā //
meaning:
सम्प्राप्य सांप्रतं सर्वं करिष्यामि दिवौकसाम्
देवा जलन्धरं हन्तुं निर्मितं हि पुरारिणा //
text_mt: I shall now accomplish everything for the dwellers of heaven. / O gods, the discus fashioned formerly by the enemy of pura to slay Jalandhara—

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā rathāṅgaṃ tenaiva nihatya ca mahāsurān
sarvāndhundhumukhāndaityān aṣṭaṣaṣṭiśatān surān //
meaning:
लब्ध्वा रथाङ्गं तेनैव निहत्य च महासुरान्
सर्वान्धुन्धुमुखान्दैत्यान् अष्टषष्टिशतान् सुरान् //
text_mt: Having obtained that discus and slain with it the great Asuras, / all the Daityas headed by Dhundhu, and sixty-eight hundred [demon] gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sabāndhavānkṣaṇādeva yuṣmān saṃtārayāmyaham
evam uktvā suraśreṣṭhān suraśreṣṭhamanusmaran //
meaning:
सबान्धवान्क्षणादेव युष्मान् संतारयाम्यहम्
एवम् उक्त्वा सुरश्रेष्ठान् सुरश्रेष्ठमनुस्मरन् //
text_mt: Together with their kinsmen, in an instant I shall deliver you!” / Having spoken thus to the foremost gods, remembering the foremost god,

sanskrit_iast:
suraśreṣṭhastadā śreṣṭhaṃ pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram
liṅgaṃ sthāpya yathānyāyaṃ himavacchikhare śubhe //
meaning:
सुरश्रेष्ठस्तदा श्रेष्ठं पूजयामास शङ्करम्
लिङ्गं स्थाप्य यथान्यायं हिमवच्छिखरे शुभे //
text_mt: The foremost god then worshipped the supreme Śaṅkara, / having duly installed a liṅga on the auspicious summit of the Himavat,

sanskrit_iast:
meruparvatasaṃkāśaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā
tvaritākhyena rudreṇa raudreṇa ca janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
मेरुपर्वतसंकाशं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा
त्वरिताख्येन रुद्रेण रौद्रेण च जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Resembling Mount Meru, fashioned by Viśvakarman. / Janārdana, with the fierce Rudra named Tvarita,

sanskrit_iast:
snāpya sampūjya gandhādyair jvālākāraṃ manoramam
tuṣṭāva ca tadā rudraṃ sampūjyāgnau praṇamya ca //
meaning:
स्नाप्य सम्पूज्य गन्धाद्यैर् ज्वालाकारं मनोरमम्
तुष्टाव च तदा रुद्रं सम्पूज्याग्नौ प्रणम्य च //
text_mt: Bathing [it] and worshipping [it] with perfumes and the like, radiant as a flame, delightful, / then praised Rudra, worshipping [him] and bowing in the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
devaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa bhavādyena yathākramam
pūjayāmāsa ca śivaṃ praṇavādyaṃ namo 'ntakam //
meaning:
देवं नाम्नां सहस्रेण भवाद्येन यथाक्रमम्
पूजयामास च शिवं प्रणवाद्यं नमो ऽन्तकम् //
text_mt: With the thousand names beginning with Bhava, in proper sequence, / he worshipped Śiva, beginning with the praṇava and ending with “namaḥ”.

sanskrit_iast:
devaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa bhavādyena maheśvaram
pratināma sa padmena pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram //
meaning:
देवं नाम्नां सहस्रेण भवाद्येन महेश्वरम्
प्रतिनाम स पद्मेन पूजयामास शङ्करम् //
text_mt: The god, Maheśvara, with the thousand names beginning with Bhava, / with a lotus for each name, he worshipped Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
agnau ca nāmabhir devaṃ bhavādyaiḥ samidādibhiḥ
svāhāntairvidhivaddhutvā pratyekamayutaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
अग्नौ च नामभिर् देवं भवाद्यैः समिदादिभिः
स्वाहान्तैर्विधिवद्धुत्वा प्रत्येकमयुतं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: And in the fire, to the god, the lord, with the names beginning with Bhava, using firewood and the like / ending with “svāhā”, offering duly ten thousand times for each,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva ca punaḥ śaṃbhuṃ bhavādyairbhavamīśvaram
bhavaḥ śivo haro rudraḥ puruṣaḥ padmalocanaḥ //
meaning:
तुष्टाव च पुनः शंभुं भवाद्यैर्भवमीश्वरम्
भवः शिवो हरो रुद्रः पुरुषः पद्मलोचनः //
text_mt: He praised Śambhu again, Bhava, the Lord, with [the names] beginning with Bhava: / “Bhava, Śiva, Hara, Rudra, Puruṣa, Lotus-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
arthitavyaḥ sadācāraḥ sarvaśaṃbhurmaheśvaraḥ
īśvaraḥ sthāṇurīśānaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt //
meaning:
अर्थितव्यः सदाचारः सर्वशंभुर्महेश्वरः
ईश्वरः स्थाणुरीशानः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् //
text_mt: One to be entreated, Right-conducted, All-Śambhu, Maheśvara, / Īśvara, Sthāṇu, Īśāna, Thousand-eyed, Thousand-footed,

sanskrit_iast:
varīyān varado vandyaḥ śaṅkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ
gaṅgādharaḥ śūladharaḥ parārthaikaprayojanaḥ //
meaning:
वरीयान् वरदो वन्द्यः शङ्करः परमेश्वरः
गङ्गाधरः शूलधरः परार्थैकप्रयोजनः //
text_mt: Most excellent, Boon-giver, Praiseworthy, Śaṅkara, Supreme Lord, / Bearer of Gaṅgā, Bearer of the trident, Having the benefit of others as his sole purpose,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñaḥ sarvadevādigiridhanvā jaṭādharaḥ
candrāpīḍaścandramaulir vidvānviśvāmareśvaraḥ //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञः सर्वदेवादिगिरिधन्वा जटाधरः
चन्द्रापीडश्चन्द्रमौलिर् विद्वान्विश्वामरेश्वरः //
text_mt: Omniscient, Beginning of all gods, Having a mountain for his bow, Matted-haired, / Having the moon as his crest, Having the moon on his diadem, Wise, Lord of the gods of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
vedāntasārasaṃdohaḥ kapālī nīlalohitaḥ
dhyānādhāroparicchedyo gaurībhartā gaṇeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
वेदान्तसारसंदोहः कपाली नीललोहितः
ध्यानाधारोपरिच्छेद्यो गौरीभर्ता गणेश्वरः //
text_mt: Essence of the teachings of the Upaniṣads, Bearer of the skull, Dark and red, / Base of meditation, Indivisible, Husband of Gaurī, Lord of the Gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamūrtirviśvamūrtis trivargaḥ svargasādhanaḥ
jñānagamyo dṛḍhaprajño devadevastrilocanaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टमूर्तिर्विश्वमूर्तिस् त्रिवर्गः स्वर्गसाधनः
ज्ञानगम्यो दृढप्रज्ञो देवदेवस्त्रिलोचनः //
text_mt: Eight-formed, Universal-formed, The triad of human ends, Means to attain heaven, / Attainable by knowledge, Of firm intellect, God of gods, Three-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevo mahādevaḥ pāṇḍuḥ paridṛḍho dṛḍhaḥ
viśvarūpo virūpākṣo vāgīśaḥ śucirantaraḥ //
meaning:
वामदेवो महादेवः पाण्डुः परिदृढो दृढः
विश्वरूपो विरूपाक्षो वागीशः शुचिरन्तरः //
text_mt: Vāmadeva, Mahādeva, Pale, Sovereign lord, Firm, / Universal-formed, Virūpākṣa, Lord of speech, Pure, Inner self,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapraṇayasaṃvādī vṛṣāṅko vṛṣavāhanaḥ
īśaḥ pinākī khaṭvāṅgī citraveṣaścirantanaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वप्रणयसंवादी वृषाङ्को वृषवाहनः
ईशः पिनाकी खट्वाङ्गी चित्रवेषश्चिरन्तनः //
text_mt: Harmonious with love for all, Bull-marked, Bull-vehicled, / Lord, Pinākin, Holding the khaṭvāṅga, Of varied attire, Ancient,

sanskrit_iast:
tamoharo mahāyogī goptā brahmāṅgahṛjjaṭī
kālakālaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ subhagaḥ praṇavātmakaḥ //
meaning:
तमोहरो महायोगी गोप्ता ब्रह्माङ्गहृज्जटी
कालकालः कृत्तिवासाः सुभगः प्रणवात्मकः //
text_mt: Dispeller of darkness, Great yogin, Protector, Heart of the limbs of Brahman, Matted-haired, / Death of Death, Clothed in animal hides, Auspicious, Embodiment of the praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
unmattaveṣaś cakṣuṣyo durvāsāḥ smaraśāsanaḥ
dṛḍhāyudhaḥ skandaguruḥ parameṣṭhī parāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
उन्मत्तवेषश् चक्षुष्यो दुर्वासाः स्मरशासनः
दृढायुधः स्कन्दगुरुः परमेष्ठी परायणः //
text_mt: Mad-attired, Fair to behold, Durvāsas, Chastiser of Smara, / Having firm weapons, Teacher of Skanda, Parameṣṭhin, Supreme refuge,

sanskrit_iast:
anādimadhyanidhano giriśo giribāndhavaḥ
kuberabandhuḥ śrīkaṇṭho lokavarṇottamottamaḥ //
meaning:
अनादिमध्यनिधनो गिरिशो गिरिबान्धवः
कुबेरबन्धुः श्रीकण्ठो लोकवर्णोत्तमोत्तमः //
text_mt: Without beginning, middle, or end, Mountain-dweller, Friend of the mountain, / Friend of Kubera, Śrīkaṇṭha, Best of the best of worldly castes,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyadevaḥ kodaṇḍī nīlakaṇṭhaḥ paraśvadhī
viśālākṣo mṛgavyādhaḥ sureśaḥ sūryatāpanaḥ //
meaning:
सामान्यदेवः कोदण्डी नीलकण्ठः परश्वधी
विशालाक्षो मृगव्याधः सुरेशः सूर्यतापनः //
text_mt: God of all, Archer, Blue-throated, Wielder of the battle-axe, / Large-eyed, Hunter of beasts, Lord of the gods, Tormentor of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmakarmākṣamaḥ kṣetraṃ bhagavān bhaganetrabhit
ugraḥ paśupatis tārkṣyaḥ priyabhaktaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मकर्माक्षमः क्षेत्रं भगवान् भगनेत्रभित्
उग्रः पशुपतिस् तार्क्ष्यः प्रियभक्तः प्रियंवदः //
text_mt: Incapable of unrighteous action, The field, Blessed Lord, Piercer of Bhaga's eyes, / Fierce, Paśupati, Tārkṣya, Fond of his devotees, Sweet-speaking,

sanskrit_iast:
dātā dayākaro dakṣaḥ kapardī kāmaśāsanaḥ
śmaśānanilayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śmaśānastho maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
दाता दयाकरो दक्षः कपर्दी कामशासनः
श्मशाननिलयः सूक्ष्मः श्मशानस्थो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Giver, Compassionate, Capable, Having braided hair, Chastiser of Kāma, / Abiding in the cremation ground, Subtle, Dwelling in the cremation ground, Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
lokakartā bhūtapatir mahākartā mahauṣadhī
uttaro gopatirgoptā jñānagamyaḥ purātanaḥ //
meaning:
लोककर्ता भूतपतिर् महाकर्ता महौषधी
उत्तरो गोपतिर्गोप्ता ज्ञानगम्यः पुरातनः //
text_mt: Creator of the worlds, Lord of beings, Great creator, Great healing herb, / Superior, Lord of cows, Protector, Attainable by knowledge, Ancient,

sanskrit_iast:
nītiḥ sunītiḥ śuddhātmā somaḥ somarataḥ sukhī
somapo 'mṛtapaḥ somo mahānītirmahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
नीतिः सुनीतिः शुद्धात्मा सोमः सोमरतः सुखी
सोमपो ऽमृतपः सोमो महानीतिर्महामतिः //
text_mt: Policy, Good conduct, Pure-souled, Soma, Delighting in soma, Joyful, / Drinker of soma, Drinker of nectar, Soma, Great policy, Of great intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
ajātaśatrurālokaḥ saṃbhāvyo havyavāhanaḥ
lokakāro vedakāraḥ sūtrakāraḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
अजातशत्रुरालोकः संभाव्यो हव्यवाहनः
लोककारो वेदकारः सूत्रकारः सनातनः //
text_mt: Having no born enemy, Light, Worthy of regard, Carrier of oblations, / Fashioner of worlds, Maker of the Veda, Author of sūtras, Eternal,

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣiḥ kapilācāryo viśvadīptistrilocanaḥ
pinākapāṇir bhūdevaḥ svastidaḥ svastikṛtsadā //
meaning:
महर्षिः कपिलाचार्यो विश्वदीप्तिस्त्रिलोचनः
पिनाकपाणिर् भूदेवः स्वस्तिदः स्वस्तिकृत्सदा //
text_mt: Great sage, Teacher Kapila, Light of the universe, Three-eyed, / Having the Pināka in his hand, God on earth, Bestower of welfare, Ever bringing welfare,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhāmā saubhagaḥ śarvaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvagocaraḥ
brahmadhṛg viśvasṛk svargaḥ karṇikāraḥ priyaḥ kaviḥ //
meaning:
त्रिधामा सौभगः शर्वः सर्वज्ञः सर्वगोचरः
ब्रह्मधृग् विश्वसृक् स्वर्गः कर्णिकारः प्रियः कविः //
text_mt: Having three abodes, Auspicious, Śarva, Omniscient, Object of perception of all, / Bearing Brahman, Creator of the universe, Heaven, Karṇikāra blossom, Beloved, Poet-seer,

sanskrit_iast:
śākho viśākho gośākhaḥ śivo naikaḥ kratuḥ samaḥ
gaṅgāplavodako bhāvaḥ sakalaḥ sthapatiḥ sthiraḥ //
meaning:
शाखो विशाखो गोशाखः शिवो नैकः क्रतुः समः
गङ्गाप्लवोदको भावः सकलः स्थपतिः स्थिरः //
text_mt: Śākha, Viśākha, Gośākha, Śiva, Not one, Sacrifice, Equal, / Whose water is the flow of the Gaṅgā, Pure being, Complete, Master builder, Firm,

sanskrit_iast:
vijitātmā vidheyātmā bhūtavāhanasārathiḥ
sagaṇo gaṇakāryaś ca sukīrtiś chinnasaṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
विजितात्मा विधेयात्मा भूतवाहनसारथिः

शुभाङ्गो लोकसारङ्गो जगदीशो ऽमृताशनः

text_mt: Golden-seeded, Sun, Ray of light, Abode of greatness, / Great lake, Great womb, Praised by multitudes of Siddhas,

sanskrit_iast:

पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वज्ञः पारिजातः परावरः

text_mt: Standard of truth, Difficult to know, Suparṇa, Having the wind as his vehicle, / Wielder of the bow, Science of archery, Heap of virtues, Mine of virtues,

ऋषिर्ब्राह्मणविज्जिष्णुर् जन्ममृत्युजरातिगः

text_mt: the sage, knower of Brahmā, victorious, beyond birth, death, and old age, / sacrifice, lord of sacrifice, sacrificer, end of sacrifice, of unfailing prowess,

महेन्द्रो दुर्भरः सेनी यज्ञाङ्गो यज्ञवाहनः

text_mt: Mahendra, hard to sustain, possessing an army, part of sacrifice, vehicle of sacrifice, / origin of the five Brahmans, lord of the universe, of spotless dawn,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmayonir anādyantaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatsaptalokadhṛk

आत्मयोनिर् अनाद्यन्तः षड्विंशत्सप्तलोकधृक्

text_mt: self-born, without beginning or end, the twenty-sixth principle, supporter of the seven worlds, / beloved of the Gāyatrī, tall, abode of the universe, maker of light,

text_mt: the child, delighting in mountains, sovereign, having good armies, slayer of the enemies of the gods, / unfailing, crusher of misfortune, Mukunda, freed from distress,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃjyotir anujyotir ātmajyotir acañcalaḥ

स्वयंज्योतिर् अनुज्योतिर् आत्मज्योतिर् अचञ्चलः

text_mt: self-luminous, secondary light, light of the Self, unwavering, / tawny, having a reddish-brown beard, having the scriptures as eyes, having the threefold Veda as body,

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaskandho mahājñānī nirutpattir upaplavaḥ
bhago vivasvānādityo yogācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ //

ज्ञानस्कन्धो महाज्ञानी निरुत्पत्तिर् उपप्लवः
भगो विवस्वानादित्यो योगाचार्यो बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: aggregate of knowledge, possessed of great wisdom, devoid of origination, calamity, / Bhaga, Vivasvat, Āditya, master of yoga, Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
udārakīrtir udyogī sadyogī sadasanmayaḥ
nakṣatramālī rākeśaḥ sādhiṣṭhānaḥ ṣaḍāśrayaḥ //
meaning:
उदारकीर्तिर् उद्योगी सद्योगी सदसन्मयः
नक्षत्रमाली राकेशः साधिष्ठानः षडाश्रयः //
text_mt: of exalted fame, energetic, true yogin, composed of existence and non-existence, / garlanded with constellations, lord of the full moon, possessing a base, six-supported,

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrapāṇiḥ pāpārir maṇipūro manogatiḥ
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamāsīnaḥ śuklaḥ śānto vṛṣākapiḥ //
meaning:
पवित्रपाणिः पापारिर् मणिपूरो मनोगतिः
हृत्पुण्डरीकमासीनः शुक्लः शान्तो वृषाकपिः //
text_mt: pure-handed, foe of sin, Maṇipūra, swift as thought, / seated on the lotus of the heart, white, tranquil, Vṛṣākapi,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurgrahapatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samartho 'narthanāśanaḥ
adharmaśatrurakṣayyaḥ puruhūtaḥ puruṣṭutaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुर्ग्रहपतिः कृष्णः समर्थो ऽनर्थनाशनः
अधर्मशत्रुरक्षय्यः पुरुहूतः पुरुष्टुतः //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, lord of the planets, Kṛṣṇa, capable, destroyer of misfortune, / enemy of unrighteousness, imperishable, invoked by many, praised by many,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmagarbho bṛhadgarbho dharmadhenurdhanāgamaḥ
jagaddhitaiṣī sugataḥ kumāraḥ kuśalāgamaḥ //

ब्रह्मगर्भो बृहद्गर्भो धर्मधेनुर्धनागमः
जगद्धितैषी सुगतः कुमारः कुशलागमः //
text_mt: womb of Brahman, great womb, cow of righteousness, arrival of wealth, / wishing the welfare of the world, Sugata, youth, attainment of prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyavarṇo jyotiṣmān nānābhūtadharo dhvaniḥ
arogo niyamādhyakṣo viśvāmitro dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यवर्णो ज्योतिष्मान् नानाभूतधरो ध्वनिः
अरोगो नियमाध्यक्षो विश्वामित्रो द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt: golden-hued, luminous, bearer of diverse beings, sound, / free from disease, overseer of rules, Viśvāmitra, foremost among the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhajjyotiḥ sudhāmā ca mahājyotiranuttamaḥ
mātāmaho mātariśvā nabhasvān nāgahāradhṛk //
meaning:
बृहज्ज्योतिः सुधामा च महाज्योतिरनुत्तमः
मातामहो मातरिश्वा नभस्वान् नागहारधृक् //
text_mt: great light, of lovely dwelling, supreme light, having no superior, / maternal grandfather, wind, atmosphere, wearing a garland of serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
pulastyaḥ pulaho 'gastyo jātūkarṇyaḥ parāśaraḥ
nirāvaraṇadharmajño viriñco viṣṭaraśravāḥ //

पुलस्त्यः पुलहो ऽगस्त्यो जातूकर्ण्यः पराशरः
निरावरणधर्मज्ञो विरिञ्चो विष्टरश्रवाः //
text_mt: Pulastya, Pulaha, Agastya, Jātūkarṇya, Parāśara, / knower of unveiled dharma, Viriñca, Viṣṭaraśravas,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmabhūr aniruddho 'trijñānamūrtir mahāyaśāḥ
lokacūḍāmaṇirvīraḥ caṇḍasatyaparākramaḥ //

आत्मभूर् अनिरुद्धो ऽत्रिज्ञानमूर्तिर् महायशाः
लोकचूडामणिर्वीरः चण्डसत्यपराक्रमः //
text_mt: self-existent, Aniruddha, Atri, embodiment of knowledge, of great renown, / crest-jewel of the worlds, hero, fierce, of true valour,

sanskrit_iast:
vyālakalpo mahākalpo mahāvṛkṣaḥ kalādharaḥ
alaṃkariṣṇus tvacalo rociṣṇurvikramottamaḥ //
meaning:
व्यालकल्पो महाकल्पो महावृक्षः कलाधरः
अलंकरिष्णुस् त्वचलो रोचिष्णुर्विक्रमोत्तमः //
text_mt: like a serpent, great kalpa, great tree, possessor of digits, / eager to adorn, immovable, radiant, supreme in prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
āśuśabdapatirvegī plavanaḥ śikhisārathiḥ
asaṃsṛṣṭo 'tithiḥ śakraḥ pramāthī pāpanāśanaḥ //

आशुशब्दपतिर्वेगी प्लवनः शिखिसारथिः
असंसृष्टो ऽतिथिः शक्रः प्रमाथी पापनाशनः //
text_mt: lord of rapid sound, swift, leaping, having fire as charioteer, / unattached, guest, Śakra, harasser, destroyer of sins,

sanskrit_iast:

jaryo jarādhiśamano lohitaś ca tanūnapāt //

वसुश्रवाः कव्यवाहः प्रतप्तो विश्वभोजनः
जर्यो जराधिशमनो लोहितश् च तनूनपात् //
text_mt: of rich fame, conveyer of oblations to the ancestors, burning, consumer of all, / worthy of praise, dispeller of old age and anguish, red, fire,

sanskrit_iast:

nidāghastapano meghaḥ pakṣaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ //

पृषदश्वो नभोयोनिः सुप्रतीकस् तमिस्रहा
निदाघस्तपनो मेघः पक्षः परपुरंजयः //
text_mt: having dappled horses, whose source is the sky, of pleasant face, destroyer of darkness, / heat, the sun, cloud, lunar fortnight, conqueror of enemies' cities,

sanskrit_iast:

मुखानिलः सुनिष्पन्नः सुरभिः शिशिरात्मकः

text_mt: breath of the mouth, well-accomplished, fragrant, cold-seasoned, / spring, Mādhava, summer, the rainy season, conveyor of seeds,

अङ्गिरा मुनिरात्रेयो विमलो विश्ववाहनः
पावनः पुरुजिच्छक्रस् त्रिविद्यो नरवाहनः //

text_mt: mind, intellect, egoity, knower of the field, protector of the field, / treasury of splendour, treasury of knowledge, ripening, causer of obstacles,

śailo nagastanurdeho dānavārirarindamaḥ //

अधरो ऽनुत्तरो ज्ञेयो ज्येष्ठो निःश्रेयसालयः

text_mt: unsupported, unsurpassed, to be known, eldest, abode of liberation, / rock, mountain, form, body, foe of the Dānavas, subduer of enemies,

चतुर्वेदश्चतुर्भावश् चतुरश्चतुरप्रियः //
text_mt: of pleasant mind, progenitor, lovely, free from darts, inflicter of darts upon the world, / the four Vedas, of fourfold nature, clever, fond of the clever.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Sacred tradition and the collection of tradition, the shrine of holy waters and gods, / multiform, of great form, of all forms, moving and unmoving;

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: the administrator of justice, justice itself, reachable through justice, stainless, / thousand-headed, lord of gods, crusher of all weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍī dānto guṇottamaḥ

मुण्डो विरूपो विकृतो दण्डी दान्तो गुणोत्तमः

text_mt: shaven-headed, misshapen, altered, staff-bearing, self-controlled, best in virtues, / tawny-eyed and lion-eyed, blue-throated, free from disease;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabāhuḥ sarveśaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokabhṛt
padmāsanaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ parāvaraṃ paraṃ phalam //

सहस्रबाहुः सर्वेशः शरण्यः सर्वलोकभृत्
पद्मासनः परं ज्योतिः परावरं परं फलम् //
text_mt: thousand-armed, lord of all, refuge, bearer of all worlds, / seated on a lotus, supreme light, the higher and the lower, the supreme fruit;

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
पद्मगर्भो महागर्भो विश्वगर्भो विचक्षणः
परावरज्ञो बीजेशः सुमुखः सुमहास्वनः //
text_mt: having a lotus womb, having a great womb, having the universe in his womb, discerning, / knower of the higher and lower, lord of the seed, handsome-faced, of exceedingly great sound;

sanskrit_iast:
devāsuragururdevo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ
devāsuramahāmātro devāsuramahāśrayaḥ //
meaning:
देवासुरगुरुर्देवो देवासुरनमस्कृतः
देवासुरमहामात्रो देवासुरमहाश्रयः //
text_mt: teacher of gods and asuras, the god bowed to by gods and asuras, / great minister of gods and asuras, great refuge of gods and asuras;

sanskrit_iast:
devādidevo devarṣidevāsuravarapradaḥ
devāsureśvaro divyo devāsuramaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
देवादिदेवो देवर्षिदेवासुरवरप्रदः
देवासुरेश्वरो दिव्यो देवासुरमहेश्वरः //
text_mt: primeval god of gods, boon-giver to divine sages, gods, and asuras, / lord of gods and asuras, divine, Maheśvara of gods and asuras;

sanskrit_iast:

īḍyo 'nīśaḥ suravyāghro devasiṃho divākaraḥ //
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयो ऽचिन्त्यो देवतात्मात्मसंभवः
ईड्यो ऽनीशः सुरव्याघ्रो देवसिंहो दिवाकरः //
text_mt: consisting of all gods, inconceivable, self of deities, self-born, / praiseworthy, having no master, tiger among gods, lion among gods, maker of day;

sanskrit_iast:
vibudhāgravaraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvadevottamottamaḥ
śivajñānarataḥ śrīmān śikhiśrīparvatapriyaḥ //
meaning:
विबुधाग्रवरश्रेष्ठः सर्वदेवोत्तमोत्तमः
शिवज्ञानरतः श्रीमान् शिखिश्रीपर्वतप्रियः //
text_mt: foremost and best among the wise, highest of all the highest gods, / devoted to the knowledge of Śiva, glorious, fond of the Śrī mountain and Śikhin;

sanskrit_iast:
jayastaṃbho viśiṣṭambho narasiṃhanipātanaḥ
brahmacārī lokacārī dharmacārī dhanādhipaḥ //
meaning:
जयस्तंभो विशिष्टम्भो नरसिंहनिपातनः
ब्रह्मचारी लोकचारी धर्मचारी धनाधिपः //
text_mt: pillar of victory, possessing distinct pillars, feller of the man-lion, / student of Brahman, moving through the worlds, walker in righteousness, lord of wealth;

sanskrit_iast:
nandī nandīśvaro nagno nagnavratadharaḥ śuciḥ
liṅgādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo yugādhyakṣo yugāvahaḥ //

नन्दी नन्दीश्वरो नग्नो नग्नव्रतधरः शुचिः
लिङ्गाध्यक्षः सुराध्यक्षो युगाध्यक्षो युगावहः //
text_mt: joyful, lord of joy, naked, observing the vow of nakedness, pure, / presiding deity of the liṅga, presiding deity of the gods, presiding deity of the yugas, bringer of the yugas;

sanskrit_iast:
svavaśaḥ savaśaḥ svargaḥ svaraḥ svaramayasvanaḥ
bījādhyakṣo bījakartā dhanakṛd dharmavardhanaḥ //
meaning:
स्ववशः सवशः स्वर्गः स्वरः स्वरमयस्वनः
बीजाध्यक्षो बीजकर्ता धनकृद् धर्मवर्धनः //
text_mt: self-controlled, commanding others, heaven, sound, sound consisting of notes, / overseer of the seed, maker of the seed, creator of wealth, increaser of righteousness;

sanskrit_iast:
daṃbho 'dambho mahādaṃbhaḥ sarvabhūtamaheśvaraḥ
śmaśānanilayastiṣyaḥ seturapratimākṛtiḥ //

दंभो ऽदम्भो महादंभः सर्वभूतमहेश्वरः
श्मशाननिलयस्तिष्यः सेतुरप्रतिमाकृतिः //
text_mt: arrogance, free from deceit, great ostentation, Maheśvara of all beings, / dwelling in the cremation ground, Tiṣya, the bridge, of incomparable form;

sanskrit_iast:
lokottarasphuṭālokas tryaṃbako nāgabhūṣaṇaḥ
andhakārirmakhadveṣī viṣṇukandharapātanaḥ //

लोकोत्तरस्फुटालोकस् त्र्यंबको नागभूषणः
अन्धकारिर्मखद्वेषी विष्णुकन्धरपातनः //
text_mt: of extraordinary and radiant light, three-eyed, adorned with serpents, / enemy of Andhaka, hater of the sacrifice, feller of Viṣṇu’s neck;

sanskrit_iast:
vītadoṣo 'kṣayaguṇo dakṣāriḥ pūṣadantahṛt
dhūrjaṭiḥ khaṇḍaparaśuḥ sakalo niṣkalo 'naghaḥ //
meaning:
वीतदोषो ऽक्षयगुणो दक्षारिः पूषदन्तहृत्
धूर्जटिः खण्डपरशुः सकलो निष्कलो ऽनघः //
text_mt: free from flaws, of imperishable virtues, enemy of Dakṣa, tearer of Pūṣan's teeth, / having matted hair, wielding an axe, possessing parts, partless, sinless;

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraḥ sakalādhāraḥ pāṇḍurābho mṛḍo naṭaḥ
pūrṇaḥ pūrayitā puṇyaḥ sukumāraḥ sulocanaḥ //
meaning:
आधारः सकलाधारः पाण्डुराभो मृडो नटः
पूर्णः पूरयिता पुण्यः सुकुमारः सुलोचनः //
text_mt: support, support of all, whitish-pale, Mṛḍa, dancer, / full, fulfiller, holy, delicate, fair-eyed;

sanskrit_iast:
sāmageyaḥ priyakaraḥ puṇyakīrtiranāmayaḥ
manojavastīrthakaro jaṭilo jīviteśvaraḥ //
meaning:
सामगेयः प्रियकरः पुण्यकीर्तिरनामयः
मनोजवस्तीर्थकरो जटिलो जीवितेश्वरः //
text_mt: to be sung in Sāmans, doing what is pleasing, of holy renown, free from affliction, / swift as thought, maker of holy bathing places, matted-haired, lord of life;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitāntakaro nityo vasuretā vasupriyaḥ
sadgatiḥ satkṛtiḥ saktaḥ kālakaṇṭhaḥ kalādharaḥ //
meaning:
जीवितान्तकरो नित्यो वसुरेता वसुप्रियः
सद्गतिः सत्कृतिः सक्तः कालकण्ठः कलाधरः //
text_mt: ender of life, eternal, possessing gold-semen, lover of wealth, / path of the good, virtuous action, attached, black-necked, bearer of the crescent moon;

sanskrit_iast:
mānī mānyo mahākālaḥ sadbhūtiḥ satparāyaṇaḥ
candrasaṃjīvanaḥ śāstā lokagūḍho 'marādhipaḥ //
meaning:
मानी मान्यो महाकालः सद्भूतिः सत्परायणः
चन्द्रसंजीवनः शास्ता लोकगूढो ऽमराधिपः //
text_mt: proud, worthy of honor, Mahākāla, good prosperity, the refuge of the good, / reviver of the moon, ruler, hidden from the world, lord of the immortals;

sanskrit_iast:
lokabandhurlokanāthaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kṛtibhūṣaṇaḥ
anapāyyakṣaraḥ kāntaḥ sarvaśāstrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
लोकबन्धुर्लोकनाथः कृतज्ञः कृतिभूषणः
अनपाय्यक्षरः कान्तः सर्वशास्त्रभृतां वरः //
text_mt: friend of the world, lord of the world, grateful, adorner of deeds, / imperishable, unalterable, charming, best of all wielders of weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
tejomayo dyutidharo lokamāyo 'graṇīr aṇuḥ
śucismitaḥ prasannātmā durjayo duratikramaḥ //
meaning:
तेजोमयो द्युतिधरो लोकमायो ऽग्रणीर् अणुः
शुचिस्मितः प्रसन्नात्मा दुर्जयो दुरतिक्रमः //
text_mt: consisting of splendor, bearer of brightness, worldly illusion, leader, subtle, / pure-smiling, gracious in spirit, difficult to conquer, insurmountable;

sanskrit_iast:
jyotirmayo nirākāro jagannātho jaleśvaraḥ
tumbavīṇī mahākāyo viśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
ज्योतिर्मयो निराकारो जगन्नाथो जलेश्वरः
तुम्बवीणी महाकायो विशोकः शोकनाशनः //
text_mt: consisting of light, formless, lord of the universe, lord of the waters, / playing the gourd lute, having a vast body, free from sorrow, destroyer of sorrow;

sanskrit_iast:
trilokātmā trilokeśaḥ śuddhaḥ śuddhī rathākṣajaḥ
avyaktalakṣaṇo vyakto vyaktāvyakto viśāṃpatiḥ //
meaning:
त्रिलोकात्मा त्रिलोकेशः शुद्धः शुद्धी रथाक्षजः
अव्यक्तलक्षणो व्यक्तो व्यक्ताव्यक्तो विशांपतिः //
text_mt: self of the three worlds, lord of the three worlds, pure, purifier, born from the axle of the chariot, / unmanifest in mark, manifest, manifest and unmanifest, lord of peoples;

sanskrit_iast:
varaśīlo varatulo māno mānadhano mayaḥ
brahmā viṣṇuḥ prajāpālo haṃso haṃsagatiryamaḥ //
meaning:
वरशीलो वरतुलो मानो मानधनो मयः
ब्रह्मा विष्णुः प्रजापालो हंसो हंसगतिर्यमः //
text_mt: of excellent conduct, of excellent balance, standard of measure, having pride as wealth, Maya, / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, protector of subjects, haṃsa, having the gait of a swan, Yama;

sanskrit_iast:
vedhā dhātā vidhātā ca attā hartā caturmukhaḥ
kailāsaśikharāvāsī sarvāvāsī satāṃ gatiḥ //
meaning:
वेधा धाता विधाता च अत्ता हर्ता चतुर्मुखः
कैलासशिखरावासी सर्वावासी सतां गतिः //
text_mt: creator, Ordainer, Arranger, consumer, remover, four-faced, / dweller on Kailāsa's peak, dweller in all, refuge of the virtuous;

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho hariṇaḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvajaḥ pitā
bhūtālayo bhūtapatir bhūtido bhuvaneśvaraḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो हरिणः पुरुषः पूर्वजः पिता
भूतालयो भूतपतिर् भूतिदो भुवनेश्वरः //
text_mt: Hiraṇyagarbha, deer-like, Puruṣa, first-born, father, / abode of beings, lord of beings, giver of welfare, lord of the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyogī yogavidbrahma brahmaṇyo brāhmaṇapriyaḥ
devapriyo devanātho devajño devacintakaḥ //
meaning:
संयोगी योगविद्ब्रह्म ब्रह्मण्यो ब्राह्मणप्रियः
देवप्रियो देवनाथो देवज्ञो देवचिन्तकः //
text_mt: in union, knower of yoga, Brahman, friendly to brāhmaṇas, fond of brāhmaṇas, / dear to the gods, lord of the gods, knower of the gods, thinking of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣamākṣaḥ kalādhyakṣo vṛṣāṅko vṛṣavardhanaḥ
nirmado nirahaṅkāro nirmoho nirupadravaḥ //
meaning:
विषमाक्षः कलाध्यक्षो वृषाङ्को वृषवर्धनः
निर्मदो निरहङ्कारो निर्मोहो निरुपद्रवः //
text_mt: having uneven eyes, lord of the arts, bull-marked, increaser of righteousness, / free from arrogance, free from egotism, free from delusion, free from trouble;

sanskrit_iast:
darpahā darpito dṛptaḥ sarvartuparivartakaḥ
saptajihvaḥ sahasrārciḥ snigdhaḥ prakṛtidakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
दर्पहा दर्पितो दृप्तः सर्वर्तुपरिवर्तकः
सप्तजिह्वः सहस्रार्चिः स्निग्धः प्रकृतिदक्षिणः //
text_mt: destroyer of pride, proud, haughty, revolving through all the seasons, / seven-tongued, thousand-rayed, gentle, simple by nature;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhavannāthaḥ prabhavo bhrāntināśanaḥ
artho 'nartho mahākośaḥ parakāryaikapaṇḍitaḥ //
meaning:
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथः प्रभवो भ्रान्तिनाशनः
अर्थो ऽनर्थो महाकोशः परकार्यैकपण्डितः //
text_mt: lord of past, future, and present, origin, destroyer of error, / wealth, misfortune, great treasury, skilled solely in the affairs of others;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkaṇṭakaḥ kṛtānando nirvyājo vyājamardanaḥ
sattvavān sāttvikaḥ satyakīrtistambhakṛtāgamaḥ //
meaning:
निष्कण्टकः कृतानन्दो निर्व्याजो व्याजमर्दनः
सत्त्ववान् सात्त्विकः सत्यकीर्तिस्तम्भकृतागमः //
text_mt: free from thorns, having bliss made, free from guile, crusher of deceit, / endowed with sattva, sāttvika, renowned for truth, maker of pillars, tradition;

sanskrit_iast:
akaṃpito guṇagrāhī naikātmā naikakarmakṛt
suprītaḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sukaro dakṣiṇo 'nalaḥ //
meaning:
अकंपितो गुणग्राही नैकात्मा नैककर्मकृत्
सुप्रीतः सुमुखः सूक्ष्मः सुकरो दक्षिणो ऽनलः //
text_mt: unshaken, receptive of virtues, not having a single self, performer of varied deeds, / well-pleased, fair-faced, subtle, easy to do, auspicious, Agni;

sanskrit_iast:
skandhaḥ skandhadharo dhuryaḥ prakaṭaḥ prītivardhanaḥ
aparājitaḥ sarvasaho vidagdhaḥ sarvavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
स्कन्धः स्कन्धधरो धुर्यः प्रकटः प्रीतिवर्धनः
अपराजितः सर्वसहो विदग्धः सर्ववाहनः //
text_mt: Skandha, bearer of the shoulder, foremost bearer of burdens, manifest, increaser of love, / invincible, all-enduring, wise, borne by all;

sanskrit_iast:
adhṛtaḥ svadhṛtaḥ sādhyaḥ pūrvamūrtiryaśodharaḥ
varāhaśṛṅgadhṛg vāyur balavān ekanāyakaḥ //
meaning:
अधृतः स्वधृतः साध्यः पूर्वमूर्तिर्यशोधरः
वराहशृङ्गधृग् वायुर् बलवान् एकनायकः //
text_mt: unsupported, self-supported, to be accomplished, primeval form, bearer of glory, / holding the tusk of the boar, wind, mighty, sole leader;

sanskrit_iast:
śrutiprakāśaḥ śrutimān ekabandhur anekadhṛk
śrīvallabhaśivārambhaḥ śāntabhadraḥ samañjasaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुतिप्रकाशः श्रुतिमान् एकबन्धुर् अनेकधृक्
श्रीवल्लभशिवारम्भः शान्तभद्रः समञ्जसः //
text_mt: illumination of revelation, master of revelation, sole friend, bearer of many, / beloved of Śrī, whose undertakings are auspicious, peaceful and gracious, proper;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūśayo bhūtikṛdbhūtir bhūṣaṇo bhūtavāhanaḥ
akāyo bhaktakāyasthaḥ kālajñānī kalāvapuḥ //
meaning:
भूशयो भूतिकृद्भूतिर् भूषणो भूतवाहनः
अकायो भक्तकायस्थः कालज्ञानी कलावपुः //
text_mt: sleeping on the earth, maker of prosperity, prosperity, ornament, vehicle of beings, / bodiless, residing in the bodies of his devotees, knower of time, having the arts as his body;

sanskrit_iast:
satyavratamahātyāgī niṣṭhāśāntiparāyaṇaḥ
parārthavṛttir varado viviktaḥ śrutisāgaraḥ //
meaning:
सत्यव्रतमहात्यागी निष्ठाशान्तिपरायणः
परार्थवृत्तिर् वरदो विविक्तः श्रुतिसागरः //
text_mt: keeper of vows of truth, great renunciant, dedicated to steadfastness and peace, / acting for the sake of others, giver of boons, solitary, ocean of revelation;

sanskrit_iast:
anirviṇṇo guṇagrāhī kalaṅkāṅkaḥ kalaṅkahā
svabhāvarudro madhyasthaḥ śatrughno madhyanāśakaḥ //
meaning:
अनिर्विण्णो गुणग्राही कलङ्काङ्कः कलङ्कहा
स्वभावरुद्रो मध्यस्थः शत्रुघ्नो मध्यनाशकः //
text_mt: undepressed, receptive of virtues, marked with a stain, remover of stains, / Rudra by nature, impartial, slayer of enemies, destroyer of the middle;

sanskrit_iast:
śikhaṇḍī kavacī śūlī caṇḍī muṇḍī ca kuṇḍalī
mekhalī kavacī khaḍgī māyī saṃsārasārathiḥ //
meaning:
शिखण्डी कवची शूली चण्डी मुण्डी च कुण्डली
मेखली कवची खड्गी मायी संसारसारथिः //
text_mt: having a topknot, armored, trident-bearer, fierce, shaven-headed, wearing earrings, / wearing a girdle, armored, sword-bearer, wielder of illusion, charioteer of saṃsāra;

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtyuḥ sarvadṛk siṃhas tejorāśir mahāmaṇiḥ
asaṃkhyeyo 'prameyātmā vīryavān kāryakovidaḥ //
meaning:
अमृत्युः सर्वदृक् सिंहस् तेजोराशिर् महामणिः
असंख्येयो ऽप्रमेयात्मा वीर्यवान् कार्यकोविदः //
text_mt: deathless, all-seeing, lion, mass of brilliance, great jewel, / innumerable, immeasurable in soul, valorous, skilled in action;

sanskrit_iast:
vedyo vedārthavidgoptā sarvācāro munīśvaraḥ
anuttamo durādharṣo madhuraḥ priyadarśanaḥ //
meaning:
वेद्यो वेदार्थविद्गोप्ता सर्वाचारो मुनीश्वरः
अनुत्तमो दुराधर्षो मधुरः प्रियदर्शनः //
text_mt: to be known, knower of Vedic meaning, protector, of all observances, lord of sages, / unsurpassed, unassailable, sweet, pleasing to look at;

sanskrit_iast:
sureśaḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvaḥ śabdabrahma satāṃ gatiḥ
kālabhakṣaḥ kalaṅkāriḥ kaṅkaṇīkṛtavāsukiḥ //
meaning:
सुरेशः शरणं सर्वः शब्दब्रह्म सतां गतिः
कालभक्षः कलङ्कारिः कङ्कणीकृतवासुकिः //
text_mt: lord of the gods, refuge, all, Brahman as sound, refuge of the good, / devourer of time, enemy of blemish, who made Vāsuki his bracelet;

sanskrit_iast:
maheṣvāso mahībhartā niṣkalaṅko viśṛṅkhalaḥ
dyumaṇis taraṇir dhanyaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhisādhanaḥ //
meaning:
महेष्वासो महीभर्ता निष्कलङ्को विशृङ्खलः
द्युमणिस् तरणिर् धन्यः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिसाधनः //
text_mt: wielder of a great bow, bearer of the earth, stainless, unchained, / jewel of the sky, the sun, blessed, giver of perfection, means of perfection;

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ śilpo vyūḍhorasko mahābhujaḥ
ekajyotir nirātaṅko naro nārāyaṇapriyaḥ //
meaning:
निवृत्तः संवृतः शिल्पो व्यूढोरस्को महाभुजः
एकज्योतिर् निरातङ्को नरो नारायणप्रियः //
text_mt: turned inward, covered, artisan, broad-chested, mighty-armed, / sole light, free from distress, Nara, dear to Nārāyaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
nirlepo niṣprapañcātmā nirvyagro vyagranāśanaḥ
stavyastavapriyaḥ stotā vyāsamūrtiranākulaḥ //
meaning:
निर्लेपो निष्प्रपञ्चात्मा निर्व्यग्रो व्यग्रनाशनः
स्तव्यस्तवप्रियः स्तोता व्यासमूर्तिरनाकुलः //
text_mt: unstained, free from the manifold world, undisturbed, destroyer of agitation, / worthy of praise, fond of praise, praiser, having Vyāsa's form, unperturbed;

sanskrit_iast:
niravadyapadopāyo vidyārāśiravikramaḥ
praśāntabuddhirakṣudraḥ kṣudrahā nityasundaraḥ //
meaning:
निरवद्यपदोपायो विद्याराशिरविक्रमः
प्रशान्तबुद्धिरक्षुद्रः क्षुद्रहा नित्यसुन्दरः //
text_mt: path to the flawless state, mass of wisdom, of unhindered stride, / having a tranquil mind, not mean, destroyer of the mean, eternally handsome;

sanskrit_iast:
dhairyāgryadhuryo dhātrīśaḥ śākalyaḥ śarvarīpatiḥ
paramārthagurur dṛṣṭir gurur āśritavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
धैर्याग्र्यधुर्यो धात्रीशः शाकल्यः शर्वरीपतिः
परमार्थगुरुर् दृष्टिर् गुरुर् आश्रितवत्सलः //
text_mt: foremost among the steadfast, lord of the earth, Śākalya, lord of the night, / teacher of the highest truth, sight, guru, affectionate to those who take refuge;

sanskrit_iast:
raso rasajñaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvasattvāvalaṃbanaḥ
evaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tuṣṭāva vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
रसो रसज्ञः सर्वज्ञः सर्वसत्त्वावलंबनः
एवं नाम्नां सहस्रेण तुष्टाव वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: essence, knower of essence, omniscient, support of all beings. / In this way, with a thousand names, he praised the bull-bannered lord.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayāmāsa ca vibhuḥ pūjayāmāsa paṅkajaiḥ
parīkṣārthaṃ hareḥ pūjākamaleṣu maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
स्नापयामास च विभुः पूजयामास पङ्कजैः
परीक्षार्थं हरेः पूजाकमलेषु महेश्वरः //
text_mt: And the all-pervading lord bathed him, and worshipped him with lotuses. / In order to test Hari, Maheśvara, among the worship-lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
gopayāmāsa kamalaṃ tadaikaṃ bhuvaneśvaraḥ
hṛtapuṣpo haristatra kimidaṃ tvabhyacintayat //
meaning:
गोपयामास कमलं तदैकं भुवनेश्वरः
हृतपुष्पो हरिस्तत्र किमिदं त्वभ्यचिन्तयत् //
text_mt: Then the lord of the world concealed one lotus; / finding a flower stolen there, Hari thought, “What is this?”

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā svanetramuddhṛtya sarvasattvāvalambanam
pūjayāmāsa bhāvena nāmnā tena jagadgurum //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा स्वनेत्रमुद्धृत्य सर्वसत्त्वावलम्बनम्
पूजयामास भावेन नाम्ना तेन जगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: Having realized [this], he plucked out his own eye, the support of all living beings, / and devotedly worshipped the guru of the universe with that name.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastatra vibhurdṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ haro harim
tasmādavatatārāśu maṇḍalātpāvakasya ca //
meaning:
ततस्तत्र विभुर्दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं हरो हरिम्
तस्मादवतताराशु मण्डलात्पावकस्य च //
text_mt: Then, seeing Hari [acting] thus there, Hara, the all-pervading lord, / quickly descended from that orb of fire:

sanskrit_iast:
koṭibhāskarasaṃkāśaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam
jvālāmālāvṛtaṃ divyaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ bhayaṅkaram //
meaning:
कोटिभास्करसंकाशं जटामुकुटमण्डितम्
ज्वालामालावृतं दिव्यं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रं भयङ्करम् //
text_mt: Resembling ten million suns, adorned with a crown of matted locks, / surrounded by a wreath of flames, divine, sharp-fanged, and terrifying,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṭaṅkagadācakrakuntapāśadharaṃ haram
varādabhayahastaṃ ca dvīpicarmottarīyakam //
meaning:
शूलटङ्कगदाचक्रकुन्तपाशधरं हरम्
वरादभयहस्तं च द्वीपिचर्मोत्तरीयकम् //
text_mt: Bearing a trident, chisel, mace, discus, spear, and noose, / Hara, with hands bestowing boons and freedom from fear, had a leopard skin as an upper garment.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃbhūtaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhavaṃ bhasmavibhūṣitam
hṛṣṭo namaścakārāśu devadevaṃ janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थंभूतं तदा दृष्ट्वा भवं भस्मविभूषितम्
हृष्टो नमश्चकाराशु देवदेवं जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Seeing Bhava thus adorned with sacred ash, / delighted Janārdana quickly bowed to the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dudruvustaṃ parikramya sendrā devāstrilocanam
cacāla brahmabhuvanaṃ cakampe ca vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
दुद्रुवुस्तं परिक्रम्य सेन्द्रा देवास्त्रिलोचनम्
चचाल ब्रह्मभुवनं चकम्पे च वसुंधरा //
text_mt: Circumambulating that three-eyed god, the gods along with Indra fled; / the world of Brahmā shook, and the earth trembled.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāha tejastacchaṃbhoḥ prāntaṃ vai śatayojanam
adhastāccordhvataścaiva hāhetyakṛta bhūtale //
meaning:
ददाह तेजस्तच्छंभोः प्रान्तं वै शतयोजनम्
अधस्ताच्चोर्ध्वतश्चैव हाहेत्यकृत भूतले //
text_mt: That splendour of Śambhu burned for a boundary of a hundred yojanas, / both below and above, and on the surface of the earth they cried “Alas! Alas!”

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prāha mahādevaḥ prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ
samprekṣya praṇayādviṣṇuṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam //
meaning:
तदा प्राह महादेवः प्रहसन्निव शङ्करः
सम्प्रेक्ष्य प्रणयाद्विष्णुं कृताञ्जलिपुटं स्थितम् //
text_mt: Then Mahādeva Śaṅkara, as if smiling, / looking with affection upon Viṣṇu standing with folded hands, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
jñātaṃ mayedamadhunā devakāryaṃ janārdana
sudarśanākhyaṃ cakraṃ ca dadāmi tava śobhanam //
meaning:
ज्ञातं मयेदमधुना देवकार्यं जनार्दन
सुदर्शनाख्यं चक्रं च ददामि तव शोभनम् //
text_mt: “This task of the gods has now been understood by me, O Janārdana; / I give you the splendid discus named Sudarśana.

sanskrit_iast:
yadrūpaṃ bhavatā dṛṣṭaṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram
hitāya tava yatnena tava bhāvāya suvrata //
meaning:
यद्रूपं भवता दृष्टं सर्वलोकभयंकरम्
हिताय तव यत्नेन तव भावाय सुव्रत //
text_mt: The terrifying form seen by you that frightens all the worlds / [was assumed] with effort for your welfare, for your devotion, O one of noble vows.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntaṃ raṇājire viṣṇo devānāṃ duḥkhasādhanam
śāntasya cāstraṃ śāntaḥ syāc chāntenāstreṇa kiṃ phalam //
meaning:
शान्तं रणाजिरे विष्णो देवानां दुःखसाधनम्
शान्तस्य चास्त्रं शान्तः स्याच् छान्तेनास्त्रेण किं फलम् //
text_mt: A peaceful [disposition] on the battlefield, O Viṣṇu, causes grief to the gods; / a peaceful weapon belongs to one who is peaceful—what is the fruit of a peaceful weapon?

sanskrit_iast:
śāntasya samare cāstraṃ śāntireva tapasvinām
yoddhuḥ śāntyā balacchedaḥ parasya balavṛddhidaḥ //
meaning:
शान्तस्य समरे चास्त्रं शान्तिरेव तपस्विनाम्
योद्धुः शान्त्या बलच्छेदः परस्य बलवृद्धिदः //
text_mt: The weapon of one who is peaceful in battle is only the peace of ascetics; / through the peacefulness of a warrior comes the destruction of strength, while giving increase to an enemy's strength.

sanskrit_iast:
devairaśāntairyadrūpaṃ madīyaṃ bhāvayāvyayam
kimāyudhena kāryaṃ vai yoddhuṃ devārisūdana //
meaning:
देवैरशान्तैर्यद्रूपं मदीयं भावयाव्ययम्
किमायुधेन कार्यं वै योद्धुं देवारिसूदन //
text_mt: Meditate upon this imperishable form of mine as [conceived] by the unpeaceful gods; / what is to be done with a weapon if one does not fight, O slayer of the enemies of the gods?

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā yudhi na kāryaṃ vai yoddhuṃ devārisūdana
anāgate vyatīte ca daurbalye svajanotkare //
meaning:
क्षमा युधि न कार्यं वै योद्धुं देवारिसूदन
अनागते व्यतीते च दौर्बल्ये स्वजनोत्करे //
text_mt: Forbearance is not to be exercised in battle to fight, O slayer of the enemies of the gods, / [nor] in what is yet to come, nor in what has passed, nor in weakness toward one’s own people,

sanskrit_iast:
akālike tvadharme ca anarthe vārisūdana
evamuktvā dadau cakraṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham //
meaning:
अकालिके त्वधर्मे च अनर्थे वारिसूदन
एवमुक्त्वा ददौ चक्रं सूर्यायुतसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: Nor in untimely unrighteousness, nor in adversity, O slayer of enemies!” / Having spoken thus, he gave him the discus equal in splendour to ten thousand suns.

sanskrit_iast:
netraṃ ca netā jagatāṃ prabhurvai padmasannibham
tadāprabhṛti taṃ prāhuḥ padmākṣamiti suvratam //
meaning:
नेत्रं च नेता जगतां प्रभुर्वै पद्मसन्निभम्
तदाप्रभृति तं प्राहुः पद्माक्षमिति सुव्रतम् //
text_mt: And the lord, the leader of the worlds, [restored] his eye resembling a lotus; / from then on, they call that god of noble vows “the lotus-eyed one” (Padmākṣa).

sanskrit_iast:
dattvainaṃ nayanaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇave nīlalohitaḥ
pasparśa ca karābhyāṃ vai suśubhābhyāmuvāca ha //
meaning:
दत्त्वैनं नयनं चक्रं विष्णवे नीललोहितः
पस्पर्श च कराभ्यां वै सुशुभाभ्यामुवाच ह //
text_mt: Having given this eye and discus to Viṣṇu, Nīlalohita / touched him with both of his exceedingly auspicious hands and spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
varado 'haṃ varaśreṣṭha varānvaraya cepsitān
bhaktyā vaśīkṛto nūnaṃ tvayāhaṃ puruṣottama //
meaning:
वरदो ऽहं वरश्रेष्ठ वरान्वरय चेप्सितान्
भक्त्या वशीकृतो नूनं त्वयाहं पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: “I am the bestower of boons, O best among the noble; choose your desired boons! / Indeed, O Puruṣottama, I have been won over by you through devotion.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto devadevena devadevaṃ praṇamya tam
tvayi bhaktirmahādeva prasīda varamuttamam //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन देवदेवं प्रणम्य तम्
त्वयि भक्तिर्महादेव प्रसीद वरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the god of gods, having bowed to that god of gods, [he said]: / “Let there be devotion to you, O Mahādeva; be gracious with this supreme boon!

sanskrit_iast:
nānyamicchāmi bhaktānām ārtayo nāsti yatprabho
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya dayāvān sutarāṃ bhavaḥ //
meaning:
नान्यमिच्छामि भक्तानाम् आर्तयो नास्ति यत्प्रभो
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य दयावान् सुतरां भवः //
text_mt: I desire no other, for which there is no distress for devotees, O Lord.” / Hearing those words of his, Bhava, being exceedingly compassionate,

sanskrit_iast:
pasparśa ca dadau tasmai śraddhāṃ śītāṃśubhūṣaṇaḥ
prāha caivaṃ mahādevaḥ paramātmānamacyutam //
meaning:
पस्पर्श च ददौ तस्मै श्रद्धां शीतांशुभूषणः
प्राह चैवं महादेवः परमात्मानमच्युतम् //
text_mt: Touched him, and the god adorned with the cool-rayed moon granted him faith; / and Mahādeva spoke thus to the infallible Supreme Self:

sanskrit_iast:
mayi bhaktaś ca vandyaś ca pūjyaścaiva surāsuraiḥ
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādātsurottama //
meaning:
मयि भक्तश् च वन्द्यश् च पूज्यश्चैव सुरासुरैः
भविष्यसि न संदेहो मत्प्रसादात्सुरोत्तम //
text_mt: “Devoted to me, you shall be praised and worshipped by gods and asuras; / there is no doubt, O best of the gods, by my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā satī dakṣaputrī vinindyaiva sulocanā
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ bhaviṣyati sureśvarī //
meaning:
यदा सती दक्षपुत्री विनिन्द्यैव सुलोचना
मातरं पितरं दक्षं भविष्यति सुरेश्वरी //
text_mt: When Satī, Dakṣa's daughter, the fair-eyed queen of the gods, / having reviled her mother and father Dakṣa, will become

sanskrit_iast:
divyā haimavatī viṣṇo tadā tvamapi suvrata
bhaginīṃ tava kalyāṇīṃ devīṃ haimavatīmumām //
meaning:
दिव्या हैमवती विष्णो तदा त्वमपि सुव्रत
भगिनीं तव कल्याणीं देवीं हैमवतीमुमाम् //
text_mt: The divine daughter of Himavat, O Viṣṇu, then you too, O one of noble vows, / [shall have] as your auspicious sister that goddess Umā, daughter of Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sādhvīṃ pradāsyasi mamaiva tām
matsaṃbandhī ca lokānāṃ madhye pūjyo bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः साध्वीं प्रदास्यसि ममैव ताम्
मत्संबन्धी च लोकानां मध्ये पूज्यो भविष्यसि //
text_mt: By Brahmā’s instruction, you shall give that virtuous lady to me alone; / and as my kinsman, you shall be worshipped among the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ divyena ca bhāvena tadāprabhṛti śaṅkaram
drakṣyase ca prasannena mitrabhūtamivātmanā //
meaning:
मां दिव्येन च भावेन तदाप्रभृति शङ्करम्
द्रक्ष्यसे च प्रसन्नेन मित्रभूतमिवात्मना //
text_mt: From then on, with a divine disposition, you shall see me, Śaṅkara, / with a pleased mind, as though a friend to yourself.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntardadhe rudro bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ
janārdano 'pi bhagavān devānāmapi saṃnidhau //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे रुद्रो भगवान्नीललोहितः
जनार्दनो ऽपि भगवान् देवानामपि संनिधौ //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the blessed Lord Rudra Nīlalohita vanished; / and the blessed Janārdana too, in the presence of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
ayācata mahādevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ munibhiḥ samam
mayā proktaṃ stavaṃ divyaṃ padmayone suśobhanam //
meaning:
अयाचत महादेवं ब्रह्माणं मुनिभिः समम्
मया प्रोक्तं स्तवं दिव्यं पद्मयोने सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: Prayed to Mahādeva and to Brahmā along with the sages: / “The divine and most splendid praise spoken by me, O lotus-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā dvijottamān
pratināmni hiraṇyasya tat tasya phalam āpnuyāt //
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि श्रावयेद्वा द्विजोत्तमान्
प्रतिनाम्नि हिरण्यस्य तत् तस्य फलम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Whoever reads it, listens to it, or recites it to the best of the twice-born, / shall obtain the fruit of [a gift of] gold for every name.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasreṇa phalaṃ bhavati tasya vai
ghṛtādyaiḥ snāpayedrudraṃ sthālyā vai kalaśaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्रेण फलं भवति तस्य वै
घृताद्यैः स्नापयेद्रुद्रं स्थाल्या वै कलशैः शुभैः //
text_mt: He indeed obtains the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices. / He who bathes Rudra with ghee and the like from a dish or auspicious vessels,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāṃ sahasreṇānena śraddhayā śivamīśvaram
so 'pi yajñasahasrasya phalaṃ labdhvāsureśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
नाम्नां सहस्रेणानेन श्रद्धया शिवमीश्वरम्
सो ऽपि यज्ञसहस्रस्य फलं लब्ध्वासुरेश्वरैः //
text_mt: With faith in Śiva the Lord, with this thousand names, / having obtained the fruit of a thousand sacrifices, he too becomes worshipped

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyo bhavati rudrasya prītirbhavati tasya vai
tathāstviti tathā prāha padmayonerjanārdanam //
meaning:
पूज्यो भवति रुद्रस्य प्रीतिर्भवति तस्य वै
तथास्त्विति तथा प्राह पद्मयोनेर्जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: By the chiefs of the asuras, and the affection of Rudra is his.” / “So be it!” said the lotus-born one to Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
jagmatuḥ praṇipatyainaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum
tasmānnāmnāṃ sahasreṇa pūjayed anagho dvijāḥ //
meaning:
जग्मतुः प्रणिपत्यैनं देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम्
तस्मान्नाम्नां सहस्रेण पूजयेद् अनघो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Having bowed to that god of gods, the guru of the universe, both departed. / Therefore, O sinless twice-born ones, one should worship with the thousand names;

sanskrit_iast: japennāmnāṃ sahasraṃ ca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning: जपेन्नाम्नां सहस्रं च स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: And one who recites the thousand names attains the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
saṃbhavaḥ sūcito devyās tvayā sūta mahāmate
savistaraṃ vadasvādya satītve ca yathātatham //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
संभवः सूचितो देव्यास् त्वया सूत महामते
सविस्तरं वदस्वाद्य सतीत्वे च यथातथम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / “The manifestation of the goddess has been indicated by you, O wise Sūta; / tell it now in full detail and accurately regarding her state as Satī,

sanskrit_iast:
menājatvaṃ mahādevyā dakṣayajñavimardanam
viṣṇunā ca kathaṃ dattā devadevāya śaṃbhave //
meaning:
मेनाजत्वं महादेव्या दक्षयज्ञविमर्दनम्
विष्णुना च कथं दत्ता देवदेवाय शंभवे //
text_mt: How Mahādevī was born of Menā, the crushing of Dakṣa's sacrifice, / and how she was given by Viṣṇu to Śambhu, the god of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
kalyāṇaṃ vā kathaṃ tasya vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ //
meaning:
कल्याणं वा कथं तस्य वक्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम्
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः //
text_mt: Or how her marriage [took place]—you ought to tell it now.” / Having heard those words of theirs, Sūta, the best of the Purāṇa reciters,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhavaṃ ca mahādevyāḥ prāha teṣāṃ mahātmanām
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ daṇḍine tat suvistaram //
meaning:
संभवं च महादेव्याः प्राह तेषां महात्मनाम्
ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं दण्डिने तत् सुविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Spoke of the manifestation of the Great Goddess to those great-souled ones, / as it was told in full detail long ago by Brahmā to Daṇḍin,

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmābhir vai kumārāya tena vyāsāya dhīmate
tasmādahamupaśrutya pravadāmi suvistaram //
meaning:
युष्माभिर् वै कुमाराय तेन व्यासाय धीमते
तस्मादहमुपश्रुत्य प्रवदामि सुविस्तरम् //
text_mt: By you to Kumāra, and by him to the wise Vyāsa; / having heard it from him, I tell it in full detail.

sanskrit_iast:
vacanādvo mahābhāgāḥ praṇamyomāṃ tathā bhavam
sā bhagākhyā jagaddhātrī liṅgamūrtestrivedikā //
meaning:
वचनाद्वो महाभागाः प्रणम्योमां तथा भवम्
सा भगाख्या जगद्धात्री लिङ्गमूर्तेस्त्रिवेदिका //
text_mt: At your word, O fortunate ones, having bowed to Umā and likewise to Bhava: / She who is called Bhaga is the supporter of the universe, the threefold altar of the liṅga-form.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgastu bhagavāndvābhyāṃ jagatsṛṣṭirdvijottamāḥ
liṅgamūrtiḥ śivo jyotis tamasaścopari sthitaḥ //
meaning:
लिङ्गस्तु भगवान्द्वाभ्यां जगत्सृष्टिर्द्विजोत्तमाः
लिङ्गमूर्तिः शिवो ज्योतिस् तमसश्चोपरि स्थितः //
text_mt: The liṅga is the Lord; from both of them comes the creation of the world, O best of the twice-born. / Śiva in the form of the liṅga is light, situated above the darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgavedisamāyogād ardhanārīśvarobhavat
brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe devam agre putraṃ caturmukham //
meaning:
लिङ्गवेदिसमायोगाद् अर्धनारीश्वरोभवत्
ब्रह्माणं विदधे देवम् अग्रे पुत्रं चतुर्मुखम् //
text_mt: Through union with the altar of the liṅga, he became Ardhanārīśvara; / first he brought forth the god Brahmā, his four-faced son.

sanskrit_iast:
prāhiṇoti sma tasyaiva jñānaṃ jñānamayo haraḥ
viśvādhiko 'sau bhagavān ardhanārīśvaro vibhuḥ //
meaning:
प्राहिणोति स्म तस्यैव ज्ञानं ज्ञानमयो हरः
विश्वाधिको ऽसौ भगवान् अर्धनारीश्वरो विभुः //
text_mt: Hara, consisting of knowledge, transmitted knowledge to him alone; / that Lord Ardhanārīśvara is all-pervading and transcends the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ devo jāyamānamapaśyata
so 'pi rudraṃ mahādevaṃ brahmāpaśyata śaṅkaram //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भं तं देवो जायमानमपश्यत
सो ऽपि रुद्रं महादेवं ब्रह्मापश्यत शङ्करम् //
text_mt: The god saw that Hiraṇyagarbha being born; / and Brahmā also saw Rudra, Mahādeva Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsthitaṃ devam ardhanārīśvaraṃ prabhum
tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhir varadaṃ vārijodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा संस्थितं देवम् अर्धनारीश्वरं प्रभुम्
तुष्टाव वाग्भिर् इष्टाभिर् वरदं वारिजोद्भवः //
text_mt: Seeing that lord Ardhanārīśvara standing there, / the lotus-born one praised the bestower of boons with desired hymns of praise:

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajasveti viśveśaṃ viśvātmānamajo vibhuḥ
sasarja devīṃ vāmāṅgāt patnīṃ caivātmanaḥ samām //
meaning:
विभजस्वेति विश्वेशं विश्वात्मानमजो विभुः
ससर्ज देवीं वामाङ्गात् पत्नीं चैवात्मनः समाम् //
text_mt: “Divide yourself!” the unborn lord [said] to the lord of all, the Self of all; / from his left side he brought forth the goddess, his wife equal to himself.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā hyasya śubhā patnī tataḥ puṃsaḥ purātanī
saivājñayā vibhordevī dakṣaputrī babhūva ha //
meaning:
श्रद्धा ह्यस्य शुभा पत्नी ततः पुंसः पुरातनी
सैवाज्ञया विभोर्देवी दक्षपुत्री बभूव ह //
text_mt: Faith (Śraddhā) indeed was the ancient auspicious wife of that Puruṣa; / then, by the Lord's command, that goddess became the daughter of Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
satīsaṃjñā tadā sā vai rudramevāśritā patim
dakṣaṃ vinindya kālena devī mainā hyabhūtpunaḥ //
meaning:
सतीसंज्ञा तदा सा वै रुद्रमेवाश्रिता पतिम्
दक्षं विनिन्द्य कालेन देवी मैना ह्यभूत्पुनः //
text_mt: Bearing the name Satī at that time, she took refuge in Rudra alone as her husband. / In time, having censured Dakṣa, the goddess became [the daughter] of Menā.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasyaiva dakṣo 'pi śāpādevaṃ vinindya ca
avajñādurmado dakṣo devadevamumāpatim //
meaning:
नारदस्यैव दक्षो ऽपि शापादेवं विनिन्द्य च
अवज्ञादुर्मदो दक्षो देवदेवमुमापतिम् //
text_mt: And Dakṣa also, because of Nārada's curse, having reviled in this way, / Dakṣa, mad with contempt [towards] the God of gods, the lord of Umā,

sanskrit_iast:
anādṛtya kṛtiṃ jñātvā satī dakṣeṇa tatkṣaṇāt
bhasmīkṛtvātmano dehaṃ yogamārgeṇa sā punaḥ //
meaning:
अनादृत्य कृतिं ज्ञात्वा सती दक्षेण तत्क्षणात्
भस्मीकृत्वात्मनो देहं योगमार्गेण सा पुनः //
text_mt: having shown disregard and Satī having known that deed done by Dakṣa, instantly / having reduced her own body to ashes through the path of yoga, she again

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva pārvatī devī tapasā ca gireḥ prabhoḥ
jñātvaitadbhagavān bhargo dadāha ruṣitaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
बभूव पार्वती देवी तपसा च गिरेः प्रभोः
