sahasrayojanāyāme divye maṇimaye śubhe //
meaning:
सेव्यमानोथ मध्ये वै सहस्रद्वारसंवृते /
सहस्रयोजनायामे दिव्ये मणिमये शुभे //
text_mt: Being served thus in the center, which was enclosed by a thousand gateways, / A thousand leagues in length, divine, jewel-bedecked, auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
vimāne vimale citre bhadrapīṭhāsane hariḥ /
lokakārye prasaktānāṃ dattadṛṣṭiśca mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
विमाने विमले चित्रे भद्रपीठासने हरिः /
लोककार्ये प्रसक्तानां दत्तदृष्टिश्च माधवः //
text_mt: On an immaculate, marvelous aerial chariot, seated on a throne of auspiciousness, Hari, / Mādhava, cast his glance upon those engaged in worldly affairs.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle 'tha bhagavān kauśikādyaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ /
āgamya praṇipatyāgre tuṣṭāva garuḍadhvajam //
meaning:
तस्मिन्काले ऽथ भगवान् कौशिकाद्यैश्च संवृतः /
आगम्य प्रणिपत्याग्रे तुष्टाव गरुडध्वजम् //
text_mt: At that time, the blessed [Brahmā], accompanied by Kauśika and the others, / Came, bowed before him, and praised the one who has Garuḍa on his banner.

sanskrit_iast:
tato kilokya bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ /
kauśiketyāha saṃprītyā tānsarvāṃśca yathākramam //
meaning:
ततो किलोक्य भगवान् हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः /
कौशिकेत्याह संप्रीत्या तान्सर्वांश्च यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Then, having looked upon them, the blessed Lord Hari Nārāyaṇa / Addressed them with affection: “Kauśika!” and all of them in order.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaghoṣo mahānasīnmahāścarye samāgate /
brahmāṇamāha viśvātmā śṛṇu brahman mayoditam //
meaning:
जयघोषो महानसीन्महाश्चर्ये समागते /
ब्रह्माणमाह विश्वात्मा शृणु ब्रह्मन् मयोदितम् //
text_mt: A great cry of victory arose when that great wonder came to pass. / The Self of All spoke to Brahmā: “Listen, O Brahmā, to what is spoken by me!

sanskrit_iast:
kauśikasya ime viprāḥ sādhyasādhanatatparāḥ /
hitāya saṃpravṛttā vai kuśasthalanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
कौशिकस्य इमे विप्राः साध्यसाधनतत्पराः /
हिताय संप्रवृत्ता वै कुशस्थलनिवासिनः //
text_mt: These brāhmaṇas of Kauśika, intent on achieving what is to be accomplished, / Dwellers of Kuśasthalā, engaged in the welfare [of others],

sanskrit_iast:
matkīrtiśravaṇe yuktā jñānatattvārthakovidāḥ /
ananyadevatābhaktāḥ sādhyā devā bhavantvime //
meaning:
मत्कीर्तिश्रवणे युक्ता ज्ञानतत्त्वार्थकोविदाः /
अनन्यदेवताभक्ताः साध्या देवा भवन्त्विमे //
text_mt: Devoted to hearing my praises, skilled in the true essence of knowledge, / Devoted to no other deity—let these become Sādhya gods!”

sanskrit_iast:
divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmān śṛṇvangānamihādhipaḥ /
āsva nityaṃ yathākāmaṃ yāvallokā bhavanti vai //
meaning:
दिव्यरूपधरः श्रीमान् शृण्वन्गानमिहाधिपः /
आस्व नित्यं यथाकामं यावल्लोका भवन्ति वै //
text_mt: Bearing a divine form, glorious, hearing music here as sovereign, / dwell forever as you desire, for as long indeed as the worlds endure.

sanskrit_iast:
padmākṣamāha bhagavān dhanado bhavamādhavaḥ /
dhanānāmīśvaro bhūtvā yathākālaṃ hi māṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
पद्माक्षमाह भगवान् धनदो भवमाधवः /
धनानामीश्वरो भूत्वा यथाकालं हि मां पुनः //
text_mt: The Lord, Mādhava, said to Padmākṣa, “Be the giver of wealth! / Having become the lord of treasures, then in due course [approach] me.

sanskrit_iast:
mālabaṃ mālavīṃ caivaṃ prāha dāmodaro hariḥ /
mama loke yathākālaṃ bhāryayā saha mālava //
meaning:
मालबं मालवीं चैवं प्राह दामोदरो हरिः /
मम लोके यथाकालं भार्यया सह मालव //
text_mt: Hari Dāmodara thus spoke to Mālava and Mālavī: / “In my realm, at the proper time, together with your wife, O Mālava,

sanskrit_iast:
divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmān śṛṇvangānamihādhipaḥ /
āsva nityaṃ yathākāmaṃ yāvallokā bhavanti vai //
meaning:
दिव्यरूपधरः श्रीमान् शृण्वन्गानमिहाधिपः /
आस्व नित्यं यथाकामं यावल्लोका भवन्ति वै //
text_mt: bearing a divine form, glorious, hearing music here as sovereign, / dwell forever as you desire, for as long indeed as the worlds endure.”

sanskrit_iast:
padmākṣamāha bhagavān dhanado bhavamādhavaḥ /
dhanānāmīśvaro bhūtvā yathākālaṃ hi māṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
पद्माक्षमाह भगवान् धनदो भवमाधवः /
धनानामीश्वरो भूत्वा यथाकालं हि मां पुनः //
text_mt: The Lord, Mādhava, said to Padmākṣa, “Be the giver of wealth! / Having become the lord of treasures, then in due course [approach] me;

sanskrit_iast:
āgamya dṛṣṭvā māṃ nityaṃ kuru rājyaṃ yathāsukham /
evamuktvā harirviṣṇurbrahmāṇamidamabravīt //
meaning:
आगम्य दृष्ट्वा मां नित्यं कुरु राज्यं यथासुखम् /
एवमुक्त्वा हरिर्विष्णुर्ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: having arrived and seen me constantly, rule your kingdom happily.” / Having spoken thus, Hari Viṣṇu addressed Brahmā with these words:

sanskrit_iast:
kauśikasyāsya gānena yoganidrā ca me gatā /
viṣṇusthale ca māṃ stauti śiṣyaireṣa samantataḥ //
meaning:
कौशिकस्यास्य गानेन योगनिद्रा च मे गता /
विष्णुस्थले च मां स्तौति शिष्यैरेष समन्ततः //
text_mt: “By the singing of this Kauśika, my yogic sleep was dispelled; / and in Viṣṇu’s place, he praises me on all sides with his disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñā nirastaḥ krūreṇa kaliṅgena mahīyasā /
sa jihvācchedanaṃ kṛtvā hareranyaṃ kathañcana //
meaning:
राज्ञा निरस्तः क्रूरेण कलिङ्गेन महीयसा /
स जिह्वाच्छेदनं कृत्वा हरेरन्यं कथञ्चन //
text_mt: Cast out by the cruel and mighty king Kaliṅga, / he cut off his tongue, [vowing,] ‘Anyone other than Hari

sanskrit_iast:
na stoṣyāmīti niyataḥ prāptosau mama lokatām /
ete ca viprā niyatā mama bhaktā yaśasvinaḥ //
meaning:
न स्तोष्यामीति नियतः प्राप्तोसौ मम लोकताम् /
एते च विप्रा नियता मम भक्ता यशस्विनः //
text_mt: I shall never praise!’ Firm in his resolve, he attained my realm. / And these disciplined Brahmins, devoted to me and renowned,

sanskrit_iast:
śrotracchidramathāhatya śaṅkubhirvai parasparam /
śroṣyāmo naiva cānyadvai hareḥ kīrtimitisma ha //
meaning:
श्रोत्रच्छिद्रमथाहत्य शङ्कुभिर्वै परस्परम् /
श्रोष्यामो नैव चान्यद्वै हरेः कीर्तिमितिस्म ह //
text_mt: piercing each other’s ear-cavities with pegs, / [declared,] ‘We shall hear nothing else than Hari's glory!’

sanskrit_iast:
ete viprāsca devatvaṃ mama sānnidhyameva ca /
mālavo bhāryayā sārdhaṃ matkṣetraṃ parimṛjya vai //
meaning:
एते विप्रास्च देवत्वं मम सान्निध्यमेव च /
मालवो भार्यया सार्धं मत्क्षेत्रं परिमृज्य वै //
text_mt: These Brahmins [attained] divinity and my very proximity; / and Mālava, together with his wife, having swept clean my sacred place,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpamālādibhirnityamabhyarcya satataṃ hi mām /
gānaṃ śṛṇoti niyato matkīrticaritānvitam //
meaning:
दीपमालादिभिर्नित्यमभ्यर्च्य सततं हि माम् /
गानं शृणोति नियतो मत्कीर्तिचरितान्वितम् //
text_mt: constantly worshipped me every day with rows of lamps and other offerings, / and, restrained, listened to singing endowed with the exploits of my glory.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāsau prāptavāṃllokaṃ mama brahmā sanātanam /
padmākṣosau dadau bhojyaṃ kauśikasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तेनासौ प्राप्तवांल्लोकं मम ब्रह्मा सनातनम् /
पद्माक्षोसौ ददौ भोज्यं कौशिकस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: Therefore, O Brahmā, he attained my eternal world. / This Padmākṣa gave food to the great-souled Kauśika;

sanskrit_iast:
dhaneśatvamavāptosau mama sānnidhyameva ca /
evamuktvā haristatra samāje lokapūjitaḥ //
meaning:
धनेशत्वमवाप्तोसौ मम सान्निध्यमेव च /
एवमुक्त्वा हरिस्तत्र समाजे लोकपूजितः //
text_mt: he attained the lordship of wealth and my very proximity.” / Having spoken thus in that assembly, Hari, revered by the world,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin kṣaṇe samāpannā madhurākṣarapeśalaiḥ /
vipañcīguṇatattvajñairvādyavidyāviśāradaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन् क्षणे समापन्ना मधुराक्षरपेशलैः /
विपञ्चीगुणतत्त्वज्ञैर्वाद्यविद्याविशारदैः //
text_mt: At that moment arrived [singers] charming with sweet syllables, / knowing the principles of the lute's strings, skilled in the art of instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
mandaṃ mandasmitā devī vicitrābharaṇānvitā /
gāyamānā samāyātā lakṣmīrviṣṇuparigrahā //
meaning:
मन्दं मन्दस्मिता देवी विचित्राभरणान्विता /
गायमाना समायाता लक्ष्मीर्विष्णुपरिग्रहा //
text_mt: Smiling gently, adorned with variegated ornaments, / singing, the goddess Lakṣmī arrived, the consort of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtā sahasrakoṭībhiraṅganābhiḥ samantataḥ /
tato gaṇādhipā dṛṣṭvā bhuśuṇḍīparighāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
वृता सहस्रकोटीभिरङ्गनाभिः समन्ततः /
ततो गणाधिपा दृष्ट्वा भुशुण्डीपरिघायुधाः //
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by thousands of crores of women. / Then, seeing [them], the troop leaders, armed with bhuśuṇḍīs and iron clubs,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīṃstarjayantaste munīndevānsamantataḥ /
utsārayantaḥ saṃhṛṣṭā dhiṣṭhitāḥ parvatopamāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादींस्तर्जयन्तस्ते मुनीन्देवान्समन्ततः /
उत्सारयन्तः संहृष्टा धिष्ठिताः पर्वतोपमाः //
text_mt: menaced Brahmā and the others, the sages and the gods on every side; / shouting for joy, standing like mountains, they drove them away.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve vayaṃ hi niryātāḥ sārdhaṃ vai brahmaṇā suraiḥ /
tasmin kṣaṇe samāhūtastuṃbarurmunisattamaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे वयं हि निर्याताः सार्धं वै ब्रह्मणा सुरैः /
तस्मिन् क्षणे समाहूतस्तुंबरुर्मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt: All of us departed together with Brahmā and the gods. / At that moment, Tumbaru, the best of sages, was summoned.

sanskrit_iast:
praviveśa samīpaṃ vai devyā devasya caiva hi /
tatrāsīno yathāyogaṃ nānāmūrcchāsamanvitam //
meaning:
प्रविवेश समीपं वै देव्या देवस्य चैव हि /
तत्रासीनो यथायोगं नानामूर्च्छासमन्वितम् //
text_mt: He entered the presence of the Goddess and the God. / Seated there as appropriate, with various swooning modulations,

sanskrit_iast:
jagau kalapadaṃ hṛṣṭo vipañcīṃ cābhyavādayat /
nānāratnasamāyuktairdivyairābharaṇottamaiḥ //
meaning:
जगौ कलपदं हृष्टो विपञ्चीं चाभ्यवादयत् /
नानारत्नसमायुक्तैर्दिव्यैराभरणोत्तमैः //
text_mt: delighted, he sang melodious notes and played upon the lute. / With excellent divine ornaments set with various jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
divyamālyaistathā śubhraiḥ pūjito munisattamaḥ /
nirgatastuṃbarurhṛṣṭo anye ca ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यमाल्यैस्तथा शुभ्रैः पूजितो मुनिसत्तमः /
निर्गतस्तुंबरुर्हृष्टो अन्ये च ऋषयः सुराः //
text_mt: and with bright divine garlands the best of sages was honoured. / Tumbaru departed rejoicing, as did the other ṛṣis and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjitaṃ yāntaṃ yathāyogamarindama /
nāradotha munirdṛṣṭvā tuṃbaroḥ satkriyāṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा संपूजितं यान्तं यथायोगमरिन्दम /
नारदोथ मुनिर्दृष्ट्वा तुंबरोः सत्क्रियां हरेः //
text_mt: Seeing him departing honoured, as was fitting, O subduer of foes, / sage Nārada, seeing the hospitality of Hari toward Tumbaru,

sanskrit_iast:
śokāviṣṭena manasā saṃtaptahṛdayekṣaṇaḥ /
cintāmāpedivāṃstatra śokamūrcchākulātmakaḥ //
meaning:
शोकाविष्टेन मनसा संतप्तहृदयेक्षणः /
चिन्तामापेदिवांस्तत्र शोकमूर्च्छाकुलात्मकः //
text_mt: with a mind overcome by sorrow, with heart and eyes burning, / fell into deep anxiety, agitated by a stupor of grief:

sanskrit_iast:
kenāhaṃ hi haretyāsye yogaṃ devīsamīpataḥ /
aho tuṃbaruṇā prāptaṃ dhiṅmāṃ mūḍhaṃ vicetasam //
meaning:
केनाहं हि हरेत्यास्ये योगं देवीसमीपतः /
अहो तुंबरुणा प्राप्तं धिङ्मां मूढं विचेतसम् //
text_mt: “How may I attain union in Hari’s presence, near the Goddess? / Ah, what Tumbaru has achieved! Fie upon me, foolish and senseless!

sanskrit_iast:
yohaṃ hareḥ sannikāśaṃ bhūtairniryātitaḥ katham /
jīvanyāsyāmi kutrāhamaho tuṃbaruṇā kṛtam //
meaning:
योहं हरेः सन्निकाशं भूतैर्निर्यातितः कथम् /
जीवन्यास्यामि कुत्राहमहो तुंबरुणा कृतम् //
text_mt: I who was driven out from the presence of Hari by the beings! How / shall I go on living, where shall I go? Ah, what Tumbaru has accomplished!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃcintayan viprastapa āsthitavānmuniḥ /
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu nirucchvāsasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
इति संचिन्तयन् विप्रस्तप आस्थितवान्मुनिः /
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु निरुच्छ्वाससमन्वितः //
text_mt: Thinking thus, the Brahmin sage undertook austerities / for a thousand divine years, holding his breath,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyanviṣṇumathādhyāste tuṃbaroḥ satkriyāṃ smaran /
rodamāno muhurvidvān dhiṅmāmiti ca cintayan //
meaning:
ध्यायन्विष्णुमथाध्यास्ते तुंबरोः सत्क्रियां स्मरन् /
रोदमानो मुहुर्विद्वान् धिङ्मामिति च चिन्तयन् //
text_mt: meditating upon Viṣṇu, dwelling upon the hospitality shown to Tumbaru, / weeping repeatedly, the wise one, thinking, “Fie upon me!”

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yatkṛtavānviṣṇustacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge kauśikavṛttakathanaṃ nāma prathamodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तत्र यत्कृतवान्विष्णुस्तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे कौशिकवृत्तकथनं नाम प्रथमोध्यायः
text_mt:
What Viṣṇu did there, listen to that, O king.

Thus ends the first chapter in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa, entitled “The Narration of Kauśika’s Deeds”.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
tato nārāyaṇo devastasmai sarvaṃ pradāya vai /
kālayogena viśvatmā samaṃ cakre 'tha tuṃbaroḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
ततो नारायणो देवस्तस्मै सर्वं प्रदाय वै /
कालयोगेन विश्वत्मा समं चक्रे ऽथ तुंबरोः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then Lord Nārāyaṇa, having granted him everything, / the Soul of All, in course of time made him equal to Tumbaru,

sanskrit_iast:
nāradaṃ muniśārdūlamevaṃ vṛttamabhūtpurā /
nārāyaṇasya gītānāṃ gānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
नारदं मुनिशार्दूलमेवं वृत्तमभूत्पुरा /
नारायणस्य गीतानां गानं श्रेष्ठं पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: namely Nārada, best of sages; thus did it happen in the past. / Continual singing of Nārāyaṇa's songs is best.

sanskrit_iast:
gānenārādhito viṣṇuḥ satkīrti jñānavarcasī /
dadāti tuṣṭiṃ sthānaṃ ca yathāsau kauśikasya vai //
meaning:
गानेनाराधितो विष्णुः सत्कीर्ति ज्ञानवर्चसी /
ददाति तुष्टिं स्थानं च यथासौ कौशिकस्य वै //
text_mt: Worshipped through song, Viṣṇu grants true renown, knowledge, brilliance, / contentment, and an abode, just as he did indeed for Kauśika.

sanskrit_iast:
padmākṣaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca saṃsiddhiṃ pradadau hariḥ /
tasmāttvayā mahārāja viṣṇukṣatre viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
पद्माक्षप्रभृतीनां च संसिद्धिं प्रददौ हरिः /
तस्मात्त्वया महाराज विष्णुक्षत्रे विशेषतः //
text_mt: And Hari granted perfection to Padmākṣa and the others. / Therefore, O great king, especially in a sacred place of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
arcanaṃ gānanṛtyādyaṃ vādyotsavasamanvitam /
kartavyaṃ viṣṇubhaktairhi puruṣairaniśaṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
अर्चनं गाननृत्याद्यं वाद्योत्सवसमन्वितम् /
कर्तव्यं विष्णुभक्तैर्हि पुरुषैरनिशं नृप //
text_mt: worship with song, dance, and festive music / should be performed continually by men devoted to Viṣṇu, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotavyaṃ ca sadā nityaṃ śrotavyosau haristathā /
viṣṇukṣetre tu yo vidvān kārayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
श्रोतव्यं च सदा नित्यं श्रोतव्योसौ हरिस्तथा /
विष्णुक्षेत्रे तु यो विद्वान् कारयेद्भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: He should always and constantly be heard, and that Hari should be heard about. / The wise person who, endowed with devotion, causes to be performed in Viṣṇu’s field

sanskrit_iast:
gānanṛtyādikaṃ caiva viṣṇvākhyānāṃ kathāṃ tathā /
jatismṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ ca tathaivoparame smṛtim //
meaning:
गाननृत्यादिकं चैव विष्ण्वाख्यानां कथां तथा /
जतिस्मृतिं च मेधां च तथैवोपरमे स्मृतिम् //
text_mt: singing, dancing, and the like, as well as stories containing Viṣṇu's narratives, / [attains] memory of past lives, intelligence, and mindfulness at the time of death,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnoti viṣṇusāyujyaṃ satyametannṛpādhipa /
etatte kathitaṃ rājan yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi //
meaning:
प्राप्नोति विष्णुसायुज्यं सत्यमेतन्नृपाधिप /
एतत्ते कथितं राजन् यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि //
text_mt: and attains union with Viṣṇu; this is the truth, O king of kings. / This has been told to you, O king, which you asked of me.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vadāmi ca te bhūto vada dharmabhṛtāṃ vara //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
किं वदामि च ते भूतो वद धर्मभृतां वर //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे विष्णुमाहात्म्यं नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
What further shall I say to you? Speak, O best of the upholders of dharma.

Thus ends the second chapter in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa, entitled “The Majesty of Viṣṇu”.

sanskrit_iast:
ambarīṣa uvāca
mārkaṇḍeya mahāprājña kena yogena labdhavān /
gānavidyāṃ mahābhāga nārado bhagavānmuniḥ //
meaning:
अम्बरीष उवाच
मार्कण्डेय महाप्राज्ञ केन योगेन लब्धवान् /
गानविद्यां महाभाग नारदो भगवान्मुनिः //
text_mt: Ambarīṣa said: / O Mārkaṇḍeya of great wisdom, by what yoga did the lordly sage / Nārada, the highly fortunate one, attain the art of music?

sanskrit_iast:
tuṃbarośca samānatvaṃ kasminkāla upeyivān /
etadācakṣva me sarvaṃ sarvajñosi mahāmate //
meaning:
तुंबरोश्च समानत्वं कस्मिन्काल उपेयिवान् /
एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं सर्वज्ञोसि महामते //
text_mt: And at what time did he reach equality with Tumbaru? / Tell me all this, for you are omniscient, O great-minded one.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
śruto mayāyamartho vai nāradāddevadarśanāt /
svayamahā mahātejā nārado 'sau mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
श्रुतो मयायमर्थो वै नारदाद्देवदर्शनात् /
स्वयमहा महातेजा नारदो ऽसौ महामतिः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This matter was heard by me directly from Nārada, who has seen the gods. / He himself related it, that Nārada of great splendour and noble mind.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtapyamāno bhagavān divyaṃvarṣasahasrakam /
nirucchvāsena saṃyuktastuṃbarorgauravaṃ smaran //
meaning:
संतप्यमानो भगवान् दिव्यंवर्षसहस्रकम् /
निरुच्छ्वासेन संयुक्तस्तुंबरोर्गौरवं स्मरन् //
text_mt: Performing austerities for a thousand divine years, the venerable one, / holding his breath, remembered the honour paid to Tumbaru,

sanskrit_iast:
tatāpa ca mahāghoraṃ taporāśistapaḥ param /
athāntarikṣe śuśrāva nārado 'sau mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
तताप च महाघोरं तपोराशिस्तपः परम् /
अथान्तरिक्षे शुश्राव नारदो ऽसौ महामुनिः //
text_mt: and, a mass of ascetic power, performed supreme, exceedingly dreadful tapas. / Then the great sage Nārada heard in the sky

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇīṃ divyāṃ mahāghoṣāmadbhutāmasarīriṇīm /
kimarthaṃ muniśārdūla tapastapasi duścaram //
meaning:
वाणीं दिव्यां महाघोषामद्भुतामसरीरिणीम् /
किमर्थं मुनिशार्दूल तपस्तपसि दुश्चरम् //
text_mt: a divine, bodiless voice of great resonance and wonder: / “For what purpose, O best of sages, do you perform this austerity so hard to practice?

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkaṃ paśya gatvā tvaṃ yadi gāne ratā matiḥ /
mānasottaraśaile tu gānabandhuriti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उलूकं पश्य गत्वा त्वं यदि गाने रता मतिः /
मानसोत्तरशैले तु गानबन्धुरिति स्मृतः //
text_mt: Go see an owl, if your mind is devoted to music! / On Mount Mānasottara there is one known as Gānabandhu.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha śīghraṃ ca paśyainaṃ gānavittvaṃ bhaviṣyasi /
ityukto vismayā viṣṭo nārado vāgvidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
गच्छ शीघ्रं च पश्यैनं गानवित्त्वं भविष्यसि /
इत्युक्तो विस्मया विष्टो नारदो वाग्विदां वरः //
text_mt: Go quickly and see him; you will become a master of music.” / Spoken to thus, filled with wonder, Nārada, best among those skilled in speech,

sanskrit_iast:
mānasottaraśaile tu gānabandhuṃ jagāma vai /
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣāstathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
मानसोत्तरशैले तु गानबन्धुं जगाम वै /
गन्धर्वाः किन्नरा यक्षास्तथा चाप्सरसां गणाः //
text_mt: went to Gānabandhu on Mount Mānasottara. / Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, and troops of Apsarases

sanskrit_iast:
samāsīnāstu parito gānabandhuṃ tatastataḥ /
ganavidyāṃ samāpannaḥ sikṣitāstena pakṣiṇā //
meaning:
समासीनास्तु परितो गानबन्धुं ततस्ततः /
गनविद्यां समापन्नः सिक्षितास्तेन पक्षिणा //
text_mt: Sitting all around Gānabandhu on every side, / having attained the science of music, they were instructed by that bird.

sanskrit_iast:
snigdhakaṇṭhasvarās tatra samāsīnām udānvitāḥ /
tato nāradamālokya gānabandhuruvāca ha //
meaning:
स्निग्धकण्ठस्वरास् तत्र समासीनाम् उदान्विताः /
ततो नारदमालोक्य गानबन्धुरुवाच ह //
text_mt: Sitting there, full of joy, with melodious throat-voices. / Then, seeing Nārada, Gānabandhu spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
/
praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ svāgatenābhyapūjayat /
kimarthaṃ bhagavānatra cāgato 'si mahāmate //
meaning:
/
प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायं स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयत् /
किमर्थं भगवानत्र चागतो ऽसि महामते //
text_mt: Bowing down properly, he honored him with a welcome: / "For what purpose have you come here, O lord, O highly intelligent one?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kāryaṃ hi mayā brahman brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te /
nārada uvāca
ulūkendra mahāprājña śṛṇusarvaṃ yathātatham //
meaning:
किं कार्यं हि मया ब्रह्मन् ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते /
नारद उवाच
उलूकेन्द्र महाप्राज्ञ शृणुसर्वं यथातथम् //
text_mt: What indeed is my duty, O brāhmaṇa? Speak, what shall I do for you?" / Nārada said: / "O king of owls, O greatly wise one, hear everything as it happened.

sanskrit_iast:
mama vṛttaṃ pravakṣyāmi purā bhūtaṃ mahādbhutam /
atīte hi yuge vidvannārāyaṇasamīpagam //
meaning:
मम वृत्तं प्रवक्ष्यामि पुरा भूतं महाद्भुतम् /
अतीते हि युगे विद्वन्नारायणसमीपगम् //
text_mt: I shall recount my past conduct, very wonderful, which happened formerly: / In a past yuga, O learned one, while I was near Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ vinirdhūya saṃhṛṣṭaḥ samāhūya ca tuṃbarum /
lakṣmīsamanvito viṣṇuraśṛṇodgānamuttamam //
meaning:
मां विनिर्धूय संहृष्टः समाहूय च तुंबरुम् /
लक्ष्मीसमन्वितो विष्णुरशृणोद्गानमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Brushing me aside, Viṣṇu, highly pleased, summoned Tumburu / and, accompanied by Lakṣmī, listened to his excellent song.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve nirastāḥ sthānato 'cyutāḥ /
kauśikādyāḥ samāsīnā gānayogena vai harim //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादयः सुराः सर्वे निरस्ताः स्थानतो ऽच्युताः /
कौशिकाद्याः समासीना गानयोगेन वै हरिम् //
text_mt: All the gods, Brahmā and the rest, were displaced from their positions, cast down, / while Kauśika and others, sitting together, by the yoga of song [worshiped] Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
evamārādhya saṃprāptā gāṇapatyaṃ yathāsukham /
tenāhamatiduḥkhārtastapastaptumihāgataḥ //
meaning:
एवमाराध्य संप्राप्ता गाणपत्यं यथासुखम् /
तेनाहमतिदुःखार्तस्तपस्तप्तुमिहागतः //
text_mt: Having thus worshiped [him], they attained the status of leaders of Gaṇas at ease. / Afflicted with great sorrow on that account, I have come here to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddattaṃ yaddhutaṃ caiva yathā vā śrutameva ca /
yadadhītaṃ mayā sarvaṃ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm //
meaning:
यद्दत्तं यद्धुतं चैव यथा वा श्रुतमेव च /
यदधीतं मया सर्वं कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् //
text_mt: Whatever was given, whatever was offered in sacrifice, whatever was heard, / and whatever was studied by me—all that is not worth a sixteenth part

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇormāhātmyayuktasya gāna yogasya vai tataḥ /
saṃcintyāhaṃ tapo ghoraṃ tadarthaṃ taptavān dvija //
meaning:
विष्णोर्माहात्म्ययुक्तस्य गान योगस्य वै ततः /
संचिन्त्याहं तपो घोरं तदर्थं तप्तवान् द्विज //
text_mt: Of the yoga of song endowed with the majesty of Viṣṇu. Reflecting on this, / I performed fierce austerities for that purpose, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
divyavarṣasahasraṃ vai tato hyaśṛṇuvaṃ punaḥ /
vāṇīmākāśasaṃbhūtāṃ tvāmuddiśya vihaṅgama //
meaning:
दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं वै ततो ह्यशृणुवं पुनः /
वाणीमाकाशसंभूतां त्वामुद्दिश्य विहङ्गम //
text_mt: For a thousand divine years. Then indeed I heard once more / a voice arising from the sky, addressed concerning you, O bird:

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkaṃ gaccha devaṣe gānabandhuṃ matiryadi /
gāte cedvartate brahman tatra tvaṃ vetsyase cirāt //
meaning:
उलूकं गच्छ देवषे गानबन्धुं मतिर्यदि /
गाते चेद्वर्तते ब्रह्मन् तत्र त्वं वेत्स्यसे चिरात् //
text_mt: 'Go to the owl Gānabandhu, O divine sage, if your mind / is set upon song, O brāhmaṇa; there you will learn after a long time.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityahaṃ preritastena tvatsamīpamīhāgataḥ /
kiṃ karīṣyāmi śiṣyohaṃ tava māṃ pālayāvyaya //
meaning:
इत्यहं प्रेरितस्तेन त्वत्समीपमीहागतः /
किं करीष्यामि शिष्योहं तव मां पालयाव्यय //
text_mt: Impelled by that, I have come here into your presence. / What shall I do? I am your disciple; protect me, O imperishable one!"

sanskrit_iast:
gānabandhuruvāca
śṛṇu nārada yadvṛttaṃ purā mama mahāmate /
atyāścaryasamāyuktaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham //
meaning:
गानबन्धुरुवाच
शृणु नारद यद्वृत्तं पुरा मम महामते /
अत्याश्चर्यसमायुक्तं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् //
text_mt: Gānabandhu said: / "Hear, O Nārada, what happened to me formerly, O highly intelligent one, / endowed with great wonder, removing all sins, auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaneśa iti khyāto rājabhūddhārmikaḥ purā /
aśvamedhasahasraiśca vājapeyāyutena ca //
meaning:
भुवनेश इति ख्यातो राजभूद्धार्मिकः पुरा /
अश्वमेधसहस्रैश्च वाजपेयायुतेन च //
text_mt: Formerly there was a righteous king known as Bhuvaneśa. / By means of a thousand horse sacrifices and ten thousand Vājapeya sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ koṭyarbude caiva suvarmasya tathaiva ca /
vāsasāṃ rathahastīnāṃ kanyāśvānāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
गवां कोट्यर्बुदे चैव सुवर्मस्य तथैव च /
वाससां रथहस्तीनां कन्याश्वानां तथैव च //
text_mt: And ten billion cows, and likewise gold, / garments, chariots, elephants, maidens, and horses,

sanskrit_iast:
datvā sa rājā viprebhyo medinīṃ pratipālayan /
nivārayan svake rājye geyayogena keśavam //
meaning:
दत्वा स राजा विप्रेभ्यो मेदिनीं प्रतिपालयन् /
निवारयन् स्वके राज्ये गेययोगेन केशवम् //
text_mt: Having given [these] to the brāhmaṇas, while protecting the earth, that king / forbade in his own kingdom Keśava [being sung of] through the yoga of song:

sanskrit_iast:
anyaṃ vā geyayogena gāyanyadi sa me bhavet /
vadhyaḥ sarvātmanā tasmādvedai rīḍyaḥ paraḥ pumān //
meaning:
अन्यं वा गेययोगेन गायन्यदि स मे भवेत् /
वध्यः सर्वात्मना तस्माद्वेदै रीड्यः परः पुमान् //
text_mt: 'If anyone should sing of another through the yoga of song, he shall be / put to death by me by all means; for the Supreme Person is to be praised only by the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
gānayogena sarvatra striyo gāyantu nityaśaḥ /
sūtamāgadhasaṃghāśca gītaṃ te kārayantu vai //
meaning:
गानयोगेन सर्वत्र स्त्रियो गायन्तु नित्यशः /
सूतमागधसंघाश्च गीतं ते कारयन्तु वै //
text_mt: Let women sing everywhere continually by the yoga of song, / and let crowds of Sūtas and Māgadhas perform song!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityajñāpyamahātejā rājyaṃ vai paryapālayat /
tasya rājñaḥ purābhyāśe harimitra iti śrutaḥ //
meaning:
इत्यज्ञाप्यमहातेजा राज्यं वै पर्यपालयत् /
तस्य राज्ञः पुराभ्याशे हरिमित्र इति श्रुतः //
text_mt: Having so ordered, the king of great splendor ruled the realm. / In the vicinity of that king's city, there was one renowned as Harimitra,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo viṣṇubhaktaśca sarvadvandvavivarjitaḥ /
nadīpulinamāsādya pratimāṃ ca hareḥ śubhām //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो विष्णुभक्तश्च सर्वद्वन्द्वविवर्जितः /
नदीपुलिनमासाद्य प्रतिमां च हरेः शुभाम् //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa, devoted to Viṣṇu, freed from all dualities. / Having approached a sandbank of a river, and [setting up] an auspicious image of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya ca yathānyāyaṃ ghṛtadadhyuttaraṃ bahu /
miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasaṃ dattvā harerāvedya pūpakam //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य च यथान्यायं घृतदध्युत्तरं बहु /
मिष्टान्नं पायसं दत्त्वा हरेरावेद्य पूपकम् //
text_mt: And having worshiped it according to rule, offering abundant sweet foods / and milk rice covered with ghee and curds, and presenting cakes to Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ tatra vinyastamānasaḥ /
agāyata hariṃ tatra tālavarṇalayānvitam //
meaning:
प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायं तत्र विन्यस्तमानसः /
अगायत हरिं तत्र तालवर्णलयान्वितम् //
text_mt: Bowing down according to rule, with his mind fixed there, / he sang there to Hari, accompanied by rhythm, musical notes, and tempo,

sanskrit_iast:
atīva snehasaṃyuktastadgatenāntarātmanā /
tato rājñaḥ samādeśāccārāstatra samāgatāḥ //
meaning:
अतीव स्नेहसंयुक्तस्तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना /
ततो राज्ञः समादेशाच्चारास्तत्र समागताः //
text_mt: Full of extreme affection, with his inner self absorbed in him. / Then, by the king's command, spies arrived there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarcanādi sakalaṃ nirdūya ca samantataḥ /
brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ gṛhītvā te rājñe samyaṅnyavedayan //
meaning:
तदर्चनादि सकलं निर्दूय च समन्ततः /
ब्राह्मणं तं गृहीत्वा ते राज्ञे सम्यङ्न्यवेदयन् //
text_mt: Scattering all his worship and offerings completely, / they seized that brāhmaṇa and reported fully to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rājā dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ paribhartsya sudurmatiḥ /
rājyānnaryātayāmāsa hṛtvā sarvaṃ dhanādikam //
meaning:
ततो राजा द्विजश्रेष्ठं परिभर्त्स्य सुदुर्मतिः /
राज्यान्नर्यातयामास हृत्वा सर्वं धनादिकम् //
text_mt: Then the evil-minded king, having reviled that best of twice-borns, / banished him from the kingdom after seizing all his wealth and possessions.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāṃ ca hareścaiva mlecchā hṛtvā yayuḥ punaḥ /
tataḥ kālena mahatā kāladharmamupeyivān //
meaning:
प्रतिमां च हरेश्चैव म्लेच्छा हृत्वा ययुः पुनः /
ततः कालेन महता कालधर्ममुपेयिवान् //
text_mt: And Mlecchas seized the image of Hari and departed again. / Then, after a long time, he met with the law of time [and died].

sanskrit_iast:
sa rājā sarvalokeṣu pūjyamānaḥ samantataḥ /
kṣudhārtaśca tathā khinno yamamāha suduḥ khitaḥ //
meaning:
स राजा सर्वलोकेषु पूज्यमानः समन्ततः /
क्षुधार्तश्च तथा खिन्नो यममाह सुदुः खितः //
text_mt: That king, [though] honored all around in all the worlds, / being afflicted with hunger and exhausted, said to Yama in great sorrow:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuttṛṭ ca vartate deva svargatasyāpi me sadā /
mayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ kariṣyāmi vai yama //
meaning:
क्षुत्तृट् च वर्तते देव स्वर्गतस्यापि मे सदा /
मया पापं कृतं किं वा किं करिष्यामि वै यम //
text_mt: 'Hunger and thirst afflict me constantly, O god, even though I have gone to heaven! / What sin was committed by me, or what shall I do, O Yama?'

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca
tvayā hi sumahatpāpaṃ kṛtamajñānamohataḥ /
harimitraṃ prati tadā vāsudevaparāyaṇam //
meaning:
यम उवाच
त्वया हि सुमहत्पापं कृतमज्ञानमोहतः /
हरिमित्रं प्रति तदा वासुदेवपरायणम् //
text_mt: Yama said: / 'Indeed, a very great sin was committed by you out of the delusion of ignorance / at that time toward Harimitra, who was dedicated to Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
harimitre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāsudevārcanādiṣu /
tena pāpena saṃprāptaḥ kṣudrogastvāṃ sadā nṛpa //
meaning:
हरिमित्रे कृतं पापं वासुदेवार्चनादिषु /
तेन पापेन संप्राप्तः क्षुद्रोगस्त्वां सदा नृप //
text_mt: The sin committed against Harimitra during his worship and adoration of Vāsudeva— / because of that sin, the affliction of hunger has come upon you perpetually, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
dānayajñādikaṃ sarvaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ te narādhipa /
gītavādyasamopetaṃ gāyamānaṃ mahāmatim //
meaning:
दानयज्ञादिकं सर्वं प्रनष्टं ते नराधिप /
गीतवाद्यसमोपेतं गायमानं महामतिम् //
text_mt: All your gifts, sacrifices, and the like are destroyed, O ruler of men! / Having summoned the noble-minded Harimitra,

sanskrit_iast:
harimitraṃ samāhūya hṛtavānasi taddhanam /
upahārādikaṃ sarvaṃ vāsudevasya sannidhau //
meaning:
हरिमित्रं समाहूय हृतवानसि तद्धनम् /
उपहारादिकं सर्वं वासुदेवस्य सन्निधौ //
text_mt: Who was singing accompanied by vocal and instrumental music, you seized his wealth / and all the offerings in the presence of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
tava bhṛtyaistadā luptaṃ pāpaṃ cakrustvadājñayā /
hareḥ kīrtiṃ vinā cānyadbrahmaṇena nṛpottama //
meaning:
तव भृत्यैस्तदा लुप्तं पापं चक्रुस्त्वदाज्ञया /
हरेः कीर्तिं विना चान्यद्ब्रह्मणेन नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: At that time they were destroyed by your servants, who committed sin by your command. / Since by a brāhmaṇa nothing other than Hari's glory,

sanskrit_iast:
na geyayoge gātavyaṃ tasmātpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā /
naṣṭaste sarvalokodya gacca parvatakoṭaram //
meaning:
न गेययोगे गातव्यं तस्मात्पापं कृतं त्वया /
नष्टस्ते सर्वलोकोद्य गच्च पर्वतकोटरम् //
text_mt: O best of kings, is to be sung in the yoga of song, therefore a sin was committed by you. / All your worlds are lost today; go to the hollow of a mountain!

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvotsṛṣṭaṃ svadehaṃ taṃ khādannityaṃ nikṛtya vai /
tasminkoṇe tvimaṃ dehaṃ khādannityaṃ kṣudhanvitaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वोत्सृष्टं स्वदेहं तं खादन्नित्यं निकृत्य वै /
तस्मिन्कोणे त्विमं देहं खादन्नित्यं क्षुधन्वितः //
text_mt: Daily tearing and eating that former body of yours that was abandoned, / and daily eating this body in that corner, possessed of hunger,

sanskrit_iast:
mahānirayasaṃsthastvaṃ yāvanmanvantaraṃ bhavet /
manvantare tato 'tīte bhūmyāṃ tvaṃ ca bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
महानिरयसंस्थस्त्वं यावन्मन्वन्तरं भवेत् /
मन्वन्तरे ततो ऽतीते भूम्यां त्वं च भविष्यसि //
text_mt: You shall remain in the great hell for as long as a manvantara lasts. / Then, when the manvantara has passed, you will be born on earth;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena saṃprāpya mānuṣyamavagacchasi /
gānabandhuruvāca
evamuktvā yamo vidvāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
ततः कालेन संप्राप्य मानुष्यमवगच्छसि /
गानबन्धुरुवाच
एवमुक्त्वा यमो विद्वांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Then, in the course of time, having attained human birth, you will understand.' / Gānabandhu said: / Having spoken thus, the wise Yama vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
harimitro vimānena stūyamāno gaṇādhipaiḥ /
viṣṇulokaṃ gataḥ śrīmān saṃgṛhya gamabāndhavān //
meaning:
हरिमित्रो विमानेन स्तूयमानो गणाधिपैः /
विष्णुलोकं गतः श्रीमान् संगृह्य गमबान्धवान् //
text_mt: Harimitra, praised by the chiefs of Gaṇas in a celestial chariot, / the glorious one went to the world of Viṣṇu, taking his relatives with him.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaneśo nṛpo hyasmin koṭare parvatasya vai /
khādamānaḥ śavaṃ nityam āste kṣuttṛṭsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
भुवनेशो नृपो ह्यस्मिन् कोटरे पर्वतस्य वै /
खादमानः शवं नित्यम् आस्ते क्षुत्तृट्समन्वितः //
text_mt: King Bhuvaneśa indeed sits in this hollow of the mountain, / daily devouring his corpse, afflicted with hunger and thirst.

sanskrit_iast:
adrākṣaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ tatra sarvametanmamoktavān /
samālokyāhamājñāya harimitraṃ sameyivān //
meaning:
अद्राक्षं तं नृपं तत्र सर्वमेतन्ममोक्तवान् /
समालोक्याहमाज्ञाय हरिमित्रं समेयिवान् //
text_mt: I saw that king there, and he told me all this. / Observing and knowing this, I met Harimitra

sanskrit_iast:
vimānenārkavarṇena gacchantamamarairvṛtam /
indradyumnaprasādena prāptaṃ me hyāyuruttamam //
meaning:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन गच्छन्तममरैर्वृतम् /
इन्द्रद्युम्नप्रसादेन प्राप्तं मे ह्यायुरुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Going in a chariot with the color of the sun, surrounded by immortals. / By the grace of Indradyumna, an excellent lifespan was obtained by me;

sanskrit_iast:
tenāhaṃ harimitraṃ vai dṛṣṭavān asmi suvrata /
tadaiśvaryaprabhāvena mano me samupāgatam //
meaning:
तेनाहं हरिमित्रं वै दृष्टवान् अस्मि सुव्रत /
तदैश्वर्यप्रभावेन मनो मे समुपागतम् //
text_mt: By virtue of that, I saw Harimitra, O one of good vows. / Due to the power of that sovereignty, my mind became drawn

sanskrit_iast:
gānavidyāṃ prati tadā kinnaraiḥ samupāviśam /
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ gānayogena me mune //
meaning:
गानविद्यां प्रति तदा किन्नरैः समुपाविशम् /
षष्टिं वर्षसहस्राणां गानयोगेन मे मुने //
text_mt: Toward the science of music at that time; I sat among the Kinnaras. / For sixty thousand years, through the yoga of song, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
jihvā prasāditā spaṣṭā tato gānamaśikṣayam /
tatastu dviguṇenaiva kālenābhūdiyaṃ mama //
meaning:
जिह्वा प्रसादिता स्पष्टा ततो गानमशिक्षयम् /
ततस्तु द्विगुणेनैव कालेनाभूदियं मम //
text_mt: My tongue became clear and refined; then I taught singing. / Then, in twice that amount of time, it became for me

sanskrit_iast:
gānayogasamāyuktā gatā manvantarā daśa /
gānācāryo 'bhavaṃ tatra gandharvādyāḥ samāgatāḥ //
meaning:
गानयोगसमायुक्ता गता मन्वन्तरा दश /
गानाचार्यो ऽभवं तत्र गन्धर्वाद्याः समागताः //
text_mt: Fully endowed with the yoga of song; ten manvantaras passed. / I became a master of music there; Gandharvas and others assembled.

sanskrit_iast:
ete kinnarasaṃghā vai māmācāryamupāgatāḥ /
tapasā naiva śakyā vai gānavidyā tapodhana //
meaning:
एते किन्नरसंघा वै मामाचार्यमुपागताः /
तपसा नैव शक्या वै गानविद्या तपोधन //
text_mt: These hosts of Kinnaras have indeed approached me as their master. / The science of music cannot be mastered merely by ascetic austerity, O rich in austerity!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchrutena saṃyukto mattastvaṃ gānamāpnuhi /
evamukto munistaṃ vai praṇipatya jagau tadā //
meaning:
तस्माच्छ्रुतेन संयुक्तो मत्तस्त्वं गानमाप्नुहि /
एवमुक्तो मुनिस्तं वै प्रणिपत्य जगौ तदा //
text_mt: Therefore, equipped with traditional learning, receive singing from me." / Having been told thus, the sage bowed down to him and then sang.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchṛṇuṣva muniśreṣṭha vāsudevaṃ namasya tu /
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
ulūkenaivamuktastu nārado munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छृणुष्व मुनिश्रेष्ठ वासुदेवं नमस्य तु /
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
उलूकेनैवमुक्तस्तु नारदो मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt:
Listen to that, O best of sages, after bowing to Vāsudeva.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed by the owl, Nārada, the best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣākrameṇa saṃyuktastatra gānamāśikṣayat /
gānabandhustadāhedaṃ tyaktalajjo bhavādhunā //
meaning:
शिक्षाक्रमेण संयुक्तस्तत्र गानमाशिक्षयत् /
गानबन्धुस्तदाहेदं त्यक्तलज्जो भवाधुना //
text_mt:
accompanied by the regular sequence of instruction, was taught singing there.
Then Gānabandhu said this: “Become free from shame now.

sanskrit_iast:
ulūka uvāca
strīsaṃgame tathā gīte dyūte vyākhyānasaṃgame /
vyavahāre tathāhāre tvarthānāṃ ca samāgame //
meaning:
उलूक उवाच
स्त्रीसंगमे तथा गीते द्यूते व्याख्यानसंगमे /
व्यवहारे तथाहारे त्वर्थानां च समागमे //
text_mt:
The owl said:
In union with a woman, in song, in gambling, in gatherings for discourse,
in business dealings, in eating, and in the acquisition of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
āye vyaye tathā nityaṃ tyaktalajjastu vai bhavet /
na kuñcitena gūḍhena nityaṃ prāvaramādibhiḥ //
meaning:
आये व्यये तथा नित्यं त्यक्तलज्जस्तु वै भवेत् /
न कुञ्चितेन गूढेन नित्यं प्रावरमादिभिः //
text_mt:
and constantly in income and expenditure, one should indeed be free from shame.
One should never [sing] bent, concealed, covered with garments and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
hastavikṣepabhāvena vyādi tāsyena caiva hi /
niryātajihvāyogena na geyaṃ hi kathañcana //
meaning:
हस्तविक्षेपभावेन व्यादि तास्येन चैव हि /
निर्यातजिह्वायोगेन न गेयं हि कथञ्चन //
text_mt:
with flailing hands, with wide-open mouth,
or with protruding tongue; one must not sing [so] by any means.

sanskrit_iast:
na gāyedūrdhvabāhuśca nordhvadṛṣṭiḥ kathañcana /
svāṅgaṃ nirīkṣamāṇena paraṃ saṃprekṣatā tathā //
meaning:
न गायेदूर्ध्वबाहुश्च नोर्ध्वदृष्टिः कथञ्चन /
स्वाङ्गं निरीक्षमाणेन परं संप्रेक्षता तथा //
text_mt:
One should not sing with arms raised, nor ever with upward gaze,
nor inspecting one's own limbs, nor staring at another.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃghaṭṭe ca tathotthāne kaṭisthānaṃ na śasyate /
hāso roṣastathā kaṃpastathānyatra smṛtiḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
संघट्टे च तथोत्थाने कटिस्थानं न शस्यते /
हासो रोषस्तथा कंपस्तथान्यत्र स्मृतिः पुनः //
text_mt:
And in clapping [the beat] and in standing up, [clapping against] the hip region is not commended.
Laughter, anger, trembling, and having one's mind elsewhere—

sanskrit_iast:
naitāni śastarūpāṇi gānayoge mahāmate /
naikahastena śakyaṃ syāttālasaṃghaṭṭanaṃ mune //
meaning:
नैतानि शस्तरूपाणि गानयोगे महामते /
नैकहस्तेन शक्यं स्यात्तालसंघट्टनं मुने //
text_mt:
these are not praiseworthy forms in the practice of singing, O wise one.
Nor can the striking of musical beats be accomplished with a single hand, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhārttena bhayārtena tṛṣṇārtena tathaiva ca /
gānayoge na kartavyo nāndhakāre kathañcana //
meaning:
क्षुधार्त्तेन भयार्तेन तृष्णार्तेन तथैव च /
गानयोगे न कर्तव्यो नान्धकारे कथञ्चन //
text_mt:
One afflicted by hunger, afflicted by fear, and likewise afflicted by thirst
must not engage in the practice of singing, nor ever in darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
evamādīni cānyāni na kartavyāni gāyatā /
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāṃstenoktairvidhilakṣaṇaiḥ /
aśikṣayattathā gītaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam //
meaning:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि न कर्तव्यानि गायता /
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवमुक्तः स भगवांस्तेनोक्तैर्विधिलक्षणैः /
अशिक्षयत्तथा गीतं दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् //
text_mt:
These and other such things must not be done by a singer.”
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed, that venerable [owl] taught [him] singing according to the prescribed rules
laid down by him for a celestial thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samastasaṃpanno gītaprastārakādiṣu /
vipañcyādiṣu saṃpannaḥ sarvasvaravibhāgavit //
meaning:
ततः समस्तसंपन्नो गीतप्रस्तारकादिषु /
विपञ्च्यादिषु संपन्नः सर्वस्वरविभागवित् //
text_mt:
Then, fully accomplished in musical matrices and the like,
expert in the vipañcī lute and others, knower of all divisions of musical notes,

sanskrit_iast:
ayutāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśatsahasrāṇi śatāni ca /
svarāṇāṃ bhedayogena jñātavānmunisattamaḥ //
meaning:
अयुतानि च षट्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि शतानि च /
स्वराणां भेदयोगेन ज्ञातवान्मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt:
thirty-six myriad and hundreds of thousands
of musical notes through their combinations and divisions, the best of sages came to know.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gandharvasaṃghāśca kinnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca /
muninā saha saṃyuktāḥ prītiyuktā bhavanti te //
meaning:
ततो गन्धर्वसंघाश्च किन्नराणां तथैव च /
मुनिना सह संयुक्ताः प्रीतियुक्ता भवन्ति ते //
text_mt:
Then the hosts of Gandharvas and likewise of Kinnaras,
associated with the sage, became filled with affection [for him].

sanskrit_iast:
gānabandhuṃ muniḥ prāha prāpya gānamanuttamam /
tvāṃ samāsādya saṃpannastvaṃ hi gītaviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
गानबन्धुं मुनिः प्राह प्राप्य गानमनुत्तमम् /
त्वां समासाद्य संपन्नस्त्वं हि गीतविशारदः //
text_mt:
Having obtained the unsurpassed art of singing, the sage said to Gānabandhu:
“Having approached you, I have attained [this]; for you are skilled in song.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvāṅkṣaśatro mahāprājña kimācārya karomi te /
gānabandhuruvāca
brahmaṇo divase brahman manavastu caturdaśa //
meaning:
ध्वाङ्क्षशत्रो महाप्राज्ञ किमाचार्य करोमि ते /
गानबन्धुरुवाच
ब्रह्मणो दिवसे ब्रह्मन् मनवस्तु चतुर्दश //
text_mt:
O enemy of crows, O greatly wise one, what teacher’s fee shall I offer you?”
Gānabandhu said:
“In a single day of Brahmā, O brahmin, there are fourteen Manus.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastrai lokyasaṃplāvo bhaviṣyati mahāmune /
tāvanme tvāyuṣo bhāvastāvanme paramaṃ śubham //
meaning:
ततस्त्रै लोक्यसंप्लावो भविष्यति महामुने /
तावन्मे त्वायुषो भावस्तावन्मे परमं शुभम् //
text_mt:
Then the inundation of the three worlds will take place, O great sage.
So long let my lifespan last, and so long let supreme auspiciousness be mine.

sanskrit_iast:
manasādhyāhitaṃ me syāddakṣiṇā munisattama /
nārada uvāca
atītakalpasaṃyoge garuḍastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
मनसाध्याहितं मे स्याद्दक्षिणा मुनिसत्तम /
नारद उवाच
अतीतकल्पसंयोगे गरुडस्त्वं भविष्यसि //
text_mt:
Let that which is cherished in my mind be my sacrificial fee, O best of sages.”
Nārada said:
“At the conclusion of the past kalpa, you will become Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
svasti te 'stu mahāprājña gamiṣyāmi prasīda mām /
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evamuktvā jagāmatha nāradopi janārdanam //
meaning:
स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु महाप्राज्ञ गमिष्यामि प्रसीद माम् /
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवमुक्त्वा जगामथ नारदोपि जनार्दनम् //
text_mt:
May it be well with you, O greatly wise one; I shall depart; be pleased with me.”
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having spoken thus, Nārada then went to Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetadvīpe hṛṣīkeśaṃ gāpayāmāsa gītakān /
tatra śrutvā tu bhagavānnāradaṃ prāha mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
श्वेतद्वीपे हृषीकेशं गापयामास गीतकान् /
तत्र श्रुत्वा तु भगवान्नारदं प्राह माधवः //
text_mt:
In Śvetadvīpa, he sang songs to Hṛṣīkeśa.
Hearing them there, the venerable Mādhava said to Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
tuṃbarorna viśiṣṭosi gītairadyāpi nārada /
yadā viśiṣṭo bhavitā taṃ kālaṃ pravadāmyaham //
meaning:
तुंबरोर्न विशिष्टोसि गीतैरद्यापि नारद /
यदा विशिष्टो भविता तं कालं प्रवदाम्यहम् //
text_mt:
“Even today you are not superior to Tumburu in songs, O Nārada.
I shall tell you the time when you will become superior.

sanskrit_iast:
gānabandhuṃ samāsādya gānārthajño bhavānasi /
manorvaivasvatasyāhamaṣṭaviśatime yuge //
meaning:
गानबन्धुं समासाद्य गानार्थज्ञो भवानसि /
मनोर्वैवस्वतस्याहमष्टविशतिमे युगे //
text_mt:
Having approached Gānabandhu, you have come to know the meaning of music.
In the twenty-eighth yuga of the Manu Vaivasvata,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāṃparāṃ te bhavaṣyāmi yudavaṃśakulodbhavaḥ /
devakyāṃ vasudevasya kṛṣṇo nāmnā mahāmate //
meaning:
द्वांपरां ते भवष्यामि युदवंशकुलोद्भवः /
देवक्यां वसुदेवस्य कृष्णो नाम्ना महामते //
text_mt:
at the end of the Dvāpara, I shall be born in the lineage of the Yadu race,
from Vasudeva in Devakī, under the name Kṛṣṇa, O greatly wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
tadānīṃ māṃ samāsādya smārayethā yathātatham /
tatra tvāṃ gītasaṃpannaṃ kariṣyāmi mahāvratam //
meaning:
तदानीं मां समासाद्य स्मारयेथा यथातथम् /
तत्र त्वां गीतसंपन्नं करिष्यामि महाव्रतम् //
text_mt:
Approaching me then, you should remind me in accordance with the truth.
There I will make you accomplished in song, O you of great vows,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṃbarośca samañcaiva tathātiśayasaṃyutam /
tāvatkālaṃ yatāyogaṃ devagandharvayoniṣu //
meaning:
तुंबरोश्च समञ्चैव तथातिशयसंयुतम् /
तावत्कालं यतायोगं देवगन्धर्वयोनिषु //
text_mt:
both equal to Tumburu and endowed with pre-eminence [over him].
Until that time, as appropriate, among divine and Gandharva beings,

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣayasva yatānyāyamityuktvāntaradhīyata /
tato muniḥ praṇamyainaṃ tathātiśayasaṃyutam //
meaning:
शिक्षयस्व यतान्यायमित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत /
ततो मुनिः प्रणम्यैनं तथातिशयसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
teach [singing] properly.” Having spoken thus, he vanished.
Then the sage, having bowed to him, endowed with that excellence,

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣirdevasaṃkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ /
tapasāṃ nidhiratyantaṃ vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
देवर्षिर्देवसंकाशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः /
तपसां निधिरत्यन्तं वासुदेवपरायणः //
text_mt:
the divine sage resembling a god, adorned with all ornaments,
a supreme storehouse of austerities, wholly devoted to Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
skandhe vipañcīmāsādya sarvalokāṃścacāra saḥ /
vāruṇaṃ yāmyamāgneyamaidraṃ kauberameva ca //
meaning:
स्कन्धे विपञ्चीमासाद्य सर्वलोकांश्चचार सः /
वारुणं याम्यमाग्नेयमैद्रं कौबेरमेव च //
text_mt:
placing the vipañcī lute upon his shoulder, roamed through all the worlds:
the assembly of Varuṇa, of Yama, of Agni, of Indra, and of Kubera,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyaṃ ca tatheśānaṃ saṃsadaṃ prāpya dharmavit /
gāyamāno hariṃ samyagvīṇāvādavicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
वायव्यं च तथेशानं संसदं प्राप्य धर्मवित् /
गायमानो हरिं सम्यग्वीणावादविचक्षणः //
text_mt:
and of Vāyu, and reaching the assembly of Īśāna, the knower of righteousness,
singing properly of Hari, skilled in playing the vīṇā,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṃghaiḥ pūjyamānastata stataḥ /
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसां संघैः पूज्यमानस्तत स्ततः /
ब्रह्मलोकं समासाद्य कस्मिंश्चित्कालपर्यये //
text_mt:
worshipped here and there by hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases,
reached the world of Brahmā in the course of time.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhāhūhūśca gandharvau gītavādyaviśāradau /
brahmaṇo gāyakau divyau nityau gandharvasattamau //
meaning:
हाहाहूहूश्च गन्धर्वौ गीतवाद्यविशारदौ /
ब्रह्मणो गायकौ दिव्यौ नित्यौ गन्धर्वसत्तमौ //
text_mt:
Hāhā and Hūhū, the two Gandharvas skilled in vocal and instrumental music,
the two celestial, perpetual singers of Brahmā, the best of Gandharvas,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tābhyāṃ samāsādya gāyamāno hariṃ prabhum /
brahmaṇā ca mahātejāḥ pūjito munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र ताभ्यां समासाद्य गायमानो हरिं प्रभुम् /
ब्रह्मणा च महातेजाः पूजितो मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt:
having met with them there, singing of the lord Hari,
the best of sages, of great splendor, was worshipped by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ praṇamya mahātmānaṃ sarvalokapitāmaham /
cacāra ca yathākāmaṃ sarvalokeṣu nāradaḥ //
meaning:
तं प्रणम्य महात्मानं सर्वलोकपितामहम् /
चचार च यथाकामं सर्वलोकेषु नारदः //
text_mt:
Having bowed to that great soul, the Pitāmaha of all the worlds,
Nārada roamed at will through all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena mahatā gṛhaṃ prāpya ca tuṃbaroḥ /
vīṇāmādāya tatrastho hyagāyata mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
ततः कालेन महता गृहं प्राप्य च तुंबरोः /
वीणामादाय तत्रस्थो ह्यगायत महामुनिः //
text_mt:
Then after a long time, having reached the house of Tumburu,
the great sage, remaining there, took up his vīṇā and sang.

sanskrit_iast:
svarakalpāstu tatrasthāḥ ṣaḍjādyāḥ sapta vai matāḥ /
krīḍato bhagavāndṛṣṭvā nirgataśca susatvaram //
meaning:
स्वरकल्पास्तु तत्रस्थाः षड्जाद्याः सप्त वै मताः /
क्रीडतो भगवान्दृष्ट्वा निर्गतश्च सुसत्वरम् //
text_mt:
Present there were the personified forms of the notes, the seven regarded as beginning with ṣaḍja.
Seeing them playing, the venerable one departed in great haste.

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣayā māsa bahuśastatra tatra mahāmatiḥ /
śramayogena saṃyukto nāradopi mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
शिक्षया मास बहुशस्तत्र तत्र महामतिः /
श्रमयोगेन संयुक्तो नारदोपि महामुनिः //
text_mt:
The noble-minded one practiced extensively in various ways here and there.
Accompanied by exertion, the great sage Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
saptasvarāṅganāḥ paśyan gānavidyāviśāradaḥ /
āsīdvīṇā samāyoge na tāstantryaḥ prapedire //
meaning:
सप्तस्वराङ्गनाः पश्यन् गानविद्याविशारदः /
आसीद्वीणा समायोगे न तास्तन्त्र्यः प्रपेदिरे //
text_mt:
skilled in the art of music, beheld the maiden forms of the seven notes;
when he was occupied with the vīṇā, they did not resort to its strings.

sanskrit_iast:
tato ravaitake kṛṣṇaṃ praṇipatya mahāmuniḥ /
vijñāpayadaśeṣaṃ tu śvetadvīpe tu yat purā //
meaning:
ततो रवैतके कृष्णं प्रणिपत्य महामुनिः /
विज्ञापयदशेषं तु श्वेतद्वीपे तु यत् पुरा //
text_mt:
Then, having bowed to Kṛṣṇa at Mount Raivataka, the great sage
reported everything that had formerly been spoken in Śvetadvīpa

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇena kathitaṃ gānayogamanuttamam /
tacchrutvā prāhasankṛṣṇaḥ prāha jāṃbavatīṃ mudā //
meaning:
नारायणेन कथितं गानयोगमनुत्तमम् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा प्राहसन्कृष्णः प्राह जांबवतीं मुदा //
text_mt:
by Nārāyaṇa concerning the unsurpassed practice of singing.
Hearing that, Kṛṣṇa laughed and said with joy to Jāmbavatī:

sanskrit_iast:
etaṃ munivaraṃ bhadre śikṣayasva yathāvidhi /
vīṇāgāna samāyoge tathetyuktvā ca sā harim //
meaning:
एतं मुनिवरं भद्रे शिक्षयस्व यथाविधि /
वीणागान समायोगे तथेत्युक्त्वा च सा हरिम् //
text_mt:
“O auspicious lady, instruct this best of sages according to the rules
in the union of vīṇā and song.” Saying “So be it” to Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
prahasaṃtī yathāyogaṃ śikṣayāmāsa taṃ munim /
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe punarāgamya mādhavam //
meaning:
प्रहसंती यथायोगं शिक्षयामास तं मुनिम् /
ततः संवत्सरे पूर्णे पुनरागम्य माधवम् //
text_mt:
laughing, she instructed that sage as was fitting.
Then, when a full year had passed, having returned to Mādhava,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇipatyāgratastasthau punarāha sa keśavaḥ /
satyāṃ samīpamāgaccha śikṣayasva yathāvidhi //
meaning:
प्रणिपत्याग्रतस्तस्थौ पुनराह स केशवः /
सत्यां समीपमागच्छ शिक्षयस्व यथाविधि //
text_mt:
he bowed and stood before him; Keśava said to him again:
“Go to the presence of Satyā; let her instruct you according to the rules.”

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā satyabhāmāṃ praṇipatyajagau muniḥ /
tayā sa sikṣito vidvān pūrṇe saṃvatsare punaḥ //
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा सत्यभामां प्रणिपत्यजगौ मुनिः /
तया स सिक्षितो विद्वान् पूर्णे संवत्सरे पुनः //
text_mt:
Saying “So be it,” the sage bowed to Satyabhāmā and sang.
Taught by her, the learned one, when a year was completed again,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevamiyukto 'sau rukmiṇīsadanaṃ gataḥ /
aṅganābhistatastābhirdāsībhirmunisattamaḥ //
meaning:
वासुदेवमियुक्तो ऽसौ रुक्मिणीसदनं गतः /
अङ्गनाभिस्ततस्ताभिर्दासीभिर्मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt:
sent by Vāsudeva, went to the palace of Rukmiṇī.
Then that best of sages was addressed by those women, the maidservants:

sanskrit_iast:
ukto 'sau gāyamānopi na svaraṃ vetsi vai mune /
tataḥ śrameṇa mahatā vatsaratrayasaṃyutam //
meaning:
उक्तो ऽसौ गायमानोपि न स्वरं वेत्सि वै मुने /
ततः श्रमेण महता वत्सरत्रयसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
“Even though singing, O sage, you do not know the correct pitch!”
Then, with great effort through a period of three years,

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣitosau tadā devyā rukmiṇyāpi jagau muniḥ /
tataḥ svarāṅganāḥ prāpyaḥ tantrīyogaṃ mahāmuneḥ //
meaning:
शिक्षितोसौ तदा देव्या रुक्मिण्यापि जगौ मुनिः /
ततः स्वराङ्गनाः प्राप्यः तन्त्रीयोगं महामुनेः //
text_mt:
he was instructed by Queen Rukmiṇī as well, and the sage sang.
Then the maidens of the notes resorted to the strings of the great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya kṛṣṇo bhagavān svayameva mahāmunim /
aśikṣayadameyātmā gānayogamanuttamam //
meaning:
आहूय कृष्णो भगवान् स्वयमेव महामुनिम् /
अशिक्षयदमेयात्मा गानयोगमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Calling the great sage himself, the venerable Kṛṣṇa,
of immeasurable soul, instructed him in the unsurpassed practice of singing.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'tiśayamāpannastuṃbarormunisattamaḥ /
tato nanarta devarṣiḥ praṇipatya janārdanam //
meaning:
ततो ऽतिशयमापन्नस्तुंबरोर्मुनिसत्तमः /
ततो ननर्त देवर्षिः प्रणिपत्य जनार्दनम् //
text_mt:
Then the best of sages attained superiority over Tumburu.
Then, having bowed down to Janārdana, the divine sage danced.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca hṛṣīkeśaḥ sarvajñastvaṃ mahāmune /
prahasya gānayogena gāyasva mama sannidhau //
meaning:
उवाच च हृषीकेशः सर्वज्ञस्त्वं महामुने /
प्रहस्य गानयोगेन गायस्व मम सन्निधौ //
text_mt: And Hṛṣīkeśa smiled and said: “O great sage, you are all-knowing. / Sing in my presence through the yoga of song.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte prārthitaṃ prāptaṃ mama loke tathaiva ca /
nityaṃ tuṃbaruṇā sārdhaṃ gāyasva ca yathātatham //
meaning:
एतत्ते प्रार्थितं प्राप्तं मम लोके तथैव च /
नित्यं तुंबरुणा सार्धं गायस्व च यथातथम् //
text_mt: What you prayed for has been obtained, and so it shall be in my world. / Sing constantly together with Tumburu according to the proper rules.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto munistatra yathāyogaṃ cacāra saḥ /
yadā saṃpūjayan kṛṣṇo rudraṃ bhuvananāyakam //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो मुनिस्तत्र यथायोगं चचार सः /
यदा संपूजयन् कृष्णो रुद्रं भुवननायकम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus, the sage wandered there according to yoga. / Whenever Kṛṣṇa worshipped Rudra, the lord of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā jagai harestasya niyogācchaṅkarāya vai /
rukmiṇyā saha satyā ca jāṃbavatyā mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
तदा जगै हरेस्तस्य नियोगाच्छङ्कराय वै /
रुक्मिण्या सह सत्या च जांबवत्या महामुनिः //
text_mt: then, by the command of Hari, the great sage sang indeed for Śaṅkara / together with Rukmiṇī, Satyā, and Jāmbavatī,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇena ca nṛpaśreṣṭha śrutijātiviśāradaḥ /
eṣa vo muniśārdūlāḥ prokto gītakramo muneḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णेन च नृपश्रेष्ठ श्रुतिजातिविशारदः /
एष वो मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रोक्तो गीतक्रमो मुनेः //
text_mt: and with Kṛṣṇa, O best of kings, as one skilled in the musical notes and types. / O tigers among sages, this order of the sage’s singing has been declared to you.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo vāsudevākhyāṃ gāyamāno bhṛśaṃ nṛpa /
hareḥ sālokyamāpnoti rudragāno 'dhiko bhavet //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो वासुदेवाख्यां गायमानो भृशं नृप /
हरेः सालोक्यमाप्नोति रुद्रगानो ऽधिको भवेत् //
text_mt: A Brahmin constantly singing the names of Vāsudeva, O king, / attains dwelling in the same world with Hari; singing of Rudra would be even greater.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā narakaṃ gacchedgāyamānonyadeva hi /
karmaṇā manasā vācā vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यथा नरकं गच्छेद्गायमानोन्यदेव हि /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा वासुदेवपरायणः //
text_mt: Otherwise, singing of any other god, one would go to hell. / Devoted in action, mind, and speech to Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyan śṛṇvaṃstamāpnoti tasmādgeyaṃ paraṃ viduḥ //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge vaiṣṇavagītakathanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
गायन् शृण्वंस्तमाप्नोति तस्माद्गेयं परं विदुः //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे वैष्णवगीतकथनं नाम तृतीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
singing and hearing, one attains him; therefore they know singing to be supreme.

Thus ends the third chapter, named ‘The Account of the Vaiṣṇava Song’, in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vaiṣṇavā iti ye proktā vāsudevaparāyaṇāḥ /
kāni cihnāni teṣāṃ vai tanno brahi mahāmate //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
वैष्णवा इति ये प्रोक्ता वासुदेवपरायणाः /
कानि चिह्नानि तेषां वै तन्नो ब्रहि महामते //
text_mt: The sages said: / Those who are called Vaiṣṇavas, devoted to Vāsudeva— / what indeed are their signs? Tell us that, O noble-minded one.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ vā kiṃ karotyeṣa bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ /
etanme sarvamācakṣva sūta sarvārthavittama //
meaning:
तेषां वा किं करोत्येष भगवान् भूतभावनः /
एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व सूत सर्वार्थवित्तम //
text_mt: Or what does this lord, the creator of beings, do for them? / Tell me all this, O Sūta, best of those who know all subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
aṃbarīṣeṇa vai pṛṣṭo mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purāmuniḥ /
yuṣmabhiradya yat proktaṃ tadvadāmi yathātatham //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अंबरीषेण वै पृष्टो मार्कण्डेयः पुरामुनिः /
युष्मभिरद्य यत् प्रोक्तं तद्वदामि यथातथम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Formerly the sage Mārkaṇḍeya was asked indeed by Ambarīṣa. / What has been asked by you today, that I shall declare according to the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
śṛṇu rājanyathānyāyaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi /
yatrāste viṣṇubhaktastu tatra nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
शृणु राजन्यथान्यायं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि /
यत्रास्ते विष्णुभक्तस्तु तत्र नारायणः स्थितः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hear properly, O king, what you ask of me. / Where a devotee of Viṣṇu resides, there Nārāyaṇa is present.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇureva hi sarvatra yeṣāṃ vai devatā smṛtā /
kīrtyamāne harau nityaṃ romāñco yasya vartate //
meaning:
विष्णुरेव हि सर्वत्र येषां वै देवता स्मृता /
कीर्त्यमाने हरौ नित्यं रोमाञ्चो यस्य वर्तते //
text_mt: For those whose deity is indeed Viṣṇu alone everywhere, / when Hari is constantly praised, he who has horripilation,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃpaḥ svedastathakṣeṣu dṛsyante jalabindavaḥ /
viṣṇubhaktisamāyuktān śrautasmārtapravartakān //
meaning:
कंपः स्वेदस्तथक्षेषु दृस्यन्ते जलबिन्दवः /
विष्णुभक्तिसमायुक्तान् श्रौतस्मार्तप्रवर्तकान् //
text_mt: trembling, perspiration, and drops of water seen in his eyes, / who is delighted upon seeing those endowed with devotion to Viṣṇu

sanskrit_iast:
prīto bhavati yo dṛṣṭvā vaiṣṇavo 'sau prakīrtitaḥ /
nānyadācchādayedvastraṃ vaiṣṇavo jagato 'raṇe //
meaning:
प्रीतो भवति यो दृष्ट्वा वैष्णवो ऽसौ प्रकीर्तितः /
नान्यदाच्छादयेद्वस्त्रं वैष्णवो जगतो ऽरणे //
text_mt: and promoting Śrauta and Smārta practices—he is celebrated as a Vaiṣṇava. / A Vaiṣṇava should cover himself with no other garment in the forest of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktamathāyāntaṃ yo dṛṣṭvā sanmukhasthitaḥ /
praṇāmādi karotyevaṃ vāsudeve yathā tathā //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तमथायान्तं यो दृष्ट्वा सन्मुखस्थितः /
प्रणामादि करोत्येवं वासुदेवे यथा तथा //
text_mt: He who, having seen a devotee of Viṣṇu approaching, stands facing him / and offers obeisance and the like, just as [he would] to Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai bhakta iti jñeyaḥ sa jayī syājjagattraye /
rūkṣākṣarāṇi śṛṇvanvai tathā bhāgavateritaḥ //
meaning:
स वै भक्त इति ज्ञेयः स जयी स्याज्जगत्त्रये /
रूक्षाक्षराणि शृण्वन्वै तथा भागवतेरितः //
text_mt: he indeed is to be known as a devotee; he will be victorious in the three worlds. / Even hearing harsh words spoken by another devotee,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmapūrvaṃ kṣāntyā vai yo vadedvaiṣṇavo hi saḥ /
gandhapuṣpādi kaṃ sarvaṃ śirasā yo hi dhārayet //
meaning:
प्रणामपूर्वं क्षान्त्या वै यो वदेद्वैष्णवो हि सः /
गन्धपुष्पादि कं सर्वं शिरसा यो हि धारयेत् //
text_mt: he who speaks with patience, preceded by a bow, is indeed a Vaiṣṇava. / He who bears on his head all things such as perfumes and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
hareḥ sarvamitītyevaṃ mattvāsau vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ /
viṣṇukṣetre śubhānyeva karoti snehasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
हरेः सर्वमितीत्येवं मत्त्वासौ वैष्णवः स्मृतः /
विष्णुक्षेत्रे शुभान्येव करोति स्नेहसंयुतः //
text_mt: considering, ‘All this belongs to Hari’—he is remembered as a Vaiṣṇava. / In a sacred place of Viṣṇu, he performs only auspicious acts, endowed with love.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāṃ ca harernityaṃ pūjayetprayatātmavān /
viṣṇubhaktaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ karmaṇā manasā girā //
meaning:
प्रतिमां च हरेर्नित्यं पूजयेत्प्रयतात्मवान् /
विष्णुभक्तः स विज्ञेयः कर्मणा मनसा गिरा //
text_mt: And he who, with a self-restrained mind, constantly worships the image of Hari / in action, mind, and speech—he is to be recognized as a devotee of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaparo nityaṃ mahābhāgavato hi saḥ /
bhojanārādhanaṃ sarvaṃ yathāśaktyā karoti yaḥ //
meaning:
नारायणपरो नित्यं महाभागवतो हि सः /
भोजनाराधनं सर्वं यथाशक्त्या करोति यः //
text_mt: Always devoted to Nārāyaṇa, he is indeed a great Bhāgavata. / He who, to the best of his ability, provides food and honors

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktasya ca sadā yathānyāyaṃ hi kathyate /
nārāyaṇaparo vidvānyasyānnaṃ prītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तस्य च सदा यथान्यायं हि कथ्यते /
नारायणपरो विद्वान्यस्यान्नं प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt: constantly to a devotee of Viṣṇu, is rightly described [thus]: / That food which a wise person devoted to Nārāyaṇa eats with a delighted mind

sanskrit_iast:
aśrāti taddharerāsyaṃ gatamannaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
svārcanādapi viśvātmā prīto bhavati mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
अश्राति तद्धरेरास्यं गतमन्नं न संशयः /
स्वार्चनादपि विश्वात्मा प्रीतो भवति माधवः //
text_mt: has entered Hari's mouth—there is no doubt about this. / Even more than by worship of himself, Mādhava, the Soul of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhāgavate tacca dṛṣṭvāsau bhaktavatsalaḥ /
vāsudevaparaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaiṣṇavaṃ dagdhakilbiṣam //
meaning:
महाभागवते तच्च दृष्ट्वासौ भक्तवत्सलः /
वासुदेवपरं दृष्ट्वा वैष्णवं दग्धकिल्बिषम् //
text_mt: is pleased when he sees that done toward a great Bhāgavata, being affectionate toward his devotees. / Seeing a Vaiṣṇava whose sins are burned away and who is devoted to Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
devāpi bhītāstaṃ yānti praṇipatya yathāgatam /
śrūyatāṃ hi purāvṛttaṃ viṣṇubhaktasya vaibhavam //
meaning:
देवापि भीतास्तं यान्ति प्रणिपत्य यथागतम् /
श्रूयतां हि पुरावृत्तं विष्णुभक्तस्य वैभवम् //
text_mt: even the gods depart in fear, having bowed to him just as they came. / Hear indeed the ancient event showing the power of a devotee of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā yamo 'pi vai bhaktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dagdhakilbiṣam /
utthāya prāñjalirbhūtvā nanāma bhṛgunandanam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा यमो ऽपि वै भक्तं वैष्णवं दग्धकिल्बिषम् /
उत्थाय प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा ननाम भृगुनन्दनम् //
text_mt: Having seen the Vaiṣṇava devotee whose sins were burned away, even Yama / rose up with folded hands and bowed to that descendant of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaṃpūjayedbhaktyā vaiṣṇavānviṣṇuvannaraḥ /
sa yāti viṣṇusāmīpya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
तस्मात्संपूजयेद्भक्त्या वैष्णवान्विष्णुवन्नरः /
स याति विष्णुसामीप्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Therefore, a person should worship Vaiṣṇavas with devotion as if they were Viṣṇu. / He goes to the proximity of Viṣṇu; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
anyabhaktasahasrebhyo viṣṇubhakto viśiṣyate /
viṣṇubhaktasahasrebhyo rudrabhakto viśiṣyate /
rudrabhaktātparataro nāstiloke na saśaṃyaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यभक्तसहस्रेभ्यो विष्णुभक्तो विशिष्यते /
विष्णुभक्तसहस्रेभ्यो रुद्रभक्तो विशिष्यते /
रुद्रभक्तात्परतरो नास्तिलोके न सशंयः //
text_mt: A devotee of Viṣṇu is distinguished above thousands of devotees of others; / a devotee of Rudra is distinguished above thousands of devotees of Viṣṇu; / there is none higher in the world than a devotee of Rudra—there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttu vaiṣṇavaṃ cāpi rudrabhaktamathāpi vā /
pūjayetsarvayatnena dharmakāmārthamuktaye //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge viṣṇubhaktakathanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तस्मात्तु वैष्णवं चापि रुद्रभक्तमथापि वा /
पूजयेत्सर्वयत्नेन धर्मकामार्थमुक्तये //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे विष्णुभक्तकथनं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Therefore, one should worship with every effort a Vaiṣṇava or a devotee of Rudra / for the attainment of righteousness, pleasure, wealth, and liberation.

Thus ends the fourth chapter, named ‘The Account of the Devotees of Viṣṇu’, in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
aikṣvākuraṃbarīṣo vai vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ /
pālayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ viṣṇorājñāpuraḥ saraḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
ऐक्ष्वाकुरंबरीषो वै वासुदेवपरायणः /
पालयामास पृथिवीं विष्णोराज्ञापुरः सरः //
text_mt: The sages said: / Ambarīṣa of the Ikṣvāku dynasty, devoted to Vāsudeva, / protected the earth, keeping Viṣṇu's command before him.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutametanmahābuddhe tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi /
nityaṃ tasya hareścakraṃ śatrurogabhayādikam //
meaning:
श्रुतमेतन्महाबुद्धे तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि /
नित्यं तस्य हरेश्चक्रं शत्रुरोगभयादिकम् //
text_mt: This has been heard by us, O one of great intellect; you should relate all of that. / It is heard in the world that Hari's discus constantly destroys

sanskrit_iast:
hantīti śrūyate loke dhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ /
aṃbarīṣasya caritaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi sattama //
meaning:
हन्तीति श्रूयते लोके धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः /
अंबरीषस्य चरितं तत्सर्वं ब्रूहि सत्तम //
text_mt: the enemies, diseases, fears, and other troubles of that righteous, great-souled one. / Tell all that deed of Ambarīṣa, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
māhātmyamanubhāvaṃ ca bhaktiyogamanuttamam /
yathāvacchrotumicchāmaḥ sūta vaktuṃ tvamarhasi //
meaning:
माहात्म्यमनुभावं च भक्तियोगमनुत्तमम् /
यथावच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामः सूत वक्तुं त्वमर्हसि //
text_mt: his majesty, power, and unexcelled yoga of devotion. / We wish to hear it as it was; O Sūta, you should tell it.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrūyatāṃ muniśārdūlāścaritaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ /
aṃbarīṣasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रूयतां मुनिशार्दूलाश्चरितं तस्य धीमतः /
अंबरीषस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वपापहरं परम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Tigers among sages, hear the deed of that wise one, / the supreme majesty of Ambarīṣa, which removes all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
triśaṅkordayitā bhāryā sarvalakṣaṇaśobhitā /
aṃbarīṣasya jananī nityaṃ śaucasamanvitā //
meaning:
त्रिशङ्कोर्दयिता भार्या सर्वलक्षणशोभिता /
अंबरीषस्य जननी नित्यं शौचसमन्विता //
text_mt: The beloved wife of Triśaṅku, adorned with all auspicious marks, / the mother of Ambarīṣa, was constantly endowed with purity.

sanskrit_iast:
yoganidrāsamārūḍhaṃ śeṣaparyaṅkaśāyinam /
nārāyaṇaṃ mahātmānaṃ brahmāṇḍakamalodbhavam //
meaning:
योगनिद्रासमारूढं शेषपर्यङ्कशायिनम् /
नारायणं महात्मानं ब्रह्माण्डकमलोद्भवम् //
text_mt: To great-souled Nārāyaṇa, who has ascended yogic sleep, who lies on the couch of Śeṣa, / who is born from the cosmic egg as a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
tamasā kālarudrākhyaṃ rajasā kanakāṇḍajam /
sattvena sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam //
meaning:
तमसा कालरुद्राख्यं रजसा कनकाण्डजम् /
सत्त्वेन सर्वगं विष्णुं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: who is named Kālarudra through tamas, born from the golden egg through rajas, / and all-pervading Viṣṇu through sattva, bowed to by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayāmāma satataṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmabhiḥ /
mālyadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ svayamevamacīkarat //
meaning:
अर्चयामाम सततं वाङ्मनः कायकर्मभिः /
माल्यदानादिकं सर्वं स्वयमेवमचीकरत् //
text_mt: she constantly offered worship through acts of speech, mind, and body. / She performed all [services] such as the offering of garlands entirely by herself:

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādiṣeṣaṇaṃ caiva dhūpadravyādikaṃ tathā /
bhūmerālepanādīni haviṣāṃ pacanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
गन्धादिषेषणं चैव धूपद्रव्यादिकं तथा /
भूमेरालेपनादीनि हविषां पचनं तथा //
text_mt: the grinding of sandalwood and other perfumes, the incense materials and the like, / the plastering of the floor and the like, as well as the cooking of sacrificial offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkautukasamāviṣṭā svayameva cakāra sā /
śubhā padmāvatī nityaṃ vācā nārāyaṇeti vai //
meaning:
तत्कौतुकसमाविष्टा स्वयमेव चकार सा /
शुभा पद्मावती नित्यं वाचा नारायणेति वै //
text_mt: Seized by joy in that, she did it all by herself. / Auspicious Padmāvatī constantly uttered the word ‘Nārāyaṇa’,

sanskrit_iast:
anantetyeva sā nityaṃ bhāṣamāṇā pativratā /
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tatpareṇāntarātmanā //
meaning:
अनन्तेत्येव सा नित्यं भाषमाणा पतिव्रता /
दशवर्षसहस्राणि तत्परेणान्तरात्मना //
text_mt: and saying ‘Ananta!’ constantly, that devoted wife, / for ten thousand years, with her inner soul devoted to him,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayāmāsa govindaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ śuciḥ /
viṣṇubhaktānmahābhāgān sarvapāpavivarjitān //
meaning:
अर्चयामास गोविन्दं गन्धपुष्पादिभिः शुचिः /
विष्णुभक्तान्महाभागान् सर्वपापविवर्जितान् //
text_mt: pure, worshipped Govinda with perfumes, flowers, and the like. / The fortunate devotees of Viṣṇu, freed from all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
dānamānārcanairnityaṃ dhanaratnairatoṣayat /
tataḥ kadācitsā devī dvādaśīṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
दानमानार्चनैर्नित्यं धनरत्नैरतोषयत् /
ततः कदाचित्सा देवी द्वादशीं समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: she constantly satisfied with gifts, honors, and worship, and with wealth and jewels. / Then once, having fasted on the twelfth day,

sanskrit_iast:
hareragre mahābhāgā suṣvāpa patinā saha /
tatra nārāyaṇo devastāmāha puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
हरेरग्रे महाभागा सुष्वाप पतिना सह /
तत्र नारायणो देवस्तामाह पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: that fortunate lady slept with her husband in front of Hari. / There the god Nārāyaṇa, the Supreme Puruṣa, said to her:

sanskrit_iast:
kim icchasi varaṃ bhadre mattas tvam brūhi bhāmini /
sā dṛṣṭvā tu varaṃ vavre putro me vaiṣṇavo bhavet //
meaning:
किम् इच्छसि वरं भद्रे मत्तस् त्वम् ब्रूहि भामिनि /
सा दृष्ट्वा तु वरं वव्रे पुत्रो मे वैष्णवो भवेत् //
text_mt: “What boon do you desire from me, gentle lady? Tell me, fair one.” / Seeing [him], she chose a boon: “May my son be a Vaiṣṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
sārvabhaumo mahātejāḥ svakarmanirataḥ śuciḥ /
tathetyuktvā dadau tasyai phalam ekaṃ janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
सार्वभौमो महातेजाः स्वकर्मनिरतः शुचिः /
तथेत्युक्त्वा ददौ तस्यै फलम् एकं जनार्दनः //
text_mt: a universal emperor of great splendor, devoted to his duty, and pure.” / Saying “So be it,” Janārdana gave her a single fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
sā prabuddhā phalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhartre sarvaṃ nyavedayat /
bhakṣayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭā phalaṃ tadgatamānasā //
meaning:
सा प्रबुद्धा फलं दृष्ट्वा भर्त्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत् /
भक्षयामास संहृष्टा फलं तद्गतमानसा //
text_mt: Awakening and seeing the fruit, she reported everything to her husband. / Rejoicing, her mind set on him, she ate the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena sā devī putraṃ kulavivardhanam /
asūta sā sadācāraṃ vāsudevaparāyaṇam //
meaning:
ततः कालेन सा देवी पुत्रं कुलविवर्धनम् /
असूत सा सदाचारं वासुदेवपरायणम् //
text_mt: Then in due time that noble lady gave birth to a son who increased the lineage, / who was of virtuous conduct and devoted to Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ cakraāṅkitatanūruham /
jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā putraṃ kriyāḥ sarvāścakāra vai //
meaning:
शुभलक्षणसंपन्नं चक्रआङ्किततनूरुहम् /
जातं दृष्ट्वा पिता पुत्रं क्रियाः सर्वाश्चकार वै //
text_mt: endowed with auspicious marks, the hair on his body marked with discus-signs. / Seeing the son born, the father performed indeed all the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbarīṣa iti khyāto loke samabhavatprabhuḥ /
pitaryuparate śrīmānabhiṣikto mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
अंबरीष इति ख्यातो लोके समभवत्प्रभुः /
पितर्युपरते श्रीमानभिषिक्तो महामुनिः //
text_mt: He became the lord renowned in the world as Ambarīṣa. / When his father passed away, the illustrious great sage was consecrated [as king].

sanskrit_iast:
mantriṣvādhāya rājyaṃ ca tapa ugrañcakāra saḥ /
saṃvatsarasahasraṃ vai japannārāyaṇaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
मन्त्रिष्वाधाय राज्यं च तप उग्रञ्चकार सः /
संवत्सरसहस्रं वै जपन्नारायणं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Having entrusted the kingdom to his ministers, he performed fierce asceticism, / repeating the name of the lord Nārāyaṇa for a thousand years,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhyasthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalamadhyataḥ /
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhārayantaṃ caturbhujam //
meaning:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्यस्थं सूर्यमण्डलमध्यतः /
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधारयन्तं चतुर्भुजम् //
text_mt: [meditating on him] seated in the middle of the heart-lotus, in the midst of the sun's orb, / holding the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, four-armed,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhajāṃbūnadanibhaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam /
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
शुद्धजांबूनदनिभं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकम् /
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तं पीतांबरधरं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: resembling pure gold, the embodiment of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / adorned with all ornaments, wearing yellow garments, the lord,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ puruṣaṃ puruṣottamam /
tato garuḍamāruhya sarvadevairabhiṣṭutaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं पुरुषं पुरुषोत्तमम् /
ततो गरुडमारुह्य सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतः //
text_mt: the god with the śrīvatsa on his chest, the Puruṣa, the Supreme Puruṣa. / Then, mounting Garuḍa and praised by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāma sa viśvātmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ /
airāvatamivācintyaṃ kṛtvā vai garuḍaṃhariḥ //
meaning:
आजगाम स विश्वात्मा सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः /
ऐरावतमिवाचिन्त्यं कृत्वा वै गरुडंहरिः //
text_mt: that Self of all, bowed to by all the worlds, arrived, / Hari having indeed made Garuḍa like the inconceivable Airāvata.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ śakra ivāsīnastamāha nṛpasattamam /
indro 'hamasmi bhadraṃ te kiṃ dadāmi varaṃ ca te //
meaning:
स्वयं शक्र इवासीनस्तमाह नृपसत्तमम् /
इन्द्रो ऽहमस्मि भद्रं ते किं ददामि वरं च ते //
text_mt: Seated like Śakra himself, he said to that best of kings: / “I am Indra. May good fortune be yours! What boon shall I grant you?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokeśvaro 'haṃ tvāṃrakṣituṃ samupāgataḥ /
aṃbarīṣa uvāca
nāhaṃ tvamābhisaṃdhāya tapa āsthitavāniha //
meaning:
सर्वलोकेश्वरो ऽहं त्वांरक्षितुं समुपागतः /
अंबरीष उवाच
नाहं त्वमाभिसंधाय तप आस्थितवानिह //
text_mt: I, the lord of all worlds, have come to protect you.” / Ambarīṣa said: / “Not aiming at you have I undertaken asceticism here.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā dattaṃ ca neṣyāmi gaccha śakra yathāsukham /
mama nārāyaṇo nāthastaṃ nāmāmi jagatpatim //
meaning:
त्वया दत्तं च नेष्यामि गच्छ शक्र यथासुखम् /
मम नारायणो नाथस्तं नामामि जगत्पतिम् //
text_mt: Nor will I accept what is given by you; go at your pleasure, Śakra. / Nārāyaṇa is my master; to him, the Lord of the world, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchedra mākṛthāstvatra mama buddhivilopanam /
tataḥ prahasya bhagavān svarūpamakarodvarīḥ //
meaning:
गच्छेद्र माकृथास्त्वत्र मम बुद्धिविलोपनम् /
ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् स्वरूपमकरोद्वरीः //
text_mt: Go, Indra, do not cause the distraction of my intellect here!” / Then, laughing, the Lord assumed his own form, Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgacakragadāpāṇiḥ khaṅgahasto janārdanaḥ /
garuḍopari sarvātmā nīlācala ivāparaḥ //
meaning:
शार्ङ्गचक्रगदापाणिः खङ्गहस्तो जनार्दनः /
गरुडोपरि सर्वात्मा नीलाचल इवापरः //
text_mt: with bow, discus, and mace in his hand, a sword in his hand, Janārdana, / atop Garuḍa, the Self of all, like another blue mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
devagandharvasaṃghaiśca stūyamānaḥ samantataḥ /
praṇamya sa ca saṃtuṣṭastuṣṭāva garuḍadhvajam //
meaning:
देवगन्धर्वसंघैश्च स्तूयमानः समन्ततः /
प्रणम्य स च संतुष्टस्तुष्टाव गरुडध्वजम् //
text_mt: praised on all sides by the hosts of gods and Gandharvas. / Bowing down, gratified, he praised the one whose banner is Garuḍa:

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda lokanātheśa mama nātha janārdana /
kṛṣṇa viṣṇo jagannātha sarvalokanamaskṛta //
meaning:
प्रसीद लोकनाथेश मम नाथ जनार्दन /
कृष्ण विष्णो जगन्नाथ सर्वलोकनमस्कृत //
text_mt: “Be pleased, O Lord and Master of the world, my protector, Janārdana! / O Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, Lord of the world, saluted by all worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamādistvamanādistvamanantaḥ pūruṣaḥ prabhuḥ /
aprameyo vibhurviṣṇurgovindaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
त्वमादिस्त्वमनादिस्त्वमनन्तः पूरुषः प्रभुः /
अप्रमेयो विभुर्विष्णुर्गोविन्दः कमलेक्षणः //
text_mt: You are the beginning, you are beginningless, you are the endless Puruṣa, the Lord, / immeasurable, the omnipresent Viṣṇu, Govinda, lotus-eyed!

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvarāṅgajo madhye puṣkaraḥ khagamaḥ khagaḥ /
kavyavāhaḥ kapālī tvaṃ havyavāhaḥ prabhañjanaḥ //
meaning:
महेश्वराङ्गजो मध्ये पुष्करः खगमः खगः /
कव्यवाहः कपाली त्वं हव्यवाहः प्रभञ्जनः //
text_mt: You are born of Maheśvara's body; in the middle, you are Puṣkara, the bird, the traverser of the sky, / the bearer of the ancestral offering, Kapālin, the bearer of the sacrificial oblation, the shatterer [wind].

sanskrit_iast:
ādidevaḥ kriyānandaḥ paramātmātmanī sthitaḥ /
tvāṃ prapannosmigovinda jaya devakinandana /
jaya deva jagannātha pāhi māṃ puṣkarekṣaṇa //
meaning:
आदिदेवः क्रियानन्दः परमात्मात्मनी स्थितः /
त्वां प्रपन्नोस्मिगोविन्द जय देवकिनन्दन /
जय देव जगन्नाथ पाहि मां पुष्करेक्षण //
text_mt: The primal god, bliss of action, Supreme Self situated in the self! / I have taken refuge in you, Govinda! Victory, O son of Devakī! / Victory, O God, Lord of the world! Protect me, O lotus-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
nānyā gatistvadanyā me tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama /
sūta uvāca
tamāha bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kiṃ te hṛdi cikīrṣitam //
meaning:
नान्या गतिस्त्वदन्या मे त्वमेव शरणं मम /
सूत उवाच
तमाह भगवान्विष्णुः किं ते हृदि चिकीर्षितम् //
text_mt: I have no other resort than you; you alone are my refuge.” / Sūta said: / The blessed Viṣṇu said to him: “What is desired in your heart?

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ te pradāsyāmi bhaktosi mama suvrata /
bhaktipriyo 'haṃ satataṃ tasmāddātumihāgataḥ //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं ते प्रदास्यामि भक्तोसि मम सुव्रत /
भक्तिप्रियो ऽहं सततं तस्माद्दातुमिहागतः //
text_mt: All that I will grant you; you are my devotee, O one of good vows. / I am always fond of devotion; therefore have I come here to give.”

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbarīṣa uvāca
lokanātha parānanda nityaṃ me vartate matiḥ /
vāsudevaparo nityaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
अंबरीष उवाच
लोकनाथ परानन्द नित्यं मे वर्तते मतिः /
वासुदेवपरो नित्यं वाङ्मनः कायकर्मभिः //
text_mt: Ambarīṣa said: / “O Lord of the world, supreme bliss, my mind is constantly turned / devoted to Vāsudeva always in speech, mind, and bodily actions.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tvaṃ devadevasya bhavasya paramātmanaḥ /
tathā bhavāmyahaṃ viṣṇo tava deva janārdana //
meaning:
यथा त्वं देवदेवस्य भवस्य परमात्मनः /
तथा भवाम्यहं विष्णो तव देव जनार्दन //
text_mt: Just as you are devoted to Bhava, the God of gods, the Supreme Self, / so may I be devoted to you, O God Viṣṇu, Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
pāliyiṣyāmi pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā vai vaiṣṇavaṃ jagat /
yajñahomārcanaiścaiva tarpayāmi surottamān //
meaning:
पालियिष्यामि पृथिवीं कृत्वा वै वैष्णवं जगत् /
यज्ञहोमार्चनैश्चैव तर्पयामि सुरोत्तमान् //
text_mt: I will protect the earth, having made the world dedicated to Viṣṇu; / and with sacrifices, oblations, and worship I will satisfy the best of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavānpālayiṣyāmi nihaniṣyāmi śātravān /
lokatāpabhaye bhīta iti me dhīyate matiḥ //
meaning:
वैष्णवान्पालयिष्यामि निहनिष्यामि शात्रवान् /
लोकतापभये भीत इति मे धीयते मतिः //
text_mt: I will protect the Vaiṣṇavas and destroy their enemies. / Afraid of the fear of worldly torment, such is the purpose fixed in my mind.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
evamastu yathecchaṃ vai cakrametatsudarśanam /
purā rudraprasādena labdhaṃ vai durlabhaṃ mayā //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
एवमस्तु यथेच्छं वै चक्रमेतत्सुदर्शनम् /
पुरा रुद्रप्रसादेन लब्धं वै दुर्लभं मया //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / “So be it, according to your desire! This discus Sudarśana, / which was obtained by me formerly through Rudra's grace, hard to obtain,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiśāpādikaṃ duḥkhaṃ śatrurogādikaṃ tathā /
nihaniṣyati te nityamityuktvāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
ऋषिशापादिकं दुःखं शत्रुरोगादिकं तथा /
निहनिष्यति ते नित्यमित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: will constantly destroy for you the misery of sages' curses and the like, as well as enemies, diseases, and such.” / Having spoken thus, he vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tataḥ praṇamya mudito rājā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum /
praviśya nagarīṃ ramyāmayodhyāṃ paryapālayat //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ततः प्रणम्य मुदितो राजा नारायणं प्रभुम् /
प्रविश्य नगरीं रम्यामयोध्यां पर्यपालयत् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Then, having bowed down in joy to the lord Nārāyaṇa, / the king entered the charming city of Ayodhyā and ruled it.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādīṃśca varṇāṃśca svasvakarmaṇy ayojayat /
nārāyaṇaparo nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktānakalmaṣān //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणादींश्च वर्णांश्च स्वस्वकर्मण्य् अयोजयत् /
नारायणपरो नित्यं विष्णुभक्तानकल्मषान् //
text_mt: He engaged the brāhmaṇas and other castes in their respective duties; / constantly devoted to Nārāyaṇa, [he protected] the spotless devotees of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pālayāmāsa hṛṣṭātmā viśeṣeṇa janādhipaḥ /
aśvamedhaśatairiṣṭvā vājapeyaśatena ca //
meaning:
पालयामास हृष्टात्मा विशेषेण जनाधिपः /
अश्वमेधशतैरिष्ट्वा वाजपेयशतेन च //
text_mt: Gladdened in soul, the lord of men protected them especially. / Having performed sacrifices with a hundred horse-sacrifices and a hundred vājapeya rites,

sanskrit_iast:
pālayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ sāgarāvaraṇāmimām /
gṛhegṛhe haristasthau vedaghoṣo gṛhegṛhe //
meaning:
पालयामास पृथिवीं सागरावरणामिमाम् /
गृहेगृहे हरिस्तस्थौ वेदघोषो गृहेगृहे //
text_mt: he protected this earth enclosed by the oceans. / In every house stood Hari; in every house was the sound of the Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
nāmaghoṣo hareścaiva yajñaghoṣastathaiva ca /
