vaiśyānāmapi yogyānāṃ yatīnāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ /
vānaprasthāśramasthānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ satāmapi //
meaning:
वैश्यानामपि योग्यानां यतीनां तु विशेषतः /
वानप्रस्थाश्रमस्थानां गृहस्थानां सतामपि //
text_mt: and also for eligible Vaiśyas, but especially for ascetics, / for those dwelling in the hermitage of forest-dwellers, and even for virtuous householders.

sanskrit_iast:
vimuktirvidhinānena dṛṣṭvā vai brahmacāriṇām /
agnirityādinā bhasma gṛhītvā hyagnihotrajam //
meaning:
विमुक्तिर्विधिनानेन दृष्ट्वा वै ब्रह्मचारिणाम् /
अग्निरित्यादिना भस्म गृहीत्वा ह्यग्निहोत्रजम् //
text_mt: Liberation for students of the Veda is indeed seen through this rite. / Taking sacred ash produced from the agnihotra with [the mantra] beginning with 'Agnir [iti bhasma]',

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi pāśupato vipro vimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśet /
bhasmācchanno dvijo vidvān mahāpātakasaṃbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि पाशुपतो विप्रो विमृज्याङ्गानि संस्पृशेत् /
भस्माच्छन्नो द्विजो विद्वान् महापातकसंभवैः //
text_mt: that Pāśupata vipra too should wipe his limbs and touch them. / A wise twice-born man covered in sacred ash is freed from sins

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaurvimucyate sadyo mucyate ca na saṃśayaḥ /
vīryamagreryato bhasma vīryavānbhasmasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
पापौर्विमुच्यते सद्यो मुच्यते च न संशयः /
वीर्यमग्रेर्यतो भस्म वीर्यवान्भस्मसंयुतः //
text_mt: arising from the great sins; he is immediately released, without a doubt. / Since sacred ash is the vigor of fire, one endowed with sacred ash is full of vigor.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmāsnānarato vipro bhasmaśāyī jitendriyaḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
भस्मास्नानरतो विप्रो भस्मशायी जितेन्द्रियः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa devoted to bathing in sacred ash, lying on sacred ash, with senses subdued, / freed from all sins, attains union with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhūtyaṅgaṃ pūjayedvudhaḥ /
rerekāro na kartavyastuntuṅkārastathaiva ca //
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन भूत्यङ्गं पूजयेद्वुधः /
रेरेकारो न कर्तव्यस्तुन्तुङ्कारस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Therefore, the wise person should worship the ash-covered body with every effort. / One should not utter disrespectful expressions like "hey you!" or contemptuous address.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatkṣamati deveśo brahmā vā yadi keśavaḥ /
mama putro bhasmadhārī gaṇeśaśca varānane //
meaning:
न तत्क्षमति देवेशो ब्रह्मा वा यदि केशवः /
मम पुत्रो भस्मधारी गणेशश्च वरानने //
text_mt: The Lord of gods, Brahmā, or Keśava will not tolerate that. / Even my son Gaṇeśa wears sacred ash, O lovely-faced lady!

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ viruddhaṃ yattyājyaṃ sa yāti narakārṇavam /
gṛhastho brahmahīnopi tripuṇḍraṃ yo na kārayet //
meaning:
तेषां विरुद्धं यत्त्याज्यं स याति नरकार्णवम् /
गृहस्थो ब्रह्महीनोपि त्रिपुण्ड्रं यो न कारयेत् //
text_mt: Whoever abandons [reverence] contrary to them goes to the ocean of hell. / Even if he is a householder bereft of Vedic knowledge, he who does not apply the tripuṇḍra,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā karma kriyā tasya dānaṃ snānaṃ tathaiva ca /
niṣphalaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ yathā bhasmani vai hutam //
meaning:
पूजा कर्म क्रिया तस्य दानं स्नानं तथैव च /
निष्फलं जायते सर्वं यथा भस्मनि वै हुतम् //
text_mt: his worship, ritual work, rite, charitable gift, and ablution as well— / all becomes fruitless, just like an oblation poured into dead ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca sarvakāryeṣu tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ /
ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā stutvā devaiḥ samaṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
तस्माच्च सर्वकार्येषु त्रिपुण्ड्रं धारयेद्बुधः /
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्ब्रह्मा स्तुत्वा देवैः समं प्रभुः //
text_mt: Therefore, the wise person should apply the tripuṇḍra in all rites." / Having spoken thus, Lord Brahmā, the master, along with the gods, praised [him],

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmācchannaiḥ svayaṃ channo virarāma viśāṃpate /
atha teṣāṃ prasādārthaṃ paśūnāṃ patirīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
भस्माच्छन्नैः स्वयं छन्नो विरराम विशांपते /
अथ तेषां प्रसादार्थं पशूनां पतिरीश्वरः //
text_mt: and, covered in sacred ash himself with those covered in sacred ash, he paused, O ruler of the people. / Then, to bestow grace upon them, the Lord, the master of bound souls,

sanskrit_iast:
sagamaścāṃbayā sārdhaṃ sānnidhyamakarotprabhuḥ /
atha saṃnihitaṃ rudraṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ surapuṅgavam //
meaning:
सगमश्चांबया सार्धं सान्निध्यमकरोत्प्रभुः /
अथ संनिहितं रुद्रं तुष्टुवुः सुरपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt: the Lord manifested his presence along with the Mother. / Then they praised Rudra, who had drawn near, the pre-eminent among the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrādhyāyena sarveśaṃ devadeva mumāpatim /
devopi devānālokya ghṛṇayā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्राध्यायेन सर्वेशं देवदेव मुमापतिम् /
देवोपि देवानालोक्य घृणया वृषभध्वजः //
text_mt: the Lord of all, the God of gods, the husband of Umā, with the Rudrādhyāya. / And the God, Vṛṣabhadhvaja, beholding the gods with compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭosmītyāha devebhyo varaṃ dātuṃ surārihā //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāgeṣṭādaśodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तुष्टोस्मीत्याह देवेभ्यो वरं दातुं सुरारिहा //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागेष्टादशोध्यायः
text_mt:
the slayer of the foes of the gods said to the gods, "I am pleased," in order to grant a boon.

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
taṃ prabhuṃ prītamanasaṃ praṇipatya vṛṣadhvajam /
apṛcchanmunayo devāḥ prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
तं प्रभुं प्रीतमनसं प्रणिपत्य वृषध्वजम् /
अपृच्छन्मुनयो देवाः प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः //
text_mt: Śailādi said: / Having bowed down to that Lord Vṛṣadhvaja whose mind was pleased, / the sages and the gods, their skin bristling with joy, asked:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
bhagavān kena mārgeṇa pūjanīyo dvijātibhiḥ /
kutra vā kena rūpeṇa vaktumarhasi śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
भगवान् केन मार्गेण पूजनीयो द्विजातिभिः /
कुत्र वा केन रूपेण वक्तुमर्हसि शङ्करः //
text_mt: The gods said: / "By what method is the Blessed Lord to be worshipped by the twice-born? / And where, or in what form? You ought to speak, O Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
kasyādhikāraḥ pūjāyāṃ brāhmaṇasya kathaṃ prabho /
kṣatriyāṇāṃ kathaṃ deva vaiśyānāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja //
meaning:
कस्याधिकारः पूजायां ब्राह्मणस्य कथं प्रभो /
क्षत्रियाणां कथं देव वैश्यानां वृषभध्वज //
text_mt: Who is eligible for worship? How [is it performed] for a brāhmaṇa, O Lord? / How for kṣatriyas, O God, and how for vaiśyas, O Vṛṣabhadhvaja?

sanskrit_iast:
strīśūdrāṇāṃ kathaṃ vāpi kuṇḍagolādināṃ tu vā /
hitāya jagatāṃ sarvamasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi //
meaning:
स्त्रीशूद्राणां कथं वापि कुण्डगोलादिनां तु वा /
हिताय जगतां सर्वमस्माकं वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: And how for women and śūdras, or for kuṇḍas, golas, and the like? / For the benefit of the worlds, you ought to tell us everything."

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
teṣāṃ bhāvaṃ samālokya munīnāṃ nīlalohitaḥ /
prāha gaṃbhīrayā vācā maṇḍalasthaḥ sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
तेषां भावं समालोक्य मुनीनां नीललोहितः /
प्राह गंभीरया वाचा मण्डलस्थः सदाशिवः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Observing the inner intention of those sages, Nīlalohita, / Sadāśiva, situated within the maṇḍala, spoke with a deep voice.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale cāgrato paśyandevadevaṃ sahomayā /
devāśca munayaḥ sarve vidyutkoṭisamaprabham //
meaning:
मण्डले चाग्रतो पश्यन्देवदेवं सहोमया /
देवाश्च मुनयः सर्वे विद्युत्कोटिसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: And the gods and all the sages, seeing before them in the maṇḍala the God of gods with Umā, / possessing the brilliance of ten million lightnings,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭabāhuṃ caturvaktraṃ dvādaśākṣaṃ mahābhujam /
ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam //
meaning:
अष्टबाहुं चतुर्वक्त्रं द्वादशाक्षं महाभुजम् /
अर्धनारीश्वरं देवं जटामुकुटधारिणम् //
text_mt: with eight arms, four faces, twelve eyes, and mighty hands, / the god who is Ardhanārīśvara, wearing a crown of matted locks,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ raktamālyānulepanam /
raktāṃbaradharaṃ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakārakam //
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम् /
रक्तांबरधरं सृष्टिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् //
text_mt: adorned with all ornaments, anointed with red garlands and unguents, / wearing red garments, the agent of creation, maintenance, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pūrvamukhaṃ pītaṃ prasannaṃ puruṣātmakam /
aghoraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam //
meaning:
तस्य पूर्वमुखं पीतं प्रसन्नं पुरुषात्मकम् /
अघोरं दक्षिणं वक्त्रं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् //
text_mt: His eastern face was yellow, serene, in the form of Puruṣa; / the southern face was Aghora, resembling a heap of blue collyrium,

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālamatyugraṃ jvālāmālāsamāvātam /
raktaśmaśruñjaṭāyuktaṃ cottare vidrumaprabham //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालमत्युग्रं ज्वालामालासमावातम् /
रक्तश्मश्रुञ्जटायुक्तं चोत्तरे विद्रुमप्रभम् //
text_mt: terrible with fangs, exceedingly fierce, surrounded by garlands of flames, / with a red beard and matted hair; and on the north it had the brilliance of coral,

sanskrit_iast:
prasannaṃ vāmadevākhyaṃ varadaṃ viśvarūpiṇam /
paścimaṃ vadanaṃ tasya gokṣīradhavalaṃ śubham //
meaning:
प्रसन्नं वामदेवाख्यं वरदं विश्वरूपिणम् /
पश्चिमं वदनं तस्य गोक्षीरधवलं शुभम् //
text_mt: serene, called Vāmadeva, granting boons, having the universal form; / his western face was white as cow's milk and auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāphalamayairhārairbhūṣitaṃ tilakojjvalam /
sadyojātamukhaṃ divyaṃ bhāskarasya smarāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
मुक्ताफलमयैर्हारैर्भूषितं तिलकोज्ज्वलम् /
सद्योजातमुखं दिव्यं भास्करस्य स्मरारिणः //
text_mt: decorated with necklaces made of pearls, radiant with a forehead mark— / the divine face of Sadyojāta, of the Sun, the foe of Smara.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityamagrato paśyanpūrvavaccaturānanam /
bhāskaraṃ purato devaṃ caturvakraṃ ca pūrvavat //
meaning:
आदित्यमग्रतो पश्यन्पूर्ववच्चतुराननम् /
भास्करं पुरतो देवं चतुर्वक्रं च पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: They saw Āditya in the front, having four faces as before; / Bhāskara, the god in the east, having four faces as before;

sanskrit_iast:
bhānuṃ dakṣiṇato devaṃ caturvaktraṃ ca pūrvavat /
ravimuttarato 'paśyanpūrvavaccaturānanam //
meaning:
भानुं दक्षिणतो देवं चतुर्वक्त्रं च पूर्ववत् /
रविमुत्तरतो ऽपश्यन्पूर्ववच्चतुराननम् //
text_mt: Bhānu, the god in the south, having four faces as before; / and they saw Ravi in the north, having four faces as before.

sanskrit_iast:
vistārāṃ maṇḍale pūrve uttarāṃ dakṣiṇe sthitām /
bodhanīṃ paścime bhāge maṇḍalasya prajāpateḥ //
meaning:
विस्तारां मण्डले पूर्वे उत्तरां दक्षिणे स्थिताम् /
बोधनीं पश्चिमे भागे मण्डलस्य प्रजापतेः //
text_mt: Vistārā stationed in the eastern part of the maṇḍala, Uttarā in the south, / Bodhanī in the western quarter of the maṇḍala of the lord of creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāyanīṃ ca kauberyāmekavaktrāṃ caturbhujām /
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvasaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
अध्यायनीं च कौबेर्यामेकवक्त्रां चतुर्भुजाम् /
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नाः शक्तयः सर्वसंमताः //
text_mt: and Adhyāyanī in the northern quarter, one-faced and four-armed— / powers endowed with all ornaments, approved by all.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣṇuṃ vāme janārdanam /
ṛgyajuḥ sāmamārgeṇa mūrtitrayamayaṃśivam //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे भागे विष्णुं वामे जनार्दनम् /
ऋग्यजुः साममार्गेण मूर्तित्रयमयंशिवम् //
text_mt: Brahmā in the southern part, Viṣṇu Janārdana in the left, / Śiva comprised of the three forms according to the way of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaṃ varadaṃ devamīśānaṃ parameśvaram /
brahmāsanasthaṃ vadaraṃ dharmajñānāsanopari //
meaning:
ईशानं वरदं देवमीशानं परमेश्वरम् /
ब्रह्मासनस्थं वदरं धर्मज्ञानासनोपरि //
text_mt: Īśāna, the boon-granting God, Īśāna the Supreme Lord, / seated on the lotus-seat of Brahmā upon the throne of dharma and knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
vairāgyaiśvaryasaṃyukte prabhūte vimale tathā /
sāraṃ sarveśvaraṃ devamārādhyaṃ paramaṃ sukham //
meaning:
वैराग्यैश्वर्यसंयुक्ते प्रभूते विमले तथा /
सारं सर्वेश्वरं देवमाराध्यं परमं सुखम् //
text_mt: endowed with dispassion and sovereignty, abundant and spotless, / the essence, the God who is Lord of all, worthy of worship, supreme bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
sitapaṅkajamadhyasthaṃ dīptādyairabhisaṃvṛtam /
dīptāṃ dīpaśikhākārāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vidyutprabhāṃ śubhām //
meaning:
सितपङ्कजमध्यस्थं दीप्ताद्यैरभिसंवृतम् /
दीप्तां दीपशिखाकारां सूक्ष्मां विद्युत्प्रभां शुभाम् //
text_mt: standing in the middle of a white lotus, surrounded by Dīptā and others: / Dīptā shaped like a lamp flame, subtle, with the auspicious radiance of lightning;

sanskrit_iast:
jayāmagniśīkhākārāṃ prabhāṃ kanakasaprabhām /
vibhūtiṃ vidrumaprakhyāṃ vimalāṃ padmasannibhām //
meaning:
जयामग्निशीखाकारां प्रभां कनकसप्रभाम् /
विभूतिं विद्रुमप्रख्यां विमलां पद्मसन्निभाम् //
text_mt: Jayā shaped like a fire flame, Prabhā with the brilliance of gold, / Vibhūti resembling coral, Vimalā resembling a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
amoghāṃ karṇikākārāṃ vidyutaṃ viśvavarṇinīm /
caturvaktrāṃ caturvarṇāṃ devīṃ vai sarvatomukhīm //
meaning:
अमोघां कर्णिकाकारां विद्युतं विश्ववर्णिनीम् /
चतुर्वक्त्रां चतुर्वर्णां देवीं वै सर्वतोमुखीम् //
text_mt: Amoghā shaped like a pericarp, Vidyut possessing all colors, / four-faced, having four colors, the goddess facing in all directions;

sanskrit_iast:
somamaṅgārakaṃ devaṃ budhaṃ buddhimatāṃ varam /
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadvuddhiṃ bhārgavaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim //
meaning:
सोममङ्गारकं देवं बुधं बुद्धिमतां वरम् /
बृहस्पतिं बृहद्वुद्धिं भार्गवं तेजसां निधिम् //
text_mt: Soma, the god Aṅgāraka, Budha the foremost among the wise, / Bṛhaspati of vast intellect, Bhārgava the treasure of splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
mandaṃ mandagatiṃ caiva samantāttasya te sadā /
sūryaṃ śivo jagannāthaḥ somaḥ sākṣādumā svayam //
meaning:
मन्दं मन्दगतिं चैव समन्तात्तस्य ते सदा /
सूर्यं शिवो जगन्नाथः सोमः साक्षादुमा स्वयम् //
text_mt: and Manda of slow gait—these are always all around him. / Sūrya is Śiva, the Lord of the world; Soma is directly Umā herself;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhūtāni śeṣāṇi tanmayaṃ ca carācaram /
dṛṣṭaiva munayaḥ sarve devadevamumāpatim //
meaning:
पञ्चभूतानि शेषाणि तन्मयं च चराचरम् /
दृष्टैव मुनयः सर्वे देवदेवमुमापतिम् //
text_mt: the remaining five elements and the moving and unmoving world are composed of them. / Having seen the God of gods, the husband of Umā,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve munayo devatāstathā /
astu vanvāgbhiriṣṭabhirvaradaṃ nīlalohitam //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे मुनयो देवतास्तथा /
अस्तु वन्वाग्भिरिष्टभिर्वरदं नीललोहितम् //
text_mt: all the sages and likewise the deities, folding their hands in reverence, / praised the boon-granting Nīlalohita with pleasing words.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
namaḥ śivāya rudrāya kadrudrāya pracetase /
mīḍhuṣṭamāya sarvāya śipiviṣṭāyaraṃhase //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
नमः शिवाय रुद्राय कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे /
मीढुष्टमाय सर्वाय शिपिविष्टायरंहसे //
text_mt: The sages said: / "Obeisance to Śiva, to Rudra, to Kadrudra, the mindful, / to the most bountiful, to Śarva, to Śipiviṣṭa, the swift!

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūte vimale sāre hyādhāre parame sukhe /
navaśaktyāvṛtaṃ devaṃ padmasthaṃ bhāskaraṃ prabhum //
meaning:
प्रभूते विमले सारे ह्याधारे परमे सुखे /
नवशक्त्यावृतं देवं पद्मस्थं भास्करं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Upon the abundant, pure, essential support, in the supreme bliss, / [we praise] the Lord, the Sun, standing on the lotus, surrounded by the nine powers,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhānuṃ raviṃ devaṃ divākaram /
umāṃ prabhāṃ tathā prajñāṃ saṃdhyāṃ sāvitrikāmapi //
meaning:
आदित्यं भास्करं भानुं रविं देवं दिवाकरम् /
उमां प्रभां तथा प्रज्ञां संध्यां सावित्रिकामपि //
text_mt: Āditya, Bhāskara, Bhānu, Ravi, the God Divākara, / Umā, Prabhā, likewise Prajñā, Saṃdhyā, and also Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast:
vistārāmuttarāṃ devīṃ bodanīṃ praṇamāmyaham /
āpyāyanīṃ ca varadāṃ brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ haram //
meaning:
विस्तारामुत्तरां देवीं बोदनीं प्रणमाम्यहम् /
आप्यायनीं च वरदां ब्रह्माणं केशवं हरम् //
text_mt: I bow down to goddess Vistārā, to Uttarā, to Bodhanī, / to the boon-granting Āpyāyanī, to Brahmā, Keśava, and Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
somādivṛndaṃ ca yathākramema saṃpūjya mantrairvihitakrameṇa /
smarāmi devaṃ ravimaṇḍalasthaṃ sadāśivaṃ śaṅkaramādidevam //
meaning:
सोमादिवृन्दं च यथाक्रमेम संपूज्य मन्त्रैर्विहितक्रमेण /
स्मरामि देवं रविमण्डलस्थं सदाशिवं शङ्करमादिदेवम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the assembly of Soma and the rest in proper order with mantras according to the prescribed rule, / I meditate upon the God who dwells in the solar orb, Sadāśiva, Śaṅkara, the primal God.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādidevāṃśca tatheśvarāṃśca nārāyaṇaṃ padmajamādidevam /
prāgādyadhordhvaṃ ca yathākrameṇa vajrādipadmaṃ ca tathā smarāmi //
meaning:
इन्द्रादिदेवांश्च तथेश्वरांश्च नारायणं पद्मजमादिदेवम् /
प्रागाद्यधोर्ध्वं च यथाक्रमेण वज्रादिपद्मं च तथा स्मरामि //
text_mt: And likewise the gods beginning with Indra, the lords, Nārāyaṇa, and the lotus-born primal God, / in order beginning from the east, below, and above, and likewise the lotus and thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdūravarṇāya samaṇḍalāya suvarṇavajrābharaṇāya tubhyam /
padmābhanetrāya sapaṅkajāya brahmendranārāyaṇakāraṇāya //
meaning:
सिंदूरवर्णाय समण्डलाय सुवर्णवज्राभरणाय तुभ्यम् /
पद्माभनेत्राय सपङ्कजाय ब्रह्मेन्द्रनारायणकारणाय //
text_mt: To you of vermilion hue, accompanied by your maṇḍala, adorned with ornaments of gold and vajra, / with eyes resembling lotuses, holding a lotus, the cause of Brahmā, Indra, and Nārāyaṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
rathaṃ ca saptāśvamanūruvīraṃ gaṇaṃ tathā saptavidhaṃ krameṇa /
ṛtupravāheṇa ca vālīkhilyānsmarāmi mandehagaṇakṣayaṃ ca //
meaning:
रथं च सप्ताश्वमनूरुवीरं गणं तथा सप्तविधं क्रमेण /
ऋतुप्रवाहेण च वालीखिल्यान्स्मरामि मन्देहगणक्षयं च //
text_mt: And the chariot with seven horses, the thighless hero, and the sevenfold host in order, / with the course of seasons, the Vālakhilyas, and the destruction of the Mandeha hosts, I remember.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā tilādyairvividhaistathāgnau punaḥ samāpyaiva tathaiva sarvam /
udvāsya hṛtpaṅkajamadhyasaṃsthaṃ smarāmi biṃbaṃ tava devadeva //
meaning:
हुत्वा तिलाद्यैर्विविधैस्तथाग्नौ पुनः समाप्यैव तथैव सर्वम् /
उद्वास्य हृत्पङ्कजमध्यसंस्थं स्मरामि बिंबं तव देवदेव //
text_mt: Having offered various oblations of sesame and the like into the fire, and having completed everything in the same way, / having dismissed [the rites], I meditate upon your disc dwelling in the middle of the heart-lotus, O God of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
smarāmi biṃbāni yathākrameṇa raktāni padmāmalalocanāni /
padmaṃ ca savye varadaṃ ca vāme kare tathā bhūṣitabhūṣaṇāni //
meaning:
स्मरामि बिंबानि यथाक्रमेण रक्तानि पद्मामललोचनानि /
पद्मं च सव्ये वरदं च वामे करे तथा भूषितभूषणानि //
text_mt: I meditate upon the discs in due order, red, with pure lotus eyes, / holding a lotus in the right hand and granting boons with the left hand, adorned with ornaments."

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ tava divyavaktraṃ vidyutprabhaṃ daityayaṅkaraṃ ca /
smarāmi rakṣābhirataṃ dvijānāṃ mandeharakṣogaṇabhartsanaṃ ca //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालं तव दिव्यवक्त्रं विद्युत्प्रभं दैत्ययङ्करं च /
स्मरामि रक्षाभिरतं द्विजानां मन्देहरक्षोगणभर्त्सनं च //
text_mt: I remember your divine face, terrible with fangs, / shining like lightning, striking fear into the Daityas, / devoted to the protection of the twice-born, and rebuking the Mandeha demons.

sanskrit_iast:
somaṃ sitaṃ bhūmijamagnirṇaṃ cāmīkarābhaṃ budhamindusūnum /
bṛhaspatiṃ kāñcanasannikāśaṃ śukraṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇataraṃ ca mandam //
meaning:
सोमं सितं भूमिजमग्निर्णं चामीकराभं बुधमिन्दुसूनुम् /
बृहस्पतिं काञ्चनसन्निकाशं शुक्रं सितं कृष्णतरं च मन्दम् //
text_mt: [I remember] Soma, who is white; the Earth-born [Aṅgāraka], fire-hued; Budha, the son of the Moon, radiant like gold; / Bṛhaspati, resembling gold; Śukra, who is white; and the very dark Manda [Śani],

sanskrit_iast:
smarāmi savyamabhayaṃ vāmamūrugataṃ varam /
sarveṣāṃ mandaparyantaṃ mahādevaṃ ca bhāskaram //
meaning:
स्मरामि सव्यमभयं वाममूरुगतं वरम् /
सर्वेषां मन्दपर्यन्तं महादेवं च भास्करम् //
text_mt: with the right hand granting fearlessness and the left resting on the thigh granting a boon, / all up to Manda, and Mahādeva, the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇenduvarṇena ca puṣpadhaprasthena toyane śubhena pūrṇam /
pātraṃ dṛḍhaṃ tāmramayaṃ prakalpya dāsye tavārdhyaṃ bhagavanprasīda //
meaning:
पूर्णेन्दुवर्णेन च पुष्पधप्रस्थेन तोयने शुभेन पूर्णम् /
पात्रं दृढं ताम्रमयं प्रकल्प्य दास्ये तवार्ध्यं भगवन्प्रसीद //
text_mt: Preparing a sturdy copper vessel filled with clear water, / endowed with flowers white like the full moon, / I shall offer your arghya; O Lord, be gracious.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śivāya devāya īśvarāya kapardine /
rudrāya viṣṇave tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe sūryamūrtaye //
meaning:
नमः शिवाय देवाय ईश्वराय कपर्दिने /
रुद्राय विष्णवे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे सूर्यमूर्तये //
text_mt: Obeisance to Śiva, the God, the Lord, the one with matted locks, / to Rudra, to Viṣṇu, and to you, Brahmā, whose form is the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
yaḥ śivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ devaṃ saṃpūjyaivaṃ samāhitaḥ /
prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne paṭhetstavamanuttamam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
यः शिवं मण्डलं देवं संपूज्यैवं समाहितः /
प्रातर्मध्याह्नसायाह्ने पठेत्स्तवमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / He who, concentrated in mind, having thus worshipped God Śiva in the maṇḍala, / recites this supreme hymn at dawn, midday, and evening,

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ śivena sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge ekonaviṃśodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्थं शिवेन सायुज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे एकोनविंशोध्यायः
text_mt:
attains union with Śiva in this manner; of this there is no doubt.

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter in the second part of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvacā
ata rudro mahādevo maṇḍalasthaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
pūjyo vai brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवचा
अत रुद्रो महादेवो मण्डलस्थः पितामहः /
पूज्यो वै ब्राह्मणानां च क्षत्रियाणां विशेषतः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Therefore, Rudra, Mahādeva, and Pitāmaha abiding in the maṇḍala / are to be worshipped by Brāhmaṇas and especially by Kṣatriyas,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyānāṃ naiva śūdrāṇāṃ śuśruṣāṃ pūjakasya ca /
strīṇāṃ naivādikāro 'sti pūjādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
वैश्यानां नैव शूद्राणां शुश्रुषां पूजकस्य च /
स्त्रीणां नैवादिकारो ऽस्ति पूजादिषु न संशयः //
text_mt: by Vaiśyas, but not at all by Śūdras; [for them, only] service to the worshipper [is prescribed]. / Women have no qualification in worship and similar rites; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
strīśūdrāṇāṃ dvajendraiśca pūjayā tatphalaṃ bhavet /
nṛpāṇāmupakārārthaṃ brāhmaṇādyairviśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीशूद्राणां द्वजेन्द्रैश्च पूजया तत्फलं भवेत् /
नृपाणामुपकारार्थं ब्राह्मणाद्यैर्विशेषतः //
text_mt: The fruit for women and Śūdras comes through worship performed by eminent twice-born men, / especially by Brāhmaṇas and others for the benefit of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjayeyurvai brāhmaṇādyāḥ sadāśivam /
ityuktvā bhagavān rudrastatraivāntaradhātsvayam //
meaning:
एवं संपूजयेयुर्वै ब्राह्मणाद्याः सदाशिवम् /
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधात्स्वयम् //
text_mt: Thus should Brāhmaṇas and the others worship Sadāśiva. / Having spoken thus, the Lord Rudra himself vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
te devā munayaḥ sarve śivamuddiśya śaṅkaram /
praṇemuśca mahātmāno rudradhyānena vihvalāḥ //
meaning:
ते देवा मुनयः सर्वे शिवमुद्दिश्य शङ्करम् /
प्रणेमुश्च महात्मानो रुद्रध्यानेन विह्वलाः //
text_mt: All those gods and sages, turning towards Śiva, Śaṅkara, / bowed down, their great souls overwhelmed by the meditation on Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
jagmuryathāgataṃ devā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ /
tasmādabyarcayennityamādityaṃ śivarūpiṇam //
meaning:
जग्मुर्यथागतं देवा मुनयश्च तपोधनाः /
तस्मादब्यर्चयेन्नित्यमादित्यं शिवरूपिणम् //
text_mt: The gods and the sages rich in austerities departed as they had come. / Therefore, one should daily worship Āditya, whose nature is Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmakāmārthamuktyarthaṃ manasā karmaṇā girā /
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
romaharṣaṇa sarvajña sarvasāstrabhṛtāṃ vara //
meaning:
धर्मकामार्थमुक्त्यर्थं मनसा कर्मणा गिरा /
ऋषय ऊचुः
रोमहर्षण सर्वज्ञ सर्वसास्त्रभृतां वर //
text_mt: with mind, action, and speech, for the sake of dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation. / The sages said: / O Romaharṣaṇa, omniscient one, best among bearers of all scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsaśiṣya mahābhāga vāhneyaṃ vada sāṃpratam /
śivena devadevena bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
व्यासशिष्य महाभाग वाह्नेयं वद सांप्रतम् /
शिवेन देवदेवेन भक्तानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: O disciple of Vyāsa, O illustrious one, speak now of the Vāhneya [Purāṇa], / [revealed] by Śiva, the God of gods, out of a desire for the welfare of devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
vedāt ṣaḍaṅgāduddhṛtya sāṃkhyayogācca sarvataḥ /
tapaśca vipulaṃ taptvā devadānavaduścaram //
meaning:
वेदात् षडङ्गादुद्धृत्य सांख्ययोगाच्च सर्वतः /
तपश्च विपुलं तप्त्वा देवदानवदुश्चरम् //
text_mt: extracted from the Veda with its six limbs and completely from Sāṃkhya and Yoga, / after performing immense asceticism difficult even for gods and Danavas to practice,

sanskrit_iast:
arthadeśādisaṃyuktaṃ gūḍhamajñānaninditam /
varṇāśramakṛtairdharmairviparītaṃ kvacitsamam //
meaning:
अर्थदेशादिसंयुक्तं गूढमज्ञाननिन्दितम् /
वर्णाश्रमकृतैर्धर्मैर्विपरीतं क्वचित्समम् //
text_mt: connected with matters of place and context, secret, censured by the ignorant, / contrary in some respects to the duties established for the classes and stages of life, and equal to them in others,

sanskrit_iast:
śivena kathitaṃ sāstraṃ dharmakāmārthamuktaye /
śatakoṭipramāṇena tatra pūjā kathaṃ vibhoḥ //
meaning:
शिवेन कथितं सास्त्रं धर्मकामार्थमुक्तये /
शतकोटिप्रमाणेन तत्र पूजा कथं विभोः //
text_mt: the scripture declared by Śiva for the sake of dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation, / in the measure of a hundred crores [of verses]. How is the worship of the all-pervading Lord [conducted] therein,

sanskrit_iast:
snānayogādayo vāpi śrotuṃ kautuhalaṃ hi naḥ /
sūta uvāca
purā sanatkumāreṇa merupṛṣṭhe suśobhane //
meaning:
स्नानयोगादयो वापि श्रोतुं कौतुहलं हि नः /
सूत उवाच
पुरा सनत्कुमारेण मेरुपृष्ठे सुशोभने //
text_mt: or the yogas of bathing and so forth? Indeed, we are eager to hear. / Sūta said: / Formerly, on the beautiful ridge of Mount Meru,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭo nandīśvaro devaḥ śailādiḥ śivasaṃmataḥ /
pṛṣṭoyaṃ praṇipatyaivaṃ munimukhyaiśca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
पृष्टो नन्दीश्वरो देवः शैलादिः शिवसंमतः /
पृष्टोयं प्रणिपत्यैवं मुनिमुख्यैश्च सर्वतः //
text_mt: the divine Nandīśvara, the son of Śilāda, beloved of Śiva, / was questioned by Sanatkumāra, having thus bowed down, and by the foremost sages on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai sanatkumārāya nandinā kulanandinā /
kathitaṃ yacchivajñānaṃ śṛṇvantu munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मै सनत्कुमाराय नन्दिना कुलनन्दिना /
कथितं यच्छिवज्ञानं शृण्वन्तु मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: Hear, O eminent sages, that knowledge of Śiva which was spoken / to that Sanatkumāra by Nandin, the delighter of his family,

sanskrit_iast:
śaivaṃ saṃkṣipya vedoktaṃ śivena paribhāṣitam /
stutinindādirahitaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam //
meaning:
शैवं संक्षिप्य वेदोक्तं शिवेन परिभाषितम् /
स्तुतिनिन्दादिरहितं सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकम् //
text_mt: the Śaiva doctrine declared by Śiva, summarizing what is taught in the Vedas, / devoid of flattery and censure, producing immediate conviction,

sanskrit_iast:
guruprasādajaṃ divyamanāyāsena muktidam /
sanatkumāra uvāca
bhagavansarva bhūteśa nandīśvara maheśvara //
meaning:
गुरुप्रसादजं दिव्यमनायासेन मुक्तिदम् /
सनत्कुमार उवाच
भगवन्सर्व भूतेश नन्दीश्वर महेश्वर //
text_mt: born of the guru's grace, divine, effortlessly granting liberation. / Sanatkumāra said: / O Lord, master of all beings, Nandīśvara, Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ pūjādayaḥ śaṃbhordharmakāmārthamuktaye /
vaktumarhasi śailāde vinayenāgatāya me //
meaning:
कथं पूजादयः शंभोर्धर्मकामार्थमुक्तये /
वक्तुमर्हसि शैलादे विनयेनागताय मे //
text_mt: how are the worship and other rites of Śaṃbhu [performed] for the sake of dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation? / You ought to speak to me who have approached with humility, O son of Śilāda.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
saṃprekṣya bhagavānnandī niśamya vacanaṃ punaḥ /
kālavelādhikārādyamavadadvadatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
संप्रेक्ष्य भगवान्नन्दी निशम्य वचनं पुनः /
कालवेलाधिकाराद्यमवदद्वदतां वरः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having observed [him] and heard his words once again, the divine Nandin, / the foremost among speakers, spoke about time, proper hours, qualification, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
śailāderuvāca
gurutaḥ śāstrataścaivamadhikāraṃ vravīmyaham /
gauravādeva saṃjñaiṣā śivācāryasya nānyathā //
meaning:
शैलादेरुवाच
गुरुतः शास्त्रतश्चैवमधिकारं व्रवीम्यहम् /
गौरवादेव संज्ञैषा शिवाचार्यस्य नान्यथा //
text_mt: The son of Śilāda said: / I shall state the qualification according to the guru and according to scripture; / this designation of 'Śivācārya' exists only on account of gravity [of character], not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamācarate yastu ācāre sthāpayatyapi /
ācinoti ca śāstrārthānācāryastena cocyate //
meaning:
स्वयमाचरते यस्तु आचारे स्थापयत्यपि /
आचिनोति च शास्त्रार्थानाचार्यस्तेन चोच्यते //
text_mt: He who himself practices conduct, establishes [others] in proper conduct, / and gathers the meanings of the scriptures is therefore called an ācārya.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvedārthatattvajñamācāryaṃ bhasmaśāyinam /
gurumanveṣayedbhaktaḥ subhagaṃ priyadarśanam //
meaning:
तस्माद्वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञमाचार्यं भस्मशायिनम् /
गुरुमन्वेषयेद्भक्तः सुभगं प्रियदर्शनम् //
text_mt: Therefore, a devotee should seek a guru, an ācārya who knows the truth of Vedic meaning, / who lies on sacred ash, is fortunate, and pleasing to behold,

sanskrit_iast:
pratipannaṃ janānandaṃ śrutismṛtipathānugam /
vidyayābhayadātāraṃ laulyacāplayavarjitam //
meaning:
प्रतिपन्नं जनानन्दं श्रुतिस्मृतिपथानुगम् /
विद्ययाभयदातारं लौल्यचाप्लयवर्जितम् //
text_mt: receptive, bringing joy to people, following the path of Śruti and Smṛti, / granting fearlessness through knowledge, free from greed and fickleness,

sanskrit_iast:
ācārapālakaṃ dhīraṃ samayeṣu kṛtāspadam /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhāvena pūjayecchivavadgurum //
meaning:
आचारपालकं धीरं समयेषु कृतास्पदम् /
तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वभावेन पूजयेच्छिववद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: a guardian of conduct, steadfast, established in the traditional observances. / Having found him, one should worship the guru with full devotion just like Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanā ca dhanenaiva śraddhāvittānusārataḥ /
tāvadārādhayecchiṣyaḥ prasanno 'sau yathā bhavet //
meaning:
आत्मना च धनेनैव श्रद्धावित्तानुसारतः /
तावदाराधयेच्छिष्यः प्रसन्नो ऽसौ यथा भवेत् //
text_mt: with one's self and with wealth, according to one's faith and means; / the disciple should propitiate him until he becomes pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
suprasanne mahābhāge sadyaḥ pāśakṣayo bhavet /
gururmānyo guruḥ pūjyo gurureva sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
सुप्रसन्ने महाभागे सद्यः पाशक्षयो भवेत् /
गुरुर्मान्यो गुरुः पूज्यो गुरुरेव सदाशिवः //
text_mt: When that illustrious one is well-pleased, the destruction of worldly bonds occurs immediately. / The guru is to be respected, the guru is to be worshipped; the guru is indeed Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaratrayaṃ vātha śiṣyānviprānparīkṣayet /
prāṇadravyapradānena ādeśaiśca itastataḥ //
meaning:
संवत्सरत्रयं वाथ शिष्यान्विप्रान्परीक्षयेत् /
प्राणद्रव्यप्रदानेन आदेशैश्च इतस्ततः //
text_mt: Or else, [the guru] should test the twice-born disciples for three years / by having them surrender life and wealth, and by commands here and there.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaścādhame yojyo nīca uttamavastuṣu /
ākṛṣṭāstāḍitā vāpi ye viṣādaṃ na yānti vai //
meaning:
उत्तमश्चाधमे योज्यो नीच उत्तमवस्तुषु /
आकृष्टास्ताडिता वापि ये विषादं न यान्ति वै //
text_mt: The superior should be assigned to an inferior task, and the base to superior matters; / those who do not fall into dejection even when rebuked or beaten,

sanskrit_iast:
te yogyāḥ śivadharmiṣṭhāḥ śivadharmaparāyaṇāḥ /
saṃyatā dharmasaṃpannāḥ śrutismṛtipathānugāḥ //
meaning:
ते योग्याः शिवधर्मिष्ठाः शिवधर्मपरायणाः /
संयता धर्मसंपन्नाः श्रुतिस्मृतिपथानुगाः //
text_mt: they are qualified, very upright in the dharma of Śiva, devoted to the dharma of Śiva, / self-controlled, endowed with dharma, following the path of Śruti and Smṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadvandvasahādhīrā nityamudyuktacetasaḥ /
paropakāraniratā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वद्वन्द्वसहाधीरा नित्यमुद्युक्तचेतसः /
परोपकारनिरता गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः //
text_mt: patient under all pairs of opposites, steadfast, of ever-vigilant mind, / dedicated to the welfare of others, devoted to the service of the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
ārjavā mārdavāḥ svasthā anukūlāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ /
amānino buddhimantastyaktaspardhā gataspṛhāḥ //
meaning:
आर्जवा मार्दवाः स्वस्था अनुकूलाः प्रियंवदाः /
अमानिनो बुद्धिमन्तस्त्यक्तस्पर्धा गतस्पृहाः //
text_mt: upright, gentle, sound, accommodating, speaking kindly, / free from pride, wise, having abandoned rivalry, rid of craving,

sanskrit_iast:
śaucācāraguṇopetā dambhamātsaryavarjitāḥ /
yogyā evaṃ dvijāḥ sarve śivabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
शौचाचारगुणोपेता दम्भमात्सर्यवर्जिताः /
योग्या एवं द्विजाः सर्वे शिवभक्तिपरायणाः //
text_mt: endowed with the virtues of purity and right conduct, free from hypocrisy and malice; / all twice-born men of such qualities, devoted to Śiva-bhakti, are eligible.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvṛttasamopetā vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ /
śodhyā evaṃvidhāścaiva tattvānāṃ ca viśuddhaye //
meaning:
एवंवृत्तसमोपेता वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः /
शोध्या एवंविधाश्चैव तत्त्वानां च विशुद्धये //
text_mt: Those endowed with such conduct in actions of speech, mind, and body, / such persons should be purified for the purification of the tattvas.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddho vinayasaṃpanno mithyākaṭukavarjitaḥ /
gurvājñāpālakaścaiva śiṣyo 'nugrahamarhati //
meaning:
शुद्धो विनयसंपन्नो मिथ्याकटुकवर्जितः /
गुर्वाज्ञापालकश्चैव शिष्यो ऽनुग्रहमर्हति //
text_mt: Pure, endowed with humility, free from falsehood and harshness, / and obedient to the command of the guru, the disciple deserves grace.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśca śāstravit prājñas tapasvī janavatsalaḥ /
lokācārarato hyevaṃ tattvavinmokṣadaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
गुरुश्च शास्त्रवित् प्राज्ञस् तपस्वी जनवत्सलः /
लोकाचाररतो ह्येवं तत्त्वविन्मोक्षदः स्मृतः //
text_mt: And the guru, knowing the scriptures, wise, ascetic, affectionate to people, / devoted to worldly conduct, knowing reality, is considered a grantor of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ /
sarvopāyavidhānajñastattvahīnasya niṣphalam //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः /
सर्वोपायविधानज्ञस्तत्त्वहीनस्य निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Even if endowed with all auspicious marks, skilled in all scriptures, / and knowledgeable in the performance of all means, for one devoid of the tattva, it is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
svasaṃvedya pare tattve niścayo yasya nātmani /
ātmano 'nugraho nāsti parasyānugrahaḥ katham //
meaning:
स्वसंवेद्य परे तत्त्वे निश्चयो यस्य नात्मनि /
आत्मनो ऽनुग्रहो नास्ति परस्यानुग्रहः कथम् //
text_mt: One who lacks certainty in himself regarding the supreme tattva known through personal experience / has no grace for himself; how can there be grace for another?

sanskrit_iast:
prabuddhastu dvijo yastu sa śuddhaḥ sādhayatyapi /
tattvahīne kuto bodhaḥ kuto hyātmaparigrahaḥ //
meaning:
प्रबुद्धस्तु द्विजो यस्तु स शुद्धः साधयत्यपि /
तत्त्वहीने कुतो बोधः कुतो ह्यात्मपरिग्रहः //
text_mt: The twice-born who is awakened, he being pure also accomplishes [it]. / In one devoid of the tattva, whence can there be awakening? Whence can there be acceptance of the self?

sanskrit_iast:
parigrahavinirmuktāste sarve paśavoditāḥ /
paśubhiḥ preritā ye tu sarve te paśavaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
परिग्रहविनिर्मुक्तास्ते सर्वे पशवोदिताः /
पशुभिः प्रेरिता ये तु सर्वे ते पशवः स्मृताः //
text_mt: All those who are deprived of acceptance are said to be bound souls; / those who are impelled by bound souls are all considered bound souls.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tattvavido ye tu te muktā mocayanty api /
saṃvittijananaṃ tattvaṃ parānandasamudbhavam //
meaning:
तस्मात् तत्त्वविदो ये तु ते मुक्ता मोचयन्त्य् अपि /
संवित्तिजननं तत्त्वं परानन्दसमुद्भवम् //
text_mt: Therefore, those who know the truth are liberated and they liberate others as well; / the tattva gives rise to pure consciousness, born of supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvaṃ tu viditaṃ yena sa evānandadarśakaḥ /
na punarnāmamātreṇa saṃvittirahitastu yaḥ //
meaning:
तत्त्वं तु विदितं येन स एवानन्ददर्शकः /
न पुनर्नाममात्रेण संवित्तिरहितस्तु यः //
text_mt: He alone who has realized reality can show bliss, / but not one who merely possesses the name while devoid of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
anyo 'nyaṃ tārayennaiva kiṃ śilā tārayec chilām /
yeṣāṃ tannāmamātreṇa muktirvai nāmamātrikā //
meaning:
अन्यो ऽन्यं तारयेन्नैव किं शिला तारयेच् छिलाम् /
येषां तन्नाममात्रेण मुक्तिर्वै नाममात्रिका //
text_mt: Can one person deliver another? Can a stone make another stone cross over? / For those who possess it in name alone, liberation is indeed only nominal.

sanskrit_iast:
yogināṃ darśanādvāpi sparśanādbhāṣaṇādapi /
sadyaḥ saṃjāyate cājñā pāśopakṣayakāriṇī //
meaning:
योगिनां दर्शनाद्वापि स्पर्शनाद्भाषणादपि /
सद्यः संजायते चाज्ञा पाशोपक्षयकारिणी //
text_mt: Through seeing, touching, or conversing with yogins, / the command that destroys bonds arises immediately.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā yogamārgeṇa śiṣyadehaṃ praviśya ca /
bodayedeva yogena sarvatattvāni śodhya ca //
meaning:
अथवा योगमार्गेण शिष्यदेहं प्रविश्य च /
बोदयेदेव योगेन सर्वतत्त्वानि शोध्य च //
text_mt: Or, entering the pupil's body by the path of yoga, / he should awaken him through yoga, purifying all the principles of reality.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaāḍardhaśuddhirvihitā jñānayogena yoginām /
śiṣyaṃ parīkṣya dharmajñaṃ dhārmikaṃ vedapāragam //
meaning:
षआडर्धशुद्धिर्विहिता ज्ञानयोगेन योगिनाम् /
शिष्यं परीक्ष्य धर्मज्ञं धार्मिकं वेदपारगम् //
text_mt: The purification of thirty-six [principles] is prescribed through the yoga of knowledge for yogins, / after examining a pupil who knows righteousness, is virtuous, and has mastered the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ bahudoṣavivarjitam /
jñānena jñeyamālokya karṇāt karṇāgatena tu //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं वैश्यं बहुदोषविवर्जितम् /
ज्ञानेन ज्ञेयमालोक्य कर्णात् कर्णागतेन तु //
text_mt: a brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, or vaiśya who is free from many faults, / having perceived the knowable through knowledge, transmitted from ear to ear.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpāddīpo yatā cānyaḥ saṃcaredvidhipadguruḥ /
bhauvanaṃ ca padaṃ caiva varṇākhyaṃ mātramuttamam //
meaning:
दीपाद्दीपो यता चान्यः संचरेद्विधिपद्गुरुः /
भौवनं च पदं चैव वर्णाख्यं मात्रमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Just as another lamp is lit from a lamp, so the guru should act according to the injunctions: / the spatial [course], the word [course], the best [course] called sound-measure,

sanskrit_iast:
/
kālādhvaraṃ mahā bhāga tattvākhyaṃ sarvasaṃmatam /
bhidyate yasya sāmārthyādājñāmātreṇa sarvataḥ //
meaning:
/
कालाध्वरं महा भाग तत्त्वाख्यं सर्वसंमतम् /
भिद्यते यस्य सामार्थ्यादाज्ञामात्रेण सर्वतः //
text_mt: the time course, O fortunate one, and that called reality, agreed upon by all. / By whose power it is pierced everywhere through mere command,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya siddhiśca muktiśca gurukāruṇyasaṃbhavā /
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni āviśanti ca bhauvane //
meaning:
तस्य सिद्धिश्च मुक्तिश्च गुरुकारुण्यसंभवा /
पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि आविशन्ति च भौवने //
text_mt: his accomplishment and liberation arise from the guru's compassion. / The gross elements, beginning with earth, enter into the spatial [course];

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca bhāvataḥ /
padaṃ varṇākhyakaṃ vipra buddhīndriyavikalpanam //
meaning:
शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथा रूपं रसो गन्धश्च भावतः /
पदं वर्णाख्यकं विप्र बुद्धीन्द्रियविकल्पनम् //
text_mt: sound, touch, form, taste, and smell exist in reality [there]. / The word [course] and that called phonemes, O vipra, are the conceptualization of the cognitive organs;

sanskrit_iast:
karmendriyāṇi mātraṃ hi mano buddhirataḥ param /
ahaṅkāramathāvyaktaṃ kālādhvaramiti smṛtam //
meaning:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि मात्रं हि मनो बुद्धिरतः परम् /
अहङ्कारमथाव्यक्तं कालाध्वरमिति स्मृतम् //
text_mt: the organs of action are the sound-measure; beyond this are mind and intellect; / egoity and the unmanifest are considered the time course;

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣādiviriñcyantamunmanatvaṃ parātparam /
tatheśatvamiti proktaṃ sarvatattvārtha bodhakam //
meaning:
पुरुषादिविरिञ्च्यन्तमुन्मनत्वं परात्परम् /
तथेशत्वमिति प्रोक्तं सर्वतत्त्वार्थ बोधकम् //
text_mt: from the Puruṣa up to Viriñci is the supreme state beyond the mind, higher than the high; / similarly, sovereignty is proclaimed, awakening the meaning of all principles.

sanskrit_iast:
ayogī naiva jānāti tattvaśuddhiṃ śivātmikām //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge viṃśodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अयोगी नैव जानाति तत्त्वशुद्धिं शिवात्मिकाम् //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे विंशोध्यायः
text_mt:
One who is not a yogin never knows the purification of principles whose nature is Śiva.

Thus ends the twentieth chapter in the second part of the glorious Liṅgamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ vidhivadgandhavarṇarasādibhiḥ /
alaṅkṛtya vitānādyairīśvarāvāhanakṣamām //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
परीक्ष्य भूमिं विधिवद्गन्धवर्णरसादिभिः /
अलङ्कृत्य वितानाद्यैरीश्वरावाहनक्षमाम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having properly tested the ground by smell, colour, taste, and so forth, / and adorned it with canopies and the like, fit for the invocation of the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
ekahastapramāṇena maṇḍalaṃ parikalpayet /
ālikhetkamalaṃ madhye pañcaratnasamanvitam //
meaning:
एकहस्तप्रमाणेन मण्डलं परिकल्पयेत् /
आलिखेत्कमलं मध्ये पञ्चरत्नसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: one should construct a maṇḍala measuring one cubit. / In the centre one should draw a lotus provided with five gems,

sanskrit_iast:
cūrṇairaṣṭadalaṃ vṛttaṃ sitaṃ vā raktameva ca /
parivāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ bahuśobhāsamanvitam //
meaning:
चूर्णैरष्टदलं वृत्तं सितं वा रक्तमेव च /
परिवारेण संयुक्तं बहुशोभासमन्वितम् //
text_mt: an eight-petalled circle with coloured powders, white or red, / accompanied by his retinue, endowed with great beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya karṇikāyāṃ tu śivaṃ paramakāraṇam /
arcayetsarvayatnena yathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
आवाह्य कर्णिकायां तु शिवं परमकारणम् /
अर्चयेत्सर्वयत्नेन यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Having invoked Śiva, the supreme cause, upon the pericarp, / one should worship him with every effort according to the extent of one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
daleṣu siddhayaḥ proktāḥ karṇikāyāṃ mahāmune /
vairāgyajñānanālaṃ ca dharmakandaṃ manoramam //
meaning:
दलेषु सिद्धयः प्रोक्ताः कर्णिकायां महामुने /
वैराग्यज्ञाननालं च धर्मकन्दं मनोरमम् //
text_mt: The accomplishments are said to reside on the petals, O great sage, and [the Lord] on the pericarp; / the stalk is dispassion and knowledge, and the bulb is charming righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī vikaraṇī tathā /
balavikaraṇīcaiva balapramathinī kramāt //
meaning:
वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च काली विकरणी तथा /
बलविकरणीचैव बलप्रमथिनी क्रमात् //
text_mt: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Vikaraṇī, / Balavikaraṇī, and Balapramathinī in order,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtasya damanī kesareṣu ca śaktayaḥ /
manonmanī mahāmāya karṇikāyāṃ śivāsane //
meaning:
सर्वभूतस्य दमनी केसरेषु च शक्तयः /
मनोन्मनी महामाय कर्णिकायां शिवासने //
text_mt: and Sarvabhūtadamanī: these are the Śaktis on the filaments. / Manonmanī, Mahāmāyā, is on the pericarp, on the seat of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dvandvanyāyena vinyaset /
manonmanaṃ mahādevaṃ manonmanyātha madhyataḥ //
meaning:
वामदेवादिभिः सार्धं द्वन्द्वन्यायेन विन्यसेत् /
मनोन्मनं महादेवं मनोन्मन्याथ मध्यतः //
text_mt: One should install them together with Vāmadeva and the others, in pairs. / Then [one should install] Mahādeva as Manonmana in the centre with Manonmanī.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryasomāgnisaṃbandhātpraṇavākhyaṃ śivātmakam /
puruṣaṃ vinyasedvaktraṃ pūrve patre raviprabham //
meaning:
सूर्यसोमाग्निसंबन्धात्प्रणवाख्यं शिवात्मकम् /
पुरुषं विन्यसेद्वक्त्रं पूर्वे पत्रे रविप्रभम् //
text_mt: Due to the connection with sun, moon, and fire, it is called Praṇava, possessing the nature of Śiva. / One should install the face Puruṣa, shining like the sun, on the eastern petal;

sanskrit_iast:
aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe pātre nīlāñjanacayopamam /
uttare vāmadevākhyaṃ japākusumasannibham //
meaning:
अघोरं दक्षिणे पात्रे नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् /
उत्तरे वामदेवाख्यं जपाकुसुमसन्निभम् //
text_mt: Aghora on the southern petal, resembling a mass of blue collyrium; / on the northern [petal], the one called Vāmadeva, resembling a hibiscus flower;

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaṃ paścimapatre tu gokṣīradhavalaṃ nyasen /
īśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu śuddhasphaṭikasannibham //
meaning:
सद्यं पश्चिमपत्रे तु गोक्षीरधवलं न्यसेन् /
ईशानं कर्णिकायां तु शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभम् //
text_mt: on the western petal, one should install Sadyojāta, white as cow's milk; / and Īśāna on the pericarp, resembling pure crystal,

sanskrit_iast:
candramaṇḍalasaṃkāśaṃ hṛdayāyeti mantrataḥ /
vāhneye rudradigbhāge śirase dhūmravarcase //
meaning:
चन्द्रमण्डलसंकाशं हृदयायेति मन्त्रतः /
वाह्नेये रुद्रदिग्भागे शिरसे धूम्रवर्चसे //
text_mt: resembling the lunar disc, with the mantra 'To the heart'. / In the south-eastern direction, Rudra's quarter, [one installs the mantra] for the head, smoke-coloured;

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyai ca namaścoti raktābhe nairṛte dale /
kavacāyāñjanābhāya iti vāyudalenyaset //
meaning:
शिखायै च नमश्चोति रक्ताभे नैरृते दले /
कवचायाञ्जनाभाय इति वायुदलेन्यसेत् //
text_mt: [saying] 'Obeisance to the tuft' on the red-hued south-western petal; / [saying] 'To the armour, of collyrium hue' one should install it on the north-western petal;

sanskrit_iast:
astrāyāgnisikhābhāya iti dikṣu pravinyaset /
netrebhyaśceti caiśānyāṃ piṅgalebhyaḥ pravinyesat //
meaning:
अस्त्रायाग्निसिखाभाय इति दिक्षु प्रविन्यसेत् /
नेत्रेभ्यश्चेति चैशान्यां पिङ्गलेभ्यः प्रविन्येसत् //
text_mt: [saying] 'To the weapon, resembling a flame of fire' one should install it in the directions; / and [saying] 'To the tawny eyes' one should install it in the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ sadā śivaṃ devaṃ maheśvaramataḥ param /
rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ viriñciṃ ca sṛṣṭinyāyena bhāvayet //
meaning:
शिवं सदा शिवं देवं महेश्वरमतः परम् /
रुद्रं विष्णुं विरिञ्चिं च सृष्टिन्यायेन भावयेत् //
text_mt: One should meditate upon Śiva, Sadāśiva, the god Maheśvara, and beyond him / Rudra, Viṣṇu, and Viriñci, according to the order of creation:

sanskrit_iast:
śivāya rudrarūpāya śāntyatītāya śaṃbhave /
śāntāya śāntadaityāya namaścandramase tathā //
meaning:
शिवाय रुद्ररूपाय शान्त्यतीताय शंभवे /
शान्ताय शान्तदैत्याय नमश्चन्द्रमसे तथा //
text_mt: 'To Śiva, having the form of Rudra, beyond peace, to Śambhu, / to the peaceful one, to the one who quieted the daityas, and obeisance to the Moon;

sanskrit_iast:
vedyāya vidyādhārāya vahnaye vahnivarcase /
kālāyai ca pratiṣṭhāyai tārakāyāntakāya ca //
meaning:
वेद्याय विद्याधाराय वह्नये वह्निवर्चसे /
कालायै च प्रतिष्ठायै तारकायान्तकाय च //
text_mt: to the knowable, the foundation of knowledge, to Fire, having the splendour of fire; / to Kālā, to Pratiṣṭhā, to the deliverer, to the destroyer;

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttyai dhanadevāya dhārāyai dhāraṇāya ca /
mantrairetairmahābhūtavigrahaṃ ca sadāśivam //
meaning:
निवृत्त्यै धनदेवाय धारायै धारणाय च /
मन्त्रैरेतैर्महाभूतविग्रहं च सदाशिवम् //
text_mt: to Nivṛtti, to the god of wealth, to Dhārā, and to Dhāraṇa.' / With these mantras, [one meditates upon] Sadāśiva, whose body consists of the great elements;

sanskrit_iast:
īśānamukuṭaṃ devaṃ puruṣāsyaṃ purātanam /
aghora hṛdayaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ vāmaguhyaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
ईशानमुकुटं देवं पुरुषास्यं पुरातनम् /
अघोर हृदयं हृष्टं वामगुह्यं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: the god whose diadem is Īśāna, whose face is Puruṣa, the ancient one, / whose heart is Aghora, the delighted one, whose secret part is Vāma, Maheśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
sadyamūrti smareddevaṃ sadasadvyaktikāraṇam /
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujamaṣṭatriṃśatkalāmayam //
meaning:
सद्यमूर्ति स्मरेद्देवं सदसद्व्यक्तिकारणम् /
पञ्चवक्त्रं दशभुजमष्टत्रिंशत्कलामयम् //
text_mt: one should remember the god whose form is Sadyojāta, the cause of the manifest and unmanifest, / five-faced, ten-armed, composed of thirty-eight kalās;

sanskrit_iast:
sadyamaṣṭaprakāreṇa prabhidya ca kalāmayam /
vāmaṃ trayodaśavidhaurvibhidya vitataṃ prabhum //
meaning:
सद्यमष्टप्रकारेण प्रभिद्य च कलामयम् /
वामं त्रयोदशविधौर्विभिद्य विततं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: having divided Sadyojāta into eight aspects composed of kalās; / having divided Vāmadeva into thirteen kinds, the pervasive lord;

sanskrit_iast:
aghoramaṣṭadhā kṛtvā kalārūpeṇa saṃsthitam /
puruṣaṃ ca caturdhā vai vibhajya ca kalāmayam //
meaning:
अघोरमष्टधा कृत्वा कलारूपेण संस्थितम् /
पुरुषं च चतुर्धा वै विभज्य च कलामयम् //
text_mt: having made Aghora eightfold, abiding in the form of kalās; / and having divided Puruṣa into four, composed of kalās;

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā pañcamūrtyā vyavasthitam /
haṃsahaṃseti mantreṇa śivabhaktyā samanvitam //
meaning:
ईशानं पञ्चधा कृत्वा पञ्चमूर्त्या व्यवस्थितम् /
हंसहंसेति मन्त्रेण शिवभक्त्या समन्वितम् //
text_mt: having made Īśāna fivefold, established in five forms, / with the mantra 'haṃsa haṃsa', endowed with devotion to Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāramātramoṅkāramakāraṃ samarūpiṇam /
ā ī ū e tathā aṃbānukrameṇātmarūpiṇam //
meaning:
ओङ्कारमात्रमोङ्कारमकारं समरूपिणम् /
आ ई ऊ ए तथा अंबानुक्रमेणात्मरूपिणम् //
text_mt: the syllable Om alone, the syllable Om, having the same form as the letter A; / Ā, Ī, Ū, E, and Aṃ, having the nature of the Self in due order;

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānasahitaṃ devaṃ pralayotpattivarjitam /
aṇoraṇīyāṃsamajaṃ mahato 'pi mahattamam //
meaning:
प्रधानसहितं देवं प्रलयोत्पत्तिवर्जितम् /
अणोरणीयांसमजं महतो ऽपि महत्तमम् //
text_mt: the god accompanied by Pradhāna, free from dissolution and origination, / smaller than the smallest, unborn, and greater than the greatest;

sanskrit_iast:
urdhvaretasamīśānaṃ virūpākṣamumāpatim /
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
उर्ध्वरेतसमीशानं विरूपाक्षमुमापतिम् /
सहस्रशिरसं देवं सहस्राक्षं सनातनम् //
text_mt: the one whose seed is drawn up, Īśāna, Virūpākṣa, the lord of Umā, / the thousand-headed god, thousand-eyed, eternal;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrahastacaraṇaṃ nādāntaṃ nādavigraham /
khadyotasadṛśākāraṃ candrarekhākṛti prabhum //
meaning:
सहस्रहस्तचरणं नादान्तं नादविग्रहम् /
खद्योतसदृशाकारं चन्द्ररेखाकृति प्रभुम् //
text_mt: having a thousand hands and feet, the end of sound, whose embodiment is sound, / having a form like a firefly, the lord shaped like a crescent moon;

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśānte bhruvormadhye tālumadhye gale kramāt /
hṛddeśe 'vasthitaṃ devaṃ svānandamamṛtaṃ śivam //
meaning:
द्वादशान्ते भ्रुवोर्मध्ये तालुमध्ये गले क्रमात् /
हृद्देशे ऽवस्थितं देवं स्वानन्दममृतं शिवम् //
text_mt: at the dvādaśānta, between the eyebrows, in the middle of the palate, in the throat in order, / the god abiding in the region of the heart, his own bliss, immortal Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyudvalayasaṃkāśaṃ vidyutkoṭisamaprabham /
śyāmaṃ raktaṃ kalākāraṃ śaktitrayakṛtāsanam //
meaning:
विद्युद्वलयसंकाशं विद्युत्कोटिसमप्रभम् /
श्यामं रक्तं कलाकारं शक्तित्रयकृतासनम् //
text_mt: resembling a ring of lightning, shining like ten million lightning bolts, / dark, red, formed of kalās, whose seat is made of the three Śaktis;

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaṃ smareddevaṃ tattvatrayasamanvitam /
vidyāmūrtimayaṃ deva pūjayecca yathākramāt //
meaning:
सदाशिवं स्मरेद्देवं तत्त्वत्रयसमन्वितम् /
विद्यामूर्तिमयं देव पूजयेच्च यथाक्रमात् //
text_mt: one should remember the god Sadāśiva, endowed with the three principles of reality; / and one should worship the god, who consists of the forms of knowledge, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālāṃstathāstreṇa pūrvādyānpūjayet pṛthak /
caruṃ ca vidhināsādya śivāya vinivedayet //
meaning:
लोकपालांस्तथास्त्रेण पूर्वाद्यान्पूजयेत् पृथक् /
चरुं च विधिनासाद्य शिवाय विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Likewise, one should worship the guardians of the world separately with the weapon mantra, starting from the east; / and having properly prepared the caru offering, one should present it to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhaṃ śivāya dattvaiva śeṣardhena tu homayet /
aghoreṇātha śiṣyāya dāpayedbhoktumuttamam //
meaning:
अर्धं शिवाय दत्त्वैव शेषर्धेन तु होमयेत् /
अघोरेणाथ शिष्याय दापयेद्भोक्तुमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having offered half to Śiva, one should perform homa with the remaining half; / then with the Aghora [mantra] one should give the excellent [remnant] to the pupil to consume.

sanskrit_iast:
upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā puruṣaṃ vidhinā yajet /
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya īśānenābhimantritam //
meaning:
उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा पुरुषं विधिना यजेत् /
पञ्चगव्यं ततः प्राश्य ईशानेनाभिमन्त्रितम् //
text_mt: Having sipped water and become pure, one should worship Puruṣa according to the rule; / then, having consumed the pañcagavya consecrated with the Īśāna [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevena bhasmāṅgī bhasmanoddhūlayetkramāt /
karṇayośca japeddevīṃ gāyatrīṃ rudradevatām //
meaning:
वामदेवेन भस्माङ्गी भस्मनोद्धूलयेत्क्रमात् /
कर्णयोश्च जपेद्देवीं गायत्रीं रुद्रदेवताम् //
text_mt: with limbs smeared with sacred ash by means of Vāmadeva, one should dust himself with sacred ash in order; / and in his ears one should whisper the divine Gāyatrī having Rudra as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
sasūtraṃ sapidhānaṃ ca vastrayugmena veṣṭitam /
tatpūrvaṃ hemaratnaughairvāsitaṃ vai hiraṇmayam //
meaning:
ससूत्रं सपिधानं च वस्त्रयुग्मेन वेष्टितम् /
तत्पूर्वं हेमरत्नौघैर्वासितं वै हिरण्मयम् //
text_mt:
with string, with a lid, and wrapped with a pair of cloths,
filled beforehand with a multitude of gold and jewels, indeed golden.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśānvinyasetpañca pañcabhirbrāhmaṇaistataḥ /
homaṃ ca caruṇā kuryādyathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
कलशान्विन्यसेत्पञ्च पञ्चभिर्ब्राह्मणैस्ततः /
होमं च चरुणा कुर्याद्यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Then five pitchers should be set in place by five brāhmaṇas; / and one should perform homa with caru according to the extent of one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaṃ ca vāsayedbhaktaṃ dakṣiṇe maṇḍalasya tu /
darbhaśayyāsamārūḍhaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇam //
meaning:
शिष्यं च वासयेद्भक्तं दक्षिणे मण्डलस्य तु /
दर्भशय्यासमारूढं शिवध्यानपरायणम् //
text_mt: And he should lodge the devoted disciple to the south of the maṇḍala, / resting on a bed of darbha grass, wholly devoted to meditation on Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
aghoreṇa yathānyāyamaṣṭottaraśataṃ punaḥ /
ghṛtena hutvā duḥsvapnaṃ prabhāte śodhayenmalam //
meaning:
अघोरेण यथान्यायमष्टोत्तरशतं पुनः /
घृतेन हुत्वा दुःस्वप्नं प्रभाते शोधयेन्मलम् //
text_mt: Then, having offered clarified butter a hundred and eight times with the Aghora [mantra] according to rule, / in the morning he should purify the evil dream [and] impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ copoṣitaṃ śiṣyaṃ snātaṃ bhūṣitavigraham /
navavastrottarīyaṃ ca soṣṇīṣaṃ kṛtamaṅgalam //
meaning:
एवं चोपोषितं शिष्यं स्नातं भूषितविग्रहम् /
नववस्त्रोत्तरीयं च सोष्णीषं कृतमङ्गलम् //
text_mt: And so, to the disciple who has fasted, bathed, and adorned his person, / wearing a new garment and upper cloth, with a turban and auspicious marks applied,

sanskrit_iast:
dukūlādyena vastreṇa netraṃ baddhvā praveśayet /
suvarṇapuṣpasaṃmiśraṃ yatāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
दुकूलाद्येन वस्त्रेण नेत्रं बद्ध्वा प्रवेशयेत् /
सुवर्णपुष्पसंमिश्रं यताविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: having bound his eyes with a cloth such as silk, he should lead him in, / mixed with gold and flowers according to the extent of his wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānena ca mantreṇa kuryātpuṣpāñjaliṃ prabhoḥ /
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā rudrādhyāyena vā punaḥ //
meaning:
ईशानेन च मन्त्रेण कुर्यात्पुष्पाञ्जलिं प्रभोः /
प्रदक्षिणात्रयं कृत्वा रुद्राध्यायेन वा पुनः //
text_mt: And with the Īśāna mantra he should make a flower-offering to the Lord, / having performed three circumambulations, or else with the Rudrādhyāya,

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ praṇavenātha śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ /
dhyātvā tu devadeveśamīśāne saṃkṣipetsvayam //
meaning:
केवलं प्रणवेनाथ शिवध्यानपरायणः /
ध्यात्वा तु देवदेवेशमीशाने संक्षिपेत्स्वयम् //
text_mt: or solely with the Praṇava; then, devoted to meditation on Śiva, / having contemplated the God of gods, he should himself cast [the flowers] toward Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminmantre patetpuṣpaṃ tanmantrastasya sidhyati /
śivāṃbhasā tu saṃspṛśya avoreṇa ca bhasmanā //
meaning:
यस्मिन्मन्त्रे पतेत्पुष्पं तन्मन्त्रस्तस्य सिध्यति /
शिवांभसा तु संस्पृश्य अवोरेण च भस्मना //
text_mt: Upon whichever mantra the flower falls, that mantra succeeds for him. / Having touched him with Śiva-water and with sacred ash using the Aghora [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyamūrdhani vinyasya gandhādyaiḥ śiṣyamarcayet /
vāruṇaṃ paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dvāraṃ vai sarvavarṇinām //
meaning:
शिष्यमूर्धनि विन्यस्य गन्धाद्यैः शिष्यमर्चयेत् /
वारुणं परमं श्रेष्ठं द्वारं वै सर्ववर्णिनाम् //
text_mt: and having placed [it] on the disciple's head, he should worship the disciple with scents and the like. / The western [entrance] is the supreme and foremost door for all castes;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣattriyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa dvāraṃ vai paścimaṃ smṛtam /
netrāvaraṇamunmucya maṇḍalaṃ darśayettataḥ //
meaning:
क्षत्त्रियाणां विशेषेण द्वारं वै पश्चिमं स्मृतम् /
नेत्रावरणमुन्मुच्य मण्डलं दर्शयेत्ततः //
text_mt: for kṣatriyas in particular, the western door is prescribed. / Then, having removed the eye-covering, he should show him the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāsena tu saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsthitaḥ /
tattvaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryātpañcatattvaprakārataḥ //
meaning:
कुशासेन तु संस्थाप्य दक्षिणामूर्तिमास्थितः /
तत्त्वशुद्धिं ततः कुर्यात्पञ्चतत्त्वप्रकारतः //
text_mt: Having seated him on a seat of kuśa grass, facing the south, / he should then perform the purification of the tattvas by means of the five tattvas.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttyā rudraparyantamaṇḍamañjodbhavātmaja /
pratiṣṭhayā tadūrdhvaṃ ca yāvadavyaktagocaram //
meaning:
निवृत्त्या रुद्रपर्यन्तमण्डमञ्जोद्भवात्मज /
प्रतिष्ठया तदूर्ध्वं च यावदव्यक्तगोचरम् //
text_mt: O son of the lotus-born [Brahmā], through Nivṛtti [he purifies] the egg up to Rudra; / and through Pratiṣṭhā [the sphere] above that, as far as the unmanifest range.

sanskrit_iast:
viśveśvarāntaṃ vai vidyā kalāmātreṇa suvrata /
tadūrdhvamārgaṃ saṃśodhya śivabhaktyā śivaṃ nayet //
meaning:
विश्वेश्वरान्तं वै विद्या कलामात्रेण सुव्रत /
तदूर्ध्वमार्गं संशोध्य शिवभक्त्या शिवं नयेत् //
text_mt: Through Vidyā [he purifies] as far as Viśveśvara by the mere kalā, O you of noble vows; / having purified the path above that, he should lead [him] to Śiva through devotion to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
samarcanāya tattvasya tasya bhogeśvarasya vai /
tattvatrayaprabhedena caturbhiruta vā tathā //
meaning:
समर्चनाय तत्त्वस्य तस्य भोगेश्वरस्य वै /
तत्त्वत्रयप्रभेदेन चतुर्भिरुत वा तथा //
text_mt: For the sake of worship of that tattva, of the Lord of enjoyment, / by the division of the three tattvas, or indeed with four,

sanskrit_iast:
homayed aṅgamantreṇa śāntyatītaṃ sadāśivam /
sadyādibhistu śāntyantaṃ caturbhiḥ kalayā pṛthak //
meaning:
होमयेद् अङ्गमन्त्रेण शान्त्यतीतं सदाशिवम् /
सद्यादिभिस्तु शान्त्यन्तं चतुर्भिः कलया पृथक् //
text_mt: he should offer into the fire with the limb-mantra to Sadāśiva, who is beyond Śānti, / and separately with the four [mantras] beginning with Sadyo[jāta] up to Śānti, by means of the kalā.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntyatītaṃ muniśreṣṭha īśānenāthavā punaḥ /
pratyekamaṣṭottaraśataṃ diśā homaṃ tu kārayet //
meaning:
शान्त्यतीतं मुनिश्रेष्ठ ईशानेनाथवा पुनः /
प्रत्येकमष्टोत्तरशतं दिशा होमं तु कारयेत् //
text_mt: Or else to Śāntyatīta with Īśāna, O best of sages; / he should cause oblation to be made toward each direction a hundred and eight times.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānyāṃ pañcamonātha pradhānaṃ parigīyate /
samidājyacarūṃl lājān sarṣapāṃś ca yavāṃs tilān //
meaning:
ईशान्यां पञ्चमोनाथ प्रधानं परिगीयते /
समिदाज्यचरूंल् लाजान् सर्षपांश् च यवांस् तिलान् //
text_mt: In the northeast is the fifth, O lord, proclaimed as the principal one. / Sacrificial twigs, clarified butter, caru, parched grains, mustard seeds, barley, and sesame seeds—

sanskrit_iast:
dravyāṇi sapta hotavyaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikam /
teṣāṃ pūrṇāhutirvipra īśānena vidhīyate //
meaning:
द्रव्याणि सप्त होतव्यं स्वाहान्तं प्रणवादिकम् /
तेषां पूर्णाहुतिर्विप्र ईशानेन विधीयते //
text_mt: seven substances are to be offered, ending with Svāhā and beginning with the Praṇava. / O twice-born, the final oblation of these is prescribed with Īśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
sahaṃsena yathānyāyaṃ praṇavādyena suvrata /
aghoreṇa ca mantreṇa prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
सहंसेन यथान्यायं प्रणवाद्येन सुव्रत /
अघोरेण च मन्त्रेण प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते //
text_mt: together with Haṃsa, according to rule, beginning with the Praṇava, O you of noble vows; / and expiation is prescribed with the Aghora mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
jayādisviṣṭaparyantamagnikāryaṃ krameṇa tu /
guṇasaṃkhyāprakāreṇa pradhānena ca yojayet //
meaning:
जयादिस्विष्टपर्यन्तमग्निकार्यं क्रमेण तु /
गुणसंख्याप्रकारेण प्रधानेन च योजयेत् //
text_mt: The fire-rite [proceeds] in order up to the Svistakṛt and the Jaya [oblations]; / he should connect it with the principal [entity] according to the number of guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāni brahmabhirvāpi maunī bījādibhistathā /
atha pradhānamātreṇa prāṇāpānau niyamya ca //
meaning:
भूतानि ब्रह्मभिर्वापि मौनी बीजादिभिस्तथा /
अथ प्रधानमात्रेण प्राणापानौ नियम्य च //
text_mt: Either the elements with the Brahma-mantras, silent, with the seed-syllables and so forth, / then by the principal [mantra] alone, having restrained the prāṇa and apāna,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhena bhedayedātmapraṇavāntaṃ kulākulam /
anyo 'nyamupasaṃhṛtya brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ haram //
meaning:
षष्ठेन भेदयेदात्मप्रणवान्तं कुलाकुलम् /
अन्यो ऽन्यमुपसंहृत्य ब्रह्माणं केशवं हरम् //
text_mt: with the sixth [mantra] he should pierce the kulākula ending with his own praṇava, / dissolving Brahmā, Keśava, and Hara into one another,

sanskrit_iast:
rudre rudraṃ tamīśāne śive devaṃ maheśvaram /
tasmātsṛṣṭiprakārema bhāvayedbhavanāśanam //
meaning:
रुद्रे रुद्रं तमीशाने शिवे देवं महेश्वरम् /
तस्मात्सृष्टिप्रकारेम भावयेद्भवनाशनम् //
text_mt: [Brahmā and Keśava] into Rudra, that Rudra into Īśāna, and the god Maheśvara into Śiva; / therefore, according to the process of creation, he should meditate on the destroyer of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpyātmanamamuṃ jīvaṃ tāḍanaṃ dvāradarśanam /
dīpanaṃ grahaṇaṃ caiva bandhanaṃ pūjayā saha //
meaning:
स्थाप्यात्मनममुं जीवं ताडनं द्वारदर्शनम् /
दीपनं ग्रहणं चैव बन्धनं पूजया सह //
text_mt: Having established this soul, the self: striking, showing the door, / illuminating, seizing, and binding, along with worship,

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ caiva kārayedvidhipūrvakam /
paṣṭhāntaṃ sadyasaṃyuktaṃ tṛtīyena samanvitam //
meaning:
अमृतीकरणं चैव कारयेद्विधिपूर्वकम् /
पष्ठान्तं सद्यसंयुक्तं तृतीयेन समन्वितम् //
text_mt: and he should duly cause immortalisation to be performed. / Ending with the sixth, joined with Sadyo[jāta], and accompanied by the third,

sanskrit_iast:
phaḍantaṃ saṃhṛtiḥ proktā pañcabhūtaprakārataḥ /
sadyādyaṣaṣṭhasahitaṃ śikhāntaṃ saphaḍantakam //
meaning:
फडन्तं संहृतिः प्रोक्ता पञ्चभूतप्रकारतः /
सद्याद्यषष्ठसहितं शिखान्तं सफडन्तकम् //
text_mt: ending in Phaṭ, dissolution is taught according to the five elements. / Joined with the sixth beginning with Sadyo[jāta], ending with Śikhā, and ending in Phaṭ,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍanaṃ kathitaṃ dvāraṃ tattvānāmapi yoginaḥ /
pradhānaṃ saṃpuṭīkṛtya tṛtīyena ca dīpanam //
meaning:
ताडनं कथितं द्वारं तत्त्वानामपि योगिनः /
प्रधानं संपुटीकृत्य तृतीयेन च दीपनम् //
text_mt: striking is proclaimed as the entrance to the tattvas for yogins. / Enclosing the principal [mantra] with the third is illuminating;

sanskrit_iast:
ādyena saṃpuṭīkṛtya pradhānaṃ grahaṇaṃ smṛtam /
pradhānaṃ prathamenaiva saṃpuṭīkṛtya pūrvavat //
meaning:
आद्येन संपुटीकृत्य प्रधानं ग्रहणं स्मृतम् /
प्रधानं प्रथमेनैव संपुटीकृत्य पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: enclosing the principal [mantra] with the first is taught as seizing; / having enclosed the principal [mantra] with the first as before,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhanaṃ paripūrṇena plāvanaṃ cāmṛtena ca /
śāntya tītā tataḥ śāntirvidyā nāma kalāmalā //
meaning:
बन्धनं परिपूर्णेन प्लावनं चामृतेन च /
शान्त्य तीता ततः शान्तिर्विद्या नाम कलामला //
text_mt: binding [is done] with the complete [mantra], and inundation with nectar. / Śāntyatītā, then Śānti, the spotless kalā named Vidyā,

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśca kalāsaṃkramaṇaṃ smṛtā /
tattvavarṇakalāyuktaṃ bhuvanena yathākramam //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिश्च कलासंक्रमणं स्मृता /
तत्त्ववर्णकलायुक्तं भुवनेन यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: and Pratiṣṭhā and Nivṛtti are taught as the transition of kalās. / Endowed with the tattvas, letters, and kalās, in due order with the world,

sanskrit_iast:
mantraiḥ pādaiḥ stavaṃ kuryādviśodhya ca yathāvidhi /
ādyena yonibījena kalpayitvā ca pūrvavat //
meaning:
मन्त्रैः पादैः स्तवं कुर्याद्विशोध्य च यथाविधि /
आद्येन योनिबीजेन कल्पयित्वा च पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: he should make praise with mantras and quarters of verse, and having purified [it] according to rule, / having fashioned it as before with the first womb-seed [syllable],

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ viddhi tāḍanaṃ haraṇaṃ tathā /
saṃhatasya ca saṃyogaṃ vikṣepaṃ ca yathākramam //
meaning:
पूजासंप्रोक्षणं विद्धि ताडनं हरणं तथा /
संहतस्य च संयोगं विक्षेपं च यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: know worship and sprinkling, striking and extraction, / the union of what was brought together, and scattering in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
arcanā ca tathā garbhadhāraṇaṃ jananaṃ punaḥ /
adhikāro bhavedbhānorlayaścaiva viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अर्चना च तथा गर्भधारणं जननं पुनः /
अधिकारो भवेद्भानोर्लयश्चैव विशेषतः //
text_mt: and worship, the holding of the womb, then birth, / the authority of the sun, and particularly dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamādyaṃ tathāntyena yonibījena suvrata /
uddāre prokṣaṇe caiva tāḍane ca mahāmune //
meaning:
उत्तमाद्यं तथान्त्येन योनिबीजेन सुव्रत /
उद्दारे प्रोक्षणे चैव ताडने च महामुने //
text_mt: The highest first and also with the last womb-seed, O you of noble vows, / in elevation, sprinkling, and striking, O great sage,

sanskrit_iast:
aghoreṇa phaḍantena saṃsṛtiśca na saṃśayaḥ /
pratitattvaṃ kramo hyeṣa yogamārgeṇa suvrata //
meaning:
अघोरेण फडन्तेन संसृतिश्च न संशयः /
प्रतितत्त्वं क्रमो ह्येष योगमार्गेण सुव्रत //
text_mt: and with the Aghora [mantra] ending in Phaṭ, transmigration undoubtedly [is severed]. / This indeed is the sequence for each tattva along the path of yoga, O you of noble vows.

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṭinā caiva yāvacca tāvatkālaṃ nayetkramāt /
viṣuveṇa tu yogena nivṛttyādi śivāntikam //
meaning:
मुष्टिना चैव यावच्च तावत्कालं नयेत्क्रमात् /
विषुवेण तु योगेन निवृत्त्यादि शिवान्तिकम् //
text_mt: And as far as with the fist, for that long he should lead it in order; / by yoga during the equinox, [the path] beginning with Nivṛtti up to the vicinity of Śiva

sanskrit_iast:
ekatra samatāṃ yāti nānyathā tu pṛthakpṛthak /
nāsāgre dvādaśāntena pṛṣṭhena saha yoginām //
meaning:
एकत्र समतां याति नान्यथा तु पृथक्पृथक् /
नासाग्रे द्वादशान्तेन पृष्ठेन सह योगिनाम् //
text_mt: attains equality in one place, not separately otherwise. / At the tip of the nose, together with the dvādaśānta at the back, for yogins,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣantavyamiti viprendra devadevasya śāsanam /
hemarājatatāmrādyairvidhinā kalpitena ca //
meaning:
क्षन्तव्यमिति विप्रेन्द्र देवदेवस्य शासनम् /
हेमराजतताम्राद्यैर्विधिना कल्पितेन च //
text_mt: it must be endured, O best of twice-born: this is the command of the God of gods. / And with [a vessel] made of gold, silver, copper, and the like according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
sakūrcena savastreṇa tantunā veṣṭitena ca /
tīrthāṃbupūritenaiva ratnagarbheṇa suvrata //
meaning:
सकूर्चेन सवस्त्रेण तन्तुना वेष्टितेन च /
तीर्थांबुपूरितेनैव रत्नगर्भेण सुव्रत //
text_mt: with a brush of kuśa grass, with cloth, wrapped with thread, / filled with sacred water, containing gems inside, O you of noble vows,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhitāmāntritenaiva rudrādhyāyastutena ca /
secayecca tataḥ śiṣyaṃ śivabhaktaṃ ca dhārmikam //
meaning:
संहितामान्त्रितेनैव रुद्राध्यायस्तुतेन च /
सेचयेच्च ततः शिष्यं शिवभक्तं च धार्मिकम् //
text_mt: consecrated with the Saṃhitā, and praised with the Rudrādhyāya, / he should then sprinkle the disciple who is devoted to Śiva and righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi śiṣyaḥ śivasyāgre suroragre ca sādaram /
vahneśca dīkṣāṃ kurvīta dīkṣitaśca tathācaret //
meaning:
सो ऽपि शिष्यः शिवस्याग्रे सुरोरग्रे च सादरम् /
वह्नेश्च दीक्षां कुर्वीत दीक्षितश्च तथाचरेत् //
text_mt: That disciple, too, before Śiva, before the guru, and respectfully / before the fire should receive initiation; and initiated, he should conduct himself accordingly:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaśchedanaṃ śiraso 'pi vā /
na tvanabhyarcya bhuñjīyādbhagavantaṃ sadāśivam //
meaning:
वरं प्राणपरित्यागश्छेदनं शिरसो ऽपि वा /
न त्वनभ्यर्च्य भुञ्जीयाद्भगवन्तं सदाशिवम् //
text_mt: Better to abandon one's life, or the cutting off of one's head, / but one should not eat without having worshipped the Lord Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dīkṣā prakartavyā pūjā caiva yatākramam /
trikālamekakālaṃ vā pūjayetparameśvaram //
meaning:
एवं दीक्षा प्रकर्तव्या पूजा चैव यताक्रमम् /
त्रिकालमेककालं वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Thus initiation should be performed, and worship according to rule; / he should worship the Supreme Lord at the three times of day, or once [daily].

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraṃ ca vedāśca yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ /
śivaliṅgārcanasyaite kalāṃśenāpi no samāḥ //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रं च वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च बहुदक्षिणाः /
शिवलिङ्गार्चनस्यैते कलांशेनापि नो समाः //
text_mt: The agnihotra, the Vedas, and sacrifices with abundant gifts / are not equal to even a fraction of a portion of the worship of the Śivaliṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā yajati yajñena sadā dānaṃ prayacchati /
sadā ca vāyubhakṣaśca sakṛdyo 'bhyarcayecchivam //
meaning:
सदा यजति यज्ञेन सदा दानं प्रयच्छति /
सदा च वायुभक्षश्च सकृद्यो ऽभ्यर्चयेच्छिवम् //
text_mt: He sacrifices always with a sacrifice, he gives gifts always, / and he lives on air always, who worships Śiva even once.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityameva vā /
yor'cayānti mahādevaṃ te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं नित्यमेव वा /
योर्ऽचयान्ति महादेवं ते रुद्रा नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Those who worship Mahādeva once, twice, three times, or constantly, / are Rudras, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
nārudrastu spṛsedrudraṃ nārudro rudramarcayet /
nārudraḥ kīrtayedrūdraṃ nārudro rudramāpnuyāt //
meaning:
नारुद्रस्तु स्पृसेद्रुद्रं नारुद्रो रुद्रमर्चयेत् /
नारुद्रः कीर्तयेद्रूद्रं नारुद्रो रुद्रमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: One who is not a Rudra may not touch Rudra; one who is not a Rudra may not worship Rudra; / one who is not a Rudra may not praise Rudra; one who is not a Rudra cannot attain Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ prokto hyadhikārividhikramaḥ /
śivārcanārthaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣaphalapradaḥ //
iti śrīliṃṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge dīkṣāvidhirnāmaikaviṃśatitamodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो ह्यधिकारिविधिक्रमः /
शिवार्चनार्थं धर्मार्थकाममोक्षफलप्रदः //
इति श्रीलिंङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे दीक्षाविधिर्नामैकविंशतितमोध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus in brief the order of rules for an eligible person has been declared / for the sake of worshipping Śiva, bestowing the fruit of righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation.

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, named the Rules of Initiation, in the Latter Part of the glorious Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
snānayāgādikarmāṇi kṛtvā vai bhaskarasya ca /
śivasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryādbhasmasnānaṃ śivārcanam //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
स्नानयागादिकर्माणि कृत्वा वै भस्करस्य च /
शिवस्नानं ततः कुर्याद्भस्मस्नानं शिवार्चनम् //
text_mt:
The son of Śilāda said:
Having performed the rites of bathing, sacrifice, and the like for the Sun,
one should then perform the Śiva-bath, the bath of sacred ash, [and] the worship of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhena mṛdamādāya bhaktyā bhūmaunyasenmṛdam /
dvitīyena tathābhyukṣya tṛtīyena ca śodhayet //
meaning:
षष्ठेन मृदमादाय भक्त्या भूमौन्यसेन्मृदम् /
द्वितीयेन तथाभ्युक्ष्य तृतीयेन च शोधयेत् //
text_mt:
Taking earth with the sixth [mantra], he should devotedly place the earth on the ground;
sprinkling it with the second, he should cleanse it with the third.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthenaiva vibhajenmalamekena śodhayet /
snātvā ṣaṣṭhena taccheṣāṃ mṛdaṃ hastagatāṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थेनैव विभजेन्मलमेकेन शोधयेत् /
स्नात्वा षष्ठेन तच्छेषां मृदं हस्तगतां पुनः //
text_mt:
He should divide it with the fourth, and remove impurities with the first.
Having bathed with the sixth, [taking] the remaining earth held in the hand once again,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā vibhajya sarvaṃ ca caturbhirmadhyamaṃ punaḥ /
ṣaṣṭhena saptavārāṇi vāmaṃ mūlena cālabhet /
daśavāraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhena diśo bandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिधा विभज्य सर्वं च चतुर्भिर्मध्यमं पुनः /
षष्ठेन सप्तवाराणि वामं मूलेन चालभेत् /
दशवारं च षष्ठेन दिशो बन्धः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt:
and dividing it all into three parts, and the middle one further with the four [mantras],
with the sixth, seven times, he should touch the left [arm] with the basic mantra,
and the confinement of the quarters is declared [to be performed] ten times with the sixth.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmena tīrthaṃ savyena śarīramanulipya ca /
snātvā sarvaiḥsmaran bhānumabhiṣekaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
वामेन तीर्थं सव्येन शरीरमनुलिप्य च /
स्नात्वा सर्वैःस्मरन् भानुमभिषेकं समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Smearing the sacred water with the left [hand] and the body with the right,
having bathed with all [the mantras], recollecting the Sun, he should perform the consecration,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgeṇa parṇapuṭakaiḥ pālāśena dalena vā /
saurai rebhiśca vividhaiḥ sarvāsiddhikaraiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
शृङ्गेण पर्णपुटकैः पालाशेन दलेन वा /
सौरै रेभिश्च विविधैः सर्वासिद्धिकरैः शुभैः //
text_mt:
with a horn, leaf-cups, or a palāśa leaf,
and with these various auspicious solar [mantras] that accomplish all attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
sārauṇi ca pravakṣyāmi bāṣkalādyāni suvrata /
aṅgāni sarvadeveṣu sārabhūtāni sarvataḥ //
meaning:
सारौणि च प्रवक्ष्यामि बाष्कलाद्यानि सुव्रत /
अङ्गानि सर्वदेवेषु सारभूतानि सर्वतः //
text_mt:
And I shall explain the solar [mantras] beginning with Bāṣkala, O you of noble vows,
which are limbs [of worship] among all deities and the essence everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūḥ oṃbhuvaḥ oṃsvaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃsatyam oṃ ṛtam oṃ brahmā /
navākṣaramayaṃ mantraṃ bāṣkalaṃ parikīrtitam /
na kṣaratīti lokāni ṛtamakṣaramucyate /
satyamakṣarīmatyuktaṃ praṇavādinamontakam //
meaning:
ओं भूः ओंभुवः ओंस्वः ओं महः ओं जनः ओं तपः ओंसत्यम् ओं ऋतम् ओं ब्रह्मा /
नवाक्षरमयं मन्त्रं बाष्कलं परिकीर्तितम् /
न क्षरतीति लोकानि ऋतमक्षरमुच्यते /
सत्यमक्षरीमत्युक्तं प्रणवादिनमोन्तकम् //
text_mt:
"Oṃ bhūḥ, oṃ bhuvaḥ, oṃ svaḥ, oṃ mahaḥ, oṃ janaḥ, oṃ tapaḥ, oṃ satyam, oṃ ṛtam, oṃ brahmā."
The mantra consisting of nine syllables is renowned as the Bāṣkala.
Because it does not decay (na kṣarati), it is called the imperishable ṛta of the worlds;
it is called the imperishable satya, beginning with the praṇava and ending with "namaḥ".

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūrbhavaḥ suvaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi /
oṃ namaḥ sūryāya khakholkāya namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं भूर्भवः सुवः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि /
ओं नमः सूर्याय खखोल्काय नमः //
text_mt:
"Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ. Tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi.
Oṃ namaḥ sūryāya khakholkāya namaḥ."

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantramidaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ /
navākṣareṇa dīptāsyaṃ mūlamantreṇa bhāskaram //
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रमिदं प्रोक्तं भास्करस्य महात्मनः /
नवाक्षरेण दीप्तास्यं मूलमन्त्रेण भास्करम् //
text_mt:
This is declared to be the basic mantra of the great-souled Sun.
With the nine-syllabled basic mantra, [he worships] the Sun whose face is radiant.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayendragamantrāṇi kathayāmi yatākramam /
vedādibhiḥ prabhūtādyaṃ praṇavena ca madhyamam //
meaning:
पूजयेन्द्रगमन्त्राणि कथयामि यताक्रमम् /
वेदादिभिः प्रभूताद्यं प्रणवेन च मध्यमम् //
text_mt:
One should worship the limb-mantras; I shall explain them in due order:
the initial Prabhūta and others with the beginnings of the Vedas, and the middle one with the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūḥ brahma hṛdayāya oṃ bhuvaḥ viṣṇuśirase oṃsvaḥ rudraśikhāyai oṃbhūrbhūvaḥ svaḥ jvālāmālinīśikhayai oṃ mahaḥ maheśvarāya kavacāya oñjanaḥ śivāya netrebhyaḥ
oṃ tapaḥ tāpakāya astrāya phaṭ mantrāṇi kathitānyevaṃ saurāṇi vividhāni ca /
etaiḥ śṛṅgādibhiḥ pātraiḥ svātmānamābheṣeṭayet //
meaning:
ओं भूः ब्रह्म हृदयाय ओं भुवः विष्णुशिरसे ओंस्वः रुद्रशिखायै ओंभूर्भूवः स्वः ज्वालामालिनीशिखयै ओं महः महेश्वराय कवचाय ओञ्जनः शिवाय नेत्रेभ्यः
ओं तपः तापकाय अस्त्राय फट् मन्त्राणि कथितान्येवं सौराणि विविधानि च /
एतैः शृङ्गादिभिः पात्रैः स्वात्मानमाभेषेटयेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrakuṃbhena vā vipraḥ kṣatriyo vaiśya eva ca /
sakusena sapuṣpeṇa mantraiḥ sarvai samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
ताम्रकुंभेन वा विप्रः क्षत्रियो वैश्य एव च /
सकुसेन सपुष्पेण मन्त्रैः सर्वै समाहितः //
text_mt:
Or a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya, with a copper pot,
with kuśa grass and flowers, collected in mind, with all the mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
raktavastraparīdhānaḥ svācāmedvidhipūrvakam /
sūryaścoti divā rātrau cāgniśceti dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
रक्तवस्त्रपरीधानः स्वाचामेद्विधिपूर्वकम् /
सूर्यश्चोति दिवा रात्रौ चाग्निश्चेति द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt:
dressed in red garments, should sip water according to rule:
"Sūryaś ca..." by day, and "Agniś ca..." by night, O best of the twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
āpaḥ punantu madhyāhne mantrācamanamucyate /
ṣaṣṭhena śuddhiṃ kṛtvaiva japedādyamanuttamam //
meaning:
आपः पुनन्तु मध्याह्ने मन्त्राचमनमुच्यते /
षष्ठेन शुद्धिं कृत्वैव जपेदाद्यमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
"Āpaḥ punantu..." at noon; this is called the mantra-sipping of water.
Having performed purification with the sixth, he should recite the supreme first [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
vauṣaḍantaṃ tathā mūlaṃ navākṣaramanuttamam /
karaśākhāṃ tathāṅguṣṭhamadhyamānāmikāṃ nyaset //
meaning:
वौषडन्तं तथा मूलं नवाक्षरमनुत्तमम् /
करशाखां तथाङ्गुष्ठमध्यमानामिकां न्यसेत् //
text_mt:
and the supreme nine-syllabled basic [mantra] ending in "vauṣaṭ".
He should perform the placement on the fingers of the hand, the thumb, the middle, and the ring finger,

sanskrit_iast:
tale ca tarjanyaṅguṣṭhaṃ muṣṭibhāgāni vinyaset /
navākṣaramayaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvāṅgairapi pāvitam //
meaning:
तले च तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठं मुष्टिभागानि विन्यसेत् /
नवाक्षरमयं देहं कृत्वाङ्गैरपि पावितम् //
text_mt:
and on the palm, the forefinger, the thumb, and the parts of the fist.
Having made the body composed of nine syllables and purified by the ancillary mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryo 'hamiti saṃcintya mantrairetairyathākramam /
vāmahastagatairadbhirgandhasiddhārthakānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यो ऽहमिति संचिन्त्य मन्त्रैरेतैर्यथाक्रमम् /
वामहस्तगतैरद्भिर्गन्धसिद्धार्थकान्वितैः //
text_mt:
meditating "I am the Sun," in due order with these mantras,
with water held in the left hand mixed with scent and white mustard seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśapuñjena cābhyukṣya mūlāgrairaṣṭadhā sthitaiḥ /
āpo hiṣṭhādibhiścaiva śeṣamāghrādha vai jalam //
meaning:
कुशपुञ्जेन चाभ्युक्ष्य मूलाग्रैरष्टधा स्थितैः /
आपो हिष्ठादिभिश्चैव शेषमाघ्राध वै जलम् //
text_mt:
and having sprinkled with a bunch of kuśa grass, whose roots and tips stand in eightfold division,
and with the mantras beginning with "Āpo hi ṣṭhā...", having smelled the remaining water,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanāsāpuṭenaiva dehe saṃbhāvayecchivam /
arghyamādāya dehasthaṃ savyanāsāpuṭena ca //
meaning:
वामनासापुटेनैव देहे संभावयेच्छिवम् /
अर्घ्यमादाय देहस्थं सव्यनासापुटेन च //
text_mt:
through the left nostril he should imagine Śiva within the body.
Taking the water offering present in the body, through the right nostril,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇavarṇena bāhyasthaṃ bhāvayecca śilāgatam /
tarpayetsarvadevebhya ṛṣibhyaśca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णवर्णेन बाह्यस्थं भावयेच्च शिलागतम् /
तर्पयेत्सर्वदेवेभ्य ऋषिभ्यश्च विशेषतः //
text_mt:
he should imagine it outside, of black color, fallen upon a stone.
He should offer libations to all the gods, and especially to the ṛṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca vidhinārghyaṃ ca dāpayet /
vyāpiniṃ ca parāṃ jyotsnāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samyagupāsayet //
meaning:
भूतेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च विधिनार्घ्यं च दापयेत् /
व्यापिनिं च परां ज्योत्स्नां संध्यां सम्यगुपासयेत् //
text_mt:
and to the spirits and the ancestors, and offer the water offering according to rule.
He should properly worship the all-pervading, supreme luminous dawn twilight;

sanskrit_iast:
