prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne arghyaṃ caiva nivedayet /
raktacandanatoyena hastamātreṇa maṇḍalam //
meaning:
प्रातर्मध्याह्नसायाह्ने अर्घ्यं चैव निवेदयेत् /
रक्तचन्दनतोयेन हस्तमात्रेण मण्डलम् //
text_mt:
in the morning, at noon, and in the evening, he should present the water offering.
With red sandalwood water, [he should draw] a circle measuring one cubit,

sanskrit_iast:
suvṛttaṃ kalpayedbhūmau prārthayeta dvijottamāḥ /
prāṅmukhastāmrapātraṃ ca sagandhaṃ prasthāpūritam //
meaning:
सुवृत्तं कल्पयेद्भूमौ प्रार्थयेत द्विजोत्तमाः /
प्राङ्मुखस्ताम्रपात्रं च सगन्धं प्रस्थापूरितम् //
text_mt:
a well-rounded circle he should fashion on the ground, and pray, O best of the twice-born.
Facing east, having filled a fragrant copper vessel holding a prastha,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrayedgandhatoyena raktacandanakena ca /
raktapuṣpaistilaiścaiva kuśākṣatasamanvitaiḥ //
meaning:
पूरयेद्गन्धतोयेन रक्तचन्दनकेन च /
रक्तपुष्पैस्तिलैश्चैव कुशाक्षतसमन्वितैः //
text_mt:
he should fill it with fragrant water and red sandalwood,
with red flowers, sesame seeds, kuśa grass, and unbroken grains of rice,

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāpāmārgagavyena kevalena ghṛtena ca /
āpūrya mūlamantreṇa navākṣaramayena ca /
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā deva devaṃ namasya ca //
meaning:
दूर्वापामार्गगव्येन केवलेन घृतेन च /
आपूर्य मूलमन्त्रेण नवाक्षरमयेन च /
जानुभ्यां धरणीं गत्वा देव देवं नमस्य च //
text_mt:
with dūrvā grass, apāmārga, produce of cows, and unmixed clarified butter.
Having filled it with the nine-syllabled basic mantra,
having touched the ground with both knees and bowed to the god of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātramarghya mūlena dāpayet /
aśvamedhāyutaṃ kṛtvā yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रमर्घ्य मूलेन दापयेत् /
अश्वमेधायुतं कृत्वा यत्फलं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt:
having placed that vessel upon his head, he should offer the water offering with the basic mantra.
Whatever fruit is declared from performing ten thousand horse sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
tatphalaṃ labhate dattvā saurārghyaṃ sarvasaṃmatam /
dattvaivārghyaṃ yajedbhaktyā devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam //
meaning:
तत्फलं लभते दत्त्वा सौरार्घ्यं सर्वसंमतम् /
दत्त्वैवार्घ्यं यजेद्भक्त्या देवदेवं त्रियंबकम् //
text_mt:
that fruit one attains by offering the solar water offering, agreed upon by all.
Having offered the water offering, he should worship with devotion the god of gods, Tryambaka.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā bhāskaraṃ ceṣṭvā āgneyaṃ snānamācaret /
pūrvavadvai śivasnānaṃ mantramātreṇa bheditam //
meaning:
अथवा भास्करं चेष्ट्वा आग्नेयं स्नानमाचरेत् /
पूर्ववद्वै शिवस्नानं मन्त्रमात्रेण भेदितम् //
text_mt:
Or having worshipped the Sun, he should perform the fiery bath;
the Śiva-bath is indeed as before, differentiated only by the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
dantadhāvanapūrvaṃ ca snānaṃ sauraṃ ca śāṅkaram /
vighneśaṃ varuṇaṃ caiva guruṃ tīrthaṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
दन्तधावनपूर्वं च स्नानं सौरं च शाङ्करम् /
विघ्नेशं वरुणं चैव गुरुं तीर्थं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt:
Preceded by the cleaning of teeth are the solar and the Śaiva baths.
He should worship Vighneśa, Varuṇa, the guru, and the sacred ford.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā padmāsanaṃ tīrthe tathā tīrthaṃ samarcayet /
tīrthaṃ saṃgṛhya vidhinā pūjāsthānaṃ praviśya ca //
meaning:
बद्ध्वा पद्मासनं तीर्थे तथा तीर्थं समर्चयेत् /
तीर्थं संगृह्य विधिना पूजास्थानं प्रविश्य च //
text_mt:
Having assumed the lotus posture at the sacred ford, he should worship the sacred ford in that manner.
Taking the sacred water according to rule and entering the place of worship,

sanskrit_iast:
mārgeṇārghyapavitreṇa tadākramya ca pādukam /
pūrvavatkaravinyāsaṃ dehavinyāsamācaret /
tīrthaṃ saṃgṛhya vidhinā pūjāsthānaṃ pravisya ca //
meaning:
मार्गेणार्घ्यपवित्रेण तदाक्रम्य च पादुकम् /
पूर्ववत्करविन्यासं देहविन्यासमाचरेत् /
तीर्थं संगृह्य विधिना पूजास्थानं प्रविस्य च //

sanskrit_iast:
arghyasya sādanaṃ caiva samāsātparikīrtitam /
baddhvā padmāsanaṃ yogī prāṇāyāmaṃ samabhyaset //
meaning:
अर्घ्यस्य सादनं चैव समासात्परिकीर्तितम् /
बद्ध्वा पद्मासनं योगी प्राणायामं समभ्यसेत् //
text_mt:
the preparation of the water offering is declared in brief.
Having assumed the lotus posture, the yogin should practice breath control.

sanskrit_iast:
raktapuṣpāṇi saṃgṛhya kamalādyāni bhāvayet /
ātmano dakṣiṇe sthāpya jalabhāṇḍaṃ ca vāmataḥ //
meaning:
रक्तपुष्पाणि संगृह्य कमलाद्यानि भावयेत् /
आत्मनो दक्षिणे स्थाप्य जलभाण्डं च वामतः //
text_mt:
Taking red flowers, he should visualize lotuses and the like;
placing them to his right, and the water vessel to his left,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātrāṇi saurāṇi sarvakāmārthasiddhaye /
ārghyapātraṃ samādāya prakṣālya ca yathāvidhi //
meaning:
ताम्रपात्राणि सौराणि सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये /
आर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय प्रक्षाल्य च यथाविधि //
text_mt:
copper vessels are solar, for the attainment of all desired aims.
Taking the vessel for the water offering and washing it according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktenāṃbunā sārdhaṃ jalabhāṇḍe tathaiva ca /
astrodakena caivārghyamarghyadravyasamanvitam //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेनांबुना सार्धं जलभाण्डे तथैव च /
अस्त्रोदकेन चैवार्घ्यमर्घ्यद्रव्यसमन्वितम् //
text_mt:
together with the water mentioned previously, and likewise in the water vessel,
and the water offering with weapon-water, accompanied by the offering substances,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhitāmantritaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya prathamena ca /
turīyeṇāvaguṇṭhyaiva sthāpayedātmano pari //
meaning:
संहितामन्त्रितं कृत्वा संपूज्य प्रथमेन च /
तुरीयेणावगुण्ठ्यैव स्थापयेदात्मनो परि //
text_mt:
having consecrated it with the saṃhitā mantras and worshipped it with the first,
and having veiled it with the fourth, he should place it in front of himself.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca gandhapūṣpasamanvitam /
aṃbhasā śodhite pātre stāpayetpūrvavatpṛthak /
saṃhitāṃ caiva vinyasya kavacenāvaguṇṭhyaca //
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च गन्धपूष्पसमन्वितम् /
अंभसा शोधिते पात्रे स्तापयेत्पूर्ववत्पृथक् /
संहितां चैव विन्यस्य कवचेनावगुण्ठ्यच //
text_mt:
Water for the feet and water for sipping, accompanied by perfume and flowers,
he should place separately as before in a vessel cleansed with water,
and having applied the saṃhitā mantras, he should veil it with the armor mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyābunā samabhyukṣya dravyāṇi ca viśeṣataḥ /
ādityaṃ ca japed devaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam //
meaning:
अर्घ्याबुना समभ्युक्ष्य द्रव्याणि च विशेषतः /
आदित्यं च जपेद् देवं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt:
Having sprinkled the substances especially with the water offering,
he should recite the name of the divine Āditya, worshipped by all the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
ādityo vai teja ūrjo balaṃ yaśo vivirdhati /
ityādinā namaskṛtya kalpayedāsanaṃ prabhoḥ //
meaning:
आदित्यो वै तेज ऊर्जो बलं यशो विविर्धति /
इत्यादिना नमस्कृत्य कल्पयेदासनं प्रभोः //
text_mt:
"Āditya indeed increases fiery energy, vigor, strength, and fame."
Having bowed with these words and others, he should arrange a seat for the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ sāramārāvyaṃ paramaṃ sukham /
āgnoyyādiṣu koṇeṣumadhyamāntaṃ hṛdānyaset //
meaning:
प्रभूतं विमलं सारमाराव्यं परमं सुखम् /
आग्नोय्यादिषु कोणेषुमध्यमान्तं हृदान्यसेत् //
text_mt:
Prabhūta, Vimala, Sāra, and Ārādhya, the supreme bliss:
he should place them with the heart mantra in the corners beginning with the south-east, ending with the center.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgaṃ pravinyaseccaiva bījamaṅkurameva ca /
nālaṃ suṣirasaṃ yuktaṃ sūtrakaṇṭakasaṃyutam //
meaning:
अङ्गं प्रविन्यसेच्चैव बीजमङ्कुरमेव च /
नालं सुषिरसं युक्तं सूत्रकण्टकसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
He should also place the limb, the seed, and the sprout,
the stalk endowed with hollows, and accompanied by fibers and thorns.

sanskrit_iast:
dalaṃ dalāgraṃ suśvetaṃ hemābhaṃ raktameva ca /
karṇikākesaropetaṃ dīptādyaiḥ śaktibhirvṛtam //
meaning:
दलं दलाग्रं सुश्वेतं हेमाभं रक्तमेव च /
कर्णिकाकेसरोपेतं दीप्ताद्यैः शक्तिभिर्वृतम् //
text_mt: The petals, the tips of the petals are pure white, golden, and red, / provided with a pericarp and filaments, and surrounded by the Śaktis beginning with Dīptā.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalākramāt /
aghorā vikṛtā caiva dīptādyāścāṣṭaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
दीप्ता सूक्ष्मा जया भद्रा विभूतिर्विमलाक्रमात् /
अघोरा विकृता चैव दीप्ताद्याश्चाष्टशक्तयः //
text_mt: Dīptā, Sūkṣmā, Jayā, Bhadrā, Vibhūti, Vimalā in order, / Aghorā, and Vikṛtā—these are the eight Śaktis beginning with Dīptā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarābhamukhāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ śubhāḥ /
athavā padmahastā vā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
भास्कराभमुखाः सर्वाः कृताञ्जलिपुटाः शुभाः /
अथवा पद्महस्ता वा सर्वाभरणभूषिताः //
text_mt: All having faces shining like the sun, with hands folded in supplication, auspicious, / or holding lotuses in their hands, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyato varadāṃ devīṃ sthāpayetsarvatomukhīm /
āvāhayettato devīṃ bhāskaraṃ parameśvaram //
meaning:
मध्यतो वरदां देवीं स्थापयेत्सर्वतोमुखीम् /
आवाहयेत्ततो देवीं भास्करं परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: In the centre, one should install the boon-granting goddess facing all directions; / then one should invoke the goddess, [and] the Sun, the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
navākṣareṇa mantreṇa bāṣkaloktena bhāskaram /
āvāhane ca sānnidhyamanenaiva vidhīyate //
meaning:
नवाक्षरेण मन्त्रेण बाष्कलोक्तेन भास्करम् /
आवाहने च सान्निध्यमनेनैव विधीयते //
text_mt: One invokes the Sun with the nine-syllable mantra taught by Bāṣkala; / by this alone is the invocation and presence prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
mudrā ca padmamudrākhyā bhaskarasya mahātmanaḥ /
mūle nārghyaṃ tato dadyātpādyamācamanaṃ pṛthak //
meaning:
मुद्रा च पद्ममुद्राख्या भस्करस्य महात्मनः /
मूले नार्घ्यं ततो दद्यात्पाद्यमाचमनं पृथक् //
text_mt: And the mudrā of the great-souled Sun is called the lotus-mudrā. / At the root, one should then offer arghya water, and separately foot-water and sipping-water,

sanskrit_iast:
punararghyapradānena bāṣkalena yatāvidhi /
raktapadmāni puṣpāṇi raktacandanameva ca //
meaning:
पुनरर्घ्यप्रदानेन बाष्कलेन यताविधि /
रक्तपद्मानि पुष्पाणि रक्तचन्दनमेव च //
text_mt: by offering arghya again according to rule with the Bāṣkala [mantra], / red lotuses, flowers, and red sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpadhūpādinaivedyaṃ mukhāvāsādireva ca /
tāṃbūlavartidīpādyaṃ bāṣkalena vidhīyate //
meaning:
दीपधूपादिनैवेद्यं मुखावासादिरेव च /
तांबूलवर्तिदीपाद्यं बाष्कलेन विधीयते //
text_mt: lamps, incense, food-offerings, mouth-perfumes and so forth; / betel, wick-lamps, and the like are prescribed with the Bāṣkala [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
āgnoyyāṃ ca tathaiśānyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ vāyugocare /
pūrvasyāṃ paścime caiva paṭprakāraṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
आग्नोय्यां च तथैशान्यां नैरृत्यां वायुगोचरे /
पूर्वस्यां पश्चिमे चैव पट्प्रकारं विधीयते //
text_mt: In the south-east, in the north-east, in the south-west, in the north-west, / in the east, and in the west, a sixfold manner is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
netrāntaṃ vidhinābhyarcya praṇavādinamontakam /
karṇikāyāṃ pravinyasya rūpakadhyānamācaret //
meaning:
नेत्रान्तं विधिनाभ्यर्च्य प्रणवादिनमोन्तकम् /
कर्णिकायां प्रविन्यस्य रूपकध्यानमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped according to rule up to the netra, beginning with the praṇava and ending with 'namaḥ', / placing [them] on the pericarp, one should perform the visual meditation:

sanskrit_iast:
sarve vidyutprabhāḥ śāntā raudramastraṃ prakīrtitam /
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ hyaṣṭamūrti bhayaṅkaram //
meaning:
सर्वे विद्युत्प्रभाः शान्ता रौद्रमस्त्रं प्रकीर्तितम् /
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं ह्यष्टमूर्ति भयङ्करम् //
text_mt: All have the splendour of lightning, are tranquil; the Raudra weapon is proclaimed; / with fanged, terrifying faces, terrifying in eight forms,

sanskrit_iast:
varadaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ padmavibhūṣitam /
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannā raktasraganulepanāḥ //
meaning:
वरदं दक्षिणं हस्तं वामं पद्मविभूषितम् /
सर्वाभरणसंपन्ना रक्तस्रगनुलेपनाः //
text_mt: the right hand granting boons, the left adorned with a lotus, / endowed with all ornaments, wearing red garlands and ointments,

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃbaradharāḥ sarvā mūrtayastasya saṃsthitāḥ /
samaṇḍalo mahādevaḥ siṃdūrāruṇavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
रक्तांबरधराः सर्वा मूर्तयस्तस्य संस्थिताः /
समण्डलो महादेवः सिंदूरारुणविग्रहः //
text_mt: all his forms standing there wearing red garments; / Mahādeva, attended by his retinue, his body reddish like vermilion,

sanskrit_iast:
padmahasto 'mṛtāsyaśca dvihastanayanaḥ prabhuḥ /
raktābharaṇasaṃyukto raktasraganulepanaḥ //
meaning:
पद्महस्तो ऽमृतास्यश्च द्विहस्तनयनः प्रभुः /
रक्ताभरणसंयुक्तो रक्तस्रगनुलेपनः //
text_mt: holding a lotus in hand, with a face of nectar, the lord having two hands and [two] eyes, / adorned with red ornaments, wearing red garlands and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃrūpadharaṃ dhyāyedbhāskaraṃ bhuvaneśvaram /
padmabāhye śubhaṃ cātra maṇḍaleṣu samantataḥ //
meaning:
इत्थंरूपधरं ध्यायेद्भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम् /
पद्मबाह्ये शुभं चात्र मण्डलेषु समन्ततः //
text_mt: One should meditate upon the Sun, the lord of the worlds, possessing such a form; / and outside the lotus, auspiciously all around in the circles here,

sanskrit_iast:
somamaṅgārakaṃ caiva budhaṃ buddhimatāṃvaram /
bṛhaspatiṃ mahābuddhiṃ rudraputraṃ ca bhārgavam //
meaning:
सोममङ्गारकं चैव बुधं बुद्धिमतांवरम् /
बृहस्पतिं महाबुद्धिं रुद्रपुत्रं च भार्गवम् //
text_mt: Soma, Aṅgāraka, and Budha, the best of the wise, / Bṛhaspati of great wisdom, Bhārgava the son of Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaraṃ tathā rāhuṃ ketuṃ dhūmraṃ prakīrtitam /
sarve dvinetrā dvibhujā rāhuścordhvaśarīradhṛk //
meaning:
शनैश्चरं तथा राहुं केतुं धूम्रं प्रकीर्तितम् /
सर्वे द्विनेत्रा द्विभुजा राहुश्चोर्ध्वशरीरधृक् //
text_mt: Śanaiścara, and likewise Rāhu, and Ketu proclaimed to be smoky-grey; / all have two eyes and two arms, but Rāhu has only an upper body,

sanskrit_iast:
vivṛttāsyo ḥñjaliṃ kṛtvā bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇaḥ /
śanaiścaraśca daṃṣṭrāsyo varadābhayahastadhṛk //
meaning:
विवृत्तास्यो ःञ्जलिं कृत्वा भ्रुकुटीकुटिलेक्षणः /
शनैश्चरश्च दंष्ट्रास्यो वरदाभयहस्तधृक् //
text_mt: with wide-open mouth, folding his hands, his glance crooked with knit brows; / and Śanaiścara has fangs in his mouth and holds hands granting boons and fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
svaiḥsvairbhāvaiḥ svanāmnā ca praṇavādinamontakam /
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena dharmakāmārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
स्वैःस्वैर्भावैः स्वनाम्ना च प्रणवादिनमोन्तकम् /
पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नेन धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt: According to their respective bhāvas, each with their own name, beginning with the praṇava and ending with 'namaḥ', / they should be worshipped with effort for the attainment of dharma, desire, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
saptasaptagaṇāṃścaiva bahirdevasya pūjayet /
ṛṣayo devagandharvāḥ pannagāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
सप्तसप्तगणांश्चैव बहिर्देवस्य पूजयेत् /
ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वाः पन्नगाप्सरसां गणाः //
text_mt: And outside, one should worship the groups of seven-seven of the god: / the ṛṣis, the divine gandharvas, the hosts of serpents and apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
grāmaṇyo yātudhānāśca tathā yakṣāśca mukhyataḥ /
saptāśvān pūjayedagre saptacchandomayān vibhoḥ //
meaning:
ग्रामण्यो यातुधानाश्च तथा यक्षाश्च मुख्यतः /
सप्ताश्वान् पूजयेदग्रे सप्तच्छन्दोमयान् विभोः //
text_mt: village chiefs, yātudhānas, and especially the yakṣas; / in front, one should worship the lord's seven horses composed of the seven metres,

sanskrit_iast:
vālakhilyagaṇaṃ caiva nirmālyagrahaṇaṃ vibhoḥ /
pūjayedāsanaṃ sūrterdevatāmapi pūjayet //
meaning:
वालखिल्यगणं चैव निर्माल्यग्रहणं विभोः /
पूजयेदासनं सूर्तेर्देवतामपि पूजयेत् //
text_mt: and the group of Vālakhilyas, the receivers of the lord's remains; / one should worship the seat of the form, and worship the deity as well.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyaṃ ca dāpayetteṣāṃ pṛthageva vidhā nataḥ /
āvāhane ca pūjānte teṣāmudvāsane tathā //
meaning:
अर्घ्यं च दापयेत्तेषां पृथगेव विधा नतः /
आवाहने च पूजान्ते तेषामुद्वासने तथा //
text_mt: And one should offer them arghya separately according to rule, / in the invocation, at the end of the worship, and likewise in their dismissal.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā /
bāṣkalaṃ ca japedagre dhaśāṃśena ca yojayet //
meaning:
सहस्रं वा तदर्धं वा शतमष्टोत्तरं तु वा /
बाष्कलं च जपेदग्रे धशांशेन च योजयेत् //
text_mt: A thousand, or half of that, or one hundred and eight times, / one should recite the Bāṣkala [mantra] in front, and accompany it with a tenth part [in libations].

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍaṃ ca paścime kuryādvartulaṃ caiva mekhalam /
caturaṅgulamānena cotsedhādvistarādapi //
meaning:
कुण्डं च पश्चिमे कुर्याद्वर्तुलं चैव मेखलम् /
चतुरङ्गुलमानेन चोत्सेधाद्विस्तरादपि //
text_mt: And one should make a circular pit in the west, with a rim / four aṅgulas in measure, both in height and in width,

sanskrit_iast:
ekahastapramāṇena nitye naimittike tathā /
kṛtvāśvatthadalākāraṃ nābhiṃ kuṇḍe daśāṅgulam //
meaning:
एकहस्तप्रमाणेन नित्ये नैमित्तिके तथा /
कृत्वाश्वत्थदलाकारं नाभिं कुण्डे दशाङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: measuring one cubit, for daily and occasional [rites]; / having made a navel of ten aṅgulas in the pit in the shape of an aśvattha leaf,

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhena purastāttu gajoṣṭhasadṛśaṃ smṛtam /
galamekāṅgulaṃ caiva śeṣandviguṇavistaram //
meaning:
तदर्धेन पुरस्तात्तु गजोष्ठसदृशं स्मृतम् /
गलमेकाङ्गुलं चैव शेषन्द्विगुणविस्तरम् //
text_mt: in front of it, [a spout] resembling an elephant's lip is stated to be half of that [size], / the neck being one aṅgula, and the remainder having twice that width.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpramāṇena kuṇḍasya tyaktvā kurvīta mekhalām /
yatnena sādhayitvaiva paścādvomaṃ ca kārayet //
meaning:
तत्प्रमाणेन कुण्डस्य त्यक्त्वा कुर्वीत मेखलाम् /
यत्नेन साधयित्वैव पश्चाद्वोमं च कारयेत् //
text_mt: According to that measure of the pit, leaving [the rest], one should make the rim; / having prepared it with effort, one should then perform the homa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhenolle khanaṃ kuryātprokṣayedvāriṇā punaḥ /
āsanaṃ kalpayenmadhye prathamena samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
षष्ठेनोल्ले खनं कुर्यात्प्रोक्षयेद्वारिणा पुनः /
आसनं कल्पयेन्मध्ये प्रथमेन समाहितः //
text_mt: With the sixth [mantra] one should furrow [the pit] and sprinkle it again with water; / composed, one should arrange the seat in the centre with the first [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāvatīṃ tataḥ śaktimādyenaiva tu vunyaset /
bāṣkalenaiva saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
प्रभावतीं ततः शक्तिमाद्येनैव तु वुन्यसेत् /
बाष्कलेनैव संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, with the very first [mantra], one should place the power Prabhāvatī; / having worshipped with the Bāṣkala [mantra] using fragrances, flowers, and the like in order,

sanskrit_iast:
bāṣkalenaiva mantreṇa kriyāṃ prati yajetpṛthak /
mūlamantreṇa vidhinā paścātpūrṇāhutirbhavet //
meaning:
बाष्कलेनैव मन्त्रेण क्रियां प्रति यजेत्पृथक् /
मूलमन्त्रेण विधिना पश्चात्पूर्णाहुतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: with the Bāṣkala mantra itself, one should sacrifice for each rite separately; / with the root mantra according to rule, the final oblation should then be made.

sanskrit_iast:
kramādevaṃ vidhānena sūryāgnirjanito bhavet /
pūrvoktena vidhānena prāguktaṃ kamalaṃ nyaset //
meaning:
क्रमादेवं विधानेन सूर्याग्निर्जनितो भवेत् /
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन प्रागुक्तं कमलं न्यसेत् //
text_mt: In this manner, the solar fire will be generated in order; / by the procedure mentioned earlier, one should place the aforementioned lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhopari samabhyarcya pūrvavadbhāskaraṃ prabhum /
daśaivāhutayo deyā bāṣkalena mahāmune //
meaning:
मुखोपरि समभ्यर्च्य पूर्ववद्भास्करं प्रभुम् /
दशैवाहुतयो देया बाष्कलेन महामुने //
text_mt: Having worshipped the lord Sun upon the face [of the fire] as before, / ten oblations should be offered with the Bāṣkala [mantra], O great sage,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgānāṃ ca tathaikaikaṃ saṃhitābhiḥ pṛthak punaḥ /
jayādisviṣṭaparyantamidhmaprakṣepameva ca //
meaning:
अङ्गानां च तथैकैकं संहिताभिः पृथक् पुनः /
जयादिस्विष्टपर्यन्तमिध्मप्रक्षेपमेव च //
text_mt: and one each for the limbs, again separately with the saṃhitā mantras, / up to the Jayā and Sviṣṭakṛt [offerings], and the throwing of fuel-sticks.

sanskrit_iast:
samānyaṃ sarvamārgeṣu pāraṃparyakrameṇa ca /
nivedya devadevāya bhāskarāyāmitātmane //
meaning:
समान्यं सर्वमार्गेषु पारंपर्यक्रमेण च /
निवेद्य देवदेवाय भास्करायामितात्मने //
text_mt: This is common to all paths, according to lineage tradition; / having offered [all this] to the god of gods, the Sun of boundless self,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāhomādikaṃ sarvaṃ dattvārghyaṃ ca pradākṣiṇam /
aṅgaiḥ saṃpūjya saṃkṣipya hṛdyudvāsya namasya ca //
meaning:
पूजाहोमादिकं सर्वं दत्त्वार्घ्यं च प्रदाक्षिणम् /
अङ्गैः संपूज्य संक्षिप्य हृद्युद्वास्य नमस्य च //
text_mt: having performed all the worship, homa, and so forth, having offered arghya and circumambulation, / having worshipped with the limbs, withdrawn [the rites], dismissed [him] into the heart, and bowed down,

sanskrit_iast:
śivapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāddharmakāmārthasiddhaye /
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ yajanaṃ bhāskarasya ca /
sarvaiśvaryasamopetastejasāpratimaśca saḥ //
meaning:
शिवपूजां ततः कुर्याद्धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये /
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं यजनं भास्करस्य च /
सर्वैश्वर्यसमोपेतस्तेजसाप्रतिमश्च सः //
text_mt: one should then perform the worship of Śiva for the attainment of dharma, desire, and wealth. / Thus has the worship of the Sun been proclaimed in brief; / endowed with all sovereignty and unequalled in brilliance is he.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sakṛdvā yajeddevaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum /
bhāskaraṃ paramātmānaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
यः सकृद्वा यजेद्देवं देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम् /
भास्करं परमात्मानं स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Whoever worships the god even once—the god of gods, the teacher of the world, / the Sun, the Supreme Self—he attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sarvapāpa vivarjitaḥ /
sarvaiśvaryasamopetastejasāpratimaśca saḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ताः सर्वपाप विवर्जितः /
सर्वैश्वर्यसमोपेतस्तेजसाप्रतिमश्च सः //
text_mt: Freed from all sins, completely devoid of all sins, / he is endowed with all sovereignty and unequalled in brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautrādimitraiśca bāndhavaiś ca samantataḥ /
bhuktvaiva vipulān bhogānihaiva dhana dhānyavān //
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रादिमित्रैश्च बान्धवैश् च समन्ततः /
भुक्त्वैव विपुलान् भोगानिहैव धन धान्यवान् //
text_mt: Surrounded on all sides by sons, grandsons, friends, and kinsmen, / having enjoyed extensive pleasures right here, rich in wealth and grain,

sanskrit_iast:
yānavāhanasaṃpanno bhūṣaṇairvividhairapi /
kālaṃ gatopi sūryeṇa modate kālamakṣayam //
meaning:
यानवाहनसंपन्नो भूषणैर्विविधैरपि /
कालं गतोपि सूर्येण मोदते कालमक्षयम् //
text_mt: provided with vehicles and conveyances and diverse ornaments, / even when overtaken by death, he rejoices with the Sun for imperishable time.

sanskrit_iast:
punastasmādihāgatya rājā bhavati dharmikaḥ /
vedavedāṅgasaṃpanno brāhmaṇo vātra jāyate //
meaning:
पुनस्तस्मादिहागत्य राजा भवति धर्मिकः /
वेदवेदाङ्गसंपन्नो ब्राह्मणो वात्र जायते //
text_mt: Returning here from that [state], he becomes a righteous king, / or is born here as a brāhmaṇa endowed with the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prāgvāsanāyogāddhārmiko vedapāragaḥ /
sūryameva samabhyarcya sūryasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge dvāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पुनः प्राग्वासनायोगाद्धार्मिको वेदपारगः /
सूर्यमेव समभ्यर्च्य सूर्यसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे द्वाविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Again, through the impression of prior tendencies, becoming righteous and versed in the Vedas, / worshipping the Sun alone, he attains union with the Sun.

Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Liṅgamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi śivārcanamanuttamam /
trisaṃdhyam arcayed īśam agnikāryaṃ ca śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि शिवार्चनमनुत्तमम् /
त्रिसंध्यम् अर्चयेद् ईशम् अग्निकार्यं च शक्तितः //
text_mt: Śailādi said: / Now I shall declare to you the unsurpassed worship of Śiva; / one should worship the Lord at the three dawn and dusk twilights, and perform fire-rites according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
śivasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā tattvaśuddhiṃ ca pūrvavat /
puṣpahastaḥ praviśyātha pūjāsthānaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
शिवस्नानं पुरा कृत्वा तत्त्वशुद्धिं च पूर्ववत् /
पुष्पहस्तः प्रविश्याथ पूजास्थानं समाहितः //
text_mt:
Having first performed the bath of Śiva and the purification of the cosmic principles as before,
one should then enter the place of worship with flowers in hand, fully concentrated.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dāhanāplāvanāni ca /
gandhādivāsitakaro mahāmudrāṃ pravinyaset //
meaning:
प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा दाहनाप्लावनानि च /
गन्धादिवासितकरो महामुद्रां प्रविन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
Having performed three breath-controls, along with burning and flooding,
and perfumed the hands with sandalwood paste and the like, one should impose the great seal.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānena tanuṃ kṛtvā brahmāgnerapi yatnataḥ /
avyaktabuddhyahaṅkāratanmātrāsaṃbhavāṃ tanum //
meaning:
विज्ञानेन तनुं कृत्वा ब्रह्माग्नेरपि यत्नतः /
अव्यक्तबुद्ध्यहङ्कारतन्मात्रासंभवां तनुम् //
text_mt:
Having fashioned a body through discernment, also by the fire of Brahman with effort,
a body arising from the unmanifest, intellect, ego, and subtle elements,

sanskrit_iast:
śivāmṛtena saṃpūtaṃ śivasya ca yathātatham /
adhoniṣṭhyā vitastyāṃ tu nābhyāmupari tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
शिवामृतेन संपूतं शिवस्य च यथातथम् /
अधोनिष्ठ्या वितस्त्यां तु नाभ्यामुपरि तिष्ठति //
text_mt:
purified properly with the nectar of Śiva,
a span below the palate, and above the navel, there resides

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayaṃ tadvijānīyādviśvasyāyatanaṃ mahat /
hṛtpadmakarṇikāyāṃ tu devaṃ sākṣātsadāśivam //
meaning:
हृदयं तद्विजानीयाद्विश्वस्यायतनं महत् /
हृत्पद्मकर्णिकायां तु देवं साक्षात्सदाशिवम् //
text_mt:
the heart—one should know that as the great abode of the universe.
In the pericarp of the heart lotus, however, [one should visualize] the god Sadāśiva in visible presence:

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam /
prativaktraṃ trinetraṃ ca śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharam //
meaning:
पञ्चवक्त्रं दशभुजं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् /
प्रतिवक्त्रं त्रिनेत्रं च शशाङ्ककृतशेखरम् //
text_mt:
with five faces, ten arms, adorned with all ornaments,
three eyes on each face, and bearing the crescent moon upon his crest,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhapadmāsanāsīnaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham /
ūrdhvaṃ vaktraṃ sitaṃ dhyāyetpūrvaṃ kuṅkumasannibham //
meaning:
बद्धपद्मासनासीनं शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभम् /
ऊर्ध्वं वक्त्रं सितं ध्यायेत्पूर्वं कुङ्कुमसन्निभम् //
text_mt:
seated in the bound lotus posture, resembling pure crystal.
One should meditate on the upward face as white, and the eastern face as resembling vermilion;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlābhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vaktramatiraktaṃ tathottaram /
gokṣīradhavalaṃ divyaṃ paścimaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
नीलाभं दक्षिणं वक्त्रमतिरक्तं तथोत्तरम् /
गोक्षीरधवलं दिव्यं पश्चिमं परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt:
the southern face as blue in hue, and the northern face as exceedingly red;
and the divine western face of the Supreme Lord as white as cow's milk.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ paraśukhaṅgaṃ ca vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca dakṣiṇe /
vāme pāśāṅkuśaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ nāgaṃ nārācamuttamam //
meaning:
शूलं परशुखङ्गं च वज्रं शक्तिं च दक्षिणे /
वामे पाशाङ्कुशं घण्टां नागं नाराचमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
In his right hands are a trident, an axe, a sword, a thunderbolt, and a spear;
in his left, a noose, a goad, a bell, a serpent, and an excellent iron arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
varadābhayahastaṃ vā śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva tu /
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ citrāṃbaradharaṃ śivam //
meaning:
वरदाभयहस्तं वा शेषं पूर्ववदेव तु /
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तं चित्रांबरधरं शिवम् //
text_mt:
Or, with hands showing the gestures of granting boons and fearlessness, the rest just as before,
endowed with all ornaments, wearing variegated garments—Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṅgavigrahaṃ devaṃ sarvadevottamottamam /
pūjayetsarvabhāvena brahmāṅgairbrahmaṇaḥ patim //
meaning:
ब्रह्माङ्गविग्रहं देवं सर्वदेवोत्तमोत्तमम् /
पूजयेत्सर्वभावेन ब्रह्माङ्गैर्ब्रह्मणः पतिम् //
text_mt:
the god whose form consists of the Brahmans and their ancillary parts, the highest of all gods.
With all one's being, one should worship the lord of Brahman with the Brahmans and their ancillary parts.

sanskrit_iast:
uktāni pañca brahmāṇi śivāṅgāni śṛṇuṣva me /
śaktibhūtāni ca tathā hṛdayādīni suvrata //
meaning:
उक्तानि पञ्च ब्रह्माणि शिवाङ्गानि शृणुष्व मे /
शक्तिभूतानि च तथा हृदयादीनि सुव्रत //
text_mt:
The five Brahmans have been declared; hear from me the ancillary parts of Śiva,
which are powers, and likewise the heart and others, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ hṛdayāya śaktibījāya namaḥ /
oṃ īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmamṛtāya śirasenamaḥ //
meaning:
ओं ईशानः सर्वविद्यानां हृदयाय शक्तिबीजाय नमः /
ओं ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानाममृताय शिरसेनमः //
text_mt:
“Oṃ, to Īśāna, the ruler of all branches of knowledge, to the heart, to the seed of power, homage!
Oṃ, to the Lord of all beings, to the immortal, to the head, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ brahmādhipataye kālāgnirupāya śikhāyai namaḥ /
oṃ brahmaṇodhipataye kālacaṇḍamārutāya kavacāya namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं ब्रह्माधिपतये कालाग्निरुपाय शिखायै नमः /
ओं ब्रह्मणोधिपतये कालचण्डमारुताय कवचाय नमः //
text_mt:
Oṃ, to the overlord of Brahmā, whose form is the fire of Time, to the crest, homage!
Oṃ, to the overlord of Brahman, the fierce wind of Time, to the armor, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ brahmaṇe bṛṃhaṇāya jñānamūrtaye netrāya namaḥ /
oṃ śivāya sadāśivāya pāśupatāsrāya apratihatāya phaṭphaṭ //
meaning:
ओं ब्रह्मणे बृंहणाय ज्ञानमूर्तये नेत्राय नमः /
ओं शिवाय सदाशिवाय पाशुपतास्राय अप्रतिहताय फट्फट् //
text_mt:
Oṃ, to Brahman, the expander, whose form is knowledge, to the eye, homage!
Oṃ, to Śiva, to Sadāśiva, the unhindered weapon of the Pāśupata, phaṭ phaṭ!”

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sadyojātāya bhavebhavenāti bhave bhavasya māṃ bhavodbhavāya śivamūrtaye namaḥ /
oṃ haṃsaśikhāya vidyādehāya ātmasvarūpāya parāparāya śivāya śivatamāya namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं सद्योजाताय भवेभवेनाति भवे भवस्य मां भवोद्भवाय शिवमूर्तये नमः /
ओं हंसशिखाय विद्यादेहाय आत्मस्वरूपाय परापराय शिवाय शिवतमाय नमः //
text_mt:
“Oṃ, to Sadyojāta, in Bhava, in Bhava, to him who surpasses Bhava, protect me, to the origin of Bhava, whose form is Śiva, homage!
Oṃ, to the swan-crested, whose body is knowledge, whose nature is the self, higher and lower, to Śiva, the most auspicious, homage!”

sanskrit_iast:
kathitāni śivāṅgāni mūrtividyā ca tasya vai /
brahmāṅgamūrti vidyāṅgasahitāṃ śivaśāsane //
meaning:
कथितानि शिवाङ्गानि मूर्तिविद्या च तस्य वै /
ब्रह्माङ्गमूर्ति विद्याङ्गसहितां शिवशासने //
text_mt:
The ancillary parts of Śiva have been declared, and indeed his form-formula,
together with the Brahmans, their ancillary parts, the form, and the ancillary formula, in the ordinance of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
saurāṇi ca pravakṣyāmi bāṣkalādyāni suvrata /
aṅgāni sarvavedeṣu sārabhūtāni suvrata //
meaning:
सौराणि च प्रवक्ष्यामि बाष्कलाद्यानि सुव्रत /
अङ्गानि सर्ववेदेषु सारभूतानि सुव्रत //
text_mt:
I shall also proclaim the solar ones, beginning with the Bāṣkala, O you of noble vows,
the limbs that are the essence of all the Vedas, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃbhūḥ oṃbhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ oṃmahaḥ oñjanaḥ ontapaḥ oṃsatyam oṃṛtam oṃbrahmānavākṣaramayaṃ mantraṃ bāṣkalaṃ parikīrtitam /
na kṣaratīti loke 'smiṃstato hyakṣaramucyate /
satyam akṣaram ity uktaṃ praṇavādinamo ḥntakam //
meaning:
ओंभूः ओंभुवः ओं स्वः ओंमहः ओञ्जनः ओन्तपः ओंसत्यम् ओंऋतम् ओंब्रह्मानवाक्षरमयं मन्त्रं बाष्कलं परिकीर्तितम् /
न क्षरतीति लोके ऽस्मिंस्ततो ह्यक्षरमुच्यते /
सत्यम् अक्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं प्रणवादिनमो ःन्तकम् //

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi /
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
namaḥ sūryāya khakholkāya namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि /
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
नमः सूर्याय खखोल्काय नमः //
text_mt:
“Oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ. Let us meditate on that excellent splendor of the divine Savitṛ,
who may inspire our thoughts.
Homage to the Sun, to Khakholka, homage!”

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantramiti proktaṃ bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ /
navākṣareṇa dīptādya mūlamantreṇa bhāskaram //
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रमिति प्रोक्तं भास्करस्य महात्मनः /
नवाक्षरेण दीप्ताद्य मूलमन्त्रेण भास्करम् //
text_mt:
This is declared to be the root-formula of the great-souled Sun.
With the nine-syllable root-formula beginning with Dīpta, [one should worship] the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedaṅgamantrāṇi kathayāmi samāsataḥ /
vedādibhiḥ prabhūtādyaṃ praṇavena tu madhyamam //
meaning:
पूजयेदङ्गमन्त्राणि कथयामि समासतः /
वेदादिभिः प्रभूताद्यं प्रणवेन तु मध्यमम् //
text_mt:
One should worship [him]—I shall briefly declare the ancillary formulas:
the first with the syllables of the Vedas, and the middle one with the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃbhūḥ brahmaṇe hṛdayāya namaḥ /
oṃbhuvaḥ viṣṇave śirase namaḥ /
oṃsvaḥ rudrāya śikhāyai namaḥ oṃbhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ jvālāmāninyai devāya namaḥ oṃmahaḥ maheśvarāya kavacāya namaḥ /
oñjanaḥ śivāya netrebhyo namaḥ /
ontapastāpanāya astrāya namaḥ /
evaṃ prasaṃgādeveha saurāṇi kathitāni ha /
śaivāni ca samāsena nyāsayogena suvrata //
meaning:
ओंभूः ब्रह्मणे हृदयाय नमः /
ओंभुवः विष्णवे शिरसे नमः /
ओंस्वः रुद्राय शिखायै नमः ओंभूर्भुवः स्वः ज्वालामानिन्यै देवाय नमः ओंमहः महेश्वराय कवचाय नमः /
ओञ्जनः शिवाय नेत्रेभ्यो नमः /
ओन्तपस्तापनाय अस्त्राय नमः /
एवं प्रसंगादेवेह सौराणि कथितानि ह /
शैवानि च समासेन न्यासयोगेन सुव्रत //
text_mt:
“Oṃ bhūḥ, to Brahman, to the heart, homage!
Oṃ bhuvaḥ, to Viṣṇu, to the head, homage!
Oṃ svaḥ, to Rudra, to the crest, homage! Oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, to the god who wears the flaming garland, homage! Oṃ mahaḥ, to Maheśvara, to the armor, homage!
Oṃ janaḥ, to Śiva, to the eyes, homage!
Oṃ tapaḥ, to the burner, to the weapon, homage!”
Thus, in this context, the solar formulas have been proclaimed;
and the Śaiva ones, concisely, through the yoga of ritual imposition, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ mantramayaṃ devaṃ pūjayeddhṛdayāṃbuje /
nābhau homaṃ tu kartavyaṃ janayitvā yathākramam //
meaning:
इत्थं मन्त्रमयं देवं पूजयेद्धृदयांबुजे /
नाभौ होमं तु कर्तव्यं जनयित्वा यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
Thus one should worship the god whose essence is mantras in the heart-lotus.
And in the navel, an oblation is to be performed, having produced [the fire] in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā sarvakāryāṇi śivāgnau devamīśvaram /
pañcabrahmāṅgasaṃbhūtaṃ śivamūrtiṃ sadāśivam //
meaning:
मनसा सर्वकार्याणि शिवाग्नौ देवमीश्वरम् /
पञ्चब्रह्माङ्गसंभूतं शिवमूर्तिं सदाशिवम् //
text_mt:
Mentally [performing] all acts in the fire of Śiva, unto the god, the Lord,
arisen from the five Brahmans and their ancillary parts, whose form is Śiva, Sadāśiva,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapadmāsanāsīnaṃ sakalīkṛtya yatnataḥ /
mūlena mūrtimantreṇa brahmāṅgādyaistū suvrata //
meaning:
रक्तपद्मासनासीनं सकलीकृत्य यत्नतः /
मूलेन मूर्तिमन्त्रेण ब्रह्माङ्गाद्यैस्तू सुव्रत //
text_mt:
seated on a red lotus seat, having carefully made [the body] whole,
with the root-formula, the form-formula, and the Brahmans and their ancillary parts, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
samidājyāhutīrhutvā manasā candramaṇḍalāt /
candrasthānātsamutpannāṃ pūrṇadhārāmanusmaret //
meaning:
समिदाज्याहुतीर्हुत्वा मनसा चन्द्रमण्डलात् /
चन्द्रस्थानात्समुत्पन्नां पूर्णधारामनुस्मरेत् //
text_mt:
Having offered the oblations of firewood and clarified butter, one should mentally contemplate
a full continuous stream flowing from the sphere of the moon, from the station of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāhutividhānena jñānināṃ śivaśāsane /
śivaṃ vaktragataṃ dhyāyettejomātraṃ ca śāṅkaram //
meaning:
पूर्णाहुतिविधानेन ज्ञानिनां शिवशासने /
शिवं वक्त्रगतं ध्यायेत्तेजोमात्रं च शाङ्करम् //
text_mt:
According to the rule of the full oblation in the teaching of Śiva for the wise,
one should meditate on Śiva residing in the mouth, purely the splendor of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭe devadeveśaṃ bhramadhye vā smaretpunaḥ /
yacca hṛtkamale sarvaṃ samāpya vidhivistaram //
meaning:
ललाटे देवदेवेशं भ्रमध्ये वा स्मरेत्पुनः /
यच्च हृत्कमले सर्वं समाप्य विधिविस्तरम् //
text_mt:
One should remember the Lord of the gods again on the forehead or between the eyebrows;
and having concluded everything in the heart-lotus in full ritual detail,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhadīpaśikhākāraṃ bhāvayedbhavanāśanam /
liṅge ca pūjayeddevaṃ sthaṇḍile vā sadāśivam //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge trayoviṃśatitamodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
शुद्धदीपशिखाकारं भावयेद्भवनाशनम् /
लिङ्गे च पूजयेद्देवं स्थण्डिले वा सदाशिवम् //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे त्रयोविंशतितमोध्यायः

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
vyākhyāṃ pūjāvidānasya pravadāmi samāsataḥ /
śivaśāstroktamārgeṇa śivena kathitaṃ purā //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
व्याख्यां पूजाविदानस्य प्रवदामि समासतः /
शिवशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण शिवेन कथितं पुरा //
text_mt:
The son of Śilāda said:
I shall concisely state the explanation of the rite of worship
according to the path taught in the scriptures of Śiva, as related by Śiva in ancient times.

sanskrit_iast: athobhau candanacarcitau hastau vauṣaḍantenādyañjaliṃ kṛtvā mūrtividyāśivādīni japtvā aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhikānta īśānādyaṃ kaniṣṭhikādimadhyamāntaṃ hṛdayāditṛtīyāntaṃ turīyamaṅguṣṭhenānāmikayā pañcamaṃ taladvayena ṣaṣṭhaṃ tarjanyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ nārācastraprayogeṇa punarapi mūlaṃ japtvā turīyenāvaguṇṭhya śivahastamityucyate //
meaning: अथोभौ चन्दनचर्चितौ हस्तौ वौषडन्तेनाद्यञ्जलिं कृत्वा मूर्तिविद्याशिवादीनि जप्त्वा अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठिकान्त ईशानाद्यं कनिष्ठिकादिमध्यमान्तं हृदयादितृतीयान्तं तुरीयमङ्गुष्ठेनानामिकया पञ्चमं तलद्वयेन षष्ठं तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां नाराचस्त्रप्रयोगेण पुनरपि मूलं जप्त्वा तुरीयेनावगुण्ठ्य शिवहस्तमित्युच्यते //
text_mt: Now, both hands having been anointed with sandalwood paste, having made the initial hollowed-hand gesture ending with “vauṣaṭ”, having recited the form-formula, the formula of Śiva, and the like: [touching] from the thumb to the little finger with the Īśāna formula; from the little finger to the middle finger with the third ending with the heart; the fourth with the thumb and the ring finger; the fifth with both palms; the sixth with the forefinger and thumb using the arrow-weapon formula; having recited the root-formula again; having veiled [the hands] with the fourth—this is called the hand of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast: śivārcaṃnā tena hastena kāryā //
meaning: शिवार्चंना तेन हस्तेन कार्या //
text_mt: The worship of Śiva is to be performed with that hand.

sanskrit_iast: tattvagatamātmānaṃ vyavasthāpya tattvaśuddhiṃ pūrvavat //
meaning: तत्त्वगतमात्मानं व्यवस्थाप्य तत्त्वशुद्धिं पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: Having established the self residing in the cosmic principles, [one performs] the purification of the cosmic principles as before.

sanskrit_iast: kṣmāmbhognivāyuvyomāntaṃ pañcacatuḥśuddhakoṭyante dhārāsahitena vyavasthāpya tattśuddhiṃ pūrvaṃ kuryāt //
meaning: क्ष्माम्भोग्निवायुव्योमान्तं पञ्चचतुःशुद्धकोट्यन्ते धारासहितेन व्यवस्थाप्य तत्त्शुद्धिं पूर्वं कुर्यात् //
text_mt: Extending up to earth, water, fire, wind, and ether, at the end of five and four pure crores, having established them with the continuous stream, one should first perform the purification of the cosmic principles.

sanskrit_iast: tattvaśuddhiḥ ṣaṣṭhena sadyena tṛtīyena phaḍantāddharāśuddhiḥ //
meaning: तत्त्वशुद्धिः षष्ठेन सद्येन तृतीयेन फडन्ताद्धराशुद्धिः //
text_mt: The purification of the cosmic principles: the purification of the earth is with the sixth, with the Sadyojāta formula, with the third, ending with “phaṭ”.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhasahitena sadyena tṛtīyena phaḍantena vāritattvaśuddhiḥ //
meaning: षष्ठसहितेन सद्येन तृतीयेन फडन्तेन वारितत्त्वशुद्धिः //
text_mt: The purification of the water principle is with [the formula] accompanied by the sixth, with the Sadyojāta formula, with the third, ending with “phaṭ”.

sanskrit_iast: vāhneyatṛtīyena phaṇḍatenāgniśuddhiḥ //
meaning: वाह्नेयतृतीयेन फण्डतेनाग्निशुद्धिः //
text_mt: The purification of fire is with the third belonging to fire, ending with “phaṭ”.

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyacaturthena ṣaṣṭhasahitena phaḍantena vāyuśuddhiḥ //
meaning: वायव्यचतुर्थेन षष्ठसहितेन फडन्तेन वायुशुद्धिः //
text_mt: The purification of wind is with the fourth belonging to wind, accompanied by the sixth, ending with “phaṭ”.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhena sasadyena tṛtīyena phaḍantenākāśaśuddhiḥ //
meaning: षष्ठेन ससद्येन तृतीयेन फडन्तेनाकाशशुद्धिः //
text_mt: The purification of space is with the sixth, together with Sadyojāta, with the third, ending with “phaṭ”.

sanskrit_iast: upasaṃhṛtyaivaṃ sadyaṣaṣṭhena tṛtīyena mūlena phaḍantena tāḍanaṃ tṛtīyena saṃpuṭīkṛtyagrahaṇaṃ mūlameva yonibījena saṃpuṭīkṛtvā bandhanaṃ bandhaḥ //
meaning: उपसंहृत्यैवं सद्यषष्ठेन तृतीयेन मूलेन फडन्तेन ताडनं तृतीयेन संपुटीकृत्यग्रहणं मूलमेव योनिबीजेन संपुटीकृत्वा बन्धनं बन्धः //
text_mt: Having thus drawn them in: striking is done with Sadyojāta, the sixth, the third, and the root-formula ending with “phaṭ”; taking up is done by enclosing with the third; binding, the bond, is done having enclosed the root-formula itself with the yoni seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ kṣāntātītādinivṛttiparyantaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā praṇavena tattvatrayakamanudhyāya ātmānaṃ dīpaśikhākāraṃ puryaṣṭakasahitaṃ trayātītaṃ śaktikṣobheṇāmṛtadhārāṃ suṣumṇāyāṃ dhyātvā //
meaning: एवं क्षान्तातीतादिनिवृत्तिपर्यन्तं पूर्ववत्कृत्वा प्रणवेन तत्त्वत्रयकमनुध्याय आत्मानं दीपशिखाकारं पुर्यष्टकसहितं त्रयातीतं शक्तिक्षोभेणामृतधारां सुषुम्णायां ध्यात्वा //
text_mt: Having thus done as before up to the cessation beginning with 'beyond endurance', having meditated upon the triad of tattvas with the praṇava, having meditated upon the self in the form of a lamp-flame, accompanied by the subtle body of eight, beyond the triad, [and] the stream of nectar in the suṣumṇā through the agitation of Śakti

sanskrit_iast: śāntyatītādinivṛttiparyantānāṃ cāntarnādabindvakārokāramakārāntaṃ śivaṃ sadāśivaṃ rudraviṣṇubrahmāntaṃ sṛṣṭimeṇāmṛtīkaraṇaṃ brahmanyāsaṃ kṛtvā pañcavaktreṣu pañcadaśanayanaṃ vinyasya mūlena pādādikeśāntaṃ mahāmudrāmapi baddhvā śivohamiti dhyātvā śaktyādīni vinyasyahṛdi śaktyābījāṅkurānantarātsasuṣirasūtrakaṇṭakapatrakesaradharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryasūryasomāgnivāmājyeṣṭhāraudrīkālīkalavikaraṇībalavikaraṇībala prathamanīsarvabhūtadamanīḥ kesareṣu karṇikāyāṃ manonmanīmapi dhyātvā //
meaning: शान्त्यतीतादिनिवृत्तिपर्यन्तानां चान्तर्नादबिन्द्वकारोकारमकारान्तं शिवं सदाशिवं रुद्रविष्णुब्रह्मान्तं सृष्टिमेणामृतीकरणं ब्रह्मन्यासं कृत्वा पञ्चवक्त्रेषु पञ्चदशनयनं विन्यस्य मूलेन पादादिकेशान्तं महामुद्रामपि बद्ध्वा शिवोहमिति ध्यात्वा शक्त्यादीनि विन्यस्यहृदि शक्त्याबीजाङ्कुरानन्तरात्ससुषिरसूत्रकण्टकपत्रकेसरधर्मज्ञानवैराग्यैश्वर्यसूर्यसोमाग्निवामाज्येष्ठारौद्रीकालीकलविकरणीबलविकरणीबल प्रथमनीसर्वभूतदमनीः केसरेषु कर्णिकायां मनोन्मनीमपि ध्यात्वा //
text_mt: Having performed the projection of the Brahmamantras which confers immortality, beginning with Śāntyatītā and ending with Nivṛtti, within [the phonemes] terminating in Nāda, Bindu, A-kāra, U-kāra, and Ma-kāra, ending with Śiva, Sadāśiva, Rudra, Viṣṇu, and Brahmā in creation; having projected the fifteen eyes upon the five faces; having [projected] from the feet to the hair with the root mantra; having bound the great seal; having meditated ‘I am Śiva’; having projected Śakti and the rest—he should meditate in the heart upon [the throne of] Śakti: after the seed and sprout, the stalk with its hollow fiber, thorns, petals, and filaments, [the deities of] dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereignty, the sun, moon, and fire, and on the filaments Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Kalavikaraṇī, Balavikaraṇī, Balapramathanī, and Sarvabhūtadamanī, and upon the pericarp Manonmanī.

sanskrit_iast: āsanaṃ parikalpyaivaṃ sarvopacārasahitaṃ bahiryogopacāreṇāntaḥkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nābhau vahnikuṇḍe pūrvavadāsanaṃ parikalpya sadāśivaṃ dhyātvā binduto 'mṛtadhārāṃ śivamaṇḍale nipatitāṃ dhyātvā lalāṭe maheśvaraṃ dīpaśikhākāraṃ dhyātvā ātmaśuddhiritthaṃ prāṇāpānau saṃyamya suṣumṇayā vāyuṃ vyavasthāpya ṣaṣṭhena tālumudrāṃ kṛtvā digbandhaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhena sthānaśuddhirvastrādi pūtāntararghyapātrādiṣu praṇavena tattvatrayaṃ vinyasya tadupari bunduṃ dhyātvā vipūrya dravyāṇi ca vidhāya amṛtaplāvanaṃ kṛtvā pādyapātrādiṣu teṣāmarghyavadāsanaṃ parikalpya saṃhitayābhimantryādyenābhyarcya dvitīyenāmṛtīkṛtvā tṛtīyena viśodhyacaturthenāvaguṇṭhya pañcamonāvalokyaṣaṣṭhena rakṣāṃvidhāya caturthena kuśapuñjenārghyāṃbhasābhyukṣya ātmānamapi dravyāṇi punarghyāṃbhasābyukṣya sapuṣpeṇa sarvadravyāṇi pṛthakpṛthak śodhayet //
meaning: आसनं परिकल्प्यैवं सर्वोपचारसहितं बहिर्योगोपचारेणान्तःकरणं कृत्वा नाभौ वह्निकुण्डे पूर्ववदासनं परिकल्प्य सदाशिवं ध्यात्वा बिन्दुतो ऽमृतधारां शिवमण्डले निपतितां ध्यात्वा ललाटे महेश्वरं दीपशिखाकारं ध्यात्वा आत्मशुद्धिरित्थं प्राणापानौ संयम्य सुषुम्णया वायुं व्यवस्थाप्य षष्ठेन तालुमुद्रां कृत्वा दिग्बन्धं कृत्वा षष्ठेन स्थानशुद्धिर्वस्त्रादि पूतान्तरर्घ्यपात्रादिषु प्रणवेन तत्त्वत्रयं विन्यस्य तदुपरि बुन्दुं ध्यात्वा विपूर्य द्रव्याणि च विधाय अमृतप्लावनं कृत्वा पाद्यपात्रादिषु तेषामर्घ्यवदासनं परिकल्प्य संहितयाभिमन्त्र्याद्येनाभ्यर्च्य द्वितीयेनामृतीकृत्वा तृतीयेन विशोध्यचतुर्थेनावगुण्ठ्य पञ्चमोनावलोक्यषष्ठेन रक्षांविधाय चतुर्थेन कुशपुञ्जेनार्घ्यांभसाभ्युक्ष्य आत्मानमपि द्रव्याणि पुनर्घ्यांभसाब्युक्ष्य सपुष्पेण सर्वद्रव्याणि पृथक्पृथक् शोधयेत् //
text_mt: Having thus conceived the seat complete with all offerings, having made the internal organ into an external instrument of yoga, having conceived the seat in the fire-pit at the navel as before, having meditated on Sadāśiva, having meditated on the stream of nectar falling from the Bindu into the circle of Śiva, having meditated on Maheśvara on the forehead in the form of a lamp-flame—such is the purification of the self. Having restrained the prāṇa and apāna, having established the breath in the suṣumṇā, having formed the palate-mudrā with the sixth [mantra], having made the boundary-lock with the sixth—such is the purification of the place. In the vessels for guest-water and the rest, purified inside with cloth and other means, having projected the three principles with the Praṇava, having meditated upon the Bindu above them, having filled them and arranged the articles, having flooded them with nectar, having conceived a seat for them in the vessels for foot-water and the rest like the guest-water, having consecrated with the Saṃhitā, having worshipped with the first, having immortalized with the second, having cleansed with the third, having veiled with the fourth, having inspected with the fifth, having provided protection with the sixth, having sprinkled with the guest-water using a bunch of kuśa grass with the fourth—he should purify himself and also the articles, sprinkling them again with the guest-water, purifying all articles one by one with a flower.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyena gandhaṃ vāmena vastram /
aghoreṇa ābharaṇaṃ puruṣeṇa naivedyam /
īśānena puṣpāṇi athābhimantrayet //
meaning:
सद्येन गन्धं वामेन वस्त्रम् /
अघोरेण आभरणं पुरुषेण नैवेद्यम् /
ईशानेन पुष्पाणि अथाभिमन्त्रयेत् //
text_mt: He should then consecrate perfume with the Sadyojāta mantra, cloth with the Vāmadeva mantra, / ornaments with the Aghora mantra, food offering with the Tatpuruṣa mantra, / and flowers with the Īśāna mantra.

sanskrit_iast: śivagāyatryā śeṣaṃ prokṣayet //
meaning: शिवगायत्र्या शेषं प्रोक्षयेत् //
text_mt: He should sprinkle the remainder with the Śivagāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāmṛtapañcagavyādīni brahmāṅgamūlādyairābhimantrayet //
meaning: पञ्चामृतपञ्चगव्यादीनि ब्रह्माङ्गमूलाद्यैराभिमन्त्रयेत् //
text_mt: He should consecrate the five nectars, the five products of the cow, and the rest with the Brahmamantras, the limb-mantras, the root mantra, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthakpṛthaṅmūlenārghyaṃ dhūpaṃ dattvācamanīyaṃ ca teṣāmapi dhenumudrā ca darśayitvā kavacenāvaguṇṭhyāstreṇa rakṣāṃ ca vidhāya dravyaśuddhiṃ kuryāt //
meaning: पृथक्पृथङ्मूलेनार्घ्यं धूपं दत्त्वाचमनीयं च तेषामपि धेनुमुद्रा च दर्शयित्वा कवचेनावगुण्ठ्यास्त्रेण रक्षां च विधाय द्रव्यशुद्धिं कुर्यात् //
text_mt: Having offered guest-water, incense, and sipping-water separately with the root mantra, having shown the cow-gesture to them as well, having veiled them with the armour-mantra, and having effected protection with the weapon-mantra, he should perform the purification of the substances.

sanskrit_iast: arghyodakamagre hṛdā gandhamādāyāstreṇa viśodhya pūjāprabhṛtikaraṇaṃ rakṣāntaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ dravyaśuddhiṃ pūjāsamarpaṇāntaṃ maunamāsthāya puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā sarvamantrāṇi praṇavādinamontājjapitvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tyajenmantraśuddhirittham //
meaning: अर्घ्योदकमग्रे हृदा गन्धमादायास्त्रेण विशोध्य पूजाप्रभृतिकरणं रक्षान्तं कृत्वैवं द्रव्यशुद्धिं पूजासमर्पणान्तं मौनमास्थाय पुष्पाञ्जलिं दत्त्वा सर्वमन्त्राणि प्रणवादिनमोन्ताज्जपित्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं त्यजेन्मन्त्रशुद्धिरित्थम् //
text_mt: Having taken the perfume in front with the heart-mantra, having purified the guest-water with the weapon-mantra, having performed everything from the preparation of the worship up to the protection, having thus accomplished the purification of substances up to the offering of worship, having maintained silence, having offered a handful of flowers, having recited all the mantras beginning with the Praṇava and ending with ‘namaḥ’, he should release the handful of flowers. Such is the purification of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
agre sāmānyārghyapātraṃ payasāpūrya gandhapuṣpādinā saṃhitayābhimantrya dhenamudrāṃ dattvā kavacenāvaguṇṭhyāstreṇa rakṣayet /
pūjāṃ paryuṣitāṃ gāyatryā samabhyarcya sāmānyārghyaṃ dattvā gandhapuṣpadhūpācamanīyaṃ svadhāntaṃ namontaṃ vā datvā brahmabhiḥ pṛthakpṛthakpuṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā phaḍantāstreṇa nirmalyaṃ vyapohya īśānyāṃ caṇḍamabhyarcyāsanamūrti caṇḍaṃ sāmānyāstreṇa liṅgapīṭhaṃ śivaṃ pāśupatāstreṇa viśodhya mūrdhni puṣpaṃ nidhāya pūjayelliṅgaśuddhiḥ //
meaning:
अग्रे सामान्यार्घ्यपात्रं पयसापूर्य गन्धपुष्पादिना संहितयाभिमन्त्र्य धेनमुद्रां दत्त्वा कवचेनावगुण्ठ्यास्त्रेण रक्षयेत् /
पूजां पर्युषितां गायत्र्या समभ्यर्च्य सामान्यार्घ्यं दत्त्वा गन्धपुष्पधूपाचमनीयं स्वधान्तं नमोन्तं वा दत्वा ब्रह्मभिः पृथक्पृथक्पुष्पाञ्जलिं दत्त्वा फडन्तास्त्रेण निर्मल्यं व्यपोह्य ईशान्यां चण्डमभ्यर्च्यासनमूर्ति चण्डं सामान्यास्त्रेण लिङ्गपीठं शिवं पाशुपतास्त्रेण विशोध्य मूर्ध्नि पुष्पं निधाय पूजयेल्लिङ्गशुद्धिः //
text_mt: Having filled the vessel for common guest-water in front with water, having consecrated it with perfume, flowers, and the rest using the Saṃhitā, having displayed the cow-gesture, he should protect it with the weapon-mantra, having veiled it with the armour-mantra. / Having worshipped the stale offering with the Gāyatrī, having offered the common guest-water, having offered perfume, flowers, incense, and sipping-water ending with ‘svadhā’ or ‘namaḥ’, having offered a handful of flowers separately with each of the Brahmamantras, having removed the stale offerings with the weapon-mantra ending in ‘phaṭ’, having worshipped Caṇḍa in the northeast, having purified Caṇḍa, the seat and the form with the common weapon-mantra, and the liṅga-pedestal and Śiva with the Pāśupata weapon-mantra, having placed a flower on the head, he should worship. This is the purification of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast: āsanaṃ kūrmaśilāyāṃ bījāṅkuraṃ tadupari brahmaśilāyāmanantanālasuṣire sūtrapatrakaṇṭakakarṇikākesaradharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryasūryasomāgnikesaraśaktiṃ manonmanīṃ karṇikāyāṃ manonmanenānantāsanāyeti samāsenāsanaṃ parikalpya tadupari nivṛttyādikalāmayaṃ ṣaṅvidhasahitaṃ karmakalāṅgadehaṃ sadāśivaṃ bhāvayet //
meaning: आसनं कूर्मशिलायां बीजाङ्कुरं तदुपरि ब्रह्मशिलायामनन्तनालसुषिरे सूत्रपत्रकण्टककर्णिकाकेसरधर्मज्ञानवैराग्यैश्वर्यसूर्यसोमाग्निकेसरशक्तिं मनोन्मनीं कर्णिकायां मनोन्मनेनानन्तासनायेति समासेनासनं परिकल्प्य तदुपरि निवृत्त्यादिकलामयं षङ्विधसहितं कर्मकलाङ्गदेहं सदाशिवं भावयेत् //
text_mt: On the tortoise-stone the seed and sprout, above that on the Brahmā-stone the endless stem with its hollow, the thread, petals, thorns, pericarp, filaments, [the deities of] dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereignty, the sun, moon, and fire, the powers of the filaments, and Manonmanī in the pericarp—having thus conceived the seat in brief with ‘To the endless seat of Manonmanī’, he should meditate above that on Sadāśiva, whose body consists of the ritual limbs and energies, made of the energies beginning with Nivṛtti and accompanied by the sixfold [principles].

sanskrit_iast: ubhābhyāṃ sapuṣpābhyāṃ hastābhyāmaṅguṣṭhena puṣpamāpīḍya āpāhanamudrayā śanaiḥśanaiḥ hṛdayādimastamāropya hṛdā saha mūlaṃ plutamuccāryasadyena bindusthānādabhyadhikaṃ dīpaśikhākāraṃ sarvatomukhahastaṃ vyāpyavyāpakamābāhya sthāpayet //
meaning: उभाभ्यां सपुष्पाभ्यां हस्ताभ्यामङ्गुष्ठेन पुष्पमापीड्य आपाहनमुद्रया शनैःशनैः हृदयादिमस्तमारोप्य हृदा सह मूलं प्लुतमुच्चार्यसद्येन बिन्दुस्थानादभ्यधिकं दीपशिखाकारं सर्वतोमुखहस्तं व्याप्यव्यापकमाबाह्य स्थापयेत् //
text_mt: Holding a flower with both hands that contain flowers, pressing it with the thumbs, using the invocation-gesture, raising it gradually from the heart to the head, uttering the root mantra protracted along with the heart-mantra, he should summon and establish with the Sadyojāta mantra that which transcends the station of the Bindu, having the form of a lamp-flame, with faces and hands on all sides, pervasive and encompassing.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvahṛdā śivaśaktisamavāyena paramīkaraṇamamṛtīkaraṇaṃ hṛdayādimūlena sadyenāvāhanaṃ hṛdā mūlopari aghoreṇa sannirodaṃ hṛdā mūlopari puruṣeṇa sānnidhyaṃ hṛdā mūlena īśānena pūjayediti upadeśaḥ //
meaning: पूर्वहृदा शिवशक्तिसमवायेन परमीकरणममृतीकरणं हृदयादिमूलेन सद्येनावाहनं हृदा मूलोपरि अघोरेण सन्निरोदं हृदा मूलोपरि पुरुषेण सान्निध्यं हृदा मूलेन ईशानेन पूजयेदिति उपदेशः //
text_mt: With the former heart-mantra, by union with the Śiva-energy, supreme transformation and immortalization; invocation from the heart with the root and Sadyojāta mantra; confinement above the root with the heart-mantra and Aghora; presence above the root with the heart-mantra and Tatpuruṣa; he should worship with the heart-mantra, the root mantra, and Īśāna: such is the instruction.

sanskrit_iast: pañcamantrasahitena yathāpūrvamātmano dehanirmāṇaṃ tathā devasyāpi vahneścaivamupadeśaḥ //
meaning: पञ्चमन्त्रसहितेन यथापूर्वमात्मनो देहनिर्माणं तथा देवस्यापि वह्नेश्चैवमुपदेशः //
text_mt: Just as the formation of one’s own body was done previously with the five mantras, so also is that of the deity and of the fire: such is the instruction.

sanskrit_iast: rūpakadhyānaṃ kṛtvā mūlena namaskārāntamāpādya svadhāntamācamanīyaṃ sarvaṃ namaskārāntaṃ vā svāhākārāntamarghyaṃ mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ vauṣaḍantena sarvaṃ namaskārāntaṃ hṛdā vā īśānena vā rudragāyatryā oṃnamaḥ śivāyeti mūlamantreṇa vā pūjayet //
meaning: रूपकध्यानं कृत्वा मूलेन नमस्कारान्तमापाद्य स्वधान्तमाचमनीयं सर्वं नमस्कारान्तं वा स्वाहाकारान्तमर्घ्यं मूलेन पुष्पाञ्जलिं वौषडन्तेन सर्वं नमस्कारान्तं हृदा वा ईशानेन वा रुद्रगायत्र्या ओंनमः शिवायेति मूलमन्त्रेण वा पूजयेत् //
text_mt: Having performed meditation on the form, making it end in ‘namaḥ’ with the root mantra, sipping-water ending in ‘svadhā’—or everything ending in ‘namaḥ’—guest-water ending in ‘svāhā’, a handful of flowers with the root mantra ending in ‘vauṣaṭ’—or everything ending in ‘namaḥ’—he should worship with the heart-mantra, or with Īśāna, or with the Rudragāyatrī, or with the root mantra ‘oṃ namaḥ śivāya’.

sanskrit_iast: puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā punardhūṣācamanīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhena puṣpāvasaraṇaṃ visarjanaṃ mantrodakena mūlena saṃsnāpya sarvadravyābhiṣekamīśānena pratidravyamaṣṭapuṣpaṃ dattvaivamarghyaṃ ca gandhapuṣpadhūpācamanīyaṃ phaḍantāstreṇa pūjāpasaraṇaṃ śuddhodakena mūlena saṃsnāpya piṣṭāmalagādibhiḥ //
meaning: पुष्पाञ्जलिं दत्त्वा पुनर्धूषाचमनीयं षष्ठेन पुष्पावसरणं विसर्जनं मन्त्रोदकेन मूलेन संस्नाप्य सर्वद्रव्याभिषेकमीशानेन प्रतिद्रव्यमष्टपुष्पं दत्त्वैवमर्घ्यं च गन्धपुष्पधूपाचमनीयं फडन्तास्त्रेण पूजापसरणं शुद्धोदकेन मूलेन संस्नाप्य पिष्टामलगादिभिः //
text_mt: Having offered a handful of flowers, again incense and sipping-water, the removal of the flowers with the sixth mantra, the dismissal; having bathed [the liṅga] with mantra-water using the root mantra, having performed the unction of all substances with Īśāna, having offered eight flowers for each substance and likewise guest-water, perfume, flowers, incense, and sipping-water, having removed the worship with the weapon-mantra ending in ‘phaṭ’, having bathed [it] with pure water using the root mantra, with paste, āmalaka fruits, and so forth;

sanskrit_iast: uṣṇodakena haridrādyena liṅgamūrti pīṭhasahitāṃ viśodhya gandhodakahiraṇyodakamantrodakena rudrādhyāyaṃ paṭhamānaḥ nīlarudratvaritarudrapañcabrahmādibhiḥ namaḥ śivāyeti snāpayet //
meaning: उष्णोदकेन हरिद्राद्येन लिङ्गमूर्ति पीठसहितां विशोध्य गन्धोदकहिरण्योदकमन्त्रोदकेन रुद्राध्यायं पठमानः नीलरुद्रत्वरितरुद्रपञ्चब्रह्मादिभिः नमः शिवायेति स्नापयेत् //
text_mt: having cleansed the liṅga-form together with the pedestal with hot water, turmeric, and the like, reciting the Rudrādhyāya, with fragrant water, golden water, and mantra-water, with the Nīlarudra, Tvaritarudra, the five Brahmamantras, and so forth, he should bathe it with ‘namaḥ śivāya’.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhni puṣpaṃ nidhāyaivaṃ na śūnyaṃ liṅgamastakaṃ kuryādatra ślokaḥ //
meaning: मूर्ध्नि पुष्पं निधायैवं न शून्यं लिङ्गमस्तकं कुर्यादत्र श्लोकः //
text_mt: Having placed a flower on the top, he should not leave the head of the liṅga bare; here is a verse on this:

sanskrit_iast:
yasya rāṣṭre tu liṅgasya mastakaṃ śūnyalakṣaṇam /
tasyālakṣmīrmahā rogo durbhikṣaṃ vāhanakṣayaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य राष्ट्रे तु लिङ्गस्य मस्तकं शून्यलक्षणम् /
तस्यालक्ष्मीर्महा रोगो दुर्भिक्षं वाहनक्षयः //
text_mt: “In whose kingdom the head of the liṅga / bears the mark of being bare, / misfortune, great disease, famine, / and destruction of vehicles befall him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpariharedrājā dharmakamārthamuktaye /
śūnye liṅge svayaṃ rājā rāṣṭraṃ caiva praṇaśyati //
meaning:
तस्मात्परिहरेद्राजा धर्मकमार्थमुक्तये /
शून्ये लिङ्गे स्वयं राजा राष्ट्रं चैव प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: Therefore the king should avoid it, / for the sake of dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation; / when the liṅga is bare, the king himself / and his realm are destroyed.”

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ susnāpyārghyañca dattvā saṃmṛjya vastreṇa gandhapuṣpavastrālaṅkārādīṃśca mūlena dadyāt //
meaning: एवं सुस्नाप्यार्घ्यञ्च दत्त्वा संमृज्य वस्त्रेण गन्धपुष्पवस्त्रालङ्कारादींश्च मूलेन दद्यात् //
text_mt: Having bathed it well thus, having given guest-water, and having wiped it with a cloth, he should offer perfume, flowers, cloth, ornaments, and the like with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast: dhūpācamanīyadīpanaivedyādīṃśca mūlena pradhānenopari pūjanaṃ pavitrīkaraṇamityuktam //
meaning: धूपाचमनीयदीपनैवेद्यादींश्च मूलेन प्रधानेनोपरि पूजनं पवित्रीकरणमित्युक्तम् //
text_mt: Incense, sipping-water, lamps, food offerings, and so forth [are offered] with the root mantra; worship and sanctification upon the Pradhāna are thus stated.

sanskrit_iast:
ārārtidīpādīṃścaiva dhenumudrāmudritāni kavacenāvaguṇṭhināni ṣaṣṭhena rakṣitāni liṅge ca liṅgasyādhaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ ca darśayet //
mūlena nanaskāraṃ vijñāpyāvāhanastāpanasannirodhamānnidhyapādyacamanīyārghyagandhapuṣpadhūpanaivedyācamanīyahasto dvatanamukhavāsādyupacārayuktaṃ brahmāṅgabhogamārgeṇa pūjayet// 23.34 //
meaning:
आरार्तिदीपादींश्चैव धेनुमुद्रामुद्रितानि कवचेनावगुण्ठिनानि षष्ठेन रक्षितानि लिङ्गे च लिङ्गस्याधः साधारणं च दर्शयेत् //
मूलेन ननस्कारं विज्ञाप्यावाहनस्तापनसन्निरोधमान्निध्यपाद्यचमनीयार्घ्यगन्धपुष्पधूपनैवेद्याचमनीयहस्तो द्वतनमुखवासाद्युपचारयुक्तं ब्रह्माङ्गभोगमार्गेण पूजयेत्// 23.34 //
text_mt:
He should display waving lights and the like, sealed with the cow-gesture, veiled with the armour-mantra, and protected with the sixth [mantra], on the liṅga and generally below the liṅga.

Offering obeisance with the root mantra, having addressed [him] with invocation, installation, confinement, presence, water for the feet, water for sipping, guest-water, perfume, flowers, incense, food offerings, water for sipping, unguent for the hands, and mouth-perfumes, accompanied by services, one should worship [him] through the path of the enjoyment of the limbs of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sakaladhyānaṃ niṣkalasmāraṇaṃ parāvaradhyānaṃ mūlamantrajapaḥ /
daśāṃśaṃ brahmāṅgajapasamarpaṇamātmanivedanastutinamaskārādayaśca gurupūjā ca pūrvano dakṣiṇe vināyakasya //
meaning:
सकलध्यानं निष्कलस्मारणं परावरध्यानं मूलमन्त्रजपः /
दशांशं ब्रह्माङ्गजपसमर्पणमात्मनिवेदनस्तुतिनमस्कारादयश्च गुरुपूजा च पूर्वनो दक्षिणे विनायकस्य //
text_mt: Meditation on the qualified [form], contemplation on the unqualified, meditation on the higher and lower, recitation of the root mantra, / dedicating a tenth part as recitation of the limbs of Brahman, self-offering, praise, obeisances, and so forth, and worship of the guru first, [and then] of Vināyaka in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau cānte ca saṃpūjyo vighneśo jagadīśvaraḥ /
daivataiśca dvijaiścaiva sarvakarmārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
आदौ चान्ते च संपूज्यो विघ्नेशो जगदीश्वरः /
दैवतैश्च द्विजैश्चैव सर्वकर्मार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt: At the beginning and at the end, the lord of obstacles, the sovereign of the universe, should be worshipped / by deities and by twice-borns alike, for the attainment of success in all rites and purposes.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śivaṃ pūjayedevaṃ liṅge vā sthāṇḍilepi vā /
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ varṣamātreṇa karmaṇā //
meaning:
यः शिवं पूजयेदेवं लिङ्गे वा स्थाण्डिलेपि वा /
स याति शिवसायुज्यं वर्षमात्रेण कर्मणा //
text_mt: Whoever worships Śiva thus, whether in a liṅga or on an altar, / attains union with Śiva through this rite in merely a year.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgārcakaśca ṣaṇmāsānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
sapta pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā daṇḍavatpraṇamedvudhaḥ //
meaning:
लिङ्गार्चकश्च षण्मासान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
सप्त प्रदक्षिणाः कृत्वा दण्डवत्प्रणमेद्वुधः //
text_mt: And one who worships the liṅga [attains it] in six months; no doubt should be entertained here. / Having made seven circumambulations, the wise person should bow down like a staff.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇakramapādena aśvamedhaphalaṃ śatam /
tasmātsaṃpūjayonnityaṃ sarvakarmārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणक्रमपादेन अश्वमेधफलं शतम् /
तस्मात्संपूजयोन्नित्यं सर्वकर्मार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt: At each step in the sequence of circumambulation, there is a hundredfold fruit of a horse-sacrifice. / Therefore, one should worship [him] daily for the attainment of success in all rites and purposes.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogārthī bhogamāpnoti rājyārthī rājyamāpnuyāt /
putrārthī tanayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rogī rogātpramucyate //
meaning:
भोगार्थी भोगमाप्नोति राज्यार्थी राज्यमाप्नुयात् /
पुत्रार्थी तनयं श्रेष्ठं रोगी रोगात्प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: One who desires enjoyment obtains enjoyment; one who desires a kingdom may obtain a kingdom; / one who desires a son [obtains] an excellent son; the sick person is freed from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
yānyāṃścintayate kāmāṃstāṃnprāpnoti mānavaḥ //
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यान्यांश्चिन्तयते कामांस्तांन्प्राप्नोति मानवः //
इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे चतुर्विशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whatever desires a person contemplates, those he attains.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter in the second part of the glorious Liṅgamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śailādiruvāca
śivāgnikāryaṃ vakṣyāmi śivena paribhāṣitam /
janayitvāgrataḥ prācīṃ śubhe deśe susaṃskṛte //
meaning:
शैलादिरुवाच
शिवाग्निकार्यं वक्ष्यामि शिवेन परिभाषितम् /
जनयित्वाग्रतः प्राचीं शुभे देशे सुसंस्कृते //
text_mt: Śailādi said: / I shall declare the ritual of Śiva's fire, as enunciated by Śiva, / having first determined the east in an auspicious, well-prepared site.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ ca kuryātsūtratrayaṃśubham /
caturastrīkṛte kṣetre kuryātkuṇḍāni yatnataḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वाग्रमुत्तराग्रं च कुर्यात्सूत्रत्रयंशुभम् /
चतुरस्त्रीकृते क्षेत्रे कुर्यात्कुण्डानि यत्नतः //
text_mt: One should draw three auspicious lines pointing east and pointing north. / In the squared-off ground, one should diligently prepare the pits.

sanskrit_iast:
nityahomāgnikuṇḍaṃ ca trimekhalasamāyutam /
catustridvyaṅgulāyāmā mekhalā hastamātrataḥ //
meaning:
नित्यहोमाग्निकुण्डं च त्रिमेखलसमायुतम् /
चतुस्त्रिद्व्यङ्गुलायामा मेखला हस्तमात्रतः //
text_mt: And the fire-pit for the daily oblation is endowed with three tiers. / The tiers are four, three, and two finger-breadths in extent, [rising] from a measure of one cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
hastamātraṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ yoniḥ prādeśamātrataḥ /
aśvatthapatravadyonīṃ mekhalopari kalpayet //
meaning:
हस्तमात्रं भवेत्कुण्डं योनिः प्रादेशमात्रतः /
अश्वत्थपत्रवद्योनीं मेखलोपरि कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: The pit should be one cubit in measure; the vulva-channel is a span in measure. / One should fashion the vulva-channel like an aśvattha leaf upon the tier.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍamadhye tu nābhiḥ syādaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam /
prādeśamātraṃ vidhinā kārayedbrahmaṇaḥ suta //
meaning:
कुण्डमध्ये तु नाभिः स्यादष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम् /
प्रादेशमात्रं विधिना कारयेद्ब्रह्मणः सुत //
text_mt: In the middle of the pit there should be a navel, eight-petalled, with a pericarp, / measuring a span; O son of Brahmā, one should have it made according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhenollekhanaṃ proktaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ varmaṇā smṛtam /
netreṇālokya vai kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍrekhāḥ kārayedbudhaḥ //
meaning:
षष्ठेनोल्लेखनं प्रोक्तं प्रोक्षणं वर्मणा स्मृतम् /
नेत्रेणालोक्य वै कुण्डं षड्रेखाः कारयेद्बुधः //
text_mt: Marking [the pit] is said [to be done] with the sixth [mantra]; sprinkling is remembered to be with the armor [mantra]. / Having looked upon the pit with the eye [mantra], the wise person should make six lines.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgāyatena viprendra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
uttarāgrāḥ śivā rekhāḥ prokṣayedvarmaṇā punaḥ //
meaning:
प्रागायतेन विप्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः /
उत्तराग्राः शिवा रेखाः प्रोक्षयेद्वर्मणा पुनः //
text_mt: The lines pointing east, O best of Brahmins, are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara; / the lines pointing north are Śiva; one should sprinkle them again with the armor [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
śamīpippalasaṃbhūtāmaraṇīṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulām /
mathitvā vahnibījena śaktinyāsaṃ hṛdaiva tu //
meaning:
शमीपिप्पलसंभूतामरणीं षोडशाङ्गुलाम् /
मथित्वा वह्निबीजेन शक्तिन्यासं हृदैव तु //
text_mt: Having churned the fire-drill sixteen finger-breadths in size, born of the śamī and pippala trees, / with the fire-seed-mantra, [one performs] the installation of the power with the heart [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣipedvidhinā vahnimanvādhāya yathāvidhi /
tūṣṇīṃ prādeśamātraistu yājñikaiḥ śakalaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रक्षिपेद्विधिना वह्निमन्वाधाय यथाविधि /
तूष्णीं प्रादेशमात्रैस्तु याज्ञिकैः शकलैः शुभैः //
text_mt: Having added fuel according to rule, one should cast in the fire according to rule, / silently, with auspicious sacrificial kindling-sticks measuring merely a span.

sanskrit_iast:
parisaṃmohanaṃ kuryājjalenāṣṭasu dikṣu vai /
paristīrya vidhānena prāgādyevamanukramāt //
meaning:
परिसंमोहनं कुर्याज्जलेनाष्टसु दिक्षु वै /
परिस्तीर्य विधानेन प्रागाद्येवमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: One should perform the encircling with water in the eight directions; / having strewn [grass] around according to the rite, beginning from the east in this order:

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāgraṃ purastāddhi prāgagraṃ dakṣiṇe punaḥ /
paścime cottarāgraṃ tu saumye pūrvāgrameva tu //
meaning:
उत्तराग्रं पुरस्ताद्धि प्रागग्रं दक्षिणे पुनः /
पश्चिमे चोत्तराग्रं तु सौम्ये पूर्वाग्रमेव तु //
text_mt: pointing north in the east, and pointing east in the south; / pointing north in the west, and pointing east in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
aindre caindrāgramāvāhya yāmya evaṃ vidhīyate /
saumyasyoparicāndrāgnaṃ vāruṇāgnamadhastataḥ //
meaning:
ऐन्द्रे चैन्द्राग्रमावाह्य याम्य एवं विधीयते /
सौम्यस्योपरिचान्द्राग्नं वारुणाग्नमधस्ततः //
text_mt: Invoking [the fire] pointing east in the east, the same is prescribed in the south; / above the north pointing east, and beneath pointing west.

sanskrit_iast:
dvandvarūpeṇa pātrāṇi barhaḥṣvāsādya suvrata /
adhomukhāni sarvāṇi dravyāṇi ca tathottare //
meaning:
द्वन्द्वरूपेण पात्राणि बर्हःष्वासाद्य सुव्रत /
अधोमुखानि सर्वाणि द्रव्याणि च तथोत्तरे //
text_mt: Having placed the vessels in pairs upon the sacrificial grasses, O you of good vows, / all turned downwards, and likewise the materials in the north,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari nyaseddarbhāñchivaṃ dakṣiṇatonyaset /
pūjayenmūlamantreṇa paścāddhomaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
तस्योपरि न्यसेद्दर्भाञ्छिवं दक्षिणतोन्यसेत् /
पूजयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण पश्चाद्धोमं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: one should place darbha grasses upon it; one should place Śiva in the south. / One should worship with the root mantra; thereafter, one should perform the oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇīpātramādāya pūrayedaṃbunā punaḥ /
prādesamātrau tu kuśau sthāpayedudakopari //
meaning:
प्रोक्षणीपात्रमादाय पूरयेदंबुना पुनः /
प्रादेसमात्रौ तु कुशौ स्थापयेदुदकोपरि //
text_mt: Taking the vessel for sprinkling-water, one should fill it again with water. / One should place two kuśa blades, measuring a span, upon the water.

sanskrit_iast:
plāvayecca kuśāgraṃ tu vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ /
vikīrya sarvapātrāṇi susaṃprokṣya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
प्लावयेच्च कुशाग्रं तु वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः /
विकीर्य सर्वपात्राणि सुसंप्रोक्ष्य विधानतः //
text_mt: One should submerge the tip of the kuśa [reciting] 'By the rays of the wealthy sun,' / and having strewn all the vessels and sprinkled them thoroughly according to the rite,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇītāpātramādāya pūrayedaṃbunā punaḥ /
anyodakakuśagraistu samyagācchādya suvrata //
meaning:
प्रणीतापात्रमादाय पूरयेदंबुना पुनः /
अन्योदककुशग्रैस्तु सम्यगाच्छाद्य सुव्रत //
text_mt: taking the praṇītā vessel, one should fill it again with water; / having covered it completely with the tips of kuśa grasses with other water, O you of good vows,

sanskrit_iast:
hastābhyāṃ nāsikaṃ pātramaiśānyāṃ diśi vinyaset /
ājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kuryātpaścimottarataḥ śubham //
meaning:
हस्ताभ्यां नासिकं पात्रमैशान्यां दिशि विन्यसेत् /
आज्याधिश्रयणं कुर्यात्पश्चिमोत्तरतः शुभम् //
text_mt: with both hands one should place the vessel at nose-level in the north-east direction. / One should perform the heating of the clarified butter in the north-west, an auspicious act.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmamiśrāṃstathāṅgārān grāhayetsakalena vai /
paścimottarato nītvā tatra cājyaṃ pratāpayet //
meaning:
भस्ममिश्रांस्तथाङ्गारान् ग्राहयेत्सकलेन वै /
पश्चिमोत्तरतो नीत्वा तत्र चाज्यं प्रतापयेत् //
text_mt: One should take burning embers mixed with ashes with the sakala [mantra]; / having brought them to the north-west, one should heat the clarified butter there.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśānagnau tu prajvālya paryagniṃ tribhirācaret /
tānsarvāṃstatra niḥkṣipya cāgre cājyaṃ nidhāpayet //
meaning:
कुशानग्नौ तु प्रज्वाल्य पर्यग्निं त्रिभिराचरेत् /
तान्सर्वांस्तत्र निःक्षिप्य चाग्रे चाज्यं निधापयेत् //
text_mt: Igniting kuśa blades in the fire, one should carry the fire around [it] three times. / Having cast them all therein, one should set down the clarified butter in front.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhamātrau tu kuśau prakṣālya vidhinaiva tu /
paryagniṃ ca tataḥ kuryāttaireva navabhiḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रौ तु कुशौ प्रक्षाल्य विधिनैव तु /
पर्यग्निं च ततः कुर्यात्तैरेव नवभिः पुनः //
text_mt: Having washed two kuśa blades measuring the length of a thumb according to rule, / one should then perform the carrying of fire around [it] again with those nine [blades].

sanskrit_iast:
paryagniṃ ca punaḥ kuryāttadājyamavaropayet /
athāpakarṣayet pātraṃ krameṇottarapaścime //
meaning:
पर्यग्निं च पुनः कुर्यात्तदाज्यमवरोपयेत् /
अथापकर्षयेत् पात्रं क्रमेणोत्तरपश्चिमे //
text_mt: One should perform the carrying of fire around [it] again, and take down that clarified butter. / Then one should move the vessel sequentially to the north-west.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyujya cāgniṃ kāṣṭhena prakṣālyāropya paścime /
ājyasyotpavanaṃ kuryātpavitrābhyāṃ sahaiva tu //
meaning:
संयुज्य चाग्निं काष्ठेन प्रक्षाल्यारोप्य पश्चिमे /
आज्यस्योत्पवनं कुर्यात्पवित्राभ्यां सहैव तु //
text_mt: Uniting the fire with wood, having washed and placed it in the west, / one should perform the purification of the clarified butter together with the two strainers.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagādāya hastābhyāṃ pravāheṇa yathākramam /
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu ubhābhyāṃ mūlavidyayā //
meaning:
पृथगादाय हस्ताभ्यां प्रवाहेण यथाक्रमम् /
अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां तु उभाभ्यां मूलविद्यया //
text_mt: Taking them separately with both hands, through the stream in proper order, / with both the thumb and the ring finger, using the root formula,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyukṣya dāpayedagnau pavitre ghṛtapaṅkite /
sauvarṇaṃ sruksruvaṃ kuryādratnimātreṇa suvrata //
meaning:
अभ्युक्ष्य दापयेदग्नौ पवित्रे घृतपङ्किते /
सौवर्णं स्रुक्स्रुवं कुर्याद्रत्निमात्रेण सुव्रत //
text_mt: having sprinkled, one should cast into the fire the two strainers smeared with ghee. / One should make the ladle and spoon of gold, measuring an aratni, O you of good vows,

sanskrit_iast:
rājataṃ vā yathānyāyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam /
athavā yājñikairvṛkṣaiḥ kartavyau sruksruvā vubhau //
meaning:
राजतं वा यथान्यायं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् /
अथवा याज्ञिकैर्वृक्षैः कर्तव्यौ स्रुक्स्रुवा वुभौ //
text_mt: or of silver according to rule, endowed with all auspicious marks; / or both the ladle and the spoon should be made of sacrificial trees.

sanskrit_iast:
aratnimātramāyāmaṃ tatpotre tu bilaṃ bhavet /
ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhṝṃ daṇḍamūlaṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
अरत्निमात्रमायामं तत्पोत्रे तु बिलं भवेत् /
षडङ्गुलपरीणाहॄं दण्डमूलं महामुने //
text_mt: The length should be the measure of an aratni; there should be a cavity in its snout. / The base of the handle should have a circumference of six finger-breadths, O great sage;

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhaṃ kaṇṭhānālaṃ syātpuṣkaraṃ mūlavadbhavet /
govālasadṛśaṃ daṇḍaṃ mruvāgraṃ nāsikāsamam //
meaning:
तदर्धं कण्ठानालं स्यात्पुष्करं मूलवद्भवेत् /
गोवालसदृशं दण्डं म्रुवाग्रं नासिकासमम् //
text_mt: its throat and tube should be half of that; the lotus-bowl should be like the base. / The handle should resemble a cow's tail; the tip of the spoon should be like a nose,

sanskrit_iast:
puṭadvayasamāyuktaṃ muktādyena prapūritam /
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmamaṣṭāṅgulasavistaram //
meaning:
पुटद्वयसमायुक्तं मुक्ताद्येन प्रपूरितम् /
षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुलायाममष्टाङ्गुलसविस्तरम् //
text_mt: furnished with two folds, filled with pearls and the like, / thirty-six finger-breadths in length, eight finger-breadths in breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
utsedhastu tadardhaṃ syātsūtreṇa samitaṃ tataḥ /
saptāṅgulaṃ bhavedāsyaṃ vistarāyāmataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
उत्सेधस्तु तदर्धं स्यात्सूत्रेण समितं ततः /
सप्ताङ्गुलं भवेदास्यं विस्तरायामतः पुनः //
text_mt: Its height should be half of that, measured by a cord from there. / Its mouth should be seven finger-breadths in width and length;

sanskrit_iast:
tribhāgaikaṃ bhavedagraṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ parityajet /
kaṇṭhaṃ ca dvyaṅgulāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ caturaṅgulam //
meaning:
त्रिभागैकं भवेदग्रं कृत्वा शेषं परित्यजेत् /
कण्ठं च द्व्यङ्गुलायामं विस्तारं चतुरङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: the tip should be one-third; having made it, one should discard the remainder. / The neck is two finger-breadths in length and four finger-breadths in width.

sanskrit_iast:
vediraṣṭāṅgulāyāmāvistārastatpramāṇataḥ /
tasya madhye bilaṃ kuryāccaturaṅgulamānataḥ //
meaning:
वेदिरष्टाङ्गुलायामाविस्तारस्तत्प्रमाणतः /
तस्य मध्ये बिलं कुर्याच्चतुरङ्गुलमानतः //
text_mt: The altar is eight finger-breadths in length, and its width is of that same measure. / In its middle, one should make a cavity measuring four finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
bilaṃ suvartitaṃ kuryādaṣṭapatraṃ sukarṇikam /
parito bilabāhye tu paṭṭikārdhāṅgulena tu //
meaning:
बिलं सुवर्तितं कुर्यादष्टपत्रं सुकर्णिकम् /
परितो बिलबाह्ये तु पट्टिकार्धाङ्गुलेन तु //
text_mt: One should make the cavity well-rounded, eight-petalled, with an attractive pericarp. / All around, outside the cavity, there should be a border of half a finger-breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbrāhme ca vinidaṃ tu padmapatravicitritam /
yavadvayapramāṇena tadbrāhme paṭṭikā bhavet //
meaning:
तद्ब्राह्मे च विनिदं तु पद्मपत्रविचित्रितम् /
यवद्वयप्रमाणेन तद्ब्राह्मे पट्टिका भवेत् //
text_mt: In its Brahmā-portion is that cavity, decorated with lotus petals. / Measuring two barley-corns, there should be a border in that Brahmā-portion.

sanskrit_iast:
vedikāmadhyato randhraṃ kaniṣṭhāṅgulamānataḥ /
khātaṃ yāvanmukhāntaḥ syādbilamānaṃ tu nimragam //
meaning:
वेदिकामध्यतो रन्ध्रं कनिष्ठाङ्गुलमानतः /
खातं यावन्मुखान्तः स्याद्बिलमानं तु निम्रगम् //
text_mt: From the middle of the platform there is an aperture measuring the little finger, / a hollow extending as far as the mouth, with the cavity sloping downward.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ nālaṃ daṇḍāgre daṇḍikātrayam /
ardhāṅgulavivṛddhyātu kartavyaṃ caturaṅgulam //
meaning:
दण्डं षडङ्गुलं नालं दण्डाग्रे दण्डिकात्रयम् /
अर्धाङ्गुलविवृद्ध्यातु कर्तव्यं चतुरङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: The handle is a six-finger-breadth tube; at the tip of the handle are three small rods. / It should be made four finger-breadths, increasing by half a finger-breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśāṅgulāyāmaṃ daṇḍamūle ghaṭaṃ bhavet /
dvyaṅgulastu bhavetkuṃbho nābhiṃ vidyāddaśāṅgulam //
meaning:
त्रयोदशाङ्गुलायामं दण्डमूले घटं भवेत् /
द्व्यङ्गुलस्तु भवेत्कुंभो नाभिं विद्याद्दशाङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: There should be a pot of thirteen fingers' length at the base of the handle; / the vessel should be two fingers, and one should know the hub to be ten fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
vedimadhye tathā kṛtvā pādaṃ kuryācca dvyaṅgulam /
padmapṛṣṭhasamākāraṃ pādaṃ vai karṇikākṛtim //
meaning:
वेदिमध्ये तथा कृत्वा पादं कुर्याच्च द्व्यङ्गुलम् /
पद्मपृष्ठसमाकारं पादं वै कर्णिकाकृतिम् //
text_mt: Having made it thus in the middle of the altar, one should make a foot of two fingers; / the foot should indeed have the appearance of the back of a lotus, shaped like a pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
gajoṣṭhasadṛśākāraṃ tasya pṛṣṭhākṛtirbhavet /
abhicārādikāryeṣu kuryātkṛṣṇāyasena tu //
meaning:
गजोष्ठसदृशाकारं तस्य पृष्ठाकृतिर्भवेत् /
अभिचारादिकार्येषु कुर्यात्कृष्णायसेन तु //
text_mt: The form of its back should resemble the lip of an elephant. / But in rites of sorcery and the like, one should make it of black iron.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatkuśenaiva sruksruvau mārjayet punaḥ /
agramagreṇa saṃśodhya madhyaṃ madhyena suvrata //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशत्कुशेनैव स्रुक्स्रुवौ मार्जयेत् पुनः /
अग्रमग्रेण संशोध्य मध्यं मध्येन सुव्रत //
text_mt: Then, with twenty-five blades of kuśa grass, one should wipe the sruc and sruva ladles, / cleansing tip with tip, middle with middle, O one of good vows,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlaṃ mūlena vidhinā agnau tāpya hṛdā punaḥ /
ājyasthālī praṇītā ca prokṣaṇī tisra eva ca //
meaning:
मूलं मूलेन विधिना अग्नौ ताप्य हृदा पुनः /
आज्यस्थाली प्रणीता च प्रोक्षणी तिस्र एव च //
text_mt: [and] base with base according to the rule, having heated them again in the fire with the heart-mantra. / And there are three [vessels]: the ghee-pot, the praṇītā, and the prokṣaṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇī rājatī vāpi tāmrī vā mṛnmayī tu vā /
anyathā naiva kartavyaṃ śāntike pauṣṭike śubhe //
meaning:
सौवर्णी राजती वापि ताम्री वा मृन्मयी तु वा /
अन्यथा नैव कर्तव्यं शान्तिके पौष्टिके शुभे //
text_mt: they may be of gold, silver, copper, or made of clay. / It should never be done otherwise in auspicious rites for appeasement and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
āyasī tvabhicāre tu śāntike mṛnmayī tu vā /
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ pātrāṇāṃ mukhamucyate //
meaning:
आयसी त्वभिचारे तु शान्तिके मृन्मयी तु वा /
षडङ्गुलं सुविस्तीर्णं पात्राणां मुखमुच्यते //
text_mt: In sorcery, however, it should be of iron, or in appeasement of clay. / The mouth of the vessels is said to be six fingers wide.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇī dvyaṅgulotsedhā praṇītā dvyaṅgulādhikā /
ājyasthālī tatastasyā utsedho dvyaṅgulādhikaḥ //
meaning:
प्रोक्षणी द्व्यङ्गुलोत्सेधा प्रणीता द्व्यङ्गुलाधिका /
आज्यस्थाली ततस्तस्या उत्सेधो द्व्यङ्गुलाधिकः //
text_mt: The prokṣaṇī is two fingers high, the praṇītā two fingers higher; / then the height of the ghee-pot is two fingers higher than that.

sanskrit_iast:
yaiḥ samidbhirhutaṃ proktaṃ taireva paridhirbhavet /
madhyāṅgulaparīṇāhā avakraā nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
यैः समिद्भिर्हुतं प्रोक्तं तैरेव परिधिर्भवेत् /
मध्याङ्गुलपरीणाहा अवक्रआ निर्व्रणाः समाः //
text_mt: The boundary sticks should be made from the very same firewood with which the oblation was prescribed, / having the circumference of the middle finger, unbent, free of flaws, and straight.

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśadaṅgulāyāmāstisraḥ paridhayaḥsmṛtāḥ /
dvātriṃśadaṅgulāyāmaistriṃśaddarbhaiḥ paristaret //
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशदङ्गुलायामास्तिस्रः परिधयःस्मृताः /
द्वात्रिंशदङ्गुलायामैस्त्रिंशद्दर्भैः परिस्तरेत् //
